dbe skrun gsal bshad/'dzam gling yang steng du chags pa'i rang re'i bod mi rigs 'di nyid la lo rgyus ring zhing mi rigs kyi thun min gyi khyad chos ldan pa'i rig gnas gzhan dring mi 'jog pa zhig yod gshis/ deng sang 'dzam gling du bod rig pa zhes bod kyi srid 'byor rig gsum gtso bor gyur pa'i bod spyi tshogs kyi khyab khongs so sor zhib 'jug bgyi ba'i rig lam gsar ba 'di gsar dar byung ste/rgyal khab dang sa khul mang po zhig gis zhib 'jug las khungs ched btsugs kyis do snang chen po byas dang byed bzhin yod pa spyi dang / sgos su rang rgyal du nye ba'i lo 'ga' nas bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug gi las ka dbyar mtsho bzhin du rgyas pa'i dgos mkho'i ched dang / lhag par rgyal nang du spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi dpal yon gsum 'dzugs spel gyi rba rlabs 'phyur bzhin yod pa'ang mi'i shes rig la rag las stabs/ mi rigs so so'i rtsa ba'i rig gnas phul byung rnams nyams pa sor chud dang ma nyams gong 'phel gtong ba'i dgos mkho bcas la dmigs te/ 'di ga dpe skrun khang gis rgyal khab rim pa'i tshan rig zhib 'jug gi rnam grangs gtso gras su tshud pa'i bod yig gi 〈bka' 'gyur 〉 dang 〈bstan 'gyur 〉 dpe bsdur ma par skrun 'grem spel byas dang byed mur yod pa ma zad/ da dung bod kyi mkhas dbang snga rabs pa dag gis mdzad pa'i gsung 'bum thams cad legs sgrig bya rgyu'i 'char gzhi ltar/ bod yig gi gna' dpe'i dpe dkon dpe tshogs du ma par du bskrun dang skrun bzhin yod la/ da lam rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan ras dgyes pa'i dga' ston du 'bul bya ni 〈rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum 〉 zhes pa ste/ 'di ni dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i skabs su byon pa'i tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i gsung chos rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs (pod 1428yod pa )pa yin la/ yongs grags su rgyal dbang lnga pa zhes pa khong ni tā la'i bla ma sku phreng thams cad las brtsams chos ches mang zhing / bod kyi chos srid rig gnas thad la mdzad pa ha cang rgya chen po gnang yod pa'i thun min skyes mchog cig yin/

rmongs pa'i nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman mchog bdud rtsi lta bu de dag gi ro bcud gangs can pa'i lus sems su shog bu snum tshos bzhin du sims pa nas bzung / skye bo phal pa dag gi blang dor 'byed pa'i shes rab kyi tshad kyang ches mthon por son te sgo gsum dge bcu'i las la brtson pa dang / byams dang snying rjes rgyud dul zhing / ya rabs dang gshis bzang gi mdzes sdug rang chas su ldan sdo'i mi rigs khyad 'phags can zhig tu yar rgyas byung ba'i 'bras bur/ deng gi dus su'ang 'dzam gling yongs su gnas pa'i srid 'byor rig gsum spyi dang / yang sgos tshan rig rtser son gyi yul gru dag gi mi sna grags can rnams kyang yul 'di dang 'di nyid kyi rig gnas la blo kha phyogs sa dang / zhib 'jug bya yul zhig tu gyur don yang de'i phyir lags/'on kyang sems can spyi mthun gyi bsod nams nyams dmas su song ba'i nyer len las/ lo bcu'i god chags kyi khrod du stong gsum nor gyis bkang ste yon du phul na yang blu thabs bral ba'i gangs ljongs kyi khyad noX te/ gsung rab par shing dang bcas pa phal mo che me lha dang chu lha'i zhal du phul zin dag ni bskyar gso bya rgyu'i nus mthu rang cag su la'ang med la/ dus ngan de lta bu'i khrod nas stes dbang gis da lta sa steng du lhag lus gsung rab dag kyang phal che ba dpe rgyun dkon rigs sha stag tu gyur stabs deng skabs rig gnas dngos rdzas kyi lam lugs gzhir bzung bdag srung byed dgos rkyen/ rigs gzhung don gnyer ba'i spyan lam du bstar ma thub pas gsung rab kyi dgos pa ji bzhin ma grub cing / de bas nyen tshabs che ba ni 'byung bzhi sogs kyi gnod pas sa steng du rtsa brlag mi gtong ba'i nges pa med gshis/ 'di kun bdag srung gnad 'khel bya rgyu de g.yin la 'gel thabs med pa'i rang cag kho na'i 'gan 'khri nyid du nges so/ /der brten se ra theg chen gling dang lha ldan gtsug lag khang mnyam 'brel gyis ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang zhes pa'i tshan pa zhig ched du btsugs nas da bar bgrang bya gsum lhag tsam gyi ring la phyogs gnyis nas thun mong du ma thebs sgor sa ya gsum lhag 2

tsam btang ste dpe dkon myur skyob dang / deng skabs slob gnyer ba'i nyer mkho'i ched du gangs can khyad nor zhes pa'i dpe tshogs gsar du bsgrigs te da phan pod phreng nyis brgyar nye ba par skrun zin pa dang / dgon sde dang / spyi tshogs kyi dpe mdzod khang brgya la nye bar cha tshang gnyis re rin med 'bul lam zhus pa phud/ de byings ma gnas tsam gyi thog nas spus 'tshong zhugate/ rgyal bstan la sri zhu dang ris med ser skya thos bsam can rnams kyi thugs 'dun stong thabs zhu mus su mchis/'das pa'i lo zla'i nang nga tsho'i las gzhi la gong rim 'brel yod tshan pa khag gi dbu khrid nas gzigs skyong bla na med pa gnang ba dang / mkhyen dpyod mkha' ltar yangs shing / lhag bsam dung ltar dkar ba'i skyes chen du mas nga tsho'i las kar gdeng 'jog tshad med dang / ma nor lam ston/ mdape mkho 'don gnang ba sogs kyis mtsho ni/ nga tshor phyar ba gru 'degs kyis lhad med rgyab skyor rogs ram gnang bar rjes su yi rangs dang / snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhes zhu ba dang chabs ciga'abyung 'gyur yang ser gtsug nas dge lugs gsung 'bum gtso bor gyur pa'i ris med gsung rab dpe rgyun dkon rigs dang / zhib 'jug tshan pa khag dang / slob grwa khag la nye bar mkho ba'i rig gzhung dag kyang rim pas par skrun zhu rgyu'i 'dun pa snying bcangs su yod pa lags na/ lhag bsam rnam dpyod can gyi ris med ser skya kun nas ma dpe mkho 'don dang / nga tsho'i las gar rtsa che'i lam ston bka' slob mu mthud lhug stsol yod pa mkhyen zhes zhu'o/ /ser ka khug nang bstan dpe rnying 'a sgor bas phyog ga khang nas/spyi lo 279lo'i zla ba pa'i tshes 7la/

bas sgrig ga bshad/7gong sa lnga pa chen po mchog ni spyir sku tshe hril po chos srid gnyis kyis mtshon sku gsung thugs kyi gsang gsum mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas dus 'da' bar mdzad pa dang/ yang sgos mdzad pa'i mchog gsung gi mdzad pa ste/ dam pa gang gis rjes 'jug skal ldan rnams kyi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du bzhag pa'i yid bzhin nor bu las kyang lhag pa'i rtsa chen gsung 'bum dag ni/gang nyid sku 'tsho bzhugs skabs nas lha rtse dga' ldan phun tshogs gling du cha tshang par shid du brkos yod rung / rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs rtsa thor du song nas da lta gsung 'bum cha tshang gcig kyang btsal rnyed dka' bar gyur stabs/ snga phyir don gnyer lhag bsam can gyi tshogs pa dang mi sger mi nyung ba zhig la/ phyogs bsgrigs dang dpe skrun zhu 'dun yod kyang / ma dpe btsal 'tshol dang mi sna'i cha rkyen sogs rgyu rkyen sna tshogs la brten nas/ da bar sus kyang dpe skrun ma thub par rim khungs ma su lus 'dug par brten/'di ga ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang nas spyi lo 2005nas bzung snga phyir 'bras spungs dgon dang /pho brang po tā la/bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang sogs rig dngos tshan pa khag dang /de bzhin mi sger sogs nas ma dpe g.yar po zhus pa bzhin 'brel yod khag nas gang ci'i mthun 'gyur gang legs stsal ba brgyud dge lugs gsung 'bum gtso gnad du byas pa'i ris med kyi gsung 'bum pod stong phrag brgal ba zer bris su dpar ba dang / gzhan yang dpe dkon dang nyer mkho'i rigs dpe deb nyis brgyar nye ba nang khul par skrun byas zin pa dang /de'i khongs nas rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po'i gsung 'bum pod nyer lnga dang / sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang gi 'phros pod gsum bcas khyon pod nyer brgyad bzhugs pa/gangs can khyad nor dpe tshogs kyi pod 'phreng 171nas 198bar bsgrigs te rgya che'i gzigs pa

po'i spyan lam du phul ba yin/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi ma phyi ni pho brang po tā lar bzhugs pa'i rgyal dbang mchog gi gsung 'bum slong gzhin bzung thog yi ge mi gsal ba dang dogs gnas can rnams se ra theg chen gling gi rgyal ba'i gzims chung bde ba can du bzhugs pa' gsung 'bum dang /lha ldan gtsug lag khang gi dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa' gsung 'bum 'phrul par ma/de bzhin dwags po mnga' ris grwa tshang gi gsung 'bum 'phrul par ma sogs ma dpe khag bzhi tsam la chib bsdur zhus pa yin/glegs bam dang chos tshan gyi go rim ni/ deb nas 4bar pod rtags ka)(kha)rtoganakhong )ste rgyal dbang mchog gi don gyi rnam thar gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun bod bzhi dang /deb ldanas7bar pod rtags6)'ad(ja)ste thun mong phyi'i rnam thar du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam pod gsum/deb 8nas 0bar sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang gi 'phros po dgasums po da rtags la(ja she(ja)(ja)bkod yod de ba pal pod rtags6)rte'adi bang / rgyal dbang sku 'phreng gsum pa dang bzhi pa/dpon slob paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan/mgon po bsod na mas mchogo ldan/khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel/'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/byang pa rig 'dzin chen po'i rnam thar bcas chos tshan bdun/deb 2pa la pod rtags 6 ) gzur chen chos dbyings rang grol/nyang ston khra tshang pa/tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar bcas chos tshan lnga/deb 3pa la bod rtags 6)ste bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga zung 'jug sgrub pa'i shing rta sogs chos drug cu re gsum/deb 4pa la pod rtags9)ste dam can chos srung rgya mtsho'i mngon rtogs mchod 'bul bskang bshags bstod tshogs sogs chos tshan bcu bdun/ deb 5pa la pod rtags 6)ste lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung sogs chos tshan bcu/deb 6pa la bod rtags 6)ste phar phyin blo bzang dgongs rgyan gdong lnga'i dbang po'i sgra dbyangs/deb 7pa la pod rtags (pha)ste 'dul ba'i

las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog dang / chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta sogs chos tshan gsum/ deb 18pa la pod rtags6)ste bstod tshogs dngos grub rgya mtsho sogs cho me tshan bcu gcig deb 19nas 21bar pod rtags 6) 6yi 'o mi ste sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag dang tham phud deb khrims yig 'go rgyangs sde bzhi'i sgo 'phar phye ba'i skal bzang pod gsum/ deb 22pa la pod rtags (7ste rgyal rabs deb ther dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs sogs chos tshan bzhi/ deb 23pa la pod rtags (wa)ste snyan 'grel ma dbyangs can dgyes glu sogs chos tshan gsum/ deb 24pa la pod rtags zhe)ste smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis/deb 25pa gsung nang ma (ka)ste bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i las byang khrag 'thung gad rgyangs sogs chos tshan nyer drug deb 26pa gsung nang ma 6)ste tshe bdag gi yig char rnam par dpyad pa'i yi ge ri thang mtshams kyi nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman gcig sogs chos tshan zhe gsum/ deb 27pa gsung nang ma rtog)ste rdzogs chen 'khrid yig rig 'dzin zhal lung sogs chos tshan nyer drug deb 28pa gsung nang ma rtoge ste le'u bdun pa'i brgyud 'debs sogs chos tshan nga lnga bcas te pho brang po tā la'i gsung 'bum dkar chag gi go rim ltar bsgrigs pa yin/dmigs bsal zhu bya zhig la khong gi gsung las gsang ba rgya can bris ma pod gnyis bzhugs pa ha cang bka' gnyan pa dang / gsang ba khyab bsgrags mi rung ba'i bka' srol ltar 'dir yang par skrun zhus med pa thugs nges zhu rgyu ma zad/ ma dpe'i nang du mchod brjod sogs kyi skabs su lañdza mang tsam byung yang da lta glog klad du la lha'i yi ge med pas 'jog thub med pa bcas kyang thugs la nges par 'tshal zhu/lhag par du rnam dpyod dang ldan pa rnams kyis slad phyin ma phyir dpe sdur ba dang / 'tshol bde ba'i ched ma dpe'i shog grangs dang nyin srib kyi bsdus rtags(2na) (2ba ) 'di'i nang bkod yod/6

zhu dag byed skabs/ thog ma'i zhu dag dang / bskyar zhus/ yang zhus/ zhus chen bcas zhu dag gi rim pa bzhi lhag brgyud cing / tshig phrad dang / lhag bcas/ rgyan sdud gsum gyi phrad dang yig nor mngon gsal can re zung dag bcos byas pa phud/ skabs de'i yi ge'i 'bri srol/ deng skabs dang mi 'dra ba dper na/'bri la 'dri dang /tsong kha pa la btsong kha pa/mtshams la 'tshams/ mthun la 'thun/mtsho la 'tsho/ med la smad/ byung la 'byung / rang rkya la rang skya/ grwa la ga klong la slong / rig 'dzin la rigs 'dzin/ rig gnas la rigs gnas/ rigs pa la rig pa/ gcod la spyod/ rdzong brda la rdzong sta/ rdzong bda' sogs kyang ma dpe sor bzhag byas yod/spyir na tshig don gnyis thad nas zhus dag pher nges su rloms kyang / nged rnams rtsom sgrig gi bya bar las dang po ba yin pa dang / shes rig nor gyis dbul bas phyogs gang thad nas mi ldeng ba'i cha sogs skyon dang nor 'khrul mi nyung ba zhig 'byung nges pas rgya che'i mkhyen ldan rnam pas thad gar ram/yig thog zhal par bcas gang rung gi thog nas nyes 'gog legs spel gyi dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang rogs zhes dran skul zhu rgyu ma zad/ lhag par nged tsho'i las don thad lhag bsam rnam dag gis rgyab skyor gnang mkhan dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang dang / pho brang po tā la'i rig dngos do dam khang gis gtsos tshan pa khag dang / mi sger bcas nas gang ci'i thad slob ston dang mthun rkyen gyi rgyab skyor tshad med gnang bar snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhes lan brgyar zhu'o/ /ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshor bas phyogs ga khang nas/bod sa glang lo'i sa ga zla ba'i tshes 15la/7

yas kyi gtsug lag khang bcas la nyams gso gnang ba/ gzhan yang rje 'dis dgon sde gsar 'debs mdzad pa dang / dgon sde khag tu lha khang dang rten mchod gsar bzhedas/ chos gzhis mchode rgyun sbyor 'jags mdzad pa/ ris med gsung rab pod khrir nye bar dkar chag gsar bsgrigs/bsgrub bya khri phrag mang por dge tshul slong gi sdom pa bstsal ba dang / de bzhin dpe rgyun dkon rigs par 'debs byed rgyu khyab brdal gtong ched/ 'bras spungs dga' ldan pho brang gi par khang dang / pho brang po tā la'i ltag sgo'i rgyab kyi par khang bcas gsar du 'dzugs gnang mdzad pa sogs chos srid kyi mdzad pa spyi dang / lhag par rgyal dbang mchog gi don gyi rnam thar gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun/ phyi'i rnam thar du kū la'i gos bzang gis gtsos pa'i rnam thar/ gzhung chen khag gi 'grel pa dbu ma la theg chen rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru rdzings dang / mdzod la chos ma wa zhe rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta/ 'dul bar las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog rgyal rabs la deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhen nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ smin byed kyi 'khrid yig rnam gnyis te lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung dang / rdzogs chen 'khrid yig rig 'dzin zhal lung / de bzhin rtsis skar nag tshe bdag dris lan/dkar chag zhal gdams/ snyan mgur/ snyan dar zhal yig chab shog brtan bzhugs/ lam yigabasko 'ja'/ grwa tshang 'don cha/ dam can chos srung gi sgrub skor/ bsnyen yig sogs pod nyer lnga dang /gsang ba'i gras rtsa gsum lha dang mngon sum mjal zhing bgros pa la sogs pa'i rgya can nyer bzhi'i bu yig bka' rtsom gras pod gnyis bcas/ legs par bshad pa pod nyi shu rtsa bdun brtsams par gnang ste bstan 'gro'i phan bde rgya cher spel gnang mdzad nas mthar dgung grangs re drug ste rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu khyi ste 1682lor dgongs pa gzhan don du gshegs pa bcas dam pa gang gi rnam par thar pa mdor mtshon tsam du bkod pa las zhib phra rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang sogs mdzad rnam gzhan mang du bzhugs pa las mkhyen par zhu'o/ /ser ga khu gnang gas dpe rdzing la chos bas phyog ga khang nas/10

dkar chagabrag rdzong rgyun 'byer rdo rje'i go khrab ces pa (1)dpal mgon po che chung las mkhan rnams kyi bskang bshags chos srung dgyes pa'i sgra dbyangs/ (8)dpal mgon po che chung las mkhan rnams kyi gtor ma'i cho ga las bzhi lhun grub/ (36)dpal mgon po che chung las mkhan rnams kyi bstod bskul bshan pa rnam par rol pa (57)dgra gu drug cu rtsa bzhi'i gtor chog srid gsum rnam rgyal/ (74)dam can chos srung rgya mtsho'i mngon rtogs sogs 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub ces bya ba/ (78)gtor ma brgya rtsa bklags pas don 'grub ces bya ba/ (430)gtor ma brgya rtsa 'khyer bde kun phan/ (slo1)gzhi gsum cho ga'i cha rkyen gtor ma cha bzhi dang gzhi bdag gtor bsngo/ (445)klu gtor bdud rtsi'i 'o ma'i chu rgyun/ (448)klu gtor rgyun khyer bzhugs so/ (453)bsur chog gi rim pa yid bzhin 'dod 'jo/ (455)lha lnga'i gsol mchod bsod nams dpal bskyed/ (460)lha rnams mnyes par byed pa'i bsangs mchod bkra shis 'khyil ba/ (466)rgya hor gyi yul du nye bar phan pa'i bsangs kyi yi ge dngos grub char 'bebs (477)mi mthun nyes kun sel zhing legs tshogos ci 'dod 'grub pa'i bsangs yig gi rim pa mi 'dzad mchod sprin sgo 'byed ces bya ba/ (481)1

klu gtor gdengs can dga' bskyed/ (497)dkar cha bzhi'i dga' ston phan bde'i 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba/ (499)gtor ma brgya rtsa'i rim pa mu thi la'i 'khri shing / (505)gtor ma brgya rtsa phan bde'i sgo 'byed/ (513)

brag rdzong sa wer rdo rje'i go khrab/ 9)ra༅༅//brag rdzong rgyun 'byer rdo rje'i go khrab ces pa bzhus/sa theg//༄༅//blogs la skal bzang gyo mtsho chen po'i dbus//snyan brgyud grags pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgreng mkhas pa//rdo rje lang dbang tshar wo chos kyi rje//yab sras brgyud par bcas la gus da o nas//chos skyong rnam gnyis bdag bskyed ches zab pa//snying gi zungs khrag lta bu'i brag rdzong gi6na 'byer gsang chen slob bshad bzhed srol ltar//ngag 'don khrigs chags yi ge'i 'phreng bar spel//skyab 'gro ni/bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o//rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o//dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabasasu mchi'o//'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o//zhagatso/bla ma dang dkon cog rin po che rnam ba gsum la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu 2na ngo sol/sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob par bya/de'i r+pā du bdag gi rdo rje nag bo r+ṣa po gur gyi mgon po bsgom par bgyi'o//zha gtso/rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas ni/bdag gi spyi bor pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du/skad cig gisabacom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' dpal he ru ka sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'byud pa/rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/de'i pang na yum rdo rje bsnyems ma sku mdog dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa dang mnyam par sbyor bar bsgoms la/yab kyi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)hūṃ dkar po/ de las 'od 'phros pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po ye shesakyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs nas hūṃ la thim/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes lhung dri ma'i tshogs (2ba)thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol btab pas/ hūṃ las bdud rtsi babs/ he ru ga'i sku gang de nas sku'i dbyibs brgyud yum gyi sku gang / yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi babs/ bdag gi spyi gtsug nas zhugs pas/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dud khu'am/ rnag khrag gi rnam pas bshang gci gnyis dang rkang mthil gnyis nas 'thon nas/ shul thams cad bdud rtsis gang bar bsam la/ ngag tu/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ he ru ka twe no pa zhin dṛ rnyo me bha wa/ su to stso me bha wa/ a nu ra sto me bha wa/ su po stso me bha wa/ sarba sirnyi sme bra ༷ sarba ga dze su tsa me/ tsi/ she yeḥ ku ru hūṃ/ ha ha ha hobha ga wa na/ badz+ra he ru da mā me mus he ru ko bha wa/ ma hā sa ma ya sa hwa āḥ〉 phaṭa/ ces lan nyi shu rtsa gcig yan chad ci nus bzlas nas/ /rdo rje thal mo snying gar sbyar la/ /bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste/ /dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad 'thol lo bshags so/ /sdig pa dang sgrib pa nyes pa dang lhung ba dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu nas/ spyi bo nas rang la thim pas rang gi lus shel gong lta bur bsam/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni (3na yinas khang dur khrod rol ba'i gzhal yas khang du gsal ba'i rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar mgon po 'khor bcas bzhugs pa'i spyi bor seng khri pad nyi bdud kyi gdan la drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid nas bzung ste/ rdo rje 'amang gi bar gyi brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad rdo rje nag po che gur gyi mgon po'i rnam pa can mtho brtsegs su reg la ma 'byar ba'i tshul gyi bdag la dgyes shing 'dzum —2

brag rdzong rgyun wer rdo rje'i go khrab/ 9)pa'i nyams kyis bzhugs par bsam/sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po la skyabs su mchi'o//sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang ོ po la gsol ba 'debs so//sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang ོ pos byin gyis rlobs shig de bsto du/bram ze chen po mchog sred la ྾/slob dpon nor bu gling pa la ྾/shrī d+dha kā ra wa rma la ྾/lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po la ྾/brag steng pa yon tan tshul khrims la ྾/rje btsun mal lo chen po la ྾/sa wo kun dga' snying po la ྾/slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo la ྾/rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan la ྾/chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta la ྾/'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa ྾/mthu chen a nyan dam pa ྾/bla ma bdag nyid chen po ྾/mkhas btsun nam mkha' legs pa ྾/bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan ྾/bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan ྾/'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal4zha ྾/bdag wo blo gros rgyal ma zha ྾/rdo ring ca spangs ra po ྾/tshar wo rdo rje la4 ྾/'jam dbyangs mkhyen 3ba tha rtse'i dbang phyug ྾/mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan ྾/khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan ྾/rje btsun mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan ྾/rdo rje 'dzin pa bkra shis kun dga' ྾/bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma ྾/zhes gsol ba btab pas/rim pa bzhin du brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams 'od du zhu/rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim par gyur/dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pas bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes dang rim gnyis kyi rtogs pa khyad par can rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams bdag gi dbang du 'dus nas las bzhi'i 'phrin las thams cad 'bad med du 'grub par byin gyis brlab du gsol/lde sogasol ba gro kho pas/chos skyong sgyur cas bla ma la thim//bla ma de nyid 'od zer sngon por zhu/rang gi spyi bo nas thim pas lusang ga yed gsum dang //bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dbyer med du ba4//dngos la tso sgo srung ༅ lor lo bsgom pa ni/rang nyid skad cig gi rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon por gsal ba'i thugs ga'i hūṃ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas/nag po chen po srung ba'i 'khor lo la bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam pas gtso bo'i dbu la brgyan pa mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)dzaḥ/ na mo gu ru saḥn mtha ma hā ka la maṇ+ḍali khyoḥ shrī gu ru ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra a lha bra titsā ye swāhā/ pā hūm̐/ puṅge lha pe/ ā lo ke /(4na ngo rnye/ ni li bye/ shabha āḥ&/ dkon cog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi//rang g.yin don gnyis rab bsgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub mchog tu sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyasahrūb par shog /zhagasum brjod/ /sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad nye ring chags snang gnyis dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig /ces tshad med bzhi bsgom/ /tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par bsam/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra su bhā wa āt+pa ko ྅ nya/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las / las rdo rje'i brag rdzong dmar nag gru gsum pa/ mtho zhing ngam chod pa de'i steng du e las chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag yangs shing rgya che ba nang khrag zhag 'khrugs pa'i rgya mtshos gang ba de'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros(4ba ngos/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ khor yug rdo rje'i ra ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre/ phyi rol thams cad ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar zhing 'brug pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lor bsam/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ srung 'khor gyi dbus su hūṃ las gnam lcags las grub pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa/ rtse mo rno ba/ khog pa stong pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ go skabs med par gyur/oṃ badz+ra tsakra rak+ṣa hūṃ sa hūṃ/ 'khor lo'i nang gi dbus dang phyogs bcur pad+ma dang nyi ma mi ro dmar ser mgo g.yas su bstan pa'i steng du hūṃ mthing nag re re/ de rnams las 'od 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug —4

brag rdzong rgyun wer rdo rje'i go khrab/ 'dipa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ /dbus su bdag nyid dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po che zhing cher 'bar ba/ sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas gri gug dang / g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs gar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ phyag gnyis kyi dbus na rnam 'phrul gyi gaṇ+ḍi bsnams pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs pa'i gra nas khrag 'dzag pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brjes pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang / sprul gyi brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ dar sna tshogs kyi cod pan dang / lhab lhub kyis klubs pa/ mi'u thung gel ba'i 'dug stangs kyis ro'i steng na bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas (ldan kho bya nag 'bum sde gshog skor byed pa/ g.yon na khyi nag 'bum sde 'khang zhing zug pa/ rgyab na ce spyang 'bum sde g.yal zhing rgyug pa/ mdun na mi nag 'bum sde gnam du 'o dod 'bod pa/ steng na khyung chen 'bum sde lding zhing 'khor ba ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /phyogs bcu'i mgon po rnams sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing / g.yon thod khrag thugs gar 'dzin pa/ rgyan dang cha lugs gtso bo dang mthun pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon rkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/'khor lo'i rgyab ra gur gyi nang dur khrod brgyad na/ phyogs skyong / zhing skyong / klu dang / sprin dang /me dang / chu dang / ro dang / ro langs la sogs pa du ma dang / gtsang ris kyi mgon po bdun sto rtsa lnga/dregs byed dpag tu med pas bskor ba de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ de las 'od sa pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas nag po chen po lha bcu gcig srung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpas bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ/ dzaḥ& baṃ lho gnyisasu med par thim/ slar yang thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥkhyed rnams kyis bdag la mngon (5ba)par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis/ oṃ badzi bha wa a bhi ṣi ñtsa hūṃ/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i —3

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ lha bcu gcig la mi bskyod pa re res dbu brgyan par bsam/ gtso bo'i thugs dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rdo rje'i sngon po rtse lnga pa gyen du langs pa'i lte bar sems rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo hūṃ yig sngon po gsal zhing 'tsher ba la/ bsrung bya rnams sba zhing gnas pa'i mthar sngags thung dang / shā sa na kha dog mthing khas g.yas su 'khor ba'i hūṃ yig las 'phros pa'i rdo rjes bsgrub bya'i lus thams cad 'jig pa med par bsrung ba'i rang bzhin du grub cing / lha rnams kyi zhal nas sngags kyi sgra 'brug ltar sgrog pa/ 'khor lo 'khor ba'i me dpung dang bcas pas dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad par bsam/oṃ ma hā kwa la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ shā san bzla/ rang mgon por gsal ba'i lag mthilaganyis 'khor lo bstol ba'i bar du dgra bgegs thams cad thal ba'i rdul phran tsam du brlag pa bsam/ oṃ bha ya nā sha na/ t+yā sa ni sarba mā ra pra tu dhi ra bi nā sha ni ye ke tsita/ dus sa twa ma ma bi rū pa ge ku rba na/ kṛ tu ni sarba mā ra pra kyi dhi ra pa ta tru hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ su gang dag bdag cag dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang / sangs rgyas 9na)kyi bstan pa dang / bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams dang / sems can thams cad la sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / gdug pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / sbyor ba phyin ci log byed pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad kyi bsam sbyor ngan pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig /gal te zhi bar ma gyur na/ de'i tshe de dag thams cad kyi lus bcing bar bgyi'o//ngag bcing bar bgyi'o//yid bcing bar bgyi'o/ /mthu brlag par gyur cig /rdzu hrūl brlag par gyur cig /stobs brlag par gyur cig /de la 'go ba'i lha de nyid kyis de'i sha la za bar gyur cig /rdzas sngags ting nge 'dzin gyi nus pa thams cad kho rang gi gshed du dbab bar gyur cig /sbyor ba ngan pa'i 'bras bu de nyid la 'byung bar gyur cig /khro bo 'bar ba'i tshogs rnams kyis/ dgra bgegs rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /lus ngag thal ba'i rdul du rlog /rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su drongs/ snro 'khor lo thams cad g.yas su 'khor zhing / /hūṃ khro bcu rnams zhal nang du gzigs pas—6

brag rdzong rgyun wer rdo rje'i go khrab/ (dpesra zhing brtan par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ rdo rje'i ra gur ma gtoṭa pa'i srung 'khor khro bcu dang bcas pa/ rang nyid gur mgon du gsal ba'i thugs kar thim par gyur/ snyan brgyud mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs can/ 4ba༄dung min pa'i man ngag las/ /brag rdzong rgyun 'khyer ngag 'don tsam/ /brgyud pa'i gsung 'gros ji bzhin bkod/ /sba dang go gyon jag bkye sogs/ /zab gnad rje btsun kha'u ba'i/ /rjes 'brang mkhas grub gsung ngag las/ /'bad pas btsal te nyams su long / /mkhas 'dod lung med dpe tshogs sdud/ /rgyus med mun khung 'khyams pa yi/ /chos skyong shes rlome dregs ldan dang / /rtog ge skal dman spyod yul min/ /dge des snod ldan snying dbus kyi/ /bum bzang snyan brgyud kyis bkang ste/ /gsang chen slob bshad ring lugs mchogo /dar zhing rgyas pa'i dpal gyur cig /ces kha'u brag rdzong pa'i khyad chos rdo rje nag po chen po'i brag rdzong gi nyams len rgyun 'khyer 'di yang phyir 'khrid nang 'khrid 'jug bde a the sirnyi shrī mā na gyi don du tshar chen gyis zho lung mtsho kha'i ri khrod du mdzad pa snyan brgyud yid bzhin nor bu las phyi 'khrid kyi snying po bsdus pa phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i mgon po che chung gi bdag bskyed thun mong ma yin pa'i ched du tshar pa rdo rje 'chang gi gsang gsum gyi rnam thar la rgyu mtshan shes nas dad pa thob pa'i za hor gyi btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos sbyar/ /

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)no༅༅//dpal mgon po che chung las mkhan rnams kyi bskang bshags chos srung dgyes pa'i sgra dbyangs bzhugs//na mo gu ru mahā kā lu ya/dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i rigs kyi khyab bdag mkhas grub dbang po sa skya pa//gang gi gsung ngag slob bshad 'dzin mkhas sngags 'chang dbang po rdo ring pa//kha'u pa yi bstan 'dzin dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang dbang tshar pa rje//brgyud par bcas pa'i rig sngags 'chang rnams dus kun rtag tu rgyal gyur cig/gdug can snying khrag gis smyos rda can khrir//rngams brjid gar gyi rol ba'i nag po che//mchod cing bskangs bshags las rim 'bri byed na//dgyes pa'i spyan gyis gzigs la snang ba stsol//log lta'i dri ma'i tshogs kyi ma sbags shing //gzur gnas blo ldan be+e ḍūr 'khyil ba yi//thos 'dzin nor bu'i za ma rtag yangs par/sdugs so skal bzang tshogs rnams dga' bder spyod/dpal mgon rnam pa gnyis po 'di gnyis kyi gtor sgrub bya ba la nye bar mkho ba'i le lag bskangs bshags kyi lag len khrigs su bya ba la//thog mar sgrub khang /rten dang brten pa'i dam rdzas/phyi nang gi mchod gtor//spyan 2na yi zigs rnams tshar pa rdo rje 'chang gis dpal sa skya pa'i bka' srung rnams kyi gtor sgrub bskang gso'i phyag len gyi gsal byed lhan thabs dang /mthong brgyud kyi phyag len las shes dgos la/ngag 'don la thog mar gnas khang mchod pa byin gyis brlabs pa ni/rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gnad dang mchod pa rnams la gtor zhing /a mṛ tas bsangs/su bha bas sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las/gnas khang zlo las thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis mdzes pa/tshad dang mtshan /da thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du mchod

dpal mgon po che chung las mkhan rnams kyi bskang bshags chos srung dgyes pa'i sgra dbyangs/ 9)rdzas rnams a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me rta ge /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams rgyu 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge ba las byung ba ngo bo gtsang zhing bzang la rgya che ba'i yul nam mkha'i mthas klas pa/ dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs kyi bar du gnas pa/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang (2bsta'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab par bsam/ byu:tsa / lha/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ pā thu/ badz+ra pu po dha pe/ ā lo ke — /ni we bye/sha rdi/o badz+ra gharnye ra ṇi ta/ bra ra ṇi ta/ /pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba burnya/ snye tra pratsā li zhe/ pra dz+nya pā ra mi tā nad su bha we/ badz+ra dharma hri da ya sa〉ṭha ni hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hoḥho a byu swā hā/ tshar gsum brjod cing rol mo'i yo byad thams cad 'bud dkrol byas la gnas dang mchod pa'i yo byad rnams byin dbab bo/ /brgyud 'debs ni/ 'a r+sā gyis mdzad/ /rnam kun mchog ldan zung 'jug rdo rje 'dzin/ /zag med bde ba'i gar bsgyur rdo rje gur/ grub pa mchog gi ded dpon bram ze che/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /yul dbus rnal 'byor mkhas pa bde ba'i mtshan/ /paṇa grub dbang po/ dad rjes go cha'i zhabs/ /gangs can bstan pa'i sgron me lo tswab/ /snying nas mo/ /sngags 'chang nus pa mthar phyin brag steng pa/ /skad gnyis smra ba'i mkhas grub blo gros grags/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug brtse chen sa skya pa/ /snying nas ྾/ /'ja' lus mkha' spyod rol mdzad bsod nams rtse/ grub rigs rgya mtsho'i gtsug rgyan bla ma rje/ /gangs khrod mkhas pa'i dbang po paṇ+ḍita/ /snying nas ྾/ /dregs ldan gtsug gis legs mchode 'phags pa'i mtshan/ /'jigs rung gaṇ+ḍi 'dzin pa'i kun dga' grags/ /mkhas grub rgya mtsho'i 'byung gnas bzang po dpal/ /snying nas mo/ /mas stobs bdung rtsis myos pa'i nam mkha' legs/ khred gsum 'gran (3na)zla bral ba chos kyi rje/ /snyan brgyud mnga' bdag bla chen kun rgyal ba/ /snying nas mo/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen po yar klungs pa/ /de sras thu bo bsod nams rgyal mchog zhabs/ /pad+ma'i rnam 'phrul 'jam dbyangs nam mkha'i mtshan/ /snying nas sko/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal/ /—9

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)mthu stobs dbang phyug rje btsun rdo ring ba/ /dngos grub mchog stsol rje btsun tshar pa la/ /snying nasar/ /mkhyen yangs rig gnas mthar phyin mkhyen brtse'i dbang / /mgon des rjes bzung bslab gsum rgyal mtshan dpal/ /gsang chen mnga' bdag dbang phyug rab brtan la/ /snying nas ྾/ /bsod nams mchog ldan dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i mgon/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang rje btsun ā nan+da/ /bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ snying nas ྾/ /deng nas dus kun rgyud rgyal kai la sha /snyan brgyud tsha zer gyisabran gdams pa'i rgyun/ /ma sdus chu klung las 'ong bka' babs bzhi'i/ /zab don bdud rtsis bdag rgyud tshim par shog /dben pa'i dur khrod nags tshal yid 'ong bar/ /drug ldan rten gyi tsho gos rnams leṭa gtams shing / /rnam gsum dmar chen gtor mas byur bur bshams/ /phyi nang mchod pasabastan srung mnyes byed shog /rten gyi dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i dam rdzas dang / /rab zab bskyed dang bsad pa'i 'byul 'khor bcas/ /zab gsal ting 'dzin ma nor gsang ba'i sngaṭa/ /rtse gcig 'bad pas bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin shog /thub bstan mchog dang bstan 'dzin 'joms pa'i dug /ma rig nag (3bsta'i rtsa lag sder bcas pa/ /bdag gi mngon spyod drag po'i 'phrin las kyis/ /bskrad gzir bsgral ste chos dbyings sbyor bar shog /de nas grub kyang don chung tshe 'di'i ched/ /bor nas rgyang ring dben pa'i ri sul du/ /bse ru'i rnam thar rjes su dran byas ste/ /rdzogs rim zab mo'i lam mchog bsgomasapar shog /nang gi dregs byed rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga/ /dbab ldog bdud rtsi'i mchod pas mnyes byas nas/ /rlung sbyor rdo rje'i sngags kyis rjes bskul bas/ /zag med bde chen mgon po 'grub par shog /gsal stong zung 'jug gdod ma'i rgyud gsum po/ /spros bral blo 'das ngang du bsgrubs pa yi/ /sgrib gnyis 'khrul pa'i dgra tshogs drung phyungs nas/ /zug la jug rdo rje 'dzin pa mngon gyur shog /go 'phang mchog 'di tshe 'dir ma thob na/ /'chi ba 'od gsal don gyi nag po che/ /rig nas 'grogs pa'i mdza' bo nyams dga' de/ /mthong ba'i mod la dbyer med 'gyur bar shog /der kyang zhabrul nas bar do shar gyur na/ /bla ma mchog dang dam can rgya mtshor bcas/ /yid 'ong mchod sprin gdugs dang rgyal mtshan — 10

dpal mgon po che chung las mkhan rnams kyi bskang bshags chos srung dgyes pa'i sgra dbyangs/ (gethogs//ming nas lung bstan mkha' spyod khrid par shog/mdor na deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du//rje btsun bla ma gtsug gi nor bur bsten//bka' srung chos skyong lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs//rim gnyis ting 'dzin dpal la spyod par shog/khyad par grub mchog rje btsun sa skya pa'i//gdung brgyud rim par chog brgyud zhal gdams su//byon pa'i bstan srung nag po'i snyan brgyud 4na lkogs//gangs can ljongs 'dir ches cher rgyas gyur cig/mthu r+ṣa nag po'i stobs dang gzi brjid dang //'dod khams lha mo' brtse gdung drag shul dang //bka' nyan pho nya'i mthu stobs rdzu phrul gyis//bkra shisadapal gyis bdag cag ring du skyongs//zhal gyi brgyud 'debs kho bos ma4/mkha' sbyor bdun ldan khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang //rgyal ba gnyis pa mgon po klu sgrub zhabs//'phags yul paṇa grub dbang po ba ling ta//gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlomes//'jam dpal rdo rje'i srol 'byed ye shes zhabs//'dus pa'i bstan pa rgyas mdzad mar me mdzad//rim gnyis rtogs pa mchog brnyesadapal bde ba//gsol ba ྾//gsang chen rig 'dzin bi ma la gup+ta//theg mchog rnal 'byor rin cen rdo rje'i dpal//thub bstan gsal byed rin cen grags pa la//gsol ba ྾//mkha' 'gro'i dbang mo ri sul rnal 'byor ma//'jig rten mig gcig gnyan lo dar ma grags//sngags yong nus pa mthar phyin kha'u pa//gsol ba ྾//gsang sngags rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag sa skya pa//'ja' lus mngon du gyur pa'i bsod nams rtse//zung 'jug sku brnyes grags pa rgyal mtshan zhabs//gsol ba ྾//kun mkhyen gnyis pa chos rje paṇ+ḍi ta/khar phyogs rgyal po'i cod paṇa 'phags pa'i mtshan//gsung ngag 'dzin mkhas 'ad ston chos rje la//gsol ba ྾/snyan rgyud bdud rtsis myos pa'i brag phug pa//sku bzhi'i dbang phyug bsod nams rgyal mtshan zhabs//thugs sras dam pa bla chen kun rgyal bar//gsol 4bsgo ྾/zab don rgya mtsho'i 'byung gnas yar klungs pa//de'i gsung gsang ba kun 'dzan rgyal ba mchog/pad+ma'i rnam 'phrul nam mkha' rgyal mtshan la//gsol ba ྾//rdo rje 'chang dngos bdag chen blo gros rje//gsang chen slob bshad bstan 'dzin rdo ring pa//snyan brgyud mnga' bdag tshar pa rdo

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)rje 'chang / /gsol ba ྾/ /'jam dbyangs bla ma mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug zhabs//bslab gsum rgyal mtshan sngags 'chang rta ra ba//zhing skyong bran 'khol dbang phyug rab brtan la//gsol ba ྾//dang po'i mgon po bsod nams mchag ldan pa'i//sngagasang dbang po ba po shis kun dga'i zhabs//bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma la//gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlomes//rdo rje'i slob dpon gsang gsum yid ba smi nor//ra byung rten cing tshol 'byung gas rje las//sgo don snyan brgyud 'dod rgu'i char wo pos//bdag rgyud si zhing longs su spyod par shog khrug ldan rten dang dmar chen gtor ma'i tshogs//phyi nang gsang mchod dgyes pa skyed pa'i rten//legs bshams dpal ldan mgon po dus kun du//'bral med nye ba'i bsnyen pas mnyes par shog/dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i rdzas dang bca' gzhi tshogs/gzugs byad bla tshe bkug cing dbye ba sogs//dam can srung ma rbad pa'i 'phrin las kyis//mngon spyod drag po'i sgrub pa mthar phyin shog/ting 'dzin 'phro 'du drag sngags rno dbal can//mtshon char dug rlangs nus ldan mthun rdzas kyis//dgra bgegasatshar bcad ldan ) thar med lcags khang nang //'jug pa'i las sbyor 'phrin lasahrūb par shog/'og min dag pa'i zhing dang dur khrod brgyad//grangs med gnas su 'jigs rung khros pa'i gar//rab bsgyur dgra bo'i srog 'phrog dbu ṭa len pa'i//stobs log phyi yi mgon po 'grub par shog/rang lus rtsa gsum 'khor lo rnam lnga yi//rtsa khams rlung gi ngo bo gzung 'dzin sogs//yongs 'phrog lhan skyes ye shes sbyin mdzad pa'i//nang gi dpal ldan mgon po 'bral med shog/phyi nang dregs pa'i sgyu 'phrul sna tshogs kun//rang sems rol ba'i rtsal du yongs rtogs pa'i//gsal stong zung 'jug brjod bral gsang ba'i mgon/rang zhal mthong ba'i bde r+ṣa thob par shog/thun slong ma yin gsang chen slob bshad ces/kha'u brag rdzong bzhed srol zhabrul med lam//nyams su blangs pas 'phrin las rnam bzhi dang //zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang dbang 'grub gyur cig/de nas brag rdzong ma'i rgyun 'byer nyams len dkyus ltar byas rjes/badz+ra a mri tas bsangs sa

dpal mgon po che chung las mkhan rnams kyi bskang bshags chos srung dgyes pa'i sgra dbyangs/ rtogebhā was sbyangs/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor zhes pa nas/tsho zhes lan gsum gyis nang mchod byin gyis brlab/ de nas bshaṭa pa ni/ chos skyong rnams kyi 'khu ldog sel ba dang / rnal 'byor pa rang gi nyes lhung dag par byed pa'i dmigs pa gsung rgyun khungs ma las 'byung ba man ngag ltar gyi dmigs pa dang bcas nyams su len dgos pas zog po 'ur rgyangs can (5bdang / rtog ge tha snyad mkhan gyi spyod yul ma yin no/ /rgyu mtshan des na gong 'og tu dgos pa rnams blos byas rang bzor ma song ba'i zhib tu dpyod par bya'o/ /he ru ga'i yi ge brgya pa brgya sogs ci rigs pa bzla'o/ /de nas rnal 'byor pa rnams langs te phyag 'tshal ba'i thal mo sbyar te badz+ra sa mā dzaḥgang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang / /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi/ /dang por me tog phog pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'dud/ /thams cad dngos po'i rang bzhin mchog /gdod nas thams cad bdag nyid gnas/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyisamed pas/ /kye rdo rje la phyag 'tshal/ /chos dbyings rnam dag dbyings las ma g.yos kyang / /thabs kyi khro bo'i skur ston gdug pa 'dul/ /che ba'i che mchog lha yi lhar gyur pa/ /kun bzang he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /srin po'i gzugs kyi gdug pa can/ /tshar gcod byang chub sems dpa' ste/ /grong khyer gsum ya rtsegs 'jigs byed pa/ /gtum po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi sku gsung thugs kyi mthus/ /'dod pa'i khams kun zil mnan nas/ /'dod pa'i khams la dbang sgyur ma/ /'dod khams dbang phyug ma la bstod/ /dpal ldan dbang ldan srid gsum dbang sgyur zhing / /mche ba gtsigs shing mchu 'phyang shugs che ba/ /sgra sgrog dril bu'i phreng bas brgyan pa yi/ /gzhen nu'i lus can bgegs (6na)'joms khyod la bstod/ /g.yung mo gtum mo srin mo dang / /siṅga la gnas rnal 'byor ma/ /dmar ser ljang nag khros pa'i zhal/ /gri gug thod 'dzin rnams la bstod/ /dpal ldan 'phrin las kun mdzad pu tra khyod/ /sku mdog mthing nag me yi 'phro 'du can/ /rngams pa'i stobs kyis 'gying zhing shang — 13

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)lang bsnams/ /gying chen gdug pa 'dul la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos nyid zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yosakyang / /ma rung 'dul phyir drag po'i skur bstan nas/ /mthu stobs phun tsho gos bstan pa srung mdzad pa'i/ /sgrol gying srog bdag dmar po la phyag 'tshal/ /gang gi sprul dang mngon par shes pa dpal/ /nye bar thob nas thub pa'i bka' bzhin du/ /bstan pa rin cen bang mdzod legs srung ba'i/ /rdo rje chos skyong rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag byar 'os pa thams cad la/ /zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyis/ /lus btud pa yi rnam kun tu/ /mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /bshaṭa pa bya ba ni/ lag tu me tog thogs nas 'thor zhing / 'phags pas mdzad/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po lcam dral bran g.yog bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang / mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la zhu zhing gsol ba ni/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis las dang nyon mongs pa dang / mi shes pa dang / bag med pa dang / ma gus pa dang / snyoms las kyi 9ba bo bang du gyur pa'i rang bzhin dang bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba 'bargyas pa dang / dam tshig dang mi ldan pa dang / dam tshig ma dag pa dang tsho gis 'dres pa dang /spyod yul gcig tu gyur pa dang / bsnyen pa dang sgrub pa la mi brtson pa dang / srung ma khyad par can khyed rnams dus dus su ma mchod cing ma gsol ba'i dbang gis sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig nyams chags su gyur pa dang / khyed rnams kyi thugs dang 'gal bar gyur ba thams cad spros med rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang las/ /thugs rje dang mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug dpal mgon khyad par can khyed rnamasakyi spyan sngar mthol lo bshags so/ /bzod par gsol lo/ /mkha' la sprin dengs pa'am/ rgya mtsho la rlabs zhi ba ltar snangs par spyad pa dang/ de'i 'bras bu thams cad med par gyur cig /zhi bar gyur cig /rab tu zhi bar gyur cig /sngags dang phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin gyis byin gyis brlabs pasamachod sbyin gyi gtor ma dar sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa 'di dang / rta mchog rgyan gyis brgyan pa 'di dang / tshogs kyi 'khor lo dam pa dang bcas pa'i mchod pa 'dis dpal mgon srung ma khyad par can —14

dpal mgon po che chung las mkhan rnams kyi bskang bshags chos srung dgyes pa'i sgra dbyangs/ 9)khyed rnams kyi thugs dam bskong bar gyur cig /bzhed pa 'grub par gyur cig /re ba rdzogs par gyur cig /de ltar gyur nas kyang rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod rnams kyi sngon gyi las las gyur pa dang / 'phral gyi rkyen las gyur pa'i nad dang gdon dang rims dang bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ dgra dang bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams (7na)cad bzlog tu gsol/ tshe dang bsod nams dang dpal dang 'byor pa dang / dbang phyug phun sum tshogs par mdzad du gsol/ mdor na 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ khyod thugs gsang ba dam pa'i mdzod/ /dgyes pa chen po'i sgo phye las/ /dngosagrub phrin las bdud rtsi yis/ /rgyun gi bdag rgyud gtams par mdzod/ lan gsum dang / bstan srung rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams chags thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /bzod par gsol lo/ /tshangs par stsal du gsol/zhes phyag gsum btsal te gral la 'khod do/ /bskang rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ bskang rdzas rnams la rdo rjes nang mchod gtor/ a mri tas bsangs/ sa bha bas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ gnas khang zlo las drag po'i las kyi gzhal yas khang tshad dang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du bskang rdzas rnams dgra bgegs gdug pa can ma lus pa bsgral ba las byung ba'i khrag zhag gi mchod yon/ dbang po lnga dang dri ldan gyi me rtagagasur chen gyi bdug spos/ zhun chen gsal ba'i sgron me/ mkhris chen gyi dri chab/ sha rus gtams pa'i bza' ba/ rkang gling snyan pa'i rol mo/ g.yang gzhi'i bla bre/ rgyu rlon gyi lda ldi/ gsang ba'i rnga chung / mi rkang gi gling bu/ gzhan yang mdzes pa'i spu sdug (7bsgo kha' la lding ba/ rta mchog rin cen rgyan sa rgyas brgyan pa/ g.yag rog zhol chen sprin ltar gtibs pa/ lug nag spyi dkar shel ltar 'tsher ba/ khyi nag snying dkar dom ltar 'phyo ba/ mi nag gying po srog gi gshed ma/ skye 'gro sems can la sogs pa/ stag gzig go mtshon la sogs pa/ dam rdzas rgyan dang ldan pa'i gtor ma/ 'chi med bdud —/5

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)rtsi sman gyi rgya mtsho/ dza gad phud kyi btung ba la sogs pa'i bskang rdzas/ mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa 'di dag dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral bran g.yog bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang / mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa 'khor dang bcas pa'i spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig /oṃ sarba bid/ pu ra pu ra/ su ra su ra/ a wa rta ya a wa rta ya sngo badz+ra skyo ra ṇa kho su hā/ zhes brjod cing nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgyas se gol gtog pa dang bcas pa lan gsum bya/ de nas dar nag dang gsur chen sogs kyi lag len/ gtor chog gi lhan thabs ltar byas te rol mos byin legs par dbab/ dmigs pa lhan thabs dang man ngag ltar byas ngos/ gur mgon gyi bskang gso ni/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros bas zhes pa nas/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dza:zhes pa'i bar dang / phyag rgya rnams gtore chog ltar byed/ dbyangs kyi nga ro dang bcas pas//dam pa kun dga' grags kyis mdzad/hūṃ/ chos nyid ngang las ma(8na g.yos kyang / /bstan pa bsrung phyir chos stong sku/ /nag po chen po stobs po che/ /dus la bab kyi las la spyon/ /he ru ka yi sprul pa ste/ /srid gsum thams cad sgrol mdzad pa/ /sku las sprul pa du ma 'phro/ /mchod pa'i gnas 'dir myur du spyon/ /hūṃ/ nag po chen po 'khor bcas rnams/ /'bar ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ khrag po'i las la spyan 'dren no/ /'dir bzhugs dgra bgegs bzlog tu gsol/ /oshrī ma hā kā lwa ya/ma hā kā lī de nyis ka dzā dzin zhi in+da gis pa ri wā ra e gye hi/ zhes pa nas/ pad+ma snam lu ya ri/ sngagasamachod/ dam bsgrags/ gtor 'bul/ 'phrin bcol rnams bya/ lha dpal ldan mgon po 'khor bcas la/ /mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'bul ba ni/ /dmar chen khrag gi a dang / /dbang po lnga yi me tog dang / /tshil chen rkang klad bsregs pa'i spos/ /zhun chen til mar sgron me dang / /rdo rje rang byung dri chab dang / sha chen rnam lnga'i zhal zas dang / /rkang gling thod rnga snyan pa'i sgra/ /dngos lor yid sprul mkha' khyab pas/ /ma hā kā la lcam dral dang / /dam can pu tra 'khor bcas kyi/ /thugs dam gnyan po bskang zhing bshags/ /sku gsung thugs mchog mnyes nas kyang / /dgra bgegs ma lus bskul nas—16

dpal mgon po che chung lasamakhan rnam kyi bskang bshags chos srung dgyes pa'i sgra dbyangs/ 9)ni//sgrub mchog bdag la dngos grub stsol//lhaḥgazhan yang mchod rdzas 'bul ba ni//'bru bcud stong sbyar dza gad dang //rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi dang //dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i don snying dang //sha dang rus pa'i 8ba gtore tshogs dang //de bzhin tshe 'dzin khrag rgyun gyis//mas ldan gri thod bkang ba rnams//ma hā kā li ྾zhes pa nas/grub mchog bdag la dngos sgrub stsol//yan sbyar ba 'gre/lhaḥde las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs//zhing chen bla bre 'phan gdugs dang /khyu rlon lda ldi snying 'phreng dang //keng rus sna tsho gos sa gzhi gang /sha khrag dri gsur rgyun mi chad//sna tsho gis rgyan gyi mchod pa 'dis//ma hā ྾//lhaḥrnam dag tsho gis kyi gtor ma 'di//sna tsho gos rgyan gyis rab brgyan nas//sngags dang phyag rgyas rgya cher spel//ro brgya ldan pa'i mchod gtor 'dis//ma hā ྾//lhaḥmadzes pa'i spu sdug mkha' la lding //bya nag lcags kyi mchu sder can//ma hā ྾//hūṃ/rta mchog nag po sprin gyi shugs//myur mgyogs mdzes pa'i rgyan dang ldan//lhang lhang la'i la'i phyogs sto sgrogatang shes rgyal thogs med 'dis//ma hā ྾/hūṃ/g.yag rgod lcags rmig khro chu'i mig/mdzes pa'i rā dang rnga yab can//ma hā ྾//lhaḥkhyi nag dung gi mche ba can //seng ge'i stobs ldan rngam zhing rgyug/ma hā ྾//hūṃ/luganag lcags ru dar gyi brgyan//bdud kyi spu nor mdzes pa 'dis//ma hā ྾//lhaḥmi nag gying chen rdo phrul can//las kun byed pa'i stobs ldan 'dis//ma hā ྾//lhaḥdapal gyi zhal zas 'brang rgyas mchog/rak+ta'i thig les brgyan pa dang //ra gha'i yon chab rab bskyil ba/khrog rtsa'i lam nas brtane pa 'dis//ma hā ྾//hūṃ/gri snying rtsa lag ma nyams pa//rin cen sman gyis 9nasgo kang ba dang //'bru sna stong gi bcud bsdus pa'i//gzi brjid che bar mnga' bskyed chang //ma hā ྾//hūṃ/smyug ma rtse rgyal mnyen ldan la//spu sdug bya rgod sgro yis brgyan///nam mkha' sku rten rgyang bu la//'phan gdugs mdzes pas bskor ba 'dis//ma hā ྾//hūṃ/rdo rje brag ri gtams pa'i steng //sna tsho gis pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan/sems bral mi ro'i gdan steng na//hūṃ las byung ba'i srin po'i gzugs//sku ni mthing nag chen po ste//zhal gcig phyag ni gnyis dang ldan//phyag 7

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)g.yas gri gug thugs gar 'phyar/ /g.yon pa thod khrag zhal du gsol/ /rnam 'phrul gaṇ+ḍi thugs gar 'dzin/ /thod skam lnga yi dbu la brgyan/ /thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal byas/ /stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ /ro yi steng na 'gying zhing bzhugs/ /dbu skra ser po gyen du 'bar/ /spyan gsum zhal bgrad mche ba gtsigs/ /klu brgyad sku yi rgyan du byas/ /dur khrod chen po'i klong dkyil na/ /ye shes me 'bar dbus na bzhugs/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol mdzad pa'i/ /dpal ldan ma hā kul dang / /dpal ldan lha mo mthu chen ma/ /dam can 'khor dang bcas rnams la/ /mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'di 'bul gyi/ /nag po chen po 'khor bcas bzhes/ /྅: nag po chen po'i thugs dam bskangs/ /lha chen dpal 'bar ྾/ /'jigs byed chen po'i ྾/ /lha mchog nag po'i ྾/ /tshogs bdag chen po'i ྾/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad ྾/ khrag 'thung nag po'i ྾/ /bstan srung (9ba bā na po'i ྾/ /lhaḥ khyod kyi thugs dam bskang ba'i rdzas/ /bsten pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir/ /lug nag rgyal mtshan dag gisabaskang / /'bod pa'i dam rdzas ra/ /g.yab dar nag pos mo/ dam tshig gnyan po bsro ba'i phyir/ /bdud rtsi sman gyis za/ /gsang ba'i dam rdzas za/ /gri rgod snying gis mo/ /dgyes pa'i dam rdzas sko/ /lug nag snying gis ྾/ /drag po'i las la shis pa'i phyir/ /dmar nag gzhos bus ྾/ /rak+ta skom du 'thung ba'i phyir/ /dmar chen a rgyus྾/ /gsur chen dri la bsnom pa'i phyir/ /tshil chen dud pas mo/ /rtag tu mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i phyir/ /rten gtor chen pos mo/ khyun du phrin las mdzad pa'i phyir/ /rgyun gyis gtor mas ྾/ /gsang sngags bstan pa srung ba'i phyir/ /'dod yon tsho gis kyis ra/ /mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'di dag gis/ /dpal ldan mgon po 'khor bcas kyis/ /thugs dam gnyan po bskang zhing bshags/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi nyams chags kun/ /skong gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ lhaḥmathun pa'i dam rdzas 'di dag gis/ /dpal ldan mgon po'i thugs dam bskang / /ma gcig lha mo'i ྾/ /gnod sbyin nag po'i ྾/ /bka' stod pu tra'i ྾/ /dam can rgya mtsho'i ྾/ /nag po 'bum sde'i ྾/ /las mkhan bran gyi ྾/ /lha dpal ldan mgon po 'khor bcas kyi/ /thugs dam gnyan po — 18

dpal mgon po che chung las mkha rnams kyi bskang bshags chos srung dgyes pa'i sgro dbyangs/ (da)skongs gyur nas//bdag cag 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis/khyod la gsol ba 'debs pa ni//bstan la sdang pa'i dgra bo yis/ /dkyil 'khor rbod gtong bral ba srid/ /nyes byed sdebs su shor ba srid//bdag cag rnal 'byor 10na ba pa po//rdo rje slob dpon slob mar bcas//rdo rje mched dang lcam dral dang /khyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po yi//lus kyi nad rigs thams cad bzlog/nor gyi god kha thams cad bzlog/zhing la btsa' ser sad ma gtong //bdud kyi zhags pa nag po chod//gshin rje'i khram kha dgra pre//mi mthun rkyen dang bar chad sol//'khor bcas srungs la rkyen ga bzlog/sdang ba'i dgra la rtags thon zhig/gnod pa'i bgegs rnams med par mdzod//'dod pa'i dngosagrub bdag la stsol//bcol ba'i 'phrin las myur du mdzod/mgon po zhal gyi bskang gso ni/thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phrosapasazhesapa nas/chabadz+ras mā dzaḥzhes pa'i bar dang /phyag rgya rnams gtor chog ltar byas/dbyangs kyi nga ro dang bcas pas/tshes lnga lhu po tsho a rtsom rtse lug sa bzang rtse pa'i phyag4kho/lhaḥdus gsum rgyal ba'i spyan sngar rang rang gis//srog gi snying po phul nas dam bcas bzhin//dam tshig ldan pa'i bka' srung yongs kyi gtso//lha mchog ma hā kā la gshegs su gsol//te se'i gangs la rtag par bzhugs pa'i tshe//sde brgyad yum bzhi'i 'khor gyis yongs su bskor//rnal 'byor yongs kyi dgra lha mthu rtsal can//dmag dpon chen po gnas 'dir ྾//po ta la yi ri la bzhugs pa'i tshe//gdong bzhi'i sprul pa phyogs bcur 'gyed pa yis//dus drug tu ni bstan pa'i bya ra mdzad//lha chen drag po zhal bzhi ྾//byang shar ha ha dgod pa'i dur khrod nas//zhing skyong dbang phyug chen po'i thugs kyi sras//ma mo mkha'10ba'i gro kun gyi gtso bo ste//zhing skyong gzi ldan dbang phyug ྾//bsil pa tshal gyi dur khrod gnas na bzhuṭa/kha sar pa ni'i ri sul rnal 'byor mas//gnyan gyi srung mar bka' bsgos rab bzhugs pa//bram ze'i gzugs can dpa' bo ྾//da lta dar lung gnyan gyi rdzo brang du//bka' bsgos bzhin du bsrung ba'i las rnams mdzad/khyod kyi rten sa kha'u brag rdzong ste//bdag gi las rnam/bsgrub phyir ྾/shar phyogs nam mkha' yangs

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)pa'i dkyil yangs nas/ /yum chen g.yung mo nag mo ྾/ /lho phyoṭa nam mkha' ྾/ /las mdzad gtum mo ljang khu ྾/ zhub phyogs mo/ /dmar nag srin mo chen mo ྾/ /byang phyogs za/ /ser nag siṅga gling ma ྾/ /rgyal chen sdebazhi ru mtshon pur ru mā /rgyal chen sdebazhi 'khor bcas mo/ /phyogs skyong bcu ni nam mkha'i sprin ltar sa tibs/ /phyogs skyong bcu po 'khor bcas ྾/ /nag po stong gi las byed khyugs rtse khyug /nag po stong gi tshogs rnams mo/ sha za'i tsho gos rnams rkan sgra togos rtse togo sha za'i tshogs rnams 'khor bcas ྾/ /ma mo bye ba'i gdung dbyangs kyur ru sa /ma mo bye ba'i tshogasarnams mo/ /lha srin sdo brgyad bso sgra dir ri ri/ /lha srin sdebargyad tsho gos rnams mo/ /bdud dang srin mo'i dung 'bud rub se rub/ /bdud dang srin po'i tshogs rnams ྾/ /stag spyang seng ge'i ngar sgra 'ur ru sa /stag spyang seng ge'i tshogs rnams ྾/ /bzhad dang gang ga'i kha rlangs spungs se spungs/ /ba 'ad dang gam ga'i tshogs rnams ྾/ /khyung chen bya nag gshog sgra 'ur ru sa /khyung chen bya nag tshogs(11na snams mo/ /bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho spungs rtse spung/ /bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho ྾/ /lhaḥsngon tshe rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga sa /gtum po khyod kyis ji ltar khas blangs bzhin/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi'i las la spyan 'dren na/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa srung phyir gshegasu gsol/ /lhaḥ gzha los mdzad/lha mchog ma hā kā la mthu bo che/ /'phrin las drag pos gdug pa tshar gcod phyir/ /ha ha dgod pa'i dur khrod 0 po nas/ /zhing skyong chen po gnas 'dir ྾/ /myur mgyogs sde brgyad dmag dpon mdzad tsa na/ /te se gangs ri'i gnas nas ྾/ /gdong bzhi'i sprul pa phyogs bcur 'gyed tsa na/ /po ta la yi ri nas ྾/ /mkha' 'gro mang po'i gtso bo mdzad tsa na/ /dur khrod bsil pa'i tshal nas ri/ /dam nyams dgra bgegs rtsad nas gcod tsa na/ /dar lung gnyan gyi gnas nas ྾/ /rnal 'byor dam ldan srung ma mdzad tsa na/ kha'u brag rdzong gnas ྾/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa phyogs bcur spel tsa na/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i gnas nas ྾/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi stong grogs mdzad pa'i tshe/ /chos 'khor rgyal gyi gtsug lag khang nas gshegs/ /lha mchog ma hā kā la spyan 'dren no/ /lha chen drag po zhal —20

dpal mgon po che chung las mkhan rnams kyi bskang bshags cho srung dgyes pa'i sgra dbyangs/ (gebazhi gshegs su gsol//zhing skyong gzi ldan dbang phyug ྾//bram ze'i gzugs can dpa' ba ྾//yum chen g.yung mo nag mo ྾//las mdzad gtum mo ljang khu ྾//dmar nag srin mo chen mo ྾//ser nag seng ge gling ma ྾//'khor gyi zhing skyong tsho ge rnams ri/khregs pa sdebargyad tshogs rnams mo//1bgri thogs bshan pa'i tsho gos rnams sko//ma lus 'khor bcas spyan 'dren gnas 'dir gas//da spos gleng rtse pos tshe kha te spos da/kye bos so chos skyong snyan ma sra//g.yab bon ga po spyan ma brtul//bsten no nag po rgyang ma ring //sgrub bo nag po dgongs ma g.yel//bskul lo nag po phrag ma dog/rbad do nag po mthu ma chung //kyeḥdo nub dam tshig gnas 'dir spyon//do nub chad dang mtho la spyon//do nub mna' dang khrims la spyon//grogs po bgyi'o gci ma ga//mdza' bor bgyi'o khrel ma bor//mna' mtho yod do mna' mja//rje bor bgyid do dbang ma che//bran ltar bskul lo rgyud ma ga//dam tshig gzha la mi sems sam//dang por chad don 'di min nam//chos skyong ma hā kā la dang //rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag cag gnyis/dam tshig srung bar ma chad dam//bstan pa srung bar ྾/dngos grub ster bar ྾//dgra bgegs sgrol bar ྾//'phrin las sgrub par ྾//dam bca' ma g.yel da tshur spyon//bcol ba'i las de ma byas na//bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' yang bslus//rig 'dzin rnal 'byor yid yang ho//dang por ho pa'i mna' yang zos//dam tshig gto po'i ho pa yong //bka' yi dmod pas bsdigs par mchis//de bas dam las ma 'da' bar//bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub pa'i phyir//da lta nyid du gshegs su gsol//bcom ldan rdo rje 'chang gi pho nya ba//'brin las drag pos gdug pa tshar gcod phyir//ha ha dgod pa'i dur khrod 2na ji na po nas//zhing skyong chen po gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol//oṃ ma hā kā la kā la zhes pa nas gnyis su med par gyur zhes pa'i bar dang /pad+ma ka mā la ye sto/sngags mchod/dam bsgrag/gtor 'bul phrin bcol rnams bya/lhaḥ༅ma pas mdza/dur khrod chen po gnas brgyad dang /khyad par bsil ba tshal gyi gnas//chos skyong mgon po thams cad dang /khyad par dpal mgon gdong bzhi pa//gnas 'dir spyan 'dren

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)da tshur spyon/ /ha ha dgod pa'i dur khrod nas/ /sgeg cing dpa' ba'i cha lugs can/ /dpal ldan mgon po gdong bzhi pa/ /gnas 'ar spyan 'dren gsheṭa su gsol/ /po ta la yi ri bo nas/ /mi srun k+ṣ-i k+ṣi ཾ sgra sgrog pa'i/ /dpal ldan ྾/ /gnas 'dir ྾/ /te se gangs can ri bo nas/ /drag shul 'jigs rung srin po'i gzugs/ /dpal ldan ྾/ /gnas 'dir ྾/ /dam tshig ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ khyed la mchod cing bsten pa yi/ /dpal ldan ྾/ /gnas 'dir ྾/ /dam tshig can la dgongasasu gsol/ /g.yag nag lug nag phyi yi rten/ /zhwa nag gos nag nang gi rten/ /gri snying thod pa gsang ba'i rten/ /dpal ldan mgon po'i rten du 'dzugs/ /yan lag brgyad ldan sman gyi chab/ /gri khrag mi khrag 'dres pa yi/ /dug chu 'khol ma'i yon chab 'di/ /dpal ldan mgon po'i spyan sngar 'bul/ /pad+ma ut+pal sngon po dang / /bawo dug ra dug shing dug dang / /me tog sngon po dri ma can/ dpal ldan mgon po'i dbu la 'bul/ /gu gul a ka ru (12bzhag dang / /rnga mo bong bu'i bdud rtsi dang / sha chen tshil chen bdug spos 'di/ dpal ldan mgon po'i shangs la 'bul/ /mi rta bya rog ba glang tshil/ /ra tshil khyi tshil phag tshil dang / /zhun chen gsal ba'i sgron me 'di/ /dpal ldan mgon po'i spyan la 'bul/ /tsan dan ga bur gla rtsi dang / sha rus khrag rus dug sbyar ba'i/ /mkhris chen gzhin byasabasil dang ldan/ /dmar nag 'brug pa'i dri chab 'di/ /dpal ldan mgon po'i thugs la 'bul/ /ro brgya ldan pa'i zas mchogo dang / /nas nag til nag bra nag dang / sha rus chen po'i zhal zas 'di/ /dpal ldan mgon po'i zhal du 'bul/ /mi rkang dung dang ḍa ma sa /rnga chen rnga chung ting ting shags/ /rol mo sna tsho gis dbyangs bcas pa/ /dpal ldan mgon po'i snyan du 'bul/ zhes rab ma da na dang ni/ /thabs kyi me sa chen po dang / /dam rdzas rgyan gyi tsho gos phud 'di/ /dpal ldan mgon po'i ljagasal 'bul/ /mtshan nyid ldan pa'i gnas mchag 'dir/ /thod chen sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ /ye shes lnga sogasagacig car ste/ /rten cing 'brel 'byung sngags phyag rgyas/ /byin rlabs dam rdzas sna tsho gos kyis/ /gtor ma rgyan dang bcas pa dang / /tshil chen gzhir sbyar sbyar spos 'di/ /dpal ldan mgon po khyod la 'bul/ /—22

dpal mgon po che chung las mkhan rnams kyi bskang bshags chos srung dgyes pa'i sgra dbyangs/ 9)de ltar dngos bshams yid sprul pa'i//mar pa'i sprin gyi phung po 'di//zhing skyong gdong bzhi'i thugs dam bskang//dpal mgon khyod kyi thugs dam bskang //g.yung mo gtum mo'i ྾//srin mo sing gling ྾//bka' gnyan sdo brgyad ྾//sprul pa'i yang 13na rdzal ྾//gsol cig mchod do bzhes su gsol//rnal lhor bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod//bar go bdud dang 'gal rkyen spongs//mthun rkyen tshe dang dpal 'byor spel//bla ma dke sgo mchog dbu 'phang bstod//sangs rgyas bstan srung sems can rnams//phan tshun byams dang rab ldan ste//bde skyid dpal la sbyor du gsol//lhaḥthams༅ ma' pa dge bon rgya mtshos mdzad/bde chen cho me sku'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang //te se gangs sogs gar bzhugs pho brang nas//dpal ldan nag po chen po yum chen bzhi//dam can rgya mtsho'i tsho gos bcasad tshur spyon//mdun gyi nam mkhar me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus//chos 'byung khrag zhag rgya mtsho 'khyil ba'i nang //pad nyi dgra bgegs bsnol ba'i gdan steng du//zhal bzhi phyag bzhi mig sman lhun po bzhin//srin po'i gzugs can dgra bgegs rdul du rlog/sna tshogs rnam 'gyur du ma'i zlos gar mkhan//gdug pa'i 'khor tshogs rnams dang lhan cig tu//rnal 'byor 'phrin las sgrub phyir brtan par bzhugs//dpal ldan nag po chen po 'khor bcas la//zag med bde ba chen po'i ye shes kyi//rol pa las byung sna tshogasamachod pa nge sprin//nam mkha'i khams kun bkang te 'bul ba ni//dgra bgegs khrag zhag mchod yon mtsho ltar bskyil//chu skyes sngon po'i phreng bas bar snang gang /sha chen dud pa'i sprin phung mkha' lam khyab//zhun chen sgron me tshar du dngar ba 'di//lha chen drag 13ba ) po zhal bzhi'i thugs dam bskang //las mdzad yum chen bzhi yi ྾//bka' gnyan 'khor tsho gis rgya mtsho'i ྾//thugs dam skong zhing nyams chags gsos gyur cig/ga bur dri ngad g.yo ldan khrag zhag gi/dri byu dmar ser lha ba'i do shal tso//sna tsho gos bza' dang 4'a ba ro brgyar ldan/sha khrag phang phung chags pa'i zhal zas 'dis//lha chen drag po sogs tshig rkang bzhi po 'gre//mdzes pa'i snod du rab gtams 'chi med kyi//bdud rtsi la 'gran sna tshogs brtsang ba dang //phyogs kun dal gyis

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)dgod pa'i 'brug sgra bzhin//brjid pa'i sgra ldan rol mo'i tsho gos rnams kyis//lha chen ྾/rdzu 'phrul bang ldan glog phreng 'gyu ba bzhin//nor bu'i sga srab mdzes pa'i chas kyis brgyan//'ja' tshon ltar bkra'i dar gyi cod pan can//stong gsum yud kyis bskor ba'i rta mchog 'dis//lha chen ྾//lhun sdug char sprin g.yo ba'i rnam pa can//drag po'i ngar sgra 'brug gi gad mo bzhin//rno ba'i rwa ldan stobs kyis ri rab kyang //thal bar rlog byed g.yag rog zhol chen 'dis//lha chen ྾/sha rgyas dal gyis 'gro ba 'dzin ma'i rgyan//spyi bo rab dkar zla tshes bkod pa bzhin//'jam pa'i spu ldan in+d+ra ni la ltar/ /mdzes pa'i rwa bzhi 'khyil ba'i lug nag 'dis/ /lha chen྾/ /mi bzad lcags kyu dang mtshungs sder mo yis//dgra bo'i snying 'byin mchu yis rgyu rlon gyi//lda ldi 'phyang zhing mkha' la khyung bzhin du//'dab ma'i gar byed bya nag tsho gis rnams kyis//lha chen ྾//la la ce spyang bzhin du 'dur zhing rgyug/14na sgo ga' zhig gdong lnga'i dbang po lta bur 'gying //gzhan dag dgra bgegs sha rus chem chem za//dam nyams srog 'phrog 'jigs pa'i khyi nag 'dis//lha chen ྾//stong gsum khyon ltar yangs pa'i ka pā lar//dgra bgeṭa sha khrag spungs pa'i gtor ma ni//dbang po'i gzhu ltar dwangasapa'i dar gyi tshogs//'phur lding sa dang bar snang khyon gang bas//lha chen ྾//dgra bgegs srog 'phrog 'bar ba'i gri gug dang //bdud sde'i nags tshal gcod pa'i ral gri dang //dug gsum dbyingasasu sgrol ba'i rtse gsum dang //dam nyams snying la bsnun pa'i mdung snon 'dis//lha chen ྾//dmar chen sha khrag rol ba'i thod pa dang //myos byed gas bas gang ba'i bum pa dang //sgyu skar do shal dang mtshungs rus 'phreng dang //gnas gsum mkha' 'gro 'bod pa'i rkang gling 'dis//lha chen ྾//gzhan yang dpal ldan mgon po mnyes bya'i phyir/sku gsung thugs dang phyi nang gsang ba'i rten//gling bzhi ri rab rin cen bdan la sogs//dngos bshams yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod sprin 'dis//lha chen ྾//gdod nas rang bzhin dag pa sems kyi dbyings//glo bur dri ma gsum gyis g.yogs pa las//rmi lam bzhin du 'khrul pas nongs pa rnams//sgrib 4bral chos kyi dbyings su dag par bgyi//drag po

dpal mgon po che chung las mkhan rnams kyi bskang bshags chos srung dgyes pa'i sgra dbyangs/ 9)gzi ldan dbang phyug 'khor bcas kyis/ /gdug pa'i dgra 'gegs ma lus tshar chod la/ /bstan pa bsrung zhing bstan 'dzin skyong ba dang / /rnal 'byor 'phrin las bsgrub la ma g.yel zhig(14bskor losamadzad/ lhaḥ lha mchog mahā kā la mthu bo che/ khyod la mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'bul ba ni/ /g.yag rog zhol chen sprin ltar gtibs pa dang / /rta nag rting dkar rlung ltar 'phyo ba dang / /lug nag spyi dkar shel ltar 'tsher ba dang / /khyung ltar lding ba'i bya nag tshogs rnams dang / khyi nag snying dkar dom ltar 'phyo ba la/ /mthing nag dar gyi cod paṇa mang pos brgyan/ /lha mchog ma hā kā la'i thugs dam bskang / /lha chen drag po zhal bzhi'i thugs dam bskang / /zhing skyong gzi ldan dbang phyug thugs dam bskang / /bram ze'i gzugs can dpa' bo'i thugs dam bskang / /yum chen g.yung mo nag mo'i thugs dam bskang / /las mdzad gtum mo ljang gu'i thugs dam bskang / /dmar nag srin mo chen mo'i thugs dam bskang / /ser nag siṅga gling ma'i thugs dam bskang / /'khor gi zhing skyong tsho gos kyi thugs dam bskang / /dregs pa sdebargyad tsho gos kyi thugs dam bskang / /'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam skongs gyur nas/ /rnal 'byor dpon slob nyams chags sos gyur cig /rak+ta dmar chen khrag gi a lha dang / /dri ldan gsar rnying me tog nag po dang / /tshil ོ me sa spos kyi dud sprin dang / /sa r+ṣa sgron me 'bar ba'i snang gsal dang / khrag zhag rgya mtshor 'khyil ba'i dri chab dang / /zhal zas bsgos bu dmar nag ri rab tsam/ sha khrag rkang rus gtos pa'i tshom bu bkod/ /rkang gling snyan pa'i rol mo'i sgra sgrog cing / /sna tshogs mchod pa'i sprin gyis brgyan pa 'dis/ /lha mchog ma hā sogs sh+lau ka gsum sbyor/ /(15na dam rdzas rgyan dang ldan pa'i gtor ma dang / /'chi med bdud rtsi sman gyi rgya mtsho dang / /dza gad phud kyi btung ba sna tshogs dang / /bza' dang btung ba ri dang rgya mtsho tsam/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs pa'i/ /ro brgya ldan pa'i mchod pa rgya mtsho 'dis/ /lha mchog sogs 〈 ka gsum gyi mthar/ /gdong bzhi dregs pa 'khor dang bcas pa yis/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung zhing skyong ba dang / /gnod pa'i dgra bgegs thal ba'i rdul du rlog /zhi rgyas dbang drag dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /lhaḥ g.yul —25

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)du bsad pa'i mtshon lcags gri khrag dang //dug chusang ra blud stobs chen shugs drag 'bar//'chang bzung rdo rje rtse lnga'i yu ba can//gri gug stobs 'phrog nag po'i phyag tu 'bul//g.yul du ྾//dug chus྾//dar nag phyang phrul yu ba rdo rjes mtshan//rtse gsum stobs 'phrog ྾//g.yul du ྾//dug chus྾//rdo rje'i 44 bzung rtse mor modapung wor//ral gri mo//g.yul du ྾//dug chus྾//gri snying mgul btags ba dan lhab lhub can//mdung rnon ྾//mchog mthun dngos grub yid bzhin char 'bebs pa//rnal wor 'dod dgu 'jo ba dpa' bo'i rdzas//bde stong zung 'jug rak+ta 'khyil ba'i snod//thod khrag legs ldan gdong bzhi'i phyag tu 'bul//mchog thun ྾//rnal 'byor ྾/khun ོ srad bur brgyus pa gri thod kyi//brgya 'phreng legs ldan ྾//mchog sa ྾//rnal 'byor ྾//'chi med bdud rtsis gtams pa'i gser sbyangs kyi//bum bzang ྾//mchog 15bar//rnal 'byor ྾//gnas gsum mkha' 'gro 'bod pa'i sgra dbyangs can//rkang gling legs ྾//mchog ྾//rnal lhor ྾//rang byung rdo nag gru gsum maṇ+ḍal//bla rdo legs ldan gdong bzhi'i rten du 'bul//mchog ྾/rnal wor ྾//sngags 'khor rdzas kyis bkang ba'i rtsa gsum can//gri snying khos za//zhi rgyas dbang gis mthun pa'i rkyen rnams spel//ma wa zhe spyod drag pos dgra bgegs thal bar rlog/zab gsang lam gyis rang sems dag pa'i mgon//tshe 'dir bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin thob shog/ces pa 'di ni rnam par rgyas pa'i phan bde legs bshad gling par zhal gyi phyag mtshan 'bul tshig gnyan dang tshar chen gyis mdzad pa gang rung 'dzugs pa'i nyer bsdogs kyi tsha//bya rog skad snyan par sgra drag bo yun ring bsgrags par brten de gnyis kyi don tshang ba'i gsar sgrigs gyis zhes khyab bdag khra tshang nas kyis kyang gsung gi bskul ma thag dbu btsugs pa dang dus mnyam du bya rog g.yin du 'phur song bas ngo mtshar te/za hor gyi bsdos sug bris su byas/྅:rdo rje kho bos0mas/la4 dbang 'phagasamachog klu sgrub nas//rnal 'byor dbang mo'i bar byon bla ma yis//bsten cing bsgrubs pa'i gnasamachog tshogs rnams nas//stobs 'phrog gdong ༷zhi gzi ldan dbang phyug bzhengs//lo chen gnyan

dpal mgon po che yo las mkha rnams kyi bskang bshag chos srung dgyes pa'i sgra dbyangs/ rtogedang dar ma rgyal mtshan gyis//bran bzhin bkol ba'i gtum chen bram ze'i gzugs//sgrub pa'i gnasamachog dar lung me 'bar dang /kha'u'i brag rdzong dag nas sku bzhengs shig/'jam dbyangs bdun sogs rigs 'dzin sa skya ba//nam mkha' rgyal mtshan bdag chen blo gros rje'i//16na phra zhin lasam lus bsgrub pa'i srung ma che//dpal ldan sa skya'i gtsug lag khang nas bzhengs/grub pa'i dbang phyug bram ze mchog sred zhabs//snyan brgyud bstan pa'i bdag po kun spangs rje'i//rnam rol gang de'i bka' srung bshan pa che//grom stod kha'u brag rdzong gnas nas bzhedas/rdo rje 'amang dbang sprul pa'i zlos gar mkhan/gsang wo slob bshad bstan 'dzin tshar pa rje'i//bstan srung stobs 'phrog nag po zhal bzhi pa//gsang chen rdo rje'i pho brang gnas nas bzhengs//bsod na mas mchoge gi 'jig rten dbang phyug dpal//rgya mtsho'i mtshan can bzhad pa'i rdo rje yis//bsten cing rbad pas sde brgyad dmag dpon che//chos 'khor rgyal gyi gtsug lag khang nas bzhengs//mkhyen brtse nus pa'i dbang phyug dang po'i mgon//kun bzang bde chen dga' ston ster ba'i dpal//bgrang yas dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i bdag wo mchog/drin wo bla ma'i bka' srung dbyings nas bzhengs//rigs 'dzin mchog des rdo rje'i dam tshig gis//bran dang grogs gi tshul du bka' bsgos shing //sngags yong bdag gisadus kun bsgrubs pa yi//srog 'phrog khrag 'thung nag po da bzhengs shig/de ltar rtsa brgyud bla ma nas bzung ste//rnal 'byor rdo rje 'dzin pa bdag gi bar//bsten cing bsgrubs pa'i lha mchog mthu bo che//gsol zhing mchod pa'i lha chen nag po che//rbad cig bskul ba'i zhing skyong drag shul can//dgra bo'i stobs 'phrog dpa' bo bram ze'i gzugs//rab 'jigs yum chen 16ba ) 'khor tshogs rgya mtshor bcas/gson cig dgongs shig ye shes dbyings nas gzigs//rbad du bskul lo dam rdzo gnyan po dgongs/ khros shig 'chos shig drag po'i las la bh+yo//sngon gyi khas blangs dam tshig dran gyis la//ma thogs rings pa'i tshul gyis wen las sgrubs/dam can mnol bu lcam dral gyi bskang ba ni/7lhaḥsgo wo gyis mdzad/khrag 'thung dpal r+ṣa khros

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)pa'i rnam 'phrul mchog /mgon po'i bka' nyan dregs pa'i sde dpon che/ /stobs chen dam can gnod sbyin yab yum gnyis/ /ma g.yel dam tshig dgongs la gnas 'dir gshegs/ /bden tshig grub pa'i bram ze 'byugs pa las/ /skye 'gro'i srog bdud mon bu pho mor sprul/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i mngag bzhug zhing bcu'i gshed/ /bka' sdod lcam dral gnas 'dir myur du spyon/ /gsod byed gshin rje pu tra gnas 'dir spyon/ /bdud chen ma lon bu bha tra ྾/ sha za srin mo ral gcig ྾/ /stobs chen ru 'dren sde bzhi ྾/ /mon nag gying chen 'bum sde ྾/ /nad bdag ma mo bye ba ྾/ /snang srid lha srin sde brgyad ྾/ /sprul pa yang sprul bcas pa ྾/ /rnal 'byor snying nas gdung ba'i 'bod dbyangs dang / /dar nag g.yab mo g.yab cing khyod 'bod do/ /nam mkha' bar snang char sprin btib pa ltar/ /spyon gyi dam tshig dgongs la gnas 'dir spyon/ /mi rkang gling bu rnga chen rol mo'i sgra/ khrag chang btung ba sha rus gtor ma'i tshogs/ /dam can pho mo 'bod phyir bshams lags na/ /sa gzhi rma dmar ji bzhin 'tshub se spyon/ khyed (17na8 rgyal ba'i bstan srung dbang po ste/ /bdag ni rigs sngaṭa 'chang ba'i sgrub pa po/ /rtsa brgyud bla mas ji ltar bka' bsgos pa/ /dran par gyis la ma thogs da lta spyon/ /badz+ra kā la yak+ṣa nas/ dra lo rak+ṣa sa sa pa ri wā ra e gye hi/ badz+ra sa mā dza : dza ཿlha baṃ hoḥ lha mngon spyod drag po'i pho brang 'dir/ /gdug can baṃ r+ṣa bsgyel ba'i khrir/ /stobs kho mon pa pho mo rnams/ /khro 'khrug rngams pa'i rol pas bzhugs/ /gong gi sngags kyi rjes su/ sarba bi ༄khye/ be ta ā san ti ṣ+ṭhaṣ+ṭha/ lhaḥ 'bru bcud dpa' bo myos byed chang / /zhing bcu bsgral ba'i snying gi khrag /sman raka rgya mtshor 'khrigs pa 'di/ /las mgon pho mo'i zhal du 'bul/ /sngags kyi rjes su/ ma hā pañtsa a khra ta khā hi/mahā tsi t+ta ji hi mahā rak+ta khā hi/ hūṃ bh+yoḥ dpal ldan mgon po'i las mdzad mthu bo che/ /dam can yab thum mon pa lcam sring gsum/ /sprul pa yang sprul bcas pa'i tsho gos rnams la/ /dam rdzas mchode pa 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes/ /lhaḥ cang shes rta nag rting dkar rlung ltar 'phyo/ /'byong g.yag rog po zhol chen sprin ltar btibs/ /gdung lug gser mig lcags rwa 'khyil ba can/ khyi nag dom bu —28

dpal mgon po che chung las mkhan rnams kyi bskang bshags chos srung dgyes pa'i sgra dbyangs/ rtoge'adur zhig khrag rjes spyod/ /bya nag lcags sder dgra snying 'byin pa'i mchu/ /mi nag gtum po gad mos sa chen g.yo/ /drel nag rting dkar bong bu gā dmar sogs/ /dpa' bo khyod kyi phyi yi dam rdzas kyis/ /dam can gnod sbyin yab yum thugs dam bskang / /gsod byed gshin rje pu (17ba)tra'i ྾/ /bdud chen mon bu bha tra'i ྾/ kha 'bar sring mo ral gcig ྾/ /stobs chen ru 'dren sdebazhi'i ྾/ /mon nag dregs pa'i tsho gos kyi ྾/ /thugs dam skongs shing nyams chags ma lus bshags/ /dam nyams dgra bgegs thal ba'i rdul du rlogs/ /lha: rnga yab nag po nal bu'i rgyal mtshan dang / /mtshan ldan thod pa snying snas gang ba dang / /dmar chen gtor ma ri ltar spungs pa dang / khrag rgod chang gi btung ba mtsho ltar 'khyil/ /bza' bca' bldag pa'i kha zas byur bur gtams/ rno ngar ldan pa'i phyag mtshan dar snas brgyan/ /zhwa nag gos nag lhab lhub sprin ltar btibs/ /stobs can khyod kyi nang gi dam rdzas kyis/ /dam can gnod sbyin sogs sho lo ka gnyis sbyor ba 'gre/ lha: smyug rgod tshiṭa bdun bya rog sgro yi brgyan/ /dar nag 'phyang zhing gnam lcags ma de'ur bcas/ /phas dang gri lcags byang bu'i lan tshar can/ /dgra bgegs liṅga mi bzad khram la btab/ /stag gzigs ras ma g.yer kha'i sgra ldan pa/ /dregs pa'i bla rdo rdzas rgod srog snying bcas/ /'khrul med srog gi 'khor lo kha sbyar sogs/ /las mkhan dbang po'i gsang ba dam rdzas kyis/ /dam can gnod sbyin ྾/ /lhaḥ dam nyams snying khrag dron mo'i mchod yon dang / khrag 'dzags dbang po lnga yi me tog spungs/ /bsur chen dud pasasprin gyis phyogs kun khyab/ /zhun chen sgron me 'bar ba'i stong gsum gsal/ /mkhris chen ga bur dri yi ngad ldang ba/ sha rus za ba'i tshogs rnams khrag ltar bcer/ /dung chen gling bu'i sgra dbyangs (18na)lhang sgo lhang / /dam nyams bsgral ba'i nyer spyod mchod pa 'di/ /dam can gnod sbyin ྾/ /lhaḥ dgra bgegs zhing chen g.yang bzhi'i bla bre bres/ khyu rlon lda ldi don snying tshal pa 'phyang / /ro skra'i rnga g.yab rus pa'i rgyan drug 'khrol/ /keng rus dum bus sa gzhi bcal du bkrams/ /stag gzig dom dred shun pas phyogs kun khyab/ /go mtshon dpa' bo'i chas rnams rab tu bkra/ /rnal 'byor khros shing drag —29

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)po'i rgyan gyis klubs/ /stobs chen gsang sngagasang ro sgrog pa yi/ /dam can gnod sbyin ྾/ /lasamakhan lcam dral gyi bskang ba ni/ bh+yoḥ lcang spe bsgo ge mgyis mdzad/ byang shar dbang ldan mtshams kyi dur khrod nas/ /dbang gi skyes bu bse yi mdog can khyod/ /dbang thang dpal 'byor rgyas phyir spyan 'dren na/ /dbang drag phrin las bsgrub phyir gshegs su gsol/ /srid pa'i bu mo gar gyi dbang phyug ma/ /las mkhan sgrol gying srog bdag dmar po dang / /e kri la sogs 'khor gyi bshan pa rnams/ /spyan 'dren 'bod kyi gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /sngon tshe lha chen ma hā de wa dang / /yum chen e ka dza shi'i spyan snga sa /bstan pa srung zhing bstan dgra sgrol ba sa /zhal bzhes dran par gyis la gshegs su gsol/ /srung ma khyod kyi thugs dam bskang ba dang / /rnal 'byor nged kyi nyams chagasabaskang ba'i phyir/ /sgrub mchog bdag gis gdung bas bos pa'i tshe/ /lha mchog brtse bas dgongs la gshegs su gsol/ /ra klo pra ṇa zhes pa nas/ pad+ma ka mā la ye sto zhes pa'i bar dang / (18ba'i mo ghasamadzad/ rab dmar khrag chang sbyar ba'i mchod yon dang / /dbang po'i me tog bsur r+ṣa dud pa'i sprin//zhun chen sgron me mkhris pa'i dri chab dang / sha khrag rkang rus zhal zas rol mor bcas/ /phyi nang 'dod yon lnga dang rin chen bdun/ /lcags kyu lnga dang sgron ma lnga sbyar ba'i/ /gser skyems gtsang ma phud kyi nang mchod dang / /btsun bsgos dkar dmar bse yi ra skyes sogs/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i dam rdzas spyan gzigs tshogs/ /dngos bshams yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod sprin 'di/ khrog bdag dmar po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa srung phyir bzhes su gsol/ /sngags mchode dang /gtor 'bul/ 'phrin las bcol ba rnams bya/ kye/ a mo gha sa mdzad/dus gsum rgyal ba'i bstan srung mthu rtsal can/ /srog bdag dmar po 'khor bcas spyan lam du/ /nam mkha' gang ba'i dam rdzasaspyan gzigs tshogis/ 'byung zhing rgyas la thugs dam skongs gyur cig /rab dmar khrag chang mchod yon mtsho ltar 'khyil/ /dbang po lnga yi me tog ri ltar spungs/ /sha chen tshil chen dud pa sprin ltar 'khrigs/ /zhun chen sgron me nyi ltar 'bar ba 'di/ /gnod sbyin dregs pa lcam dral thugs dam —30

dpal mgon po che chung las mkhan rnams kyi bskang bshags chos srung dgyes pa'i sgra dbyangs/ 9)bskangs/ /las mkhan srog bdag dmar po'i thugs dam bskangs/ /gri thog bshan pa'i tsho gos kyi thugs dam bskang / /'khor tsho gis dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskangs/ /'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam skongs gyur nas/ /rnal 'byor dpon slob nyams chags gsos gyur cig /mi mthun rkyen dang bar chad (19na༄zlog pa dang / /mthun pa'i dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol/ /gser zhun 'khyil 'dra mkhris pa'i dri chab dang / /dgra bgegs sha khrag spungs pa'i zhal zas dang / /snyan brjid rol mo'i sgra yis stong gsum khyab/ /ro brgya ldan pa'i gser skyems dam pa 'di/ /gnod sbyin dregasapa sogs sho lo ka gnyis po sbyor ba 'gre/ rno sdug rwa g.yo sha rgyas dal gyi 'gro/ /mdzes pa'i spu ldan mtshams sprin phung po bzhin/ /'ja' tshon ltar bkra dar gyi rgyan cha can/ /spyan gzigs bse yi ra skyes kham pa 'dis/ /gnod sbyin ྾/ /zhol g.yag kham pa rnams ni ngar 'jo byed/ /mdzes ldan rta mchog rnams ni rlung bzhin rgyu/ /dur bya srin bya'i gar gyis mkha' lam khyab/ /bse khra dam nyamasaklad la lding ba 'dis/ /gnod sbyin ྾/ /sra zhing brtan pa rdo rje'i go khrab dang / /rno ngar mi bzad sna tshogs mtshon cha dang / /dur bya'i sgro ldan dar dmar g.yo bas mdzes/ /dgra bgegs snying la thog ltar rgyug pa 'dis/ /gnod sbyin ྾/ sha khrag gtor ma'i tshogs kyi sa gzhi gang / /phyi nang 'dod yon tsho gos kyis bar snang gang / /rgyal srid rin chen bdun gyis nam mkha' gang / /dngos bshams yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod sprin 'dis/ /gnod sbyin ྾/ /sems nyid rang bzhin mkha' ltar rnam dag kyang / /glo bur nyon mongs sprin gyis g.yog pa'i mthus/ /nongs par gang gyur bshags dang bshags yul dang / /bshaṭa bya dmigs med ngang du dag par bgyi/ /sgrol gying srog(19ba thad ga dmar po 'khor bcas kyis/ /gnod sbyin
