dgra bgegs thams cad tshar chod la/ /yid bzhin nor dang dpag bsam shing bzhin du/ /phyogs dang thun mong dngos grub char du phob/ /hūṃ bh+yoḥ tshar r+ṣa gyis mdzod/sngon tshe rgyal ba 'od srung bstan pa la/ /rgyal ba nyid dang smon lam lhan cig btab/ zhing 'dir thub bstan srung bar dam bcas pa'i/ khyod kyi thugs dam gnyen po dus la bab/ /'dzam gling byang shar dur khrod —31—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)ma ru tser/ /lha chen po dang e ka dza ṭi yi/ /spyan sngar bstan dgra sgrol bar khas blangs pa'i / /thugs dam dus la bab bo sa ma ya/ /gshin rje gshed dang ma hā de wa dang / /nyi 'od grags pa zla ba nag po dang / /dha ra kra shu gnyan lo dar ma grags/ kha'u pa dang rje btsun sa skya pa/ /bkra shis 'od zer grub thob 'dar phyar zhabs/ /brtson 'grus rdo rje jo sras sangs rin dang / /slob dpon sher mtsho bsod nams dbang phyug dang / /lcang spe ba dang kun mkhyen mus srad pa/ /rin cen bkra shis yon tan mgon po dang / /gzhon nu dpal dang rdo rje rgyal mtshan zhabs/ shes rab rin cen tshar pa rdo rje 'ams / /kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse bsod nams chos 'phel zhabs/ /dbang phyug rab brtan mgon po bsod nams rje/ grub pa mchog brnyes rje btsun a nan+ta/ /bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs/ /rtsa brgyud bla mas brten cing bsgrubs pa dang / /gsol zhing mchod pa'i lha mchog mthu bo che/ /sgrol gying dmar po lcam dral 'khor bcas rnams/ sha chen rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i gtor ma long / khrag rgod (20na tha dud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa bzhes/ /rtsa brgyud dpal ldan bla ma'i dam tshig dgongs/ /rigasa'adzin rnal 'byor bdag gi stong grogs mdzod/ khyod la 'phrin las gnyan po gsol ba ni/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa gnyan po gshig pa dang / /dkon mchog gsum gyi dbu 'phang dmad pa dang / /mtshan ldan bla ma'i sku la sdob dang / /skye 'gro sems can yongs la gnod cing 'tshe/ /khyad par rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob la/ /snga dgra ngan pa lag la bkal ba dang / /phyi dgra snying la bsams shing byed pa dang / /da lta gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra dang bgegs/ /skyabs su brdzus shing gnya' nas bcog pa dang / /grogs ltar 'grog shing snying nas brku ba dang / /bran du sprul nas rkang nas 'dren pa rnams/ /srog bdag chen po khyod la zas su gtad/ /'di la bsrung zhing skyob pa'i gnas med kyi/ /btsan dmar stong gis zhags pas dam du chings/ /bdud po stong gis mi bzad khram la thob/ /ma mo bye bas dal yams gzer chen phob/ /gshin rje stong gis tshe srog da lta chod/ /gnod sbyin stong gis srog dbugs dron mo 'gom/ /the'u rang rgyal pos ltas ga cho 'phrul khye/ /srog bdag dmar pos don snying spar —32

dpal mgon po che chung las mkhan rnams kyi bskang bshags chos srung dgyes pa'i sgra dbyangs/ 9)gyis thob/ /gdong dmar 'bar mas srog dbug hub kyis drongs/ /gnod sbyin chen pos zangs grisamago bo khos/ /rnam shes chos dbyings dag pa'i zhing du drongs/ /yun ring lo dang zla bar ma bzhag par/ /ma thogs zhag dang za ma'i dus nyid la/ /dam nyams gdug can dgra bo ma lus pa/ /bsad cing bsgral ba'i phrin las khyod kyis mdzod/ /lhaḥ g.yin yang khyod (20ba tha phrin las zhu ba ni/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi/ /sngon gyi las dang phral rkyen las byung ba'i/ /bar chad mi mthun phyogs kun bzlog par mdzod/ /gshin rje'i 'khor lo bdud kyi khram 'debs dang / /btsan gyi zhags pa ma mo'i dal yams dang / /rgyal po'i spyo 'bog za rgod gdong thug rnams/ /dam nyams sdig can dgra bo'i steng du bsgyur/ /ban bon gdug pa'i ngan sngags bzod dka' dang / /lha srin drag po'i rbod gtong zug pa dang / /bden cing yus pa'i smod mo 'debs pa rnams/ /stobs li drag pos de nyid rang la bsgyur/ /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rigs thams cad dang / /stong phrag brgyad cu'i bgegs kyi gnod pa dang / /glo bur ye 'phrog sum brgya drug cu rnams/ /bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las khyod kyis mdzod/ /mdor na bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas rnams/ /deng nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub bar/ /sto bos chen khyod kyi srung zhing skyong ba dang / /lus dang grib ma bzhin du rab 'grogs nas/ /mi nor longs spyod dgon gnas bcas pa la/ /nyin gsum bya ra mtshan gsum mel tshe mdzod/ /srung skyobs sba ba'i stong grogs gnyan po dang / /bcol ba'i 'phrin las lhun gyi grub par mdzod/ /lhaḥ khobos shoms/ bstan srung rgya mtsho'i sdod pon rdo rje gur/ /stobs 'phrog legs ldan nag po gdong bzhi pa/ khro gawa khred las mkhan pu kro ming sring che/ /dgra wa'i bshan pa beg tse lcam dral dgongs/ /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang / /'phags bod mkhas grub sa bsnyes lo paṇa (21na stabs/ /'khon ston 'jam dbyangs rim byon sa skya ba/ khyad par tshar chen yab sras brgyud bcas kyis/ /phyi rol dur khrod brgyad du rab rgyu ba'i/ khro gtum dregs pa'i dmag gi dpung tshoṭi rnams/ /gtor ma'i ri bo rak+ta'i rgya mtsho bskyil/ /phyi nang gsang rten rdzas kyi bsten cing mchod/ /nang du rdo rje lus kyi rtsa rlung —33—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)khams/ khyud gsum dregs pa'i sgyu la rol par shar/ /gsang ba gsal stong zung 'a lcag bdeb che/ /sems nyid gcig pur nges pa'i rang zhal bltas/ /dam tshig rdo rje'i ra ba sra zhing mkhregs/ /smin byed dbang gi chu bo ma nub 'phel/ /las bzhi smin grol gnas gsang 'phyugs pa med/ /man ngag mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs 'thul le ba/ /snyan nas snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi ldan chos/ /'dzin mkhas rdo rje'i slob dpon rim byon gyis/ /rdo rje gtsug bzhag lce la mna' chu blud/ /dam tshig bsgrags pas g.yar dam nyer dgongs la/ /phan bde'i rtsa lag kun mkhyen shākya'i bstan/ /bshad dang sgrub pas dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel zhing / khyad par kha'u par grags slob bshad kyi/ /ring lugs srid mtha'i bar du rgyas par mdzod/ 'jig rten kun gyi nag po 'bras smin pa'i/ /dus kyi chad pa ming yang mi grags zhing / /bye brag gangs can kha ba'i sman ljongs 'dir/ /'gro kun bde skyid dpal la spyod par mdzod/ /yang sgos rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /snga dgra lag dar phyi dgra yid la sems/ /da dgra gnod cing 'tshe ba'i gdug can dpung / /rgyab brten (21bas dang mi min bcas pa kun/ /gnam gyi 'ju thag gnyan po steng nas cho de/ /sa yi rten phur rtsa ba 'og nas phyungs/ /bsod nams stobs 'byor mnga' thang kun dar 'phel/ /bla srog tshe gsum sbar gyis thob la bkums/ / yid srubs las rgyal ba dan srid rtser 'phyor/ /med byung snyan grags rdza rnga phyogs bcur sgrogs/ /mi gshigs rdo rje'i srog gi /ba tshugs/ /bsod nams nyi ma'i dngos rgya'i gzi byin skyed/ /tshe 'dir grub mtha' snyogs par ma gyur na/ /'chi ba 'od gsal dpal ldan nag po ches/ /sngar 'dris mdza' bo bzhin du grogs mdzad nas/ /mkha' spyod bde can dag pa'i zhing du drongs/ /ring por mi thogs rigs rnams kun gyi bdag /zung 'jug sgyu ma'i gar mkhan bcom ldan 'das/ /dgyes mdzad rdo rje he ru ka dpal gyi/ /go 'phang mngon du gyur ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /smras pa/ phul byung kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin/ /zag med bde stong rol ba'i bdud rtsi'i dpyid/ /rdo rje'i chos srung dgyes pa skyed byed pa/ /mkha' dbyings khyone kun ma lusagang snyam byed/ /phyi nang gsang ba dam rdzas spyan gzigs kyis/ /dam can mtshol ngang mo bzhin du 'du/ /—34

dpal mgon po che chung las mkhan rnams kyi bskang bshags chos srung dgyes pa'i sgra dbyangs/ 9)snying nas shugs drag gdung ba'i bshags pa yis/ /nyams chags dri ma 'khrud pa'i ga sgo'i rgyun/ /'khrul med lam srol ji bzhin nyams len pa/ /deng dus kha bas bskor ba'i yul ljongs na/ kha'u brag rdzong bzhed srol 'dzin rnams las/ /gzhan du u dum wa ra'i me tog bzhin/ /de ltar gur mgon gzi ldan dbang phyug nyid/ /(22na)bka' sdod bcas pa bskang bshags mchod sprin gyis/ /mnyes byed khrigs su bkod pa'i dge ba yis/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /ces gur gyi mgon po/ gdong bzhi pa las mkhan dang bcas pa'i gtor sgrub bya ba la nye bar mkho ba'i le lag mchod pa bskang bshags kyi rim pa chos srung dgyes pa'i sgra dbyangs zhes pa 'di yang dpal sa skya'i bka' srung rnams kyi gtor chog gi lhan thabs dngos grub rol mtsho'i dgongs pa ltar rang gi brjed byang dang phan bde legs bshad gling ba rnams kyis nyams len du za hor gyi rigs las a ba bhu ti pa'i btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni ngag dbang dge legs so/ /maṅga lo/ /—35

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)ra༅༅//dpal mgon po che chung las mkhan rnams kyi gtor ma'i cho ga las bzhi lhun grub bzhugs/oṃ swasti sid+dhi/in+d+ra ni la'i sa 'dzin dbang po gang //nyin byed 'bum gyis 'khyud pa'i dpal mnga' ba//gnyis med bde stong mchog gi rol gar mkhan//dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i gtso der gus pas 'dud//bram ze mchog sred ri sul rnal 'byor ma//chos srung bran ltar 'khol ba'i mal lo gnyan//rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gtsug rgyan sa skya pa//'khrul med gdams pa'i gsung ngag 'dzin rnamasargyal//bdag chen rdo rje 'chang dang kun spangs rje'i//thugs bcud gsang chen slob bshad 'dzin mkhas pa'i/rdo rje 'chang dbang tshar chen chos kyi rje//yab sras brgyud par bcas la gus btud nas//bstan srung dbang po mgon zung las mkhan bcas//'khor tshogs rmad byung gtor ma'i mchod pa yis//dgyes bskyed 'phrin las myur mgyogs pho nya yi//dgongs don ji bzhin 'dri bar gnang ba stsol//de la 'dir 'phags pa'i yul du slob dpon chen po bram ze mchog sred dang ri sul gyi 2narnal 'byor ma sogs gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras rnams kyi bstan srung gi gtso bo gur gyi mgon po/gdong bzhi pa/las mkhan 'khor bcas la mchod gtor 'bul ba'i ngag 'don gyi rim pa la thog mar rten dang mchod gtor spyan gzigs sogs sta gon du ji ltar bya ba'i rim pa rnams ni 'phrin las myur mgyogs sogs khungs btsun gyi yig cha dang /mthong brgyud kyi phyag len zhal las shes par bya dgos shing ngag don dngos la rdo rje brag rdzong ma'am rang nyid rgyun du bya ba'i yi dam gang yang rung ba'i bdag bskyed bzlaX pa dang bcas pa song nas/bzlas gtor byin

dpal mgon po che chung las mkhan rnams kyi gtor ma'i cho ga las bzhi lhun grub/ (dpegyis brlabs nas 'bul ba sogs kyang gzhung bzhin bya/ nag po chen po gur mgon gyi gtor ma 'bul ba ni/oṃ u3 ha ho hrīḥ/ zhes lan gsum brjod cing / sngags don bsam pa'i sgo nas dmigs pa dang phyag rgya rnams gsung rgyun ltar byas rjes/ /mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su paṃ las pad+ma dang /raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil (2ba 'khor gyi steng du bdud thams cad kyi ngo bo mi ro dmar ser mgo g.yas su bstan pa'i steng du hūṃ mthing nag las 'od 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po che zhing cher 'bar ba/ sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas gri gug dang / g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs gar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ phyag gnyis kyi dbus na rnam 'phrul gyi gaṇ+ḍi bsnams pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs pa'i gra nas khrag 'dzag pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ mi mgo skam bo lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang sprul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ dar sna tsho gos kyi cod pan dang lhab lhub kyis klubs pa/ mi'u thung gel ba'i 'dug stangs kyis ro'i steng na bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas na bya nag 'bum sde gshog skor byed pa/ g.yon na khyi nag 'bum sde 'khang zhing zug pa/ rgyab na ce spyang 'bum sde g.yal zhing rgyug pa/ mdun na mi nag 'bum sde gnam du 'o dod 'bod pa/ steng na khyung chen 'bum sde lding zhing 'khor ba/ mi bskyod pa'i cod paṇa can/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yon du pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du ṭaṃ las e ka dzā khyi sku mdog sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i g.yu'i bum pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ dar dkar gyi na (3na)bzas stod g.yogs shing / stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ g.yu'i ral pa lan bu gcig tu gyur nas g.yon du 'phyang ba/ khro mo'i rnam pa can/ rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan rgyas brgyan pa/ semasadapa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i sto ba yangs pa'i nang du trag las khrag gi rgya mtsho'i dbus su bh+yoḥlas dpal ldan lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma bong bu gwa pa la zhen pa/ sku mdog sngo nag —37

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas kyi dang po na ral gri/ gnyis pa na thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pa/g.yon gyi dang po na mdung / gnyis pa na rtse gsum gyi mgul na dar nag gis ba dan 'phyar ba 'dzin pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang ldan pa/glang po che'i ko bas stod g.yogs shing / ba lang gi ko bas smad g.yogs pa/ re lde'i sham thabs can klu'i dbang po'i ske rags bcings pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing mi ro rangs po khar bcug nas mche ba gcigs pa/ snyan g.yas pa la dug sprul dang gser gyi dril bu/ g.yon pa la seng ge dang g.yu'i dril bus brgyan pa/ zhabs gnyis lcags sgrog gis mdzes par byas pa/ sku la khrag gi thig le dang /zhag gis sor ris dang / thal chen gyi tshom bu bkod pa/ shin tu rid cing mi sdug pa'i lte ba'i thad ka nas nyi zla 'phyar ba/ ma mo mkha' 'gro sha za 'bum sde'i dbus na hūṃ dang bh+yoḥ'i sgra sgrog pa/ ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ (3bsgo hā kā lī de sa hūṃ bh+yo snri mgon po'i thugs ga'i hūṃ dang lha mo'i thugs ka'i sma las tri yig nag po gnyis chad/lcam dral gyi mdun du pad+ma dang nyi ma dang ro'i gdan gnyis kyi g.yas phyogs kyi steng du tri yig dang po yaṃ du gyur pa las/ nag po gnod sbyin mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas gser gyi gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing / g.yon sbar ba phyir gdengs pa'i lag mthil na nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'char ba/ dar men gyi ga sha dang / dar gyi aṅga rag byas pa za 'og nag po'i gos dang / mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lding stabs su gyon pa/ ral pa gyen du brdzes shing gser gyi rna cha 'phyang ba/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i gyad kyi dor stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ g.yon gyi gdan gyi steng du tri yig gnyis/ : du gyur pa las nag mo gnod sbyin mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phyag g.yas gser gyi spu gri 'phyar zhing / g.yon sbar ba phyir gdengs pa lag mthil na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'char ba/ dar men gyi ga sha dang / dar gyi aṅga rag byas pa/ dar nag po gser gyi thig le can gyi gos gyon pa/ ral pa thur du nyil zhing byu ru'i lan tshar 'phyang ba/ zhabs g.yas brkyang gi —38

dpal mgon po che chung las mkhan rnams kyi gtor ma'i cho ga las bzhi lhun grub/ 9)stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de gnyis las de 'dra ba mang po 'phros pas 'jig rten gyi khams gang nas las byed pa/ a a li ma dzaḥdzadza she/ li shi ded/ a shwa ded/ /mo smugs spu gri a li ma dzaḥdzadag mo sha la rubs dzaḥdzaḥ o ro ru ro ru tri tsa pa la a shug me ma hūṃ ma bh+yo dzaḥdzaḥyab kyi thugs(4na po'i tri las tri yig nag po gnyis dang / yum gyi thugs ka'i sma las sma yig nag po gcig chad/ yab yum de gnyis kyi mdun du dam nyams kyi ro'i gdan gsum gyi steng du tri las gshin rje ma rungs pa mon bu pu tra mdog nag po phyag g.yas shang lang rab tu 'bar ba nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon dam nyams kyi klad khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa zhal du gsol ba/ dar nag po'i lhab lhub dang / dar men gyi ga sha can/ dar dkar po'i aṅga rag gsol ba/ ral pa gyen du gzings shing / rna ba la dung long 'khrol ba/ zhabs g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yon du tri las bdud ma rungs pa mon bu bha tra mdog nag po phyag g.yas dam shing 'phyar zhing / g.yon pas dam nyams kyi snying dmar po khrag 'dzag pa rtsa lag dang bcas te zhal du gsol ba/ dar nag gi gos lhab lhub kyi steng du dar men gyis ga sha can/ stag slog gyon pa/ ral pa gzings shing / rna ba la dung long 'brol ba/ zhabasagayon brkyang gi kyi stabs sa bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yon du sma las mon mo gser gyi spu gri ma mdog nag mo kha nas me 'bar ba/ phyag g.yas gser gyi spu gri rnon po 'phyar ba/ g.yon gdug pa can gyi rgyu ma zhal du gsol zhing 'brad pa/ za 'og nag khra'i gos gyon zhing dar men gyi ga sha bcings pa ral pa thur du 'phyang zhing rna ba la dung long 'khrol ba/ zhabs g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de lnga ga'ang spyan gsum dmar por ldog cing dgra bgegs la sdang mig tu (4ba) blta ba zhal bgrad cing mche ba gcigs nas ljags glog ltar 'khyug pa/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / /mgo rlon khrag 'dzag pa'i do shal dang / mi'i rgyu ma rlon pa dang / rus pa'i phreng bas spras pa shin tu 'jigs shing rngam pa la dgra bgegs thams cad kyi srog dbugs skad cig nyid la 'phrog pa'i rnam pa can/ lcam dral gsum gyi thugs kur tri tri sma'i sa bon las rang 'dra ba'i sprul pa dpag tu med pa 'phros nas 'jig —39—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)rten gyi khams thams cad gang bas 'phrin las thams cad thogs med du bsgrub pa/ de rnams kyi g.yas kyi ru 'dren pa skyes pa dpa' bo stag chas rgyan pa brgya/ g.yon gyi ru 'dren pa dge slong dgra bcom pa brgya/ slad kyi rjes su 'brang ba brnye nag po brgya/ mdun gyi bshul byang 'dren pa bud med nag mo brgya/ de re re la'ang 'khor 'bum sde re res bskor ba/ gzhan yang dam nyams kyi rjes gcod pa'i bya nag khyi nag mi nag lcags spyang ce spyang la sogs pa pho nya bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba/gaṇ+ḍi las sprul pa'i dam tshig can rtag tu bsrung ba'i khro bo'i tshogs khro zhing rngam pa la la mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin pa/ la la ba dan g.yab mo g.yab pa/ la la mi rkang gling bu 'bud pa/ la la rgyu ma'i zhags pa 'phen pa/ la la dmar chen rak+ta sbreng ba/ la la tshil chen dud pa gtong ba/ la la g.yang gzhi sal brdeb pa/ la la hūṃ phaṭa 'byug sgra sgrog pa/ la la gnam lcags thog ser 'bebs pa la la spu gri so brdar byed pa/ kha cig dgra bo'i nang khrol dron mo za ba / la (ldan sgo dgra bo'i don snying sbar bas 'debs pa thams cad kyang slog gi phung po 'thor ba lta bu'i me lce'i phreng ba zhakhrug pa/ ha ha dang hūṃ phaṭa kyi nga ro 'brug stong ltar sgrog pa la sogs pa mi sdug pa'i cha lugs sna tshogs ston pa/ 'ur 'ur chem chem gyis stong gsum 'gengs pa khams gsum thams cad 'dar zhing g.yo bar byed pa/gas yang sgo skyong gi khro mo mgo bas can dang dur khrod na gnas pa'i phyogs skyong / zhing skyong /mkha' 'gro sha za lha srin sdo brgyad/ dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud sprul pa 'bum/ yang sprul bye ba/ gnasagasum mkha' 'gro/ dam can rgya mtsho'i tsho gos dang bcas pa/ lcam dral de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par 〉 thugs kar hūṃ/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer sa pas 'og min rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs ka nas mgon po dang / rang bzhin gyi gnas nas lha mo dang / las kyi mgon po rnams la bka' stod pho nya'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya bca'/de nas so so'i dam rgya bcas nas mdzub mo g.yab pa'am rdo rje g.yab cing / dril bu bcad gtubs su dkrol bas/ hūṃ/ mal los mdzad/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ / tshur gshegs tshur gshegs—40

dpal mgon po che chung las mkhan rnams kyi gtor ma'i cho ga las bzhi lhun grub/ rton)dpal mgon tshogs/ /lcam dral 'dir spyon gdan la bzhugs/ /da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus/ /gshegasashing bzhugs pa'i gnas ga yang / shwakya'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang / /bdag cag rnams la phan gdags (5bsta phyir/ /gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā lwa ya/ mahā kā lī de phyi/e ka dzā ṭī de zhi/ in+d+ra sī/ kā li yak+ṣa ye/ kā lī yak+ṣa sī/ yak+ṣa putra ye/ ru dra bha tra ye/ ru lu rak+ṣa sī/sa pa ri wā ra e gye nyi/ dzaḥlha baṃ sngo gnyis su med par thim/ pad+ma ka ma lwa ya rto/ gong gi sngags kyi sapa ri wā ra'i rjes su/ gro ste rda a swāhā/ pā thu swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra pur+sha nas/ shabha 〉〉/ zhesapa'i bar gyi mchod/ so so'i sngags kyi tshe dam rgya snying gar bcas te lha so so'i spyi bor dam tshig gi rdo rje bzhag pa bsams la sa pa ri wā ra'i rjes su/ sam ya sma ra/ sa ma ya mā ti kra ma/ sa ma ya rak+ṣa skyo/ /dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po lcam dral bran g.yog bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar dam tshig srungs/ bstan pa skyongs/ dkon cog gi dbu 'phang stod/ khyad par du bstan pa dang / bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams dang / rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe ba dang / bdag gi lam bsgrub pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i dgra bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs rnams kyi bsam ngan sbyor rtsub thams cad zhi ba'i thabs kyis 'dor bar mdzad du gsol/ gal te zhi ba'i thabs kyis 'dul du ma 'tshal na/ gang la gang 'tsham pa'i chad pas bcad pa dang / bskrad cing gzir ba dang / dbye ba dang bsdigs cing spa bkong zhin thar mdzad du gsol/ mdor na chos bsgrub pa'i bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang / bsam sbyor chos mthun yid bzhin du 'grub cing / bstan pa dang bstan pa 'dzin pa dang / 'jig rten kun dar zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ zhes tshig lhug pa rnams kyi tshe mgon po'i dam rgya kho na bca' zhing mthar thal mo lan gsum brdeb bo/ /lcam dral gyi ljags rdo rje'i 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud drangs shing gsol bar bsams la/ pad kor dang bcas pas rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ba'i —4/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)mthar so gol ga rta go cing /oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ma hā kā lī de sa/e /dzā smi de sa/in+d+ra sī/sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe saḥsarba thā ṇa sna ji te/྅ ra ṇa i me/ga ga na 'a gro ste da sba phywa di swāhā/zhes lan gsum mam lnga gang rigs dang /shā san lan gsum gyis 'bul/gong gi gtor sngags kyi sa pa ri wā ra'i rjes su/gro: rda rdo nas sha rdi'i bar gyis phyi mchod dang /sngags de nyid kyi rjes su/oṃ u3 zhes pas nang mchod phul/dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po/yum chen e ka dzā smi/dpal ldan lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams mchode sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes pa/sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/dkon cog gi dbu 'phang stod/dge 'dun gyi ༈skyongs/rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa'i bar ho mi mas pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba dang /bsam spyor 9bcu me mthun yid bzhin du 'grub cing /byang chub ma thob kyi bar du srung skyob sba ba'i 'phrin las/stong grogs rgya wo po mdzad du gsol/de nas rgyun du rdor dril las mi mdzad kyang spros pa la dga' na rnga brdung ba dbyangs dang bcas pa gang rung gis/hūṃ srin po'i dur sgo nag po la yang /gzugs kyi gdug pa can//tshar gcod byang chub sems dpa' ste//grong khyer sum brtsegs 'jig byed pa/gtum po khyod la bdag bstod do//mdog nag gzugs thud gzi brjed che//gdug pa tshar gcod gri gug g.yas//g.yon na gdug pa'i khrag bkang snod//thod phreng can la bdag bstod do//khros pa'i zhabs brdabs sa gzhi g.yo//'jigs pa'i gad mos ri rab bskyel/dam tshig nyams pa'i snying 'byin pa//dam tshig can la bdag bstode do//zhes pas bstod/stod pa ni/hūṃ dpal ldan 'bas yas sa/mgon po mahā kā lwa ya//lha chen dpal 'bar nag po mthu bo che/ma hā de wa'i sras po drag shul can//tsho gos bdag chen po ma hā kā wā ya//'jigs byed chen po ma hā kwa lā ya//legs ldan nag bo grong khyer sum brtsegs dgra//bstan pa yongs kyi srung ma nag po che//chos 'khor yongs kyi srog shing nag po che//dam tshig can gyi dgra lha nag po che//dam nyams dgra bo'i gshed rdo nag po che//'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di

dpal mgon po che chung las mkhan rnams kyi gtor ma'i cho ga las bzhi lhun grub/ 9)bzhes shig sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma ྾/ dzam bu ti ba'i zhal zas ྾/ /sman rag phud kyi mchod pa ྾/ /(7na sngar bcol las kyi btang rag gnyan por 'bul/ /da 'chol las kyi gsol 'debasaganyan por bzhes/ /'khor rnams bsrung zhing rkyen rnams bzlog pa dang / /snang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs la sogs/ /bdud dang bar du gcod pa rnam mang po/ /thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ /bstan pa bsrung ba'i las 'di myur du sgrubs/ bh+yoḥ 'phags pas mdzad/ gang gi sku gsung thugs kyi mthus/ /'dod pa'i khams kun zil mnan nas/ / 'dod pa'i khams la dbang sgyur ma/ /'dod khams dbang phyug ma la bstod/ /dpal ldan lha mo khyod kyi sku/ /ri rab lhun po lta bur brjid/ /dbang po sngon po lta bur 'bar/ /nyi ma'i zer ltar sprul pa 'gyed/ /dbu skra ser po gyen du 'bar/ /spyan rtsa dmar po glog ltar 'byug /mi ro khar bcug mtsheb gcigs/ khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa dang / /'gas pa'i mtshon mas phyag rnams sbrel/ /mi mgo rin cen rus pas spras/ klu dbang seng ge lcagasasgrog dang / khrag dang zhag gis thig les brgyan/ /ko rlon re lde gos su gyon/ /bong bu gā zhen mtshan mo rgyu/ khren tu rid cing mi sdug ma/ /'jigs gzugs ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ khyod kyi gsung gi nga ro'i dbyangs/ /'brug stong ldir ba'i sgra bsgrags pas/ khams gsum ma lus zil mnan nas/ /sa gsum g.yo bar mdzad la 'dud/ khyod thugs zhi la rab gzhol yang / /snying rje'i dbang gis srid la bzhugs/khro dang zhabrug (7bdang rngam pa yis/ / bgegs dpung nges par 'joms la 'dud/ /dpal ldan lha mo mi pham srid gsum bdag /'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /sogs kyis bstod cing 'phrin las bcol lo/ /dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa la gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ oṃ lha/ ha ho saḥ zhes byin gyis brlab/mdun gyi nam mkhar chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang / phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhi'i steng du nyi ma dang ro'i gdan re re dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du hūṃ las rdo rje gri gug lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ phyogs bzhi'i gdan gyi steng du hūṃ —43

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)re re de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ gtso 'khor lnga dus gcig tu grub pa ni/ dbus su rdo rje nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa dgra bo'i stobs 'phrog pa'i gzugs can/ srin po khros pa lta bu sku mdog nag po zhal bzhi phyag bzhi pa/ rtsa zhal nag po rngam shing khros pa/ g.yas zhal dkar po khro zhid 'dzum pa g.yon zhal dmar po rgya cher ba 'ad pa/ steng zhal dud kha khro gnyer dpral ba'i dbyings su bsdus pa/zhal re re la dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ sma ra dang smin ma me ltar 'bar ba/zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ ma mchu phyir 'phyang zhing ha ha dang hi hi dang / hūṃ hūṃ dang /k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ gi nga ro drag po 'brug sgra 'bum gyi sgra ltar sgrog pa/ phyag bzhi g.yas dang po rdo rje gri gug dang /g.yon dang po thod pa khrag dron mos gang ba'i nang na (8na dam nyams kyi snying 'dar bzhin pa dang bcas pa thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ g.yas rtsa zhal gyi mi ro dang g.yas kyi ral gri gnyis la sbyor gtso che bas4yo pa'i dbang du/ bto na sgrub du ltar 4kho/ 'og ma rtsegasum dang / /g.yon 'og ma mdung rnon ba dan dang bcas pa 'phyar stabs su 'dzin pa/ bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa mchan khung g.yon na thogs pa/rus phreng lha ba dmar chil le ba phyag 'gag tu brgyus pa/ dbu skra kham pa gyen du gzings shing 'bar ba/ mi mgo skam po rdzogs pa lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu mi'i rgyu ma rlon pa la brgyus pa'i do shal 'phyang ba/ dug sbrul nag po'i mchod phyir thogs byas pa/ rus pa rgyan drug gisabargyan pa tshangs pa'i skud pa'i se ral kha thogs pa/ mi rkang gi gling bu dang / gser dngul gyi dril bu g.yer ma'i dra ba sil sil gyi sgra sgrog pa/ dpa' bo stag lpags rlan pa'i sham thams can/ drag la rngam pa'i cha byad/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i rgyad kyi dor stabs kyis dam nyams dgra bo'i steng na 'jigs pa'i bro brdung ba/ de'i g.yas su yum chen g.yung mo nag mo/ g.yon du las mdzad gtum mo ljang gu/ mdun du dmar nag srin mo chen mo/ rgyab tu ser nag siṅga gling ma/ bzhi ga'ang srin mo khros pa'i cha lugs can/ 'kha gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing / g.yon thod khrag gtso la stob pa/ gcer bu ral pa thur du 'phyang ba/ rgyu ma rlon pa'i (8ba)—44

dpal mgon po che chung las mkhan rnams kyi gtor ma'i cho ga las bzhi lhun grub/ 9)ga sha can/ gzhan rgyan med pa/ khro zhing grims la rngam zhing rgod pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i gar stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ gtso 'khor lnga ga'ang ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /de dag gi mtha' skor tu dregs pa pho bdun mo bdun/ srog gi dgu bdud nag po/ las kyi bshan pa nyer gcig /zhing skyong pho mo 'bum sde/ snang srid lha srin sdebargyad kyi dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa/ kha dog dang / cha lugs dang mtshon cha sna tsho gos 'dzin pa/ drag cing gtum la khro zhing rngam pas las thams cad thogs med du bsgrub pa/ de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par 〉 thugs dar hūṃ/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ gangs te se/bsil ba'i tshal/ po ṭa la/ sid+ma'i gling/ ha ha rgod pa'i dur khrod/ dar lung gnyan gyi pho brang / gnas mchog kha'u brag rdzong / phu gsum 'ol dga'/ dpal ldan sa skya/ chos 'khor rgyal gyi gtsug lag khang la sogs pa'i gnas rnams nas stobs 'phrog rdo rje nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa yum bzhi dregs pa'i tsho gos dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dam rgya dang bcas pas mdzub mo g.yab pa'am/ rdo rje g.yab cing dril bu gsil bas/ hūṃ/ sngon gzha los mdzad/ tshe rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga sa /gtum po khyod kyis ji ltar khar blangs bzhin/ 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i las la spyan 'dren na/ sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung phyir spa/nags su gsol/ oṃ ma hā kā la kā la/ bi kā la/ (9nang tri ta/ ḍom+bhi nī/ tsaṇ+ḍa phyi/ rak+ṣa sī/siṅga lī/ de ldi sa pa ri wā ra e gye hi/ dzaḥ/ baṃ sngo gnyis su med par thim/ pad+ma ka ma lā ya sto gyis gdan dbul/ gong gi sngags kyi sa pa ri wā ra'i rjes su/ gro ste rda a: nas sha rdi'i bar gyis mchod/dam rgya spyi bor bzhag par bsam la/ sa pa ri wā ra'i rjes su/ sa ma ya sma ra 'a nas rak+ṣa n+tu 'a bar dang / /dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa lcam dral bran g.yog bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ zhes sogs gong du gur mgon gyi skabs su bshad pa'i tshig rnams brjod cing / stobs 'phrog dbang po 'bor dang bcas pa'i ljags rdo rje'i 'od zer sogs gong ltar/ sa pa ri wā ra'i rjes su na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo sogs btags pa gsum mam —45

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang sgo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)lnga dang /rgyas par byed na sngags ring lan gsum brjod/gong ltar nyer spyod kyis phyi mchod dang /sa pa ri wā ra'i rjes su/oṃ u3/zhes pas nang mchod phul la/lha mchog ma hā kā la/lha chen nag po zhal bzhi/zhing skyong gzi ldan dbang phyug /bram ze'i gzugs can dpa' bo/yum chen g.yung mo nag mo/las mdzad gtum mo ljang gu/ser nag siṅga li ma dmar nag srin mo chen mo/'khor gyi zhing skyong 'bum sde/dregs pa pho bdun mo bdun/srog gi dgu bdud nag po/las kyi bshan pa nyer gcig/snang srid lha srin sde brgyad kyi dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams mchod sbyin 9bgyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/zhes sogs kyis 'phrin las bcol lo//rgyun du rdor dril las mi mdzad kyang spro na rnga brdung zhing dbyangs dang bcas pas/hūṃ/bla mangs pas mdzad/sku gsum ma rga gyur rdo rje 'amang dbang gi/rnam gsum bstan pa spel zhing bsrung bya'i phyir//dus gsum bdud dpung ma lus 'joms mdzad pa//cho 'phrul sum ldan khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/khams gsum me ltar dmar nag 'bar ba'i dbus//stong gsum zil gnon zhing skyong rgyal po'i sku//sa gsum 'dar byed khro gtum rngam brjid can/srid gsum dbang sgyur khyod la ྾//'phreng ba sum ldan drag po'i bshad sgra can/rtse gsum mdung sogs drag po'i mtshon cha bsnams//spyan gsum snang mig drag po phyogasabacur gzigs//gnas gsum dgra bgegs 'joms la 〉rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro bye ba'i dbang phyug gtso/lam bzhi'i dam tshig la gnas rnal 'byor ba'i/las bzhi bsgrub la thugs dam brtan pa can/phyogs bzhir bzhugs pa'i yum chen rnams la bstod//phyi nang gsang gsum mchod sprin rgya mtshos brgyan//gsang ba gsum bdag bdud rtsir byin brlabs nas/ro bcud nus gsum phun sum tshogs ldan pa/khams gsum yid 'phrog mchod gtor 'di bzhes shig/dus gsum rgyal ba'i ngo bo bla ma dang //sgo gsum rdo rjes bsrung ba bdag cag la//lus ngag yid gsum sdang bas rab zhakhrug pa'i//dgra bgegs log 'dren rnam gsum tshar gcod mdzod/gdong 10na bzhi dregs pa rtsal chen 'khor bcas rnams//'dir gshegs rgyan gyi //ra ma 'di bzhes shig/ces sogs kyis bstod

dpal mgon po che chung las mkhan rnams kyi gtor ma'i cho ga las bzhi lhun grub/ (gecing 'phrin las bcol lo/ /las mkhan mon bu lcam dral la gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ oṃ mi lha ha ho khyuḥs byin gyis brlab la/ bod pa'am yang na bod rbad bsad gsum ga'i mthar/ i rda ba kla snu lha kha kha khā hi khā hi/ che khug pas 'bul/ badz+ra kā la yak+ṣa nas ru lu yak+ṣa nas ru lu rak+ṣa gis pa ri wā ra a: nas rdi'i bar gyis phyi mchod dang / sngags de'i mthar oṃ u/ btags pas nang mchod 'bul/ /dam can gnod sbyin yab yum/ bka' sdod pu tra ming sring / dregs byed ru 'dren sde bzhi/ dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud/ snang srid lha srin sde brgyad dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams mchode sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ zhes sogs kyis 'phrin las bcol lo/ /gong ltar rdor dril lam rnga brdung ba gang rung gis/ /tsho gyis mdzad/ gang zhig mkha' 'gro kun gyi gtso/e ka dzā khyi ral gcig ma/ /gnod sbyin yab yum stobs dang ldan/ tshar gcod las mdzad rnams la bstod/ /mon bu pu tra mas rtsal can/ /bha dra nag po shugs chen po/ /gser gyi spu gri rdzu phral che/ /las byed ming sring rnams la bstod/ /legs ldan bka' sdod phyogs skyong bcu/ /dregs pa pho mo sde brgyad dang / pho nya zlangs gri ru 'dren rnams/ /dam tshig rjes 'brel dbang gis bstod/ /gtor ma rdzasan (10ba thabar bcas/ sha chen khrag zhag gtams pa yi/ mchod pa dam pa 'di bzhes la/ bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /ces bstod cing bstab bo/ /las mkhan bshan pa lcam dral la gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ oṃ u3 ha ho hrīḥs byin gyi brlabs/ rang gi mdun du rta khrag dang mi khrag gi rgya mtsho dmar la dngas pa/ rba klong gru gsum bsnol mar 'khrug pa'i dbus su zangs kyi ri gru bzhi pa'i steng du pad+ma dang nyi ma/ rta ro dang mi ro brtsegs pa'i gdan la/ lpu dang zangs kyi ral gri las skyes pa'i gnod sbyin chen po sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i zangs kyi ral gri nam mkha' la phyar bas dam nyams kyi srog rtsa gcod cing g.yon mda' gzhu dang bcas pa'i dgra bgegs kyi glo snying thugs gar 'dzin pa'i mchan khung g.yon du bse'i ru mtshon dmar po bsnams pa/ zhal rab tu gdangs shing mche ba rno ngar gtsigs nas ljags rnam par brkyang —47

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)pa/ /spyan gsum dang ldan pa'i khro gnyer shin tu bsdus pa/ smin ma dang sma ra dus mtha'i me ltar rab tu 'bar zhing / dbu skra kham ser ltag par bcings pa/ zangs rmog me 'od 'phro ba la dar dmar gyi 'gying thod bcings pa gsol ba/ khrag 'dzag pa'i mgo rlon lnga bcu ri do shal can/ sku la zangs kyi beg tse dang dar gyi ral gu dmar pos brgyan cing / zhabs la sag lham dmar 'bob gsol ba/ sgeg pa/ dpa' ba/ mi sdug pa'i gzugs can/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyi ye shes(11na)kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yon du mo las srid pa'i lha mo gdong dmar ma/sku mdog sngo nag gdong pa bse/ so dung / smin ma g.yu/ me'i ral pa la mchong dang mu men gyis brgyan cing / gser gyi rna rgyan 'chang ba/ gcer mo can dang zhal bgrad pa/ g.yas zangs gi ral gri dgra la 'phyar ba/ g.yon lcags kyi phur bu bgegs la 'debs pa/ dred mo mi zan la zhon pa/ gtso bo'i g.yas su pre las las mkhan srog bdag dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa phyag g.yas mdung dmar 'phyar zhing / g.yon btsan gyi zhags pa dgra la 'debs pa/ bse khrab dang bse rmog gyon zhing /ce spyang la zhen pa/ mtshan mo rgyu zhing dgra bgegs la 'o dod 'bod pa/ gtso 'khor gsum gyi shar du mi dmar khra ma/ lhor ri tsi mi dmar/ nub tu kro ti mi dmar/ byang du srog bdag ko sha shar lhor e kri mi dmar/ lho nub tu ro kri mi dmar/ nub byang du ha shang mi dmar/ byang shar du srog bdag thal ba ste gri thogs brgyad bshan pa nyi shu rtsa gcig po thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar po g.yas zangs kyi ral gri 'phyar zhing / g.yon la la rgyu ma lag sdogs byed pa/ la la glo snying mchin pa 'brad pa/ la la snying khrag klad pa bldag pa/ la la sha khrag sbar gyis 'debs pa/ la la nang khrol rgyu ma 'dren pa/ la la rus pa rkang mar 'cha' ba/ la la pags pa dmar bshus byed pa/ la la sha gdan dmar po'i gding ba/ /thams cad kyang dgra bo'i srog len pa/ mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi dang / ba (11ba〉pang gi ko ba blo pa gyon pa/ gas yang btsan dmar stong dang / bdud dang gnod sbyin srin po sum stong / ma mo 'bum/ the'u rang stong la sogs pa dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba'i —48

dpal mgon po che chung las mkhan rnams kyi gtor ma'i cho ga las bzhi lhun grub/ rtogegatso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi bor chamagrin par 'a thugs kur hūṃ/ rang gi thugs rka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas byang shar ma ru tse'i dur khrod brag dmar po mchong lding gi pho brang nas gnod sbyin dregs pa lcam sring 'khor dang bcas pa skad cig gis badz+ra sa mā dza: kye/ yul gnyan los mdzad/ gcig mya ngam 'das bdun pha rol na/ mda' na khrag mtsho phu na zangs brag brtsegs/ mi ro rta ro mang po gcal du bkram/ /mi khrag rta khrag du ma mtsho ltar 'khyil/ khor yug zangs ri'i phreng bas kun nas bskor/ ba semakhar smug po dung gi bgam can/ thod pa brtsegs pa'i gzhal yas chen po nas/ chos skyong dregs pa lcam sring gshegs su gsol/ /'khor tsho gos bshan pa'i tshogs rnams ྾/ /zhing bcu'i dam nyams dgra bo 'dul ba dang / rnal 'byor bdag gis las bcol bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /da lta nyid du gnas 'dir gshegs ྾/ /da lta nyid du gnas 'dir gshegs nas kyang / /rings pa'i tshul gyis mchod gtor 'di bzhes la/ /nag po'i phyogs dang gang la dmigs pa yi/ /gnod byed dgra bgegs thal ba'i rdul du rlog /ra smo pra ṇa āt+pa sa pa ri wā ra /lha ya dzaḥ/ dzaḥ/ baṃ ho/ dam tshig pa dang ye shesaganyis su med par bsam/ pad+ma ka (12nasgo lwa ya sto/ chos nyid zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang / /ma rungs 'dul phyir drag po'i skur bstan nas/ /mthu stobs phun tsho gos bstan pa bsrung mdzad pa'i/ /sgrol gying srog bdag dmar po la phyag 'tshal/ /bka' yi 'khor gnas ye shes srung ma'i tshogs/ /rnal 'byor 'dod pa'i bde ster gsang ba'i yum/ /las byed bshan pa gas po sde lnga dang / /ma mo the'u rang tsho gos la gus pas 'dud/ ces phyag bya/ oṃ ra smo pra āt+pa sa pa ri wā ra a lha/ pā: nas shabha pra ti ts+tsha swāhā'i bar sbyar la mchod/ sngags mthar oṃ 〉〉 btags la nang mchod phul/ chos skyong dregs pa lcam sring 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags hūṃ las skyes pa'i rdo rje rtse gcig pa dmar po 'od kyi sbu gu can du gyur nas gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar bsams la/ oṃ ra smo pra ṇa āt+pa sa pa ri wā ra sarba bi sha hūṃ i rda ba li ta kha kha 'a hi 'a hi/ zhes lan bdun gyis gtor ma phul/slar yang phyi mchod dang nang mchod phul nas/ kye rgya gar yul gyi dgra lha/ ma ru tse'i gnas srung / li —49

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)yul chos kyi srung ma/ ma hā de lha'i bka' nyan/ gshin rje gshed kyi bka' sdod/ yab gnod sbyin zangasakyi ral pa can/ yum srin mo khrag gi ral pa can gyi sras gnod sbyin zangs kyi beg tse can/ sring mo srid pa'i lha mo gdong dmar ma 'khor srog gcod bshan pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes (12bsgo/ zhes sogs gur ltar bya'o/ /kye gyu wang mdzad/dbang ldan ma ru tse yi dur khrod nas/ /mtsho dmar brag la brten pa'i gnas bcas pa/ /sgrol gying chen po srog bdag dmar po dang / /srog bdud chen po bse yi lan phran can/ /lcam sring khyod kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba'i/ /las mkhan srog bdag dmar po 'khor dang bcas/ /sgrol byed bshan pa gri thogs brgyad po dang / /ro nyan nyi shu rtsa snyag 'bor dang bcas/ /bdud dang gnod sbyin srin po sum stong dang / /btsan dmar stong gi dmag tsho gos 'khor dang bcas/ /ma mo 'bum dang the'u rang stong la sogs/ /ston pa'i bka' nyan bstan srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /dgra sha khrag gi mchod gtor ྾/ /gtsang ma phud kyi gser skyems ྾/ /rab dmar khrag chang mchod yon ྾/ /sngar bcol las kyis btang rag gnyan por 'bul/ /da 'chol las kyi gsal 'debs rten du 'bul/ /rgyal ba'i bstan dang bstan 'dzin gces par skyongs/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi gnas lus longs spyod dang / /'khor dang yo byad bzhon pa la sogs pa/ /bcol lo gto do srung ma mthu rtsal can/ /nyin gsum bya ra rgyang nas ma g.yel zhig /mtshan gsum mel tshe drung nas ma g.yel zhig /rtag tu sgrub pa'i stong grogs ma g.yel zhig /bla mas bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /sdang ba'i dgra la mngon pa'i rtags ston cig /rnal 'byor bdag gi mgon skyabs dpung gnyen mdzod/ /bla ma'i sku (13na dgra bstan pa'i spyi dgra dang / /rnal 'byor sgos dgra sems can yongs la 'tshe ma nyas log par lta ba'i dgra dang bgegs/ /dpal mgon khyod kyi sgrol la bstan pa srungs/ /zhesabarjod la bstab bo/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor ni/ oṃ u3 ha ho khyiḥs byin gyis brlabs/ /'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral bar bcas la/ pho/ oṃ badz+ra ā ra li sngo dzaḥ& baṃ ho badz+ra rte ki ni/ sam ya sku dṛ shu —50

dpal mgon po che chung las mkhan rnams kyi gtor ma'i cho ga las bzhi lhun grub/ 9)hoḥgator mgron spyan drangs pa la gtor ma phul bar bsams te/ rdo rje thal mo gyen du phye ba'i mthar se gol gtog cing / oṃ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa/ rāk+ṣa sa/ bhū ta/ pre ta/ pi shā tsa/ un da/a ba smu ra ḍā ka ḍā ki rgyu da yaḥ i rma ba kla gros skyo/ sam yarak+ṣa skyo/ ma ma sarba ge/ me pra byu/ ya thi baṃ/ ya then snu lha tha/ pi ba tha/ dzi gh+ra thamā ti pom tha/ ma ma sarba ga rlo/ sku kha bi shurnya ye/ sa ha yi ka bha wa skyo hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis 'bul/ a nas sha rdi'i bar gyis mchod /oṃ 〉lha gis nang mchod gtor la/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro /rin cen mkha' 'gro/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro/ sna tshogs mkha' 'gro la sogs pa gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la sogs gong ltar brjod/ gzhi bdag gtor ma ni/ oṃ u3 ha ho hrīḥs byin gyis brlabs/ hūṃ mdzad phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ bhū mi pa ti mā gas ya dzaḥ zhesapas mgron dgug ma a kā (13bsta ( mu kho sarba dharmā 'o/ ār+ya nut+pa 4 tā ta oṃ sa/ phaṭa swāhā/ zhesalan gsum gyis phul/ gong ltar phyi nang gis mchod/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'dod pa'i yon to lnga dang ldan pa 'di nyid sa'i lha mo bstan ma/ bod khams skyong ba'i bstan ma bcu gnyis la sogs pa gnas bdag gzhi bdag grong bdag yul bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams dang / ma ltar byams shing sring ltar nye ba rnams la 'bul lo/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing 'jig rten du dge legs rgya chen po 'byung ba dang / gnas mgron gyi dam tsheg srungs/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis bya ba dang spyod pa nyes pa la ko long ru nga phrag dog ma mdzad par bsam sbyor chos mthun yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i 'phrin las stong grogs rgya chen po mdzad du gsol/ na ma'i dag gi bsam pa'i stobs dag dang / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang / /chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis/ /don rnams gang dag bsams pa kun/ /de dag thams cad ci rigs pa/ /'jig rten khams 'dir ma lus pa/ /thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig /ces brjod/bzlas pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /he ru ku'i yi ge —51 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)brgya pa gsum bdun nyer gcig skabs sbyar brjod/ yi dam gyi sngags ni/ oṃ de wa pi tsu badz+ra hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ mgon po gur gyi sngags ni/ oṃ ma hā kā la hūṃ phags/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya hūṃ hūṃ phags (14na)swāhā/ lha mo'i sngags ni/ oṃ ru ru ro ru bi ti sgo ba dh+wa si ka ma la rā si hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ/ mgon po zhal gyi sngags ni/ oṃ ma hā kā la kā la bi kā la/ ra tri ta/ ḍom+bhi nī/ tsaṇ+ḍasnyi/ ra'i sī/ siṅga lī de bī hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ/ las mkhan lcam dral gyi sngags ni/ oṃ ro ru ro ru tri tsa pa la a shu sme ma hūṃ ma bh+yo dzaḥdzaḥ a li a li ma dzaḥdzaḥshe she li shi ded/ a shwa ded/ mo smugs spu gri /a li ma dzaḥdzaḥnag mo sha la rubs dzaḥdzaḥ las mkhan lcam dral gyi sngags ni/ oṃ pra ṇa ā khru k+ṣi ru pu ru ga lu hi ta sarba sha hūṃ mā ra ya hūṃ phags/ oṃ ra smo ya ma tsi t+ta dzā la ri/ pra ti de sa ldi hūm̐/ srog la ya ma dza: sarba sha nyu ma ra ya phags/ las sngags ni/ oṃ shri ma hā ka la ya/ sha ba'i na ༷/ pa hā ri ṇi/ e dzi a paX/ ma kā 'o1 a yaṃ/ i rda rat+na tra yu ya/ a pa gī ra ṇi/ ya di bra ti dz+nya/ sma ra sī ta dwa/ i rda du sna kha kha/ 'a hi khā hi/ ma ra mar/ gro sna gro sna/ rjo — / ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di na me kon/ mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ cham hā kwa la kā la/ bi gas karā la/la zhi ta og la sba dpe ka /lo ba /ba le/ ra bi ghaṇ+ḍa/ ru dra māl bi hu re/ tshe da ha /le/ ha le na ha le/ pi zhi dzāli/ ba me 〉 ku dhu ri yaṃ mo e/ da hi na ga rti /ro tri/ bhi bhi ṣa na dha e/ bā me shā la pā ṇi/ ha ra 'o ra/ na ra sī ra māl/ pā ta lo k+ṣi ཾ kā ra /la/ ma hā po ṭa le/ ma hā kā la shrī/ /bi la ki bi la r+shahā tra pā la/ ha ha ka re/ 1 bha ṣastisdoX/ dzo dzan+ti/ me sa/ bha ta phul+la dhū pa/ i gha (14ba tshe1/ ba smra/ dzi gh+ra ha/ da sha di ka /u stu ra wu ri/ 'o bhi ni/ tsaṇ+ḍasnyi/ rak+ṣa sī/ siṅga lī/ de khyi/ ha na ha na/ ban+dha brnya/ mā ra mā ra/ da ha da ha/ ba tsa ba tsa/ k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ/ le he ba kla de hi sa/ bi kwa la sha hūṃ/ mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa tra me/raka kha mun/ ru lu ru lu3/ ra ka snying khrag snying bh+yoḥ sbu ta spu to bh+yoḥ sha sha trag sha sha trag lha smo tra pa/ snying khrag ra smo tra pa/ gnod byed mā ra ya/ oṃ ma hā raka tsit+ta srog ltu ltu/ ka ma la rak+ta tsit+ta srog rtu tī/ gu tho raka tsit+ta srog tī ṭaṃ/ hri baṃ raka tsit+ta srog ltu tī/ ma ma tsa spur tsit+ta srog tī ltu/ pu ru tsa lte tsit+ta srog tī rtu/khru ga dhi ga ya du pa sha ni sod/ rdu shig ā gad dzaḥ mon bu ā gad dzaḥ ya snar ya snar mon bu dzaḥ mon —52

dpal mgon po che chung las mkhan rnams kyi gtor ma'i cho ga las bzhi lhun grub/ (dpebu khrag la 'jibs dzaḥ/ snar na rbad/ du na rbad/ shi na rbad/ shag shig rbad/ tri na rbad/ du na rbad/mon bu pu tra she rbad/ yaṃ smugs/ ling 'dus/ kho shod/ pa ya mo dzaḥ dgra bo'i rus la khrol khrol rbad/gser gyi sbu gri gnod byed kyi snying la yaṃ rbad/ ces pa ci rigs pa bzlas rjes su bha ya na tshar gsum/su gang dag sogs dmod pa 'dor zhing thal mo brdab par bya'o/ 'khon gcugs sbyang ba'i bzlas pa/gnya' gnon gyi bzlas pa/ /thugs mnyes pa'i bzlas pa/ drag po'i bzlas pa bzhi po'i dmigs pa rnams kha'u brag rdzong ba'i khyad chos ltar zhal las blang bar bya'o/ /thun gyi mthar gtor ma skyong bar 'dod pas/ yi dam ma gtogos pa'i gtor ma g.yin rnams sgrub khang gi steng gi gtor stegs sam/sa gtsang sar khyer la/(15na3 bh+yo/ dpal ldan mgon po ma hā kā la dang / /dpal ldan lha mo mi pham srid gsum bdag /rdo rje nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa/ /'jigs gzugs mkha' 'gro yum chen sring mo bzhi/ lcam dral khyod kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba'i/ /dur khrod bdag po zhing skyong 'khor dang bcas/snang srid lha srin sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas/ /dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud 'khor dang bcas/ /mkha' lding bya khyi lcags spyang 'khor dang bcas/ pu tra la sogs las mkhan 'khor dang bcas/ /chos skyong beg tse lcam dral 'khor dang bcas/ khrung ma dam can rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas/ /'dir bzhugs gzhi bdag gnyan po 'khor dang bcas/ /'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /ces sogs dkyus ltar bya/ /de nas/ oṃ/ srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ma lus 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /thub pa'i bstan pa yun ring gnas pa dang / /de 'dzin byed pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams/ /dpal 'byor gyis brgyan yun ring zhabs brtan mdzod/ /bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas rnams/ /tshe ring nad med bde skyid phun sum tshogs/ /bsams pa'i don rnams yid bzhin grub pa dang / 'gro ba'i don la mthu dang ldan pas mdzod/ yi ge brgya pa dang / ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang / zhes sogs brjod/ /phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam (15ba)pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las —53

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu yang sku gzugs kyi rten 'di rnams la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs rnams ji srid 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas kyang bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi mgon dang skyabs dang dpung gnyen dam pa mdzad du gsol/ oṃ su pra byu badz+re swāhā/ rten med pa'i gtor mgron rnams/ oṃ khyed kyis semasacan don kun mdzad/ ces sogs dang / badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa rang gnas su gshegs/ /dam tshig pa dzaḥ& baṃ hoḥ bdag dang gnyis su med par bsam/ dge ba 'di yis nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i/ /lus can kun gyi bsod nams ye shes tshogs/ /myur du bsgrubs nas tshe 'di kho na la/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa la 'god par lha(ga /bdag gis dus gsum dge ba ci bsags pa/ /nam mkha'i mtha' klas gyur pa'i sems can rnams/ /bla med theg pa chen po'i snod gyur nas/ kun kyang rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sathob shog /bdag kyang sangs rgyas ma thob bar/ /skye dang skye bar gnas bzang po/ rigs bzang spyod pa bzang ba dang / /grogs bzang bla mas rjes 'dzan shog /tshul khrims dag cing mkhas la bsgrin/ /rnam par dag cing rgyud gcig la/ /skal bzang spyod pas rnam brgyan pa/ /thos nas legs par ston par shog /mgo bor bla ma'i cod pan 'chang / /(16na sgog pa thabs shes rdor dril 'dzin/ /ngag tu gsang sngags rgyal po bzla/ /yid kyis zung 'jug bsgom par shog /deng nas byang chub ma thob par /bla ma lha dang mi 'bral zhing / /sgrub la bar chad med pa dang / /bstan la bya ba byed par shog /lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang / /des gsungs tshig kyang tshad ma'i tshig yin te/ /bden pa de dag gis ni lha mo rnams/ /bdag cag rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces gnas skabs kyi smon lam dang bden tshig gi rgyas gdab/ shis brjod ni/ rdo rje 'chang dbang klu sgrub mchog sred zhabs/ /mal gnyan 'khon rigs 'jam mgon rim byon dang / kha'u pa dang tshar chen yab sras sogs/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /dkyil 'di man tshar r+ṣa gyi gsung / 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag kyai rdo rje/ /dam —54

dpal mgon po che chung las mkhan rnams kyi gtor ma'i cho ga las bzhi lhun grub/ (gechos rgya mtsho'i nying khu gsung ngag mchog /bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i gtsug rgyan sa skya pa/ /mchog gsum 'gran zla bral ba'i bkra shis shog /bstan srung kun gyi sdod pon rdo rje gur/ /bstan 'dzin bu ltar skyong ba'i 'dod khams ma/ /bstan dgra'i gshed ma zhing skyong gdong bzhi pa/ /bstan srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyi bkra shis shog /'dod dgu'i mchog sbyin rje btsun rigs byed ma/ /'dod yon char 'bebs lha chen tsho gos kyi bdag /'dod pa'i rgyal po khams gsum dbang sdud lhas/ /'dod don bde blag 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /g.yin yang bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa ci rigs pa bya'o/ /smras pa/ 'phrin las myur mgyogs pho nya'i chu gter las/ /chos skyong dgyes bskyed gtore chog (16ba tsā da bzhin nor/kho bo'i blo gros rgyal mtshan rtser bkod tshe/ /mchog mthun dngos grub 'dod dgu char du bsnyil/ /lugasasrol gzhan gyi rgyas bkab 'dra bcos dang / khungs bral rang bzos bslad pa'i dpar hrul min/ kha'u brag rdzong bzhed pa'i lam srol ltar/ /bklags choge 'khyer bde'i tshul du gsal bar bkod/ /gdams pa'i gnad bral drag brdung rol mo tsam/ /sgrogs pas zhing skyong bran 'khor grub mchog tu/ /rlom rnams lha lam ngos kyi 'ja' ris ltar/ /rab bgrad don gyis stong pa'i gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /bla ma zab chos brgyud tshul mi sems shing / /grags 'dod dbang gis dpe tsam 'khyams pa la/ ngag 'don gzu lums spyod na dregs ldan de/ bka' srung bshan pa dmar pos chad pa chod/ /rtog ges gzhal ba'i tshig gi spun pa dang / stobs ldan zog chos byed pa'i dpe 'khyams min/ /yid bzhin nor 'dra'i gsang chen slob bshad kyi/ /lugs ltar bkod la chos srung dgyes pa bskyed/ /dge des thub bstan 'joms pa'i dgra bgegs dpung / /srog dang phral te rnam shes mi bskyod pa'i/ /zhing du rgyal ba'i sras su nyer bskrun te/ /phan bde'i dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /ces dpal gur gyis mgon po/ gdong bzhi pa las mkhan dang bcas pa la gtor ma 'bul ba'i cho ga 'phrin las lhun grub ces pa 'di ni rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras kyi phyag len bdag chen rdo rje 'chang chen po blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i bar du gdung brgyud rim par chig brgyud du byon pa'i lugs srol —55

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)(17na〉nga chen chos kyi rgyal po'i gsung ngag rin po che 'phrin las myur mgyogs pho lha'i dgongs pa dang phyag len ji lta ba bzhin yin na'ang pho nya myur mgyogs snyan brgyud glegs bam du bzhugs pas bka' rgya dam pa dang / las mkhan rnams ru nga phrag dog che bas dngos su spel bar ma nus la/'don cha'i skor rnams zur du phye zhing gsung dngos rnams ras su ma bor bar ji lta ba bzhin bris/ sku gsum mngon gyur ma sogs 'ga' zhig bsnan te bklags chog tu rang gi brjed byang dang / phan bde legs bshad gling pa rnams kyi rgyun 'khyer du a wa dhū tī ba'i za hor gyi btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos sa pho byi ba'i lo chu shel gyi dbang po mgos nya ba'i dpa' bo dga' ston gyi tshes la dga' ldan pho brang du sbyar ba yi ge pa ni ngag dbang dge legs so/ / sarba maṅga lo// //

dpal mgon po che chung las mkhan rnams kyi bstod bskul bshan pa rnam par rol pa/ (dper༅༅/ /dpal mgon po che chung las mkhan rnams kyi bstod bskul bshan pa rnam par rol pa bzhugs/bde chen chos dbyings 'gyur ba med pa'i sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rol gar las/ /longs sku khro rgyal nag po chen po dgra bgegs steng du bro brdung ba'i/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i bstan srung kun gyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po mchog /dam ldan rnal 'byor tshogs kyis bstod na dgyes pa'i dmar zlum spyan gyis gzigs/ /mchog sred ri sul rnal 'byor mal lo gnyan/ /sa skya pa dang bdag chen rdo rje 'chang / /kun spangs chos rje tshar chen mkhyen brtse dbang / /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bstan srung nag po che/ /khyod nyid bstod cing bskul ba'i dbyar skyes rnga/ /srid gsum ldeg cing g.yo ba tsam nyid du/ /'gag med rdo rje'i dbyangs su len byed na/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis char ltar dbab tu gsol/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po gdong bzhi pa las mkhan dang bcas pa'i gtor chog sogs kyi skabs su nye bar mkho ba'i bstod cing bskul ba'i tshogs (2na)kyi rim pa/ dpal ldan sa skya ba'i bstan srung dbang po'i tshogs rnams kyi bstod pa'i rim pa las bsdus pa dang / gzhan yang khungs ldan brgyud pa'i gsung gi rim pa'i tshogs 'ga' zhig brjod pa ni 'di lta ste/ gur mgon lcam dral gyi bstod pa ni/ : 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad/ gang gi thugs ni dbyings las ma g.yos kyang / /rgyal ba kun gyi 'phrin las bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /sna tshogs sprul pas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i/ /dpal chen gtum po khyod la bdag bstod do/ khyod sku lhun po lta bur rab brjid cing / /mi 'gyur nam mkha'i mdangs ltar shin tu mdzes/ /chos sku de bzhin nyid du gcig pa'i dbu/ /bden gnyis zab mo'i don —57

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)mtshon phyag dang zhabs/ /skyon drug gcod cing bdud sde'i tsho gos 'joms phyir/ /g.yas pa'i phyag gis gri gug thugs kar 'dzin/ /'dod khro rmongs spangs g.yon pa'i phyag gis ni/ /gdug pa'i khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin/ /chos sgra chen pos bdud kyi klad 'gems phyir/ /rnam (2ba phra phrul gaṇ+ḍi phyag gi dbus na bsnams/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lnga ni rnam dag pa/ /mi mgo skam po lnga yis dbu brgyan cing / /ā li kā li lnga bcu dag pa'i phyir/ /gdug pa'i mgo rlon lnga bcu'i do shal can/ /gzung 'dzin rab spangs stag gi sham thabs can/ /klu chen dbang du sdud pas sbrul gyis brgyan/ /rin chen rus pa'i rgyan gyis rab tu sgeg /bdud sdodapung bcas mi bzad 'dzoms mdzad pa/ khro gnyer mche ba rab gtsigs mi sdug pa/ /sna tsho gis sprul pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gang gi gsung ni nam mkha'i mthas gtugs par/ /ha ha hi hi zhes pas rab tu ba 'ad/ /hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa la sogs drag shul sgras/ /bdud dang log 'dren tsho gos rnams skrag par mdzad/ /dpa' bo'i gsung gi nga ro 'brug stong sgras/ khren tu 'jigs rung sgrog pa de la 'dud/ khyod kyi thugs ni spros las rnam grol yang / /snying rje'i dbang gis 'gro ba'i yid las byung / /skad cig gis ni khams gsum ma lus kun/ /za bar nus pa'i rngam pa mchog dang ldan/ /de lta'i sprul pa sna tshogs rab ston kyang / /rang bzhin chos sku nyer zhi'i thugs la 'dud/ /dpa' bo khyod kyis thub pa'i bstan pa mchog /rab tu skyong phyir log 'dren 'dul ba dang / /gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs pa'i/ /lam la gnas pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa skyongs/bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi/ /rmi lam ltas sdig skal ba ngan pa dang / /nad dang gnod dang dus min 'chi la sogs/ /mi mthun (3na phyogs rnams zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ /bdag dang bdag la phan par gang sems pa/ /de dag kun gyi tshe dang bsod nams dang / /'khor dang longs spyod mthu dang dbang phyug kun/ /rtag tu mi nyams rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /lha dang mi dang klu dang gnod sbyin sogs/ /'gro ba kun gyi gdug pa'i sems zhi nas/ /thams cad bdag gi dbang du gyur nas kyang / /theg mchog bstan pa'i snod du 'gyur bar mdzod/ /gang zhig zhi bas 'dul bar mi nus 58

dpal mgon po che chung las mkhan rnams kyi bstod bskul bshan pa rnam par rol pa/ 9)shing / /gdug cing gtum pa'i sems dang rab ldan pas/ /bla ma dam pa'i sku la rdzob dang / /semasacan la 'tshe thub pa'i bstan la gnod/ /rnal 'byor rdo rje 'dzin pa bdag cag gi /sgrub la bar du gcod par byed pa yi/ /gnod dang log par 'dren pa'i tshogs kun la/ /gtum po khyod kyi mngon spyod las kyis ni/ /bskrad dang gzir dang bcings dang rengs pa dang / /rmugs shing dran pa rab tu nyamasapa dang / /de yi lusang ga yid kyi rdzu phrul dang / /mthudang longs spyod dbang phyug tsho gos rnams kun/ /skad cig gis ni thams cad rab nyams nas/ /'du ba rnam bzhi'i nad kyis gzir nas kyang / /kha nas khong khrag dron mo rab bskyugs nas/ /da lta nyid du bsad cing bsgral bar gyis/ /bdag gis bsgo ba'i las 'di ma bsgrubs na/ /sngon tshe bde bar gshegs pa'i spyan snga mā /thub pa'i bstan pa bsrung bar khas blangs pa/ /dam bcas nyams 'gyur de slad ma g.yel zhig /〉ཿ gzung khrus las byu /kun (3bkro bzang po'i rig ma las/ /ma g.yos u ma de ldi'i sku/ /ma mo thams cad bskyed mdzad ma/ /yum chen khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje'i mi 'gyur sku mdog mthing / /ye shes dbu gcig 'gying zhing khro/ /g.yu yi ral pas srid gsum sgrol/ /snyan gnyis 'gro drug gsol 'debs gsan/ gangasakyi rlung sgras bag chags 'joms/ /skye shi rtsad gcod mche ba gcigs/ /spyan gsum 'gro la gzigs shing ba 'ad/ /thar pa'i lam ston gsung dbyangs snyan/ /thabs dang shes rab phyag gnyis kyis/ /g.yu yi bum pa thugs kar 'dzin/ /tshe 'dzin bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis gtams/ /skye 'gro gso ba'i yum gcig ma/ /e ka dzā ṭī dpal dang ldan/ /yum chen khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bh+yoḥ bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad/ rgya mtsho'i klong nas me 'bar khyod/ /mtsho rnams skems par nus ma ste/ /bud med thams cad zhi mdzad phyir/ /lha chen sku yi byed du bzhugs/ /rdzong dang dka' bzlog nag mo che/ /lha dang lha min phyag byasam/ /mi nad gang yin khyod ming shes/ /de la 'jigs pa med par mdzad/ /gshin rje'i lcam mo bdud kyi yum/ /'dod khams dbang phyug ma la 'dud/ /stobs 'phrog zhal bzhi pa'i bstod pa ni/ lhaḥ sa paṇa gyis mdzad/ dpal ldan dbang ldan srid gsum dbang sgyur zhing / /mche ba gtsigs shing mchu 'phyang 59

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)shugs che ba/ /sgra sgrog dril bu'i phreng bas brgyan pa yi/ /gzhen nu'i lus can bgegs 'joms khyod la bstod/ /(4na khu ma'i ming can drag po'i phreng ba can/ /nyi zla 'bar ba'i mig gis bdud 'joms shing / /brkyang bskum glog stong 'gyu 'dra'i khro gnyer can/ /mdung rnon gri gug bum thod 'dzin la bstod/ /'jigs byed myur 'gro tshangs skud mi mgo yi/ /phreng ba 'dzin zhing sa gsum skrag byed pa/k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ sgra sgrog srin po'i gzuṭa 'dzin pa'i/ /dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba khyod la bstod/ /dpal ldan gru 'dzin chen po na/ khyod bzhugs te se'i gangs ri la/ gdong bzhi ldan khyod zhing skyong mdzad/ /kun srung khyod la bstod par bya/ /ha ha'i gad brgyangs ga sgra sgrog /hūṃ hūṃ sgrog pa'i dpal khyod kyis/ /srid gsum gnas pa'i bgegs rnams kun/ /skrag mdzad khyod la bstod par bya/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas spyan snga sa /dam bcas don de da lta 'dir/ /bsgrub la thogs pa med gyur pa/ /dam tshig ldan khyod bstod par bya/ sha chen zan dang me tog spos/ /chang phud sha khrag la dga' ba/ khyod ni byang na rab bzhugs kyang / /phyogs bcu'i dbang phyug khyod la bstod/ /g.yung mo gtum mo srin mo dang / /siṅga la gnas rnal 'byor ma/ /dmar ser ljang nag khros pa'i zhal/ /gri gug thod 'dzin rnams la bstod/ khyod ni rang phyogs legs skyong zhing / /gzhan phyogs rnam par sun 'byin pa/ /don gnyisabasgrub pa'i yab yum la/ /bdag gis rtag tu bstod par bya/ /de ltar bstod cing rab bsngags pas/ /bdag cag 'khor bcas (4bsgo srung ba dang / /'dod pa thams cad bsgrub pa dang / /bgegs rnams ma lus med par mdzod/ khyod kyis sgrub pa'i las bya zhing / /rjes su bsgrub na brtse ba dang / /yongasasu bsten na dgyes pa dang / /sun 'byin rnam par gzhes par mdzod/ /klog pa rnams ni rgyas pa dang / /kha ton phun sum tsho gos pa dang / /sgrub pa dri ma med pa yi/ /bstan pa dag kyang dar bar mdzod/ /mdor na gang dang gang bcol ba'i/ /de dang de yi las rnams la/ /btang snyoms g.yel ba ma mdzad bar/ /bdag la rjes su brtse bar mdzod/ /nyu ga 'a gyis mdzad/ paṃ pad raṃ nyi ro steng du/ hūṃ skyes nag po 'jigs pa'i gzugs//zhal bzhi phyag bzhi zhabs gnyis la/ khro gtum rngam pa khyod la bstod/ /g.yas —60

dpal mgon po che chung las mkhan rnams kyi bstod bskul bshan pa rnam par rol pa/ 9)gnyis sngon po mche gtsigs zhal/ /spyan rtsa dmar zlum nyi ltar 'khyil/ /smin ma sma ra dmar ser 'bar/ /ljags 'dril ha har bzhad la bstod/ /g.yon gnyis ljang gu khro gnyer 'khrigs/ /dpral bsdus sdang mig glog ltar gzigs/ shang nas rlung 'tshub rdul gyis 'gengs/ /hūṃ hūṃ sgra 'byin khyod la bstod/ /g.yas g.yon gri gug thod khrag ni/ /thugs kar steng 'og bsnams pa yis/ /dgra bgeṭa snying 'byin dgra khrag 'thung / /phaṭa phaṭa dgra bgegs sgrol la bstod/ /g.yas g.yon 'og ma'i phyag gnyis kyis//rtse gsum bum pa bsnams pa ni/ /mdung rnon dgra bgegs lus la 'debs/ /bum pas(ldan〉skrub la dngos grub rtsol/ /mi mgo khrag 'dzag lnga bcu dang / /dril bu g.yer ga'i sil sil gyi/ /zhing skyong khyod kyi sku la brgyan/ /srid gsum g.yo byed khyod la bstod/ /zhabs gnyis gar gyi dor stabs kyis//sa gzhi rab g.yos dgra bgegs 'dul/ /dpa' bo khro byed rang sha gcod/ /rngam pa'i dpa' bo khyod phyag 'tshal/ /bh+yoḥ g.yas phyogs rgyug byed g.yung mo khyod/ /gri gug thod 'dzin bshug pas 'geng //dgra bo myos byed gsod byed ma/ /g.yung mo nag mo khyod la bstod/ /g.yon nas 'gying stabs bzhad cing rgyug /gri gug thod 'dzin sha rus za/ /dgra bgi spyo dbang gsod byed ma/ /gtum mo ljang gu khyod la bstod/ /mdun nas srin mo mchong stabs rgyug /gri gug thod 'dzin dgra snying 'byin/ /la khrag gang yab la stob/ /yab la dgyes 'khril yum la bstod/ /rgyab nas gar stabs gsar zhing rgyug /gri gug thod 'dzin sing gling ma/ /'o dod khus 'debs dgra bo dgug /siṅga gling ma khyod la bstod/ /gtso 'khor 'khor bcas te se'i gnas/ /zhing skyong srung ma gtso 'khor lngas/ /bstan dgra gdug pa'i dgra bgegs rnams/ /sgrol byed gtso 'khor lnga la bstod/ sha chen zan bcas me tog dang / /rus chen spags pa'i gtor ma 'di/ /ye shes lnga ru byin brlabs pa/ /'di bzhes dgra bgegs brlag pa mdzod/ /hūṃ/ mkha'u bas mdzad/ bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na/ /zhal (5ba tha zhi phyag bzhi mthing nag rngam pa'i sku/ /rtsa 'kha nag brtsegs g.yas dkar g.yon pa dmar/ /phyag g.yas gri gug g.yon par thod nang snying / /'og ma ral gri mi rus phreng ba bsnams/ /spyan gsum khro gnyer zhal —61 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)gdangs mche ba gtsigs//dbu skra gyen brdzes thod skam dbu la bcings//mi mgo'i do shal sbrul dang rus pas brgyan//dpa' bo stag sham zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum tshul//rgyal ba'i bka' sdod nag po che la bstod//lha rnams kun gyi sde dpon dpa' bo che//legs ldan nag po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo//bka' dang bstan pa ci bsrung mdzad dam tshig che//zhing skyong chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo//ma mo kun gyi gtso bo dbang phyug che//dur khrod bdag po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo//log 'dren dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i mthu bo che//mahā kā la khyod la phyag 'tshal lo//snri mgon po'i mtshan gsol dpal ldan nag po che//rgyal ba'i bstan srung bka' yi bya ra ba//gdug pa tshar gcod drag shul mthu rtsal ldan/bdud 'dul dpa' bo bdag la dgongs su gsol//'dod yon rgya chen gtor ma'i rgya mtsho dang //longs spyod sna tsho gis zhal zas mchod pa 'di//dpal ldan nag po chen po'i zhal du 'bul//dgyesapa'i tshul gyis mchod gtor 'di bzhes la//sngon gyi thugs dam gto po nyer dgongs te//rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa yi//mi mthun gnod pa'i rkyen rnams zhi ba dang //'dod pa'i don rnams khrub par mdzad du gsol//:klu sgrub kyi dzad/srin po'i gzugs kyi gdug pa can//tshar gcod byang chub sems dpa' ste//4na ) grong khyer sum brtsegs 'jig byed pa//legs ldan khyod la phyag 'tsha4bstod//bdag gis brtson par sno bstod do/'ag rten 'di na rang dbang thob//sngon gyi bram zes smras pa ltar//bkra shis mchogo grub sems bder byed//yid myur gzugs can kun tu grags//mgon po byed cing 'jig rten skyong //'thab pa'i tshe na rtag tu rgyal//gshin rje ma mos mngon par bstod//dar gyi stod g.yogs sngon po can//sdug dang mi sdug lus su ston//mig gi thams cad dwangs par byed//mchog sgrub dpag med sems bder byed//snying dang ldan zhing rab tu dpa'//rtag tu khyod la bdag gis bstod//hūṃ/bla mdam pa bar nams rgyal ma gyis mdzad/srid gsum dbang sgyur dpal ldan nag po che//dus gsum rgyal ba'i ye shes las sprul zhing //byang shar ha ha rgod pa'i dur khrod kyi//zhing skyong dbang phyug chen po'i thuṭa kyi sras//sku mdog cher nag zhal bzhi mche ba 62

dpal mgon po che chung las mkhan rnams kyi bstod bskul bshan pa rnam par rol pa/ 9)gcigs//byis pa'i lus can shugs chen srog la rngam//dril bu'i sgra sgrog drag po'i phreng ba can//rnam grangs mang po'i ming can mgyogs 'gro zhing //g.yas kyi dang pos 'bar ba'i gri gug 'phyar//g.yon gyi dang pos thod nang khrag kun gsol//g.yas 'og ral gris dgra bgegs phye mar rlog/g.yon 'og phreng bas bde chen ye shes 'gugs//res 'ga' bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa dang //rdo rje dang bcas mdung thung cher rno bas//sgrub pa po la dngos grub mchog rtsol zhing //nyams pa'i dgra bo'i srog rtsa myur du gcod//rgyan drug gis brgyan mi mgo'i do 6bskal mdzes//stag gis pags pa'i na bzas smad g.yogs can//brkyang bskum gar gyis sna tshogs pad nyi'i steng //dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil bzhugs/khyod ni rnam 'phrul sna tshogs dpag yas pas//ri bo gru 'dzin gangs can bsil ba'i tshal//drag tu rgod pa'i dur khrod 'jigs pa'i nang //ha ha hūṃ hūṃ gad mo cher bzhad cing //sa 'og k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ 'brug sgra ltar sgrogs pas//phyogs bcu stong mdzad dus mtshan nag po che//'phrin las rnam bzhis nyid thugs dgyes mdzad pa'i//yum chen 'jigs gzugs mkha' 'gro'i tsho gos dang bcas//zhing skyong sde brgyad dregs pa'i 'khor gyis bskor//dam can sprul pa yang sprul srung ma'i tshogs//tshur gshegs sngon gyi dam tshig rjes dgongs la//'dir spyon dgyes pa'i dam rdzas 'di bzhes mdzod//dgra bgegs khrag gi bdud rtsi lcags kyu lnga//'dzam bu ti ba mi rus sna tsho gos dang //me tog rnying par yos sna tshogs dang //sman dang rak+ta phud kyi mchod par bcas//zhim pa'i bza' btung tshil chen spos kyi dri/khrag gi a lha me tog nag po dang //zhun chen sgron me zhag gi dri chab dang //zhal zas bsgos nag rus pa'i rgyan spras pa'i//gtor ma ri dang rgya mtshor mnyam pa'i tshogs//sna tshogs dar gyis lhab lhub kyis mdzes pa//ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin rlabs pa'i//bzhed dgu longs spyod phun tsho gos khrung ba 'di//bdag la brtser dgongs nyid kyis rab bzhes la//gsol zhig snoms shig rol zhig tshim 7na ngor mdzod//ji ltar phul ba bzhin du bzhes nas kyang //sngon gyi dam bcas g.yel bar ༷ mdzad par/ /rdo rje 'chang gi spyan sngar khas blangs

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)bzhin/ /bstan pa bsrung ba'i las 'di myur du sgrubs/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa'i dgra bgeṭa dang / /lam la bar du gcod pa'i bdud rigs rnams/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug rdzu 'phrul nyams pa dang / /bsad bskrad dbye rmongs ngag sems bcing ba dang / /lus sregs tshos la zhal du gsol bar mdzod/ /gang yang bdag sogs bstan 'dzin de dag la/ /nyid kyis rjes dgongs bcol ba'i las mdzad de/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi'i dngos grub kun stsal nas/ /bsams pa'i don kun chos bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ snri gnam kha'u pas zhal gzigs dusamadzad pa/ rdo rje 'chang dbang thuṭa kyi phrin las las/ /rnam 'phrul zhi bas 'dul bar mi spyod la/ /drag po'i stobs kyis gdug pa tshad gcod pa/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can khyod la bstod par bgyi/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i bka' sdod pho nya khyod/ /rnal 'byor dam tshig ldan pa'i srog shing ste/ /gang gis bsten cing bcol na thugs rje'i mthus/ /yid la mngon 'dod 'byor pa grub mdzad bstod/ khyod ni ha ha rgod pa'i dur khrod kyi/ /zhing skyong dbang phyug chen po'i sprul pa ste/ /lha chen thugs kyi pho nya mthu bo che/ khyod kyi pahrūl phyogs sogs ma lus khyab/ /yab gcig rtag tu te se'i gangs la bzhugs/ /phal cher po ṭa la yi ri bo la/ /res 'ga' bsil ba'i tshal na bram ze'i gzugs/ /da lta dar lung gnyan gyi pho brang na/ khyod (7na)kyi rten sa kha'u'i brag rdzong la/ /rnal 'byor dam tshig ldan pa'i rjes 'brang zhing / /gang gis bcol ba'i las rnams sgrub mdzad pa'i/ /drag po dbang phyug gzi ldan 'dir spyon zhig /sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga mā /gtum po khyod kyis ji ltar khas blangs bzhin/ /drag po'i las la gnas pa'i spyan 'dren gyis/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol/ khyod kyi bzhugs tshul gyad kyi dor stabs kyis/ /gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla gdan du bting / /dam nyams dgra bo'i steng du bro brdung zhing / /sna tsho gis rnam 'gyur gar mkhan gdan la bzhugs/ khyod kyi sku ni mi'u thung srin po'i gzugs/ /mdog nag rtsa zhal nag po brtsegs pa'i zhal/ /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar zhal du mi ro gsol/ /srog 'phrog rngam zhing mi mgo'i phreng bas brgyan/ /phyag bzhi g.yas kyi dang po —64—

dpal mgon po che chung las mkhan rnams kyi bstod bskul bshan pa rnam par rol pa/ (gegri gug gis//g.yon gyi dang po thod nang snying gcod tshul//lhag mar ral gri mdung thung bum pa 'dzin//res 'ga' mi rus phreng ba phyag na bsnams//nag po chen po mche ba gtsigs pa'i zhal/khugs chen ma mchu 'phyang ba byis pa'i gzugs//dril bu'i sgra sgrog drag po'i phreng bas brgyan//'phrog pa'i dpa' bo gcod pa'i mtshon cha 'dzin//rnam grangs mang po'i ming can mgyogs 'gro zhing //sa 'og gnasal k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ sgra sgrog cing //ha ha'i gad brgyangasa3 hūṃ bzhad sgra can//stobs ldan tshangs skud mi rkang gling bus brgyan//dpa' bo khyod kyi sring mo chen mo bzhi//g.yung mo gtum mo srin mo siṅga li//'jigasagazugs mkha' 'gro gcer mo gri gug dang //ban+ta'i phyag can nag nya sngang dmar ser te//ma lus 'khor bcas 'dir spyon dam rdzas bzhes/kha wo spos kyi dud pa zan dang sha/bdud rtsi sman gyi rtsi bas rak+ta'i zor//dam rdzas rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la//sangs rgyas bstan pa gto po khyod kyis srungs//dkon mchog dbu 'phang gnyan po khyod kyis bstod//bla ma dam pa'i sku la mtho 'tsham zhing //sangs rgyas bstan bshig skye bo yongs la 'tshe//gtum po khyod kyi bka' las 'da' byed na//bdag la sdang bar byed pa'i dgra bo 'di//sod cig sod cig srog rtsa myur du ra//rgyob cig sregasashig tshos la zhal du gsol/kha raṃ khā hi las la mas ma chung //bcol ba'i 'phrin las myur du grub par mdzod//྅:thams cad mkhyen pa dge bon rgya mtshos mdzad/lhun grub chos sku spros dang bral ba'i dbyings//smra bsam brjod dang bral yang 'ja' tshon bzhin/khro dang bral yang shin tu khros pa lta'i//rten 'brel snang ba mgon po khyod la bstod//bde stong dbyer med nam mkha'i ngo bo la//zhal phyag bral yang zhal bzhi phyag bzhi'i sku/kha dog med kyang mdog nag srin po'i gzugs//rmi lam bzhin du snang ba khyod la bstod//he ru gaḥdapal lhan skyes rol pa ni//me long gzugs ba ji bzhin rol pa la 'di ni dpal ldan nag po chen po zhes//rang gi sems kyis ri mor byas pa nyid//sgyu ma mkhan gyis byasapa'i gshin rje'i gzugs/kha gdangs mche gtsigs sna tshogs mtshon cha can//ji bzhin rang ngos med kyang khro bo'i gzugs//snang ngor mtshon maX1 bgegs 'joms8bcud la bstod//rang bawo

rgyal dbang lnga pa pag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)med kyang rgyal ba thams cad kyi/ /bstan pa bsrung mdzad khro bo'i gar ston pa/ /bden zhen med kyang gzugs brnyan skyes bu yis/ /brag ca'i dbyangs kyis bstod bzhin khyod la bstod/ /sgyu ma'i rnam rol las byung sring mo bzhi/ /med bzhin snang bas byis pa skrag byed bzhin/ /bden zhen spros bral chos sku'i snang brnyan gyis/ /bstan pa srung mdzad yum chen bzhi la bstod/ /sgyu ma'i dmag tsho gos yan lag bzhi pa'i tshogs/ /med bzhin sa gzhi gang ba snang ba ltar/ /rang bzhin stong ba'i mkha' la sprin tshogs bzhin/ /snang ba'i dam can 'khor tshogs rnams la bstod/ /'di na mchod dang mchod yul mchod pa'i rdzas/ /ngo bos grub pa rdul tsam ma ma mis kyang / /rmi lam yul la rmi lam skyes bu yis/ /rol pas tshigapar snang bzhin khyod kyis bzhes/ /'di ni mig 'phrul las byung seng ge yis/ /sgyu ma'i glang po srog dang phral ba bzhin/ /bsad bya bral yang bstan la sdang ba'i dgra /rang bzhin stong pa'i dbyings su khyod kyis sgrol/ /me long nang gi sgeg mo'i gzugs brnyan gyis/ /chags ldan byis pa'i snying la dga' bskyed bzhin/ /bden dngos bral yang mchog dang mthun mong gi /dngos grub char chen phab pas bdag tshim mdzod/ /las mkhan mon bu lcam bral gyi bstod pa ni/ ྅: tshar ོ gyis mdzad/ rab 'ji nag po gnod sbyin ni/ /za 'og gos gyon mi lpags 'phyang/ /gri gug 'phyar zhing sbar ba gnangs/ /gser gyi rna cha g.yo la bstod/ /bh+yoḥ sha za nag mo gnod sbyin ni/ dar nag gos rgya ne (9na rdza gri gde pas/ /bstan dgra'i snying 'byin spar shad can/ /byu ru'i lan tshar 'phyang la bstod/ // pu tra mthing nag shang lang 'phyar/ /klad khrag dron mo hub kyis 'debs/ /mon tri nag po'i lhab lhub can/ /gsod byed gshin rje khyod la bstod/ /snri gtum chen bha dra mun pa'i mdog /dam shing thegs shing dgra snying za/ /stag slog men tri'i ga sha can/ /bdud po las byed khyod la bstod/ /bh+yoḥ bdud mo kha nas me 'bar ma/gcer mo spu gyis dgra snying 'don/ /rgyu rlon 'brad cing ral pa 'phyang / /srin mo nag mo khyod la bstod//ཿ g.yas kyi ru 'dren skyes pa brgya/ khro zhing rngam pa'i stag chas can/ /g.yon gyi ru 'dren dgra bcom brgya/ /gseg shang 'khrol zhing dgra la rngam/ /rgyab kyi ru 'dren sngags nag brgya/ phur bu bsgril zhing —66

dpal mgon po che chung las mkhan rnams kyi bstod bskul bshan pa rnam par rol pa/ 9)ban dmar thogs/ /mdun gyi ru 'dren bud med brgya/ /sbar mo gdengs shing 'o dod 'bod/ /re relayagrangs med 'khor gyis bskor/ khyug cing 'dral bas stong gsum khengs/ /mi sdugang ro 'brug ltar sgrog /ru 'dren dregs pa'i tsho gis la bstod/ /lhaḥ g.yin yang stobs chen khyod kyi bran/ /sku gsung thugs kyi mon pa gsum/ / dgra la thun 'debs mon pa bdun/ /yang sprul mon pa bye ba brgya/ khrag 'thung dam can rgya mtshor bcas/ /lha srin dregs pa'i dmag tsho gos la/ /bstod dang gtor ma 'di 'bul gyis/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /sngo 'a r+pā gyi lhas rdzong spun bag lag sto shā go du mdzad pa/ dam can gnod sbyin yab yum dgongs su gsol/ /bka' sdod pu tra ming sring da tshur gsen/ /ru 'dren dregs pa'i dpung (9ba'i cas dmag la 'chos/ /mon nag srog bdud gzhin rje dgra la bh+yo/ sngon tshe lho phyogs bas mtha'i ri sul du/ /bden tshig grub pa'i bram zer gyur pa'i tshe/ /skye 'gro'i srog bdud byed par ma byas sam/ /de tshe bden tshig grub pa da ston cig /dkyil 'khor gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bkas/ /sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bskur te/ /srog gi snying po phul nas zhid brgya yi/ /bshan par zhal gyis bzhes pa bsnyel lam ci/ /klu sgrub snying po pad+ma badz+ra dang / dharma pā la'i spyan sngar dam bcas pa/ /rgyal ba'i bstan dang bstan 'dzin rnal 'byor rnams/ /bsrung zhing skyong par kha yis ma blangs sam/ /byang phyogs dpal ldan sa skya'i gtsug lag tu/ /'jam dbyangs rnam 'phrul rje btsun sa skya pa/ /brgyud par bcas pas nyin mtshan dus kun tu/ khyod nyid bsten cing bsgrubs pa'i dgosapa ci/ khyad par drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma yis/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi bran du khyod bskos nas/ /dam tshig rdo rje spyi bor ma bzhag gam/ /mi zad rdo rje'i bdud rtsi ma byin nam/ /sngon gyi dam tshig khas blangs ji bzhin du/ /ma g.yel ma g.yel mon bu pho mo'i tshogs/ sha za khrag 'thung mi zad bla rkun can/ /ma thogs rings pa'i tshul gyis las la 'chos/ /dmar wo gtor ma wo pos khyod bsgrubs na/ /bos pa'i tshe na dam can snying ma ring / /sman raka rgya mtshor bcas nas khyod bsgrubs na/ /bskul ba'i dus su las mgon bang ma bul/ /dka' ba khyad du bsad nas khyod bsgrubs na/ /rbad pa'i dus su stobs—67

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)chen rtsal ma zhan/ /lus srog thed la bor nas khyod bsgrubs na/ /mngags pa'i tshe na srog gshed kham (10na to/chung / /stobs chen khyod la las su gtad pa ni/ /sangs rgyas bstan bshig bla ma'i sku la sdo/ /skyes 'gro yongs kyi bde ba 'joms byed cing / /srung ma khyod la do bsdos khyad du sad/ /rnal 'byor bdag la lha med zer zhing brnyas/ /dam nyams dgra bgegs mi nor 'khor bcas rnams/ /stong gsum 'jig rten gang na gnas kyang rung / /skad cig nyid la mngon sum 'dir khug cig /'jigs pa'i mun chen nag pos mdun nas bsus/ /las kyi lung dmar 'tshub mas rgyab nas phul/ /gnam gyi 'ju thag dkar po steng nas chod/ /sa yi rten phur nag po 'og nas phyung/ /dam nyams snying khrag dmar po thang la pho/ /don snying nang khrol dron mo to kyis thob/ /klod khrag sha rus dmar po chem chem zo/ /mi nor rdzas gsum thal ba'i rdul du rlog /rnal 'byor bdag tsam skyong ba'i rtsal med na/ /snyiṭa dusargyal ba'i bstan pa ji ltar bsrung / /bstan la gnod byed byung tshe mi sgrol na/ /zhing bcu'i gshed mar khas blangs ngo re gnong / /de bas dam rdzas mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /bdag gis ji ltar bcol ba'i 'phrin las rnams/ /ma g.yel da lta nyid du bsgrubs nas kyang / /byang chub bar du bsrung skyob stong gro ṭa mdzod/ /las mkhan bshan pa lcam dral gyi bstod pa ni/ /kye: thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nam rgya mtshos mdzad/chos dbyings bde ba chen po'i ye shes kyi/ /rnam mang rol pa las byung gzhal yas nas/ /ma rungasagadug pa 'dul phyir khros pa'i skur/ /ston mdzad dpal ldan mgon po khyod la bstod/ khru gsum rba klong khrag zhag zhabrug pa'i dbus/ /(10bang ba mtho mchong dmar brag ri 'jiṭa pa'i steng / / pad nyi rta ro mi ro'i gdan khri la/ /'gying mkhas dbang gi skyes bu khyod la bstod/ /brgya phrag nyi ma'i 'od zer dang 'grogs pa'i/ khyu ru'i lhun po lta bur brjid pa'i sku/ khrag tu khros pa'i gzi 'bar mche ba gcigs/ /gtum chen srog gi bdag po khyod la bstod/ /rab 'bar dpa' gtum bskal ba'i me dpung bzhin/ /glog stong 'byug 'dra'i sma ra smin ma bskyod/ /nyi ltar rab 'khyil spyan gyis dgra dpung gzir/ kham ser dbu skra ltag par bcings la bstod/ /phyag g.yas 'bar ba'i zangs gri mkha' la 'phyar/ /g.yon pa —68

dpal mgon po che wo las mkhan rnams kyi bstod bskul bshan pa rnam par rol pa/ rtogeru dra'i glo snying mda' gzhu 'dzin/ /bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i ru mtshon ni/ /ba dan dmar po srid rtser sgreng la bstod/ /'jigs rung mi mgo lnga yis dbu la brgyan/ khrag 'dzag mgo rlon brgya phyed phreng ba 'phyang / /mo lce ltar dmar brtse khrab dmar po dang / /dar dmar lhab lhub cod paṇa mdzes la bstod/ /brkyang bskum gar gyis 'dzin ma'i khyen kun g.yo/ /'jig dus bskal ba'i me ltar mi bzad pa'i/ /ye shes me dbung 'bar ba'i klong bzhugs pa'i/ /dpal ldan mgon po khyod la bdag bstod do/ /bh+yoḥrig pa'i lha mo gar gyi dbang phyug ma/ /char sprin ltar gnag nyams pa'i srog la rngam/ /rab 'jigasadabang gi mdangs 'dzin bse gdong can/ /srog bdud ma mo chen mo khyod la bstod/ /gdug pa'i khrag gis myos pa'i sring mo ni/ /in+d+ra ni la'i ri dbang lhun po'i rtser/ /dus kyis me dpung 'bar 'dra'i zhal gdangs shing / /zla tshes ltar dkar mche ba gtsigs la bstod/ /dmar zlum spyan bgrad khamasaser ral pa ni/ /mchong (11na bong mu men byu ru'i lan tshar 'phyang / /rab mdzes gser gyi rna cha rgyan du byas/ /nam mkha'i gos can ma la bdag bstod do/ /'bar ba'i zangs gri g.yas pas mkha' ldo'aphyar/ /bdud sdon ga po'i tsho gos rnams rtsad nas gcod/ /g.yon pa gnam lcags 'bar ba'i phur bu yis/ /dgra snying tshal bar 'gems mdzad khyod la bstod/ /srog la rngam pa'i dred mo mi zan chibs/ /stong gsum cig car myul zhing bstan pa bsrung / /thogs med las bzhi'i 'phrin las bsgrubs mdzad ma/ /dpal ldan lha mo khyod la bdag bstod do/ /lcam sring gnyis kyi las mkhan ma cu bo che/ /srog bdag dus kyi me dpung dang mtshudas pa/ /'od 'bar brtse zhwa brtse khrab rgyan spras pa'i/ khrag mdog lasakyi bshan pa khyod la bstod/ khros pa'i kha gdangs 'o dod dgra la 'bod/ /g.yas pa'i mdung dmar rnon pos dgra snying 'bigs/ /g.yon pa btsan zhags dmar po dgra la 'debs/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i gshed ma khyod la bstod/ /srog 'phrog ce spyang smyon pa'i gdan la rol/ /nyin mtshan kun tu bka' yi bya ra byed/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod bgegs tshar gcod pa'i/ /las mkhan srog gi bdag po khyod la bstod/ /gtso 'khor gsum gyi bka' sdod mthu bo che/ /dag bo'i srog len bshan pa gri thogs brgyad/ / 69

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)ro bshan gas po nyi shu rtsa gcig rnams/ /mdog dmar me 'thor 'dra ba kun tu rgyug /grog 'phrog zangs gri dmar po lhag lhag 'phyar/ khrag 'dzag pags pa rlom pa gos su gyon/ /g.yin yang btsan dmar stong sde'i dmag tsho gos dang / /bdud dang srin po ma mo the'u rang sogs/ /sdebargyad dpung tshogasadam can rgya (11bsgo tshore bcas/ /dbang drag phrin las ma lus bsgrub mdzad pa'i/ /'khor dang bcas pa rnams la bdag bstod kyi/ /bcol ba'i phrin las lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ khrag tu bskul ba ni/ /kye gnam lcags thog dmar dang khrag gi mda' 'phen ma gnyis las btus nas thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtshos rgyal nasags dgrar rtags mas mdzo sum du lhan pa/ chos skyong zangs kyi beg tse can/ /sgrub pa po yi grogs mdzod cig /ma hā de wa'i bka' nyen la/ /gshin rje gshed po'i las mdzod cig /gdong dmar mo yis sna drongs la/ /dam nyams srog rtsa myur du chod/ /gnod sbyin zangs kyi beg tse can/ /me 'od 'bar ba'i glog 'phreng can/
