/g.yas pas zangs gri klad la 'phyar/ /g.yon pa glo snying zla zhing rgyug /dgra bgegs sgrol zhig ma ru tse/ /dam nyams sgrol zhig ma ru tse/ khrog rtsa chod cig ma ru tse/ /dus la bab bo ma ru tse/ /rig pa'i lha mo gdong dmar ma/ /gshin rje gshed kyi bka' nyan ma/ /e /dzā shrī'i gsung bstod ma/ /bse yi skyes bu'i sna 'dren ma/ /lha min 'bum gyi g.yul bzlog ma/ ma mo 'bum gyi dbang mo che/ /rgyan cha ma mo mthu mo che/ /gsang ba'i ma mo yal gam can/ /cho 'phrul yongs kyi sna 'dren ma/ /sdang ba'i dgra la cho 'phrul thong / /nga yi nor gyi rjes la rgyug /srog bdag dmar po rting la rgyug /nga dang 'grasapa'i dgra bo la/ /cho 'phrul sna dgu thong la shog /las mkhan srog bdag dmar po ni/ /'od 'bar bse khrab bse rmog gyon/ /chibs su ce sbyang spyon pa chibs/ /ru mar dmar po dgra la phyor/ /btso 'khu dmar pos dam nyams chings/ /dgra bgegs bla tshe khug la shog /gnod sbyin dbang po'i bka' nyan pa/ /sgrol byed gri thogs brgyad po dang / /ro bshan nyi shu rtsa r+sāg ni/ /dmas dgra la rbad pa'i tshe/ /zangs kyi gri brdar lam se lam/ /ral pa sprugs pas sig se sig /pha la rgyu ma lag sdogos byed/ /la la glo snying mchin pa 'brad/ /la la sha khrag spar gyis 'debs/ /la la rus pa rkang mar 'cha' la —70

dpal mgon po che chung las mkha rnams kyi bstod bskul bshan pa rnam par rol pa/ 9)la snying khrag klad pa bldag/la la nang khrol rgyu ma 'dren//la la pags pa dmar bshus byed//la la sha gdan dmar po 'ding //dgra bgegs sgrol zhig bshan pa'i tshogs//dam nyams sgrol zhig bshan pa'i tshogs//dus la bab po bshan pa'i tshogs//gzhan yang khyod kyi bka' 'khor na//btsan dmar stong ni rta rgyugs byed//ru mtshon dmar po nar ra ra/khyug cig sdang ba'i dgra la rgyug/phyor zhig ru mtshon dgra la phyor//bdud dmag gnod sbyin srin mo stong //rol mo gar 'chams bun nu nu//'chosashig snang ba'i dgra la 'chos//the'u rang stong ni than sna 'dren/khrin bya lug pa bzhad gad byed//sbyang gi wa brgyal dings rtse ding /khong zhig dgra yul than gyis khong //than sna sna tsho gos dgra la thong //ma mo 'bum ni r+sār mor rgyug/gos deb g.yab rdul thul lu lu//gad brgyangs shon skor sgo ro ro//dalayams nad rkyal lag na thogs//nad yams dal yams dgra la thong //mtshon gyi dru gu na ra ra//khyong zhig dam nyams dgra la khyong //gzhan yang dam can rgya mtsho rnams//dgra la cho 'phrul sna tshogasathong //lha khang mdze po ban+de dang //dmag dang chu bo byu po dang //bud med dmar mo gcer mo dang /mi dmar liṅga bsgreng ba sogs//'jigs pa'i cho 'phrul sna tsho gis thong //dam nyams lasang na sdig can 'di//lo 12bzlar bzhag pa'i skabs med pas//zhag dang za ma tsam la zo//dmar po dbon g.yas dus la bab/ /phung byed chen po dus la bab/ /dgra bo'i yul khams stobs bar gyis/ /bcol ba'i phrin las myur du sgrubs/smras pa/gsal stong mkha' dbyings dngas pa la//ting 'dzin glog phreng rnam par 'khyug/bstod bskul drag sngags tsā ga sgra ldir//dngos grub bdud rtsi'i char chen 'bebs//de 'dra'i gnad kyi zhabrul 'khor gyis//zhi rgyas dbang drag las 'grub cing //zung 'jug sgyu ma'i gar mkhan du//lhun grub tshul de ngo mtshar med//e ma de 'dra'i gnad shes pa//tshar 0 chos rje'i brgyud 'dzin las/ /rmongs pa nor gyis cher dregs pa'i/ /'ur brgyangs can tsho'i spyod yul min//deng dus rtog ge tha snyad mkhan//tshig gi mche gcigs ce spyang dang / /mthon po'i khrir 'gying blun po yis//bong bugazig pags gyon pas khengs//'on kyang sngon gyi las lo yis//brgyud

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)ldan dam pa'i snyan brgyud thob/ /zab gnad mtha' dag khong du chud/ /de phyir gzhan la smon ma dgos/ /tshul 'di cung zad bkod pa'i dges/ tshe rabs kun tu mgon po yis/ /rjes su bzung ste kha'u pa'i/ /slob bshad bdud rtsir rol bar shog /thub bstan ji srid gnas kyi bar/ /gsang chen slob bshad mi nyams shing / /skal bzang skye bo'i tshogs rnams la/ /ngo mtshar ltad mos tshim gyur cig /de ltar dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po dang / /dpal mgon stobs 'phrog dbang po las mkhan dang bcas pa'i gtor chog /bskang bshags/ bstod bskul le tshan 'di rnams/ /deng sang gi sa skya tshang gi rna bar ma grags pa'i gsang chen slob bshad (13na sgo'i khyad chos/ phrin las myur mgyogs kyi pho nya dang lhan thabs dngos grub rol mtsho/ bka' sdod kyi bskang gso phrin las myur 'grub/ beg tse lcam dral gyi bskang gso phrin las lhun grub sogs rgyas bsdus du ma 'dug pa sogs dgongs don ma 'phyugs shing / spyan 'dren bskang bstod sogs kyi tshig khungs ldan kyi bla ma mang pos mdzad pa nas kha bskang ba yin la/ 'phrin las myur mgyogs kyi pho nya/ lhan thabs sogs snyan brgyud po ting bzhugs pa dang / /bka' rgya dam pa'i stabs kyis dngos bstan mang por ston pa skabs su ma babs pas/ kho bos 'dir 'don cha rnams logs su bkol ba yin la/ phyag rgya dmigs pa phyag len sogs zhib cha mtha' dag yig cha de nyid las shes dgos yod cing rang bzo mi bya/ kho bos bsgrigs pa'i le tshan gsum po 'di yang dpe cha sor gnas las snon 'phri dang bsres nas nag po 'gro shes su 'dri ba dang dpe gog gzhan gyi rgyas 'gebs/ lugs srol gzhan gyi dpe byed pa sogs gtan mi byed par ma 'phyugs pa dgos shing blo ldan mtha' dag gis rtog pa zhib par gyis shig /lugs srol 'di dag gi phyogs su rnam dbye dang gus pa cung zad tsam yang med par sgo nga dang sgong lkogs ltar rang mgon por mkhas grub kyi snyan pa 'dod pas dam pa'i skyes bur grags pa'i blun po nyam pa can mang pos gzhan gyi man ngag rang gi lugs su sgro btags te rmongs pa'i tshogs rnams mgo bo mgal me ltar bskor phyir byung rgyal du bdag gir bzung nas spyod pa byung na bka' srung dam can pu tra dang bshan pa dmar —72

po gnyis kyis snying khrag shub kyis 'thung zhig/gtor 13na skyong dang gtor chen ngag 'don mi 'dra ba rnams lugs srol 'di ga'i yig cha khungs ma las blangs pas bde blag tu 'grub par 'gyur ro//zhes gur gyi mgon po gdong bzhi pa las mkhan dang bcas pa'i bstod bskul bshan pa rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba 'di yang tshar pa rdo rje 'chang gi gsang gsum gyi rnam thar la rgyu mtshan shes nas dad pa thob pa'i za hor gyi sngags ban ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos rang gi brjed byang dang phan bde legs bshad gling pa rnams kyi nyams len du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni ngag dbang dge legs so//sarba maṅga lo////

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)ra༅༅/ /dbyu gu drug cu rtsa bzhi'i gtor chog srid gsum rnam rgyal bzhugs so/ /na mo badz+ra gi rta ye/ /'jam dpal dpa' bo ma rungs bdud sde'i dpung / /'dul phyir drag po'i skur bstan gshin rje gshed/ /bka' sdod las kyi gshin rjer bcas pa yi/ /gtor ma la brten mngon spyod drag po'i las/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug rje btsun rwa lo yi/ /thugs la gab pa'i mtshon cha zab mo gang / /'khon ston chos rje'i phyag bzhes ji bzhin du/ /yi ger 'god la shes ldan rna ba nyon/ /'di la spyor dngos rjes gsum las/ sbyor ba la/ dus phyogs kyi khyad par dang / mchod gtor bsham tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ nyer dgu dang gnam gang / nyin phyed mtshan byed/ gza' skar gdug pa can dang / sgra gcan dang bstun dgos te/ mar ngo'i bcu bzhi 'am bco lnga yi/ /dgra bo la ni mtshan phyed dam/ /bgegs la nyi ma phyed kyi dus/ /sreg tshes 'chi sbyor dag dang ldan/ /lha srin lto 'gro'i lta ba dang / /mthun pa'i phyogs su kha bltas te/ /las sbyor 'di dag brtsam par bya/ /zhesagasungs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'phung gsum gyi sa las byas pa'i stegs bu'i khar/ /dug khrag dang ro sol gyis byugs pa'i steng du/ /ro skra'i (2na)thig skud dang mi rus kyi rdul tshon sogs tshogs par byas nas dkyil 'khor bris te/ /ci 'tsham 'os pa'i sa stegs ni/ yi/ gsum pa la dug khrag dang / /ro sol gyis ni byugs pa'i steng / /chos 'byung rtse mo dgra'am lto/ /yang na lha min gdong phyoṭa bstan/ /phyi rol rdo ra me ri ni/ /chos yang dbyibs ba de nang du/ /gdung zlum pa dang gdung bzhi yis/ /mig mangs ris su ling tshe dgu /gdung rnams nag po ling tshe rnams/ /phyogs mdog chos 'byung nag po rno/ /rdo ra me ri sna tshogs so/ /ling tshe dgur ni tshom bu dgu /dbus kyi mdun rgyab gnyis su re/ /—74

dbyu gu drug sto rtsa bsnya gtor chog srid gsum rnam rgyal/ 9)phyogs skyong mdog dang mthun par dgod/ ces gsungs so/ /drug cu pa rtsi tshul ni/ lcags slang sogs kyi nang du ni/ /zan la thig gis bgos pa yi/ /drug cu rtsa bzhi bgod par bya/ /phyi ni lcagasamakhar zur dgu pa/ /nang du gshin rje'i dong gsum mo/ /bzhi'am chos yang rtse mo lho/ /dong gsum rtse mo rang la bstan/ /drug sto rtsa bzhi rtsig tshul ni/ /phyi yi zur dgu nyis brtsegs dang / /bang rim dgu la bzhi brtsegs dang / /kun gyi dbus mar bdun brtsegs so/ /gsum ni dong gi kha gcod do/ /dong gsum (2bstong du dgra bgegs kyi/ /ling ga mi rus mgo mjug log /gtor ma'i phyogs mtshams brgyad dang ni/ /dbus kyi rgyab dang mdun rnams su/ /'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa ni/ /phyogs skyong kha dog dang mthun pa/ /dbus su 'jigs byed zhal dgu'am/ /yang na dpa' gcig sngon po rnams/ /dar gyi sham bus brgyan pa 'dzugs/ /chos 'byung rtse mor las gshin gyi/ /gtor ma zur gsum sha khrag dang / /dar nag gis ni brgyan pa bzhag /ces gsungs pa'i phyag len ltar bshams/ /mdun du khrag sna'i mchod pa dang zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar/ /mdun du khrag gi a:/ dbang po'i me tog /gsur chen gyi dud pa/ zhun chen gyi mar me/ sha rus kyi zhal zas/ nang mchod gtso bor dang las gshin gyi mchod gtor liṅga dang bcas pa bsham mo/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ nang mchod/mchod pa/ gtor ma byin rlabs pa/ sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis byin rlabs rnams bya/ su bhā wasasbyangs stong pa'i ngang las/ mdun du srung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su/ gnam lcags la grub pa'i lcags mkhar nag po zur dgu pa 'jigs su rung ba'i lte bar zlo las gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi ba/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la sno las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal rdo rje'i 'jigs byed chen po zhes pa nas bzung ste/ slong dkyil na bzhugs pa/ de'i mdun du pad+ma dang nyi ma zhes sogs las gshin yab yum gyi mngon rtogs bskyed/ oṃ hrīḥnyi wi skru tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ hūṃ sarba du gi na zhes pa nas/ 'byung po'i tshogs dang bcas pa lhags par gyur/ dzaḥ 'jam (3na bo pa la rang bzhin chos—75

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)rnams kun gyi dngos//zhes pa nas/'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs shing bzhugs su gsol//dza 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed kyi bka' sdod mchoge zhes pa nas/gnyis su med par gyur/rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer zhes pa nas/yongs su gyur pa las/gtso bo la mi bskyod pa dang /lasakyi gshin rje la rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ma sngon zhes pa nas/sam ya sku/rgyasapar spro na/rgyal ba rnams ni gtsang gyur cing dang /stong gsum khyon ltar yangs pa sogs byed/bsdun sngags mchod 'bul/nang mchod bla ma brgyud pa'i mtshan nas brjod pa'am/bsdun sngags kyisa'abul/gtor ma 'bul ba ni/gtso bo la yum dang 'khor sngags dor/gzhan dngos gzhi dang mthun/las gshin gyi gtor ma 'bul/gnyis med thun mong ma dang /'jam dpal bka' wa mas bstod/phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas pa zhes pa nas/rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/bla ma mchog dang dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang /zhes sogs kyi bshags pa dang /bde chen lhun grub ma'i bskang gso/gtso bo dang las gshin gyi bzlas pa ci rigs pa byas rjes/gtor ma sngar bzhin 'bul/gzhi bdag gtor ma btang /'jam dpal gser mdog ma dang /las gshin gyi bstod pa gang 'os bya/'chi bdag ma'am/bcom ldan gshin rje gshed kyi bka'/zhes sogs bskul gang rigs kyi rjes su gser skyems btang /liṅga dgug gzhug bya/sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/zhes pa nas/kā larū pa dgra bgegs mā ra ya hūṃ phags/ces cha dgur gtubs la cha gcig gtor ma 3ba lo brgyad drug cu pa ltar bshams/gtso bo dang las gshin la gtor ma ltar 'bul/phyogs skyong la bhu tsa ra brgyad tshan brgyad du bsngos rjes bzlog pa bya'o//gsum pa mjug gi cho ga ni/gtor ma byin rlabasadang sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis byin gyis brlabs/gtso bo dang las gshin la 'bul ba dang /drug sto rtsa bzhi bsngo ba sngar ltar bya/de nas/rnal lor dbang phyug zor 'phen no//so gos kyi sgo dbye dang /rgyal ba spyi bskul 'di bka' brgyad khro rol gyi tshig yin pas gsar ma la ha cang 'brel mi chags kyang ding sang mdzad srol 'dug pa dang /skad la/da che ba sogs nas byas kyang 'gal ba med/de

dbyu gu drug sto rtsa ba ni le gtor chog srid gsum rnam rgyal/ (gerjes gom pa zhe dgu'i sar khyer te/ gser skyems dang bzlog bskul skabs thob sbyar nas gtor zor 'phen/ nang du log ste srung 'khor dang mnga' gsol/ gtang rag shis brjod dkyil 'khor bsdu ba sogs las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o/ /las gshin kho na la brten na phyogs skyong rnams 'od gsal du 'jug pa mi rigs pas/ phyogs skyong rang gi tsakli 'dzugs dgos la de yang rtsa ba rnams ser gyis gsal bar byas shing / bsdus pa las gshin kho na la brten par 'dod na/ rgya tshos kyis phye ba rnamasador bas 'grub bo/ /gang zhig thub bstan dbyar gyi pad+mo'i tshal/ /zhing bcu'i dgra bgegs glang pos nyer 'joms tshe/ /mngon spyod drag pos 'dul ba'i mtshon cha 'di/ /rje bas rwa lo'i thugs bcud ches zab kyang / /tshul 'di ji bzhin 'dzin pa'i rig sngags 'chang / /u dum wa ra lta bur ches dkon pas/ /bstan dang 'gro la phan pa'i bsam pa yis/ /bklags chog 'khyer bde'i tshul du gsal bar bkod/ /dge tshogs wo mor byed pa'i 'od zer gyis/ /mi mthun mun pa'i (4na'i ga rum drungs phyung nas/ /phan bde'i 'dab brgya bzhad pa'i rnam dpyod kyis/ /rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i dga' ston rgod par shog /ces rje btsun rwa lo'i thugs kyi zab gnad/ dbyu gu drug cu rtsa bzhi la brten pa'i gtor chen gyi rim pa khrigs su bsdebs pa srid gsum rnam rgyal zhes pa 'di yang pho brang gung ri dkar po'i sku gnyer dpon dge steng bla ma byams pa kun dga' 'byung gnas kyis bskul ba dang /rang gi brjed byang du chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa chen po'i ring lugs 'dzin pa za hor gyi btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos rwa lugs kyi yig cha dang bla ma'i man ngag la brten nas sbyar ba'i yi ge ba ni ngag dbang dge legs so/ /sarba maṅga le// //—77

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)ra༅༅/ /thogs med drag rtsal nus stobs ldan pa'i dam can chos srung rgya mtsho'i mngon rtogs mchod 'bul bskang bshags bstod tshogs sogs 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub ces bya ba bzhugs/na ma sma ra su sti/ 'gyur mtha' dag gzugs mā/ med chos dbyings gser ldan yangs pa'i dbus/ /gsang gsum mi zad yon tan lhun po'i spor/ /'jigs rung lha dbang dpung tsho gos phral gyi sgos/ /dgra bgegs sngon gyi lha rnams 'joms la bstod/ /rab yan lag snyag pa'i gzugs ga dang dpe rgyan semasamed rab rtog le'u gsum pa'i thog ma'i zung ldan bar chod pa rkang pa bzhi pa la bod pa rnams 'dres pa'i rab spel/ dmar khrag gi na kra'i grong khyer las/ /rab 'jigs 'bab ldan 'khrigs shing cher zhabrugs pa/ /rab mtho srid rtser 'phyur lta'i sgra chen pos/ /rab rmongs bdud sde gdung ba'i ca co sgrog /sra phul byung rag rtog brtan 'od srung yin yang g.yo byed pa'i/ khugs drag rdul gyi rgyal mtshan 'tshub ma yis/ /sa 'dzin dbang po 'jig na mi rung zhes/ /bcu gnyis khyim gyi zhags pas ring du bcings/ /mdog dpe rgyan dang dam pa'i sa 'dres pa/ lnga'i bgrod pa'i shugs kyang dub byed cing / khyu dge la 'gran theg pa'i dbang po la/ /'bod grogs rus pa'i gzeb dang ka ne'i sgas/ /legs sbud mi thod srab skyogs rnam par 'phyang / /ga rtang lon gyi chos dang 'dres༅ lo byung gi dpa/ /ni la'i rdul brtsegs lhun po ni/ /stang:la lan brgyar byug la snang gter gyi/ /tsha (2na thar gos kyi klubs na khyod kyi sku'i/ /cha shas tsam la 'gran pa'i dpe ru bstan/ /gtum drag rab brngam 'das pa 'gog pa/ g.yar ngo bstan tsam gyis/ /srid gsum dregs ldan —78

dam ༅ chos srung mngon rtogs phren las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ (getsit+ta bkas gyur na//rā ma ṇa yis nor sbyin gcung po dag/lnga pa'i lam du btang smra brdzun pa'i gtam//dmar sgo med ra shog gi ra tso/ser gtsug phud 'khyil ba'i gzi 'od kyi//tsha gdung 'jigs pas 'phur byed tshogs rnams kun//bsrung phyir chu shel dbang po'i dkyil 'khor gyis//mngon par rgyan gyi zol la brten par nges/ /zhal yak+ṣa ṭa ༅ gyi khyad par phul byung / khyim 'bras ldan dus kyi kun gsal dbus//snang byed rta bdun dkyil 'khor mngon gsal bas//ji snyed shes bya'i 'dab stong ba 'ad pa las//lkog gyur thun gsum ma de gang du bros//'dren byed le'u gsum pa'i slu byed kyi gang 'gram dkyus rab gsal bzhin snod ngos//thun mtshams sgeg mo 'byug pa'i gzugs kyi 'phrul//'gag med rtag tu shar ba'i lcags kyu yis//bi shwa ga me'i yid kyi khengs pa phyogs//mi sdug zhal gyi le'u dang po'i don gsal gyi ༅ shar sa gon pa la grags pa/'dzi na dkar po las//dam nyams khrag gi yan lag brgyad ldan chab/khugs drag ches cher babs pa'i dbu phreng 2bkas//so skyong gos ser bgrod byed rnam par brlan//rab ldan pa'i gzugs/gtsigs mche ba'i chu 'dzin 'khrigs pa'i dbus//gsung gi nga ro dbyar gyi rnga gsangs dang //ro 'dzin mjug brgya rab 'byug rig sngags kyi/ /rdo rje'i zegs mas log 'dren brag ri 'joms/ /dzam bu sems ldan rab rtog na da las ba rna rgyan steng / /gtsug phud lnga pa 'khyil ba'i rnam 'gyur gyis//sa gsum dregs ldan gnyis 'thung dbang po'i tshogs//'jigs te lnga pa'i gong du bros kyis dogs//g.yon phyogs sgos ldan ra tshog thos 'dzin dbang po mdzes byed pa'i//rlung gi zas can smra ba'i 'bab stegs las/ /mi bzad ha la'i zhags pas bcings dogs nas/ /sbyin skyes stobs ldan sa 'og skyabs su bsten//cod pan rab dkar thod skam lnga yi phreng sa byung gi nyas//mi sdug aṇ+ḍa'i srad bu la brgyus te//yid 'ong sna tshogs rin cen phreng ba yi//bkod legs 'dren byed dga' ston e ma mtshar/ /'byug sems ldan gyi rab rtog sgra mngal 'dzin lus 'dogs las grub pa'i//rnam bkrang ga gi ma zhi cha'i rdzing ring rgyan//nor bu'i tog gis mas par rgyu snar tshogs//blta phyir lha yi lam las 'ongs pa 'dra/ /gnam /jigs rung gi nyams/ lcags rdo rje 'bar ba'i 'chang

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)gzung can/ /bdud dpung phye mar 'thag pa'i dbyig pa ni/ /'dzin byed g.yas pa mkha' la 'phyar tsam gyis/ /sa gsum ma lus cig car 'dar bar nges/ /log mi sa pa'i kho dang ldan pa'i rab rtog 'dren mgo bo bres pa'i ka pā la/ /dmar nag khrag gis rab gang phyag g.yon gyis/ /zhal du btab pas gaṅgā ma gnyis la/ /yan lag mchog dang mi ldan gtam gyi rdzu/ /graṭa pa phul byung / rnam mang gdul bya'i blo yi me long ngos/ /sna tshogs(3na rdzal bsgyur ston pa'i gzugs sku'i khyon/ /tshad mas gzhal nus min 'di zhing sgrags kyis/ /tshad ldan stod kyi gos su rung ba mtshar/ /gang sgor ga kyi khos/ gi byams brtse'i bcu gnyis bdag po yis/ /lus can sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan skyong bstan yang / /rak+tas sngaṭa pa'i bam chen mgo rlon gyi/ /mkha' dbang grangs ldan 'phreng 'di bzhad gad rgyu/ /zur gyi phra mo/ gsus khyim 'jigs bral rab mtho'i ba gam la/ /legs bris dpung tsho gis rnam bzhi'i gnas bcas nas/ /bcud bral ming gi lhag mar btang ba'i tshul/ /gsal bar ston phyir nam mkha'i nor bus brgyan/ /phyi nang rdzas kyi rang bsto brjod pa/ gsal 'grib med pa'i ye shes skur/ /rab bkra stag lpags dar nag lhab lhub dang / /'byog 'gro zung gi gser ga bdun pa yis/ /mngon par brgyan pa'i byed po su zhig yin/khram cha shas gzugs༅/ shing sho rde mtshon gyi dru gu sogs/ /'jigs rung sha kra'i dpal mgrin snang byed mes/ /dgra bgegs chu srin rgyal mtshan can gyi lus/ /lhag mar bsreg pa'i phul byung stobs ni med/ /rkyang ser rigs gnyis steng du zhabs pad zung / /skyil krung phyed pa'i tshul gyis mkha' dbyingasal/ /mngon par 'phags pa'i shugs drag gar nyams kyis/ /rgya chen srid gsum tshad kyis 'jal ba bzhin/ khyod ma 'gyur 'gog pa/ sku rab dngas lha yi lam yangs par/ /mtshan dpe'i gzi byin dbang gzhus legs spras na/ /rin cen rus pa brang 'gro'i chu khur gyi/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyis spud la mtshar du ci/ /mig gis le'u dang po nas༅da pa'i lho phyogs pa'i rgya che phe yon to/ blta bar bzod dka'i drag mo'i skur/ /bstan pa tsam gyis stobs ldan dregs pa'i tshogs/ /snyems pa btang (3bkas khyod kyi bran bgyid na/ /stong gsum mi mjed bdag po gang du mchos/ /rab dkar sbyar phagazugs ga/ ri dwags—80

dam can chos srung ma' rtogs phren las rnam pha lhun grub/ (gergyan gyis sba ba'i lus//mdzes sdug cha shas rdzogs la sred bral zhing //mi sdug snang gter gzugs sku'i dkyil 'khor gyis//log 'dren sa mos tshal kun cig car zum//seng ge phul byung rab rtog mo'i bu'i stobs kyang zil gnon pa'i//mig sman 'bum sde'i mdangs can 'jigs gzugs la//skrag ste chos kun stong pa'i mkhar bros pas//ye shes me lce 'bar bas rjes su bsnyegs//thos snying rje skas/'dzin bdud rtsi'i lang tsho 'chi med dbyangs//snyan brjid yan lag drug cu'i phul byung gsung //'jigs rung nga ro drag pos bdud sde'i snying //dum bur gas kyang rna ba'i khung bu 'gebs//chos sags ga gyi sags ga/dbyings 'dam skyes rdzing bu'i ba gam dbus//gang thugs dpal khyim ze'u 'bru'i sgyu rtsal sprod//bde r+ṣa bung ba'i ri dwags mig can ma//yid gcugs groṭa su bkug ste rtse dgar rol//rab grags pa phul nga /mas dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus pa'i//gsang gsum las byung mkhyen brtse nus mthu'i tshogs//gcig bsdus gang gi yon tan phung po khur//theg pa'i gser ldan lus ni' ma sra//las bzhi'i 'phrin las bcug sa bsdus shing mas rtsal/gnyas bdag po yis//gang 'tsham legasabris lam gyi khyon yangs par//'ongs pas las ldan snang gsal rab rgyas shing //dgra bgegs 'byung po'i bya tsho gos phye mar mdzad//thub ā+o dang yi shar mas gol 'don gtso gyi ༅/ bstan zla ba'i ma ma'i bas kyi phul//rdo rje theg pa'i:la dngar kā la shar//'bu ba'i sems 'am pa bdud 4na dpung sbyin skyes rdzo//'joms mdzad mgrin sngon lhag pa'i lha der bstod//gtsug dngos sgo dgong 'dre4'a rabartog phud mgrin par co 'dri'i pad gdan la//mngon par pha pas 'byud lta'i ches bdag steng //sna tsho gos rgyan gyis sbud wa'i kai la shar//gar dgu'i rnam 'gyur ston pa yod dam snyam//yid la thimang li ca kyi dang gzugs༅ lo byung gi sngos gsum yod ra tshol/ dpyang thag 'dzin pa'i gang gi sku//zhal khyim dri bzang khang pa rgyas pa'i dbus//tshems kyi ze'u 'bru rab 'khrigs bung ba'i spyan//dkar dmar mdangs so gos ma 'dres yid du 'ong /dzi t+pal chor me/'dab ltar mar+sā 'jam phyag zung gis//'dab ldan mel tshe dar gyi phang phung ༅/ /bkod 8 1 nam gyi yol lha'i nang / /yid 'ong rin

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)chen 'phyur bur gtams pa 'dzin/ /mtshan le'u dang pho rab dngas kyi rgyan/ bzang lang tsho'i gzi ldan khyod kyi sku/ /'chi med rdzas kyi nang gsum lhab lhub dang / /rtse phran se mo do sogs rin cen phras/ /legasapar spras pa'i rgyan gyis rnam par mdzes/ /chags bral cho se kyi sprin bsas pa rgya che ༅gzugs༅/ gyi mkha' dbyings la/ /gang gi gsang gsum rta ljang ma rnga zhe rdzogs kyang / /'gro kun pad dkar la chags zhabs zung gi /'od stong skyil krung lus can 'dab brgya ba 'ad/ /rigs rdzas kyi rang za'i brjod pa/ gnyis sngon 'gro 'jigs rung mun pa'i mdog /'bod grogs zag phung na kra'i spyi bo can/ /mngon par 'gyingasapas dgra dpung gnam 'phyo'i tshogs/ /gsus khyim lnga pa'i grong du 'jug las gang / /'phrog sems ldan rab rtog byed gdong can dmar nag sha za'i gzugs/ /sra brtan nor 'dzin lho bar bgrod byed zung / /shugs drag stobs (4ba)kyis bsdabs pas sa gsum yang / /'jig snyam tshangs 'joms lus med tshul gyis gnas/ /dri bzhen 'byug pa'i bgrang bya'i cho 'phrul gyis/ /sa gsum 'gengs mdzad chu 'dzin stug po'i ngos/ /byed pos rlung gi rgyal mtshan byugs 'dra'i mdog /stobs 'gro'i steng du 'jiṭa rung gar gyis rol/ /rdo rje wodang yi mdzes pho yon to lngas stong sbyar ba/ zegs ma chu khrigs pho nya can/ /rnam 'gyur grangs med ston pa'i byu ru'i ri/ /ngo mtshar yid la 'god pa'i khyod kyi sku/ /chu glang gdan la mi sdug rnam 'gyur tshul/ /gar dpe rgyan dang grangs kyi gab tshig rab rtog gsum tshos pa'i rab spel/ dgu'i nyams ldan ri skyes sa 'dzin la/ /'khru ba'i khyod sku phyoṭa kyis rwa ldan steng / /mngon par 'phags pa'i gzi 'od ma bzod par/ /pad gnyen gling bzhi bskor ba'i rdol bsten/ /thun dpe ༅ dang 'jigs rung gi nyams 'dres pa/ gsum dus kyi mkha' glang sdug po'i dbus/ /sprin gyi lcug ma 'khyug lta'i gzugs kyi sku/ /mi sdug steng du gtum drag brngam tshul gyis/ /log 'dren dgra sde'i mgo bo cig car 'gems/ /sna cha shas gcig pa'i gzugs can/ tshogs las bzhi'i 'phrin las mel tshe'i ngos/ /brjod bral rnam 'gyur grangs med ston pa'i sku/ /mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul dpag dka' srid gsum la/ /dbang sgyur bka' sdod dam can tshogs la bstod/ /gang mi mnyam gzugs can gyi shis brjod/ gi thugs rje'i rgyu skar mu khyud kyis/ /mi —82

dam ༅ chos srung mngon rtog phren las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)mthun nyer 'tshe'i kun khebs stug po yi/ /dpung tsho gis ma lus 'joms pa'i sgyu 'phrul gyis/ /rab 'byams ni ba'i las kun grub par mdzod/ mi mtha' dag gzug ༅ gyi shis brjod/ zad gsang gsum zla ba'i ma ma las/ /legs 'ongs khyod thugs rta bdun dkyil 'khor gyis/ /lugs zung mthun rkyen 'od stong (ldan phrang rab yis/ /rab 'byams rgyas pa'i las kun grub par mdzod/ /grangs sa phegazugs༅ gyi shis brjod/ med mdzad pa'i yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal/ khugs drag gsol 'debs ka shi'i thabs mkhas gos/ /ji snyed srid gsum rgyal mtshan rtser bkod pa'i/ /rab mas dbang gi las kun grub par mdzod/ /da pa gagazug ༅ shis brjod/ dka' nus mthu'i phyugs bdag 'dab ldan can/ /rdzas sngags ting 'dzin gnam ru'i phrul 'khor gyis/ /dgra bgeṭa bcu da bral grong khyer mthar byed pa'i/ /rab 'byams mngon spyod las kun grub par mdzod/ khyad par le'u dang i don gsal gyi rgyan shar phyogs go ḍa pa las sa 'a shi brjod/ bdag yid mkha' lding rgyal mtshan can/ /'dod don sa man+ta ka nor bu'i mchog /las bzhi'i ta lha'i na chung thabs kyi rgyas/ /thogs med yid bzhin grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /dpal sdug mtha' dag gzugs༅ gyi shis brjod/ bstan pa yongs 'du sa brtol la/ /thun mong theg pa'i yal 'dab rab rgyas shing / /nges gsang bla med gang bus g.yur za ba'i/ /rigs 'dzin 'chi med dga' ston rgyas gyur cig /ces dpal ldan 'dod khams dbang phyug dmag zor rgyal mo la bstod pa nor bu dbang gi rgyal po'i do shal zhes bya ba 'di yang / rang nyid lhag pa'i lha mor mi byed dad pa'i shugs kyis mngon par bskul zhing / rab 'byams smra ba ngag dbang bsod nams rnam rgyal dang /rig byed pa blo bzang 'jam dpal sogs kyis mtshams sbyar ba la brten nas/ tshangs sras ba 'ad pa'i rdo rjes sa yos nam mthong sa zla ba'i dkar phyogs bzang po gnyis par kun mkhyen bu ram shing pa bltams pa'i dus chen gyi nyin 'chi med skyed tshal sal 'phos 'dra'i dga' ldan pho brang gi gzims chung mngon par dga' bar sbyar ba'o/ /(5ba)dngos grub rin cen bye ba'i gter gyur rtsa brgyud bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa'i tshogs rnams dang / /—83

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)chu srin rgyal mtshan sder bcas ming gi lhag mar rab mdzad rten dang brten pa'i 'khor lo che/ /log 'dren dgra sde'i snying la 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa ster mdzad khrag 'thung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor tshoṭi rnams la bu bzhin skyongs la 'phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med sgrubs/ /gang zhig 'di na dmod pa drag sngags dag gi dpung tshogs mngon gyur tshe/ /gzugs can dgra dang gzugs med bgegs kyi lha min sder bcas snying kha 'dar/ /rgyal ba'i bstan dang dkar phyogs skyong rnams rnam par rgyal ba'i rdza rnga che/ /phyogs bcur bsgrags pas sa 'og sa steng sa bla gsum yang 'gul snyam byed/ /'di na dam can rgya mtsho'i tsho gis rnams la/ /mchod bstod 'phrin las 'chol ba'i rim pa dag /klags chog 'byer bde'i tshul 'di bkod pa'i tshe/ /rab khros khrag 'thung tsho gos kyang 'dzum zhal ston/ /de la 'dir thun mong ma yin pa'i bka' srung rnam pa gnyis bka' sdod dang bcasapa ma gtogs pa'i dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams kyi gtor ma'i cho ga phyogs gcig tu 'byer bde bar brjod par bya'o/ /thog mar mchod gtor rnams byin gyis brlab pa ni/ 'jigs byed kyi bdag bskyed dang las byang gnam lcags 'khor lo gnyis nas bshad pa ltar rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar/de nas mdun bskyed ni/ oṃ su bhā wa shurnya sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shu d+dha ྅ gi/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan la r+ghaṃ las tshogis bdag gan rkyal du sgyel ba'i steng du hūṃ las gri gug hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po sku mdog mthing na g.yon po lta gcig phyag drug pa/ cher 'bar ba rab tu khros shing shin tu rngam pa/ zhal rnam par 'gyur zhing mche ba rnon po bzhi gtsigs pa/ /spyan gsum dmar zhing zlum pa glog ltar 'byug cing khro gnyer shin tu bsdus pa/ dbu skra kham ser rgyan du brdzes shing sma ra dang smin ma dus mtha'i me ltar rab tu 'bar ba/ ljags rnam par 'gril zhing ha ha'i gad brgyangs 'brug ltar sgrog pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po na gri gug /gnyis pa na thod pa'i 'phreng ba/gsum pa na thod pa'i ḍā ma ru drag tu 'brol ba/ phyag g.yon gyi dang po na thod khrag /gnyis pa na rtse —84

dam can chos srung mngon rtogs tshwan las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ (gegasum/ gsum pa na rdo rje zhags pa 'dzin pa/ sprul rigs lngas sku'i cha thams cad legs par brgyan cing / stag gi pags pa rlon pa'i sham thabs la dar ljang gu'i ska rags bcings pa/ lto ba rab tu 'phyang zhing yan lag rags pa/ bzod par dka' ba'i gzi brjid can/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbu la brgyan cing / khrag 'dzag pa'i mgo bo rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ dpral bar byu ras legasapar byugs shing / spyi bor mi bskyod pas rgyas btab pa/ phyag zhabs thams cad la dril bu g.yer kha'i sgra dang bcas pas rab tu brgyan cing / glang po che'i pags pa rlon pa gos su gyon pa/ zhabs g.yasabaskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i gar stabs kyis ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ mgon po'i g.yas su pad+ma dang nyi ma nor bdag /gan rkyal du sgyel ba'i gdan la hūṃ dkar po yongs su gyur pa las/ mgon dkar yid bzhin gyi nor bu zhal gcig phyag drug pa/ /spyan gsum khro 'dzum sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas gsum nor bu gri gug /cang tes g.yon gsum bum pa rtse gsum 4bskogs kyu bsnams pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' dang rin po che dang /dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan pa/ mkha' 'gro dang nor bdag gnod sbyin dpag tu med pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ mgon po'i g.yon du bh+yo las ma cig 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma phyag g.yas ral gri rab tu 'bar ba nam mkha' la 'phyar nyid / g.yon pa sgra dang bcas pa'i thod rlon khrag gis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ /spyi bor rma bya'i sgro mdongs kyis brgyan cing / glang po che'i ko ba rlon pas stod g.yogs shing / re lde'i sham thabs la sbrul nag po stong gi chun pos ska rags byas pa/ sku la khrag gi thig le dang / zhag gi zor ris dang thal chen gyi tshom bus byugs shing / lte ba'i dbus nas nyi ma 'char ba/ dre'u ga pa la zhen pa/ sha za mkha' 'gro bye ba'i 'khor dang bcas pa/ mgon po'i mdun du k+ṣe las k+ṣe tra pā la mthing nag g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa dom nag smyon pa la zhen pa/ mgon po'i g.yas su pad nyi ro'i gdan la dzi las dbang phyug dzi na mi tra dmar nag g.yas ḍā ma ru dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ mgon po'i rgyab tu —85

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)pad nyi ro'i gdan la ṭa ga las gshin rje ṭak+ki rā dza mthing nag g.yas cang te'u dang g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ lha mo'i g.yon du trag las bdud mgon trag shad nag po g.yas ru mtshon 'phyar zhing / g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ za 'og sngo khra'i ber gsol zhing rta nag rting dkar la bcibs pa/bzhi ga'ang shin tu khros shing 'jigs pa/ me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ gtso 'khor de dag gi g.yas su 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor rim gyis brtsegs pa'i steng du/ / las ri rab yangs shing rgya che ba'i gdan la/ rdo rje'i gur khang chen po me ris bskor ba'i dbus su/ kai la sod (7na)pa'i gzhal yas khang 'jigs su rung ba'i nang khrag gi rgya mtshos gang ba'i klong dkyil du / las rdo rje'i brag ri nag po phyi rol tu rlung 'khor rtsibs drug pas bskor ba/ brag ri'i 'khor yug dang bcasapa'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma dang / raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ mthing nag las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ ma hā kā la mthing nag sku thung zhing sbom la brjid pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ g.yas rdo rje gri gug dang g.yon khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa thugs kur steng 'og tu 'dzin pas phyag gnyis kyi dbus na rnam 'phrul gyi gaṇ+ḍi bsnams pa/ dbu skra dang smin ma sma ra dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa dar gyi na bza' dang dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ mi'u thung 'gying ba'i 'dug stangs kyis/ ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas na bya nag /g.yon na khyi nag /rgyab na spyang nag /mdun na mi nag /steng na nam mkha' lding gi sprul pa'i pho nya 'phro ba/ sku las skyes pa'i ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i klong dkyil du bzhugs pa/ phyi'i rtsibs dang po la mo las lha mo e ka dzā ṭi'i lto ba yangs pa'i nang du trag las khrag gi rgya mtsho'i dbus su bh+yo las dpal ldan lha mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma g.yas gnyis ral gri dang thod khrag /g.yon gnyis mdung dang tir shul bsnams pa/ snyan g.yas dug sbrul dang g.yon seng shes brgyan pa/ dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan cing lte ba'i thad nas nyi ma 'char ba/ byug pa'i rdzas gsum gyis sbags shing / ma mo dang ḍā zhi'i 'khor gyi dbus na bzhugs pa/ rtsibs gnyis par —86

dam can chos srung mngon rtogs tshon las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ (getri yig yaṃ du gyur pa las gnod sbyin nag po mi lpags gos su gyon pa g.yas gser gyi gri gug dang /g.yon sbar ba dgra la (7bang grad pa'i lag mthil du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'char ba/ rtsibs gsum par tri yig 3 du gyur pa las gnod sbyin nag mo dar nag gi gos gyon pa/ g.yas spu gri dang g.yon sbar mo dgra la gdeng ba'i lag mthil du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'char ba/ rtsibs bzhi par tri las pu tra nag po dar dkar gyi ang rag gyon pa/ g.yas ral gri dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ rtsibs lnga par tri las bha dra nag po stag gi slog pa gyon pa g.yas dam shing dang g.yon mi snying 'dzin pa/ rtsibs drug par smo las srin mo khrag mig ma nag mo za 'og gi gos gyon pa/ g.yas sbu gri dang g.yon rgyu ma'i zhags pa 'dzin pa/ gsum ga'ang dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ de dag gi phyi rol tu skyes pa ru mtshon thogs pa brgya/ bud med gri thod thogs pa brgya/ dge slong 'khar gsil thogs pa brgya/sngags pa phur bu thogs pa brgya la sogs pa'i 'khor dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ myur mdzad mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa'i g.yon phyogs su : las rin po che'i gzhal yas khang yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su khang bu brtsegs pa dgu yod pa'i dbus ma'i nang du hrī las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du be+e ser po las byung ba'i rgyal mtshan be+e sa mtshan pa/ de las 'od sa 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rgyal po chen po ngal bsos po sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rin po che'i rgyal mtshan dang / g.yon gter gyi ne'u le 'dzin pa/ seng ge nyal ba kha de nyid la lta ba'i steng du sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gisabazhugs pa/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan la sogs pa'i rin po che'i rgyan rnams kyis spras shing / phrag gong gnyis la nyi ma dang zla bas brgyan pa/ nam mkha' (8nasgo dzod la mnga' brnyes shing nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid dang ldan pa/ shar gyi khang brtsegs kyi pad+ma'i gdan la sa la ser po g.yas rin po che bsnams pa/ lhor gang ba bzang po ser po g.yas bum bzang bsnams pa/ nub tu nor bu bzang po dkar po g.yas nor bu bsnams pa/ byang du ku be ra nag po g.yas ral gri bsnams pa/ shar lhor —87

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)yang dag shes ser po g.yas gser gri bsnams pa/ lho nub tu 'brog gnas nag po g.yas rin po che'i mdung bsnams pa/ nub byang du lnga rtsen ser skya g.yas khang brtsegs bsnams pa/ byang shar du 'jam po 'khyil ba dkar po g.yas gri phub bsnams pa/ /thams cad kyang g.yon pas gter gyi ne'u le bsnams pa/ rang rang gi sku mdog dang mtshungs pa'i rta la bcibs shing rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras pa/ de dag gi phyi rol tu gnod sbyin gyi tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba gtso 'khor de dag gi g.yon phyogs su pad+ma dang nyi ma dang dgra bgegs rnams kyi snying ga nas brdzis pa'i ma he rab tu khros pa'i gdan /steng du ya las thod dbyug yas mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa ma he rab tu khros pa'i gdong pa can/ rwa rnon po gnyis dang ldan pa/ bskal pa 'jig pa'i dus kyi me'i phung po dang mtshungasapa'i spyan gsum sdang mig tu blta ba/ zhal rab tu gdangs shing 'bar ba'i mche ba rnon po bzhi gtsigs nas sngags rnam par bskyod pa/ smin ma dang sma ra rab tu 'bar zhing / skra kham pa gyen du gzings shing 'phyang ba/ phyag g.yas thod dbyug 'phyar zhing g.yon sdigs mdzub rab tu bsgreng bas bdud kyi zhags pa nag po 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum pas ma he rab tu (8bsgo rgyas pa'i rwa sprag nas brjes shing / g.yon brkyang pas ma he rab tu khros pa'i tshang steng nas brdzis pa/ mi rus kyi rgyan gyis spras pa/ sbom zhing thung la gsus pa 'phyang ba/ gcer bu liṅga dmar po gyen du langs pa/ de'i g.yon du tsa muṇ+ḍi nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ mi sdug pa'i gzugs can/ dud 'gro'i pa ṭa pa rlon pa gos su gyon zhing / g.yas rtse gsum dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ yab yum de gnyis kyi 'khor du las kyi gshin rje'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ mdor na gtso 'khor rnam pa bzhi po de dag gi phyi rol tu snang srid lha srin sde brgyad kyi tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba'i gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūṃ sngon pos mtshan par gyur/ bdag nyid kyi thugs spu'i hūṃ sngon po'i 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa can gyis/ dur khrod bsil —88

dam can chos srung mngon rtogs wen las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)ba'i tshal/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs ka /byang phyogs lcang lo can/ lho phyogs rim pa bdun gyi sa'og sogs rang bzhin lhun 'gyas grub pa'i pho brang nas skad cig gis gnas 'dir spyan drangs/ sposasbyor bsreg cing rol mo dbyangs dang bcas pas/ hūṃ/ rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje gcig bsdus pa/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang bde ba chen po yi/ /rnam par rol pa las byung drag po'i skur/ /ston mdzad ma hā kā la spyan 'dren no/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma lus pa/ /bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po ji bzhin du/ /stsol mdzad rig 'dzin srung ma kun gyi gtso/ /legs ldan nag po gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /cho ge kyi dbyings las zhi ba'i skur ston pa/ /gangs ri'i mdangs 'phrog mgon po thugs rje'i gter/ /yid bzhin nor bu mkha' 'gro'i tsho gos dang bcas/ /dngos grub 'dod dgu stsol (9na khrur ྾/ grangs med gnas gsum mkha' 'gro yongs kyi gtso/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir khro mo'i skur ston pa/ /'dod khams dbang phyug ma mo yongs kyi bdag /dam bcas dgongs la gnas 'dir ྾/ /lhaḥ dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal/ /'jigs su rung ba'i bskal ba yi/ /me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas/ /ma hā kā la mthu bo che/ /sdebargyad ma mo mkha' 'gros bskor/ /nag mo mi zad bsam las 'das/ /lha mo dkar nag grangs su med/ /snang srid thams cad khyod kyi bran/ /srid gsum thams cad khyod kyi 'khor/ /dregs pa can rnams las mkhan te/ /stong gsum skad cig glog ltar myul/ /sdang dgra gnod bgegs thal bar rlog /bdag cag dam tshig sgrub pa po/ /'dasadang bzhuṭa pa'i sangs rgyas kyi/ /spyan sngar zhal bzhes dran dgongs la/ /gtor ma ri la rak+ta mtsho/ /bdud rtsi rgya mtsho lta bur 'khyil/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i rten rnams tshang / /dam tshig ldan pa'i gnasa'adir gshegs/ /dad pa dang ni dam tshig gi /tshur gshegs ma hā kā la che/ /nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas/ /dkyil 'khor gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /k+ṣe tra pā la la sogs pa'i/ /'khor gyi bka' nyan gnod sbyin tshogs/ /bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /dam can rgya mtsho gshegs su gsol/ /rdo rje'i dam tshig rjes dran nas/ /dam tshig chen pos gnas 'dir gshegs/ /bde ba chen —89

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)po'i pho brang nas/ /'phrin las drag pos 'dul don du/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i thugs kyi sprul/ /gnyis med ye shes las mdzad pa'i/ / nag po chen po drag shul can/ /'phrin las mdzad phyir gnas ra/ /mas stobs rdzu 'phrul bsam mi khyab/ /mkha' 'gro'i yul dang 'dod (9bab mas mi/ /las byed gnod sbyin yab yum dang / /pu tra lcam sring ྾/ /dur khrod bdag po phyogs skyong dang / /zhing skyong gdong bas 'khor dang yos/ /pho rgyud mo rgyud sdebargyad dang / /ru 'dren sdebazhi ྾/ /brtan pa'i dam rdzas sna tsho gis bshams/ /tshil chen dud pa sprin ltar gtibs/ /sman phud rak+ta mtsho ltar bskyil/ /'bru sna bdud rtsi'i phud kyis mchod/ /sngags can dar nag g.yab mo sogs/ /spyan 'dren mchod pa'i ྾/ /baiḥ sa 'dzin dbang po byang gi phyogs/ /rig sngags 'chang ba kun gyi gnas/ /lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas/ /nor gyi dbang phyug rnam thos sras/ /'khor dang yos spyan 'dren na/ /rnal 'byor bdag la brtser dgongs nas/ /thogs pa med pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol/ /dzaḥ 'jam dbyangs gshin rje gshed kyi bka' sdod mchog /chos kyi rgyal po yab yum ya ba ti/ /pho nya mo la sogs pa'i 'khor dang bcas/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi'i las la spyan 'dren na/ /gling gi mchog gyur 'dzam gling lho yi phyogs/ /mthar byed lcags kyi thod mkhar 'bar ba nas/ /lho sprin nag po rlung gis bskyod pa bzhin/ /brtse ba'i thugs kyis gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ shrī ma hā kwa la/ ma hā kā la kā li de li be+e shra ma ṇa ya ma rā dza sa pa ri wā ra e khyo hi dzaḥdzaḥ dzaḥlha baṃ sngoganyis su med par gyur/ pad+ma ka ma lā ya sto/ de nas mchode pa 'bul ba ni/ /rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba yi/ /lha rdzas bzang po'i mchod yon 'di/ /dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul/ /bstan pa bsrung phyir bzhes su gsol/ /rkang pa gnyis pa'i mchod yon gyi gnas su/ /zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol (10na spo rnams bcug /oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ma hā kā la/ kā li de li/ be+e shra wa ṇa/ kwa la rū pa sa pa ri wā ra/ a/ pā bye/ ri lci pe/ ā lo ke /garnye/ ni li te/shabha pra titsā hūṃ swā hā/ /nang mar 'bul ba ni/ ma rdzo do/ /sku bzhi ye shes lnga'i bdag ṣ+ka drin mā rtsa—90

dam can chos srung ma' rtogs mun las rnam tso lhun grub/ (geba'i bla ma rin po che'i zhal du oṃ āḥlha/rgyal ba khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po'i zhal du ྾//dpal ldan sha wa ri dbang phyug gi ྾//rje btsan mi tri pa chen po'i ྾/grub chen rā hu la chen po'i ྾//mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor ྾//mas med rin cen brtson 'grus kyi ྾//dbon ston skyer sgang pa wo po'i ྾//gto r+sā sbas pa'i rnal wor ྾//chos rje 4sa rgyas r+sā pa'i ྾//gas grub shangasaston chen po'i ྾//mus chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang gi ྾//sngags 'chang rdo rje gzhon nu'i ྾//mnyam med nam mkha'i rnal 'byor pa ྾//mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa'i ྾/grub chen bzang po rgyal mtshan ྾//rdo rje 'chang kun dga' rgyal mtshan ྾//thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho dpal bzang po'i ྾//slar yang /rgyal ba rdo rje lang ྾//bram ze wo po mchog sred ྾//slob dpon nor bu gling pa ྾//shirnya kā ra wa rma ྾//lo tsā ba rin cen bzang po ྾//brag steng pa yon to tshul khrims ya//rje bas mal lo wo po ྾//sar kun dga' snying po ྾//slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo ྾//rje bas grags pa rgyal mas ྾//chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍita ྾//'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa ྾//mthu chen a nyan dam pa ྾//bla ma bdag nyid chen po ྾//mkhas btsun nam mkha' legs pa ྾//bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan ྾//bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan ྾//'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan ྾//bdag 10bsnen blo gros rgyal mtshan ྾//mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug kun spangs wo po kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma ྾//tsho r+pā chos kyi rgyal po blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mas dpal bzang po ྾//rdo rje 'dzin pa bod mkhar ba don grub rgyal mtshan ྾//thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho ྾//'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug ྾//mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan ྾//rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan ྾//sngagasa'achang dbang po mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan ྾//rdo rje 'dzin pa bkra shis kun dga' ྾//bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma ྾//gzhan yang dbang bskur rgyud bshad man ngag gnang ba'i bla ma dam pa yab sras brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams 9 1 zhal du oṃ āḥ&/rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs za/ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā la/ ma hā kā la/ kā li de wi/ be+e shra wa ṇa kā la rū pa sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥ&/ de nas dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcas pa'am/ lcags kyi rdo rje lag tu 'dzin pas/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā sa ma ya ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ bstan bsrung dam can rgya mtsho'i tsho gos khyed rnams kyis/ rdo rje 'chang nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar gyi dam tshig dran par mdzod la/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon cog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ khyad par rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen po'i bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa spel ba dang / yang sgos rig sngags 'chang ba bdag dang bltos bcas sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa la ban bon rig sngags mkhan gyi rdzas sngags ting nge 'dzin gyi 'phrul 'khor nga rgyas sa la mnan pa chu la gtad pa/ me la bsregs pa/ rlung la bskor ba la sogs pa'i sbyor ba ngan pa dang / mdor na sngon las pol rkyen gyi mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi zhing bzlog pa sogasa'aphrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub par mdzod (11na:ga /skabs 'dir gtor ma 'bul/ de nasabashags pa bya ba ni/ rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer los pas rdo rje gsum gyi lha tsho gis spyan drangs/ dmigs pa dang bcas pas yi ge brgya pa bzla/ lhaḥ rdo rje 'chang dang dpal ldan sha wa ri/ /mi tri rā hu dzo ki rat+na dang / /bram ze mchog sred nor bu gling pa sogs/ /dngos dang brgyud pa'i bla ma dgongs su gsol/ /'gro ba'i re skong yon to rab rdzogs pa'i/ /brgyud ldan bla ma dus gsum sangs rgyas la/ /dag pa gnyis ldan chos skur ma rtogs pa'i/ /'jig rten rtog bcas dbang gyur mthol lo bshags/ /sku gsung thugs dang yon tan 'phrin las bcas/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i lha rnams dgongs su gsol/ /bdag cag theg mchog sngags kyi sgor zhugs nas/ /rtsa ba yan lag 'gal nyams mthol lo bshags/ /mthu stobs nus pa 'phrin las phun tsho gos shing / /skad cig dran pas bar chad thams cad sel/ /'du 'bral med par dngos grub ster mdzad pa'i/ /dam can srung ma'i tshogs rnams dgongs su gsol/ /dur khrod nags 'dabs chu gling bas mtha' mā /phyi nang rten dang dam rdzas tshogos gyur kyang / /bsnyen bsgrub bskang bshags tshul bzhin ma grub par/ /le lo g.yeng ba'i —92

dam can chos srung ma' rtogs mun las rnam pha lhun grub/ rtodapedabang gyur mthol lo bshags/ khyad par gsang ba'i rten mchog bla na med/ /dam can bstan srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas rnams/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi rnam rol du/ /rtse gcig gdung shugs ma bgyis mthol ྾/ /bdag ni ma rig 'khrul ba'i dbang gyur te/ /bla ma bstan srung rgya mtsho'i tshogasarnams kyi/ /sku gsung thugs dang 'gal ba ci mas pa/ /mnong zhing 'gyod pa'i sems dang bcas(11ba)nas kyang / lha mchog khyod kyi spyan sngar mthol ྾/ /ye shes bka' bsgrub las kyi pho nya mdzad/ /re ma tī dang gnod sbyin rnam pa bzhi/ /pu tra mched gsum gnod sbyin ming sring gnyis/ /phyogs skyong bcu dang gtsang ris dgongs su gsol/ /ji ltar khyed kyis khas blangs dam bcas bzhin/ /bdag gi 'phrin las yengs med sgrub pa la/ /yi chad bgyis shing sha khrag gtor tshogs kyis/ /gtang rag dusasu ma thongs mthol lo bshaṭa/ /mngon shes med pa'i nyes skyon ma rtogs par/ /bstan pa 'jig dang bla ma'i sku dgra la/ /drag po'i las kyis tshar bcad ma bgyis par/ /gsang ba bsgrags shing byams bgyis mthol ྾/ /dam nyams grib phog gtam 'dres zas zos dang / khyu chung phud nyams sgom bzlas nor la sogs/ /nyes skyon zhakhrul pa'i tsho gis rnams ci mchis pa/ /mnong zhing 'gyod pa'i sgo nas mthol ྾/ /nyams gyib dag phyir bshags pa 'di byas pas/ /dam can bstan srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas kyis/ /pha ma bu tsha bzhin du bzod bzhes la//dngos grub thams cad dus 'dir stsal du gsol/ /bshags dang bshags par bya ba mi dmigs kyang / /rnam par rtog pa'i bag chags dag bya'i phyir/ /rje btsun dam pa yul gyi mchog rnams la/ /rab tu bshags pas bde chen thob gyur cig /bskang rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ khyiḥdhīḥwi kri tā na 'a hūṃ phags/ oṃ su bhā wa/ zhes pa nas/ stong pa'i ngang las rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i bla ma dang dam can rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas pa mnyes par byed pa'i dam rdzas/ spyan gzigs/ mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bla ma dang dam can rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas pa'i spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas (12na)par gyur cig /oṃ sarba bid pū ra pā ra/ /su ra su ra/ ā wa rta ya ā wa rta ya sngo badz+ra —93

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)lpa ra ṇa khaṃ/ oṃ swa bhā wa bi shu khye dharmā:te badz+ra sirnyi hūṃ/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe saḥ sarba thā khaṃ 0 te skra ra ṇa i me ga ga na kho swā hā/ oṃ a phri te hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ a kā ro mu kho sarba dharmā 'o ār+ya nu t+pa na tā ta/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūṃ/ oṃ ru ru spru ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sirnyi lo tsa ni sarba ar+sha swā dha na su hā/ bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dag dang / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobasadang / /chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis/ /don rnams gang dag bsams pa kun/ /de dag thams cad ci rigs pa/ /thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig /de nas bskang gso ni/ lha: rtsa rgyud bla ma mchog gsum rgyal ba'i bka'/ /gsang sngags rig sngags ting 'dzin phyag rgya'i mthu/ /rang bzhin rnam dag chos dbyings bden pa yis/ /mthun pa'i dam rdzas phyi nang mchod pa'i tshogs/ /sa dang bar snang nam mkha'i khyon gang zhing / /zag med bde ster re ba rdzogs byed pa/ /dam can rgya mtsho 'khor bcas spyan lam du/ /'byung zhing rgyas la thugs dam skong gyur cig /gdug pa'i dgra bgegs rnamasakyi snying gi khrag /dmar chen rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rab 'khyil ba/ /dmar ser lha bas 'khrigs pa'i mchod yon 'di/ /ye shes mgon po rnam gsum re ma twe/ /chos kyi rgyal po bka' sdod bcas pa yi/ /'bor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam skong gyur nas/ /bar chad bzlog la mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /gdug pa'i dgra bgegs rnams kyi mig dang ni/ /rna ba sna dang lce dang de bzhin snying / /ri ltar spungs pa dbang po'i me tog 'dis/ /ye shes mgon po (12ba phrogs blo ka gcig po 'di man kun la 'gre'o//gdug pa'i dgra bgegs rnams kyi mig dang ni/ /rna ba sna dang lce dang de bzhin snying / /ri ltar spungs pa dbang po'i me tog 'dis/ /ye shes mgon po rnam gsum re ma ti/ /chos kyi rgyal po bka' sdod bcas pa yi/ /'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam stong gyur nas/ /bar chad bzlog la mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /dug khrag yungs kur gu gul nag po sogs/ /drag po'i rjes mchog sbyar ba mthun pa'i spos/ /ro sol me yis bsregs pa'i dud sprin 'dis/ /ye shes mgon po ྾/ gdug pa'i dgra bgegs rnams kyi zhun chen po/ /skra yi ras kya sdong bur bcas pa la/ /yi dwags me yis sbar ba'i sgron me 'dis/ /ye shes—94

dam can chos srung mngon rtogs 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ (gemagon po ྾/ gsar rnying khrag dang ga bur sbyar ba la/ /bdud rtsi lnga yis sbags shing byin brlabasapa'i/ /zhag chen spris ma chags pa'i dri chab 'dis/ /'bru nag zan dang 'bras chan 'khur ba dang / /la phug la du sha khrag rus par bcas/ /ro brgya ldan pa'i zhal zas rgya mtsho 'dis/ /ye shes mgon po ྾/ /mi rkang gling bu gsang ba'i rde'u chung dang / /dzornga rnga zlum thod pa'i cang teg /brjid pa'i sgra ldan sna tsho gos rol mo 'dis/ /ye shes mgon po ྾/ /dgra bgegs g.yang gzhi bla bre mkha' la bres/ /gdug pa'i rgyu rlon lda ldi bar snang gang / /keng rus sa gzhi khyab par gcal du bkram/ /ye shesamagon po ྾/ /glang chen ko rlon stag gi pags pa dang / /mi mgo'i phreng ba phyag rgya rnam pa drug /mkha' 'gro'i rdzas mchog li khri'i thog pa 'dis/ /ye shes mgon po ྾/ /myos byed stong gi bcud bsdusabadud rtsi mchog /sbyangs shing bskyed de sbar ba'i byang chub sems/ /med byung dgyes pa bskyed pa'i btung ba 'dis/ /ye shes mgon po ྾/ /lha: sprin gyi shugs 'chang gling bzhi yud kyis bskor/ sha rgyas spu sdug dar gyi cod pan can/ /zla ba'i mdongs mdzes rta nag bcu gsum gyis/ ye shes mgon po ྾/ /g.yag rog zhol chen sprin ltar gtibs pa la/ /rno zhing mtho ba'i rdo rje'i rwa rtse can/ /drag po'i ngar sgra sgrog (13na)pa bcu gsum gyis/ /ye shes mgon po ྾/ /lug nag spyi dkar dbang po ma nyams shing / /'khyil legs chu gnyer mdzes pa'i rwa bzhi pa/ /'jam legs spu yi gos gyon bcu gsum gyis/ /ye shes mgon po ྾/ /dgra bo'i snying 'byin rdo rje'i mchu sder can/ /drag po'i skad sgrog kha nas glog 'byug cing / /khyung ltar lding ba'i bya nag bcu gsum gyis/ /ye shes mgon po ྾/ khyi nag snying dkar dom ltar 'phyo ba la/ kha gdangs mche gtsigs 'jigs pa'i nga ro can/ /sna tshogasargyan gyis mdzes pa bcu gsum gyis/ /ye shes mgon po ྾/ /g.yin yang rin cen bdun dang 'dod yon lnga/ /phyi nang nyer spyod gling bzhi ri rab sogs/ /dngos bshams yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod sprin 'dis/ /ye shes mgon po ྾/ /dmar chen gtor ma ri ltar spungs pa la/ /dmar nag dar gyi cod pan du mas brgyan/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs pas/ /ye shes mgon po ྾/ /—95

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)mnyen lcug drang zhing rgod chen sgro yis brgyan/ /srog gi sngags bris dar nag mgul bar 'phyang / /gnam lcags mde'u dgra bgegs snying dkyil du/ /thog ltar rgyug pa'i nang rten dam pa 'dis/ /ye shes mgon po ྾/ /dpa' bo g.yul du mtshon gyis bsad pa'i snying / /rtsa gsum ma nyams rin cen phye ma dang / /bzang po'i sman dang sngags kyis rab bkang nas/ /bskyed cing byin brlabs gsang ba'i rten rdzas 'dis/ /ye shes mgon po ྾/ khams gsum za byed drag po'i skur bstan yang / /rtsa brgyud bla ma kun dang dbyer med pa'i/ /snang stong sgyu ma lta bu'i skur bltas nas/ /dungs bas gsol 'debs bla med rten mchog 'dis/ /ye shes mgon po ྾/ khyi nag 'phyo zhing lcags spyang g.yal zhing rgyu/ /mi nag rab 'gying bya nag tshoṭi rnams lding / /phyi nang gsang rten ma tshang med pa 'dis/ /ye shesamagon po ྾/ /thod dbyug zhags pa khram baṃ thod khrag dang / /rno ngar rdo rje'i rwa (13badzin ma he'i tshogs/ /rdo rje go mtshon dur khrod mas brgyad kyis/ /ye shes mgon po ྾/ /mdor na phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa'i tshogs/ /mkha' dbyings nor 'dzin ma lus rab bkang pa'i/ /zag med bde chen rnam rol dam pa 'dis/ /ye shes mgon po ྾/ lhaḥ rin cen mang sprul rgyal po chen po ste/ /bde mdzad srid gsum phongs dang rgud pa las/ myur skyob bkra shis dpal 'bar bde ster ba/ /mgon po sirnyi'i gter mchog thugs dam bskang / /gos sngon lung thang phreng ba cang shes rta/ /'dod 'jo'i ba dang gter bum dpag bsam shing / khrus kyi rdzing bu gtsug lag khang chen dang / /gsang chen bris sku dam pas thugs dam bskang / /don dam spros bral skye 'gag gnas gsum bral/ /rdo rje 'dzin dang rgyal po chen po yang / /ting 'dzin 'ja' tshon lta bur dus kun spyod/ /lta sgom spyod pa zab mos ྾/ /gsang sngags bsnyen sgrub thun mong khyad par dang / /sku gsung thugs dang bye brag spyi rnams kyi/ /dam tshig gtsang ma'i dge ba ci mchis pas/ /mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa'i ྾/ /gta' gtor rgyun gtor dus gtor gnyan po dang / /mchod pa lnga dang 'dod yon rnam lnga dang / /rin cen bdun dang bkra shis rdzas brgyad kyis/ /mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa'i ྾/ /nas 'bras gro sran til dang 'bru —96

dam can chos srung ma' rtogs 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ rtogeyi tshogs/ /dzā ti gur kum tsan+dan ga bur dang / /gla rtsi dri lnga 'bru sna lnga dang ni/ /byā gh+ri saṃ kṛ ha sa de ba dang / /gar ni ka dang sman mchog rnam lnga dang / /chu yi snying po lan tsha rtsi tog dang / mang rtog bur ma sbrang rtsi til mar dang / /sman lnga snying po lnga yis ྾/ /lus 'phags po dang 'dzam gling ba glang spyod/ /sgra mi snyan dang gling phran brgyad po dang / /nyi zla ri rab kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin/ /mgon po 'khor (14na)dang bcas pa'i ྾/ /thugs dam gnyan po dbyings su skong gyur nas/ /bdag cag sgrub pa po la dngos grub stsol/ /de nas bsnyen pa bya ba ni rang yi dam gang yin du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ mdun gyi lha so so'i thugs skar nyi gdan gyi steng du sa bon la sngags kyi bskor ba la phog /thugs rgyud bskul bas las rab 'byams bsgrub par bsam pa tsam thun mong gi dmigs pa yin zhing / /thun mong ma yin pa'i zhi rgyas dbang drag gi dmigs pa'i kha bsgyur sogs ni/ su byung gi bla ma la brten nas gang byung gi gdams ngag thos pas gnad kyi myong ba med pa'i rtog ge'i tshig tsam gyis 'grig 'grig gi bshad pa la yid rton par mi rung ba'i phyir/ tshad thub kyi rdo rje slob dpon gyi drung du sgro 'dogs gcod dgos pas 'dir ma spros so/ /mgon po'i snying po ni/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la sku k+ṣa tra bisna na bi nā ya kā hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ gur gyi snying po ni rma shrī ma hā kā wā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/lha mo'i snying po ni/ oṃ ru ru ro ru bi tiṣ+ṭha ba dh+wa si/ ka ma la rak+ṣa si hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ/ gnod sbyin bzhi li snying po ni/ oṃ k+ṣe tra pā la bi tsā na hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dzi na mi tra wa shaṃ ku ru hūṃ phags/ oṃ ṭak+ki rā dza sam ya bh+yo hūṃ phags/ oṃ du yag dzi ma hā kā la trag da hūṃ phaṭa/ las mkhan mo sngon la bzla bar bshad pas/ oṃ ru ru ro ru tri tsa pa la a shug me ma hūṃ ma bh+yo dzaḥdzaḥ las mkhan pho'i sngags/ a'i li a li ma dzaḥdzaḥ she she li shi dang / a shwa dad/ mo rmugs/ sbu gri a li ma dzaḥdzaḥ nag mo sha la ru sa dzaḥdzaḥ rnam sras kyi snying po ni/ cha'i shra wa ṇa ya swā hā/ 'khor gyi snying po ni/ byung la dza le sgru ya swā hā/ cha gu r+ṇa bha drwa ya swā hā/(14ba tshe tsā ma ṇi bha drwa ya swā hā/ oṃ ku be rā ya swā hā/ skye khes spra dza nā ya swā hā/ oṃ gu hasta nā ya swā hā/ tsong nyi pa kā ya swā hā/ oṃ bi tsi ku ṇ+ḍali ye swā hā/ chos rgyal gyi snying po ni/ oṃ kā la rū pa hūṃ phaṭa/ bad rbad —97

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)bsad gsum bsgril ba'i mgon po rnams kyi rtsa sngags/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lwa ya shā sa na u ba ha ri ṇi e ṣa a pa smi ma kā lo ya e/ i da rat+na tra yā ya a pa kā ri ṇi/ ya di pra tī dz+nyā/ sma ra gi ta dwa/ i rda dun kha kha/ 'a hi khā hi/ ma ra ma ra/ gros grihā/ ban+ta ban+ta/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ de na rdzekan mā ra ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ lhag chad bskang phyir gshin rje gshed kyi yi ge brgya pa bzla/ gtor ma gong bzhin byin gyis brlabs la/ dam can srung ma 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags/ las skyes pa'i rdo rje rtse gcig pa dmar po 'od kyi sbu gu can gyis gtor ma'i bcud drangs te gsol bar gyur/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ma hā kā la/ kā li de wi be+e shra wa ṇa/ kā la rā pa sa pa ri wā ra i rda ba kla ta kha kha 'a hi khā hi/zhes pa bdun nam nyer gcig gis gtso bo yab yum la 'bul zhing shā san dang / a kā ro gang yang rung bas 'khor rnams la 'bul/ de nas gong gi sngaṭa mjug tu/ a:/ bā ju/ puṅge lha pe/ ā lo ke /ga rje/ ni li te/ shabha āḥlha/ btags pas mchode pa dang / oṃ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ma hā rak+ta a skṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ zhes pas nang mchod dang / rak+ta 'bul/ gtor rdzong ni/ dam can bstan srung rgya mtshol/ /bdag gis mchod gtor phul ba yis/ /dkon cog dbu 'phang smod pa dang / /theg pa chen po sun 'byin dang / /bstan pa 'jig dang dbyen byed dang / /bla ma'i sku la sdob dang / /(14na)rnal 'byor bdag la sdang ba rnams/ /de dag bstan srung rgya mtshos sgrol/ /a mu ka mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ de nas gzhi bdag gtor ma btang rjes bstod pa bya ba ni/ myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhabs gdub dang bcas bi nā ya ka mnan/ /nag po chen po stag gi sham thabs can/ /phyag drug sprul gyi rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ /g.yas pa gri gug bar pa 'phreng ba 'dzin/ /tha ma ḍā ma ru ni drag tu 'khrol/ /g.yon pa thod pa dang ni mdung rtsegasum/ /de bzhin zhags pa bzung nas 'tshing bar byed/ /drag po'i zhal gdangs mche ba rnam par gtsigs/ /spyan gsum drag po dbu skra gyen du 'bar/ /dpral bar si ra yis legs par byugs/ /spyi bor mi bskyod rgyal pos rgyas btab brtan/ /khrag 'dzag mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal can/ /rin chen thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan/ khreng la byon nas gtor ma —98

dam ༅ chos srung ma' rtogs skrun las rnam swo lhun grub/ 9)len mdzad pa'i/ /dpal ldan phyag drug pa la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po bsrung ba dang / /dkon cog dbu 'phang gnyan po bstod pa dang / /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas rnams kyi/ /rkyen ga bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang / /ci 'dod dngos grub myur du stsal du gsol/ /bh+yoḥ phyogs bcu dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /mkhyen brtse gcig bsdus rje btsun spyan ras gzigs/ /de yi sprul pa phyag drug mgon po la/ /lusang ga yid gsum gus pasaphyag 'tshal lo/ /bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /rlung nag 'tshub mar 'tshub pa'i pho brang nas/ /ma gcig 'dod khams dbang phyug re ma ti/ /sku mdog nag mo char sprin lta bu la/ /thod skam dbu rgyan (15bsnyan g.yas seng ge 'phyo/ /snyan g.yon sprul gyis 'khril ba'i gdengs ka can/ /spyan gsum dmar 'khrug zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs/ /'jiṭa byed lha mo khyod la bdag bstod do/ /g.yas pa ral gri 'bar bas dgra srog gcod/ /phyag g.yon thod rlon rgyal mtshan snying khrag gsol/ /sku stod sprul nag zhing lpags ska rags bcings/ /sku smad glang chen ko rlon re lde dkris/ /stong gsum bgrod phyir dre'u rta rkang gsum bcibs/ /srin po'i ya mgal snga rur khram bam btags/ /gong rmed sprul nag nad rkyal dgra la gtong / /mchod gtor 'di bzhes dgra bgegs sgrol la shog /bcol ba'i 'phrin las ma lus grub par mdzod/ /lhaḥ dur khrod 'jigs su rung ba'i shar phyogs na/ /mgon po'i bka' nyan las byed pho nya ba/ /mi yi lus la srin po'i gdong pa can/ /gnod sbyin k+ṣe tra pā lasalas mdzod cig /lhaḥ dur khrod 'jigs su rung ba'i lho phyogs na/ /mgon po'i ྾/ kha nas khrag dang dug gi zor 'phen pa'i/ /dbang phyug dzi na mi thos las mdzod cig /lhaḥ dur khrod 'jigs su rung ba'i nub phyogs na/ /mgon po'i ྾/ /mi sha khrag gi dri tshor bzod glags med/ /gshin rje ṭak+ki rā dzas las mdzod cig /lhaḥ dur khrod 'jigs su rung ba'i byang phyogs na/ /mgon po'i ྾/ /bdud mgon mi nag rta nag rdzu 'phrul can/ /srog bdud thog shad nag pos las mdzod cig /de nas bskul ba ni/ lhaḥdam nyams dgra dang bgegs rnams kyi/ /mthu dang rdzu 'phrul nyams par gyis/ /rgyab brten —8

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)lha dang myur du phrol/ /mdza' ba kun dang rnam par phye/ /khong nas snying phyungs srog rtsa chod/ /rigs brgyud rtsad nas cho de la shog /nyes can stobs la shor ra re/ /gdug (16na cung sdang ba'i dgra bo 'dis/ /bla ma dam pa'i sku dgra byas//rdo rje theg pa sun phyung zhing //dge 'dun lde rnams dkrugs shing 'joms/ /sdom brtson kun la brnyas shing smod/ /skye bo yongs la gnod cing 'tshe/ /rnal 'byor lha med zer nasabarnyas/ /lha khyod mthu med zer nas smod/ /bstan pa'i dgra bor gyur pa ni/ /lo dang zla bar ma bzhag par/ /ya ma rā dza'i zhal du thob/ /gshog pa can gyis mtha' nas chus sa/ /sder mo can gyis snying nas drongs/ /mche ba can gyis klad nas phub/ /las kyi rlung gis rgyab nas ded/ khun pa nag posamadun nas bsus/ /ṭak+ki rā dzas g.yas nas chus sa/ /tshogs bdag glang snas g.yon nas chu mus/ /gnam gyi 'ju thag chod las shog /sa yi brten phur thon la shog /don snying lnga po phyungs las shog /kha nas khong khrag skyug tu chug /ltas ga brgyad cu rtsa gcig thong / /bdud kyi sgo bro brdung du chug /btsan gyi zhags pa 'debs su chug /ma mo'i dal yams dgra la sgyur/ /bstan pa'i dgra bor gyur pa 'di/ khram la bab kyi khram la thob/ tag la bab kyi sho khye zhig /dam nyams las ga sdig can 'di/ /lo dang zla bar ma bzhag par/ /rtags dang mtshon cha myur du ston/ /bcol ba'i las 'di ma byas na/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i bka' yang bslus/ /phyi rabs gsang sngags sun yang phyung / /rig 'dzin bdag gi re ba bcad/ /sngon gyi thugs dam gnyan po nyams/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i dam tshig 'gal/ /thub pa'i bstan bsrung ming tsam gyur/ /de bas dam las ma 'da' bar/ /mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'di bzhes la/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /gur gyi bstod pa ni/(16bskoX srin po'i gzugs kyis gdug pa can/ /tshar gcod byang chub sems dpa' ste/ /grong khyer sum brtsegs 'jigs byed pa/ /gtum po khyod la bdag bstod do/ /mdog nag gzugs thung gzi brjid che/ /gdug pa tshar gcod gri gug g.yas/ /g.yon na gdug pa'i khrag bkang snod/ /thod 'phreng can la bdag bstod do/ khros pa'i zhabs brdabs sa gzhi g.yo/ /—100

dam can chos srung mngon rtogs 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ (ge'ajigs pa'i gad mos ri rab sgyel/ /dam tshig nyams pa'i snying 'byin pa'i/ /dam tshig can la bdag bstod do/ /bh+yoḥ gang gi sku gsung thugs kyi mthus/ /'dod pa'i khams kun zil mnan nas/ /'dod pa'i khams la dbang sgyur ma/ /'dod khams dbang phyug ma la 'dud/ /lhaḥ ye shes mgon po'i 'khor gyi gtso bo pa/ /mig sman mdog can nyams pa'i srog rtsa gcod/ /legs nyes bstangs 'dzin dam nyams sha la rol/ /gnod sbyin nag po khyod la bdag bstod do/ /bh+yoḥ sha za nag mo dam nyams snying 'byin ma/ khrag mig 'khyil zhing mi lngags gos su gyon/ /za byed zhal gdangs spyan bgrad me dpung 'phro/ /gnod sbyin nag mo khyod la bdag bstod do/ /lhaḥ las mkhan pu tra'i mtshan gsol mthu bo che/ /las bzhi kun bsgrub srog gi bdud po khyod/ /las la bskul tshe mon pa 'bum dang bcas/ /lasarnams thogs med bsgrub la ྾/ /legs ldan bka' sdod bha tra nag po khyod/ /mun pas byugs 'dra ha ha'i gad brgyangs sgrog /srid gsum dregs byed ma lus zil gnon pa'i/ /gtum po khrag 'thung khyod la ྾/ /srin mo'i cha byad khrag 'thung chen mo ni/ /'jigs pa'i lus la kha nas me 'bar ma/ /srid gsum cig car 'gengs pa'i mthu mo che/ /bran bdud nag mo khyod la ྾/ /(17na ngo zhan yang ru 'dren sde bzhi pho nya lnga/ /phyogs skyong dam can zhing skyong dzi brgyad sogs/ /sprul pa yang sprul bye ba'i tsho gis rnams kyis/ /sna tshogs wen las lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ khyad par bstan dang bstan 'dzin dge 'dun la/ /log par 'bu ba'i bsam sbyor ga rtsom pa'i/ /bdud dgra nag po'i sde rnams spa bkong la/ /mthun rkyen dngos grub ma lus deng 'dir stsol/ /bskul ba ni/ lhaḥ ma hā kā la mthu bo che/ /lha chen dpal 'bar mas bo che/ /steng nas sprul pa'i pho nya ni/ khyung chen sngon po lding zhing 'phyo/ /g.yas nas sprul pa'i pho nya ni/ /bya nag mang po klad la lding / /g.yon nas sprul pa'i pho nya ni/ /lcags spyang mang po 'dur zhing rgyug /mdun nas sprul pa'i pho nya ni/ /mi nag gnam la 'o dod 'bod/ /rgyab nas sprul pa'i pho nya ni/ khyi nag mang po 'khang zhing zug /gaṇ+ḍi las sprul pho nya ni/ khro chen 'bar bsa'ajig rten gang / /mngags shing las la bskul ba'i tshe/ /stong gsum 'jig rten ma lus 'gengs/ /—101

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)kha cig mtshon cha sna tsho gos 'phen/ /la las ba dan g.yab mo g.yob/ /la la mi rkang gling bu 'bud/ /kha cig rgyu ma'i zhags pa 'debs/ /la la dmar chen rak+ta sbreng / /la la tshil chen dud pa gtong / kha cig zhing chen sa la brdeg /la la hūṃ phaṭa 'brug sgra sgrog /la la gnam lcags thog ser 'bebs pho nya drag gtum mthu bo che/ /'ur 'ur chem chem stong gsum khengs/ /bh+yo bh+yo sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo/ /bh+yo bh+yo gnod pa'i bgegs la bh+yo/ /lhos shig bsgral lo dmag la 'phyos/ /dmag dpung bskyed la ru mtshon phyor/ /dgra bgegs thal ba'i rdul du rlog /bh+yoḥ lha mo (17bas pham srid gsum bdag /dung stong rgyal mo'i pho nya ni/ /mdun nas rgyug cing drag shul che/ /bud med gri thod thogs pa brgya/ /g.yas nas ru 'dren dpa' rtsal can/ /skyes pa ru mtshon thogs pa brgya/ /g.yon pa ru 'dren sprul pa'i sku/ /nyan thos gar gsil thogs pa brgya/ /slad kyi rjes gong 'jigs su rung / /sngags pa phur bu thogs pa brgya/ /pho nya drag gtum mi bzad 'bar/ /srin mo ral pa g.yeng ba'i tshogs/ /bstan pa srungs shig dpal ldan ma/ /pho nyar mngags kyis rtsal ma chung / /bh+yo bh+yo snang ba'i dgra la bh+yo/ /bh+yo bh+yo gnod pa'i bgegs la bh+yo/ /'phyongs shig dpung bskyed ru mtshon phyor/ /snang dgra gnod bgegs dam nyams rnams/ /rdul phran bzhin du brlag par mdzod/ /de nas rnam sras kyi bstod pa ni/ /lhaḥ mi 'jigs seng ge'i gdan steng na/ /be+e las byung ba'i mgon po ni/ /ngal bsos dge ba stobs po che/ /sa brgyad dbang phyug khyod la 'dud/ /btsun mo bzhi dang sras bzhi dang / /khyad par las grub gnod sbyin brgyad/ /nor ster ba yi klu chen brgyad/ /lha srin sdebargyad 'khor bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /dgra bgegs ma lus gzho me pa dang / /'byor ba'i longs spyod phun tsho gos shing / /'dod dgu yid bzhin 'grub pa dang / /gzhan don lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /las gshin gyi bstod pa ni/ bcom ldan 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed po yi/ /bka' sdod las kyi gshin rje ma he gdong / /sa gsum cig car g.yo 'dra'i khro bo'i gzugs/ /gtum drag rab brngams dus kyi dgra la bstod/ /mun pa bye bas byuṭa pa'i lhun po ni/ /rta gdong me yisahrūd la thod skam phreng / /ba mawo do shal(18na)—102

dam can chos srung ma' rtogs wen las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)rus pa'i rgyan 'phyang tshe//srid gsum cig car g.yo mdzad khyod la bstod//lang long 'khol ba'i khrag gi rgya mtsho'i dbus//gas drag ma he steng na mngon par 'phyo//bdud zhags dgra bo'i ske 'ching thod dbyug gis//dgra sde'i tshe srog cig car 'joms la bstod//mi bzad drag po'i 'o dod cher bos tshe//sa 'og rim pa bdun yang 'gas sam byed//nyer bzhi'i 'phrin las bsgrubs tshe lha chen yang //mthar byed gam du gtong ba khyod la bstod//gnam sa cig car gdangs 'dra'i zhal gyi dbus//'od stong 'bar ba'i ljags kyi glog 'phreng g.yo//rab dkar gangs ri'i mche ba gtsigasa'adra'i gseb//log 'dren khrag gi rba rlabs 'khrugs la bstod/ gangs nas bskal pa'i me rlung bu yug 'tshub//rnam gsum spyan gyi nyin byed mngon par g.yo//dmar ser dbu skra sma ra smin ma'i me//dus mtha'i zhugs ltar 'bar ba khyod la bstod//'chi bdag g.yon phyogs las kyi pho nya ma//sngo nag srin mo drag tu khros pa'i gdong //g.yas pa rtse gsum dgra bo'i don snying 'bigs//g.yon pa khrag gang ban+ta'i 'dzin la bstod//'jigs rung dur khrod thod skam 'bar ba'i nang /khyu 0 lda ldi zhing khams mkha' la bres//keng rus gcal bkram mi ro khri ru brtsigs//dgra bgegs gsod pa'i bshan khang ra ba na//snying rje dang bral las kyi tshe srog gshed//mi gdug gshin rje pho mo phyogasabacur rgyu//keng rus gar rtse bya nag 'thab cing lding //'byung po khus 'debs mon pa gar byed sogs//sprul pa yang sprul 'khor tsho gos rgya mtsho yis//rak+ta dmar gyi a: 'di bzhes la//log par 'dren pa'i dam nyams dgra bo 'di'i//snying 8ba tā ga dron mo 'thung la 'phrin las mdzod//de nas bskul ba ni/lhaḥ'achi bdag nag po lho phyogs kyi//rim pa bdun gyi sa 'og na//srog la rngam pa'i gshin rje ni//nag po ma he gdan steng du//ya las byung ba'i dbyug pa ni//thod pas mtshan pa las byung ba'i//gting nas khros pa ma he gdong //za byed zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs//khros pa'i spyan rtsa dmar po 'khrug/skra ser sma ra gyen du brdzes//lag g.yon zhags pas dgra bgegs 'ching //g.yas pa'i dbyug pas rdul du rlog/chos kyi rgyal 0po gshin rje'i tshogs//ma mo chen mo tsa muṇ+ḍi//rtse

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64) gsum thod khrag 'dzin mdzad ma/ /bran dang bcas pa'i dus la bab/ sha chen khrag zhag chen po yi/ /gtor ma rgya mtsho'i mchod pa bzhes/ /rgyal bas bsgos pa'i dam tshig dang / /snying rjes dgra bgegasamyur du sgrol/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ /bdud dang bar du gcod pa rnams/ /bzung zhig chings shig rnam par sdoms/ khug cig drongs shig dbang du sdus/ /sod cig sgrod cig rengasapar gyis/ /phye zhig snun zhig rmugs par gyis/ /thul zhing cho mes shig rnam par shig /rdul phran tsam yang med par mdzod/ /kā la rū pa dgra bgegs mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ skabs 'dir bzlog pa bya/ de nasagatang rag mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ 6 3ཿ〈li kri/ zhes pa nas/ oṃ su bhā wa zhes pa nas stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i zhes sogs bya'o/ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā la/ ma hā kā la/ kā li de wi/ be+e shra wa ṇa/ kā la ྅ pa sa pa ri wā ra a nas/ sha rdi'i bar du mchod/ rmashrī ma hā kā la/ ma hā kā la zhes pa nas/ oṃ āḥlha/ nang mchod kyang 'bul/ yig brgya bzla/ bzod par (19na gso le/ /bsngo ba smon lam nyer bsdu sogs kyang bya/ /rten yod na de nyid la brtan bzhugs bya zhing / /med na rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ /dam tshig pa rang la bsdus te/ yon tan rab rdzogs gangs kyi ri bo bzhin/ /byin rlabs chu bos skal ldan tshim mdzad cing / /rang sems lhan cig skyes pa ston mdzad pa'i/ /chos rje bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /sgrub pa po la bu bzhin gzigs mdzad cing / /mi 'bral lus dang grib ma ji bzhin du/ /dam tshig can la dngos grub mchog ster ba'i/ /yi dam lha tsho gos rnams kyi ྾/ /dam can sgrub pa po yi rjes gong zhing / /zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang mngon spyod sogs/ /sna tsho gos 'phrin las tshul bzhin sgrub mdzad pa'i/ /chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi ྾/ /snang srid rang grol sgyu ma rmi lam bzhin/ /bde ba chen po rgyun chad med pa'i nyams/ /yid la byar med stong gsal nam mkha'i ngang / /bde chen phyag rgya chen po'i ྾/ /sgrub pa po la brten cing mchod pa dang / /skur ba 'debs pa'i skye 'gro gang yin pa/ /thams cad byang chub lam la 'god mdzad pa'i/ /mnyam nyid byang chub sems kyi ྾/ /'khor ba mya ga 'das pa thams cad kyi/ /bkra shis go 'phang ji snyed —104

dam can chos srung mngon rtogs 'phrin la rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)yod pa kun/ /phun sum tshogs pa chu bo'i rgyun bzhin du/ /skye 'gro yongs la rtag tu ྾/ /bsod nams dar rgyas ri rgyal lhun po bzhin/ /snyan grags chen pos nam mkha' bzhin du khyab/ /tshe ring nad med gzhan don lhun grub pa'i/ /yon tan rgya mtsho mchog gi bkra shis shog khes thun mong ma yin pa'i bka' srung rnam pa gnyis bka' sdod dang bcas pa ma ga rta gos pa'i dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyi gtor ma'i cho ga gcig tu bsdebs pa dngos grub nor bu (19ba bo bang gi rgyal po'i gter chen zhesabya ba 'di'ang gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi gnad/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum la rab tu gzhol ba'i bya ba'i khur gyis mngon par mdzes pa'i rig sngags 'chang ba'i khrims ldan 'dus pa'i sde phan bde legs bshad gling pa rnams kyi nyams bzhes su/ chad lhag med cing 'khyer bde bar bsams te/dam pa gong ma'i gsung rnams 'khrugs sdebs su bsgrigs shing tshigs 'phreng gsar du cung zad spel ba 'di'ang / rdo rje 'chang dharma dh+wa dza la sogs pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa du ma'i bka' drin las mngon spyod drag po'i skor la thos bsam gyi sgro 'dogs chod pa'i rig sngags 'chang ba ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho/ ming gzhan zil gnon drag rtsal rdo rje khrag 'thung rnam par rol pa dpa' bo'i zhes nag pa zla ba'i dpa' bo dga' ston gyi tshes la sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni ngag dbang dge legs so/ /rigs brgya'i khyab bdag gsung gi gangs ri las/ /legs 'ongs rgyud sde'i dal 'gro ma lusatshogs/ /sdud mdzad gsang bdag chu gter la gas nas/ /zhang blon mchod thabs nor bu'i 'phreng ba spel/ /bde chen sprin 'byung ngang du rtag rol kyang / /grangs med gzugs sku'i 'bras ldan rnam rol gyis/ /dngos grub 'chi med 'bab ldan stsol mdzad pa'i/ /gnod sbyin bum skyes 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar yid 'ong dga' tshal nang / /bkod legs rin cen las grub ba gam dbus/ /'khor lo rtsibs bzhi lte bar nor bu'i khri/ /sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan steng na/ /gnod sbyin chen po rdo rje bdud 'dul sku/ /mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis srin po'i gzugs/ /dmar (20na)zlum spyan bgrad zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs/ /nyi 'od 'bum 'phrog rin cen rtse phran —105

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)can/ /phyag gnyis yid bzhin nor bu bum pa bsnams/ /sum brtsegs dar nag phod ka gser sked can/ /gar dgu'i nyams ldan zhabs zung sag lham gsol/ /rgyal po rol pa'i tshul gyis rnam par 'gying / /g.yon du yum chen nag mo phyag gnyis kyis/ /nad rkyal rat+na'i gzheng thogs dar dkar gsol/ /rtsibs bzhir nor lha dkar po mgon po nag /'brog gnas mched lnga rnam thos sras la sogs/ /dngos grub stsol zhing bar 'ad sel mdzad pa'i/ /mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul dpag par dka' ba yi/ /bka' nyan dam can tsho gos rnams ma lus kun/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi bsgrub phyir bzhugs su gsol/ /rtsa ba brgyad pa la sogs bzang po dri/ /mngon par 'phro ba'i mchod yon nyal 'gro'i rgyun/ /dbang gzhu ltar bkra sna tsho gis chu skyes tshal/ /lha lam gnyis 'thung la 'gran bdug spos dang / /rta bdun 'bum gyi mdangs ldan mar me'i phreng / /ro brgya'i zas la 'khu ba'i ba smra ta/ /rab snyan ngag gi mtshon cha'i phul byung dbyangs/ /pham byed rol mo'i sgra yis phyogs kun 'gengs/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i dam rdzas la sogs pa/ /dngos bshams yid sprul kun bzang mchod sprin 'dis/ /zhang blon 'khor bcas dgyes pa bskyed gyur nas/ /lugs zung dga' ston ma lus stsal du gsol/ /gtor ma spyi 'gro ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ /oṃ badz+ra rat+na tsit+ta ra gi i rda ba smra ta kha kha/ khā hi 'a hi/ 'khor rnams la a kā ros 'bul lo/ /dbang sngon brtsegs pa'i sa 'dzin na tshod gnas/ /nyal 'gro'i chom rkun rked med kyis 'khrud lta'i/ /lus kyi nyams gsum rdzogs pa'i mthing nag mdog /gnod sbyin bdud 'dul chen po'i sku la bstod/ /rab brjid dbyar gyi rnga gsang cher bsgrag par/ /phul byung tshangs pa'i dbyangs dang ldan nam zhes/ /dpyang thig rnam 'gyur yid kyi me long ngos/ /'char byed khyod gsung sgra 'dzin bdud rtsi'i dpal/ /mtha' bral gsang bdag mkhyen brtse'i lha lam la/ /khyod kyi blo gros snang gter gyis bgrod pas/ /gang la'i las kyi 'od stong spro mdzad thugs/ /rgya wo srid gsum 'dir shong e ma mtshar/ /zhang blon chen po 'bor dang bcas rnams kyis/ /rab stims las kun thoṭa med bsgrub pa dang / khyad par rang gang mo kyi rig gnas gas la'ang sbyor/ gso rig gtsug lag gzhung lugs kun/ /—106

dam can chos srung mngon rtogs 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)dkar phyogs kun phan lta bur rgyas par mdzod//ces zhang blon rdo rje bdud 'dul la mchod gtor 'bul tshul nyung ngu'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di yang /gso rig smra ba blo bzang 'jam dpal gyi ngor//tshangs sras ba shā da pa'i rdo rjes 'phral du smras pa'o//mas thā/bkra shis g.yung drung gcig tu 'khyil ba'i nor//dngos grub bdud rtsi 'byung ba'i za ma tog/gsang bdag gnod sbyin chen por gus btud nas//mchod gtor 'bul tshul nyung ngu'i tshig gis spel//rang nyid skad cig gsang bdag sku mdog mthing //phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pa sdigasamadzub mdzad//rin cen sbrul rgyan dar dang stag sham gsol//rab khros me dpung dbus bzhugasathugs ka nas//'od 'phros mchod gtor spyan gzigs ma lus pa'i//tha mal dngos 'dzin sdig sgrib mi gtsang ba'i//tsho gos rnams sbyangs te ngo bo zag med kyi//bdud rtsi 'dod pa'i yon tan 21na snga ldan gyur//chos dbyings bde chen ngang las ma g.yos kyang //zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las bsgrub pa'i ched//zhang blon chen po 'khor bcas spyan 'dren na//thogs pa med par gnas 'dir da tshur spyon//gnod sbyin chen po mthing nag phyag gnyis kyis//nor bu bum pa rab 'dzin dar nag gi/'jol ber gsol zhing rin cen rgyan gyis spras//gsang yum blon po phyi 'khor bcas pa rnams//mdun du yid 'ong skyed mos tshal gyi dbus//'jam mnyen pad+ma rgyas pa'i lte ba la//mtshams sprin mdangs ldan nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor steng //dgyes pa chen pos brtan par bzhugs su gsol//sman gyis sbags pa'i dri chab mtsho ltar 'khrug/sna tsho gos mdangs ldan me rtag rnam par bkra/khri zhis sposakyi nam mkha'i khyon kun 'geng //mar me'i 'od kyis mun pa'i go skabs 'phrog/ro brgya'i zas kyisabadud rtsi'i dpal kun ster//snyan pa'i sgra yis rna bar rtag tu 'jebs//dam rdzas rgyan dang ldan pa'i gtor ma sogs//phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa'i tsho gis kun 'bul//in+d+ra ni la'i ri bo nyin byed kyis//lan brgyar byugs pa lta bu'i gzi brjid can//dpal ldan gnod sbyin rdo rje bdud 'dul che//'khor dang bcas la gus pas bdag bstod do/0//ba bstan spyi dang khyad par gso rig gi/gzhung

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)lugs yar ngo'i zla ltar rab 'phel zhing / /bdag sogs 'dod pa'i don rnams ma lus pa/ /'bad med lhun gyis 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /cung zad nyes par bgyis pa'i tsho gos rnams kun/ /chos dbyings bde ba'i ngang du bzod par gsol/ /lhun grub pho brang chen por phyir gshegs nas/ /slar yang 'gro ba'i don du 'byon par mdzod/ /(21ba bo pag bsam shing dang yid bzhin nor bu ltar/ /'dod pa'i re ba ma lus ches skong ba'i/ /bstan srung gnod sbyin chen po 'khor bcas kyis/ /dusarnams kun tu bkra shis dga' ston stsol/ /yod blon gyi mchod gtor bdud rtsi'i bum bzang 'di ni rang gi gam du nye bar gnas pa'i bla sman byang ngos pa blo bzang gzhan phan dbang po'i rgyun 'khyer du za hor gyi brdzes bris/ na mo gu ru we/ mchod gtor byin rlabs bde 'jigs gang rung byas la/ mdun du dur khrod 'jigasu rung ba'i dbus/ /pad nyi tsho gos bdag steng na nag po che/ / zhal gcig phyag drug zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum can/ /sna tsho gos rgyan ldan sku las me dpung 'bar/ / he ru ka dpal mgon po phyag bzhi pa/ /zhabs gnyis rgyal po rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs/ /las kyi gshin rje ma he'i gdong pa can/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma he'i steng na 'gying / /srid gsum 'dod khams dbang phyug dre'u la/ /bcibs te mi sdug srin mo'i gar gyis rol/ /stobs ldan dpa' bo 'jigs rung bram ze'i gzugs/ /rnam mang thos sras beg tse lcam dral rnams/ /grangs med 'khor tshogs bcas pa spyan 'dren na/ /thogs pa med par 'dir gshegs gnyis med gyur/ /oṃ sarba badz+ra dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra a: nas/ shabha'i bar brjod/ chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs kyi spyan lam du/ /mchod yon sku skyes bdug spos mar me'i phreng / /dri chab ro brgya'i bas dang snyan pa'i glu/ /gyi ling g.yag rog 'dod pa 'jo ba'i ba/ /sra brtan go khrab gling bzhi lhun po dang / /dam rdzas med du byung ba'i gtor ma sogs/ /dngos bshams yid sprul mchod pas dam can rnams/ /thugs dam stongs la mthun pa'i dngos grub (22na sku'/ /chos srung rnams kyi ljags hūṃ las skyes pa'i rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud drangs te gsol bar gyur/ chas bo badz+ra dharma pā la sogs kyi mthar/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa bdun gyis 'bul/—108
