dam can chos srung ma' rtogs tshon las rnam pha lhun grub/ 9)slar sngags ma sug tu nang mchod 'bul/rgyal ba'i spyan sngar khas blangs mthu ldan pa'i//chos srung rgya mtshos bstan dang de 'dzin skyongs/a par rnal 'byor bdag gi mgon dang gawo//g.yel med mdzod la 'phrin las ma lus sgrubs//zhes pa yang bde mchog bla mas bskul tshe bris//yo.āḥlha gis byin gyis brlabs la/rab 'byams rgyal ba'i mkhyen pa'i nus pa kun//gcig bsdus myur mdzad mgon po 'khor bcas rnams//thogs pa med par gnas 'dir rab gshegs nas//pad nyi bam ro'i gdan la brtan par bzhugs//phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa'i tshogs spyi dang /khyad par dam rdzas rgyan dang ldan pa yi//zag med bdud rtsi'i gtor ma 'di 'bul gyis//bzhes nas dngosagrub ma lus stsal du gsol//in+d+ra nī la'i lhun po wo byed kyis//lan brgyar byugs 'dra'i dpal ldan nag po che//bla mgon dbyer med thugs rje bdag nyid la//lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo//deng nas bzung snye byang tso snying po'i bar//bar gcod bdud dgra'i g.yul las rnam rgyal zhing //zung 'jug dbang gi rgyal po'i go 'phang mchog/tshe 'dir mngon du 'grub par mdzad du gsol//gal te ma gyur dus kyi pho nya yis//zin tshe myur mdzad mgon po zhal bstan nas//22ba7kha' spyod dag pa'i zhing du legs khrid de//rgyal ba'i sras su bskrun par mdzad du gsol//mdun gyi gtor mgron dril bu cang rta'i sgra//'brol zhing 'gying bag gar gyis spyi bo nas//zhugs te snying dbus pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru la//'bral ba med par brtan par bzhugs su gsol//zhes pa 'di'ang pā thur khung tha'i ji'i nyamasalen du za hor gyi bzhes bris//'jig rten dbang phyug thugs rje'i rang snang gar//bod yul rgyal po'i gzugs su legasashar ba'i//srong btsan sgam po'i thugs rje'i 'od dkar gyis//phan bde'i ku mud rgyas pa'i dge legs stsol//bde legs rgya mtsho'i dpal ster mkhan slob zung //bod 'bangs 'gro ba'i gnyen gyur a ti sha/dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs btsong kha pa//mkhyen brtse nus pa'i mthudapung stsal du gsol//rab dkar gangs ri'i mdangs ga sgeg mo'i gzuXs//rab mang 'gro la rjes su chags pa'i nyams//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)rab mdzes rgyal ba'i yum gcig dpal lha mo'i/ /rab 'byams mchod pa'i 'phrin las deng 'dir bshad/ /de'ang rgyal ba'i yum gcig dpal gyi lha mo 'di nyid thugs dam bskang zhing / mchod bstod 'phrin las su bya bar 'dod pa'i skyes bus mchod gtor spyan gzigs sogs mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len ltar du bgyis la/ skyabs 'gro ni/ bdag sogs 'gro ba thams cad byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar du rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sangs rgyas4skyabs su mchi'o/ /chos la mo/ /dge 'dun la ྾/ sangs rgyas chos dang chogs kyi mchog rnams la/ /byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /(23na thad ga gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa 'di dag gis/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /rang nyid dpal rta mgrin du gsal ba'i thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ snod bcud kyi ma dag pa rnams sbyangs/ yaṃ las rlung / raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor/ a las mi mgo'i skyed bu gsum gyi steng na a las thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i steng du oṃ āḥlha gsum gyis mtshan pa/ thugs ka'i 'od kyis rlung gis me sbar te rdzas rnams zhu zhing khol/ yig 'bru gsum las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams kyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug ste yi ge gsum la thim pa ro gcig tu gyur pas/ zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āXlha/ slar yang thugs ka las 'od zer 'phros pas/ a las byung ba'i ka pā la'i nang du hūṃ hūṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin zad mi shes pa'i bdag nyid can/ rnam pa yid du 'ong ba'i 'dod pa'i yon tan mtha' yas par gyur/ byu ji āḥ lha/de bzhin du/ pā:/ badz+ra thi dh+wa pe/ ā lo ke /༷ / ni li te/ shabha āḥlha/ ྅ pa/ shabha/ byu/ ra sa/spar+sha āḥlha/ gtor ma yang nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs/ bdag bskyed ni/ chos kun mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang nyid las/ /pad nyi ru dra bsnol ba'i gdan steng du/ /hūṃ las rang nyid dpal chen rta mgrin sku/ /rab dmar phyag g.yas dbyug to thod khrag g.yon/ /dur khrod chas brgyad 'gying bag gar dgu'i nyams/ /yum chen phag mo mthing nag phyag g.yas kyis/ /gri gug thod khrag 'dzin pas —110

dam can chos srung mngon rtogs 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)sku la 'khril/ /bskal pa'i me dpung klong na bzhugs pa yi/ /spyi gtsug (23ba)pad nyi zla ba'i gdan steng du/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas pad+ma thod phreng rtsal/ /rang rang yum bcas dpa' bo mkha' 'grosabaskor/ /mkha' la dbang po'i gzhu ltar bkra bar gyur/ /hrī 'a 'gyur bde ba chen po'i pho brang nas/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i lha tsho gos rnams/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis thogs med 'dir gshegs nas/ /dam tshig pa dang dbyer med brtan par bzhugs/ /sna tsho gos phyi yi mchod pas sa gzhi khengs/ /dam rdzas nang gi mchod pas bar snang gang / /gsang ba gnyis med sbyor ba'i bde ba che/ /dgyes dgur rol la dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /ma bcos spros bral bla ma chos kyi skuḥ pad chen longs spyod bla ma chos kyi rje pad sdong las 'khrungs bla ma sprul pa'i sku: sku gsum rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥde nas mdun bskyed ni/ ཿ bhā wa shu d+dha mi rba dharmā su bhā wa shudhe3lha/ 'khor 'das brtan g.yo chos thams cad stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ rang gi mdun du rab dkar dar gyi gur khang 'ja' tshon rnam par bkra ba'i dbus su/ baṃ raṃ a las/ pad+ma nyi ma zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+yo dkar po las dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi yum gcig dpal gyi lha mo shel dkar gyi lhun po zla bzhun lan brgyar byugs pa lta bur rgyas pa'i zhas khyim zhi 'dzum khro chags sgeg pa'i nyams ldan phyag g.yas kyis srid gsum dbang du sdud pa'i mda' dbang po'i gzhu ltar bkra ba'i dar dang / chos kun rjen par ston pa'i me long gis brgyan pa 'dzin cing / g.yon yid bzhin gyi nor bus phyur ba'i gzheng pa bsnams pa/ rin po che sna tshogs pa'i phras bkod pa'i rgyan gyis dbu dang phyag zhabs sogs sku'i cha thams cad rnam par brgyan pa/ dar gyi (24na ltad g.yogs dang smad g.yogs sogs lhab lhub tu mdzes par klubs shing / dbu la rma bya'i mdongs kyi grib bsil can/ zhabs gnyis sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i mdun du las mkhan chu srin gdong can sku mdog mun pa'i mdangs ldan g.yas zhags pa nag po dgra la 'debs shing / g.yon khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa/sbom zhing thung la yan lag rags pa/ srin mo drag tu khros pa'i gzugs kyis dgra bgegs kyi thog tu —1//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)'phyo ba/ rgyab tu bka' sdod seng ge'i gdong can sku mdog dmar nag kha gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs nas dgra la 'o dod 'bod pa/ g.yas zhags pa dang g.yon don snying 'dzin pa/ dmar zlum spyan gsum phyi rjes su blta zhing rjes su 'brang ba/ de'i 'khor du bkra shis tshe ring ma dkar mo gangs ri'i mdzes pa 'phrog pa/ g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon bum pa 'dzin cing seng ge la bcibs pa/ mthing gi zhal bzang ma in+d+ra ni la'i mdangs can/ ba dan dang me long 'dzin cing rkyang la bcibs pa/ mi g.yo blo bzang ma gser gyi mdog can g.yas zas kyi gzheng pa dang / g.yon ne'u le bzung nas stag la bcibs pa/ cod ban mgrin bzang ma pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs ldan/ g.yas nor bu dang g.yon gter sgrom 'dzin cing sha ba la bcibs pa/ gtad dkar 'gro bzang ma ma ra ta rka'i mdog can g.yas du bo dang / g.yon sgrul zhags 'dzin cing 'brug la bcibs pa/ rdo rje kun grags ma sngon mo rgyan mtshan dang me long 'dzin cing 'brug la bcibs pa/ rdo rje g.ya' ma skyong ser mo ral gri dang zhags pa bsnams shing rkyang la bcibs pa/ rdo rje kun bzang ma dmar ser rdo rje dang bum pa 'dzin cing seng ge la bcibs pa/(24ba'i brog chen 'khor 'dul sngon mo ru mtshon dang zhags pa 'dzin cing dre'u la bcibs pa/ rdo rje spyan gcig ma dkar mo gser zor dang bum pa bsnams shing sha ba la bcibs pa/kha rag khyung btsun ser mo cang te'u dang me long 'dzin cing khyung la bcibs pa/ gser chen mkha' lding dmar po par bu dang sprul zhags 'dzin cing rta la bcibs pa/ rdo rje drag mo rgyal ljang gu be con dang 'khar gzheng 'dzin cing 'phar ba la bcibs pa/ rdo rje dpal mo che dkar mo mda' dar dang sgrom bu 'dzin cing rta la bcibs pa/ rdo rje sman gcig ma ser mo 'brang rgyas 'dzin cing mdzo la bcibs pa/rdo rje g.yar mo sil ser mo rin po che dang ting shags 'dzin cing yu mo la bcibs pa/ dril bu gzugs legs ma sngon mo pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin cing stag la bcibs pa/ de dag rnams kyang khro chags sgeg pa'i nyams ldan/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi lhab lhub can/ dpag par dka' ba'i rdzu'aphrul gyis rgyal ba'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang / 'phrin las rnam bzhi bsgrub pa la myur ba'i shugs dang —112

dam can chos srung mngon rtogs 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)bcas pa/ rig 'dzin dam tshig can gyi drod myul zhing nyams pa'i srog dbugs len pa la dpa' ba/mchog thun gyi dngos grub char ltar 'bebs par byed pa'i gtso 'khor de dag gi phyi rol tu snang srid dregs pa'i 'khor dpag tu med pas bskor ba'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ bdag nyid kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas/ ye shes rang snang las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang nas dpal gyi lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ dpal gyi lha mo 'khor bcas mkha' la sprin phung 'khrigs pa ltar byon par bsams la/ rol mo dbyangs dang bcas pas/ bh+yoḥ dus gsum (25na skos ba'i mkhyen brtse'i mkha' dbyings las/ /srid gsum dbang mo dung skyong 'od dkar can/ /grangs med thub bstan 'dab stong rgyas pa'i phyir/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar gyis gnas 'dir gshegs/ /bad dkar zla ba rgyas pa'i gdan steng du/ /kha ba'i rdul brtsegs mdangs ldan 'jo sgeg can/ /yid 'phrog mig la bdud rtsi'i dpal ster ma/ /'dod khams bdag mo 'khor bcas gsheṭa su gsol/ /sna tsho gos rin cen rgyan gyi phyang phrul can/ /rnam bkra dar gyi phang phung ci yang g.yo/ /zhi 'dzum 'gying bag nyams ldan rgyal ba'i yum/ /dpal ldan dung skyong rgyal mo ྾/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /ngo mtshar sku yi rnam rol mtha' klas pa/ /ston mdzad ma mo kun gyi gtso mo che/ /ma gcig dpal gyi lha mo ྾/ /'jig rten dbang phyug srong btsan sgam po dang / /mtsho skyes rdo rje nyang ban dge ba 'bum/ /rtsa brgyud bla mas 'phrul snang gtsug lag khang / /gnyer gtad srung ma'i gtso mo ྾/ /bh+yoḥ gdod nas lhun grub pho brang nas/ /rnal 'byor srung ma yongs kyi rje/ /dpal gyi lha mo 'khor bcas rnams/ /gnas 'dir spyan 'dren thogs med gshegs/ /lha lam yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /nyin byed thogs med rgyu ba ltar/ /dpal gyi sogs tshig rkang gnyis po 'gre /gnam sngon bzhu 'dra'i rdzing bu la/ /gnyis skyes lus dkar 'du ba ltar ྾/ /chu skyes ge sar rgyas pa la/ /rkang drug dgyes dgur spyod pa ltar ྾/ /gangs kyi nor 'dzin mthon po'i spor/ /gdong lnga'i dbang po 'gying ba ltar/ /tshang tshing 'khrigs pa'i nags klung dbus/ /—113

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)rgya stag grus ma 'phyo ba ltar ྾/ /ris med thugs(25ba)rje chen po yis/ /rgyal rnams 'gro la nyer dgongs ltar ྾/ /bh+yoḥ kun gsal bu mo'i 'gram pa la chags pa'i/ /mi phyed mtshams sprin gzhen nus legs hrūd pa/ /rnam 'dren nyi ma'i gnyen gyi bstan srung mchog /thogs med rdzu 'phrul dbang gisaganas 'dir gzhags/ /smin mchog lta bur mi mthun nad kyi dpung / /rnam par gzhom pa'i dngosagrub ster mdzad lha/ /rab 'byams zhiba'i las bsgrub dpal lha mo/ /thogs med rdzu la dbang ྾/ /dpag bsam shing ltar tshe dpal longs spyod kun/ /'bad med lhun gyis grub par ster mdzad pa'i/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i las mdzad dpal lha mo ྾/ /yid bzhin nor ltar gsol ba btab tsam gyis/ /khams gsum kun la thogs med mnga' sgyur ba'i/ /rab 'byams dbang gi las mdzad dpal lha mo ྾/ /rdo rje'i thog ltar log 'dren gdug pa'i tshogs/ /ming gi lhag mar gtor ba'i mthu rtsal can/ /rab stims drag po'i las mdzad dpal lha mo ྾/ kyeḥ rnal 'byor yongs kyi srung ma'i gtso/ /ma g.yel ma g.yel deng 'dir gson/ /rtse gcig gdung bas gsol 'debs na/ /gnas 'dir gshegs la dngos grub stsol/ /rnal 'byor ྾/ /ma g.yel ྾/ /yid 'phrog gzugs kyis gar byed na/ /gnas 'dir ྾/ /rnal 'byor ྾/ /ma g.yel ྾/ /rab snyan dbyangs su len byed na/ /gnas mo//rnal mo/ /ma g.yel ྾/ /yongs 'du lta bu'i dri 'thul na/ /gnas mo/ /rnal 'byor ྾/ /ma g.yel ྾//ro brgya'i zas tshogs bsham byed na/ /gnas mo/ /rnal 'byor ྾/ /ma g.yel za/ /lha rdzas dbang gzhu ltar bkra na/ /gnas mo/ /bh+yoḥ nor 'dzin khur gyi bteg pa'i (26na la gyi dbus/ /dge mtshan rgya mtshor 'khyil ba skyid shod kyi/ /yul gru'i lte ba 'phrul snang gtsug lag khang / /srung mdzad mkha' 'gro'i dbang mo gshegs su gsol/ /dam ldan rnal 'byor bu bzhin legs skyong zhing / /mi bsrun dgra bgegs phye mar 'thag mdzad pa'i/ /gtso mo'i snga phyir rgyu ba'i las byed mkhan/ /bka' sdod gdong can rnam gnyis ྾/ /mdzes shing brjid chags yid 'phrog lha mo'i gzugs/ /mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol la zla bral ma/ /tshe ring mched lnga bstan ma bcu gnyis po/ /'khor bcas thogs pa med —114

dam can chos srung mag rtogs phren las rnam sto lhun grub/ rtogepar ྾//oṃ shrī de sa sa pa ri wā ra e khyo hi dzaḥlha baṃ ho gnyis su med par gyur/bzhugs su gsol ba ni/sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan bzhad pa'i steng //chu shel dbang po'i dkyil 'khor la//ma gcig 'dod khams dbang phyug ma//'khor bcas dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs//pad+ma ka ma lā ya rto/phyag ni/'gro 'di'i khams dang bsam pa ji bzhin du//zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po'i 'phrin las kyis//sna tshogs sprul pa nyi ma'i 'od zer ltar//grangs med spro bar mdzad pa khyod la bstod//ces rje dge 'dun rgya mtsho ni dpal gyis mdzad do//mchod pa 'bul ba ni//mchod yon chal chil g.yo ba'i chu gter dbus//'dam skyes phang phung ze'u 'bru ci yang ldem//nam mkha'i glang por 'gran pa'i dri zhim spos//sgron me'i 'phreng bas mun pa'i go skabs bskrad//yongs 'du'i ngad pa 'thul ba'i nyal 'gro'i rgyun//grangs med ro brgya'i dpal 'dzin zhal zas dang //snyan brjid rol mor bcas pa'i tshogasarnams 'bul//bzhes nas dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol//oṃ shrī 26ba8 sa sa pa ri wā ra a nas/sha rdi'i bar brjod/lha mi'i lang tsho'i dpal 'dzin rked med mas//sna tsho gos gang bsgyur rgyud mang bi wang 'brol//rin cen snod du dri yi byug pa dang //bdud rtsi'i bza' dang btung ba ci yang thogs//'jam mnyen lha yi reg bya'i khyad par can//rlung gi rgyal mtshan lta bur rab bkra ba//dngos bshams yid kyis sprul te legs par 'bul//bzhes nas ra//oṃ shrī de sa sa pa ri wā ra rā pa nas/spar+sha'i bar brjod/mi mas gdung skyob gdugs dkar nor bu'i tog/rab gsal 'dzam bu'i gser las grub pa'i nya//mi zad gter gyi 'byung gnas bum pa bzang //dkar 'jam lo 'dab g.yo ba'i pad+ma dang //snyan pa'i grags pa 'bar ba'i g.yas 'khyil dang //bkra shis dpal gyi be'u mtshan ma can//phyogs las rnam rgyal rgyal mtshan 'khor lo 'bul//bzhes nas ྾//oṃ shrī de sa sapa ri wā ra aṣ+ṭa me ga la liṅga pra tī ts+tsha swā hā/gling bzhir dbang sgyur gser gyi 'khor lo dang //ci bsams 'dod pa 'jo ba'i yid bzhin nor//zag med bde ba'i mchog ster btsun mo dang //phun tshogs 'byor ba'i dbang phyug khyim gyi bdag/sdebazhi'i khur gyis mi ngal gnyis 'thung dbang //stong

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)gsum skad cig bgrod pa'i cang shes rta//g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i dmag dpon 'bul//bzhes nas mo//oṃ shrī de sa sa pa ri wā ra sa ltarat+na pra tī ts+tsha swā hā/nang mchod 'bul ba ni/bla med bdud rtsi'i mchod pa dam pa 'di/dngos dang brgyud pa'i bla ma'i tsho gis rnams dang //yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tsho gos rnams la 'bul//bzhes nas sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol//gu ru maṇ+ḍal de sa sa pa ri wā ra byu ཿlha//chos sku snang mtha' longs sku spyan ras 27na gzigs//sprul sku thong bawo o rgyan pad+ma 'byung //gter ston dngos grub mnga' bdag to ral la//myong grol sman mchod 'bul lo dngos grub stsol//ā+oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/tshig rkang tha ma dang sngags 'di kun la 'gre//mi bskyod rdo rje rje bas shākya bzang //lha rje dge 'bum drin can sangs rgyas lcam//chu sgom zhig po dge 'dun dpal bzang la ྾//sangs rgyas seng ge tshul khrims rgyal mtshan dang //sangs rgyasabartson sa sangs rgyas bde ོ zhabs//rin cen dpal 'byor pad+ma sangs rgyas la ྾//nyi zla sangs rgyas 'khon ston rdo rje lang /khyab bdag zur ོ chos dbyings rang grol dpal//bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma lar//phra mo sbom po las byung ba'i//byin gyis brlabs pa'i nang mchod 'di//dpal ldan lha mo la 'bul gyi//bstan pa bsrung phyir bzhes su gsol//oṃ shrī de sa sa pa ri wā ra ma hā pañtsa a gra ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/g.yin yang gtsug lag khang 'di nyid kyi gzhi bdag gzhug mar gnas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥlha/'og nas khrung ba ltar gtor ma 'bul/bh+yoḥ'agyur med chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang //rnam mang zhi ba'i sprul pa ston mdzad pa//thub pa'i bstan srung mthu stobs nus pa'i bdag/dpal ldan lha mo khyod la bdag bstod do//rab dkar pad+ma'i 'dab ma rgyas pa'i dbus//rab gsal zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang steng //rab mdzes lang tsho'i dpal kun gcig bsdus lha//rab 'byams rgyal ba'i yum gyur khyod la bstod//rab brjid gser gyi lhun po brtsegs pa la//rab ba po dbang po'i gzhu yis 'khyud 'dra ba'i//rab sgeg gzug kyi rnam 'gyur ston mdzad pa//2tha' ba 'byams za//rab dmar sdi ru'i 'khri shing gzhi nu gang //rab mang 'gro la

dam ༅ chos srung ma' rtogs phren las rnam sto lhun grub/ 9)rjes chags nyams ldan pa//rab mnyen chu skyes rgod 'dra'i 'dzum bag can//rab stims ra//rab khros mi sdug srin mo'i rnam 'gyur gyis//rab tu nye bar 'tshe ba'i gdug pa'i dgra//rab rnon mtshon gyis srog rtsa gcod mdzad pa'i//rab 'byams ྾/bshags pa ni/bh+yoḥkhyab bdag rdo rje las pa dang srong bas rje//pad+ma 'byung gnas la sogs dngos brgyud kyi//bla ma yi dam chos srung rgya mtsho rnams//rnal 'byor bdag la deng 'dir dgongs su gsol//bde legs rtsa ba drin can bla ma la//tha mal 'dzin dang log par blta ba bshags/dngos grub 'byung gnas yi dam lha tsho gis kyi//rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams pa bshags//'phrin las bsgrub mdzad chos skyong srung ma la//mchod gtor gtang rag dus su chags pa bshags/khyad par dpal gyi lha mo 'khor bcas kyi//sku gsung thugs la nongs pa'i tshogs kun bshags/ /don dam ngang du rmi lam skyes bu bzhin/ /bshags dang bshags bya'i yul rnams ma grub kyang //tha snyad rten cing 'brel 'byung slu med ngor//nyes kun snying nas bshags so dag par mdzod/bh+yoḥye shes lhun grub gzhal yas na/khams gsum dbang mdzad lha mo'i sku//thugs rje 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs ma//'dir spyon dam skongs bzhugs su gsol//chos rgyal bka' yi srung ma khyed//bstan ma bstoganyis 'khor gyis bskor//yid 'ong gzugs mdzes bkra shis ma//lha mo khyed la sku khrus gsol//'dod khams srid pa'i rgyal mo la//nyams chags sgrib pa mi mnga' yang //bdag cag bar chad sel ba'i phyir//2ra tha dud rtsi sman gyis sku khrus gsol//'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan//thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med//byin mas ye shes chu yi ga kho//ci 'dod dngosagrub stsal du gsol//'dod dgu stsol ba'i lha mo la//gling bzhi ri rab nyi zlar bcas//ma rmos lo tog rin cen bdun//blo yis blangs nas ma par 'bul//mtsho dang rdzing bu me tog dang //ljon shing gos bur bcas pa dang //yid 'ong sil ma bkram pa sogs//gus pa'i yid kyis mchode par 'bul//gser g.yu mu tig snang gsal dang ///ba mdzes me rtag 'phreng ba dang //gdugs dang

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)rgyal mtshan ba dan sogs/ /lha mo khyed la mchod par 'bul/ /zas chang kun gyi phud bsdus nas/ /bdud rtsi lnga ru byin gyis brlabs/ /gsang ba phud kyi rgya mtsho 'di/ /lha mo khyed la mchod par 'bul/ /'dod yon rnam lnga'i longs spyod dang / /rol mo sil snyan bdug spos dang / /sna tsho gos dar sna'i lhab lhub sogs/ /lha mo khyed la mchod par 'bul/ /thog ma med nas da lta'i bar/ /las ga sdig sgrib ci bsags pa/ /lha mo khyed kyi spyan snga sa /ma gsang 'gyod pas po shags par bgyi/ /deng nas ji srid 'tsho yi bar/ /mi dge'i sdig pa yongs spangs nas/ /lusang ga yid gsum dge la bskul/ /bsod na mas tshogos la rjes yi rang / /bdag so gos rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi /'gal rkyen bar chad zhib dang / /longs spyod lha dang mnyam par mdzod/ /sngon gyi las dang gol gyi rkyen/ /gdon dang bgegs rigasathams cad kyang / /zhi zhing med par mdzad du gsol/ /rgyal khams kun tu char phob la/ /lo phyugasartag tu legs par mdzod/ /ces lha lung (28ba bo pa la rdor gyis rgyal po sdig can bgrongs dus grib sel du mdzad pa'o/ /de nas thugs dam bskang ba ni/ mchod yon/ me rta go /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo/ rta/ g.yag lug bya/ khyi/ go mtshon/ mda' dar/ me long sogs mchod pa'i yo byad rnams tshogis par byas nas/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis mchode pa'i rdzas rnams kyi ma dag pa'i skyon rnams sbyangs/ dpal gyi lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa mnyes par byed pa'i spyan gzigs sa gzhi bar snang gi khyen kun khyab par gyur/ oṃ sarba bid pā ra pā ra/ su ra su ra/ā wa rta ya ā wa rta ya sto badz+ra spra ra ṇa khaṃ/ oṃ su bhā wa bi shurnya dharmā te badz+ra sirnyi hūṃ/ na masarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe ༷ ཿ sarba thā kho ca te lpa ra ṇa i me ga ga na re swā hā/ oṃ a khra te hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā khā+e ā du nut+pa sno t+t+waṃ na/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo gi te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūṃ/ oṃ ru ru sbu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sirnya lo tsa ni sarba ar+sha su dha na swā hā/ bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang / /chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis/ /don rnams gang dag bsams pa kun/ /de dag thams cad ci rigs pa/ /thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig /rol mo —118

dam can cho srung ma' rtogs sun las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)dbyangs dang bcas pas/ /bh+yo: dri med yid kyi lha lam yangs pa la/ /legs sprul mchod pa'i chu 'dzin rnam par 'khrigs/ /dngos bshams nor ldan khyon kun rab bkang bas/ /bstan srung dbang mo dgyes pa bskyed gyur cig /rin cen las grub yangs pa'i snod rnams su/ /— klung ltar dngasapa'i chu rgyun dang / /dmar chen rba rlabs chal chil g.yo ba can/ /dngos(29na 〉 ga mas yid sprul mchod yon tsho gis rnams kyis/ /dpal gyi lha mo gdong can rnam pa gnyis/ /tshe ring mched lnga bstan ma bcu gnyis sogs/ /'khor tsho gos rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskongs gyur nas/ /'gal rkyen bzlog la mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /dpal gyi sogs tshig rkang bzhi po kun la 'gre'o/ /'chi med dga' tshal gsar du bskrun pa lta'i/ /yid 'ong chu skyes yal 'dab phang phung g.yo/ /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i dbang po lnga brtsegs pa'i/ /dngos bshams yid sprul me rtag tsho gis rnams kyis/ /dpal gyi ྾/ /tshe ring ྾/ /'khor tshogs ྾/ /'gal rkyen ྾/ /dbyar dus char sprin gsar pa 'khrigs pa la/ /'gran par rab nus thal ba'i snying po dang / /tsan+dan dkar dmar sha chen rab bsregs pa/ /dngos bshams yid sprul bdug spos tshogis rnams kyis/ /dpal gyi ྾/ /tshe ring ྾/ /'khor tsho gos sko/ /'gal rkyen ྾/ khrid pa'i rtse mor bsnyeg pa'i dus mtha'i me/ /grangs med 'phreng ba tshar du legs bstar zhing / /'od kyi snang ba ster ba'i nor bu sogs/ /dngos bshams yid sprul snang gsal tshogs rnams kyis/ /dpal gyi ྾/ /tshe ring ྾/ /'khor tshogs ྾/ /'gal rkyen ྾/ /tshar du dngar ba'i ngad ldang sman gyi tshogs/ /rnyog bral dngas pa'i rdzing bur lhan cig tu/ /bsres shing gdug pa'i khrag zhag 'khyil ba yi/ /dngos bshams yid sprul dri chab tsho ge rnams kyis/ /dpal gyi ྾/ /tshe ring ྾/ /'khor tshogs ྾/ /'gal rkyen ྾/ /skabs gsum pa yi bza' dang bca' ba la /bdud rtsi'i thigs pas sbran pa'i ro bro zhing / sha dang rus phung ri ltar spungs pa yi/ /dngos bshamasayid sprul zhal zas tshog rnams kyis/ /dpal gyi ྾/ /tshe ring ྾/ /'khor tsho gos mo/ /'gal rkyen ྾/ /rdza rnga zom rnga pi wang gling bu dang / /snyan 'gyur glu dbyangs drag po'i nga ro'i gdangs/ /zin dang ma zin —119

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)gyur pa'i sgra yi tshogs//dngos bshams yid sprul rol mo'i tsho gis rnams kyis//dpal gyi ྾//tshe ring ྾//'khor tshoṭa ྾//'gal rkyen ྾//bh+yoḥstong gsum ma lus cig car myul ba la//29bdus mtha'i rlung gi shugs dang mtshudas pa yi//mdzes pa'i sga srab chas kyis legs brgyan pa'i//dngos bshams yid sprul rta mchog tshon rnams kyis//dpal gyi ྾//tshe ring ྾//'khor tsho gos mo//'gal rkyen ྾//mkha' lding dbang po'i mchu sder ltar rno ba'i//mi bzad rdo rje wor ba'i rwa rtseg//mig sman mdangs kyi spu sdug rab zhol ba//dngos bshams yid sprul g.yag rog tsho gis rnams kyis//dpal gyi ྾//tshe ring ྾//'khor tsho gis mo//'gal rkyen ྾//in+d+ra ni la 'khyil 'dra'i rwa bzhi can//sprin dkar lang long g.yo 'dra'i 'jam pa'i spu//rnam mang dar gyi cod pan g.yo ba yi//dngos bshams yid sprul lug gi tshoṭi rnams kyis//dpal gyi ྾//tshe ring ྾//'khor tsho gis ra//'gal rkyen ྾//spu gri lta bur rno ba'i mchu sder can//mun pa'i khu bas byugs pa'i lus 'degs kyis//lha lam 'phur lding gar gyis 'gengs byed pa'i//dngos bshams yid sprul bya nag tshogs rnams kyis//dpal gyi ྾//tshe ring ྾//'bor tsho gos mo//'gal rkyen ྾//ce spyang spyon pa lta bur 'dur snyo rgyug/stag mo mi ro za ltar ngar zhing 'gying //dgra bo'i don snying len la ches rngams pa'i//dngos bshams yid sprul khyi nag tshogs rnams kyis//dpal gyi ྾//tshe ring ྾//'khor tshoṭi ྾//'gal rkyen ྾//bh+yoḥsmyug rkang 'dab chags sgro yis legs sgron zhing //gnam lcags mde'u sbyar ba'i lhag phran la//dar tshon me long rgyan gyis spras pa yi//dngos bshams yid sprul mda' dar tsho gos rnams kyis//dpal gyi ྾//tshe ring ྾//'khor tshogs ྾//'gal rkyen ྾//ri gser las grub pa'i yol go'i nang //phun gas 'dod pa 'jo ba'i nor bu'i ga kho//phyur bur spungs pa'i 'od stong 'phro ba mā//dngos bshams yid sprul nor gzhed rdzo rnams kyis//dpal gyi ྾//tshe ring ྾//'khor tsho gis mo//'gal rkyen ྾//'chi med bzo bo'i lag pad kyis bskrun pa'i//bkod legs nor bu'i phras mdzes rtse bran la//man+da ra yi 'phreng 0bas byugs ris pa//dngos bshams yid sprul

dam ༅ chos srung mja rtogs wen las rnam sto lhun grub/ 9)cod pan tshogs rnams kyis//dpal gyi ྾//tshe ring ྾//'khor tshogs ྾//'gal rkyen ྾//mgul pa rked skabs phyag zhabs la sogs pa//mtha' klas 30na 'an cen las grub phyang phrul dang //'jam mnyen lha yi reg bya ji snyed pa//dngos bshams yid sprul rgyan gos tsho zhe rnams kyis//dpal gyi ྾//tshe ring ྾//'khor tsho gos za//'gal rkyen ྾//lha mi'i rin cen las grub kā la sha/legs bris dbang pos spyad bya'i zil dngar gyi//mi 'dzad btung ba mchog gis ches gang ba//dngos bshams yid sprul bum bzang tshogs rnams kyis//dpal gyi ྾//tshe ring ྾//'khor tshogs ྾//'gal rkyen ྾//be+eḍūr dkar po'i mdangs la rab 'khu zhing //gas ba'i snying po ro 'dzin bde ster ba'i//nyal 'gro'i rgyun bzhin 'o ma rtag 'bab pa//dngos bshams yid sprul 'dod 'jo'i ba tshogasakyis//dpal gyi ྾//tshe ring ྾//'khor tshogs ྾//'gal rkyen ྾//gang zhig mtshon cha'i 'khrul 'khor grangs med kyis//ji tsam bto kyang gcod par mi nus pa'i//sra brtan rdo rje 'bar ba'i khrab rmog sogs//dngos bshams yid sprul go cha'i tshogs rnams kyis//dpal gyi ྾//tshe ring ྾//'khor tsho gos sko//'gal rkyen ྾//dgra srog gnam lcags rdo rje las grub kyang //skad cig nyid la thal bar brlag 'gyur ba'i//gri gug ral gri mdung thung dgra sta sogs//dngos bshams yid sprul mtshon cha'i tshogs rnams kyis//dpal gyi ྾//tshe ring ྾//'khor tshogs ྾//'gal rkyen ྾//dam rdzas gtore ma ri rab lta bur spungs//bdud rtsi rak+ta rgya mtsho'i rlabs ltar 'khrug/mtha' yasamachod pa mkha' la skar ltar 'khrigs//dngos bshams yid sprul spyan gzigs tshogs rnams kyis//dpal gyi ྾//tshe ring ྾//'khor tshogs ྾//'gal rkyen ྾/khel dang be+eḍūr pad rā ka dbang sngon las/ /legs grub lhun po rnam rgyal khang bzang dang / /rta bdun kun phan gling bzhi gling phran sogs//dngos bshams yid sprul mthun rdzas tshogs rnams kyis//dpal gyi ྾//tshe ring ྾//'khor tshogs ྾//'gal rkyen ྾//ngag gi dbang phyug dbyangs can lha mo yi//mi 'gyur bde chen klong du ro gcig kyang //zhi rgyas dbang drag sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar//bstan par yid kyis nges rnyed

rgyas dbang lnga po ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)rten mchog 'dis//dpal gyi ྾//tshe ring ྾//'khor tshogs ྾//'gal rkyen ྾//skabs 'dir gtor ma phyag len ltar 'bul//bh+yoḥdage 30bathags 'dod dgu stsol ba'i dpal lha mo//nad gdon bgegs dang bar du gcod pa rnams//zhi mdzad lha mo zhi ba'i ngang tshul can//zhi zhing 'dzum la rab mdzes yid 'ong ma//zhi ba'i 'khor gyis bskor ba'i gtso mo khyod//phan bde'i 'byung gnas ra sa 'phrul snang la//'byung ba me yi gnod pa bsrung ba dang //'phrin las rnam bzhi phyogs bcur rgyasapar mdzod//dngos grub thun mong stsol mdzad dpal lha mo//tshodang bsod nams dpal ra grags pa rnams//rgyas mdzad lha mo rgyas pa'i ngang tshul can//rgyas pa'i sku la rin cen gser g.yus spras//rgyas pa'i 'khor gyis bskor ba'i gtso mo khyed//phan bde'i 'byung gnas ra sa phrul snang la//'byung ba chu yi gnod pa bsrung ba dang //'phrin las rnam bzhi phyogs bcur rgyas par mdzod//'dod khamasakun la dbang mdzad dpal lha mo//srid gsum kun gyi rin cen bang mdzod rnams//dbang mdzad lha mo dbang gi ngang tshul can//dbang phyug mdzes ma dar gyi na bza' gsol//dbang ldan 'khor gyis bskor ba'i gtso mo khyod//phan bde'i 'byung gnas ra sahrūl snang la//log 'dren mi yi gnod pa bsrung ba dang //'phrin las rnam bzhi phyogs bcur rgyas par mdzod//sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba'i dpal lha mo//log 'dren 'dul phyir khros shing rngam pa'i tshul//drag mdzad lha mo drag po'i mthu rtsal can//drag po'i stobs ldan bgegs dpung tshar gcod ma//drag po'i 'khor gyis bskor ba'i gtso mo khyod//phan bde'i 'byung gnas ra sa 'phrul snang la//mtha' dmag 'byung po'i gnod pa bsrung ba dang //'phrin las rnam bzhi phyogs bcur rgyas par mdzod/khes chos rgyal srong btsan sgam posa'aphrul snang gi srung mar bskos 31na yis mdzad do//de ltar gtor ma gong ltar byin gyis brlabs la//dpal gyi lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags rdo rje rtse gcig pa 'od kyi sbu gus gtore ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar gyur/oṃ shrī de sa sa pa ri wā ra i rda ba lo ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/zhes pa bdun nam nyi shu rtsa gcig gang rung gis gtso mo dang /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya ḍa gī ni ma ma pañtsa sirnyi dz+nyā na 2

dam can chos srung ma' rtogs tshon las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)sa ma ya i rda ba smra ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/zhes pas tshe ring mched lnga dang /oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā 'o ā du nut+pa na tā ta/na maḥsarba ta thā ga to bh+yo bi shwa mu khe 6 ཿsarba thā khaṃ ud+ma te lpa ra ṇa i me ba lim ta kha kha khā hi 'a hi/zhes lan gsum gyis bstan ma bcu gnyis sogs 'khor spyi la 'bul//oṃ shrī de sa sa pa ri wā ra a nas/shabha'i bar brjod/shrī de sa sa pa ra wā ra oṃ āḥlha/gtor rdzongs ni/bh+yoḥmathu stobs dbang phyug srung ma 'khor bcas kyis//rtsa brgyud bla ma'i dam tshig nyer dgongs la//nyes pa'i skyon bral bkod pas khyad 'phags pa'i//dam rdzas med byung gtor ma 'di bzhes la//rgyal ba'i bstan dang bla ma'i sku tshe spel//'dus sde bshad sgrub 'khor lo nye bar tshugs//phan bde'i 'byung gnas lha ldan gtsug lag khang //bskal brgyar 'gyur med g.yung drung ltar brtan zhing //'thab rtsod nyer 'tshe dus kyi 'khrug pa dang //nad yams mtha' dmag gdug pa'i gnod pa sogs//nag po bdud kyi bar chad kun zhi nas//mas rkyen yid bzhin 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//gzhi bdag gtor ma ni/chabadz+ra a khra ta kuṇ+ḍali ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ su bhā was stong par sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las : las rin po che'i stod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma bdud rtsi'i 31brgya mtsho chen por gyur/yo.āḥlha/de bzhin gshegs pa rin cen mang la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs mdzes dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin gshegs pa sku 'byams klas la phyag 'tshal lo/de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo//mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di nyid sa bdag sa'i lha mos gtso byas yul phyogs sa phyogs 'di nyid du gnas pa'i lha klu btsan bdud rgyal po sa bdag gnyen mthu bo che gzhi bdag gnas bdag thams cad la 'bul lo//bdag cag yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi 'gal rkyen sol/mthun rkyen sgrubs/ji ltar bsams pa'i don thams cad lhun gyis grub par mdzad du gsol/bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni//zhes pa nas/thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig/bstod pa ni/bh+yoḥka chen stong gis bteg pa'i gzhal med khang /kha bad tog sogs rin cen las grub dbus//ga pur

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)ngad ldang 'dzum pa'i zhal khyim can/ /nga ro'i sgra dbyangs phyogs bcur sgrog la bstod/ kho co lasa'adas 'gag med rdo rje'i dbyangs/ /cha lugs zhi rgyas nyams kyi gar mkhan ma/ /ja kha'i thor tshugasarin cen rgyan spras shing / /nya rgyas bsil sbyin mkhan ltar mdzes la bstod/ /ta ming la sogs gnam skos rgyal po dang / /tha mal skye bo'i tshogs kyis mchode pa'i gnas/ /da lta phan bde'i rtsal ga ra sa'adi/ /na ma rer yang brgya phrag bsrang la bstod/ /pa sangs ltar dkar thub bstan yongs kyi sgo/ /pha mtha' yas par phye ba'i bde legs kyi/ /ba dan srid gsum byas par rab bsgreng bas/ /ma rungs g.yul las rgyal ba khyod la bstod/ /tsa ri la sogs gnam bsten rtag (32nasgo cho de cing / /tsha gdung khyad bsad bzlas brjod lhur len pa/ /dzo bo shing ltar lus kyi nyams 'phel zhing / /wa ler chos kyi gnas lugs 'char la 'dud/ /zha yig gzugs ltar 'khyil ba'i nor bu'i rgyan/ /za 'og rnam par bkra ba'i lhab lhub gos/ /'a cag lha mi'i 'dod dgur longs spyod pa'i/ /ya mtshan rnam 'gyur cir yang ston la bstod/ /ra ba gangs kyis bskor ba'i dbus 'gyur 'dir/ /la klungs bgrod dka'i yul gyi phun tshogs kun/ ga stag gcig tu 'du ba'i gtsug lag khang / /sa 'dzin ji srid gnas par bsrung la bstod/ /ha ri sgos dngar ba'i dri ngad dang / /a ma'i gang bu lta bus rtag mchod na/ /ha la'i sbyor ba dang mtshungs sems ldan dgra/ /a don skye ba med pa'i dbyings su sgrol/ /bh+yoḥ rgyal kun gsang gsum lha lam yangs pa la/ /phul byung mthu stobs chu 'dzin legs 'khrigs shing / /grangs med dngos grub char wo 'bebs mdzad pa/ /bstan srung dung skyong dbang mo khyod la bstod/ /dbang po'i gzhu yis bskor ba'i lding khang dbus/ /pad dkar 'dab stong rgyas pa'i ze'u 'bru la/ /gnyis skyesargyal po'i dkyil 'khor rab gang ba/ /chu shel zhun ma'i thigs pa ci yang 'dzag /mtshan mkhan lang tsho rgyas pa gzugs kyi sku/ /be+eḍūr mthing kha lan bur byas pa'i skra/ /dkar nag ma 'dres phyed pa'i spyan gi dkyus/ /stang zil khu bas byugs pa'i smin ma nag /mu tig 'phreng ba bsgrigs pa'i bzhi bcu'i tshems/ /mchu sgros pad+ma rā ga'i gos kyis klubs/ /lhag phran gzhen nu lta bur mnyen pa'i phyag /—124

dam ༅ chos srung ma' rtogs skrun las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)mda' dar nor bus gang ba'i gzheng pa 'dzin//zhabs sen nyi ma'i mdangs la 'khu ba'i 'od//chu skyes gdan de snyigs32ba ngor ma gyur mtshar//rked skabs phra zhing nu 'bur mngon par mtho/'chi med bu mo'i mdzes sdug ma lus 'dzin//dbang sngon lo lha ta dang dzam bu'i gser//ma rgad g.yu dang man shel mu ste ka/lha mi gnod sbyin klu yi rin cen nor//srad bur brgyus pa'i rgyan gyis khyad par byas//tsi ṇa'i sgeg mos thags su bsgrubs pa'i dar//rnam mang ri mo'i ngo mtshar mtha' klas pa//'jam zhing lus la bde ba ster byed pa//lhab lhub kha dog bkra ba'i na bza' can//mdzes sdug brjid chags khro gnyer ston pa'i sku//snyan 'gyur drag shul nga ro'i gdangs kyi gsung //'gyur med bde chen dbyings su mnal ba'i thugs//rgyal ba kun gyi yum gyur khyod la bstod//lha mo khyod kyi snga phyir rgyug byed pa'i/khren mo'i gzuṭa can na kra seng ge'i gdong //bstan dgra'i srog la rngams pa'i gshed ma che//stobs ldan las mkhan gnyis la bdag bstod do/khro chags zhi ba'i nyams kyi rnam 'gyur can//jo mo bkra shis tshe ring mched lnga dang //bod khams skyong mdzad bstan ma bcu gnyis sogs//bka' nyan 'khor dang bcas la bdag bstod do//thub bstan spyi dang 'jam dpal snying po yi//ring lugasadabyar gyi mtsho ltar rab 'phel zhing //de 'dzin skyes bu khrims ldan khrus pa'i sde//bshad sgrub bya ba mtha' dag spel zhing skyongs//rnal 'byor bdag cag mi nor sbyin pa'i bdag/tshe dang bsod namasadapal 'byor rab rgyas shing //log par sems pa'i gdug can dgra bo rnams//bsad bskrad rmongs dang rengs pas 'a rdzo cig khyad par shākya'i rgyal po'i pho brang 'di//nyi zla'i 'od kyis mun pa'i dpung 'joms pa//de srid skye rgu'i nyer 'tshor g.yo med du//gnas pa'i 'phrin las lhun gyis grub par mdzod//33na / bh+yoḥbade legs rgya mtsho mtsho ltar 'khyil ba'i sa//sa 'dzin ltar mtho mtho brtsegs bod kyi yul//yul mchog rnam 'dren 'dren pa spyan ras gzigs//gzigs pa mi g.yel g.yel med kha ba'i ljongs//ljongs 'dir phan bde bde ster gtsug lag khang //khang bzang ra sa sa 'dzin kun gyi rgyan//rgyan de'i bka' srung srung ma kun gyi mchog/mchoge gsum kun dngos da dos brgyud bla

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mi'i gsung 'bum/ (4)ma'i bran//bran mo'i tshul 'dzin 'dzin ma g.yo byed ma//ma rungs dgra sde sder sa 'joms pa'i lha//lha yi mdzes log 'phrog byed la bcibs ma//ma mo mched dang dang por bod kyi yul//yul gru rnams stong skyong ma bcu gnyis tshogis//tsho gis gnyis dge legs legs tshogos kun gyi gzhi//gzhi rten dam chos chos tshul rgya mtsho'i dpal//dpal 'byor ma lus lus pa med par stsol//bh+yoḥskye 'gag gnyis med chos dbyings nam mkha'i ngos//mchog tu zhi ba'i tshul bstan khyod kyi sku//yid 'ong glog 'phreng g.yo ba'i sprin phung bzhin//dngos grub char 'bebs khyod la bdag bstod do//zhal rasazla ba'i dkyil 'khor rgyas pa la//tshems phreng 'od dkar snang bsags la byas shing //mchu sgros bisba'i 'bras bu yid du 'ong //rab tu bas pa'i dpal mo khyod la bstod//spyan zung ut+pal mthing kha'i 'dab ltar rgyas//gnag snum dbu skra'i lan tshar ci yang mdzes//rin cen zla ba'i gtsug rgyan mngon par spud//phun tsho gis sgeg mo'i sku la bdag bstod do/khyod sku rin ོ a gyis rnam par spras//lhab lhub dar gyi na bza' g.yo ba can//nor bu'i do shal rked skabs mchog tu mdzes//yid 'phrog lha mo'i sku la ྾//nu ma zung rgyas mu tig phreng 33ba tha rgod//lha yi gos bzang stod g.yogs mdzes par 'phyang //'ja' tshon ltar bkra'i dar gyis kun nas klubs//blta bas ngo mes med sku la ྾//snang srid gsal ba nor bu'i me long can//phyag g.yas mda' dar khams gsum dbang du sdud//g.yon gyis nor bus gang ba'i gzhe me pa 'dzin//dgos 'dod mchog stsol khyod la ྾//rma bya'i mdongs kyi grib bsil brten gyur cing //pad zla'i gdan la 'gying ba'i phyed skyil mdzad//sna tsho gis 'od kyi dra ba'i khor yug can//dpal gyi lha mo'i sku la ྾//tshangs dbyangs snyan pa'i gdangs kyis dbugasa'abyin zhing //log 'dren bgegs tsho gis 'joms pa'i gsang sngags sgrog/bdag med gnyis ston bdud dang mu stegs 'dul//theg mchog 'doms pa'i gsung la ྾//ye shes rdo rje bdag lta'i ri bo bsnyil//nam mkha'i rang bzhin mkhyen gnyis nyi zlas mtshan//bgegs kun gzir ba'i ting 'dzin la gzhol ba//stobs brgya mnga' ba'i thugs la ྾/6/khyod ni rgyal ba mang po'i yon to gter//zhi ba

dam ༅ chos srung ma' rtog tshon las rnam tso lhun grub/ 9)brnyes kyang thugs rjes gzhan dbang gyur//smon lam dbang gis bstan srung tshul 'dzin pa//bstan pa'i srog shing khyod la ྾//zhi rgyas dbang drag mngon spyod la sogs pa'i//lhun grub las bzhi'i rol pa sna tsho gis kyis//bstan pa bsrung zhing skyong lag ye la med pa'i//mthu stobs bdag mo khyone las//dpal gyi lha mo 'khor bcas khyed rnams kyis//rdo rje 'chang dbang slob dpon pad+ma dang //chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i spyan snga sa/ji ltar zhal bzhes dam bca' ma bsnyel bar//sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po bsrung ba dang //bla ma'i 'phrin las rgya cher spel ba dang //yul khams34na thams cad chos bzhin skyong ba dang //dngos grub kun stsol bcol ba'i las mdzod cig/khyad par 'dzig rten dbang po srong btsan gis//ye wa mas sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang //mthong thos dran pa'i dpal gyur yid bzhin nor/shākya'i rgyal po'i pho brang lha sa 'di//nam mkha' ji srid gnas pa de srid du//dbang ོ 'dzin ma'i nyal 'gro'i rgyun chen dang /khreg za'i dpung dang dus min dri bzhon sogs//gnod pa kun las rtag tu bsrung bar mdzad//yul phyogs 'dir yang mi nad phyugs nad dang //dusakyi 'byug pa mtha' dmag gnod pa sogs//mi 'dod nye bar 'tshe ba'i dngos po kun//zhi ba'i 'phrin las myur du 'grub par mdzod//tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor longs spyod rnams//bslab pa gsum gyi nyams len mtha' dag dang //bshad sgrub bya ba yar ngo'i zla ba ltar//rgyas pa'i 'phrin las myur du 'grub par mdzod//sa 'og sa steng sa bla'i 'jig rten gyi//phun sum tsho gis pa'i 'dod dgu thams cad dang //lha mo gnod sbyin la sogs che dgu rnams//dbang du 'du ba'i 'phrin lasahrūb par mdzod//rgyal ba'i bstan la sdang zhing gnod pa yi//dgra bgegs gang yin bsad rmongs gzir ba sogs/khrag po'i las kyis thal bar rlog pa yi//ma rga spyod 'phrin las myur du 'grub par mdzod//mdor na bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi//'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad sel ba dang //mthun rkyen bsams pa'i don kun ma lus pa//yid bzhin 'grub pa'i 'phrin las sgrub tu gsol//ces thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtshos mdzad pa'o//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)'dod khams dbang (34brdzag thugs kyi sprul pa ni/ /chu srin gdong can 'jigs rung srin mo'i gzugs/ /srid gsum dgra bgegs snying khrag shub gcig gis/ /'dren mdzad mun pa'i mdog can khyod la bstod/ /slad kyi rjes 'brang dmar nag seng ge'i gdong / /gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tsho gos la dbang sgyur zhing / khros pa'i zhabs brdabs srid gsum skad cig gis/ /chem chem g.yo mdzad srin mo khyod la bstod/ /oṃ/ dpal ldan bkra shis tshe ring sku mdog dkar/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pa bum pa 'dzin/ /chibs su seng ge dkar mo bcibs nas kyang / /tshe dang srid kyi dpal 'byor rgyas par mdzod/ /snang gsal bra ston mthing gi zhal bzang ma/ /phyag g.yas ba dan g.yon pa me long 'dzin/ /mdzes brjid sku mdog sngon mo rkyang la bcibs/ /rnam mang 'khor tshogs dang bcasakhyod la bstod/ /zas kyi dpal ster mi g.yo blo bzang ma/ /stag la bcibs shing lhab lhub dar gyisamadzes/ /sku mdog ser mo phyag g.yon ne'u le dang / /g.yas pa zas kyi gzhed pa 'dzin la bstod/ /nor gyi mchog stsol cod pan mgrin bzang ma/ /pad+ma rā ga'i mdog can sha yu bcibs/ /phyag g.yasadagos 'dod 'byung ba'i nor bu dang / /g.yon pa gter gyi sgrom bu 'dzin la bstod/ /rkang bzhi phyugasakyi dngos grub kun stsol ma/ /gtad dkar 'gro bzang sngo ljang ma rgad mdog /'brug la bcibs shing g.yas pa du bo dang / /g.yon pa sbrul gyi zhags pa 'dzin la bstod/ /gnam mtsho phyug mo la gnasagasang ba'i mtshan/ /bdag nyid chen mo rdo rje kun grags ma/ /sku mdog sngon mo 'brug la bcibs pa ste/ /chu srin rgyal mtshan me long 'dzin la bstod/ /lho bod mtshams la (35na tha zhugs pa gsang ba'i mtshan/ /dpal ldan ha ri rdo rje g.ya' ma skyong / /gser gyi mdog can rkyang la bcibs mdzad ma/ /shang lang dang ni zhags pa 'dzin la bstod/ /la phyi gangs la gnas pa gsang ba'i mtshan/ /gangs kyi yum chen rdo rje kun tu bzang / /sku mdog dmar mo chibs su seng ge bcibs/ /rdo rje dang ni bum pa 'dzin la bstod/ /yar 'phrog mtsho chen la gnas gsang ba'i mtshan/ /'brog chen 'khor 'dul rdo rje bgegs kyi gtso/ /sku mdog sngon mo dre'u bcibs nas kyang / /ru mtshon rtse lnga zhags pa 'dzin la 128

dgas chos zung ma' rtog lon las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)bstod/ /lha phu gangs la gnas pa gsang ba'i mtshan/ /gangs dkar sha med rdo rje spyan gcig ma/ /sku mdog dkar mo chibs su sha ba bcibs/ /gser gyi zor ba bum pa 'dzin la bstod/ /ru mtshams jo mo kha rag gsang ba'i mtshan/ kha rag khyung btsun rdo rje dpal gyi yum/ /sku mdog ser mo mkha' lding dbang po bcibs/ /ḍā ma ru dang me long 'dzin la bstod/ /byang stod do dmar mtsho bdag gsang ba'i mtshan/ /gser chen mkha' lding rdo rje klu mo ni/ /sku mdog dmar mo gyi ling rta la bcibs par bu dang ni sbrul zhags 'dzin la bstod/ /rma chen sbom ra'i sgrub gnas gsang ba'i mtshan/ /rma ri rab stims rdo rje drag mo rgyal/ /sku mdog ljang gu chibs su 'phar ba bcibs/ /be con dang ni 'bar gzheng 'dzin la bstod/ /kong yul dred sna gdong gnas gsang ba'i mtshan/ /kong btsun de mo rdo rje bod khams skyong / /gser gyi mdog can rkyang la bcibs mdzad ma/ /sprin gseng rlung bskyod resa'aga' rta la bcibs/ /dkar mo mda' dar sgrom bu 'dzin la bstod/ /ye gnyal lo ro'i gnasabadag gsang ba'i mtshan/ /btsan (35bsgo lo ro rdo rje sman gcig ma/ /sku mdog ser mo mdzo mo bcibs nas kyang / /lhab lhub dar dang 'brang rgyas 'dzin la bstod/ /gtsang stod jo mo nags rgyal gsang ba'i mtshan/ /sman btsun lkug chos rdo rje g.ya' mo sil/ /sku mdog dmar mo sha ba yu mo bcibs/ /rin cen 'bar ba'i ting shags 'dzin la bstod/ /jo mo g.yu ri la gnas gsang ba'i mtshan/ /g.yu yi rdo rje dril bu gzugs legs ma/ /sku mdog sngon mo stag la bcibs pa ste/ /pad+ma dang ni dril bu 'dzin la bstod/ /tshe ring mched lnga bstan ma bcu gnyis bcas/ /sngon gyi khas blangasadam bca' ma bsnyel bar/ /dam rdzas rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po bsrung ba dang / /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas rnams kyi/ /rkyen ga bar chad thamasacad zhi ba dang / /chos dang srid kyi dpal 'byor ma lus pa/ /rtag tu phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /ces thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i dpal gyis mdzad do/ /'phrin las bcol ba ni/ bh+yoḥ dpal ldan lha mo 'khor bcas khyed rnams kyis/ /khyab bdag —/29

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)rdo rje 'amang dbang srong btsan zhabs//pad+ma 'byung gnas nyang ral dge 'bum sogs//dngos brgyud bla ma'i dam tshig nyer dgongs la//'gro ba kun gyi phan dang bde ba'i gzhi//kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i rjes su legs zhugs pa'i//phul byung lung dang rtogs pa'i bstan pa kun//mi nub 'phel zhing rgyasapa'i 'phrin las mdzod/khyad par dri med thub bstan yang snying mchog/blo bzang grags snyan ches cher 'bar ba'i gdugs//srid gsum kun tu khyab pa'i grib bsil can//rab rgyas mi 'gyur brtan pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//lung rtogs bstan 'dzin skyes bu dam pa rnams//36na rdza tshe rnam par dkar ba'i mdzad 'phrin dang //'a 'dus pa' sde tshogs chos skyong bcu yi las//yar ngo'i zla ltar rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/kha ba'i ljongs kyi bde legs kun gyi gzhi//lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang ོ po//rten dang brten par yos pa'i 'khor lo 'di//bskal brgyar mi 'gyur brtan pa'i wen las mdzod//gnam skos bsod nams gser gyi 'khor lo yis//yangs pa'i nor 'dzin kun tu dbang sgyur bar//chos ldan rgyal po'i khrims kyis 'dzam gling kun//gser gyi gnya' shing lci bzhin rab brtan mdzod//dga' bder spyod pa'i legs pa'i yon to kun//gcig gyur sdebazhi'i bang mdzod dang ldan pa//phun tshogs skye rgu 'du ba'i pho brang che//srid 'di'i rgyan du 'gyur ba'i 'phrin las mdzod//dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi bstan pa mchog/'dzin la snying stobs btsun po'i go cha can//sa dbang chos kyi rgyal po dam pa gang //sku tshe brtan zhing chab srid rgyas par mdzod//'dzam gling spyi dang khyad par yul phyogs 'dir//g.yul 'khrug nad rims nyer 'tshe kun zhi zhing //lo legs skya rgyas mi nor 'byor pa sogs//mthun rkyen lhun gyis grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//mdor na bdag cag mi nor 'khor bcas kyi//nad gdon bar chad 'gal rkyen zhi ba dang //yid la bsams pa'i lugs zung 'dod pa'i don//thogs pa med par 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//bskul ba ni/bh+yoḥdung skyong rgyal mo 'khor bcas rnams//gdug pa'i dgra la rbad pa'i tshe//rngam zhing khro ba'i cha byad kyis//mi sdug sprul pa ci yang ston//mig sman mdog ༷dzin mche ba gtsigs//zhal nas bskal pa'i

dam ༅ chos srung mgo rtog wen las rnam sto lhun grub/ 9)me (36bdapung 'bar/ shangs nas 'brug sgra drag po sgrog /phyag nas mtsho ni ma sna tsho gos 'bebs/ /rkyang ser drel rta zhen nas brgyug /khrag 'thung don snying nang khrol za/ /mi lpags rlon pa gos su rgya ne/ /gdug pa'i 'khor tsho gis sprin ltar gtibs/ /bdud bya nag po thibs shing lding / /ce spyang mang po 'dur zhing brgyug /bskal pa'i me rlung 'tshub mar 'khyil/ /gsod rgyob sgra skad stong gsum g.yo/ /'khor bcas thugs dam dus la bab/ /bstan dang de 'dzin dge 'dun ste/ /sa dbang rgyu sbyor sbyin bdag la/ /gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs rnams/ /ltas ga cho 'phrul 'jigs skrag dang / /nad gzug mi mthun nyer 'tshe sogs/ /gdug pa'i chad pas tshar chod cig /dus la bab po sam ya/ /dus gtor sogs kyi tshe byed/ /skabs 'dir rdzong btsan 'bar ba la gsol mchod ni/ sha khrag gisabargyan pa'i gtor ma bsham/ /gyi dus gsum rgyal ba'i bstan pa bsrung ba la/ /mas stobs thogasapa med pa'i rdzu 'phrul can/ /mi bsrun klu btsan rngams shing rab 'jigs pa/ /kong mo grib ba 'a rdo rje mchog rgod rtsal/ /mdog dmar rab khros zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /dbu la sbrul mgo'i gdengasaka bdun gyis brgyan/ /bse rmog le chen bse khrab dmar po gsol/ /phyag g.yas zangs mdung dmar po g.yon pa na/ /tsit+ta rin cen 'phrul gyi lde mig 'dzin/ /btsan rta dmar po rlung gshog ro la bcibs/ /rang 'dra'i klu btsan drug dang phyi rol tu/ /btsan 'khor sum brgya drug cu sbal sbrul dang / /sdom dang dur 'chi bya khrag la sogs pa/ /sna tsho gis 'jigs su rung ba'i sprul par bcas/ /'khor bcas sngon gyi dam tshig nyer dgongs(37nasgo/ /thogs pa med par myur du gshegs su gsol/ /rgya rje'i yul nas 'ongs shing yong jo yi/ /rjesangs bod yul srung mar srong bas gyi/ /spyan sngar khas blangs klu btsan mthu bo che/ /brag ri brtsegs pa'i gnas nas gshegs su gsol/ /dge mtshan rgya mtsho ma lus 'du ba'i gzhi/ /sman ljongs sa yi lte ba yar klungs kyi/ khrel dkar brag ri brtsegasapa'i pho brang nas/ /btsan rgod chen po gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /ljon shing 'bras bu'i khur gyis rab dud pa'i/ shar phyogs kong yul bu chu lha khang dang / /spu ri phug mo che dang rtse chen brag /—131—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 74)gnas srung btsan rgod chen po gshegs su gsol/ /badz+ra ging ka ra sa ma ya dzaḥ yiḥ pad+ma 'byung gnas spyan snga sa /bstan pa bsrung bar khas blangs pa'i/ /klu btsan dge bsnyen 'khor bcas la/ /mthun pa'i rdzas kyi mchod pa 'bul/ /yid 'ong mdzes pa'i gzugs kyi gar/ /snyan pa'i sgra dang dngar ba'i dri/ /'jam pa'i reg bya zas tshogos kyis/ /btsan rgod 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang / /bdud rtsi sman gyi rba rlabs 'khrug /dam rdzas gtor ma ri ltar spungs/ /dmar chen khrag gi a gyis/ /btsan rgod ྾/ /dbang po lnga yi me rtag dang / sha chen dud sprin mkha' la 'khrigs/ /tshil chen bzhu ba'i mar me 'dis/ /btsan ྾/ /stag gzig pags pa'i rgyal mtshan dang / /mdung dmar ru mtshon ba dan tshogs/ /g.yab cing 'bod pa'i dar tshon 'dis mo/ /tshigs dgu smyug rgod lo rgyas mda'/ r+sām bkra dar gyi phang phung can/ /gyi ling rlung gzhog rta tsho gis kyis ྾/ /sra btsan khrab rmog go cha'i rigs/ /rno ngar gri mdung dgra sta dang / /(37bskyog ral gzig shubs la sogs pas mo/ /gzhan yang phyi nang gsang ba'i rten/ /mthun pa'i dam rdzas ma lus pa/ /dngos bshams yid kyis sprul byas nas za/ /ma hā ba kla ta khā hi/ /gyi dus mthali rlung la 'gran pa'i rta mchog steng / /skyes bu dbang gi rang bzhin byu ru'i mdog /nyin byed 'bum gyi 'od ltar bzod dka' ba/ /klu btsan mthu stobs dbang phyug khyod la bstod/ /g.yas pa srid rtser bsnyeg pa'i mdung dmar gyis/ /dgra bgegs dkar nag snying gi mtshams su bsnun/ /g.yon pa khrag rgyun 'bab pa'i don snying dang / /rin cen 'phrul gyi lde mig 'dzin la bstod/ /'jigs rung rang 'dra'i sprul pa'i 'khor tsho gis dang / /rnam mang pho nya las mkhan bcasapa'i dbus/ /'gying mdzad bstan dang gtsug lag khang skyong ba'i/ /rig 'dzin srung ma chen por bdag bstod do/ /dus gsum rgyal ba pad+ma ka ra'i zhabs/ /phyon gling dang gar gyi dbang phyug sogs/ /dngos brgyud bla ma'i dam tshig nyer dgongs la/ /chos 'khor 'di srungs bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /ces rigs 'dzin sangs rgyas gling pa'i gter byon la gzhi byas nas bkod cing / de nas/sto/ 'dzam gling skus ru yul gyi dbus/ /rtse mtho rin cen 'bar ba'i gnas/ /yid 'ong 'dod pa gang —132

dam ༅ cho srung ma' rtogs tshon las rnam sto lhun grub/ 9)ba'i gzhi/ /de 'dra'i chom gnas ma ga ya mtshan can/ /rin cen sna tsho gis las grub pa'i/ /pho brang chen po khyad par 'phags/ /rin chen gser gyi khri steng na/ /rdzong btsan chen po'i sku bzhugs pa/ /blta bas mi ngoms yid 'phrog cing / /mdzes pa'i sku la rgyan cha can/ /yab yum sras dang bcas pa'i tshogs/ /mchod pa'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs/ /ja chang sman phud rak+ta dang / /dgra bo rnams kyi sha khrag sogs/ /(38nangs sna sman spos 'dis mchod do/ /sto/ khrab mo phub dang mdung la brten/ /mchod do dgra lha'i sku ma 'khang / /bsten pa'i dus 'dir rgyang ma ring / /mchod pa'i dus su zhe ma ldog /bdag sogs dpon g.yog 'khor bcas kyi/ /rmog mo mgo nas ma yar cig /khrab mo rgyun thag ma chad cig /mda' mo stong nas ma yar zhig /gzhu mo rgyud nas ma chad cig /mdung ring rked pa ma chag cig /rta rgyug rmig pa ma bud cig /dmag dang byus kyi rgyal kha bzung / /tshe dang bsod nams yar la spel/ /bstan ba gnam ltar rgyas par mdzod/ zhes bon lugs yin 'dra/ /de nas bzlog pa ni/ bh+yoḥ dung skyong rgyal mo bka' sdod gdong can gnyis/ /tshe ring mched lnga bstan ma bcu gnyis dang / /rdo rje mchog rgod rtsal sogs 'khor bcas kyis/ /bdag cag rgyu sbyor 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /sdebargyad 'khrug pa'i gnod pa ma lus bzlog /ban bon gdug pa'i byad kha ma lus bzlog /nad gdon bar chad dusamin 'chi ba bzlog /lo geg zla geg chags che nyam nga bzlog /khyad par gtsug lag chos 'khor 'di nyid la/ /sa chu tshe rlud 'byung ba'i gnod pa bzlog /stod smad mtha' dam gag dug pa'i gnod pa bzlog /mi mthun phyogs kun dgra bo'i steng du bh+yo/ /mthun pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa/ /dus 'dir bdag la stsal du gsol/ /'khor dang bstan pa longs spyod rnams/ /rgyas par mdzod cig srung ma'i tshogs/ /de nas chang phud gtor zhing 'di skad do/ /zlo rnam 'dren bstan pa bsrung ba'i chos skyong mchog /rnal 'byor bu bzhin skyong mdzad mthu rtsal can/ /'dod khams bdag mo dpal gyi lha mo la/ /gsol lo mchod do bcol ba'i (34tsho khrin las mdzod/ / srin mo drag tu khros pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis/ /gtso mo'i snga phyir rgyug pa'i las mkhan zung / /chu srin seng ge'i gdong can rnam gnyis la ྾/ /bkra shis—133

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)tshe ring mthing gi zhal bzang ma//mi g.yo blo bzang cod pan mgrin bzang ma//gtad dkar 'gro bzang mkha' 'gro mched lnga la ྾//rdo rje kun grags la sogs bdud mo bzhi//rdo rje spyan gcig la sogs gnod sbyin bzhi//kong btsun de mo la sogs sman mo bzhin ྾//g.yin yang sa gzhi bar snang khyon gang ba'i//lha klu gnod sbyin srin mo'i gzugs 'dzin pa//bka' nyan 'khor tsho gos rgya mtsho'i tsho gis rnams la ྾//chos 'khor bka' srung klu btsan dbang gi mdog/kog ma sgrib btsan rdo rje mchog rgod rtsal//bzha 'khor sum brgya drug cur tsos las//mchod pa byin rlabs sngar ltar gyi mjug tu/s+t+waṃ de snyi sa pa ri wā ra a: nas/sha rdi'i bar brjod/oṃ āḥlha/btags la nang mchod 'bul/'gro ba'i khams dang bsam pa ji bzhin du//sogs kyis bstod//ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang //gang yang nus pa ma mchis pa//deng 'dir byas pa gang yin pa//de kun khyod kyis bzod par mdzod//dri med rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che/khyad par chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa'i//lung dang rtogs pa'i bstan pa srid mtha'i bar//gnas shing phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//tshul de 'dzin pa'i dam pa'i tsho gis kun gyi//zhabs zung rdo rje lta bur rab brtan zhing //khrims ldan 'dus pa'i chosakyi sde chen rnams//bshad dang sgrub pa'i dpal la spyod par shog/rgyal ba'i bstan 'dzin sa gzhi bde bar skyong //chos ldan rgyal po sku tshe 4 'a thang rgyas//'jig rten kun tu 39nard gzugs go rnams//zhi zhing phan bde'i dpal la spyod par shog/srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ma lus yang ba'i gzhi//zhesasogs dang //gzhan yang 'dod don smon lam skabs sbyar byed//'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu//'gro ba'i don du bzhugs nas kyang //nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang //mchoge rnams legs par stsal dug sol//su lta tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swā hā/mnga' gsol ni/phun tshogs rgya mtsho ma lus khrung ba'i gnas//dngos grub yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po'i mdzod//'bad med lag rtser lhun gyis grub mdzad pa//dngos grub bla ma'i ngo bor mnga' gsol lo//tshogs gnyis mtha' dag yongs rdzogs sangs rgyas dang //lung dang rtogs pa'i gter gyur dam pa'i /sa//'dzin zhing spel ba'i 'phags tshogs dge

dam can chos srung ma' rtogs tshon la rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)'dun te//slu med mchog gsum ngo bor ྾//dmigs med chos kyi dbyings su ro gcig kyang //grangs med sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rol gar mkhan//zhi dang khro bo'i sprul bsgyur dkyil 'khor gtso//yi dam rten dang brten par mnga' ྾//rnyog med dngas pa'i brgya phrag rdzing bu la//chu shel dbang po cig car snang ba ltar//zhi rgyas dbang drag sprul pa 'gyed mdzad pa'i//bka' srung dung skyong rgyal mor ྾//dga' bzhi 'phrul snang gtsug lag srung ma dang //bdag cag rgyu sbyor mi nor dgon gnas bcas//skyong zhing spel ba'i srung mar mnga' gsol gyi//'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub par mdzod//shis brjod ni/bh+yoḥsrid gsum skye rgu kun gyi skyabs gyur pa//dus gsum sgrib med gsal bar rab gzigs shing //gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro kun gyi gtso//gdan gsumatshang ba'i bla ma'i 39babakra shis shog/dpal ldan sku bzhi'i bdag nyid 'khor lo'i mgon//rab 'byams dus bzhi'i rgyal ba kun gyi dngos//bgrang yas rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro'i 'khor tsho gos can/khyud sde rnam bzhi'i lha yi bkra shis shog/sa bcu'i dbang phyug 'gro la rjes chags kyang //zhing bcu sgrol phyir khro bo'i skur ston pa//stobs bcu mnga' ba'i lung rtogs bstan pa rnams//phyogs bcur skyong mdzad rnams kyi bkrashis za//dge legs dngos grub 'dod pa kun 'jo ba'i//gnas srung gtso mod pal ldan dung skyong ma//bka' sdod gdong can tshe ring mched lnga dang //bstan ma bcu gnyis rnams kyi bkra shis ྾//rab snyan rgyud mang stong gi glu dbyangs ltar//yid dang rna bar dga' ba ster ba'i dpal//mchog gsum dam pa'i bkra shis dga' ston gyis//phyogs dus kun tu khyab pa'i dge legs stsole//ces gangs can gyi lte ba lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang skyong bar mi rje srong btsan sgam po'i spyan sngar dam bcas pa'i dpal ldan lha mo dung skyong ma dang /de'i zheng du sgrib btsan gyi mchod gtor 'bul tshul yig cha mang du 'dug kyang /go rim sogs nges can zhig mi 'dug pas/mang nyung 'tsham zhing rgyas bsdus blang bde byas chog pa zhig dgos zhes lugs gnyis la blta ba'i mkhyen dpyod kyis 'dzin ma kun bde bar skyong ba'i phyag mdzod bsod nams rab brtan gyi gsung gis bskul ba la brten nas so so'i mdzad pa

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)po kha gsal ba rnams yig rnying ltar dang de phyin gsar du bsgrigs pa'i bkra shis tshe ring ma rdo rje kun bzang dang gcig pas bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi khongs su gtogs la g.yin bzhi 'khor yin pa nasalogs su mi dgos pa gsang sngags rnying ma'i bstan skyong rnams kyis rtogs nus kyang thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun (40na)rgya mtsho'i yab chos rje dwags shangs zhi byed rnying ma sogs chos lugs sna tshogs mdzad pa'i dwags brgyud kyi shan shor te phyag len gyi rgyun la 'dug pas bsgyur bkod ma byasapa'i mchod pa'i 'phrin las don gnyis lhun grub 'di 'ang rgyal ba'i dbang po btsong kha pa'i ring lugs pa a wa dhū twe pa za hor gyi btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i tshes la sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni wā gis sre ya'o/ /rgyal po chen po sdo lnga la gsol mchod 'bul tshul 'phrin lasa'agag med rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /mi 'gyur bde ba chen po'i zlos gar las/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs sprul pa'i sku/ /pad+ma'i ka sar las legasangs pa'i/ /mtsho skyesardo rje rigs kyi bdag por bzhugs/ /zhi dang khro bo'i rgyal po ma lus pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor kun 'dusasgrub pa bka' brgyad lha'i/ /'jig rten dregs pa'i bstan srung srog bdag che/ /sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po mchod byed pa'i/ /'phrin las sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi khrigs/ /chad lhag skyon bral 'khyer bde nyer bkod pa/ /gnod sbyin dgyes dgur spyad pa'i 'gag med kyi/ /rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs deng 'dir rab bsgrags so/ /de yang sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po 'khor dang bcas pa mnyes byed kyi 'phrin lasalas/ /thog mar bla ma'i las byang sngon du 'gro dgos pas/ /bla ma yi dam chos skyong chen po rnams kyi mchod gtor spyan gzigs rnams phyag len ltar bshams la/ /thog mar rang nyid skad cig gisadapal rta mgrin sku mdog dmar po g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ dur khrod kyi chasakyis brgyan pa g.yon rkyang gis bzhugs pa/ gnas gsum du yi ge gsum gyis mtshan par 'gyur/ /de nas bgegs gtore raṃ me khaṃ gyis bsre ṭa (40bltungs bkrus/ /oṃ āḥ/ zhes phyin gyis brlabasate/ rmi me kā ro mu kho sarba dharmā ṇi ā du nut+pa sno tā ta oṃ āḥlha phaṭa swā hā/ /lan gsum gyis bsngos la/ lha:—136

dam ༅ chos srung ma' rtogs lon las rnam sto lhun grub/ 9)rtsa gsum lha yi byin rlabs kyis//bar gcod bgegs rnams phyir dengs shig/gal te ma 'gro rta mgrin dbang //khros pas thal ba'i rdul du rlag/cha/ bha sogs brjod/mtshams gcod ni/hūṃ/da ni ye nas dang ga khra mtshams gcod khro bos nam mkha' gang bgegs 'dul khro bo'i rol mtshamasalas sa yang 'da' bar ma byed cig chabadz+ra kro ta rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ phags/skyabs sems ni/na mo/bla ma bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku dkon cog gsum gyi rang bzhin la bdag dang 'gro ba sems can rnams byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi:sems bskyed 'gro ba kun don du bla ma sangs rgyas bsgrubasanas ni gang la gang 'dus tshon las kyis 'gro don byed par dam bca' 'o:tsho gos zhing ni/bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gshegs nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs:lusang ga yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal:phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa 'bul nyams chags sdig sgrib mthol lo bshags gsang sngags sgrub la rjes yi rang :smin grol gsang sngags chos 'khor skor:sems can don du bzhugs su gsol snying po sgos can don du bsngo yang dag rdo rje'i don rtogs shog byin dbabs pa ni chos kyi dbyingasanas rtsa gsum lha tshogs rnams//thogs med bzhengs la grub pa'i gnas r+pā 'dir//byin ོ phob la bdag la dbang bskur stsal//mchog dang a mong dngos grub stsal du gsol//mchod gtor byin brlab ni/4na lha badz+ra gro dha ha ya shrī wa paṅgān+ta spo ta hūṃ phags/su bhā bas sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las/yaṃ las rlung dkyil gzhu dbyibs ba dan mtshan//de steng raṃ las me dkyil gru gsum pa//raṃ gyisamatshan steng ka las mi mgo yi//skyed bu gsum steng a las thod pa'i nang /// māṃ byu māṃ tī las seng ge dang //glang po rta dang rma bya ma sha'i steng //cha/ swā e hā steng thabs shes kyi//nyi zla sbyar la dbyangasagasal gyis mas pa//dbus su rdo rje'i rtse a lte bar hūṃ//yar rwa cha lha swā e hā lnga dang //mar rwa hūṃ lī māṃ māṃ tī gyis mtshan//thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros rlung gi me//sbar te rdzas 'khor rgyal ba srasabacas mchod//rgyal kun rigs lngar gyur pa'i byang chub sems//babs pas a dang 'bru bcu hūṃ dbyangs gsol//rig gyis gcig lagacig phog thim pa yis//nyi slar bcas pa 'od zhu rdzas la thim//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)sman rag gtor gsum zag med bdud rtsir gyur//oṃ āḥlha sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūṃ gyi las āḥ/ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal hūṃ hrī yos yo āḥlha ma hā ba lo ta te dzo bha kla ta ba la ba te tsho ༅ sa ma ye hūṃ hrīḥng dhi tsit+ta gha na snu ya gu tsa sngo dngos gzhi ni/spros bral ngang las kun khyab snying rje'i gdangs//rang rig rdo rje gyi bcas gyur las//sgo bzhi gru chad rta babs yongs rdzogs pa'i//dkyil 'khor dbus su bdud bzhi pad nyi'i steng //rang nyid hrī los dbang li sku mdog dmar//gri gug thod 'dzin rdo rje phag mos lkod//dur khrod mas brgyan spyi gtsug pad nyi'i steng //pad+ma thod phreng rdo rje brgyu 'dzin//mthing nag zab ber chos gos pad zhwa la//sgro dar me long gis brgyan skyil krung bzhuṭa//41ba'i nyid gnas gyur bla ma rdo rje 'chang //mthing nag rdor dril 'dzin cing skyil krung can//bang du mkha' 'gro 'tsho rgyal sku mdog dkar//gri gug bdud rtsi'i thod 'dzin mgul nas 'byud//gnyis ka rin cen 'i rus pa rgyan gyis spras//zung 'jug bdag nyid bde ba chen po'i sku//de yi phyi rim 'dab bzhin rdo rje dang //rin chen pad+ma na me thod 'phreng rtsal//rang rtags las bzhi'i phyag mtshan gos rgyan gyis//legs par spras te gzi brjid ldan par gyur//phyi rim pad+ma'i 'dab ma brgyad po la//bad 'byung mthing nag phyag g.yas rdo rje dang //g.yon pa sdigs mdzub mdzad cing yum la 'khyud//pad+ma saṃ bha pad phor skyabs sbyin gyi//phyag rgya mdzad cing dge slong gzhon nu'i tshul//blo ldan mchog sred thod rnga pad phor 'dzin//sku mdog dkar po sngags 'chang gzi brjid can//pad+ma rgyal po ḍā ru me long 'dzin//sku mdog dmar po rgyal po'i cha lugs ro//nyi ma 'od zer kha ṭ+wāṃ nyi zer 'dzin//ser po rnal 'byor spyod pa'i cha lugs can/shwakya seng ge rdo rje lhung bzed 'dzin//sprul sku shākya thub pa'i rnam rol can//seng ge sgra sgrog mthing nag rdo rje g.yas//sdigs mdzub mdzad pa 'jigs rung khro bo'i tshul//rdo rje gro lod smug nag rdo rje g.yas//g.yon pa phur bsgril gtum rngams khro bo'i gzugs//phyi rim rigasabazhi'i mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro dang /khyams la chos skyong dam can srung ma'i tshogs//glu len gar byed char sprin lta bur gtibs//sku gsung thugs kyis byi/ rlabs ye shes lngas//dbang bskur mchog dang

dam can chos srung ma' rtogs mun las rnam swo lhun grub/ 'dithun mong dngos grub stsol//hūṃ ā+oṃ swā e ma hā gu ru : wa ḍā ki ni sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ42na8 nas spyan 'dren/bzhugs gsol/mchod bstod rnams thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtshos gnang ba 'di ltar/lhaḥdri med 'od gsal dag pa'i rol gnas las//kun khyab sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i snang brnyan ni/rnam dag dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa'i tshul//dus gsum rgyal dbang pad+ma 6bha ba//g.yas na dpa' bo'i bro brdung khrabs rtse khrab//g.yon na dpa' mo'i glu len shar ra ra//bgrang yas rigs 'dzin grub pa'i tshogs kyis bskor//dam can srung ma'i tsho gis rnams sprin ltar gtibs//mkhar nyal dbang po'i tshogs rnams rjes 'brang zhing //'chi med bu mo'i lag pad kyis gtore ba'i//man dha ra yi 'phreng bas mkha' lam khyab//tshad med thugs rje'i dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs//mdun gyi nam mkhar 'dab ma stong ldan pa'i//chu skyes lte bar seng khri nyi zla'i steng /khri med 'od zer lnga yi gur khyim dbus//dgyes pa'i 'dzum chags brtan par bzhugs su gsol//gaṅgā'i rdul gyi grangs mnyam lusasprul te//yid srubs zol skyes sbu long gos ldan zhing //dang ba'i thal sbyar me tog kha 'bus bcas/zhabs rdul spyi bor blangs te gus phyag 'tshal//gser gyi 'dab stong phags pa'i snod yangs su//'chi med bdud rtsi'i mchod yon mtsho ltar bskyil//yid 'phrog lha dang mi yi tshe togo rnams//tshig mda'i lam kun khyab par rab 'khrigs shing //'od zer ba 'ad ldan rin cen snod rnams su//tsas sprul snying lha rdzas a ka sa/bsregs pa'i dud sprin phyogs kyi 'khor lo 'gengs//rab 'bar sgron me'i 'phreng bas chu mthong 'gog/ga bur sgos gyis 42brdzags gur kum gyi//dri chab yid 'ong rol mtsho ltar 'khyil zhing //zag med bde ster ro brgya'i phun tsho gos can//lha dang mi yi zhal zas ma tshang med//gdangs snyan skad kyi 'gyur ba 'bum phrag can/khyud mang gling bu dung gi bye brag sogs//'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i mchod pa'i tshogs//ma lus zhing kun khyab par byas te 'bul//rin cen lhun po gling bzhi gling phran brgyad//nyi ma zla ba rgyal srid rin cen bdun//lus dang longs spyod 'dod dgu'i gter chen po//dus gsum dge tsho gos daX bcas khyed la 'bul//rnyog bral dad pa'i chu

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)gter las 'ongs pa'i//kun bzang mchod sprin mkha' ngos ma lus pa//yongs su khyab pa'ang rgyal sras tshogis rnams kyis//dus gsum rgyal ba mchod bzhin legs par mchod//stong gsum khyon ltar yangs pa'i thod pa'i nang //sgron ma lnga dang de bzhin lcags kyu lnga//sbyangs rtogs sbar byas zag med ye shes lnga'i//rang bzhi bdud rtsi rgya mtshor bskyil pas ma rdzo//bdag wo rje bas pad+ma thod phreng rtsal//yid 'phrog rang snang rte phyag rgya dang //mnyam par sbyar ba tshe ma'o bde ba che//skyabs ma brjod 'das mchod pa'i mchog 'di med//spros pa'i mtshan ma kun bral gdod ma'i gshis//sgrib gnyis 'ching ba las grol lhan cig skyes//brtan g.yo kun khyab kun gyi rang bzhin mchog/dmigasamed chos sku'i bdag nyid khyod la 'dud/khrad pa'i 'khor lo mgyoga'agro dbyings su thim//dngas ma lnga 'dus mtshan dpe'i dra ba can//rgyal sras sar gnas dpa' bo'i mig gi ni//bdud rtsi longs spyod rdzogs pa khyod la 'dud//yongs dag mkha' la shar ba'i ri bong can//brjod 'das dang ba'i 43nachu la snang bas bzhin//gdul bya'i khams dang bsam pa'i khyad par las/khor yang 'char ba sprulapa'i sku la bstod//au ṇ+ḍi wā nar yid bzhin rgya mtsho'i dbus//mtsho skyes las zhabrungs nyes lhung phra mosakyang //mgos sdome brtson dge slong cha lugs can//mi lus 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig khyod la 'dud//gangs ri'i phreng bas yongs bskor phyogs 'dir yang //zhabs rdul cung zad bkod pa'i bka' drin las//nag phyogs bdud dpung kun zhi rgyal ba'i bstan//'gro ba'i phan bde rgyas mdzad khyod la 'dud//de nas 'dzab bzla ba ni/cha āḥlha badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sirnyi hūṃ/oṃ aḥlha badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal//badz+ra sa ma yaḥsirnyi pha la hūṃ/hri ma ha ri ni sa/ra tsa hri ya/tsit+ta hring hring dza'aḥgand nas bskul ba ni/dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad 'dus pa'i dpal//rigs 'dzin bla ma'i dngos grub dus la bab//thugs dam gnad nas bskul na mched lcam la//sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub ma stso ma lus la/de nasamachod gtor dam rdzas rnams la dmigs te su bhā was sbyangs/rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las re me — sa pas mchod rdzas rnams kyi ma dag pa'i //rtas po thams cad bsregs gtor bkrus/tre rasne

dam ༅ chos srung ma' rtogs tshon las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)〉 lo kya brum gyis mchod gtor gyi snod nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i nang du thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i oṃ āḥlha gis rdzas rnams gtsang zhing yid du 'ong ba 'dod pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs pa mdzad pa med pa nam mkha'i mdzod kyis thugs dam gnyan po dbyings su skong ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ mdun du chos rgyal chen po 'khor bcas bskyed pa ni/(43ba tshe1 gyi badz+ra kro ta sogs kyis bsangs su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/rang gi mdun du : las mang/ dung / gser/ byu sa g.yu las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang yangs shing rgya che ba dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i khrag mtsho'i rba slong 'khrug cing / sha chen gyi lhu dum nyil ba mi lpagasakyi bla bre/ glo snying gi 'phreng ba/rgyu ma'i lda ldi/ keng rus gcal du bkram pa/ dbus phyogs mchong gi gzhal yas khang gi dbus su paṃ las pad+ma/ raṃ las nyi ma/ dgra bgegs pho mo gan rkyal kha bu btu bsnol ba'i gdan la/tri mthing kha las 'od 'phros/ dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongasasu gyur pa las thugs kyi rgyal po brgya byin sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ smin ma dang sma ra dmar ser 'byug pa/ phyag g.yas bdud kyi zhags pa dgra la 'debs shing / g.yon spu gris dgra bgegs kyi srog rtsa gcod pa/ sku la dom gyi zlog pa dang dar nag gi 'jol ber/ dbu la dar nag gi theb zhu mdzes par gsol ba rin po chesabargyan pa/ gar dgu'i nyams can/ gangs ri'i dum bu chad 'dra'i glang chen sna ring la bcibs pa'i mon bu pu lhas khrid pa/ glog dang me lce rol tu khrid cing thog ser pho nyar gtong ba bskal ba'i me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i mdun du ga snod sbyin chen po srog bdag yang le ber sku mdog dmar po nyi ma stong gi gzi ldan drag tu khros pa/ sha khrag srog dbugs zhal du gsol zhing /res 'ga' ya sos ma mchu mnan te khro gnyer smin phrag tu bsdus pa/ bse khrab dang bse rmog gyon pa/g.yas mdung dmar dang g.yon btsan zhags dgra la 'phen pa/ rin po che'i sga srab dang dar gyi (44nas da pan gyis spras pa'i rta mchog rlung gi shugs can la bcibs pa/ yum sharnyi ro zan dmar —141—

rgyal dbang lnga pa pag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)mo dar gyi yang rag gyon pa/ khrag dang zhag gis brgyan pa lcags kyu dang nga snying 'dzin pa/ sprul pa dge bsnyen gzhon nu'i cha byad can/ dar dmar gyi ber gyon zhing shel gyi 'phreng bas mgul rgyan byas pa/ g.yas sdigs mdzub nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing / g.yon zangs gri brdeg tshul mdzad pa/ blon po srog bdag bka'i bya ra ba ber smug gyon zhing / dar nag ru mtshon 'phyar ba/ seng ge dkar mo la bcibs pa/ shar phyogs dung gi gzhal yas khang gi dbus su pad nyi dgra bgegs bsnol ba'i gdan la/ tri las sku'i rgyal ba mon bu pu tra sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas gser gyi rdo rje dang g.yon sher shing gi gseg shang 'dzin pa/ sku la men tri nag po'i na bza' dang / dbu la dar nag gi theb zhu gsol ba/ seng ge dkar mo la bcibs shing / dom nag smyon pa rol du khrid pa/ stag gzig dom dred pho nyar gtong ba/ yum bdud mo ro langs ma dkar mo dar dkar gyi na bza' gsol ba/ dam shing dang ste snying 'dzin pa/ sprul pa dge slong dgra bcom gzhen nu chos gos ngur smig gsol ba/ sher shing gi gseg shang dang sbu gri bsnams pa/ ka pa li rgyab tu khur ba/ spyi blug mdun du la4 ba/ blon po bya khrid mig gcig pa gcer bu sbrul gyi thod can shel gyi rdo rje 'phen pa/ rta mchog sngon po sgab nag la bcibs pa/ lto phyags gser gyi gzhal yas khang gi dbus su tri las yon tan gyi rgyal po shing bya can sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas dgra sta dang g.yon zhags pa 'dzin pa/ sku la sbrul dang stag gi g.yang gzhi dang /(44bdabu la smyug ma'i tshag zhu gsol ba/ steng na khyung gi khog phub pa/ srid pa'i g.yu 'brug rol du khrid pa/ spra sbrel byi la pho nyar 'gyed pa/ yum gser gyi spu gri nag mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi/ g.yas ral gri dang mdung dmar/ g.yon shag ti dang tri shul bsnams pa/ dar nag gi cod pan bcings pa/ re lde ser po'i smad g.yogs la sbrul gyi ska rags can/ snyan g.yas la seng ge dang g.yon la sprul gyis brgyan pa/ mgul la dril bu 'brol ba/zhabs gnyis lcags sgrog gis brgyan pa/ bong bu gu dmar zhen nas mtshan mo rgyu ba/ sprul pa sku mdog sngo skya men tre dmar po'i ga sha can spa khug mchu rings bsnams pa/ blon po bya rgod thang nag — 142

dam ༅ chos srung ma' rtogs tshon las rnam tso lhun grub/ 9)dge bsnyen gzhon nu'i cha byad can/ rdo rje dang tho ba thogs pa/ nub phyogs byu ru dmar po'i gzhal yas khang na/ tri las gsung gi rgyal po dgra lha skyes gcig dmar po zhal gcig phya gnyis kyi g.yas sba'i 'ging 'bar dang / g.yon tsan+dan gyi beng chen bsnams pa/ dar nag gi 'jol ber can dbu la smyug zhu 'khor ma gsol ba/ drel nag rkang dkar la bcibs pa'i sna gzung mon bu pu tros byas pa/ /spyang gi rol du khrid cing lcags kyi bya khra pho lhar gtang ba/ yum mdzes byed pad ma can dmar mo dam shing dang ban+ta 'dzin pa/ mdzes pa'i rgyan cha dang ldan pa/ sprul pa mthing nag ral pa gyen du brdzesashing / ag tshom ser nag 'bar ba stag lpags gyon zhing / zhing dbyug dang spyang zhi'i rgyal mtshan 'phyar ba/ blon po rdo rje grags ldan dar dmar gyi chos gos sogs dge slong gzhon nu'i cha byad can sher shing gi gseg shing bsnams shing rnga mo ga pa la bcibs pa/ byang phyogs g.yu'i gzhal yas khang sngon po ni/ tri las 'phrin las kyi rgyal po zhal gsum stod kyi mi pho che dbu gsum phyag drug pa/dkar (45na〉thing dmar ba'i zhal can/ g.yas gsum lcags kyu mda' dang ral gri/ g.yon gsum spu gri gzhu ber ka bsnams pa/ dar dkar gyis stod g.yogs shing zhing lpags dang stag sham gyon pa/ dbu la tshag zhu gdugs thabs su gsol ba/ seng ge dkar mo la bcibs pa'i sna gzung mon bu pu tras byas pa/ 'tshub ma rol du khrid cing skyung ka pho nyar gtang ba/ yum bdud gza' smin dkar mthing nag bdud kyi slog pa gyon pa/ dam shing ༷ bsnams pa/ sprul pa nag po zhing lpagasagasol zhing sprul gyis brgyan pa/ stag dang spyang zhi'i rgyal mtshan 'phyar ba/ blon po pu tra nag po dar nag gi ral ka gsol zhing gri gug 'dzin pa/ drel rta nag po la bcibs pa/ de dag gi phyi rol gyi phyogs dang phyogs mtshams rnams su blon po sha grol gyi grol 'khol po 'dzin pa sngon po/ sngo sangasa'abag dang seng ge /mon bu a tsa ra dang sprelu dge slong 'khar gsil thogs pa brgya/ sngags pa phur bu thogs pa brgya/ bud med ral pa sprugs pa brgya/ skyes pa gri phub thogs pa brgya la sogs pa 'khor dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ gtso 'khor de dag rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar —143

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)po/ thugs kar hūṃ sngon pos mtshan par gyur/ de nas bzhengs su gsol ba ni/ rang bzhin bde ba chen po'i ngang nyid las/ /mkha' la chu 'dzin gsar du 'khrigs pa ltar/ /sprul pa'i bka' srung rgyal po sku lnga po/ /gsang yum blon por bcas pa sku bzhengs shig /dbus phyogs mcho me gi pho brang yangs pa nas/ /thugs kyi rgyal po 'khor bcas sku bzhengs shig shar phyogs dung gi pho brang ྾/ /sku yi rgyal po ྾/ /lho phyogs gser gyi ྾/ /yon to ྾/ /nub phyogs byu ru'i ྾/ /gsung gi ྾/ /byang (45ba)phyogs g.yu yi ྾/ /'phrin las ྾/ /sprul pa yang sprul sa dang bar snang kun/ /ma lus gang ba gnasa'adir sku bzhengs shig /spyan 'dren/bzhugs gso me/ bstod pa/ dam bseb rnams ni gter gzhung dngos las 'di ltar/ lhaḥ rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i gnas mchog nas: ting nge 'dzin gyis bskyed pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol ba'i chos skyong ni gnod sbyin rgyal po sde lnga 'khor dang bcas dam tshig gzhung bzhin bsrung ba'i skyes mchogo khyod thugs dam rgyud bskul gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol bka' yi bstan pa bsrung ba'i don ched du chos kyi dbyings nas sgyu mar skur bzhengs shig thugs rje chen pos 'gro ba'i don mdzad khyod thugs dam rgyud bskul gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol thugs kyi rgyal po brgya byin rgyal po dang : yum gcig sharnyi ro zan mthu mo che blon po srog bdag bka' yi bya ra ba: 'khor dang bcas pa gnas 'dir ྾/ sku yi rgyal po mon bu pu tra ste: gsang ba'i yum gcig bdud mo ro langs ma bka' yi blon po bya khrid mig gcig po 'khor dang bcas pa gnas 'dir ྾/ /yon to rgyal po gnod sbyin shing bya can gsang ba'i yum gcig gser gyi spu gri ma bka' yi blon po bya rgod thang nag ste: 'khor dang bcas pa ྾/ gsung gi rgyal po dgra lha skyes gcig bu gsang ba'i yum gcig mdzes byed pad+ma skyes bka' yi blon po rdo rje gragasaldan te 'khor dang bcas te ྾/ / 'phrin las rgyal po zhal gsum mi pho che gsang ba'i yum chen bdud gza' smin dkar ma bka' yi blon po pu tra nag po ste 'khor bcas za/ dzaḥ/ baṃ sngo a la —144

dam ༅ chos srung ma' rtog tshon la rnam pha lhun grub/ 9)la hoḥ.e gye hi bha ga wan e ku sha sa 46nasgo ya dzaḥdzaḥzhes phyag rgya bzhis rgyas gdab bo//bzhus su gsol ba ni/lhaḥm tre bsgral ba'i gnas mchog dam pa 'dir kha bub gan rkyal gyi chings gdan du bsnol:rin cen sna lnga'i ri rab gzhal yas brtsegs nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan gyis mdzes par spras:ma chags lhun gyis grub pa'i gnas mchog 'dir bstan pa bsrung phyir gnyis med brtan par bzhugs dbus phyogs mthing nag 'bar ba'i gzhal yas su:thugs kyi rgyal po 'khor bcasabazhugs su gsol shar phyogs dkar po dung gi ྾/sku yi rgyal po ྾//lho phyogs rin cen gser gyi ྾/yon to rgyal po ྾/nub phyogs byu ru dmar po'i ྾//gsung gi rgyal po ྾//byang phyogasarin cen g.yu yi ྾//'phrin las rgyal po ྾//pad+ma a be sha ya a/badz+ra tri du ru hā/badz+ra a ti tismaka ra sha ya/sam ya kha skyor dkar po a be sha ya pre/a be sha ya ti/ lhan/ces pas gnyis su med par bzhugs par bsam/phyag 'tshal ba ni/lhaḥ'ajig rten las la 'grub pa'i dregs pa can rgyal po chen po sku lnga'i skur bstan pa sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa'i rgyal po sdelnga'i tsho gos la phyag 'tshal lo a rkan ya a be sha ya/ha he ha ra ti sngo zhes 'khor rnams kyi gtso bo la phyag 'bul bar bsam mo//dam bsre ba ni/cha āḥlha/sarba pañtsa a gra ta hūṃ ngaḥbargya rtsas byin gyis brlabs/dam bsrel rab 'bring tha gsum ste//spyi rgyugs su byed tshe/tha tshig ni//ཿskyesamachog dgra lha chen po khyod khyod dang bdag gnyis dam bsre na dpal chen khrag 'thung gzu dang dpang :dus tshigs 'di nas bzung nas ni:ji srid 'tsho yi bar nyid du bdag kyang dam las ma 'da' bar 46brkog tu rgyal po mchod cing bsten khyod kyang dam las mi 'da' bar rtag tu bdag gi grogs mdzod cig ci ste dam las khyod 'das na rdo rje gnod sbyin khro bo yis//thal ba'i rdul bzhi brlag par byed rdo rje dri chu bdud rtsi mchog pañtsa a gra ta dang sbyar dam tshog snying gi khrag chen po bsre ba'i mchog de srog gi snying :snying dang snying gi grogs por byas rtag tu dam lasam 'da' zhig:badz+ra tri du rak+ṣa yak+ṣa hūṃ/ma hā pañtsa ༷ khru ta khā hi/zhes rang gi lce la yang bzhag/rgyal

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)po rnams la yang gtor/bdag dang rgyal po gnyis med du gyur te/ji srid 'tsho'i bar bka' yi cing las byed par bsam mo//phyi mchod 'bul ba ni/sprul pa'i chos rgyal 'khor bcas spyan snga sa/rba rlabs chal chil g.yo ba'i mchod yon dang //sna tsho gos me rtag phang phung ci yang g.yo//dngar ba'i dud sprin nam mkha'i khyen kun 'gengs//nyi zla ltar gsal mar me'i 'phreng ba dang //sman gyis ches cher sbags pa'i dri byu tshogs//phun tsho gos ro brgya'i bsgos bzang ji snyed pa//snyan cing brjid pa'i rol mo'i sgra dbyangs rnams//dngos bshams yid kyis sprul te legs 'bul na//'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub par mdzod//'phrin las bzhi'i mchod pa ni/sprul pa'i chos rgyal sku lnga 'khor bcasal//gzugs mdzes gar dang snyan pa'i rol mo'i sgra//dri zhim ro mchog reg bya lha yi gos//'bul gyi zhi ba'i las rnams sgrub par mdzod//rin cen gdugs dang gser nya pad+ma dung //bum bzang dpal gyi be'u rgyal mtshan dang //'khor lo sprul pa'i rgyal por 'bul byed na//tshe dpal bsod nams rgyasapa'i wen las mdzod//47na phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i 'khor lo dang //rin cen bas mo blon po glang po rta//dmag dpon sprul pa'i rgyal por 'bul byed na/khams gsum dbang du bsdu ba'i 'phrin las mdzod//bka' srung gnod sbyin chen po'i spyan snga sa/dmar chen khrag gi a mtsho ltar bskyil//mig sogs dbang po lnga yi me tog dang /sha chen bsregs pa'i dud sprin lang long g.yo//tshil chen zhun mar las 'ongs mar me'i 'phreng /sha rus phung por spungs pa'i zhal zas dang //dung wo rkang gling rol mo'i tshogs 'bul gyi//mdzo spyod drag po'i wen las myur du sgrubs//nang mchod 'bul ba ni/rtsa rgyud yan lag stong sbyar a mṛ ta//bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa dam pa 'di//kun tu bzang po rdo rje 'chang dbang la//rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul//oṃ āḥlha ma hā sarba pañtsa a skṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/phyag na rdo rje pad+ma thod phreng rtsal//jo mo 'tsho rgyal khri srong lde'u bas//mnga' bdag shing ral gu ru don seng la//rtsa brgyud ྾//oṃ āḥlha ྾//rtsa bral bya btang 'jam dbyangs blo gros dang //'jam dbyangs dpal rin dpal lda/ /na grub pa//nam mkha' bzang po bka' brgyad

dam ༅ chos srung ma' rtogs tshon las rnam tso lhun grub/ 9)gzhon bzang la//rtsa brgyud ྾//— ཿlha ྾//skal ldan rgya mtsho mi 'gyur las lo gling //'bri gung chos rgyal rin cen phun tshogs rje//nyi zla sangs rgyas lan bu dkar chen la//rtsa brgyud ྾//oṃ āḥlha ྾//rdo rje 'chang dbang pha bong kha pa'i zhabs//thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol dpal//bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma la//rtsa
