brgyud ྾//oṃ āḥlha ྾//yi dam pad+ma dbang chen dkyil 'khor lha//rgyal po sku lnga yang sprul gsang yum blon//'khor dang bcas la bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul//47bsku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol//oṃ āḥlha ma hā sarba pañtsa a khra ta kha raṃ khā hi/dmar chen khrag gi rba rlabs rab 'byug pa'i//zhing bcu'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i dngas ma ni//sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po 'khor bcas la//'bul la nye bar bzhes la dgyes dgur rol//ma hā rak+ta kha raṃ khā hi/sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags/ las skyes pa'i rdo rje rtse gcig pa dmar po 'od kyi sbu gu can gyis gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar gyur/badz+ra ya glu 'a hi/dun ni dun ting 'a hi/yag nag po 'a hi/sha grol hu ru khā hi/kyi grol hu ru khā hi/tsit+ta ma hā 'a hi/'dzin po ru tra khā hi/sdom po chang rgyud khya hi/ru tra ru tra khā hi/go ro tsa na khā hi/rag tshul pa khā hi/sha rgyud snying rgyud khā hi/dbang po sna lnga 'a hi/sha ma ru tri khā hi/ji tismo hoḥbyu tsa badz+ra du ho/bdun nam nyer gcig sogs dang /ma hā rā dza sa pa ri wā ra / nas shabha'i bar mdzod/oṃ āḥlha gis nang mchod 'bul/de nas bstod cing 'phrin las bcol ba thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtshos mdzad pa 'di ltar/lhaḥm lus rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse gcig bsdus nas//au ṇ+ḍi ya nar pad+ma'i ge sar las//legs 'khrungs rgyal dbang pad+ma saṃ bha was//gnas 'dir mnga' thang riṭa brgyud 'phel bar mdzod//mgon des bod khams phan bde 'byung ba'i gzhi//zab yangs mi 'gyur lhun gyisagrub la sogs//gtsug lag khang kun bsrung bar mnga' gsol ba'i//chos skyong chen po khyod la bdag bstod do//mtha' bral chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kurngu //'phrin las rnam bzhis bstan pa srung ba'i phyir//sku lnga'i 4ni snam rol sna tsho gos sto/ 7mdzad pa'i//bstan srung wo po khyod la bdag

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)bstod do//gang la ma rdzo bstod bsnyen sgrub lhur blangs na//dpag bsam shing dang bum bzang nor bu ltar//'dod dgu'i dngos grub char bzhin 'bebs mdzad pa'i//bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal por bdag bstod do//sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po 'khor bcas kyis//sa dang bar snang gang ba'i spyan gzigs dang //dam rdzas mchode gtor rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la//phun tsho gos cho rigs 'phel ba'i 'phrin las mdzod//gling bzhi'i dpal la 'dod dgur dbang sgyur ba'i//gser gyi 'khor los sgyur rgyal ji bzhin du//phun tshogs yon to ldan pa'i sras stong dang //ldan pa'i mnga' thang chab srid brtan par mdzod//bshags pa bya ba ni/lhaḥkun tu bzang po rigs 'dzin pad+ma 'byung //rtsa brgyud bla ma rta mgrin dbang gi lha//sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po 'khor bcas rnams//rnal 'byor bdag la deng 'dir dgongs su gsol//bdag cag ma rig sgrib pa'i dbang gyur te//dngos grub rtsa ba bla mar dmod pa dang //yi dam lha la spong len bgyis pa dang //gsang ba sngags kyi dam tshig nyams pa bshags//khyad par sprul pa'i rgyal po 'khor bcas la//bsnyen sgrub mchod gtor bskang ba chag pa dang //gtang rag le lo'i dbang gyur dus las yol/ /mchod rdzas mi gtsang sbags sogs mthol lo bshags/ /gdug can dgra dang zas gtam tshos dang //'phrin las rnam bzhi'i bya ba nye bar bor//'gro la brtse ba'i snying rje btang ba sogs//theg chen tshul dang 'gal rnams mthol lo bshags//cho ge kun gdod nas stong pa'i rang bzhin la//kun rdzob 'khrul ngor bgyid 48ba ngo'i nyes pa rnams//gsal stong 'dzin pa med pa rig pa'i gshis//spros bral chos dbyings du dag par mdzod//tsho gos byin gyis brlab pa ni/ā+oṃ sarba dra bye /sho dha ni hūṃ phags/raṃ me khaṃ hūṃ hūṃ āḥ.āḥca ā+oṃ ha ho 1spyan drangasapa ni/dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad 'dus pa'i dpal//pad+ma thod phreng dbang chen yab yum lha//dang bo ging dang chos skyong srung ma rnams//ye shes tshogis la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol//dpa' po 'bul ba ni/rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lha tsho gos dang //dpa' bo ging dang chos srung gtor bdag la//zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa dam pa 'bul//ma// dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol//gu ru

dam ༅ chos srung ma' rtogs mun la rnam sto lhun grub/ 9)de wa ḍā gi ni gha na tsa po gu tsa khā hi/bshags pa ni/yi ge brgya pa brjod//tham zan lta bu la dgra bgegs kyi gzugs su dmigs te/ni tri dzaḥme mchog pad+ma thod phreng rtsal phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga gdengs g.yon pa phur bus dgra snying gzir gnod byed dgra bgegs rdul du rlog rtswa badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dza/dri tri mā ra ya hūṃ phags bstab pa ni/pad+ma thod phreng 'khor bcas rnams//rab tu 'jigs pa'i zhal phye zhig/dgra bgegs sha rus mchode par 'bul//mnyam nyid ngang du mchod pa bzhes//gu ru de wa ḍā gi ni dgra bgegs sha khrag rus pa la kha kha khā hi 'a hi/de nas bskang ga sgo ni/bskang rdzas byin gyis brlabs te/lhaḥrab mas dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus pa'i//bstan srung sprul pa'i rgyal po 'khor bcas pa//phyi nang gsang ba'i dam rdzas kyis skongs na//dgyes dgur spyod la bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/khrag gi a rba rlabs srid rtser zhakhrug/49na gdug can bsgral ba'i dbang po'i me rtag g.yo/sha chen sbos dkar bsregs pa'i dud sprin 'thul//tshil ོ sgron me tshar du dngar ba 'dis//chos stong rgyal bo sde lnga'i thugs dam bskang //gsang ba'i yum chen rnam lnga'i thugs dam bskang //'jigs rung sprul pa lnga yi thugs dam bskang //bka' nyan blon po'i tsho gis kyi thugs dam bskang //'khor tsho gis rgya mtsho'i thugs dam skongs gyur nas//bstan 'gro'i phan bde bla ma'i sku tshe spel//sa dbang rgyal po'i mnga' thang rgyas pa dang //bdag sogs bsam pa'i don rnams hrūb par mdzod/khrag zhag 'khyil ba'i ngad ldan dri chab dang /sha khrag don snying spungasapa'i zhal zas tshogis//rkang gling dung chen sil snyan thod rnga sogs//snyan brjid rol mo'i bye brag mtha' yas pas/sgro /re'i mtshams su chos skyong rgyal po so gos tshig rkang pa brgyad po kun la 'gre//rin cen sga srab ldan pa'i cang shes rta//'jigs rung rdo rje'i rwa gdengs g.yag rog tshogs//'dod 'jo'i ba dang rwa lugs 'phur lding bya//seng go glang ོ khyi spyang spra sprel gyis//chos skyong rgyal po ྾//'ja' tshon lta bur bkra ba'i khyim bya dang //mon nag a tsa ra yi dga' ba'i gar//ru tshon sprul pa'i snang bas blun byed du//ngo mtshar gzigs mor ༷༷ ba'i tsho gis rnams kyis//chos skyong rgyal po ྾//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)pad rwag mdangs la 'khu ba'i sag theb la//gser sbyangs mdzes pa'i ri mo ci yang bkra//mig sman khu bas byug 'dra zhwa phod dang //dar nag las grub theb zhwa'i tsho gis rnams kyis//chos skyong rgyal po ྾/kha dog sna lnga'i za 'og 'jol ber dang //dgra bcom mas kyi snam sbyar rung mthun gos//gnyis 'thung pags pa stag bi/ sham thabs dang //zhing 49ba than dar gyi stod g.yogs la sogs kyis/chos skyong rgyal po ྾/ /sra brtan khrab rmog la sogs go cha'i rigs/ /gsal 'tsher 'od kyis phyogs kun ci yang 'geng //mda' mdung ral gri dgra sta spu gri sogs//dgra bgegs phye mar 'thag pa'i mtshon cha yis//chos skyong rgyal po ྾//dbang sngon las grub rtog gis rab mdzes shing //gser sbyangs rtsibs la dar gyi sham bu can//gdugs dang rma bya seng ge stag dang dom//dred gzigs gcan gzan pags pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis//chos skyong rgyal po ྾//rno ngar spu gri rdo rje gseg shang dang //dam shing dgra sta zhags pa ka pā la//gri gug can beng mda' gzhu lcags kyu dang //dar nag ru mtshon shag ti tri shu mdas//chos stong rgyal po ྾//thod pa sbrul nag gser so gos rin cen sa//ngo mtshar yid du 'ong ba'i bkod mdzes dang //glang seng drel rta rnga mo bong bu sogs//stong gsum skad cig myul ba'i bzhen pa yis//chos skyong rgyal po ྾//sna tshogs 'bru sna khrag chang gis sbran par//dam rdzasabadud rtsir ldan pa'i gtor tsho gos dang /khang mdzes gser gyi rgya phibs kyis mdzes pa'i//sgrub dang mchod pa'i gtor ma'i tshogs rnams kyis//chos stong rgyal po ྾//nyi ma zla ba rgyal srid rin cen bdun//ri rab gling bzhi gling phran dpag bsam shing / /yan lag brgyad ldan rdzing bu yid bzhin nor/ /dgyes pa bskyed pa'i mchod pa'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /chos skyong rgyal po ྾//gdod nas lhun grub dpal ldan kun tu bzang //dkyil 'khor 'khor lo shar ba bka' brgyad lha//dbyer med so sor snang ba'i bstan srung cher//yid ches mos pa'i rten mchog dam pa 'dis//chos skyong rgyal po ྾//stod pa ni/lhaḥchos dbyings bde r+pā rgyas pa'i mkha' klong las//sgyu 'phrul du ba'i rol gar smi byed dbang //mkhyen brtse nus pa'i 'od kyis phan bde'i tshal///sa mdzad dus gsum sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung //

dam can chos srung ma' rtogs wen la rnam pha lhun grub/ 9)(50na bo pa' bas gar bsgyur mkha' 'gros glu dbyangs len/ /ging chen khro rngam rol pas bdud dpung skrad/ /zhi khro'i lha yi rnam rol mtha' yas pa'i/ /rtsa gsum 'khor los mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /rang bzhin yongs dag dung gser byu ru dang / /g.yu sogs rin cen las grub gzhal yasakhang / /nang du dgra dpung bsgral ba'i khrag gi mtshor/ /keng rus zla ba'i dum bu lta bur bkram/ /glo mchin snying gi 'phreng ba rgyu ma yi/ srud bur brgyus pa'i lda ldis phyogs kun 'brel/ /g.yang gzhi'i bla bre sha yi lhu dum nyil/ /'jigs rung mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dbus/ /sa 'dzin dum bu chad 'dra'i gnyis 'thung steng / /mig sman khu bas byugs pa'i srin po'i gzugs/ /g.yas kyi zhags pasabacings pa'i zhing bcu'i tshogs/ /za bar rngams pa'i zhal gdangs phyag g.yon gyis/ /dkar nag snying gi mtshams su spu gri bsnun/ /mthing nag dar dang 'og lhags sku la gsol/ /dar nag theb zhu'i zhwa can brgya byin che/ /dbus phyogs thugs kyi rgyal po khyod la bstod/ /rab dkar ba gam dbus su seng ge'i steng / /mig gis blta bar bzod dka'i khro gtum can/ /phyag g.yas gser sbyangs 'bar ba'i rdo rje dang / /g.yon pa sher shing las grub gseg shing bsnams/ /in+d+ra ni la'i mdangs 'dzin men tri yi/ /'jol ber lhab lhub dar nag theb zhu can/ /sprul pa'i bstan srung mon bu pu tra che/ shar phyogs sku yi rgyal po khyod la bstod/ /mtshams sprin mdangs la 'khu ba'i pho brang dbus/ /mun pa'i phung po brtsegs la nyin byed kyis/ /'byud lta'i gar gyis rnam rol phyag g.yon gyis/ /bdud kyi zhags pas bcings pa'i log 'dren mig /(50ba g.yas kyi dgra stas bkas tshe srid gsum yang //'dar byed sku la dug gi brang 'gro dang / /stag lpags kyis brgyan gnod sbyin shing bya can/ /lho phyogs yon tan rgyal po khyod la bstod/ /rak+ta'i rba klong mdangs 'phros gzhal med na/ khugs drag dri bzhen stobs ldan drel nag steng / /mi srun dgra la rngams pa'i zhal gdangs shing / /phyag g.yas sba 'khar brdeg pas 'dzin ma 'gas/ /tsan bang g.yon gyis gzas las srid pa gsum/ /rab 'jomasalhab lhub mthing nag dar phod dang / /smyug zhug legs spud dgra lha skyes gcig pu/ /nub phyogs—151—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho gsung 'bum/ (4)gsung gi rgyal po khyod la bstod//gnam sngon brtsegs pa'i khang dbus gdong lnga'i steng //khro chagasazhi ba'i zhal can gdug pa'i dgra//'doms byed lcags kyu spu gri mda' gzhu gri//ber /g.yasagayon phyag 'dzin dar dkar gyis//stod brgyan zhing gi pags pa stag sham rgyan//thong chen steng na tshag zhu nag po gsol//bstan srung dgra lha'i gtso bo pe ha ra//byang phyogs tshon las rgyal po khyod la bstod//kun bzang thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul rol gar las//mngon spyod las kyi 'dul yul brnag pa'i dgrar//drag tu khros pa'i skur bzhengs srung ma'i gtso//sprul pa'i chos kyi rgyal po sku lnga po//char sprin stug po lta bu'i bzhin ras ngos//smin ma'i gar gyi glog 'phreng 'byug pa'i dbus//sdang mig bgrad pa'i 'od gzis legs nyes kun//gsal bas srog la rngams pa'i zhal gyi nang /khrag zhag rba klong 'khrug pa'i dbu 'phreng gi/gangs ri ltar dkar mche ba dmar nyams byed/khams gsum skad cig myul ba'i shugs drag gis//srid gsum kun las rnam par rgyal la bstod//dbyar rnga'i sgra la hūṃ phags drag po'i gdangs//dgra bgegs51na sog rtsa gcod pa'i rig sngags kyis//dmod pa'i tshig gi dug dbal mas gyi dar//mi bzad gsung gi nga ro che la bstod//pha mtha' yongs bral nyer zhi'i thugs kyi dbyings//g.yo med gdod nas grub pa'i ngo bo ṣ+ka//ro gcig gnyis su snang ba'i gnod byed tshogs//sgrol phyir khros pa'i sems 'cha' khyod la bstod//med byung dgyes dgur spyod pas bde ba'i dpal//rgyas byed yum lnga sprul pa pho nya'i tshogs//las kun thogs med sgrub pa'i rdzu phrul can/khrog bdag bka' yi blon po lnga la bstod//chos rgyal sku lnga'i sprul pa rnam pa lnga//gseg shang slong ba'i snod thogs nyan thos brgya//mig sman bdud kyi gos can sngags pa brgya/khun pa'i lan bu gsig pa'i bdud mo brgya//g.yul du zhugs pa'i dpa' bo stag shar brgya//dge slong mon bu rgya gar spe'u sogs//yang sprul sa dang bar snang khyon gang ba'i//'khor tsho gos dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la bstod//zab yangs gtsug lag khang dang yang dben gyi//gsung gi gnas su mtsho skyes rdo rje yis//bde gshegs rgyal ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du//bcug cing dam bzhag srung mar

dam can chos srung ma' rtogs skrun la rnam sto lhun grub/ 9)bka' bsgos pa'i//mchod bstod dregs pa'i dbang phyug 'khor bcas kyi//sngon gyi tha tshig bro bor ma g.yel bar//rgyal ba'i bstan srungs chos 'khor mtha' dbus skyongs//zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las ma lus sgrubs//bdag cag bran g.yog sder bcas rgyu sbyor la//g.yul gshom ru mtshon nyer 'tsho'i gnod pa rnams//ma lus bzlog ste nam yang mi mthun phyogs//kun las rnam par rgyal ba'i 'phrin las mdzod//ga pa'i sems 'chang rtsub mo'i sbyor ba dag/mngon du gyur pa'i mi bsrun dgra sde'i 5bdapung //phyogs mtshams steng 'og gang du gnas gyur kyang //myur du bla srog tshe gsum zhal du thob//brtul zhugs grub pa'i dbang po thod 'phreng rtsal//mnga' bdag chos kyi ral pa'i cod pan can//mdor na dngos brgyud bla ma'i bstan srung khyod//bcol ba'i las kun thogs med sgrub par mdzod//de nas thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtshos gnang ba 'di ltar//ka ma la yi ge sar las byung mtsho las skyes pa'i rdo rje zhes/kha ba can 'dir grags pa'i gur kum phyogs kyi bu mo'i 'gram par bkod//ga na bzhugs kyang thugs rje'i nyi 'od rgya mtsho'i gos can kun tu khyab//nga yi snying gi chu skyes lte bar rnam par rtsen pa'i gar mdzod cig kho co'i dbyangs kyi nga ros 'bod do ba gam mngon mtho'i pho brang nas//cha shas 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs sprul pa'i chos rgyal gnas 'dir spyon//ja chang gas ba rgya mtshor rab 'khyil rba rlabs g.yo bas chu mthong 'gog/nya sha khrag zhag rgya mtsho rtser ba brgyan ri ltar skrungs pa'i mchod gtor bzhes//ta thā ga ta'i bstan la gnod byed me tog mda' can sder gtogos pa//tha ba lta bur ma rungs sems 'chang bsam sbyor ga pa'i dgra dang bgegs//da lta nyid du rings par sgrol la snying khrag dron mo hub kyis bzhes//na tsha la sogs chad ba drag pos rkyen dang 'tsham par tshar chod cig/pa ra mi ta'i dgongs pa ji bshin chosadabyings kun gsal mdzes pa'i ngang //pha mtha' bral ba'i mkhyen pa'i 'od stong 'grogs pa'i rtse dga' lhur len yang //ba mo ltar dkar mche ba'i chu 'dzin ljags kyi glog phreng rnam par g.yo//ma lus srid gsum rab tu gsal byed mthar byed rta babs ma rga sum bzhin//tsa dang lo ma'i gnas

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)mal la brten khyod sku ting 'dzin pir gyis (52na)bris/ /tsha grang sdug bsngal khyad du bsad nas drang srong gzhan bzhin bzlas brjod brtson/ /dza zhes dus drug dag tu bos na ma g.yel ma g.yel da tshur spyon/ /wa skyes lta bu'i dgra dang bgegs rnams da lta nyid du gzhom par mdzod/ /zhwa yi tog ltar sdebargyad kun gyi zhabs sen 'dab 'phreng spyi bos bsten/ /za byed dpa' bar 'jig pa'i bskal pa nye bar ston pa'i me lce'i tshogs/ /'a 'ur sgra wo rgyud mang sgrog byed drag po'i rlung dang tshos pa'i dbus/ /ya ma la sogs sde brgyad 'byung po'i 'khor gyis yongs bskor khyod la bstod/ /rwa chen gdengs pa'i 'bar ba'i rdo rje ka pā la ni phyag zung 'dzin/ /la lar gdug pa sna tsho gis 'dul phyir drag po'i phyag rgya sna tsho gos can/ sha za bye ba'i 'khor gyis yongs bskor 'dod dgu'i gos ster dpag bsam dbang / /sa ོ skyong ba'i dbang po gang 'di srid mthar zhabs brtan dge legs mdzod/ /ha sto gad brgyangasadrag tu bzhad tshe srid pa gsum 'di phye mar 'gyur zhes cher bskrag nas/ /a don skye med dbyings su bros snyam bdag yid the tshom dpyang thag 'dzin/ /ha la'i dug gis myur du khyab pas dgra bgegs ma lus brlag pa dang / /a la la zhes dga' ba'i gar byed dngos grub ma lus yid bzhin stsol/ /'phrin las bcol ba ni/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i bstan srung mthu rtsal can/ /log 'dren dgra bgegs gshed ma srog gi bdag /gnod sbyin rgyal po sku lnga 'khor bcas rnams/ /sngon gyi dam tshig gnyen po nye bar dgongs/ /bsam yas mchims phu gsung gi dben gnas su/ /slob dpon chen po pad+ma thod 'phreng gis/ /bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor zhal phye nas/ /dbang bskur dam tshig bsgrags pa nye bar dgongs/ /rje 'bangs grags (52bdagu mnga' bdag nyang ral sogs/ /dngos dang brgyud pa'i bla ma'i tsho gis rnams kyi/ /spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas ma bsnyel bar/ /bdag gis 'phrin lasabacol tshe mthum zhan/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i bstan/ /de 'dzin skyes bu khrimasaldan 'dus pa'i sde/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i bya ba ma lus pa/ /yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel ba'i 'phrin lasamadzod/ khyad par dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs mchog /blo bzang snyan 'gyur ring lugs grags—154

dam can chos srung ma' rtogs wen las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ (gepa'i dbyangs//gdugs dkar srid pa'i rtse mor rab khyab nas//nam yang mi nub ring du gnas gyur cig/dga' ldan phyogs las rnam rgyal pho brang cher//chos srid gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong can//bsod nams bye bas yongs su nyer drangs pa//kun las ma ro zhe mtho rab tu brtan par mdzod//thub bstan 'dzin la zla bral dam pa'i chos//skyong ba'i rtsod pa'i dus kyi 'khor lo sgyur//sa spyod rgyal po chen po'i sku tshe dang //mtshan jus mnga' thang chab srid rgyas par mdzod//dus kun bsnyen sgrub gsol mchod lhur len pa'i//rnal 'byor bdag gis bsams pa'i don kun sgrubs//gnod byed dgra dang bgegs rnams thal bar rlog/zhi rgyas dbang gi 'phrin las ma lus sgrubs//bskul ni/lhaḥbastan srung gnod sbyin 'khor bcas rnams//gdug can dgra la khros pa'i tshe/khro gtum mi bzad srin po'i gzugs//ha ha'i gad brgyangs 'brug ltar ldir//nyi zla brdeb cing gnas sa g.yo//thog dang ser ba shar ra ra//ru mtshon dmar po pur ru mā/mtshon cha sna tsho gos zings rtse zing //mon pa a tsar thibasase thib//gnod sbyin dmag tshogs nyer re re//zhub can ta rgyug sil li li//ru 'dren sdebazhi shigasaseshig/chos srung 'khor dang 53na ngo sa pa rnams//mas stobs rdzul rab skyed la//bstan ba 'jig cing sems can 'tshe/zhol lhor chos bzhin spyod pa la//gnod par byed pa'i gdug can dgra//lo dang zla bar ma bzhag par//snying khrag 'thung la tshar chod cig/gsol kha ni/bskang rdzas dus su bshams pa'i mthun rdzas gsol kha'i gtor ma rgya phor du phud sbran pa sogs phyag len 'du byas rgyas par gter gzhung bzhin dang 'jug pa bde ba gtso bor 'dod tshe//lhaḥgaser skyems gtsang ma phud kyi mchod pa 'di//dbus phyogs thugs kyi rgyal po sprul pa yum//blon po 'khor dang bcas pa ma lus pa//gsol lo mchod do bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod//gzhan bzhi la yang 'don pa spo//lhag ma ni/hūṃ/dpal gyi bga' nyan lhag sdud rnams//las rnams zhal bzhes dam can tshogs//'dir spyon lhag gtor 'di bzhes la//bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod//ma u tsi gi badz+ra a ro ṭa sha sam ya kha kha khā hi 'a hi/chad mtho ni/sngon tshe bcom ldan dpal chen he ru ka/pad+ma 'byung gnas rje

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)'bangs grogs lnga dang //rigs 'dzin sngags yong rat+na gling pa sogs//rtsa brgyud bla mas dam la btags pa ltar//mkha' 'gro bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs//gtor ma 'di long bcol ba'i wen las mdzod//bstan skyong ni/snro pad+ma thod phreng spyan snga sa/bod yul skyong bar khas blangs pa'i//rdo rje kun grags g.ya' ma skyong //rdo rje kun bzang bgegs kyi gtso//bdud bzhi sha med g.yu sgron ma//khyung bas rdo rje klu mo dang //rdo rje drag rgyal gnod sbyin bzhi//kong btsun de mo sman gtsig ma//g.yar mo sil dang zu le ma//sman btsun 'khor dang bcas pa rnams//53bdam rdzas gtore ma 'di bzhes la//bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod//rta bro ni/lhaḥgasang 'dus gla ma'i dkyil 'khor du//dug lnga las bskyed dgra dang bgegs//dam sri 'byung po'i snying kha sa/dpal chen drag po'i bro brdungs pas//༅ mongs ye shes dbyings su bcom//snang dgra gnod byed thal bar rlog/gzugs med gdon gyi dpung tsho gos rnams//bsgral bsam nan pa'i cho ga rdzogs//ā+oṃ hrī badz+ra kro ta ha ya shrī wa hu lu hu lu hūṃ phags/ā+oṃ lo hūṃ lo ri pa yā nan/dgra bgegs sarba sha / ste bha ya nan/de nas srid zhi dpal 'byor ma'i mjug tu/chos sku skye med stong pa'i nga nyid las//yang gsang bla ma'i dkyil 'khor 'ja' ltar shar//'gro kun srid pa'i mtsho las sa bsgral nas//skye med chos dbyings4 du badz+ra muḥ'adir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu sogs brjod//mnga' gsol ni/dbang bskur brgyud dang man ngag gdams pa'i mdzod//ji nga ster mdzad rgyal ba kun 'dus pa//dngos dang brgyud pa'i rdo rje slob dpon tshogs//drin ༅ bla ma'i ngo bor mnga' gsol lo//skyon bral sangs rgyas yang gsang lha yi tshogs//de don rgyud sde rgya mtsho dam pa'i chos//tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i rigs 'dzin dge 'dun te//skyabs gnas dbo sgo cog gsum du ྾//chos dbyings bde ba wo po'i 4 nyid las//gdug pa 'dul phyir drag po'i skur ston pa//sprul pa'i bstan srung rgyal po sku lnga po//rigs 'dzin dgra lha'i gtso bor ྾//mchod cing bstod na srid zhi'i dge legs kun//'bad med lag rtser stsol ba'i dbang gi rgyal//dpag bsam shing ltar 'dod ༷'i re ba ca//skong mdzad rgyal po wo por ྾//

dam mā cho srung ma' rtogs phren las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)bdag cag mi nor bran g.yog dgon gnas sde//mas ldan srung ma khyod la gnyer 54na ngo to de na//'gal rkyen mi mthun phyogs rnams rab zhi nas//bsam don lhun gyis grub pa'i dge legs mdzod//shis pa brjod pa ni/phun tsho gos yang gnas chos longs sprul pa'i sku//kun 'dus rtsa brgyud bla ma'i ba po shis shog/bar chad kun sel dngos grub stsol mdzad pa'i//yi dam pad+ma dbang chen ྾//dgra bgegs kun sgrol 'phrin las sgrub mdzad pa'i//bstan srung rgyal po chen po'i ྾//las kun sgrub la 'phrin las thogs med pa'i//bka' stod 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho'i ྾//gzhan yang bkra shis pa'i tshigs bcad ci rigs pa bya'o//legs byas rgya mtsho'i dpag bsam shing chen las//phan bde'i 'brasabu dud pa'i gangs can ljongs//gtsug lag yongs kyi srung ma rgyal po che//dgyes dgur spyod pa'i 'phrin las khrigs kyi rim//'gag pa med pa rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs 'di//legs byas dpung gis yangasapa'i sa chen por//dbang sgyur gang gis nye bar bskul ba ltar//bkod 'dis wen las rnam bzhi 'grub gyur cig/ces sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po 'khor dang bcas pa dgyes dgur spyod pa'i 'phrin las 'gag med rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs zhes pa 'di yang sa chen po bde bar skyong ba'i phyag mdzod bsod nams rab brtan gyis tshang la 'khyer bde ba zhig dgos zhes bskul ba la brten/bla ma'i las byang thugs sgrub yang snying 'dus pa las bsdus shing gsol mchod kyi rim pa rnams mnga' bdag gi gter byon gyi 'phrin las don bcu ma dang sgrub skor la gzhi byas thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtshosaganang ba las legs cha blangs shing /tshig sbyor gsar du dgos pa rnams bsgrigs te gnod sbyin chen pos stong grogs tshul bzhin mdzad pa'i za hor gyi rigs54bsgos byung ba'i ban+de ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho bla med rdo rje rtsal gyis rgyal po chen pos 'phral du sgrub dgos pa'i mtshan ma byung ba ltar nyin gcig la grub par bgyis pa'i yi ge pa ni ngag dbang dge legs so//na mo gu ru we/ rgyal ba kun gyi gsang gsum ma lus pa//sprul pa'i gzugs su shar ba pad+ma 'byung //dbyer med 'jam mgon mi yi srid pa can//kun mkhyen btsong kha pa la gus phyag 'tshal//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)dpal ldan theg mchog 'byor ba'i 'phrin las rnams/ /lhun grub rnam par rab rgyas rdo rje 'chang / /gsang chen chos kyi bdag po 'khon ston rje/ /snying dbus pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru'i gtsug na mdzes/ /gdug can khrag gis myos pa'i gar stabs kyis/ /dgra bgegs don snying 'byin la ches dpa' ba'i/ /sngon rabs dam pas nyer bsten chos srung 'ga'i/ /dgyes bskyed mchod pa'i 'phrin las deng 'dir spel/ /de yang chos srung 'di dag rnams la mchod gtor 'bul bar byed pa la/ so so'i sgrub skor gyi yi ge las 'byung ba ltar/ mchod gtor sman raka spyan gzigs rnams legs par bshams/ byin rlabs kyi rim pa lugs so so 'am spyi 'gro gang yang rung ba byas la/ /thog mar brten pa lha'i tsho gis bskyed pa ni/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ srung 'khor dur khrod brgyad dang ldan pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su pad+ma zla ba nyi ma ro'i gdan la hūṃ mthing nag 'phro 'du yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal nag po chen po mthing nag khro zhing rngam pa srin po drag tu khros pa'i gzugs can/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi/dang po gnyis kyis mi snying dang thod khrag (55na 'dzin pas yum la 'byud cing / 'og ma gnyis kyisaral gri dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ka bsnams pa/ /thod skam gyi dbu rgyan/ /thod rlon gyi do shal/ sbrul gyi chun po/rus pa'i rgyan dang stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ byug pa'i rdzas gsum gyi sbags shing gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa'i pang na yum mchog tsin+ta dbang phyug nag mo g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod khrag bsnams pa/ rus rgyan dang gzig sham can/ gnyis ka ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ g.yas su hūṃ las bya rog gdong can mthing nag gri gug dang ban+ta 'dzin pa/ /thod sprul dang glang lpags stag sham can/ bya rog la bcibs pa/ rgyab tu ra las srin po bya gdong can mthing kha dbu dgu'i steng na bya gdong yod pa/ phyag g.yas chu srin gyi rgyal mtshan dang / g.yon mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ sgrul mjug 'khyil zhing dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan pa/ rgyab tu hūṃ las seng gdong mthing nag dar dmar gyi phod ka gsol ba/ g.yas ru mtshon dang g.yon dmar gtor 'dzin zhing bdud rta nag po la bcibs pa/ mdun du ru las lha mo nag mo g.yas rtse gsum dang g.yon thod khrag bsnams — 158

dam can chos srung mngon rtogs 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)pa/ glang lpags dang mi mgo'i do shal can bya rog la bcibs pa/ shar sgor ri las tshangs pa dung gi thor tshugs can dkar po g.yas dar mdung dang g.yon 'bor lo 'dzin pa/ dar dkar gyi na bza' can stag ral dang gzig shubs 'chang ba/ rta dkar zhur can la bcibs pa/ lho sgor ya las gshin rje dmar po dang sngon gyi ang rag can bse phub khur ba g.yas spu gri dang g.yon btsan zhags 'dzin pa ra kham pa la bcibs pa/ nub sgor shu las btsan rgod sngo nag za 'og gi ber can/ g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon snying 'dzin pa seng ge sngon por bcibs pa/ (55ba)byang sgor k+ṣa las gnod sbyin nag po lu'u mthing kha'i gos can/ g.yas lcags kyi ber ka dang g.yon dgra snying 'dzin pa rta nag la bcibs pa/ de dag gi 'khor du dregs ba sdebargyad kyi dmag tsho gos dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ gtso 'khor de dag gi g.yas phyogs su dur khrod chen po 'jigs su rung ba'i dbus su pad+ma nyi ma ro'i gdan la hūṃ mthing nag 'phro 'du yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal mgon ma ning nag po khro zhing gtum po mi sdug pa'i gzugs can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas ru mtshon 'phyar zhing / g.yon mi snying zhagasapa 'dzin pa/ sbrul nag gi ral pa mun ltar ga khis pa/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang thod tho gyi do shal 'phyang ba/ dar nag gi 'jol ber la gser sked bcings par tsan+dan gyi ber chen gzer ba rgyad kyi dor stabs kyis me shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ g.yas su srog bdud nag po g.yas kha ṭ+wāṃ gri gug /g.yon lcags kyi par bu/ 'og mas mda' gzhu 'geng nyid rta nag la bcibs pa/ g.yon du dpal 'bar ma dmar mo g.yas ral gri dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi dang stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ nyi ma dang zla bas brgyan pa/ de dag gi 'khor du yang khol sdebargyad kyi dmag tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ dpal mgon phyag bzhi pa 'khor bcas kyi g.yon phyogs su dur khrod 'jigs su rung ba chos 'byung mthing nag khrag zhag gi rgya mtshos gang ba'i dbus su pad+ma nyi zla dgra bgegs bsnol ba'i gdan la tri 'phro 'du yongs su gyur pa las/ gza' bdud rā hu la dud kha srin po khros pa'i dbu dgu'i rtse mor bya rog gi zhal can/ phyag —159

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)dang po gnyis chu srin gyi rgyal mtshan dang sprul nag /'og ma gnyis(56na thas mda' gzhu 'geng ba/sku smad sbrul mjug tu 'khyil zhing / sku la mig stong dang lto zhal rngam zhing brjid pa/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan/ thod rlon gyi do shal/ sbrul gyi chun po/ mi lngags kyi g.yang gzhi/ stag lpags kyi sham thabasagasol ba/ ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i 'khor du/ yab yum gnyis/gza' chen brgyad/ gdong mo bzhi/ snang srid dregs pa'i dmag tsho gis dpag tu med pas bskor ba/dpal mgon ma ning 'khor bcas kyi g.yas su me rlung dmar nag 'byug pa'i dbus na bad nyi dgra bgegs bsnol ba'i gdan la hūṃ 'phro 'du yongs su gyur pa las/ tsa ri zhing skyong bdud mgon sha za nag po seng ge'i gdong pa can khro zhing gtum pa 'jigs pa'i gzugs can/ g.yu'i ral pa gyen du 'bar ba'i gseb nas seng chung mang po 'phro ba/ phyag g.yas dar mdung nag po nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing / g.yon pa dmar gyi gtor ma 'dzin pa/ dar nag gi 'jol ber lhab lhub tu gsol zhing / stag ral dang gzigs shubs rked la bcings pa/ sag lham gsol zhing bdud rta nag po rlung gi gzhog pa can la bcibs pa/ g.yon du tri las bdud mo srog gcod ma dmar nag ral pa'i gseb nas khro chung mang po 'gyed pa/ g.yas rtse gsum dang g.yon snying bsnams pa/ dar dmar gyi 'jol ber can/bdud rta dmar nag rlung gi gzhog pa can la bcibs pa/ mdun du las mkhan bam ro pho mo mdog ser spe'u'i mgo can/ lag gnyis bya sder sal btsugs te spyi bo tshugs su 'gro zhing / rkang pa gnyisakyis dmar gtor dgra la 'phen pa/ mi lpags rked la dkris shing me rlung 'tshub pa/ las mkhan dregs pa'i 'khor (56ba bo pag tu med pas bskor ba/ rā hu la 'khor bcas kyi g.yon du dur khrod chen po 'jigs su rung ba'i dbus su pad+ma nyi ma dgra bgegs bsnol ba'i gdan la k+ṣa hri 'phro 'du yongs su gyur pa las/ gnod sbyin spu gri dmar nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ dang po gnyis kyisaral gri dang snying zhags/ 'og ma gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ /thod skam gyi dbu rgyan/ dar dmar gyi 'jol ber/ glang chen gyi ko rlon/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs gyon pa/ lus—160

dam tso chos srung ma' rtog wen la rnam sto lhun grub/ 9)mig gis gang zhing lto bar srid gsum za ba'i zhal gdangs pa/stong gsum skad cig gis myul bar nus pa'i bya khyung dmar po la bcibs pa/me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs par zhu ba can gnod sbyin gdug pa'i dmag tsho gis kyis bskor ba/zhing skyong 'khor bcas kyi g.yas su dur khrod 'jigasasu rung ba'i sa gzhi la pad+ma zla nyi dgra bgegs bsnol ba'i steng du hūṃ las thugs kyi rgyal po mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis g.yas sprul zhags dang g.yon spu gri 'dzin pa/dom gyi zlog pa dar nag gi 'jol ber//theb zhu gsol zhing rin po che'i rgyan can/glang po che la bcibs pa/phyogasabazhin/sku/yon tan/gsung 'phrin las kyi rgyal po/gzhan yang yum lnga/blon po lnga/sprul pa lnga/srog bdag gnod sbyin yang le ber/ru 'dren sde bzhi sogs 'khor dpag tu med pas bskor ba/gnod sbyin dmar po'i g.yon du chos khrung /khrag mtsho zhabrug pa lcags ri nag pos bskor ba'i pha wang long bu'i sku mkhar 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i gur khyim can gyi dbus su pad nyi'i gdan la tri las dam can rdo rje legs pa mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis g.yas khro chu'i tho ba phyar zhing /g.yon 'thor rlung drag po'i gter gyi sbud pa 'dzin pa/sku la ber nag dgu brtsegs dang 57na tsho khas la sag lham gsol zhing /gser gyi ska rags rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras pa/dbu la 'obs zhu dar gyi cod pan can rgyan pa/'khor du dgyes sde ma bzhi/ging chen bzhi/mched 'khor sum brgya drug cu'i tsho gis kyis bskor ba/de dag rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/mgrin par āḥdamar po/thugs kar hūṃ sngon po/bdag mdun gyi thugs ka las 'od zer 'phros pas rang rang gi gnas nas chos skyong srung ma'i tsho gos rnams spyan drangs/lhaḥchos dbyings bde ba chen po'i klong yangs las//gdug pa 'dul phyir khros pa'i gar mdzad pa//dpal ldan ma hā kā la phyag bzhi pa//'khor bcas thogs pa med par gnas 'dir gshegs//rdo rje gdan dang dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal//'jigs rung gnas nasamagon po yab yum dang //las mgon khyab 'jug seng gdong 'bar ma dang //tshangs pa gshin rje btsan rgod gnod sbyin sogs//bka' sdod dam ༷na rgya mtshor bcas pa rnams//sngon gyi dam tshig

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)gnyen po nyer dgongs la/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin rnal 'byor skyong ba'i ched/ /ma thogs rings ba'i tshul gyis da tshur spyon/ /lhaḥ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur gshegs mā hā kā la che/ /gsang bdag khro rgyal stobs kyi bdag /ma ning nag po kun gyi rje/ /'og min gnas mchag dam pa dang / /gsang chen lhun grub dur khrod nas/ /lha chen dpal 'bar gshegs su gsol/ /leṭa ldan nag po ྾/ /bdud rgyal thod phreng ྾/ /srog bdud dpal 'bar ྾/ /yang khol sdebargyad ྾/ /'khor dang bcasapa ྾/ /lhaḥ mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i gzhal yas nas/ /chu srin gdug pa stong gi gdan steng du/ /lha chen khyab 'jug chen po spyan 'dren no/ /thugs(57ba)rje gzi brjid 'bar ba'i sku bzhengasanas/ khrag po'i gi gang dbab pa'i mthu rtsal can/ /srog ser skyin thang las rnams mthar phyin nas/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyen po bsrung ba'i phyir/ /thugs rjes dgongs nas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /rdo rje srin po rdo rje glog 'byug dang / /gza' r+ṣa brgyad dang gdong mo mgo bzhi sogs/ /grangs med lha srin sdebargyad 'khor tsho gos rnams/ /rnal 'byor 'phrin las bsgrub phyir gshegs su gsol/ /lha pad+ma thod 'phreng bka' yi pho nya ba/ /dgra bgegs thal bar rlog pa'i bdud mgon che/ /seng gdong yab yum bam ro pho mo sogs/ /'khor tshogs rgya mtshor bcas te gshegs su gsol/ /sde brgyad kun gyi dmag dpon mdzad pa'i tshe/ /'jigs rung dur khrod che nas gshegs su gsol/ /seng gdong sprul pa phyogs bcur 'gyed pa'i tshe/ /gangs dkar te se'i mgul nas mo/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro'i gtso bo mdzad pa'i tshe/ /la phyi gangs kyi gnas nas ྾/ /sngags 'chang yongs kyi dgra lha mdzad pa'i tshe/ /gnas mchog tsa ri tra nas mo/ /lha dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi bstan srung mchog /srog bdag bshan pa dmar po mi bsrun pa/ /ri rab thal bar rlog pa'i rdzus la can/ /gnod sbyin chen po gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /dmar po mi zan ྾/ /smug po spyan mang ྾/ /smug nag 'od 'phro ྾/ /gza' bdud chen po ྾/ /gter bdag chen po ྾/ /lha srin sdebargyad ྾/ /gnod sbyin dmag tsho gis sko/ /'khor dang bcas pa ྾/ /lhaḥ rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i gnas mchogo dang / /—162

dam ༅ chos srung ma' rtogs mun las rnam sto lhun grub/ 8)mi 'gyur bsam yas gtsug lag khang sogs nas/ /thugs kyi rgyal po brgya byin chen po dang / /sku dang yon tan gsung 'phrin rgyal po lnga/ /yum blon sprul pa srog bdag yang le ber/ /bka' (58na gnyan yang sprul dmag tsho gis bcas pa rnams/ /dbyar dus sprin dkar gsar pa'i lang long ltar/ /ma thogs rings pa'i tshul gyis da tshur spyon/ /lhaḥ dbang wo thugs sprul rdo rje gshog rgod rtsal/ /rigasa'adzin yongs kyi dgra lha btsan rgod che/ /pad+mā ka ra'i dge bsnyen rdo rje legs/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i gshed ma mgar ba nag /gsang ba'i yum bzhi ging chen sdebazhi dang / /mched 'khor sum brgya drug cur bcas pa rnams/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las ma lus bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /da lta nyid du gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ ma hā kā la ye ka tsa ti su na lha ta hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kā la ka kha mu kha ma ma rag mo dzi li bi na ra hūṃ phaṭa/ rag sha rā hu la/ gang ka ra/ ya ma ra tsa tri tsa shu la ya ka/ sarba dun na'o ki ni/oṃ shrī ma hā kā la/ rā hu la/ oṃ sing ha mu kha sin ra ma/ e he rma ru rtse/ ma hā rā dza/ badz+ra sa du/ sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥlha baṃ sngo gnyis su med par gyur/ mi bzad 'jigs su rung ba'i gzhal yas dbus/ /bad nyi bam chen bsnol ba'i khri steng du/ /dam can chos skyong srung ma'i tsho gos rnamasakun/ /dgyes pa chen pos brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /sam ya a bhe sha ya tiṣ+ṭha ya hūṃ āḥ mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ /dam can srung ma lor dang bcas rnams la/ /dmar chen mchod yon dbang po'i me tog dang / /tshil chen dud pa zhun chen mar me'i tshogs/ khrag zhag dri chab sha rus zhal zas dang / /rkang gling rol mo 'dod yon rnam pa lnga/ /rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar a skṛ ta/ /bha lo gtor ma dmar chen rak+ta'i tshogs/ /chos skyong srung ma 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bcol ba'i 'phrin las(58ba༄sgrub par mdzod/ /sngar gyi sngags gsham du/ ji nas shabha'i bar/ rū pa nas spar+sha'i bar dang / ma hā pañtsa a yi ta kha raṃ khā hi/ ma hā bha ling ta ྾/ /ma hā rak+ta ྾/ /zhes brjod/ /nyams chags bshags shing bskang ba ni/ lhaḥ kun bzang he ru ka dang pad+ma 'byung / /mnga' bdag nyang ban pad+ma las 'brel rtsal/ /rig 'dzin sngags 'chang rat+na gling pa sogs/ /dngos dang —163—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)brgyud pa'i bla ma'i tshogs rnams dgongs/ /bdag cag ma rig 'khrul pa'i gzhan dbang gis/ /legs tshogs kun gyi 'byung gnas bla ma dang / /dngos grub gter gyur yi dam lha tsho gos kyi/ /sku gsung thugs dang 'gal ba'i nyes pa bshags/ /mar gyur 'gro la byams dang brtse ba btang / /bstan dgra bsgral sogs 'phrin las rnam bzhi g.yel/ /gsang chen chos la yid gnyis za ba sogs/ /rtsab yan lag dam tshig 'gal ba bshags/ khyad par mthu ldan srung ma'i tsho gos rnams kyi/ /bsnyen sgrub las sbyor dus kyi bskang ba chag /mthun rdzas dam nyams mi gtsang gis sbags sogs/ /bag med dbang gis spyad pa'i nyes kun bshags/ /sgyu ma'i skyes bu srog dang bral ba ltar/ /ma dag 'khrul ngor bsags pa'i nyes pa kun/ /gsal stong gdod nas dag pa rig pa'i dbyings/ /bde chen chos kyi nga du bshags par bgyi/ /lhaḥ dngos bshams yid sprul mchod sprin rgya tsho'i tshogs/ /rang rang mthun pa'i rdzas su byin brlabs nas/ /mthu ldan dam can srung ma'i spyan lam du/ /med byung dgyes pa wo po bskyed gyur cig /'bod pa'i dam rdzas g.yab dar nag po dang / /stong gsum 'geng ba'i mi rkang gling bu'i sgra/ /gri snying srog 'khor gsang ba rten gyi mchog /phyi rten rta g.yag shel gong bya (59na)khyi yis/ /che mchog phyag bzhi mgon po'i thugs dam bskang / /dpal mgon ma ning nag po'i thugasadam bskang / /gza' bdud rā hu la yi thugs dam bskang / /zhing skyong seng ge'i gdong can thugs dam bskang / /gnod sbyin spu gri dmar nag ྾/ /sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po'i ྾/ /dam can skyes bu chen po'i ྾/ /bga' to dregs pa 'khor tshoṭa ྾/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin dge 'dun sdebacas skyongs/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las bsgrub par mdzod/ /dmar wo rtag gtor rgyun gtor ri ltar spungs/ /bdud rtsi sman gyi dam tshig gcig tu bsre/ /rak+ta'i rba klong rgya mtsho'i rlabs ltar zhabrug /tshogs gtor bsgos bu 'dzin ma'i khyon gang 'dis/ /lhag ma tshig rkang bcu po 'gre /dbang po chu skyes bkra ba'i me tog dang / /ro skra'i sdong bu las sbar mar me'i gzi/ /snyan brjid rngam pa sna tshogs rol mo'i sgra/ sha chen gu gul spos dkar dud sprin 'dis ri/ sha khrag glo snying rgyu ma nang khrol spungs/ /dza — 164

dam ༅ chos srung ma' rtogs 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)gad gser skyems 'dod yon rnam pa lnga/ sha lnga byang sems la sogs bdud rtsi lnga/ /khyung seng glang stag dom dred gcan gzan gyis ྾/ /mig sman mdangs ldan zhwa dang phod ka dang / /za 'og 'jol ber g.yang gzhi glang stag lpags/ /sra brtan go cha rno ngar mtshon cha'i tshogs/ /sna mang gdugs dang rgyal mtshan mang po yis ྾/ /thod skam dbu rgyan do shal rus pa'i rgyan/ /ri rab gser gling gling bzhi gling phran dang / /nyi zla bkra shis rtags brgyad rgyal srid bdun/ /mdor na rang rang dgyes pa'i rdzas rnams kyis/ /lhun grub kun tu bzang po'i zlos gar las ྾/ /bde gshegs zhi khro'i tshul 'dzin bka' brgyad lha/ /log 'dren 'dul phyir drag (59bsta'i skur bstan par/ /yid ches mos pa'i rten mchog dam pa 'dis mo/ /gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ chos skyong 'khor bcas kyi ljags hūṃ las gyur pa'i rdo rje rtse gcig pa 'od kyi sbu gu can gyis gsol bar bsams la/ sngar gyi sngags gsham du ma hā bha ling ta kha raṃ khā hi/ zhes lan bdun nam nyer gcig gis 'bul/ a nas/ sha rdi'i bar gyis mchod/ma hā pañtsa dang rak+tas sman rag 'bul/ bstod pa ni/ lhaḥ stong zil brtsegs pa'i ri bo mig sman gyis/ /lan brgyar byugs la mi sdug srin po'i gzugs/ /bskal pa'i me dpung dbus na rab 'gying ba'i/ /stobs ldan ma hā kā la khyod la bstod/ /spyan gsum nyi zla ltar gsal dgra la gzigs/ /zhal gdangs khrag gi lha ba chal chil g.yo/ /sna tshogs mtshon chas dgra bo'i don snying 'bigs/ /'jigs rung dpa' bo'i rgyan gyis spras la bstod/ khro gtum nga ros srid gsum skrag byed kyang / /chos dbyings bde ba'i ngang las mi g.yo ba'i/ /phul byung dgyes pa skyed par byed pa'i yum/ /lha mo tsarnyi dbang phyug ma la bstod/ /stobs ldan khyod kyi bka' nyan las byed cing / /dam nyams dgra bo'i srog la cher rngam pa'i/ /rje dbon rnam gsum gying chen sdo lnga dang / /'khor tsho gos dregs pa sdebargyad rnams la bstod/ /'phrin las lhun grub mgon po 'khor bcas kyis/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin dge 'dun sde rnams skyongs/ /khyad par dgon gnas 'a nyid srid sder bcas/ /yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /lhaḥ dpal chen gdug pa 'dul phyir khro bo'i skur/ /ston mdzad she'am pa ba'i khro rgyal dgra bgegs —165

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)gshed//lha chen dpal 'bar bstan srung yongs kyi rje//dpal 40nasgo gon ma ning nag po khyod la bstod//gar dgu'i nyams ldan spyan gsum gyen thur gzigs//rno ngar mche gtsigs mtsho ni cha sna tsho gis thogs//beng chen rked nas sprul pa'i lha dmag 'gyed//bstan srung chen po khyod la bdag bstod do//srog bdud nag po gling bzhi skad cig myul//dpal 'bar dmar mo dgra bo'i srog rtsa gcod//las bsgrub yang khol dregs pa sdebargyad kyi//dmag tsho gos sa dang bar snang gang la bstod//bzlog pas mi bzlog sngags bzlog mkhan gyi gshed//dpal mgon 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis//bdag cag dpon slob dgon gnas dge 'dun sde//bsrung zhing rgyas pa'i 'phrin las ma lus sgrubs//lhaḥdamar chen khrag gi rgya mtsho 'khrug pa'i dbus//srin po mgo dgu lus kun khrag mig gang //stobar khag dngas sprul gyi mjug ma can//sna tsho gis mtshone 'dzin khyab 'jug chen por bstod//steng 'og phyogs mtshams kun rgyu'i sprul pa brgyad//bka' nyan gdong mo bzhi dang gza' chen brgyad//rgyu skar nyer brgyad lha srin sdebargyad kyi//grangs med pho nya dmag tsho gos rnams la bstod/khyab 'jug chen po 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis//rgyal ba'i bstan srungs bla ma'i sku tshe srings//dge 'dun sdeskyongs 'gro ba'i phan bde spel//rnal 'byor bdag gis bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrubs/khyad par gza' mchog nag po rā hu la//za hor sngags la4 rim par byon rnams kyis//nyer bsten pha mesarigs kyi srung ma ste//sngon gyi dam tshig gnyen po rab dgongs la//bdag cag dgon gnas srid sde bran g.yog la//gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra dang bgegs la sogs//bar gcod 40bas mthun rkyen ngan ma lus pa//thal ba'i rdul du rlog pa'i 'phrin las mdzad//me rlung 'khrug pa'i dbus na bdud mgon che//dar nag gos gyon ru mtshon mkha' la 'phyar//dmar gtor dgrar 'phen bdud rta rlung gshog bcibs//seng ge'i gdong can yab yum gnyis la bstod//mi sdug spre'u'i gdong can bam ro zung //lag gnyis bya sder sal btsugs nas brgyug/rkang pa dmar gtor dgra bo'i steng du 'phen//sprul pa yang sprul 'khor dang bcas la bstod//༷༷ skyong sha zan nag po 'khor kyi bcas sa//thub

dam can chos srung mtho rtogs 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)pa'i ring lugs spel ba'i chos srid sde//mi mthun phyogs rnams kun las rab rgyal nas//'dod pa'i don kun lhun gyis grub par mdzod//za hor sngags 'chang rim par byon rnams kyis//dam tshig gnyen po bsgrags shing rab bsten pa'i//rigs dang brgyud la 'go ba'i srung ma mchog/drag shul stobs ldan zhing skyong chen po yis//rigs 'dzin bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la/bsam ngan sbyor rtsub 'chang ba'i dgra bgegs kun//lo dang zla ba zhag tu ma bzhag par//ma lnga zhe spyod drag po'i 'phrin las bsgrub par mdzod//chos dbyings bde ba chen po'i klong yangs las//bstan pa bsrung phyir klu srin bsgos pa'i sras//'phung byed dmar nag gnod sbyin mthu rtsal can//dgra bgegs bshan pa'i gtso bo khyod la bstod//'jigs pa'i gzugs can dgra la kha gdangs shing //dmar zlum mig gis legs nyes bden shan 'byed//rno ngar mtshon chas dgra bgegs srog rtsa gcod//thod khrag don snying zhal du stob la bstod//dar dmar 'jol ber rin cen gsar ga can//glang lhags g.yang gzhi gos gyon rus rgyan spras//stong gsum 41na rdzad cig myul ba'i khyung dmar bcibs//gnod sbyin dbang gi mdog can khyod la bstod//bal yul yang le shod kyi gnas mchogo tu//pad+ma thod 'phreng spyan sngar zhal bzhes ltar//rnal 'byor dpon slob sde dang bcas rnams kyi//bsam pa'i don kun lhun gyis grub par mdzod//lhaḥgadod ma'i gshis lugs 'chi med lam yangs nas//bstan srung dbang po gnam lcags rdo rje'i thog/log 'dren brag ri thal bar brlag mdzad pa'i//gtsug lag chos 'khor yongs kyi srung mar bstod//sku dang yon tan gsung dang 'phrin las kyi//chos rgyalayum blon las byed sprul pa dang /khyad par srog bdag gnod sbyin yang le ber//sdebargyad dregs pa'i dmag tsho gos rnams la bstod//dbang chen khrag 'thung sku yi dkyil 'khor du//dus gsum rgyal dbang pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis//dbang bskur dam tshig gnyen po nyer bsgrags ltar//bcol ba'i 'phrin las ma lus sgrub par mdzod//sngags yong dharma pā la nas bzung ste//rigs dang brgyud kyi dgra lha mthu rtsal can//zhi rgyas dbang gis 'dod pa'i don bsgrub cing //drag po'i las kyis dgra

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)bgegs tshar gcod mdzod/ /lhaḥ mthing nag e yi rang bzhin khrag mtsho'i klong / /lcags ri nag posayongs bskor long bu'i mkhar/ /sna tsho gis dbang po'i gzhu yi gur khyim nang / /'gying mdzad dam can skyes bu khyod la bstod/ khro chu'i tho ba me 'bar mkha' dbyings su/ /phyar ba tsam gyis srid gsum phye mar 'thag /'thor rlung mi zad gter gyi sbud pa yis/ /dgra bgegs rgya mtsho'i pha mthar sgrod la bstod/ /ma nges sku yi sprul pas stong gsum 'geng / /'jigs 91ba tshe sdur gsung gi nga ro 'brug ltar ldir/'gyur med thugs ni bde ba chen por mnal/ /dam can rdo rje gshog rgod rtsal la bstod/ /dge bsnyen 'khor dang bcas pas bstan pa dang / /de 'dzin skyes bu dge 'dun sde rnams srungs/ /bdag sogasa'akhor bcas bsams pa'i don rnams kun/ /'bad rtsol med par ngang gis grub par mdzod/de nas chos skyong spyi la 'phrin las gnyer du gtad pa ni/ lha: chos dbyings bde ba chen po'i rnam rol las/ /'jigs rung khro bo'i sgyu 'phrul rol gar can/ /rigs 'dzin bu bzhin skyong ba'i bstan srung tshogs/ /ma g.yel ma g.yel deng 'dir nye bar dgongs/ /sngon tshe bcom ldan kun bzang he ru ka /tshe dbang rigs 'dzin pad+mā ka ra sogs/ /dngos brgyud bla ma'i spyan sngar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /las bzhi'i 'phrin las bsgrub pa'i dus la bab/ /'gro ba'i phan bde'i rtsa ba rgyal ba'i bstan/ /de 'dzin skyes bu khrims ldan 'dus pa'i sde/ /chos ldan rgyal po'i chab srid mnga' thang sogs/ /mi 'gyur brtan zhing rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ khyad par rgyal bas lung du bstan pa'i gnas/ /bshad sgrub thub bstan rtsa lag chos 'khor rgyal/ /rten dang brtan par bcas pa'i 'khor lo 'di/ /srid mtha'i bar du brtan zhing 'phel bar mdzod/ /gtsug lag sder bcas 'di nyid skyob pa dang / /gnod byed dam nyams dgra bo mi sgrol na/ /gdug can srog rtsa gcod pa'i bshan pa zhes/ /rtsa brgyud bla mas bsngags pa ngo re gnong / /dgon gnas 'di tsam skyob pa'i mthu med na/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i srung ma ming tsam 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor sgos dgra bsgral ba'i rtsal med na/ /zhing bcu'i gshed ma'i ming yang don re chung / /ma g.yel dgongs shig dam can srung ma'i tshogs/ /42na dka' ba dang blangs lus srog —168

dam can chos srung ma' rtogs tshon las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)thed la bor/ /mthun pa'i rdzas bsags bsnyen cing bsgrub la 'bad/ /lus dang grib ma bzhin du bsten byas na/ /bskul ba'i tshe na dam can bang ma bul/ /bos pa'i tshe na chos skyong snyan ma sra/ /bcol ba'i tshe na bstan srung las ma zhan/ /rbad pa'i tshe na bshan pa mthu ma chung / /dgon gnas 'di la snga dgra lag dar zhing / /phyi dgra yid sems da dgra gnod byed pa'i/ /dam nyams dgra bo steng 'og gar 'dug kyang / /tshe dang bsod nams kha rje dbang thang choms/ /ltasang na cho 'phrul mi rung sna tsho gos mthong / /nad rims zhabrug rtsod nyer 'tshe char ltar phob/ /gnam gyi 'ju thag sa yi brten phur byungs/ /myur du bla srog tshe gsum zhal du thob/ /thub bstan snying po kun mkhyen btsong kha pa'i/ /dri med bshad dang sgrub pa'i ring snam lugs mchag /dkar phyogs kun phan dkyil 'khor ji bzhin du/ /legs pa'i cha shas 'phel ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /gtang rag gi mchod pa dang / /rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang med na gshegs gsol sogs lag len gyi dkyus su bsnyeg go /e ma chu gter chen po las/ /rlabs phreng dus las mi yol ltar/ /'dod pa'i re ba skong ba la/ /chos srung bsten lasagazhan ci zhig /'on kyang 'di 'dra'i gnad shes pa'i/ /sngags lasang u dum wā ra bzhin/ /de phyir kho bo'i 'dren pa mchog /gsang chen chos kyi bdag por 'khrums/ /rigs 'dzin a wa dhū tī pa'i/ /mtshungs pa med pa'i bka' drin las/ /chos srung rgya mtsho mnyes byed pa'i/ /las bzhi lhun grub yi ger bkod/ /dge des nag phyogs sder bcas kyi/ /ru mtshon ma lus rab bsnyal nas/ /dkar phyogasarnam par rgyal ba yi/ /dzornga srid rtser sgrog gyur cig /42bsleb dpon chen po mtsho skyes rdo rje dang / /glegs bam rin po che sogs las lung bstan pa'i chos 'khor rgyal 'di nyid kyi yang dben srung ma rang bzhin gyis bzhugs gnas lhun grub dga' ba'i tshal du pad dkar 'dzin pa bsod nams rgya mtsho dpal bzang pos chos skyong 'di dag gi sku brnyan bris 'bur/ mdos gtor sogs kyi rten 'dzugs par gnang na'ang mchod gtor 'bul ba sogs kyi phyag len gnang rgyu ma grub par lus 'dug pa/ bzhed pa ltar grub na bstan dang 'gro la phan par 'gyur ba'i lhag pa'i bsam pas mchode —169—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)gtor gyi cho ga las bzhi lhun grub 'di yang drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'amang 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub sogs rig pa 'dzin pa du ma'i bka' drin gyis 'tsho ba'i za hor gyi ban+de ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho/ming gzhan bla med rdo rje rtsal du 'bod pas mgon po phyag bzhi pa dang /rgyal po pe har gnyis mnga' bdag gi gter byon//gza' dmar nag/zhing skyong rnams pad+ma las thal rtsal gyi gter ma/dpal mgon ma ning rat+na gling pa'i gter ma dang /dam can mgon po zhal gyi rjesa'abrangs pe srog btsan gsum zhes tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i phyag len du mdzad pa la gzhi byas tshig sbyor rnams cung zad 'byer bde bar byas te/me phag snron zla'i yar tshes la sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni ngag dbang dge legs so//rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gar//mtsho skyes sprul sku'i rol bar yongs shar ba'i//'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku brnyes pad+ma 'byung //rta mchog he ru /yis dngos grub stsol//'jam dbyangs rnam sprul khri srong lde'u btsan dang //blo bzang snyan pa'i grags 'bar btsong kha pa//phul byung bsod nams zhing gyur rgya mtsho'i dpal//dngos brgyud bla mas byin rlabs char du phob//ngag dbang 'jam dpal 43na bos dgra'i blo nus mthu/grub pa'i skal bzang nges gsang rgya mtsho'i sdes//dam tshig nyer bsgrags gsol zhing legs mchode pa'i//sprul pa'i chos rgyal 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gsheṭa//ting 'dzin rgyas sprul rin cen gzhal med dbus//pad+ma nyi zla dgra bgegs bsnol ba'i steng //mi g.yo brtan par bzhugs nas dgyes pa'i zhal//sgrub mchog rig 'dzin bdag la bstan du gsol//sman raka gtor ma mchod pa'i tshogs rnams dang //bla rdo srog 'khor phyi nang gsang ba'i rten//dam can 'du ba'i rdzas kun bshams lags na//dregs pa'i ded dpon thugs dam skongs gyur cig/zhal gsum phyag drug sna tshogs mtsho ni cha bsnams//dar dkar gos rgya zhe smyug ma'i theb zhu gsol//seng ga'i steng 'grong dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa'i//'phrin las rgyal po khyod la bdag bstod do//mun pa'i mdog can bdud zhags spu gri 'dzin///ma slog dar nag 'jol ber thib zhu can//glang

dam ༅ chos srung ma' rtogs wen las rnam pha lhun grub/ 9)chen sna ring zhen nas stong gsum myul/ /thugs kyi rgyal po ྾/ /mon nu nag po rdo rje gseg shang bsnams/ /dar nag gos dang dbu / zhu gsol/ /seng ge bcibs nas dgra bo'i bla tshe brku/ /sku yi rgyal bo ྾/ /mthing nag mdangs 'dzin dgra sta zhags pa bsnams/ /sprul dang stag snye ma'i tshag zhu gsol/ /rta nag rting dkar bcibs nas bstan pa bsrung / /yon tan rgyal po ྾/ /mdog dmar sba 'bar tsan+dan bang chen 'dzin/ /lhab lhub dar dang smyug zhu dbu la gsol/ /srid gsum skad cig bskor ba'i drel nag bcibs/ /gsung gi rgyal po ྾/ /sna khrid pho nya gsang yum sprul pa dang / /blon po khol bo skyo bsang seng ge'i 'bag /rgya gar mon pa spre'u la sogs pa/ /43ba) sna tshogs sprul pa'i 'khor tsho gos bsam mi khyab/ khrims ldan zhi zhing dul ba'i nyan thos brgya/ /sngagasanag gar dgu'i nyams ldan phur thogs brgya/ /ral ba mun ltar gtibs pa'i bud med brgya/ /g.yul du zhugs pa'i dpa' bo stag shar brgya/ /mdor na 'phrin las rnam bzhi bsgrub pa'i 'khor/ /rnal 'byor sems kyi rol par shar ba'i rtsal/ /grangs med snang srid lha srin dregs pa'i dpung / /sagazhi bar snang thams cad yongs gang ba/ /mdzes shing yid 'phrog lha yi tsho gis la 'gran/ /gzi brjid dbang phyug gnod sbyin nor lha bzhi/ /'jigs rung bdud dang gshin rje ltar ston pa'i/ /pe har rgyal po 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ /dngos su 'gro la brlams pa'i skur ston pa/ /nyi 'od ltar 'tsher bse khrab bse rmog gyon/ /mdung dmar btsan zhags ral gri dgra sta mda'/ /sna tsho gos mtshone 'dzin gas drag rngam brjid sku/ /dus gsum kun gyi 'byung dang 'byung 'gyur gyi/ /blang dang dor bya'i lkog gyur gsang ba'i gnad/ /tshul bzhin ston pa'i gsung gi nga ro mchog /dbyar gyi rnga gsang dag la skyengs pa ster/ /sna tshogs mtshon dang nye ba'i shel dkar bzhin/ /dri med rnam par gsal ba'i thugs kyi mkhar/ /chos kun dbang po'i gzhu ltar rab bkra ba'i/ /gar dgu'i nyams ldan khyod la bdag bstod do/ /bstan srung khyod la gnyer du gto pa ni/ /rgyal ba'i bstan dang de 'dzin skyong ba dang / /dus kyi 'khrug ba nad rigs rnam par zhi/ /sa steng kun tu bde bas khyab par mdzod/ /khyad par rnal —171

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)'byor bdag cag chos bsgrub pa'i/ /mthun rkyen ma lus 'bad med 'grub pa dang / /gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra dang bgegs kyi tshogs/ /thal ba'i rdul du brlag pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /44na7dor na pad+ma thod 'phreng nyang ral sogs/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bka' las ma 'da' bar/ /rig sngags 'chang ba bdag gis bcol ba'i las/ /thams cad thogs pa med par lhun grub mdzod/ /ces sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po la bstod cing 'phrin las bcol ba 'di ni lcags yos nag pa zla ba'i lha tshes la sku brnyan gsar bris phul skabs chos skyong 'di nyid kyis 'di 'dra zhig gyis zhes gsung ba ltar za hor gyi ban+de ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang rgya mtshos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni blo bzang nor bu'o/ /bde chen chosasku snang ba mtha' yas dpal/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku rta mgrin dbang gis lha/ /grangs med sprul pa'i rnam rol pad+ma 'byung / /sku gsum dbyer med dngos grub char chen phob/ /gdod nas dag pa gsal stong dbyings kyi pang / /lhun grub zhi khro rab stims 'od lnga'i klong / /gcig las du mar snang ba chu zla'i gar/ /rigs kun khyab bdag pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal/ /mkha' la 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i mdangasabakrag ltar/ /las bzhi so sor bsgrub pa'i thugs gsung sku'i/ /sna tsho gis cho 'phrul stong gi gzi byin dpung / /bskyed la sdebargyad tshogs kun dbang du sdus/ /snang srid dregs pa kun gyi cod pan du/ /mi 'da' rdo rje'i phyag rgya nyer bkod nas/ /bod yul gangs can ljongs 'dir bstan 'gro yi/ /phan bde'i legs tshogos ma lus rab rgyas shing / khyad par rig 'dzin sngags 'chang bdag cag gi /chos srid 'dod pa'i re ba skong ba dang / /srung ba rdo rje'i ra ba bcug rnams kyi/ /bar chad kun zhi mthun pa'i dngos grub spel/ /dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgo nas mi srun pa'i/ /log 'dren dgra bgegs rtsad nasagacod pa sogs/ /44bgyi thun las thogs med bsgrub pa'i gzu dpang mgon/ /dus 'dir mdzod cig pad+ma thod 'phrong rtsal/ /brgyud ldan bla ma'i dam tshig mnyan po dang / /rnal 'byor gdung ba'i yid kyis 'bod byed na/ /sprul pa'i chos rgyal sku lnga 'khor bcas rnams/ /gsang ba'i pho brang che nas sku bzhengs shig /phul byung bde chen dbyings las ma g.yos kyang / khro chags zhi sogs rnam 'gyur —172

dam ༅ chos srung ma' rtogs mun las rnam pha lhun grub/ 9)grangs med kyis//bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyong ba'i mthu rtsal can//chos rgyal sku lnga 'khor bcasaganas 'dir gshegs//dam can sprin ltar 'du ba'i gnas mchog 'dir//phyi nang gsang mchod rten pa'i dam rdzas rnams//chos skyong 'bod pa'i ched du bshams lags na//dbyar gyi char sprin lta bur 'thibs shing spyon//rkang gling dung wo 'brug gi sgra ltar ldir/sha chen spos dkar bsreg cing dmar wo sbyang //dar tshon sna lngas g.yab na bstan srung khyod//dgun gyi 'thor rlung bzhin du 'tshi cing spyon//snyan 'gyur dbyangs dang sna tshonas rol mo'i sgra//ting 'dzin gsal dang gdung sems drag po yis//dregs pa'i sde dpon gnas 'dir spyan 'dren na//tshur spyon dgyes pa'i gdan la brten par bzhugs//dpal chen khrag 'thung dbang por legs bzhugs nas//bdag gis rgyal po chen po mchod cing bstod//srung ma khyod kyis bdag gi 'phrin las rnams//sgrub pa'i rdo rje'i dam las ma 'da' nyid /kha dog sna tsho gos rab bkra'i me tog dang /khru bzang bsregs pa'i dud pas nam mkha' gang //me shel mar me'i 'phreng ba tshar du dngar//bzang po'i sman gyi ngad dang dri chab zha thug/ro brgya'i dpal 'dzin lha mi'i zhal zas spungs//snyan cing brjid pa'i grangs med rol mo'i tshogs//sprul pa'i chos rgyal sku lnga 95na 〉 khor bcas la//dgyes pa bskyed phyir 'bul gyi bzhes su gsol//khrag gi arnya dbang bo'i me tog dang /ga ོ dud pa a — mar me sbar/sha rus zhal zas rkang gling rol mo'i sgra//mi lngags gcan gzan g.yang gzhi'i bla bre dang /khyu ma'i dra ba slo snying yan lag gi/lhu dum lda ldi 'phreng bar spel ba rnams za//sprul pa'i sogs tshig rkang gnyis po kun la 'gre//cang shes rta mchog dar gyi cod pan can//'brong g.yag ma he rno ba'i rwa can gdengs//glang seng khyi spyang ra lug 'dod 'jo'i ba//spra sprel khyim bya mon nag a tsa ra//rnga mo bong bu drel sogs bzhen pa'i tshogs//'bag seng glu gar rtsed 'jo mtha' yas pa ྾//zhwa nag phod ka theb zhu gsag theb dang //za 'og 'jol ber snam sbyar pags pa'i gos//sprul gyi sgyu po rin cen rus pa'i rgyan//sra brtan go khrab rno ba'i mtshon cha'i tshogs//stag spre bya rgod spyang gi 7za 'og gi/rgyal mtshan phyogs bcu ma lus zil

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)gnon pa ྾/ /rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar a khra ta/ /dgra bgegs snying khrag bskyil ba'i rak+ta'i mtsho/ /sgrub gtor khang bzang rgya phubs rtag gis mdzes/ /mchod gtor sha khrag gsang 'phye'i rtagasakyis brgyan/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya la sogs pa/ /dngos bshams yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa rnams mo/ /phyi rten srog chag dkar po mdzes shing brjid/ /nang rten smyug rgod rnga mdar snas brgyan/ /gsang rten mdos rigs sna tshogs sku 'bag dang / /dregs pa rang bzhin 'du ba'i rdzas kyi mchog /bla rdo srog gi 'khor lo bcas pa sogs/ khyud dang man ngag ji bzhin leṭa bshams pa ྾/ /bkra shisartags brgyad rgyal srid rin cen bdun/ /lcags ri mu khyud 95ba 'a rab lhun po dang / /gling bzhi gling phran nyi ma zla ba zung / /'dod pa'i 'bras ster dpag bsam yongs 'du'i shing / /yan lag brgyad ldan mtsho dang rdzing bu sogs/ /lha mi'i dpal 'byor longs spyod ji snyed pa ྾/ /rgyal bo sku lnga 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags hūṃ las skyes pa'i rdo rje rtse gcig pa dmar po 'od kyi sbu gu can gyis gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar bsams la rdo rje thal mo kha phye nas/ oṃ ma hā rā dza sa pa ri wā ra i rda ba lo ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum mam bdun gyis gtso bo dang a kā ro lan gsum gyisa'akhor rnams la dbul/ sa pa ri wā ra'i mthar a sogs kyis mchod 'bru gsum sbyar bas nang mchod 'bul/ chos dbyings bde ba che las ma g.yos kyang / /log 'dren dgra bgegs ma lus bsgral ba'i phyir/ /srog bdag bshan pa'i gzugs kyis rnam rol pa/ /sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po sku lngar bstod/ /gdong lnga'i dbang po rab tu 'gying ba'i steng / /zhal gsum phyag drug sna tshogs mtshon cha thogs/ /khro gas gar gyis rol ba'i mthu stobs can/ /'phrin las rgyal po khyod la bdag bstod do/ /mun pa bye bas byugs pa'i lhun po la/ /nyin byed 'bum gyis stid 'dra'i gzi byin can/ /glang chen zhen nas stong gsum skad cig myul/ /thugs kyi rgyal po ྾/ /mig sman mdog can srin po khros pa'i gzugs/ /seng ge zhen nas brnag pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol/ /grangs med cho 'phrul sna tshogs ston mdzad pa'i/ /sku yi rgyal po ྾/ /dpag par dka' ba'i mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /chos 'khor skyong —174

dam ༅ chos srung mdzo rtogs wen las rnam sto lhun grub/ (gemadzad gnod sbyin shing bya can//sku mdog nag bo dgra bo'i bla tshe 'gugs//yon tan rgyal po ྾//rta gdong me yi phung po ltar dmar zhing //'jigs brgyangs nga ro drag pos96na yog gsum g.yo//rlung gi shugs 'chang drel rta la zhon pa//gsung gi rgyal po ྾//zag med bde ba'i nyams ldan gsang ba'i yum//bka' nyan blon po sprul pa yang sprul dang //ru 'dren sde bzhi dregs pa sdebargyad kyi//'khor tshogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tsho gos la bstod//chos skyong rgyal bo sde lnga 'khor bcas rnams//rigs 'dzin mtsho skyes pad+ma thod 'phreng gis//dbu rtse mchims bu shel gyi brag phug tu//srog gi snying po blangs nas dam la btags//de rjes nyang ban nyi ma 'od zer dang //mnga' bdag chos kyi dbang phyug la sogs pa//zab gter brgyud pa'i bla ma grangs med kyis//dkyil 'khor zhal phye sngon gyi mtha' tshig bsgrags//pad+ma dbang dang legs ldan rdo rje'i zhabs//bkra shis stobs kyi rgyal po la sogs pa'i//pad+ma'i gdung gsob rig pa 'dzin rnams kyis//dam tshig gnyan po bsgrags pa deng 'dir dgongs//rgyal ba kun dngos dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i dpal//mthu stobs dbang phyug bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sde//rigs 'dzin bdag gis mchode bstod gnyer gtad pa'i//dam bca' dgongasal bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrubs//phan bde'i 'byung gnas rgyal ba'i bstan pa dang //de 'dzin skyesabu khrims ldan 'dus pa'i sde//bshad dang sgrub pa'i chos ldan bya ba kun//yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzod//gangs ris bskor ba'i bod kyi rgyal khams 'dir//mi nad phyugs nad mu ge mtha' dmag dang //dus 'khrug mtha' 'dre'i kha rlangs kun zhi nas//bde skyid dga' ston dpal 'byor rgyas par mdzod//blo wo 'jam dpal dpa' bo ngur sgrig gi/rnam rol skal bzang dpyid gyur grags pa'i sde'i//dri med lung 96bdang rtogs pa'i bstan pa mchog/srid mtha'i bar du mi nyams rgyas par mdzod//nor 'dzin chos bzhin skyong ba mi yi bdag/gnam skos gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong gis//dbang sgyur sa spyod rgyal po'i mnga' thang dang //sku tshe chab srid brtan zhing 'phel bar mdzod//ngo mtshar sdebazhi'i dga' ston dang /na pa'i//phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i pho brang

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)che'i//bstan srid yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po mchog/srid zhi'i rgyal mtshan rtse mor 'bar gyur cig/mchog mas dngos grub nga gnas rdo rje'i theg/phan dang bde ba'i dpyid//nges gsang legs par bshad pa 'dus pa'i grar/lcagatso 〉 khur tshar//lugs zung rnam par rgyal ba'i ru mtshon che//srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar du sgreng bar mdzod//rgyal ba'i bstan bshig dkon cog dbu 'phang smad//bla ma'i sku dgra sems can bde skyid 'joms//rnal 'byor sgos su 'tshe ba'i ra bar dbyang ba mo sgrog dgra bgegs rnams//mdzo spyod drag po'i las kyi tshar wo cig/khyad par za hor sngag rig sngags4bgegalizur skur/'chang bdag cag la//snga dgra lag dar phyi dgra yid la sems//da dgra gnod byed dug mtshon dmag gzhoms byed//phrag dog mtho gnon legs bsub nyes pa sgrog/rang nus ma thon gzhan dag khyi ltar rbad//dngos dang brgyud nas 'tshe ba'i dam nyams dgra//yid la brnag cing bsgral ba'i zhing gyur pa//steng 'og phyogs mtshams bar gsum gar 'dug kyang //kha rje dbang thang stobs dang gzi brjid choms//lo zlar ma 'jog bla srog tshe gsum khug/don snying dmar po zhal du bstab nas kyang //rjes med rlung la skur zhig rtsal ma zhan//skyabs 'os srung ba'i 'khor lor bcug rnams kyi//bar ho nyer 'tshe'i tsho gos kun rab zhi zhing //tshe dang bsod nams 47na bo pal 'byor legs tshogs kun//'phel zhing rgyas pa'i stong grogs mtha' dag mdzod//kun mkhyen 'jam dpal snying tsho bstan pa mchog/thos sgom lar rtsod rtsom pas 'dzin pa sogs//༅ byung rnam par dkar ba'i 'phrin las kun//bsam pa ji bzhin lhun gyis grub par mdzod//tshe ring nad med legs pa'i yon to spel//srid gsum zil gnon khams gsum dbang du sdus//phun tsho gis 'dod pa'i don gyi re ba rnams//'bad med lhun gyis grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//mdor na 'dod 'jo'i ba dang bum pa bzang //dpag bsam shing dang yid bzhin nor bu ltar//dgos 'dod stsol ba'i chos skyong chen po yis//dgra lha mdzod la bkra shis dge legs stsol//zhes sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po la mchod gtor 'bul tshul dngos grub char 'bebs 'di yaX gnas chung pe har lcog tu mdos btsugs skabs

dam can chos srung mngon rtogs 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)chos skyong chen pos 'di ltar gyis zhes bskul ma mdzad pa ltar za hor gyi btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rgya mtsho'i//dpal ldan 'dod khams dbang phyug ma'i gtor 'bul bsdus pa ni/bdag nyid skad cig rdo rje srin po'i sku zhes sogs kyi nga rgyal bskyed/mchod gtor rnams/dam rdzas ye shes bdud rtsi'i ngo bor 'bar//zhes sogs kyis byin gyis brlabs te/bh+yoḥrgyal ba kun gyi ma gcig dbyangs can ma//gdug pa 'dul phyir drag mo'i skur bstan pa//dpal ldan 'dod khams dbang phyug dmag zor ma//'khor bcas thogs pa med par da tshur spyon//rlung nag gur nang khrag zhag rgya mtsho'i steng //drel rta la bcibs be con thod khrag 'dzin//sna tshogasabargyan spras gar dgu'i nyams ldan lha//brtan par snam bzhugs la ma chag mthun 97bdangos grub stsol//sman rag gtor ma phyi nang mchod pa'i tshogs//sa dang bar snang khyon kun rab bkang ba//dngosabashams yid kyis sprul nas legs 'bul na//dgyes par bzhes la 'phrin las rnam bzhi sgrubs//sha khrag la sogs bdud rtsi lnga dang bcas//zhes sogs kyis gtor ma dkyus ltar 'bul//'gyur med bde chen ye shes mchog gi mdangs//bstan srung dbang mo'i gar gyis rnam rol ba//dpal ldan lha mo 'dod khams bdag mo la//lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo//dpag bsam shing dang bum bzang 'dod 'jo'i ba//yid bzhin nor dang mtshudas pa'i lhag pa'i lhas//'gal rkyen bar chad nyer 'tshe zhi ba dang //mchog mthun dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol//cho ga chad dang dam rdzas 'bags pa sogs//ka dag gdod ma'i ngang du rab bshegs shing //ye shes rang bzhin gnasasu gshegs nas kyang //slar yang byon te dngos grub stsal du gsol//byin rlabs rtsa ba rdo rje slob dpon dang //bar chad kun sel dpal chen phur pa'i lha//ma ltar brtse ba'i dpal ldan lha mo yis//dge legs bkra shis char gyis khyab par shog/ces dpal ldan 'dod khams dbang phyug ma'i mchod gtor 'bul tshul 'di ni/lcags yos lhun grub dga' ba'i tshal du bcad rgya bgyis skabs mchod dpon dbu mdzad gnyis kyis bskul ba ltar de sa ko ṭir rig thog tu shar ba las mchims phu gsang

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)phug tu yig thog tu phab pa'o//lhaḥye nas dag pa chos sku'i rang bzhin las//sna tsho gos sprul pa'i sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar//ston mdzad dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag mchog/slob dpon sangs rgyasaganyis ba pad+ma 'byung //gang des mchod bstod dregs pa'i dkyil 'khor du//legs bcug dbang bskur 98na bom tshig nyer bsgrags pa'i//sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po 'khor bcas rnams//thogs pa med par gnas nas da tshur spyon//pad nyi dgra bgegs bskyel zhing bsnol ba'i steng //glang wo seng ge drel rta la sogs pa//grangs med sna tsho gos bzhone pas bteg pa'i khar//mi g.yo dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol//bad dkar ut+pal la sogs me rtag tshogs//dri zhim dum bu bsregasapa'i dud pa'i sprin/zhal sogs sna tsho gis nor bu'i snang gsal dang //bzang po'i ngad ldan dri dzo mtsho ltar 'khyil//ro brgya'i dpal 'dzin zas kyi tshogs rnams spungs//snyan 'gyur rol mo'i bye brag mtha' yas pa//sprul pa'i chos rgyal 'khor dang bcas la 'bul//dgyes par bzhes la zhi rgyasadabang las sgrubs//dmar chen khrag gi a rba klong zhabrug/dbang po lnga yi me tog phang phung g.yo//sha chen bsregs pa'i dud pas nam mkha' gang //ro skra'i stong bu la sbar mar me'i 'phreng /sha rusaphung por spungs pa'i zhal zas dang //rkang gling thod rnga la sogs rol mo'i tshogs//bshan pa lag dmar 'khor dang bcas la 'bul//dgyes par bzhes la drag po'i 'phrin las sgrubs//rta mchog bya khyi sprel sogs phyi yi rten//sman phud rak+ta gtor ma nang gi rten//bla rdo srog gi 'khor lo gsang ba'i rten//chos skyong rgyal po bsten pa'i rdzas su 'bul//stag gzig seng ge'i rgyal mas ba dan dang //zhwa nag bse theb phod ka rus pa'i rgyan//sra ba'i go cha rno ngar mar cha'i tshogs//dregs pa'i sdodapon dgyes pa'i rten du 'bul//ri rab lhun po gling bzhi gling phran dang //nyi ma zla ba rgyal srid rin cen bdun//dngos bshams yid kyi sprul dang mchod tsho gos kyis//chos skyong 'khor bcas dgyes pa bskyed gyur 98bcug/zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po'i 'phrin las rnams//bsgrub phyir sku yi rnam 'gyur sna tsho gos kyis//stong gsum cir car myuX ༷'i mthu stobs can//sprul pa'i chos skyong sku la

dam can chos srung ma' rtogs tshon las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ (gebadag bstod do/ /snyan zhing brjid ldan rngams pa'i nga ro sogs/ /dbyar gyi rnga gsang stong gi sgra dbyangasaltar/ /bsgrags pas srid gsum g.yo bar nus pa yi/ /chos skyong chen po'i gsung la bdag bstod do/ /spros bral bde ba che las ma g.yos kyang / /lkog gyur chos kun mngon sum rab gags nas/ /'phrin las thogs med bsgrub pa'i nus mas can/ /chos skyong chen po'i thugs la bdag bstod do/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas mnga' bdag nyang ban sogs/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi spyan snga sa /bshan pa lag dmar khyod kyis khas blangs pa'i/ /dam tshig gnyan po ma lus nye bar dgongs/ /sangs rgyas bstan srungs bla ma'i sku tshe spel/ /gangs can bod kyi phan bde'i srog shing tshugs/ /bstan dang 'gro la 'tshe ba'i dgra dang bgegs/ /nad rims mu ge 'khrug rtsod bzlog par mdzod/ /blo bzang gragasasnyan 'bar ba'i bstan pa dang / /dga' ldan phyogs las rnam rgyal pho brang che'i/ /chab srid nyi zla zung du 'brel ba gang / /rgyas shing mi 'gyur brtan pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ khyad par za hor sngags 'chang rim byon gyis/ /nye bar bsten pa'i srung ma'i dbang po khyod/ /rigs dang rgyud la 'go ba'i dam tshig de/ /ma g.yel ma g.yel 'phrin las lhun grub mdzod/ /lus la mtshon gtod zas la dug g.yasabyed/ /gnod pa'i gos bsgom ngan pa'i sems 'chang ba'i/ /snga dgra lag dar phyi dgra yid la sems/ /da lta mgo gyur dgra bgegs tshar chod cig /mdor na zhi rgyas dbang dang mdzo spyod sogs/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las dpag bsam yid bzhin dbang / /'dod pa'i re ba skong ba'i yid bzhin 99na)gyi/ /nor bu'i char gyis sa steng khyab gyur cig /ces thang po che'i srung ma sprul pa'i chos rgyal r+ṣa po'i gsol mchod 'di yang chos skyong nyid kyis bskul ma mdzad pa ltar za hor gyi bzhes 'phying bar stag rtse'i pho brang du sbyar/ /lhaḥ phul byung bde chen yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal/ /bsam don lhun gyis grub pa'i 'dod dgu'i char/ /stsol mdzad rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyis/ /dus rnams kun tu bkra shis dge legs stsol/ /gsal stong chos sku'i rol gar 'od dpag med/ /lhun grub longs skur bzhengs pa dbang chen lha/ /thugs rje'i sprul skur legs bstan pad+ma 'byung / /deng 'dir dngos grub — 179

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)rgya mtsho'i char phob cig /kun bzang thugs rje chen po'i zlos gar las/ /log 'dren gshed du dregs pa'i tshul 'dzin pa'i/ /sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po sku lnga po/ /'khor bcas thogs pa med par da tshur spyon/ /gsang ba'i yum lnga bka' sdod blon po lnga/ /sprul pa rnam lnga yang sprul grangs med pa/ /dbyar gyi chu 'dzin gsar pa'i lang long ltar/ /g.yo zhing g.yo zhing thogs med da tshur spyon/ /khyad par bka' sdod kun gyi gtso bo mchog /gtum drag bshan pa'i dbang po gnod sbyin che/ /snang srid dregs pa'i dmag dpon tsi dmar ba/ /'khor bcas thogs pa med par da tshur spyon/ /mdor na mon bu rgya gar spra sprelā /'bag seng glu gar rol mo'i gar mkhan dang / /ru 'dren sde bzhi la sogs 'khor tshogs kun/ /thogs pa med par gnas nas da tshur spyon/ /ye shes rang mdangs 'gag med lhun rdzogs pa'i/ /kha dog lnga ldan rin chen gzhal yas dbus/ /pad nyi dgra bgegs bsnol ba'i gdan steng du/ /dgyes par bzhugs la 'phrin las rnam bzhi sgrubs/ /yid 'ong chu skyes gzhen nu phang phung ldem/ /dri 99ba tha zang dud sprin lha yi lam kun khyab/ /mar me'i 'phreng bas mun pa'i go skabs 'phrog /gur kum gyis bran dri chab mtsho ltar 'khyil/ /ro brgya'i dpal 'dzin zhal zas ri ltar spungs/ /snyan 'gyur rol mo'i bye brag tsho gis rnams kyis/ /sprul pa'i chos rgyal bka' sdod 'khor bcas kyi/ /thugs dam bskang de bcol pa'i 'phrin las sgrubs/ /dgra bgegs dbang po lnga yi me tog dang / sha chen bsregs pa'i dud pa lang long g.yo/ /tshil chen ro skra la sbar mar me'i 'phreng / khrag zhag rba klong 'grug pa'i dri chab 'khyil/ sha rus phung por spungs pa'i zhal zas dang / /mi rkang gling bu thod rnga la sogs pas/ /tshig rkang 'og ma gnyis kun la 'gre/ /sga srab chas mdzes rta mchog rlung ltar 'phyo/ /rno ngar rdo rje'i rwa ldan g.yag rgod dang / /'dod 'jo'i ba dang lug nag spyi dkar can/ /stag seng ce spyang khyi nag rngams shing rgyug /dzo ki mon bu spra spre gar gyis mdzes/ /'dab chags sna tsho gis 'phur lding g.yo ba yis sko/ /rdo rje lta bur sra ba'i go khrab dang / /rno zhing ngar ldan grangs med mtshon cha'i tshogs/ /rgyal mtshan ba dan ru mtshon sna tshogs bsgreng / /za 'og 'jol ber bse zhu dmar po dang / /mig sman —180

dam can chos srung mngon rtogs la phrin la rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)mdangs ldan srid pa spyi lugs zhwa/ /rus pa rin cen rgyan gyi phreng ba yis za/ /dam tshig bsre ba'i bdud rtsi a mṛ ta/ /dmar chen rba rlabs zhabrug pa'i rak+ta'i mtsho/ /sgrub gtor sku mkhar rgya phubasalcog gi mdzes/ /mchod gtor dam rdzas rgyan ldan gsang 'phyis mdzes/ /gser skyems smyug rgod dar snas brgyan pa sogs/ /phyi nang bsten rdzas spyan gzigs ma lus pas sko/ /srog gi 'khor lo bla rdor bcas pa yis/ /dregs pa dbang du 'du ba gsang ba'i rdzas/ /gzhan yang rgyal srid bdun dang 'dod yon lnga/ /bkra shis rtags brgyad nye ba'i rdzas chen brgyad/ /(20na 'a rab gling bzhi gling phran nyi zla sogs/ /dngos bshams yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod tsho gos kyis mo/ /gdod nas mi 'gyur bde ba chen po las/ /g.yo ba med kyang bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir/ khro chags zhi dang sgeg pa'i rnam 'gyur sogs/ /ston mdzad sprul pa'i rgyal po sku lngar bstod/ /hūṃ phaṭa bh+yo sogs drag po'i ba 'ad sgra yis/ /sa gzhi ri rab 'gas pa'i mthu ldan yang / /snyan zhing 'gyur ba stong gi sgra dbyangs kyis/ /dam ldan rna ba'i bcud du 'a rje bsal bstod/ /dri bral thugs kyi be+e ḍūr zhun ma'i mtshor/ /dus gsum zla ba'i gzugs brnyan 'bum 'char bas/ /lkog gyur blang dor ji bzhin ston mdzad pa'i/ /ye shes spyan ldan dbang po khyod la bstod/ /rbad cing bskul na brnag pa'i dgra bgegs tshogos/ /skad cig tsam gyis thal bar rlog byed pa'i/ /mthu stobs rdzul dpag par dka' ba can/ /sdebargyad dregs pa'i dmag dpon khyod la bstod/ /bsnyen cing mchod na 'dod pa'i re ba kun/ /'bad med lhun gyis grub par mdzad pa yi/ /dpag bsam dbang gi rgyal po yid bzhin nor/ /sprul pa'i chos skyong chen po khyod la bstod/ /phul byung bde ba'i dpal ster gsang ba'i yum/ /las kun thogs med sgrub pa'i blon po'i tshogs/ /sna tshogs sgyu dra'i rol gar sprul pa dang / /yang sprul sa dang bar snang gang la bstod/ /bka' nyan gtso bo gnod sbyin bshan pa che/ /dar dmar gos dang thod gyon mdung dmar 'dzin/ /btsan zhags 'phen zhing rta mchog la bcibs nas/ /stong gsum skad cig myul bar mdzad la bstod/ /mun pa'i gosagyon phur thogs sngags nag brgya/ /gseg shing lhung bzed thogs pa'i nyan thos brgya/ /ral pa mun —181—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)ltar gtibs pa'i bud med brgya/ /g.yul du 40bkros pa'i dpa' bo brgya la sogs/ /mdor na snang srid 'jig rten dregs pa yi/ /dmag tshogs sa gzhi bar snang khyon gang ba'i/ /rnam 'gyur sna tsho gos ston pa'i rdzu phrul can/ /grangs med 'khor tsho gis rgya mtsho'i tsho gos la bstod/ /rigs 'dzin slob dpon pad+ma thod 'phreng gis/ /mchims phu gsung gi sgrub pa'i dben gnas su/ /bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor zhal phye ste/ /dbang bskur dam tshigs bsgrags pa nyer dgongs la/ /kun mkhyen thub pa'i bstan pa rab rgyas shing / /de 'dzin skyes bu bla ma'i sku tshe spel/ /dge 'dun sdo rnamasabashad sgrub 'phel ba dang / /'jig rten khams su bde skyid 'byung bar mdzod/ /khyad por 'jam mgon blo bzang grags pa yi/ /dri med lung dang rtogs pa'i bstan pa mchog /yar ngo'i zla ba lta bur rab 'phel ba'i/ /skal bzang kun+da'i dga' ston rgyas par mdzod/ /thub bstan 'dzin pa'i sa dbang chos rgyal gyi/ /sku tshe nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor dang mnyam zhing / /dga' ldan phyogs las rnam rgyal pho brang che'i/ /chab srid rdo rje lta bur brtan par mdzod/ kha ba'i ljongs 'dir mi nad phyugs nad dang / /dmag 'khrug 'thab rtsod mu ge rab zhi zhing / /chos srid phan dang bde ba'i legs tshogis kyi/ /'dod pa'i char gyis re ba skong bar mdzod/ khyad par za hor rig 'dzin bdag cag gis/ /bcol ba'i zhi rgyasadabang dang drag po'i las/ /ma lus thogs pa med par rab bsgrubs nas/ /bsams pa'i don kun lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /ces sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po 'khor dang bcas pa la mchod gtor 'bul ba'i rim pa bsams don lhun grub ma zhes pa 'di yang lcags yos ho me zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bdun gyi nyin chos lor bsam yas kyi pe har lcog tu ngos kyis phyin pa'i tshe/ gnod sbyin chen pos 'di (71na dzi bu zhig gyis shig ces bskul ba mdzad pa ltar za hor gyi ban+de ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi gsung gi dben gnas mchims phu gsang ba'i phug tu sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni su dhī ā tsho rgyu'o/ /yid 'phrog rab dkar phyi ltas gangs kyi ri/ /nang du rin cen las grub pho brang mchog /rtse na gser g.yu'i rgya phubs togo gis mdzes/ /rked par —182

dam can chos srung mngon rtogs 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ (gesprin dkar na bun lang long 'khrigs/ /rtsa bar yid bzhin chu gter chen po 'khyil/ /'dod pa'i longasaspyod phyi nang kun gang ba'i/ /rin cen gzhal med khang bzang nyams dga'i dbus/ /dri za'i rgyal po rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal/ /sku mdog rab dkar khro chags zhi ba'i nyams/ /phyag g.yas mnyen lhag sor mo sdigs mdzub kyis/ /sba lcag dar gyi cod pan mdzes par 'dzin/ /g.yon pa dar gyi srad bu la brgyus pa'i/ khrel dkar phreng ba brgya rtsa brgyad pa 'dren/ /mthon mthing dbu skra'i thor tshugs rab mdzesashing / /rin cen dbu rgyan snyan cha mgul rgyan dang / /gdu bus legs spras dar dkar na bza' gsol/ /rta mchog ngang dkar rin cen sga srab dang / /gong rmed mas kyis mdzes pa'i steng na bzhugs/ /grangs med 'khor tsho gos rgya mtshos bskor ba yi/ /dri za'i rgyal po zur phud lnga pa khyod/ /sngon tshe slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ /dbang bskur dam btags khri srong lde btsun gyi/ /rigs dang brgyud la 'go ba'i lha ru bskos/ /bod khams skyong ba'i srung mar mnga' yang gsol/ /de'i phyir dang por pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal/ /bar du rigs 'dzin rgod kyi ldem phru can/ /tha mar legs ldan rdo rje yab srasakyi/ /dam la gnas pa'i thang lha yab zhun khyod/ /rnal 'byor dung ba'i yid kyis spyan 'dren na/ /thogs med (71ba 'dir spyon dgyes pa'i stan la bzhugs/ /rig 'dzin bdag dang lus dang grib ma bzhin/ /'grogs la nyin mtshan dus drug bar chad sol/ /mthun rkyen bsams pa'i don kun 'bad med sgrubs/ /rin cen dar sna lnga dang gsang ba'i lug /'bras dkar bsgos bzang g.ya' chu gangasakyi chu/ /spos dkar dud pa man shel la sogs pa'i/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i rten rdzas spyan gzigs 'bul/ /dgyes par bzhes la bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /gangs can ljongs 'dir bde skyid phun tsho gos shing / /chos srid zung 'brel bstan pa rgyas pa dang / /'jam da byangasang ga gi dbang po ba po shis kyi/ /kun dga'i dpal ster rje btsun rdo rje 'dzin/ /dang po'i mgon po phul byung bsod nams kyi/ /zhing mchog leṭa par ldan zung zhabs brtan mdzod/ /rig sngags 'chang ba bdag gi lugs gnyis kyi/ /'dod pa'i re ba ma lus skong ba la/ /lhag pa'i lha khyod yongs 'du'i ljon pa dang / /—183—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)bum bzang yid bzhin nor bu ltar mdzod cig /ces pa 'di yang dri za'i rgyal po'i pho brang gi mdun sar za hor gyi bzhes thogs med du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dpal lo/ /dri med thub bstan ut+pal dkar po'i tshal/ /nge rje bsil ba'i zer gyis 'dzum byed pa'i/ /sprul pa'i chos skyong chu shel dbang po la/ /mchod bstod gnyis skyes mgrin pa'i dbyangs snyan sgrog /zag med bdud rtsi'i gtor ma ri ltar spungs/ /rnyog med btung ba'i mchod pa mtsho ltar 'khyil/ /skyon med mchod tsho gos sprin phung ltar 'khrigs pa/ /dri med yid kyis sprul te rgya cher 'bul/ /rab tu 'jam legs rnam par bkra ba'i gzugs/ /grangs med cho 'phrul stong gi rol gar mkhan/ /kun nas dge zhing shis pa'i dpal ster ba/ /thub bstan rgya mtsho'i srung ma chen po (72nas/ /sgyu ma mkhan gyi rnam par sprul pa yi/ /gdong lnga'i dbang pos ri dwags bsad pa ltar/ /gdod nas skye ba med pa'i dgra bgegs kun/ /rang bzhin med pa'i dbyings su rnam par sgrol/ /khyad par 'phags yul grub mtha' rnam bzhi yi/ /bzhed gzhung leṭa par bshad pa'i dam chos kyi/ /'khor lo rgyun chad med par bskor ba'i gling / /zla bzhon bgrod pa ji bzhin 'phel bar mdzod/ /mang thos rig pa'i rtsal ldan na rte gas/ /phas rgol dam bca'i glang chen mche ba dag /phyung ste rnam dpyod mdongs mtha' la zhen nas/ /srid pa'i mtho ris yul du gar byed shog /dpyid kyi dpal mo'i mngal las legs bskyangs pas/ /dbyar gyi lang tsho dar ba'i don gnyis kyi/ /lhun grub rgyal mtshan srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar/ /bsgrengs pa'i sgra dbyangs phyogs kun khyab par mdzod/ /ces pa 'di yang dbang phyogs kyi rgyal khams chen por 'degs skabs legs bshad chosa'akhor gling pa'i slob chung der 'dus kyi grwa rigs rnams kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes byang gi sa'i cha zo'i khug tu sbyar/ /mthu stobs nus pa'i dpung gis rgyal ba'i bstan/ /bsrung mdzad dam can chen po rdo rje legs/ /mched 'khor sum brgya drug cur bcas pa rnams/ /'khor bcas gnas nas thogs med du tshur spyon/ /mdun du pha wang long bu'i sku mkhar la/ /'ja' tshon sna lnga'i gur khyim phub pa'i dbus/ /'jigs rung bzod par dka' ba'i gzhal yas nang / /dgyes par bzhugs la bcol —184

dam ༅ chos srung ma' rtogs tshon las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ (da)pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /phyi dang nang dang gsang ba'i mchod pa dang / /tsho gos dang gtor ma bsten pa'i dam rdzas rnams/ /dngos bshams yid kyis sprul nas legs 'bul na/ /bzhes la rnal 'byor bdag gi stong grogs mdzod/ /(72bsnyan byed kyis 'byud dbang sngon lhun po la/ /thun mtshamasadabu skra sma ra dmar ser can/ /glog stong 'khyug
