pa'i dmar zlum spyan gsum bgrad/ /gangs ri la 'gran mche ba dgra la gtsigs/ /g.yas pa gnam lcags tho chen mkha' la 'phyar/ /g.yon pa 'thor rlung tshub pa'i spud pa 'dzin/ /dar nag 'jol ber rin cen ska rags mdzes/ /sag lham gyon nas ra skyes steng 'gying ba'i/ /dam can skyes bu chen po khyod nyid kyis/ /slob dpon pad+ma thod phreng spyan snga sa /ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas ji bzhin du/ /kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang / /khyad par rig sngags 'chang ba'i 'dus pa'i sde/ /bshad dang sgrub pa'i bya ba rab 'phel zhing / /bdag sogs rnams kyi bar gcod mi mthun tshogs/ /zhi zhing bsams pa'i don kun grub par mdzod/ /cesadam can skyes bu chen po la mchod gtor 'bul tshul nyung ngur bsdus pa 'di ni rgyud smad nas bsdus pa'i rgya nag pho brang du 'degs mkhan rnams kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes byang 'brong rtsar sbyar/bde stong zung 'jug khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon/ /bshes gnyen zol gyis gar mdzad rdo rje 'dzin/ /'khon rigs 'jam dbyangs grub pa'i dpa' bo mchog /dpal 'byor lhun grub gtsug gi pad mtshor bsten/ /pad gnubs gnyen sogs rtsa brgyud bla ma yis/ /bka' dang dam la btagasapa'i mthu rtsal can/ /bstan pa skyong mdzad rdo rje drag rgyal ma'i/ /med byung mchod pa'i 'phrin las deng 'dir spel/ /de la 'dir bstan skyong chen mo drag mo rgyal dgyes pa bskyed pa'i 'phrin las kyi rim pa la/ mchod gtor spyan gzigs sogs phyag len ltar bshams/ chos skyong 'di nyid dang 'brel chags pa'i yi dam gang yang rung ba'i bdag bskyed sngon du bto mchod rdzas rnams (73na)byin gyis brlabs te/ ting nge 'dzin sgo nas/ phun tshon ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho yi/ /dge mtshan ma lus gag tu rab 'khyil ba'i/ /sna tshogs rin cen las grub pho brang nas/ /dpal ldan bstan skyong chen mo sku —185

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)bzhengs shog /'khor lo'i mgon po dpal ldan he ru ka /dngos dang brgyud pa'i bla mar sprul pa yi/ /mthu ldan rnams kyis dam tshig nyer bsgrags pa'i/ /gnod sbyin dbang mo gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /snyan pa'i dbyangs dang g.yo med ting 'dzin gsal/ /mthun pa'i dam rdzas kun tshang mchod pa'i sprin/ /nor 'dzin lha yi lam kun rab 'gengs na/ /bstan skyong 'khor bcas thogs med da tshur spyon/ /chu skyes 'dab brgya bzhad pa'i ge sar rtser/ /bsil sbyin mkhan po nyin mor byed pa yi/ /gdan steng dpal ldan lha mo yang gha bza'/ /'khor bcas dgyes par bzhugs la 'phrin las sgrub/ /snang stong dag pa'i mkha' yi rtsig ngos la/ /ting 'dzin pir gyis bris pa'i 'ja' ris can/ /phul byung kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin gyis/ /bstan srung 'khor bcas dgyes pa bskyed gyur cig /bzang po'i ngad ldan mchod yon mtsho ltar 'khyil/ /lha mi'i me tog sna tsho gis phang phung g.yo/ /phun tsho gis dri zhim dud pa sprin ltar 'khrigs/ /mar me'i phreng bas nyi zla'i khengs pa 'phrog /༷ wā ra'i mdangs ga dri chab dang / /ro brgya'i dpal 'dzin zhal zas ri ltar spungs/ /snyan brjid rol mo'i bye brag la sogs pa/ /dngos bshams yid kyis sprul nas legs par 'bul/ /rta mchog dar gyi cod pan rlung ltar 'phyo/ /'brong g.yag rdo rje'i rwa rtse rnon po gdengs/ /'dod 'jo'i ba dang sha ba ra skyes lug /bya tshogs snyan pa'i skad 'byin 'phur lding g.yo/ /(73bsnyun po gling bzhi nyi zla rin cen bdun/ /rdo rje'i go mtshon dar zab rin cen rgyan/ /'dod yon lnga sogs dgyes pa bskyed pa'i rdzas/ /nas 'bras gro sogs 'bru sna phung por spungs/ /ja chang btung ba rgya mtsho lta bur bskyil/ /dkar gsum mngar gsum gtsang ma'i mchod rdzas dang / /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i dbang po rnam pa lnga/ sha rus tshil bu khrag gi — dang / /phyi nang gsang rten man ngag ji bzhin bshams/ /gser skyems dam rdzas rgyan ldan gtor ma rnams/ /mi 'gyur bde chen kun gsal yangs pa las/ /khro chags nyin byed sgyu dra'i rol gar gyis/ /thub bstan phan bde'i 'dab stong rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /dpal ldan bstan skyong chen mo khyod la bstod/ /nyi 'od 'bum gyas lkod pa'i gangs kyi ri/ /mdzes sdug rnam 'gyur ston pa'i sgyu ma —186

dam can chos srung mngon rtogs 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)mkhan/ /lha rdzas na bza' rin cen rgyan phreng can/ /'chi med lus phra'i khengs pa 'phrog la bstod/ /phyag g.yas dus gsum kun gsal me long dang / /log 'dren dgra bgegs 'ching ba'i zhags pa thogs/ /g.yon pa brtan g.yo'i dngos kun ma lus pa/ /dbang sdud lcags kyu 'dzin mdzad khyed la bstod/ /dung gi rwa co gdengs pa'i sha ba la/ /bcibs nas stong gsum skad cig tsam gyis myul/ /grangs med 'khor tsho gos rgya mtsho dang bcas te/ /chos 'khor skyong ba'i bsrung ma khyod la bstod/ /resa'aga' cung zad khros pa'i nyams ldan pa/ /sku mdog ljang gu be con phyag na bsnams/ /'phar ba zhen nas rnal 'byor drod myul ba'i/ /dam tshig gzi ldan 'bar ma khyod la bstod/ /skabs 'gar 'jigasarung bzod dka'i rnam 'gyur can/ /mthong ba tsam gyis dgra bo'i srog 'phrog cing / /srid gsum g.yo bar nus pa'i mas rtsal can/ /(4na ngo nod sbyin he le 'bar ma khyed la bstod/ /bstan skyong rdo rje drag rgyal 'khor bcas rnams/ /pad+ma thod phreng gnubs chen lo tsā ba/ /sngags 'chang gnyen chen dpal dbyangs la sogs pas/ /dbang bskur dam tshig bsgrags pa nyer dgongs la/ /kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i lung rtogs bstan pa dang / /'gro ba'i phan dang bde ba'i legs tshogis kun/ /dkar po'i phyogs kyi chu shel dbang po yi/ /dkyil 'khor cha shas ji bzhin 'phel bar mdzod/ /phul byung blo grosamachog mnga' 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /skal bzang gdul bya'i snang ngor ngur smig gar/ /ston mdzad snyan pa'i grags 'bar btsong kha pa'i/ /dri med bstan pa srid mthar rgyas par mdzod/ /dga' ba'i dpal ldan dam chos ma lus pa'i/ /'khor lo rgyun chad med pa 'du ba'i gling / /de 'dzin skyes bu khrims ldan 'dus pa yi/ /don gnyis lhun grub rgya mtsho ltar 'phel mdzod/ /gnas skabs zhi rgyasadabang dang drag po yi/ /las bzhi'i 'phrin las thogs pa med 'grub cing / /mthar thug tshe 'dir zung 'jug mngon byed sogs//bsams don lhun gyis grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /ces bstan skyong chen mo rdo rje drag mo rgyal la mchod gtor 'bul ba'i rim pa 'di ni mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son pa'i thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po chos rje don grub rgya mtshos bskul ba —187

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)ltar za hor gyi rigs las a wa dhū ti pa'i btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos dkar thang mar khu'i mtsho mor sbyar/rgyal kun mkhyen brtse nus pa yi//cha shas yongs rdzogs pad+ma 'byung //sngon med zla ba gsar pa yis//yid kyi gdung ba sel bar mdzod//gang de'i 74ba 'jigs med rdo rje yi//ri mo gtsug tu legs 'char ba'i//sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po la//dgyes bskyed mchod pa'i phreng ba spel//de yang gnas chung nas sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen por mchod gtor 'bul ba la/mchod gtor rnams bshams nga byin gyis brlabs te/lhaḥmi 'gyur bde wo chos sku'i nga nyid las//longs spyod rdzoṭa sku khrag 'thung he ru ka/dri med mtsho skyes sprul sku pad+ma 'byung //thugs rje'i mthu dpung bskyed la dngosagrub stsol//spros kun nyer zhi'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang //log 'dren gshed du drag po'i skur bstan pa//sprul pa'i chos skyong ོ po 'khor 4sa rnams//thogs med 'dir spyon dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs//dam rdzas rgyan dang ldan pa'i gtor ma dang //bdud rtsi'i btung ba khrag gi a sogs//phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod rdzas spyan gzigs rnams//sa dang bar snang khyon kun bkang ste 'bul//khro chags sgeg dang zhi sogs rnam 'gyur gyis//bstan pa bsrung zhing dgra bgegs sgrol mdzad pa'i//snang srid dregs pa kun gyi sde dpon mchog/sprul pa'i chos rgyal sku la bdag bstod do//snyan 'gyur dbyangs dang drag po'i nga ro sogs//sna tshogs skad kyis dam nyams dgra bo'i tshogs//thal bar rlog pa'i mi bzad drag po'i sgra//chos rgyal wo po'i gsung la bdag bstod do//lkog gyur chos kyi snang brnyan ma lus pa//me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ji bzhin du//legs rtogs bde stong gnyis su med pa yi//sa skyong byu tsho thugs la bdag bstod do//sngon tshe slob dpon pad+ma thod phreng gi/spyan sngar zhal bzhes dam bcas nyer dgongs la//bstan dang bstan 'dzin khrim ldan 'dus pa'i sde//'phel zhing rgyas 75na tha'i 'phrin las ma lus sgrubs//'jam dbyangs gzhen nu mthon mthing ral pa'i khur//dor nas ngur smig gos kyis raX8 klubs pa'i//kun mkhyen blo bzang grags pa'i

dam can chos srung mngon rtogs 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)ring lugs mchog/srid mtha'i bar du nyams pa med par mdzod//khyad par dga' ba ldan pa'i gnas mchog 'dir//dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor byed pa'i//'dus pa'i gling dang de 'dzin skyes bu yi//bsams don ma lus 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//ces gnas chung nas sprul pa'i chos skyong chen po la mchod gtor 'bul tshul 'di ni mang du thos pa'i chos rje don grub rgya mtshos bkas skul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes dkar thang mar khu'i mtsho mor sbyar//kyeḥgasal stong zung 'jug bde chen mkha' dbyings las//mi bsrun bshan pa glog dmar 'byug pa'i gar//mthu stobs gnam lcags thog zer 'phro bzhi du//tshur spyon tshur spyon sngon gyi dam tshig dgongs//byang shar nyam nga'i dur khrod thang chen dbus//thod pa rin cen las grub gzhal yas khang //bam chen gsar rnying brtse ṭa pa'i gdan steng nas//gnod sbyin dbang gi rgyal po gshegs su gsol/khren mo'i gzugasacan gar gyi dbang phyug ma//las mkhan srog gi bdag po khro gtum can//gri thogs brgyad dang bshan pa nyer gcig sogs//'khor tshogs dam can rgya mtsho gshegs su gsol//sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang dang nyi 'od grags//la chen gnyen dang kun mkhyen mus srad pa//rdo rje 'chang dngos blo gsal rgya mtsho sogs//dngos brgyud bla ma'i bstan srung gnas 'dir gshegs//gshin rje gshed dang pad+ma dbang chen sogs//grangs med dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i lha tsho gis kyi//75bsgo ka' sdod bstan pa bsrung ba'i dbang po khyod//rnal 'byor bdag gis 'bod na gnas 'dir gsheṭa//phyi nang gsang mchod bsnyen pa'i dam rdzas rnams//sa gzhi bar snang khyon kun yongs bkod nas//bdag cag snying nas dung bas 'bod byed na//dregs pa'i ded dpon thogs med da tshur spyon//zhes gnod sbyin beg tse lcam dral 'khor bcas rnams spyan drang pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni bla ma sangs rgyas bkra shes kyi ngor 'khon ston rdo rje 'chang dpal 'byor lhun grub sogs yongs 'dzin dam pa chos bzhin du spyod pa du ma'i bka' drin gyis 'tsho ba'i za hor gyi ban+de sdum bu bas rma chu'i 'gram du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dpal lo// 89

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)in+d+ra ni la brtsegs pa'i lhun po la/ /rta bdun 'bum gyis 'khyud 'dra'i 'od 'phro ba'i/ /stong gsum skad cig myul ba'i rdzu tshil can/ /dus mtha'i rlung gi shugs ldan rta mchog 'di/ /myur mdzad ye shes mgon po'i rten du 'bul/ /'khor tsho gos dam can rgya mtsho'i rten du 'bul/ /bsten pa'i dam rdzas spyan gzigs 'di bzhes la/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las ma lus bsgrub par mdzod/ /dbyar gyi char sprin stug po ltar gnag cing / /rno dang rdo rje'i rwa r+sā mkha' la gdengs/ /nga ro drag posasagasum 'dar byed pa'i/ /dam nyams srog la brngams pa'i 'brong g.yag 'di/ /྾ be+eḍūr+ya mthing kha'i mdog la rab 'bu zhing / /'jam mnyen mdzes pa'i sbu tsho gos rnam par 'khyil/ /spyi bo la ba tshes pa lta bur dkar/ /rno ba'i rwa bzhi ldan pa'i lug nag 'di/ /zag nam lcags 'bar ba'i spu gri'i mchu sder gyis/ /dgra bo'i don snying za zhing nor khrol 'brad/ /rdzu snyul gshog pas stong gsum skad cig myul/ /(76na7kha' la 'phur lding rol ba'i bya nag 'di/྾/gnam sa lta bur yangs pa'i kha gdangasashing / /gangs ri'i dum bu chad 'dra'i mche ba gtsigs/ /sder bzhi rab bgrad gdong lnga'i dbang po ltar/ /dgra bgegs ri dwags tshogos 'joms khyi nag 'di/྾/myur mdzad ye shes mgon bo la phyi rten lnga 'bul ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni 'o rlon pa ngag dbang chos dpal gyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni bya rgyal po bkra shis so/ /yid bzhin 'o mtsho 'khyil ba'i dbus/ /rab mdzes rin chen khang bzang can/ /ljon shing 'phreng bas yongs bskor ba/ /spang ljongs me tog chu mig sogs/ /yid 'ongs mdzes pa'i gnas mchog nas/ /gtsug na nor bu'i rgyan 'chang ba'i/ /gdengs can dbang po dung skyong dang / /'dzin pa lag mang gnas 'dir gshegs/ /dgyes pa'i stan la brtan par bzhugs/ /gtsang ma chab kyis sku khrus gsol/ /me tog bdug spos mar me dang / /zhal zlas rol mo'i mchod pa 'bul/ /dkar gsum dngar gsum sbyar ba yi/ /rnam dag gtsang ma'i gtor ma bzhes/ /bzang po drug dang zho sha gsum/ /chu srin sder mo pu shel tse/ /rnga rgyus dbang lag rma bya'i mdongs/ /dung dang mgron bu spang spos dang / /sle rtses byi thang ka—190

dam can chos srung mngon rtogs 'phrin la rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)dang gzi/ /dar tshon sna lnga rin cen lnga/ /mthun pa'i dam rdzas tshogos rnams kun/ /dngos bshamasayid kyis sprul nas 'bul/ /dgyes pa chen pos bzhes nas kyang / /bstan 'gro'i bde skyid rgyas pa dang / /bdag sogs nad gdon kun zhi zhing / /bsams don lhun gyis grub par mdzod/(7bcusapa 'di ni gtsug na nor bu 'chang ba'i klus bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar/ /bstan srung sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po yi/ /mtha' 'khob yul du blang dor ston pa'i phyir/ /dngos su 'gro la brlamasapa'i sku'i khog pa/ /chos 'phel bzang po de sgos 'bras spungs su/ /sos gdal sdod la bar chad med pa dang / /mthun rkyen sgrubs zhes bdag gis gnyer gtad na/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas dam tshig dran par mdzod/ /ces pa'ang chos 'phel bzang po'i 'dod pa ltar bkod/ /phun tsho gos dge mtshan kun tshang yul gyi dbus/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma lus snyu ba'i gling / /mi 'gyur bde chen bshad sgrub chos 'khor rgyal/ /gnas mchogo dam pa'i gnod sbyin phyogs kyi sgor/ /rab dkar yid 'ong gangs ri lhun chags pa'i/ /stod na chu 'dzin gsar pa'i lang long g.yo/ /smad na g.ya' dang spang ljongs me tog bkra/ /rtsa bar nyal 'gro lhung lhung sgor bcas 'bab/ /mig dang yid la dga' bskyed sna rtoganas ma chag tu/ /rang snang pa'aphrul las grub gzhal med khang / khrel dkar rtsig pa byu ru'i kha bad can/ /g.yu dang gser gyi rgya phubs togo bcas mdzes/ /in+d+ra ni la'i sgo 'gram dngul them la/ /pad+ma rā ga'i sgo 'phar be+eḍūr+ya'i/ /phra bkod bya 'dabs snyan pa'i dril chung sil/ /bkod pas khyad 'phags khang bzang dam pa'i nang / /pad+ma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i gdan steng du/ /rta dkar rin cen sga srab spras pa'i steng / /gnod sbyin chen po rta rgod shel lcags ni/ /sku mdog zla ba rgyas pa ltar mdzes la/ /zhi zhing 'dzum la cung zad khro chags nyams/ /dar dkar thod bcings rtse mor nor bus mtshan/ /kha ba'i mdangs 'dzin phod ka lhub lhub gsol/ /sag lham sngo khra za 'og yu ba can/ /(77na chin cen las grub dbu rgyan snyan rgyan dang //mgul rgyan ska rags phyag gnyis gdu bus mdzes/ /g.yas pa ru mtshon dkar po dar lce dmar/ /mchong dmar las grub yu ba ldem pa'i rtser/ /dgra snying 'bigs pa'i mdung —191

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)so rnon po brgyus/ /g.yon pa 'dod pa'i re ba skong ba yi/ /bsam 'phel yid bzhin nor bu thugs kur 'dzin/ /'gying bag gar gyis bzhugs pa'i 'khor tshogs su/ /gnod sbyin dmag tsho gos ru dar lhabs se lhab/ /ma mo dga' ba'i glu dbyangs tser re re/ /klu rnams rin cen char pa chil li li lha rnams dga' ba'i bro gar shigs se shig /btsan rgod dmag tshogs rta rgyus shar ra ra/ /rgyal po dgra bcom tshul 'dzin lings se ling / /dmu rnams khros pa'i mche ba gtsigs rtsegatsig /bdud dmag chos pa'i dpung tsho gos 'ur ru sa /de ltar mtha' yas 'phrin las kun sgrub pa'i/ /sgyu 'phrul yid kyi rin cen rtsig ngos la/ /kun rtog pir gyis bris pa'i zlos gar mkhan/ /dpal ldan chos skyong chen po 'khor bcas rnams/ /slob dpon pad+ma srong btsan sgam po dang / /dbyangs can bzhad pa'i rdo rje la sogs pa'i/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i dam tshig nyer dgongs la/ /gnas 'dir thogs pa med par da tshur spyon/ /ting 'dzin nyi ma'i 'od kyis legs bskyangs pa'i/ /pho brang ut+pal 'dab ma rgyas pa'i nang / /gdan gsum brtsegs pa'i ze'u 'bru g.yo ba'i steng / /mi g.yo dgyes bzhin brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /gnod sbyin khyod la mthun pa'i dam rdzas ni/ /khang brtsegs bsgos bu bdud rtsi'i btung ba dang / /rnam bkra mi togo tsan+dan bsregs pa'i spos/ /snang gsal sgron tshe dri bzang zhakhrug pa'i chab/ /(77bajo brgya'i zas dang snyan pa'i rol mo'i sgra/ /rta dkar rin cen rgyan mdzes g.yag rgod dang / /lug dang bya khyi ce spyang stag gzig dom/ /'phan gdugs rgyal mtshan bla bre go mtshon dang / /phod ka dar thod ru mtshon yid bzhin nor/ /bkra shis rtags brgyad rgyal srid rin cen bdun/ /gling bzhi gling phran ri rab nyi zlar bcas/ /dngos bshams yid kyis sprul nas rab tu 'bul/ /sna tshogasagrangs med sprul pas dgra sde rnams/ /tshar gcod rnal 'byor bu bzhin skyong mdzad kyang / /zhi ba'i sku yis don kun sgrub mdzad pa'i/ /dpal ldan gnod sbyin chen po khyod la bstod/ /'jigs rung gsung gi nga ro drag po yis/ /nag phyogs bdud sde pha mthar nyer skrad kyang / /dam ldan rna bar gsung gi dbyangs snyan po/ /sgrog mdzad dgra lha'i dbang po khyod la bstod/ /mkha' ltar dag pa bde chen —192

dam can chos srung ma' rtogs tshon las rnam swo lhun grub/ 9)dbyings nyid du//spros kun nyer zhi'i ngang las g.yo med kyang //'phrin las so sor 'jug pa'i zab yangs thugs//mkhyen brtse nus par ldan pa khyed la bstod//gnod sbyin rta rgod shel lcags 'khor bcas kyis//rgyal ba'i bstan srungs bla ma'i sku tshe spel//rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcasarnams kyi//'gal rkyen sol la mthun rkyen ma lus sgrubs//thub bstan rtsa lag gnas mchog chosa'akhor rgyal//'joms pa'i gnod byed dgra bgegs tshar chod la//chos dang srid kyi bya ba ma lusapa//yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel ba'i 'phrin las mdzod//dpag bsam shing dang yid bzhin nor bu dang //'dod 'dzo ba dang gter gyi bum pa bzhi//dngos grub 'dod dgu'i sa wo 'bebasamadzad pa'i//bstan srung gnod sbyin chen po'i bkra shis shog/ces pa 'di yang rgyal 78na gnyer pa dbon dar gyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes bris//rgyal kun mkhyen brtse'i gter gyur 'jam dpal dbyangs//dus dgra'i dbang po bcom ldan gshin rje'i gshed//dpal ldan rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma//thub bstan bsrung phyir mig sman brtsegs pa'i ri//nyin byed 'bum gyis 'khyud pa'i gzi 'od la//bskal pa'i me dpung gos su nyer gyon pa//mthong bas dgra bo'i srog 'phrog srin mo'i gzugs//khrag zhag rba klong drag tu 'khrug pa'i steng //rlung nag 'tshub mar 'khyil ba'i gur gyi nang //rkyang ser dre'u'i steng na 'gying mdzad pa'i//'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug dmag zor mar rab dkar dge legs ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas//dpal ldan phun tsho gos dam pa'i chos kyi gling //dgon gnas de 'dzin dge 'dun sbyin bdag kun//srid gsum bdag mo khyod la gnyer gtod na//rdo rje 'chang dbang sangs rgyas gsang ba'i zhal//lce ston 'byung gnas gnubs ban rgyal ba'i mtshan//ko rigs shes rab dge bon bzang po dang //sngags 'cha 'od byu de sras rdo rje rtse//spyo ston nyi 'od rin cen rnam rgyal dang //bsam gling sangs rgyas 'jam dbyangs 'khon rigs rje//rin cen mgon po nyi ma bshes gnyen dang //nam mkha' rdo rje 'jam dbyangs dkar po'i zhabs//rin cen chos bzang paṇa chen dge 'dun grub//kun dgaX rgyal mtshan dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i dpal//bsod

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)nams grags pa rje btsun bshad pa'i mtshan/ /gnyos rigs lha btsun mkhas grub snang mdzad rje/ s+t+waṃ bhū ti blo bzang rgya mtsho sogs/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bka' (78bang sgo dam tshig rnams/ /srid gsum dbang sgyur dpal ldan re ma tī/ /'khor dang bcas pas deng 'dir rab dgongs la/ /sde 'dir rnam par dag pa'i tshul khrims gtsang / /rgya chen mang du thos pa lhur len zhing / /de don bsam dang sgom pasanyams len pa'i/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa phyogs bcur 'phel bar mdzod/ /gtsug lag khang bzang sku gsung thugs kyi rten/ /kun dga' ra ba gnas mal khang bu dang / /dge 'dun 'du ba'i rdzas soṭa mthun pa'i rkyen/ / bya ba las kyi 'khor lo rgyas par mdzod/ /dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgo nasang na sems 'chang / /nye bar 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs bdud dpung choms/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin 'dusasde sbyin pa'i bdag /ma lus bsrung zhing skyob pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /nyi zla'i 'od kyis nor 'dzin pad+mo'i bzhin/ /mngon par gsal ba de srid 'dus sde 'di/ /rab brtan rgyal dbang blo bzang gragasapa yi/ /dri med ring lugs dar ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /'dod khams dbang phyug mthu stobs yid bzhin nor/ /mi mthun dbul phongs rgud pa drungs phyung nas/ /mi 'dzad phan bde'i 'dod dgur longs spyod pa'i/ /phun tshogs bkra shis dga' ston rgyas gyur cig /ces nang phyogs gser gzhed gi dga' ldan dam chos gling gi 'dus sde rgyal ba kun yum dpal ldan 'dod khams kyi dbang phyug mar gnyer du gtad pa'i tshigs su bcad pa zhig dgos zhes thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen chos rje don grub rgya mtshos bskul ba ltar za hor gyi ban+de ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni grong smad pa 'phrin las rgya mtsho'o/ /rigs kun khyab bdag dpal ldan kun tu bzang / /(79na rdo rje'i slob dpon gar mkhan pad+ma 'byung / /ris med 'gro la phan bde'i byed po mchog /byang chub bar du snying gi bad mtshor rol/ /gang de'i bka' nyan srid gsum dregs pa'i gtso/ /lha gnyen chen po sma chen spom ra la/ /dgyesabaskyed gsol mchod 'phrin las rim pa dag /khungs ldan mkhas pa'i phyag bzhes bzhin du 'dri/ /—194

dam can chos srung mngon rtogs 'phrin la rna mo bzhi lhun grub/ 9)de'ang spyan gzigs rten dang mthun rdzas mchode gtor gser skyems rnams phyag len ltar bshams/ /rang nyid rigs 'dzin bla ma'i dkyil 'khor ram dpal chen po sogs yi dam gang rung gi nga rgyal dang ldan pas mchod rdzas rnams la dmigs te/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūṃ lan gsum gyis ma dag pa rnamasabasangs/ ā+oṃ su bhā ba shurnya sarba dharmā su bhā ba shu lja3nya/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod rdzas thams cad mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ /stong pa'i ngang las: zhu ba las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangasashing rgya che ba'i nang du/ oṃ āḥlha zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod gtor rnams bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshos lha gnyen 'khor bcas kyi dbang bo rnams tshim par byed pa'i nus pa dang ldan pa/ phyi nang gsang ba'i rten rdzas spyan gzigs rnams mdzes shing brjid ldan yid du 'ong ba/ sa gzhi bar snang gi khyen thams cad yongs su gang ba'i mchod pa'i sprin bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs la/ bas sto/ rma mu ye glang chen pi ta nye ri 'ba' ra tre/bsto/ oṃ mu khyud krag pa lta nye ring tre/bsto/ oṃ mu ye she thun/ yi ta nye ri 'bar// ta / dzu dpung 'du/ su pa li swā hā/ a yad raṃ/ yaṃ/ me kho/ byu ri ri/ gar ma la ho/ brum 'dus/ zhes nyer gcig gam bdun bzlas/ bsangs dud cher (79ba tha tang / rnga gshang sogs rol mo dkrol zhing / g.yu 'byug gi ngar skad kyi dbyangasadang bcas/ bsto/ rtse mo rab dkar gangs ri brjid chags pa/ zhal dkar brtsegs pa'i lhun po'i rjes 'gro zhing / /rked pa g.yu yi g.ya' chung bsil mas mdzes/ /rtsa bar spang ljongs me tog sman shing tshal/ /lhung lhung sgra ldan chu bo grangs med 'bab/ /gangs phran sum brgya drug cus phyoṭa kun bskor/ /mthong bas yid la kun dga'i dpal ster ba'i/ /phyi ltas sa 'dzin dbang po'i rnam pa la/ /nang du rin cen sna tsho gos las grub pa'i/ /bang rim dgu dang ldan pa'i pho brang che/ /gser dang g.yu yi rgya phubs mkha' la snyeg /khor yug lcags ri nyis rim lcog dang bcas/ /kun kyang nor bu'i dra ba dra phyed dang / /dar zab las grub rgyal mtshan ba dan sogs/ /sna tsho gis bkod pas mdzes pa'i ngo mtshar gyis/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang dag la 'khu/ khros pa'i dpa' bo g.yul ngor mas 'dra —195

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshogasung 'bum/ (4)ba'i//lha srin dregs pa'i tsho gos kyi dmag gi dpung /khi ba'i go dang rno ba'i mtshon thogs pas//yongs bskor laṅka'i bdag po'i byin sha 'dar//mdzes brjid rngams pa'i gzhal med khang bzang nas//dgra lha'i rgyal po lha gnyen kun gyi gtso//mthu stobs dbang phyug sma chen spom ra khyod//thogs med rdzu tshil stobs kyis gnas 'dir gshegs//bde ba'i nyams ster dgyes pa skyed byed pa'i//gsang ba'i yum chen dgung sman lha ri dang //dpa' ba'i sras dgu mdzangs ma'i sras mo dgu//thogs pa med par gnas 'dir da tso spyon//'dzum r+sā sdom khrom dbyi r+pā rab sde dang //waṃ ོ ldang dngul lha chen thang lha de//phyogs bzhi gnyen chen sdebazhi 'khor bcas rnams//thogs pa med par gnas80na 'dir ྾//sum brgya drug cu'i gangs kyi ri phran nas//mda' mdung 'dzin pa'i dpa' bo'i tshoṭa rnams dang //'chi med bu mo'i khengs log lha sman sogs//ma lus 'khor bcas gnasa'adir ྾//ku/bsnye/cha'o/lha rgyal lo//mdun du ting 'dzin gyis sprul gzhal med khang //gser gyi khri sogs sna tsho gis gdan steng du//dgra lha'i rgyal po 'khor bcas rab bzhugs la//mas rdzasamachod pa 'bul gyi bzhes su gsol//ro brgya'i dpal dang ldan pa'i zhal zas dang //dri zhim ngad ldan btung ba mtsho ltar 'khyil//sman spos shing sna'i dud pa sprin ltar gtibs//lha mchog 'khor bcas dgyes pa bskyed phyir 'bul//rnga gzhang dung gling rol mo 'brug ltar sgrag/bdud rtsi'i gtor ma ri rab lta bur spungs//gser gyi zhal skyems chu bo'i rgyun ltar sbreng //lha mchog 'khor bcasams pa'i rdzas su 'bul/khrab rmog mdung thung ral gri dgra sta dang //mda' dang stag gzig gung gsum pags pa'i tshogs//cang shes rta dang 'brong g.yag zhol chen lug/lha mchog 'khor bcasadagyes pa'i rten du 'dzugs//za 'og ber ོ nor bu shing phreng dang //bdud rtsi'i bum pa me long rgyal srid bdun//gling bzhi ri 4 nyi ma zla ba zung //lha mchog 'khor ba mar ma rdzo pa'i rten du 'bul//sa gzhi bar snang yongs gang mchod pa 'di//sngar bcol grub pa'i gto rag go du 'bul//da lta bsrung stob mdzad pa'i bskul mar 'bul//slad ༷sa wen las sgrub pa'i rten du 'bul//dpal

dgas chos srung ma' rtog mun la rna mo sto lhun grub/ 9)ldan lha mchog sma wo sbom ra khyod//rgyal ba kun dngos pad+ma 'byung gnas dang //gas ston a mi byang chub 'dre bkol80bcu//spyan sngar khas blangs dam ba mar nyer dgongs la//bstan dang bstan 'dzin dge 'dun sdo rnams srungs//nag po dgra dang bgegs kyi dpung tshogs choms//r+pā po bod kyi rgyal khams mdo smad kyi//mi nor phyugs gsum thams cad bu bzhin skyongs/khyad par bdag cag 'khor dang bcas rnams kyi//nad gdon bar yo chag sgo nyam nga bzlog/tshe dpal bsod nams dpal 'byor longs spyod spel//bsams pa'i don kun lhun gyis grub bar mdzod//ku/bsnye/cha'o//lha rgyal lo//bsto//sku mdog rab dkar khro chags sgeg pa'i nyams//phyag g.yas yid bzhin nor bu bsam 'phel bsnams//g.yon pa shel dkar 'phreng ba brgya rtsa 'dren//dngos grub char 'bebasakhyod la bdag bstod do//dbu la rin cen brog zhu mdzes par gsol//lhab lhub za 'og ber gyi na bza' can//zhabs gnyis gser gyi khri la 'gying zhing bzhugs//dpal ldan dgra lha'i dbang po khyod la bstod//yid 'phrog sgeg mo mdzes pa'i mas kyis brgyan//g.yas pa 'chi med tshe yi bum pa dang //g.yon pa snang srid gsal ba'i me long 'dzin//gsang ba'i yum chen dgung sman lha rir bstod//lha yis sras dang sras mo bco bas dang //gto r+pā sdebazhi lha 'khor sman 'khor gyi//sum brgya drug cur bcas pa'i bka' sdod sogs//pho nya dmas gyo mtsho'i tsho gos la bstod//ku/bsto//cha'o//lha rgyal lo//bsto//rta mchog gro zhun gser gyi sga spras pa//g.yu yi gong rmed gser srab g.yu mthur bcas//nyi zla'i skru len rin byu rgyan spras par//zhen nas stong gsum myul ba'i lha wo bo//sku lagaser khrab dbu la bse rmog gsol//g.yas pa mdung ring g.yon pa zhags pa 'dzin//rked la gnam lcags thog mda'i stag dong dang //mchog 81na dkar sra ba'i gzhu ldan gzig shubasabacings//drag rtsal mas ldan sma r+pā spom ra la//gsol lo mchod do bcos ba'i 'phrin las mdzod//chibs su gser gyi sha ba su mo chabs//mdzes pa'i rgyan ldan ji/yu yi lan tshar 'phyang //tshe bum me long 'dzin pa'i dgung sman la//gsol lo ྾//// shar dpa' bo'i mas ldan mtshon cha 'dzin//rma

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)gi shugs ldan rta mchog la bcibs pa/ /lha chen shugs kyi sras po mched dgu la/ /gsol lo ྾/ /g.yu bya khu byug dung bya khrung khrung bcibs/ /bum pa me long tshe 'gugs mda' dar bsnams/ /dgra lha'i sras mo lha sman mched ྾/ /gsol lo ྾/ /'dzum chen sdom khrom mkha' lding khyung la bcibs /phyag na gnam lcags thog gi mda' gzhu bsnams/ /dbyi chen rab sde rgya stag ri khra bcibs/ /phyag na stag gi pags pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /'bri chen mdong dngul gar shog 'byong la bcibs/ /phyag na gnam lcags 'bar ba'i ral gri 'dzin/ /gnyan chen thang lha g.yu 'brug sngon mo bcibs/ /phyag na mdung ring dar gyi ba dan 'dzin/ /phyogs bzhi skyong ba'i gnyan chen sdebazhi la/ /gsol lor/ /g.yas kyis mda' 'dzin g.yon gyis mdung 'dzin zhing / /rta mchog la wo sra ba'i go cha yo/ /dung khra klad lding stag dmar rol du khrid/ /'dab chags gcan gzan ri dwags rjes su 'brang / /sma rigs sum brgya drug cu'i tsho gos rnams dang / /sman mo yid 'ong sum brgya drug cu sogs/ /bka' nyan 'khor dang bcas pa'i tsho gos rnams la/ /gsol lo ྾/ /lha mchog sma chen spom ra 'khor bcasarnams/ /bsten pa'i tshe na lha gnyan rgyang ma ring / /bos pa'i tshe na srung ma snyan ma sra/ /g.yabs pa'i tshe na dam can spyan ma rtul/ /rbad pa'i tshe na dgra lha mthu ma chung / /lus dang grib ma bzhin du khyed 'grogs la/ /wo gyi bya ra mawo gyi (81ba thal tshe mdzod/ /yo srongs skrul slong ho 'thud brjed pa bskul/ /legs pa brgya sprod nyes pa stong dang bsnol/ /gzhi lam byes gsum kun tu mthun rkyen sgrubs/ /mi nor rigs brgyud zas nor longs spyod spel/ /'khor 'bangs chab srid mnga' thang rgyasapar mdzod/ /mdor na bdag gi chos dang srid kyi don/ /phun tshogs ldebazhi'i yon to ma lus pa/ /yar ngo'i zla ba bzhin du rab 'phel nas/ /ba po shis dpal gyis dus kun khyab gyur cig /ku /bsto/ /cha'o/ /lha rgyal lo/ /zhes gtor ma dang chang phud 'bul lo/ /de ltar lha wo spom ra yi/ /gsol mchod 'phrin las nyung ngu 'di/ /skal ldan rma bya'i dga' ston du/ /snyan 'gyur dbyar gyi rnga gsang ldir/ /sma r+ṣa spom ra'i gsol ma rdzo 'dod pa'i re stong 'di ni mchog tu yangs pa'i blo gros dang ldan pa dka' —198

dam can chos srung mag rtogs wen las rnam swo lhun grub/ 9)bcu shes rab rgya mtshos bskul ba'i ngor lugs gnyis kyi 'dun sa pho brang chen po sne'u sdong rtse'i lha bcas skye rgu'i gtsug rgyan gong ma wo po'i phyag len gyi yi ge rnying pa las bsdus te za hor gyi ban+de ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos lha r+pā po nyid kyi pho brang dang nye ba'i sa'i cha rang byung khrus kyi rdzing bu'i 'gram du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dpal lo//rigs kun khyab bdag pad ma 'byung gnas zhes//snang srid zil gnon mtsho skyes rdo rje la//gus pas btud nas sprul pa'i cho ge rgyal gyi//dgyes byed 'phrin las rim pa cung zad 'bri//skyabs sems ni/na mo bla ma bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku:dkon mchog gsum gyi rang bzhin la bdag dang 'gro ba sems can rnams byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi:sems bskyed 'gro ba kun don du:bla ma sangs rgyas bsgrubs nas ni:gang la gang 'dul 'phrin las kyis 'gro don byed par dam bca'o:lan gsum brjod/tsho gos zhing ni/bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro po sheṭa nyi zla pad ma'i gdan la bzhugs lusang ga yid 82na ngo sum gus phyag 'tshal:phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa 'bul nyams chags sdig sgrib mthol lo bshags gsang sngagasasgrub la rjes yi rang :smin grol gsang sngags chos 'khor skor:sgos can don du bzhugs su gal:snying po sems can don du bsngo yang dag rdo rje'i don rtogs shog ma sgos gcod ni/da ni ye nasarang gis khra mtshams gcod khro bos nam mkha' gang :bgegs 'dul khro bo'i rol mtshams lasasu yang 'da' bar ma byed cig lta badz+ra kro ta rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ phaṭa:byin 'bebs ni/rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha tsho gis kyis//thugs dam dbyings nas bskul lo bzhengs//cho rtaganas ma ga 'di ru byin chen phob//bdag la dbang bskur stsal du gsol//sman raka gtor gsum byin gyis brlabs pa ni//oṃ.āḥ& sarba pañtsa a khru ta hūṃ hrī4/oṃ āḥlha ma hā bha lo ta te dzo bha kla ta ba la ba te ga ku tho sam ya hūṃ gyi'/o.āḥlha ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal hūṃ lha'i/gsumyo/ mam bdun brjod/dngos gzhi ni/ka dag ngang las snying rje'i gdangs//rang rig rdo rje gyi yig las//: 'phros gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa'i//mtshan nyid kun rdzogs gzhal yas khang //dbus su pad9 ༷ bdud bzhi'i steng //4 nyid phyi las rta mgrin

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)dmar//gri gug thod 'dzin yum la 'byud//dur khrod mas brgyan spyi gtsug tu//pad+ma nyi zla brtsegasapa'i steng //pad+ma 'byung gnas sku mdog dkar//phyag gnyis rdo rje bhan dha 'jin//gsang gos mthing nag chos gos dmar//zab ber khro bo g.yang lugs gso le//pad zhwa sgro dar me long can//de nyid gnas 'gyur rdo rje 'amang //mthing nag rdo rje dril bu 'dzin//pang du mtsho rgyal sku mdog dkar//gri thod 'dzin pas mgul nasahrūd//gnyis ka rin cen rus pas brgyan//'dab bzhin thod phreng rigs bzhi po//rang rtags phyag mtshan gos kyis brgyan//pad+ma'i 'dab ma brgyad po la//bad 'byung pad+ma /bhā wa//82ba ) blo ldan mchog sred pad+ma rgyal//nyi ma 'od zer shākya seng //seng ge sgra sgrog gro bo lod//mas brgyad sprul pa'i rnam par rol//phyi rim mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro dang //dam tso chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs//go mtshams med par gang bar gyur//hūṃ oṃ su o ha gu ru dhe wa ḍā zhi sam ya dza dza spyan drang ba ni/lha sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la skyon yul gyi nub byang mtsham pad+ma ge sar sdong po las ya mas mchog gi dngos grub brnyes 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor khyod kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyis byin gyis brlabs phyir gshegs su gsol badz+ra sa ma ya dza:dza lha baṃ sngo mchode pa 'bul ba ni/bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la//sman ra kagator gsum nyer spyod dang //sbyor sgrol la sogs mchode pa 'bul//bzhes nas dngos grub stsal du gsol//bstod spru ni/ma bcosaspros bral bla ma chos kyi sku bde chen longs spyod bla ma chos kyi rje pad sdong las zhakhrungs bla ma sprul pa'i sku sku gsum rdo rje 'chang la spyi bos 'dud:'dzab bzla ba ni/oṃ ā:྅ gyi badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sirnyi hūṃ/ci nus bzla/mchod gtor i gyis bas pa ni/gyi badz+ra krodha ha ya gri wa pad+ma ta srid hūṃ phaṭa//thod pa rin wo la soṭa snod yangs por/sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga dang lha mi yi//phun tsho gis 'dod pa'i longs spyod las grub pa'i//sman raka gtor ma phyi nang mchod pa'i tshogs//chos skyong 'khor bcasatshim par byed 'i nus pa/kha dog dri ro reg bya bla na med//tso tu bzang po'i ma rdzo pa'i sprin 0 pos//sa gzhi bar snang tho tso khyab gyur cig20//lo bid/pā ra gu ra/su ra su ra/ā warta ya/

dam tso chos srung ma' rtogs mun las rnam ge lhun grub/ 9)ā warta ya sngo badz+ra sla ra ṇa khaṃ swā hā/ lan gsum dang bcas nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bya'o/ /spyan 'dren ni/ lhaḥ bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po yid bzhin nor/ /mchog mthun dngos grub 'dod dgu'i dpal ster ba/ /dus(83na gsum sangs rgyas ngo bo pad+ma 'byung / /mtsho skyes rdo rje ris kyi bdag por bzhugs/ /ka nas dag pa chos sku'i lha lam ngos/ /lhun grub longs sku'i rta bdun dkyil 'khor can/ /thugs rje sprul sku 'od stong sgyu dra'i gar/ /rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha yi dngos grub stsol/ /chos dbyings bde ba che las ma g.yos kyang / /gdug pa 'dul phyir khro bo'i skur ston pa/ /sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po sku lnga po/ /thugs dam bskul na gnas 'dir da tshur spyon/ /mchong dung gser dang byu ru g.yu lnga las/ /legs grub rngams brjid yangs pa'i pho brang nas/ /thugs sku yon tan gsung dang 'phrin las kyi/ /dpal ldan rgyal po sdo lnga gshegs su gsol/ sharnyi ro zan bdud mo ro langasam/ /gser gyi skru gri mdzes byed pad+ma can/ /ro langs smin dkar bde chen bskyed mdzad pa'i/ /gsang ba'i yum chen rnam lnga ྾/ /nyan thos tshul 'dzin sdom brtson gzhon nu'i gzugs/ /khro gtum mi sdug srin po mon bu sogs/ /sna tshogs sku yi rol gar ston mdzad pa'i/ /'jigs rung sprul pa rnam lnga ྾/ /srog bdag dbang bo bya khrid mig gcig po/ /bya rgod thang nag rdo rje grags ldan dang / /pu tra nag po pa'aphrul stobs ldan pa'i/ /las byed blon po rnam lnga ྾/ sha grol gyi grol khol po 'dzim sdom dang / /'bag seng mon pa spre'u a tsa ra/ /ru 'dren sdebazhi la soṭa sprul ba'i 'khor/ /sa gzhi bar snang gang ba ྾/ khyad par dpal ldan sol nag thang chen gyi/ /gtsug lag khang dang sdebacasaskyong ba'i lha/ /chos skyong wo po rgyal po pe ha ra/ /'khor dang yos gnas 'dir da tshur spyon/ /'phying bar stag rtse'i pho brang legs skyong ba'i/ /za hor rgyal rigs pha mes brgyud pa'i lha/ /snang srid dregs pa kun gyi dmag dpon mchog /bshan pa lag dmar (83ba phra khor bcas gshegs su gsol/ /dzaḥlha baṃ hoḥ.e gye hi bha ga wa na e ku sha sam ya dzaḥdzaḥ phyag rgya bzhis spyan drangs/ bzhugasasu gsol ba ni/ sna tsho gos rin cen las grub gzhal yas khang / /glo snying rgyu ma'i 'phreng ba lda ldis—201—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)brgyan//g.yang gzhi'i bla bre bres shing pad+ma dang //nyi ma bam ro'i gdan la brtan par bzhugs//dam bsre ba ni/byuḥlha sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūṃ gyi ṭha/pad+ma 'byung gnas rta mgrin dbang gi lha//dus 'di nas bzung gzu dang dpang mdzod cig/bdag gis rgyal po chen po bsten cing mchod//srung ma khyod kyis bdag gi grogs mdzod cig/badz+ra tri dur rak+ṣa yak+ṣa hūṃ phags/ma hā pañtsa.a skṛ ta la khā hi/bshagasapa ni/ma rig dbang gis dam tshig nyams pa dang //mar gtor bsten pa'i rdzas rnams ma sgo 'bags//rtag gtor dus kyi mchod pa chag pa sogs//gsal stong 'dzin med ngang nas mthol zhing bshags/gtor ma 'bul ba ni/sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta ji bra tī ts+tsha hoḥbadz+ra yak+ṣa kha kha 'a hi khā hi/dun ting dun ting khā hi/yag sha nag po 'a hi/sha grol hu ru khā hi/kyi grol hu ru khā hi/tsit+ta ba ta khā hi/'dzin po ru tra khā hi/sdom po chang rgyud khya hi/ru tra ru tra khā hi/go ro tsa na khā hi/rak+ta tshul pa khā hi/sha rgyud snying rgyud khā hi/dbang po sna lnga khā hi/sha ma ru tra khā hi/a bra la ho pu dzaḥbadz+ra du ru sngobadun nam nyer gcig gis dbul/bskang ba ni/dam can srung ma 'du ba'i gnas mchog 'dir//phyi nang gsang ba'i rten dang ma rdzo pa'i tshogs//dngos bshams yid sprul nam mkha'i tho rnams kun//yongs su bkang ste 'bul gyis dgyes par rol//rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman//dmar chen khrag gi rgya mtsho'i btung ba dang //gsang 'phyis legs brgyan gtor tsho gis ri ltar spungs//rgya phubs lcog gis mdzes pa'i sku mkhar gyis//sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po sde lnga dang //gsang yum sprul pa blon po bka' sdod tshogs/khyad par bshan pa dmar nag 'khor bcas kyi//thugs dam bskang ngo bcol ba'i tshon las mdzod//bshos bu 'bru sna shing tog bu ram sbrang //sngo rigs sha sna bza' dang yo' ba spungs//'bras chang rgun 4 ja dkar gas ba sogs//longs spyod tsho gos kyi 'khor lo'i mchod pa 'dis//sprul pa'i sogs blo ka gcig pa 'gre/rab mdzes srog chags dkar po phyi yi rten//smyug rgod rnga ma dar r+pā nang gi rten//gsang rten sku thug bla rdo srog ga bor bams//'ja' tho ltar bkra sna pha mdos rigs kyis/snyo/2/rnyog bral chu klung 'khyil ba'i mar yon dang //

dam mā chos srung ma' rtogs tshon la rnam pha lhun grub/ 9)pad+ma ut+pal la sogs me rtag tshogs//sman sna stong dang sbyar ba'i bdug pa'i spos//me shel nyi zla'i snang ba gsal byed kyis mo//dngar ba'i ngad dang ldan pa'i dri chab dang //lha mi'i zas kun spungasapa'i zhal zas tshogos//pi wang gling bu la sogs snyan pa'i sgra//lus kyi rnam 'gyur gar 'chams stang stabs kyis mo/khrag mtsho'i a rba rlabs mkha' la 'phyo//mig lce rna ba sna snying me tog bkra/sha chen sbos dkar dud sprin lang long g.yo//chil chen zhun mar gsal byed sgron me yis ྾//khrag zhag mkhris pa 'khyil ba'i dri chab dang /sha rus nang khrol spungs pa'i bsgos bu'i tshogs//thod pa'i rnga chung mi rkang gling bu'i sgra//dzo gi mon pa spra sprel zlos gar gyis sko//rgya gling dung chen rnga dang sil snyan sogs//sna tsho gos rol mos gnam sa dus gcig sper/khrag chang 'thor zhing sbyar ba'i bdug sposasbreng //g.yab byed g.yang gzhi ma ling dar tshon gyis za//rin cen rtag gis mdzes pa'i gdugasadakar po//84bang po shis gser mig rnam par 'khyil ba'i nya//'dab stong phang phung g.yo ba'i pad+ma dkar//ngo mtshar phun tsho gos g.yas su 'khyil ba'i dung ྾//'chi med bdud rtsis gtams pa'i bum pa bzang //dge legs ri mo rnam bkra'i dpal beg/phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mas dang //rtsibs stong ldan pa'i rin cen 'khor lo yis mo//gling bzhir dbang sgyur gser gyi 'khor lo dang //'dod pa'i re ba skong ba'i yid bzhin nor//'chi med lus phra'i khengs log btsun mo dang //dpa' mdzangs rtul phod blon po rin byu gyis za//glang r+sā dbang po mche ba drug dang ldan//gling bzhi skad cig tsam gyis bskor ba'i rta//dgra dpung thal bar rlog pa'i dmag dpon dang //gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'dod yon lngas mo//dar nag dar dkar za 'og 'jol ber dang //dom gyi slog pa zhing chen stag glang lpags//dar dang smyug ma'i theb zhu sag theb zhwa//rus pa rin cen sprul gyi rgyan cha yis mo//zhags pa spu gri rdo rje gseng shang dang //dgra lta sba 'bar beng chen lcags kyu mda'//ral gri gzhu dang bas shel dkar 'phreng //dam shing rgyal mtshan ru mchen la soṭa pas mo//sra brtan bse lcags las grub khrab rmog tshogs//'ja' /sa rnga mas spras pa'i zhes btags phub//lcags

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo r+sāng rgya 40 gsung tshom/ (4)gzhibs lcags 'bag bzhen pa'i go cha sogs//rang srid bsrung ba'i khyad par ji snyed bsar//dpag chen mda' mdung ral gri dgra sta dang /khri skyogs me bya stag mo me mda' sogs//pha rol dgra dpung phye mar 'thag nus pa'i//sna tsho gos mtsho ni cha'i 'byul 'khor ji snyed pas mo//zhwa nag phod kaphur thun sgrol ba'i gri//dam nyams dgra bgegs dmigs rten liṅga dang //thar med btson khang 'brub khung la sogs pa//drag po mthu yi las sbyor rdzas ldan snams kyis mo//stag dom dred gzig seng ge ce spyang dang //bya rgod rma bya las grub rgyal mtshan 'phyar//'phan gdugs bla bre ba dan lda ldi bres//lhub lhub mdung dar nam mkha'i khyon gang bsar//rlung gi shugs ldan rta mchog tshogasarnams rgyug/'jigs yo 'brong g.yag rdo rje'i rwa wo gdengs//'o ma'i bas ldan 'dod pa 'jo ba'i ba//dkar 'jam spu ldan rwa bzhi 'khyil ba'i lug ྾//gangs ri'i dum bu ho 'dra'i gnyisa'athung dbang //rtsal gsum lus la rdzoṭa pa'i gdong lnga pa//spra dang spre'u phyi ba khyim gyi bya//rnga mo bong bu drel nag la sogs pas mo//sal 'dzul dgu gnam la 'phur dgu sogs//sna tsho gos srog chags khyad par ji snyed dang //dar zab ras dang ra ba las sgrub gos//lhung bzed par bu snod kyi bye brag gis za//ri gra lhun po gling bzhi gling phran brgyad//nyi zla yan lag brgyad ldan mtsho dang rdzing //yongs 'du'i shing dang lha mi'i 'byor pa rnams//kun bzang mar pa'i sprin ltar rab spros bas ྾//bstod pa ni/ka pā yis snying gi khrag bcus nas/kha gdangs mche ba gcigs pa'i zhal du gsol//ga na gnas kyang dam nyams dgra bgegs tshogis//nga ro drag por bcas te sgral la bstod//ca co'i glu dang 'jigs pa'i gad brgyangs sgrogs//cha lugs ma nges sna tsho gis sprul pa 'gyed//ja chang gisamachod bskul tshe dam nyams dgra//nyi ma lcags kyus 'dzin ltar 'gugs la bstod//ta la'i lo mar dgra bgegs nya bo bris//tha ho btsan pa'i lha khyod rbad pa na//da lta smi du hom khung nang bcug ste//na tsha 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa ster la bstod//pa sangs ltar dkar dgyes pa'i zhal bstan nas//pha ro go gra sde thal bar brlag go zhes//ba dan ru maX mkha' la 'phyar byed pa'i//ma lus phyoṭa 85ba

dgag chos srung ma' rtogs mun las rnam sto lhun grub/ 9)las rnam rgyal khyod la bstod//re ma ti dang rta mchog seng ge glang //tsha lu'i bya sogs spyan gzigs sna tsho gis bshams//dza gad sman phud gser skye mas kyis mchode tshe//wa ler bsams pa'i don kun sgrub la bstod//zhwa mo sag theb thib zhu sna tshogs rgya ne//za mar dgra bo'i sha khrag don snying rol//'a 'ur rlung gi 'tshub ma la sogs pa'i//ya mtshan bzhen pas stong gsum bskor la bstod//ra lug gser dngul la sogs dkor nor rdzas//la lung mang por brgal te srid mthar bsnyegs/sha za dregs pa'i pho nya grangs med spros//sa chen kun la dbang sgyur khyod la bstod//ha ri tsan+dan sha wo spos dkar dang //a ka ru yi bdug spos 'bul byed na//ha sa'i tshul gyi dgyes pa'i zhal gyi khyim//a ho mig gi bdud rtsir ston la bstod//lhaḥdapal ldan e ṇ+ḍi ā na'i yul khams su//dngas gsal rnyog med chu klung 'khyil ba'i mtshor//rab dkar pad+ma'i sbubs la nyer 'khrungs pa'i//sangs rgyasakun dngos rdo rje thod phreng rtsal//gang des bstan pa srung bar bka' bsgos pa'i//bstan srung dregasapa'i ded dpon pe ha ra//sprul pa'i chos rgyal sprul yum blon po sogs//'khor tsho gos dam can rgya mtshor bcas la bstod//in+d+ra ni la'i lhun bo dus mtha'i me'i//gos gyon bdud gas dgra bo'i ske nas 'ching //sbu gri rnon pos srog rtsa gcad mdzad pa'i//thugs kyi rgyal po brgya byin khyod la bstod//mun ba bye bas byugs pa'i lhun bo la//nyi ma 'bum gyis 'byud pa'i gzi brjid can//gser gyi rdo rje gseng shang dgra la bsnun//sku yi rgyal bo mon bu pu tso bstod//ha la'i sdong po lta bur mdog gnag cing //rno ngar ldan pa'i dgra stas mgo lus gshog/zhags pas ske dang yan lag 'ching 86nasgo dzad pa'i//yon to rgyal po shing bya can la bstod//byu ru'i lhun po ltar dmar zhal khyim can//sba 'bar brdabs pas nor 'dzin 'dar byed cing //ā+oṃ beng las sprul pa'i dmag dpung spro//gsung gi rgyal po skyes gcig dgra lhar bstod//sna tsho gos mdog can khro tha khum 'jigs pa'i tshul//lcags kyus log 'dren 'gugs shing ral gri mda'//rdo rje sbu gris thal bar brlag mdzad pa'i//'phrin las rgyal po mi bo che la bstod/khyad par sol nag thang r+ṣa 0 5 lag khang //wo mas dus drug ma yengs

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)bsrung mdzad pa'i/ /sdebargyad dmag dpon sprul pa'i chos rgyal che/ /bshan pa lag dmar 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ /gsang ba'i yum lnga sprul pa rnam pa lnga/ /blon bo sde lnga ru 'dren sdebazhi sogs/ /sadang bar snang khyon kun gang ba yi/ /bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i tsho gos la bstod/ /gsol kha ni gser skyems dang bcas/ /lhaḥ sku mdog mthing nag khros pa'i rnam 'gyur can/ /g.yas pa bdud zhags g.yon pa spu gri 'dzin/ /dom slog dar ber theb zhu mdzes par gsol/ /glang chen la bcibasathugs kyi rgyal po che/ shan ting ro zan srog bdag bya ra ba/ /sprul ba yang sprul 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /dgyes pa skyed byed mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'bul/ /gsol lo mchod do bcol ba'i 'phrin lasamadzod/ /sprul pa sogs tshig rkang gsum po 'gre/ /sku mdog mthing nag khros pa'i rnam 'gyur can/ /g.yas pa rdo rje g.yon pa gseg shang 'dzin/ /dar nag 'jol ber smyug ma'i tshag zhu gsol/ /seng ge la bcibs sku yi rgyal po che/ /bdud mo ro langs bya khrid mig gcig po/ khun pa'i mdog can dgra sta zhags pa 'dzin/ /sprul gyis brgyan cing stag lngags g.yang bzhi dang / /smyug (86bad+ku legs gyon steng nas khyung gis phub/ /rta nag la bcibs gnod sbyin shing bya can/ /gser gyi spu gri bya rgod thang nag che/ /rki sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /g.yas pa sba 'khar nam mkha'i dbyings su 'phyar/ /g.yon pa tsan dan beng las dmag dpung 'gyed/ /drel rta la bcibs dgra lha skyes gcig po/ /mdzes byed pad+ma rdo rje grags ldan can྾/ /dkar mthing dmar zhal lcaṭa kyu mda' gri g.yas/ /rdo rje gzhu dang spu gri g.yon pas bsnams/ /dar dkar stod g.yogs smyug ma'i theb zhu gsol/ /seng ge la bcibs stod kyi mi bo che/ /ro langs smin dkar blon po pu tra nag ྾/ /chos gcor stod smad gtsug lag khang rnams skyong / khro chags zhi sogs sna tsho gos sprul pa yis/ /dgra bgegs sgrol zhing rnal 'byor skyong mdzad pa/ /sol nag thang chen gtsug lag khang bzhugs tshe/ /bshan pa lag dmar zhes grags mas stobs can ྾/ /'phrin las bcol ba ni/ 〉ཿ dpal ldan sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po khyod/ /rtag gtor rgyun gtor dus kyi mchod pa yis/ /g.yel med gsol zhing thugs dam stong —206

dam ༅ cho srung ma' rtog lon la rnam sto lhun grub/ (gebyed na//'dod pa'i don gyi 'bras bu smin par mdzod//phan bde'i gzhir gyur thub pa'i bstan pa dang //de 'dzin skyes bu khrims ldan 'dus pa'i sde//thos bsam sgom pa'i bya ba ma lus pa//dbyar gyi chu gter lta bur 'phel bar mdzod//'dzam gling spyi dang khyad par gangs can 'dir//mi phyugasand dang dus kyi zhakhrug pa sogs//mi mthun rgud pa'i tshogs kun rab zhi nas//bde skyid dga' ston dpal la spyod par mdzod//rtsod pa'i dus 'dir legs byas rtsibs stong gi/'khor lo 'gog med mkha' la rab 'phags pa'i//dga' ldan phyogs las rnam rgyal pho brang che'i//chab srid 87bamanga' thang 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzod//za hor gdung gi tsan+dan ljon pa dang //nam yang 'bral med dri bsung rigs kyi lhas//mi mthun dgra bgegs tsha gdung kun bcom ste//bsams don lhun gyisagrub pa'i dga' ston stsol//dge bcu kun tshang bod kyi rgyal khams 'dir//'jam dbyangs rnam sprul khri srong lde btsan gyis//phan bde'i rtsa lag rgyal bstan spel ba'i ched//slob dpon sangs rgyas gnyis pa spyan drangs tshe//gtsug lag chos 'khor yongs kyi srung ma cher//mkhan slob chos gsum dgongasapa gcig gyur te//bha ta hor gyi yul nas srung ma khyod//spyan drangs bka' bsgos gnyer du ma gtad dam//zab yang lhun grub dpal gyi dbu rtse cher//dbang drag pad+ma drag po'i mthu stobs kyis//pe har mchod lnga bran g.yog 'khor kyi bcas//srog snying blangs shing gzir mnan mdzad min nam//bsam yas mchims phu gsang ba'i phug pa sa/bde gsheṭa kun 'dus sgrub chen bka' brgyad kyi//'jig rten mchod bstod dregs pa'i dkyil 'khor du//dbang bskur dam tshig nye bar ma bsgragasasam//nam snying sangs rgyas ye shes rgyal ba mchog/mkhar chen bza' dang 'brog mi dpal ye shes//dpal seng be+e ro lha yi me rtag sogs//rje 'bangs rnams kyis dam la ma btags sam//nyang ban chos dbang rgod ldem pad+ma dbang //legs ldan rdo rje bkra shis stobs rgyal sogs//zab don gter gyi sgo 'byed tsho gos rnams kyis//yang skyor tshul gyi dam tshig bsgrags min nam//za hor sngagasa'achang dharma pā la'i zhabs//hor rigs kun daX ra ba shākya bzang //ngag dbang bsod nams

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)grags pa la sogs pa'i//spyan sngar khas blangs dam bca' nyer dgongs la//bstan 'gro bde skyid 'joms pa spyi yi dgra//rig 'dzin bdag la 87ba tha sdo ba sgos kyi dgra//steng 'og phyogs mtshams gang du gnas kyang rung //lo zlar ma bzhag snying khrag zhal du gsol//bdun brgyud tshun gyi mi rabasartsad nas cho de//tshe srog bsod nams dpal 'byor kun dang phrol//gzi brjid mnga' thang mthustobs thams cad choms//thal bar rlog la rjes med rlung la skur//bdag sogs bsrung byar gyur pa mtha' dag la//ban bon mthu byad sde brgyad gnod pa dang //nad rigs gdon bgegs dus min 'chi ba sogs//bar chad mi mthun phyogs kun bzlog par mdzod//rdzogs ldan dus bzhin tshe dpal 'byor pa kun//yar ngo'i zla ba lta bur rab 'phel zhing //chos srid 'dod pa'i don kun bsgrub pa la//yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po lta bur mdzod//mdor na dpag bsam yongs 'du sabartol dbang //'dod 'khro'i ba dang bum pa bzang po lngar//bde skyid dga' ston ma lus stsole ba dang //bsams pa lhun gyis grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/chos sku skye med stong pa'i ngang nyid las//yang gsang bla ma'i dkyil 'khor 'ja' ltar shar//'gro kun srid pa'i mtsho las rab bsgral te//skye med chos dbyings4 du badz+ra muḥrten yod na/'dir ni gzug dang sogasakyis brtan bzhugs bya/med na/khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad/zhes sogs kyis gshegasasu gsol lo//bkra shis ni//thugs rje nus mthu'i chu 'dzin h+phu gas pa las//mchog mthun dngosagrub char chen 'bebs mdzad pa'i//bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tsho gos rnams kyis//ba po shis snyan pa'i dbyangs su len par shog/rbad na mthu che dgra bgegs thal bar rlog/bsten na snying nye nyin mas dus drug bsrung //8ni sgo chod na re skong dngos grub char ltar 'bebs//chos skyong rgyal po sde lnga'i bkra shis shog/'phrin las rin chen bum pa bzang po las//bsam pa'i don kun grub pa'i bdud rtsi'i bcud//snying gi yol gor 'khyil ba'i dge legs kyis//phyogs dus kun tu khyab pa'i bkra shis shog/gzhan yang bkra shis pa'i tshigaX/ bcas pa ci rigs par bya'o//sprul pa'i chos

dgas chos srung mdzo rtog tson las rnam tso lhun grub/ 9)rgyal chen po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams mnyes par byed pa'i las byang bskang bstod kyi rim pa bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po zhes bya ba 'di ni thang che'i gtsug lag khang gi srung ma rigs dang brgyud la bsgo ba'i dgra lha chen po gang des bgyis zhes ri mo'i lam nas bskul ba ltar/'phrin las rgyas par spro na las byang le'u brgyad ma sngon du btang /'phrin las don bcu ma nyid bya dgos pas 'dir 'byer bde ba'i dbang du bgyis ste sbyor dngos 'jug gsum tshang bar za hor gyi rigs las sngags ban gang shar rang grol gyis shing lug hor zla bzhi pa'i nyer bdun dmag dpon tha skar gyi 'grub sbyor thog bkod pa'o//na mo gu ru badz+ra pa ṇi ye/dpal ldan gsang ba kun 'dzin 'khor lo'i bdag/phyag na mthu stobs rdo rje rab 'bar ba//gtum chen mig sman mdangs 'dzin gar dgu'i nyams//skur mdzad khro bo'i dbang pos rtag tu skyongs//rab 'byams rgyal kun ngo bo pad+ma 'byung //zab gter chos kyi bka' babs las 'brel rtsal//man ngag gdam pa'i mdzod 'dzin dbang po'i sde//rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tsho gos rnams phyag gi yul//ma rungs dgra bgegs srog la rngams pa'i kha//gnam sa lta bur gdangs pa'i srin bu'i gzugs//srid gsum cig car blta ba'i mig stong can//kwa ye khyab 'jug bstan srung sbu gri'i mtshon//bsten na snying nye dam tshig 847 mi 'da'//bod na rdo rje'i brag kyang phyer 'thag pa'i //chos skyong za bdud nag po ra hu la//dgyes skyed 'phrin las tshangs pa'i sgra dbyangs can//sor mo'i skul byed rtsol bar ma bltos shing //sna tsho gos rgyud mang 'phrul dang mi ldan par//nam yang 'jigs pa med pa'i dbyangs kyi sgra//ri mo gsum pa'i lam nas deng 'dir sgrog/phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod rdzas spyan gzigs sogs mthong brgyud kyi phyag len ltar bshams//skyabasa'agro ni/bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can ma lus pa/bslu med dkon mchog gsum 0skyabs su mchi//sangs rgyas sgrub la bar gcod dgra bgegs rnams//bsgral phyir khyab 'jug chen po mchod par bya//bdag skyed ni/chos rnams mi dmigs stong ba'i ngang nyid las//pad+ma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i gdan steng du//hūṃ las bdag nyid gtum bo rab ༷sa pa//g.yas pa rdo rje rtse lnga mkha' la 'phyar//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)g.yon pa sdigs 'dzub rtse las bya khyung 'gyed/ /dur khrod chas brgyan me dpung dbus na bzhugs/ /thugs gar nyi steng rdo rje'i lte ba la/ /hūṃ yig sngags kyi phreng bas bskor bar gyur/ /oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā roṣa na/ phaṭaḥgha ru ḍa tsa le tsa le hūṃ phaṭa zhesa'adzab ci nus su bzla/ mchod gtor rnams byin gyis brlab pa ni/ sman rag gtor gsum sogs mchod rdzas rnams kyi ma dag pa'i tsho gos rang gi thugs ka'i sabon las byung ba'i raṃ las ye shes kyi mes bsregs/ yaṃ las chos nyid kyi rlung gis gtore/ kho lasamatshan med kyi chus bkrus/ ma lha gis bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ rma lha sngo rten bskyed pa ni badz+ra a mri tas bsangs/ sarba was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi nam mkhar srung ba'i 'khor lo nang khrag gi rgya mtsho ga thug pa'i dbus su chos (yon po khyung gru gsum mthing nag gi lte bar pad+ma nyi zla dgra bgegs kyi steng du tri dud kha yongs su gyur pa las gza' bdud rā hu la sku mdog dud kha srin po'i mgo dgu bya rog gi mgo dang bcur yod pa phyag dang po gnyis kyis chu srin gyi rgyal mtshan ral gri'i yu ba can dang sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis mda' gzhu 'geng ba/ smad sbrul mjug tu 'khyil ba/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang sku la spyan stong gis mdzes pa/ /thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ mi pags gi g.yang gzhi/ stag lhags gi sham thab can/ dar nag gi stod g.yog gsol ba/ sbrul dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ gar dgu'i nyams ldan ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs pa/ de'i 'khor du yab rdo rje srin po yum rdo rje glog 'gyu/ nang gi gza' chen brgyad/ gdong mo bzhi/ phyi'i gza' chen brgyad/ klu chen brgyad/ phyogs skyong bcu/ rgyu skar nyer brgyad/ nag po stong / sha za 'bum/ ma mo bye ba/ lha dmag dung phyur sogs lha srin ldebargyad kyi dmag tsho gis kyis bskor bar gyur/ gtso bo'i thugs khar o rgyan pad+ma mtshon gang ba/ de'i thugasagar ye shes kyi rā hu la sku mdog dkar po phyag gnyis thal mo sbyar ba/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ gyis mtshan pa/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas gza' bdud 'khor deng bcas pa rtsa brgyud bla ma'i dam tshig dran pa tsam gyis thogs pa —210

dam can chos srung ma' rtogs mun las rnam sto lhun grub/ (gemed par gnas 'dir badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥlhaḥ shag tu ga raṃ na ge tsit+ta khri/ ma ma yong za 'gram/ ha hi yo ke she la dza'aḥ badz+ra sa ma dzaḥdzaḥ spyan 'dren pa ni/ lhaḥ sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba'i mthu rtsal can/ /lha srin sdo brgyad kun gyi dmag dpon che/ khyab 'jug nag po gza' bdud (〈ba'i hu la/ /'khor bcas gnas 'dir thogs med gshegs su gsol/ /mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i gzhal yas nas/ /gza' mchog rgyal po sprul pa yang sprul sogs/ /thog ser skyin thang 'bebs pa'i mthu rtsal can/ khrag po'i 'phrin las sgrub phyir gshegs su gsol/ /rin chen snying po shā kya thub pa dang / /pad+ma 'byung gnas tshul khrims rdo rje sogs/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i dam tshig nyer dgongs la/ /thogs pa med par gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ rā hu la gha sna ā la ya hūṃ dzaḥ bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ lha: mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus/ /pad+ma nyi zla dgra bgegs brtsegs pa'i steng / /lha chen khyab 'jug nag po 'khor bcas rnams/ /dgyes par bzhugs la dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /rā hu la sam ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ phyag 'tshal ba ni/ lhaḥ ri rab lhun po lta bur brjid pa'i sku/ /nyi ma stong gi gzi 'od ltar 'bar ba/ /snang srid dregs pa'i sdod pon rā hu la/ /yab yum srasa'akhor bas sa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rā hu la a ti pu ho pra ti dzaḥsngo sman ma rdzo 'bul ba ni/ lhaḥ rtsab brgyad dang yan lag stong sbyar ba'i/ /bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa dam pa 'di/ /lha wo khyab 'jug 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol/ rā hu la sarba pañtsa a mri ta khā gyi yo bā sha mi ki du ru ma shi gi dza la ti a dzi te swāhā tshal pa ni rā hu la swāhā ā tra ta kra snya ra ṇa da sha shabha hūṃ phaṭaḥ rak+ta 'bul ba ni/ lhaḥ dmar nag rba klong zhabrug pa khrag gi mtsho/ /rak+ta dmar gyi a r+ghaṃ chen po 'di/ /lha chen khyab ྾/ /dam nyams dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i las mdzod cig /rā hu la mahā rak+ta kha raṃ khā gyi gtore ma 'bul ba ni/ lhaḥ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga sogs sbyar ba yi/ /(90na bom rdzas brgyan dang ldan pa'i gtor ma 'di/ /lha chen ྾/ /dam nyams dgra la thog dang ser ba phob/ /oṃ ke ta ke ta swā lha ma hā ba le ta 'a gyi dus gar sogs kyi tshe/ bskang ba ni/—211—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)lhaḥ dngos bshams yid sprul mchod pa'i tshogs/ /sa dang bar snang ma lus rab bkang nas/ /gza' bdud nag po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /thuṭa dam skongs la dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /chu skyes sna tshogs dbang po'i me tog dang / /snyan pa'i glu dbyangs rol mo gar dang 'chams/ /gsur chen ra tshil spos dkar dud sprin 'khrig ga chen spungs pa'i zhal zas dam pa 'dis/ lha chen khyab 'jug chen po'i thugs dam bskang / bza' brgyad gdong mo bzhi yi thugs dam bskang / /dregs pa lha srin sde brgyad thugs dam bskang / /thugs dam skongs la 'phrin las ma lus sgrubs/ stu1 ka gcig pu 'di 'og ma kun la riṭa 'gre/ /rtag gtor rgyun gtor dus gtor thun gtor dang / /thod mkhar gzhal yas nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan/ /don snying nang khrol dmar po rnam pa lnga/ /tshil chen snang gsal dza gad gser skyems gyis/ /〉rta g.yag ra skyes khams pa bya khyi sogs/ /sa la 'dzul dgu gnam la 'phur dgu dang / /sra ba'i go cha rno ba'i mtshon cha'i tshogs/ /'phan gdugs bla dre ba dan rgyal mtshan gyis/ /྾mdos nag nam mkha' rgyud du mda' 'phang can/ /bla rdo srog 'khor bstan pa'i dam rdzas dang / /hom khung liṅga thun dang gri phur mtshon/ /zhwa nag phod ka drag po'i chos rnams kyis/ /྾/bkra shis rtagasabargyad rgyal srid rin chen bdun/ /'dod yon lnga dang lhun po gling bzhir bcas/ /sman sna stong dang rin chen rnam pa lnga/ /bza' dang gas ba tsho gos kyi 'khor lo yis/྾/bstod pa ni/ lhaḥ rab mdzesamachong smug brtseg pa'i lhun po la/ /bskal pa'i me dpung stong gi gos gyon pa/ /drag rtsal thog med khyab 'jug rā hu la/ /bstan pa srung ba'i dbang po khyod la bstod/ /rang 'dra'i gzugs can mthu stobs nus pa'i bdag /dus gnyan rgyu ba'i gza' chen rnam pa brgyad/ /phyogs bzhi skyong ba'i gdong mo bzhi la sogs/ /yab yum sras 'khor bcas pa rnams la bstod/ /nyi zla la sogs gza' dang rgyu skar dang / /lha klu phyogs skyong lha srin sdebargyad tshogs/ sha za khrag 'thung dbugs sdud cho 'phrul can/ /bka' nyan las byed pho nya rnams la bstod/ /bskul zhing 'phrin las bco pa ba ni/ lha: lha chen khyab 'jug nag po dbu dgu pa/ /mgo brgyad gza' chen brgyad kyi ngo bo ste/ /gri rgod nad ser zhabrug —212

dam can chos srung mngon rtogs wen las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ (gegasod lha srin gyis/ /gi gang chen po snang ba'i dgra la 'bebs/ /mgo gcig bya rog mgo bo brtsegs pa yis/ /mu ge nad yams ki dang dgra la 'bebs/ /drag rtsal gi dang dbab pa'i dus la bab/ /mthun rdzas 'di bzhes bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /phyogs mtshams 'gro zhing dus brgyad rgyu ba yi/ /'jig rten khams kun 'phung byed mthu rtsal can/ /khyab 'jug chen po sprul pa rnam brgyad kyis/ /mthun rdzas sko/ /nam mkha'i mthong las gnam lcags thog ser gyis/ /dam nyams dgra bgegs 'phung byed mthu rtsal can/ /gdong mo mched bzhi 'khor tsho gis rgya mtsho yis/ /mthun rdzas mo//gza' bdud nag po 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis/ /sangs rgyas rin cen snying po shākya thub/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang slob dpon pad+ma 'byung / /ye shes 'tsho rgyal lha lcam pad+ma gsal/ /gter ston chen po pad+ma las 'brel rtsal/ /lo ston rdor 'bum bla ma grags 'od dang / /rdo rje rgyal po dharma ke tu'i zhabs/ /chos kyi blo gros nam mkha' dpal ldan rje/ /mnga' ris rigs 'dzin legs ldan rdo rje'i zhabs/ /chos rgyal (91na bkra shis stobs rgyal dbang po'i sde/ /sprul sku rigs 'dzin ngag dbang rdo rje'i dpal/ /mkhyen brtse nus ldan rje btsun pad+ma dbang / /bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs/ /gzhan yang klu dbang bsrung sogs 'khon rigs kyi/ /sngags 'chang rim byon gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin pa/ /bya nag gdung gsob bla ma rin cen 'od/ /brgyud par bcas pa'i dam tshig rab dgongs pa/ /sangasargyas bstan srung 'gro ba'i bde skyid spel/ /nad gdon dgra bgegs bar chad ma lus thul/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i las kun thogs med sgrubs/ /khyad par bya nag nor 'dzin skyong ba yi/ /tshe dpal bsod nams mnga' thang rgyas pa dang / /snang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs rnams thul/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las lhun grub mdzod/ /gsang ba gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ lhaḥ dgongs shig chosaskyong za bdud nag po khyod/ /kun bzang he ru ka dang ro gcig kyang / /'jig rten tshul 'dzin sdebargyad dmag dpon mchog /rigs 'dzin bdag cag srung skyob 'phrin las mdzod/ /zhi ba'i mdangs ldan rgyas pa'i byin chags shing / /dbang gi rtsal mnga' drag po'i las myur ba'i/ /bstan pa srung ba'i dbang po —213—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)chen po khyod/ /sgrub pa'i stan la brtan par bzhugs nas kyang / /bdag sogs bdud bzhi'i 'jigasapa kun las skyobs/ /sa dang lam la 'khrid pa'i bsu ma mdzod/ /mdor na bla med byang chub ma thob bar/ /mgon skyabs dpung gnyen dam pa mdzad du gsol/ /rgya dus sogs la thun gtor brdeg pa'am/ /glo bur du las bcol zhing drag tu bskul na/ /lhaḥ zab gter bstan srung khyab 'jug rā hu la/ /'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam dus la (91bathab/ /dar nag g.yab cing mi rkang gling bu 'bud/ /lha khyod bos pa'i tshe na snyan ma sra/ /sman rag mchod gtor mdos dang bla rdor bcas/ /lha khyod bsten pa'i tshe na rgyang ma ring / /mnan bsreg 'phang sogs drag po'i las sbyor gyis/ /lha khyod rbad pa'i tshe na mthu ma chung / /thugs dam bskul lo khyab 'jug rā hu la/ /mthong reg kha rlangs dug bse dgra bo rnams/ kha mig ltag pa'i rgyab tu skyal nas shog /spyo 'bog rengs dang zha sa kums gzer nad dang / /dmar bshal 'byu skyug dmu bor skya rbab thong / khyo dang wo ma bu sring nye du dang / /rta nor phyugs dang bran g.yog ma lus gsod/ /bsod nams mnga' thang longs spyod thams cad gtor/ /thog gis khang khyim ser bas lo tog choms/ /gnam gyi 'ju thag sa yi brten 'phur phyungs/ /rang bzhin las kyi shi la khungs ma 'byin/ /srung ma khyod dang rigs 'dzin bdag cag gnyis/ khyad du gsod pa'i dam nyams dgra bo 'di/ /lo zlar ma bzhag snying khrag zhal du gsol/ /thugs dam dus la bab bo sam ya/ /rmi les nyuḥ ka ta ke ta rā hu la sam ya mā ra ya rbad dzaḥ 'di gnyan pas gal chen ma gtogs mi bya/ /thun gtor 'bul ni/ sman rag sbran/ dpal 'bar btsugs/ lhaḥ sngon tshe si rgya rgya mtsho'i mtsho gling du/ /slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ /dam la btags pa'i za bdud 'khor bcas rnams/ /gtor ma 'di long bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /yar stod sham bo gangs kyi rab sakumā ra dzo klong chen rab 'byams kyis/ /dmal ྾/ /gtor ma ྾/ /bya yul yang rtse'i gtsug lag khang chen du/ /sngags 'chang a mi bya nag chen po yi/ /dam la ྾/ /gtor ma ྾/ /zhes gtore ma gtsang sar (92na sbal/ btang rag ni/ lhaḥ bdud rtsi sman dang dmar chen rak+ta'i mtsho/ /dmar chen gtor —214

dam ༅ chos srung ma' rtogs wen las rnam pha lhun grub/ 9)ma phyi nang mchod pa'i tshogs//gza' bdud rgyal po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul//bzhes nas dngosagrub ma lus stsal du gsol//nongs pa bzod par gsol ba ni//bdag cag ma rig rmonges pa'i dbang gyur te//'phrin las chad lhag dam rdzas nyams pa sogs//ma dag 'khrul pa'i tsho gis rnams ci mchis pa//snying nas bshags so tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol//rten yod na brten par bzhugs su gsol ba ni/bris 'bur sku gzugs bla rdo srog 'khor sogs//rten la nam yang mi 'da' brtan par bzhugs//bzhugs nas bdag sogs 'khor dang bcas rnams kyi//bsam pa'i don kun lhun gyis grub par mdzod//rten med na gshegs su gsol ba ni/chos skyong gza' bdud 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis//'phrin las rnam bzhi'i dngos grub ma lus stsol//ye shes rang bzhin gnas su gshegs nas kyang //slar yang gsol ba ji bzhin 'byon par mdzod/badz+ra muḥb po shis ni/rgya mtsho'i rlung ltar thugs rje yol med can//rtsa rgyud bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis sho/dpag bsam shing ltar dngos grub byu 'bebs pa'i//yi dam rdo rje gas tsho bkra shis shog/rdo rje'i thog ltar mthu stobs 'phrin las can//chos skyong khyab 'jug chen po'i bkra shis shog/phun sum tsho gos pa'i dge legs rgya mtsho'i dbyangs//phyogs dus kun tu khyab pa'i bkra shis shog/'di ni rgyun 'byer gyi dbang du byas pa yin la//rgyas par 'dod na gter gzhung ṣ+ka nyams su blangs bar bya'o//smras pa/zab gter ma la ya yi dga' tshal nas//92bsnam par dpyod pa'i bser bus legs skul bas/lasabyang lis yi don rgyas dri bsung can//log 'dren tsha gdung 'joms pa'i byed po bzhi//pad+ma'i ring lugs gangs kyi ri bo las//legs bshad chad pa med pa chu bo'i rgyun//blo gros ge la sha yi bcus pa chab//skal bzang rigs 'dzin dga' ston ched du sbreng /shar gter rin chen 'brasabazang smin pa'i bcud//longs su spyad mkhas byang pa rigs 'dzin rje'i//mnan ngag ro brgya'i dpal la dbang 'byor ba'i//za hor ban+de gang shar rang grol gyis//'dab bzang dbang po'i rigs las bya nag gdung //bza' bdud bran ltar gsol ba'i sngags rigs brgyad//lho phyogs nor 'dzin

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)skyong de'i rgyun khyer du/ /nyams len tshig nyung don rgyas yi ger bkod/ /dge des 'khor bar 'phen byed nyon mongs dang / /tshe 'dir log par 'khu ba'i dgra bgegs tshogos/ /ma lus ka dag dbyingasasu bsgral byas nas/ /rang gzhan don gnyis ma lusahrūb par shog /chos skyong gza' bdud chen po rā hu la'i/ /las byang bskang gso drag skul rnams phyogs gcig tu tshig sbyor gsar du bsgrig pa zhig dgos zhes/ bya khri dpon rgyal po bkra shis kyis bskul ba la brten nas/ las byang tshangs pa'i sgra dbyangs zhes pa 'di ni za hor gyi sngags btsun ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos dga' ldan pho brang du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs dpal bzang ngo / /lha chen 'phyos lha bka' sdod dang bcas pa gsol ba la/ /bla ma'i las byang rgyas bsdus gang yang rung bas gzhung bsrang / sman rag gtor gsum las byang gi nang bzhin byin gyis rlabs pa dang /bskang rdzas rnams sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis mang por spel te 'di skad do/ /swo/ 'dzam bu'i gling na che ba'i rigs sngags 43na)kyi/ /brtul bzhugs grub pa'i dbang po pad+ma 'byung / /brgyud par bcas pa'i dam tshig nyer dgongs la/ /lha chen 'phyos lha dkon pa gnas 'dir gshegs/ /mdun du ting 'dzin pir gyis nyer bris pa'i/ /be+eḍūr pad raka mar gad mu tig sogs/ /lha mi'i rin cen phra yisabakod mdzes can/ /gser gyi khang bzang rgya phubs ldan pa'i dbus/ /rab dkar lha chen khro chagasasgeg pa'i nyams/ /dar dkar thod dang gos gyon thuṭa ka na/ /dzam+bha'i gser sbyangs zhun ma'i ga'u la/ /drug dmar g.yu yi pad 'dab rnam par spungs/ /sa yi zla ba las grub ska rags la/ /nor bu'i lan tshar g.yo bas ci yang mdzes/ /sna mang rin cen du ma'i rgyan spras pa/ /rmugs 'dzin dbang po'i gzi brjid dag la 'gran/ /phyag g.yas sba lcag dkar po mkha' la 'phyar/ /g.yon pa nor bus gang ba'i gzhed pa 'dzin/ /rin cen sga srab mdzes pa'i rta dkar steng / /sag lham dang bcas 'gying ba'i tshul gyisazhen/ /pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la legs bzhugs nas/ /sprul pa yang sprul bye ba'i tsho gos rnams kun/ /dbyar gyi char sprin lta bur yongs 'khrigs te/ /med byung mchod pa'i zhing 'dir dgyes par mdzod/ /—216

dam can chos srung mag rtogs tshwan las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)swo/khyad par lha mchog khyod kyi bka' stod gtso//mthu ldan bshan pa lag dmar rdzong btsan pa//khro gtum rngams zhal dmar smug dbang gi mdog/lhag lhag gsal 'char bse khrab brtse rmog gyon//mdung dmar 'debs shing zhags pa dgra la 'phen//zhabs gnyis sag lham dmar po gsol ba yis//sga srab ldan pa'i rta mchog sngon por bcibs//tshur spyon tshur spyon dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhuṭa//ā+oṃ//lo 93bsad bdud rtsi'i gan ldan a mṛ ta//dkar dmar dam rdzas gtore ma ri ltar spungs//rin cen gser g.yu brdar ba'i zhal skyems 'dis//lha mchog 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang //nad sel sman phud rin cen snod du gtams//dar tshon sna lnga'i g.yab dar 'ja' bzhin bkra//rgya ja'i btung ba rgya mtsho ltar bskyil bas//lha mchog 'khor dang bcas pa'i ྾//dngar gsum bcud kyi ro ldan mchod yon dang //pad dkar ku mud la sogs me tog tshogs//ljon shing dri bzang bsregs pa'i dud pa'i sprin//lha mchog ྾//nyi zla nor bu rtsi bca sgron me sbar//ga pur gur kum ngad ldan dri chab 'khrug/ro brgya'i dpal 'dzin lha mi'i zhal zas kyis//lha mchog ྾//sil snyan gling bu dung sogs rol mo'i sgra//gzugs mdzes gar bsgyur snyan pa'i li wang brdung //dri ldan dung chos bza' dang bca' ba sbreng //dar dang za 'og lhab lhub na bza' yis//lha mchog ྾//gser gyi 'bor lo 'dod 'jo yid bawo nor//bde ster btsun mo dpa' mdzangs blon po'i tshogs//glang wo rta mchog dpa' bo ya lad can//lha mchog ྾//rin cen tog mdzes gdugs dang gser gyi nya//bum bzang pad+ma g.yas su 'khyil ba'i dung //dpal gyi be'u rgyal mtshan 'khor lo yis//lha mchog ྾//rlung gi shugs 'chang cang shes sga srab spras//rdo rje'i rwa ldan 'brong g.yag zhol mo'i tshogs//ra lug 'phur lding g.yo ba'i bya tshogs kyis//lha mchog ྾//stag gzig ce spyang khyi sogs 'dur zhing rgyug/sra btsan khrab rmog zhol btags 'ja' ris can//ral gri mda' mdung ru mtshon bsgreng ba yis//lha mchog ྾/khrag 94na8 a lha dbang po sna lnga spungs//gsur chen dud pa tshil chen mar me dang //sha rus zhal zas rkang gling rol mo yis//btsan /da drag po'i dmag tshogs thugs dam bskang //

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)mdor na zhi rgyas dbang drag dang 'tsham par/ /dbang po sgo lnga dgyes pa bskyed nus pa'i/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho yis/ /btsan rgod drag po'i dmag tsho gis thugs dam bskang / /lha: de ltar thugs dam gnyan po legs bskang bas/ /bdag sogs rgyu sbyor yon bdag bcas pa yis ma rig dbang gis thugs dang ci 'gal ba/ /thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ /lhaḥ zhi khro'i nyams kyi rnam 'gyur cir yang ston/ /rin cen rgyan dang dar gyi na bzas klubs/ /rta mchog zhon nas stong gsum skad cig myul/ /je bo lha chen dkon pa khyod la bstod/ /bka' sdod chen po btsan rgod 'bar ba'i gtso/ /mdog dmar kha gdangs dgra la 'o dod 'bod/ /bdud sde las rgyal ba dan mkha' la bsgreng / /gnod sbyin srog gi bshan pa khyod la bstod/ /mdzes brjid chags dang drag po'i rnam 'gyur sogs/ /bgrang yas sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rol gar gyis/ /sna tshogs 'phrin las ma lus sgrub mdzad pa'i/ /bka' sdod srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas la bstod/ /rgyal ba kun dngos pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ /bka' btags rdo rje'i phyag rgya spyi bor bzhag /rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi lce la blug /dam tshig phog pa ma g.yel deng 'dir dgongs/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i bde skyid la 'tshe ba'i/ /nag po bdud kyi ris gyur dgra dang bgegs/ /steng 'og phyogs mtshams bar gsum gar gnas kyang / /da lta nyid du sgrol ba'i dus(94bsgo bab/ /rab khros sku la nor bu'i go khrab gsol/ /phyag na mdung rnon ba dan g.yo ba 'dzin/ /srid gsum 'byung ba'i dmag gi dpung tshogs dang / /lhan cig rgyu ba'i rju'aphrul ston par mdzod/ /stong gsum blta ba'i mig gis lus kun gang / /thog dang ser ba'i sne khrid bar snang kun/ /bco dmar me yi phung pos khyab mdzad pa'i/ /ma ro zhe sum gsal ba'i cho 'phrul ston par mdzod/ /lha chen btsan rgod gnyan po 'khor bcas rnams/ /rab khros drag shul chen po'i dpung tsho gis kyis/ /nag po bdud kyi ru mtshon sa la stol/ /dkar phyogs rgyal ba'i rdza rnga srid rtser rdungs/ /lhaḥ dgyes zhal ston zla bzhin du rab gsal zhing / /nyin byed 'bum gyi gzi brjid ltar 'bar ba'i/ /ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho'i rnam rol gyis/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde spel bar mdzod/ khyad —218

dam can chos srung ma' rtogs wen las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)par gangs kyi ra ba'i khor yug dbus/ /dge bcu kun tshang yar klungs 'dzin ma'i gzhi'i/ /bye brag 'phyos lung yul gru'i skye rgu rnams/ /bde skyid phun tshogs dpal la 'god par mdzod/ /sngon bsags legs byas stong gi rgyal mtshan rtser/ /srid zhi'i dpal 'byor yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal/ /dge legs 'dod dgu'i char gyis kha ba'i ljongs/ /kun khyab bsams don lhun gyis grub par shog /ces jo bo 'phyos lha dkon pa dang / bshan pa grib btsan pa gnyis kyi gsol mchod 'di ni btsan rgod nyid kyis bskul ba la brten nas za hor gyi bzhes pho brang po ta lar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dpal lo/ /bla ma'i las byang mchod gtor byin rlabs sogs sngon du 'gro bas/ hūṃ/ rgyal ba kun gyi mthu stobs ma lus pa/ /rdzus skyes sprul pa'i gar mkhan pad+ma 'byung / /(95na cun sangs rgyas gnyisapa'i dge bsnyen che/ /tshangs pa dung gi thor tshuṭa gnas 'dir gshegs/ /snyan pa'i dbyangs dang brjid ldan rol mo'i sgra/ /mchod gtor mdos dang phyi nang gsang ba'i rten/ /lha khyod bsten pa'i rdzas su bshams lags na/ /mdzes zhal zla ba lta bur ngom zhing gshegs/ /tshur spyon tshur spyon ting 'dzin gyis sprul pa'i/ /rin cen lnga las grub pa'i pho brang dbus/ /pad+ma nyi zla rta mchog ngang dkar steng / /'gying bag rol pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs su gsol/ /rnyog bral mchod yon me rtag sna tshogs bkra/ /sman spos dud sprin mar me'i 'phreng ba 'khrigs/ /dri chab ro brgya'i zas dang pi wang sgrog /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'dod yon lngas/ /lha chen tshangs pa yum sras blon por bcas/ /sprul pa yang sprul bye ba'i tsho gos rnams kyi/ /thugs dam bskang ngo bstan 'gro'i bde skyid spel/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las ma lus sgrubs/ /bdud rtsi sman mchod dmar chen gtor ma dang / khrag gi arnya dbang po sna lnga spungs/ sha chen gsur dud tshil chen mar me sbar/ /mkhris pa'i dri chab sha rus zhal zas kyis/ /lha chen tshangs pa sogs glo ka gcig po 'gre ྾/ /dar dkar gos thod sna tsho gos rin cen rgyan/ /sra brtan khrab rmog rnga zhol 'ja' ltar bkra/ /mda' mdung ral gri dgra sta zhags pa dang / /spyang ki rgod sprel byi la'i rgyal mtshan gyis rki/ /rdza rnga dung chen sil snyan 'brug ltar sgrog /rin cen gser g.yu brdar —219

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)ba'i zhal skyems dang / /rta dkar g.yag rgod ra lug bya dang khyi/ /ce spyang stag gzig dom dred la sogs pas za/ /mon pa dzo ki spre'u 'bag seng dang / /dar 'phan bla bre lda ldi ru (95ba bor g.yo/ /gdugs mdzes gser nya bum pa pad+ma bzang / /dung dkar dpal be'u rgyal mtshan 'khor lo yis mo/ /rgyal srid sna bdun nye ba'i rin cen bdun/ /bkra shis rdzas brgyad gling bzhi gling phran dang / /nyi zla ri rab lha mi'i 'dod yon sogs/ /nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo phye mchod sprin gyis ྾/ /gangs kyi ri bo zla ba zhun ma yis/ /lan brgyar byugs pa'i mdzes sdug yid 'ong la/ khro chags zhi ba'i rnam 'gyur ston mdzad pa'i/ /lha chen tshangs pa chen po khyod la bstod/ /res 'ga' dmar zlum spyan bgrad am gtsigs bsdams/ /btsan po'i go gyon rnon po'i mtshon thogs nas/ /srog bdag btsan rgod chen po'i rnam rol gyis/ /sna tshogs sprul pa'i gar mkhan khyod la bstod/ /sa 'og sa steng sa bla ma lus par/ /rnam 'gyur cir yang ston pa'i rdzu 'phrul can/ /gsang yum blon po sprul pa yang sprul sogs/ /'khor tshogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tshoṭa la bstod/ /skyon slob dpon pad+ma thod phreng gis/ /sgrub pa bka' brgyad lha yi dkyil 'khor du/ /dbang bskur sangs rgyas bstan pa'i srung ma sa /mnga' gsol gzengasabastod lha yi dge bsnyen khyod/ /dgra bgegs 'dul la gnam lcags rdo rje'i thog /re ba skong la dpag bsam ljon pa'i shing / /nad brgya 'joms la sman mchog rnam par rgyal/ /'chi med stsol la bdud rtsi'i bum pa bzang / /gdung ba'i yid kyis thugs dam rgyud bskul na/ /lung rtogs bstan pa dbyar gyi mtsho ltar rgyas/ /'gro kun bde zhing skyid pa'i dpal la sbyor/ /sa spyod rgyal po'i mnga' thang chab srid spel/ /bdag sogs 'khor bcas bsams don lhun grub mdzod/ /gangs can lha gcig srong btsan skyes lha che/ /zhes sogs blo ka (96na gsum po'i mthar/ mdor na phan bde'i rtsa lag thub pa'i bstan/ /spyi dang khyad par mnyam med btsong kha pa'i/ /chos srid nyi zla'i 'od kyis 'jig rten kun/ /phan bde'i snang bas khyab pa'i bkra shis shog /tshangs pa dung gi thor tshugs can la 'phrin yig gsol ba'i nang gi gnyer gtad blo ka gsum po dang bcas pa'i gsol mchod cig dgos zhes —220

dam can chos srung mngon rtogs 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)tsher gseb bla ma blo bzang 'jam dbyangs rgya mtshos bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dpal lo// //dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs/ /mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lor rnam rol ba/ /srid pa gsum na che ba'i rigs sngags 'chang / /skyon sangs rgyas gnyis pas byin phob cig /don dam spros dang bral ba'i dbyings nyid la/ /kun rdzob sgyu 'phrul 'ja' tshon ltar bkra ba'i/ /mchong smug dung dang gser sbyangs byu ru g.yu'i/ /rin cen lnga las grub pa'i gzhal med khang / /lta na nyer sdug lha yi pho brang la/ /rngam brjid srin po'i grong khyer dang mtshudas nas/ /dbus phyogs thugs kyi rgyal po brgya byin che/ shar phyogs sku yi rgyal po pu tra nag /lho phyogs yon tan rgyal po shing bya can/ zhub phyogasagasung gi rgyal po dgra lha skyes/ /byang phyogs 'phrin las rgyal po mi bo che/ /kun kyang gsang yum sprul pa blon po dang / /rngam brjid gos dang rgyan cha bzhon par bcas/ /sna bzung rol khrid sprul pa'i pho nya 'gyed/ sha grol gyi grol 'dzin sdom 'bag seng dang / /mon bu nag po spre'u a tsa ra/ /ru 'dren sdebazhi snang srid dregs pa'i 'khor/ /sa gzhi bar snang gang ba'i tshogs rnams kun/ /tshur gshegs ting 'dzin gyis sprul dkyil (96bskor bor du/ /pad nyi dgra bgegs gdan la brtan par bzhugs//khyad par shar phyogs sku yi rgyal po'i blon/ bya khrid mig gcig gcer bu sprul thod can/ /rta sngon la bcibs shel gyi rdo rje 'phen/ /'dir spyon dgyes pa'i gdan la brtan par bzhugs/ /mthu stobasanus pa mnga' ba'i drag rtsal can/ /'jig rten dregs pa'i sdod pon pe hā ra/ /gnod sbyin rgyal po sdelnga blon por bcas/ /sprul pa yang sprul tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnal 'byor bdag dang lha khyod dam tshig bsre/ /bdag gis rtag tu rgyal chen thugs dam bskong / /skyes mchogo khyod kyis bdag gi stong grogs mdzod/ /dpal chen khrag 'thung gzu dang dpang por bzhugs/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i sman mchod bhan+ta ra gtams/ /'bru bcud stong sbyar dza gad mtsho ltar bskyil/ /phun tshogs rgya ja rab dkar snod du 'khyil/ /grangs med bcud ldan btung ba'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /sprul pa'i chos rgyal sku lnga —221

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho gsung 'bum/ 64)'khor bcas dang / khyad par bshan pa bya khrid mig gcig pa/ /gsol lo mchod do bdag sogasa'akhor bcas kyi/ /'gal rkyen kun sel bsam don lhun grub mdzod/ /dam rdzas dmar chen gtor ma ri ltar spungs/ /ro brgya'i g.yang chags lha bsgos rgyan dang ldan/ /seng ge glang wo rta khyung rma bya'i sha /shing 'bras dngar gsum 'bru sogs bza' bca' yis/ /sprul pa'i chos rgyal sogs glo ka gcig po 'gre ྾/ /dri bzang sman gyis sbags pa'i mchod yon dang / /dmar wo a rak+ta'i lha 'phreng 'khrigs/ /dag byed khrus kyi zhabs bsil rnam par sbreng / khrag zhag ga bur dri chab legs bshams pas mo/ /puṇ+ḍa ri ka u ltal dkar dmar sogs/ /(97na'i skyes sna tsho gos bkra ba'i chun po dang / /don snying mig gos rna ba sna lce yi/ /dbang po lnga yi me rtag tsho gis rnams kyis ྾/ /spos dkar sman sna tsan+dan a ka sa khug pa ba lu 'khan pa stag pa sogs/ /dri bzang sna tshogs bsregs pa'i bsangs mchode dang / sha chen gsur gyi dud pa'i sprin phung gis ྾/ /mun pa'i gdung sel nyi zla'i 'od snang dang / /bkrag mdangs rab 'bar phun rdzos nor bu'i dpya/ /rtsi gan tso mar tshil r+pā las sbyar ba'i/ /mar me'i phreng ba skar tsho gos ltar bkra bas mo/ /snyan 'gyur 'degs 'jog rngamasabarjid gyer dbyangs dang / /sil snyan rdza rnga dung wo gling bu'i sgra/ /skyes bu bud med dga' ba'i glu len cing / /rnam 'gyur rtsed 'jo'i zlos gar ji snyed pas ྾/ /mi dkar rgyan ldan ra dkar sga srab ldan/ /bya dkar lding zhing khyi dkar 'khang zhing zug /'jam mnyen spu tsho gos sul ba'i lug dkar dang / zhal gong ltar gsal ra dkar tsho gis rnams kyis ྾/ /khrab rmog zhol btags phub sogs sra ba'i go /mda' mdung ral gri dgra sta lcags kyu dang / /sbu gri be con zhags pa dam zhing sogs/ /ji snyed mtshon cha phyag mtshan sna tsho gos kyis mo/ /tse ber zhwa phod sag theb dar zab gos/ /snam sbyar mthang gos lhung bzed gseg /li/ /'khar gsil nga glang stag pags pa'i gos/ /g.yang gzhi rusapa rin cen sprul a gyis ྾/ /rab 'jigs rgya stag rtsal wo spre'u dang / /lding byed bya rgod za byed spyang zhi'i pags/ kha dog rnam par bkra ba'i za 'og las/ grub pa'i rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan —222

dam can chos srung mngon rtogs lon las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 8)'di ྾/ /mdor na lha dang mi yi nyer spyad dang / lha srin (97bathags pa dga' ba'i mthun rdzasasogs/ /dngos bshams yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa'i tshogs/ /mi 'dzad nam mkha' mdzod du byin brlabs pas mo/ /de ltar pe har cho ge rgyal sku lnga po/ /sprul pa yang sprul bka' nyan mngag gzhug bcas/ khyad par blon po bya khrid mig gcig pa/ /'khor dang bcas pa bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /ma rig dbang gis mchode rdzas nyams shing 'bags/ /ting 'dzin mi gsal chad lhag nongs pa kun/ /rmi lam sgyu ma'i rol pa ji bzhin du/ /rang bzhin gdod nas
