stong pa'i dbyings su bshags/ /chosaskyong dgra lha'i rgyal po 'khor bcas kyis/ /sangs rgyas bstan srungs 'gro ba'i bde skyid spel/ /bdag sogs gzhi lam byes gsum gang du yang / /mgon skyabs dpung gnyen mdzod la bsams don sgrubs/ /mdor na skyon pad+ma thod phreng dang / /'gro mgon mnga' bdag yab sras la sogs pa'i/ /rigs 'dzin brgyud pa'i dam las ma 'da' bar/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las ma lus sgrub par mdzod/ /ces rgyal po sku lnga gtso bo brtan pa la sku'i rgyal po mon bu pu tra'i blon po'i sger gsol yod pa zhig dgos zhes gra ar dge nas bya khrid mig gcig par grags pas bskul ba la brten nas 'phrin las don bcu ma'i kha skong du phan par bsams te za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin no/ /gter srung ldang lhar rgyun du mchod gtor 'bul ba ni/ /zangs gzhong gi nang du btsan bsgos dmar po ra'i khrag gis byugs pa dkar rgyan dang ra sha'i dmar rgyan can/ /skyu gu bdun gyis bskor ba bshams/ lhaḥ lha yi dge bsnyen drag rtsal can/ /ldang lha sku mdog dkar la dmar/ /'jigs gzugs khro gtum am gtsigs(98nathasdams/ /dar dkar na bza' sku la gsol/ /dar gyi thod bcings sag lham can/ /g.yas pa dar dkar ru mtshon 'phyar/ /g.yon pa dgra snying zhal du gsol/ /ngang dkar rta mchog sga srab can/ /zhen nas stong gsum skad cig myul/ /'khor du btsan rgod stong gis bskor/ /res 'ga' bse khrab bse rmog gyon/ /bse phub khur zhing mdung dmar bsnams/ /btsan rta dmar po zhon nas rgyug /zhags pas dgra bo'i ske nas 'ching / /'khor bcas—223

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)tshur gshegs gnas 'dir spyon/ /pad nyi dgra bgegs gdan la bzhugs/ /btsan rgod 'khor bcas spyan lam du/ /ra dmar khrag chang a lha dang / /dbang po sna lnga'i me tog spungs/ sha chen ra sha'i dud sprin 'khrigs/ /tshil chen ra tshil sgron me sbar/ /mkhris pa'i dri chab chal chil g.yo/ sha rus brtsegs pa'i zhal zas ldam/ /rkang gling dung dang rnga chen lding / /mdzes pa'i rta mchog rlung ltar g.yo/ /'brong g.yag ngar zhing bas bya lding / /ra lug 'o ma'i rgyun 'dzin pa/ /dar thod gos dang ru mas mdung / /rnon po'i mtshon dang sra ba'i go /sman raka gtor gsum tshogs 'khor sogs/ /mthun pa'i dam rdzas tshogs rnams kyis/ /btsan rgod 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang / khyu chung phud nyams 'bags pa sogs/ /sgo gsum dam tshig nyams chags kun/ /rang rig ka dag dbyings su bshags/ /bzod par mdzod la dngos grub stsol/ /oṃ shu la ra tsa ljang lnga sa pa ri wā ra ma hā pas ma hā rak+ta/ ma hā ba kla khā nyis sman ra kagatore gsum phul/ nyi ma 'bum gyis legs 'khyud pa'i/ /byu ru'i lhun po ltar brjid pa/ /ldang lha bas (98brgod mthu bo che/ /'khor dang bcas pa bdag bstod do/ /slob dpon pad+ma thod phreng dang / /gter ston sprul sku tshul rdor nas/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i spyan snga mā /khas blangs dam bcas ma g.yel bar/ /rig 'dzin bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs thul/ /tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor rnams/ /yang ngo'i zla ltar rgyas par mdzod/ khyad par zab gter chos 'di rnams/ /nyams su len cing spel ba la/ /'gal rkyen bar chad mi 'byung zhing / /mthun rkyen yid bzhin lhun grub mdzod/ /ces phyag rdor dregs 'dul gyi gter srung btsan rgod ldang lha la mchod gtor 'bul tshul 'byer bde bar bkod pa 'di ni rigs 'dzin chen po'i sprul pa'i zlos gar blo bzang pad+ma 'phrin las kyi gsung gis bskul ba la brten nas za hor gyi bzhes 'god pa'i skabs lha chen nyid gter gzhung gi bshad tshod dang cung zad mi mthun pa'i btsan chos kyi rnam pa'i dgyes tshul gi rol gar nying 'brul du shar ba'i don yang cung zlad smos te sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin no/ /—224

dam can chos srung mngon rtogs 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)oṃ swā bhā wa shurnya sarba dharmā su bhā wa shuzlo3nya/ mchod rdzas rnams mi dmigs pa'i stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las yul lha gzhi bdag 'khor dang bcas pa mnyes par byed pa'i mchod rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa rang rang gi dbang po rnams tshim zhing dgyes pa skyed par byed pa'i nus pa dang ldan pa sa dang bar snang nam mkha'i khyon thams cad yongs su gang bar gyur/ oṃ āḥlha gis byin gyis brlabs/ khri shog rgyal mo'i mtsho la gnas byas pa'i/ /mtsho sman ljang gu chu dar gosasngon gyon/ /rin cen rgyan spras rus sbal la zhen pa/ /'khor dang bcas pa (99na gnas 'dir da tshur spyon/ /nyal 'gro 'khyil ba'i mgo bo slo ba ri/ /mtsho yi mjug ma mcher pa ri dang ni/ /mtsho snying ma hā de wa la gnas pa'i/ /lha klu gzhi bdag 'khor bcas da tshur spyon/ /gnyan chen zor ba btsan gdong dmar po dang / /klu yi chu khol wa chu ring mo'i gnas/ /chen po bcu gsum tshwa mtsho dkar mo la/ /gnas pa'i lha klu gzhi bdag ma lus spyon/ /mthon po bcu gsum mgon po gdong sna dang / /'ju lag mdung rtse che chung be'i tug thang / /en tse ri dang zho sha la bo che'i/ /yul lha gzhi bdag lha klu ma lus spyon/ /ga rti ka gnas la btsas dkar po dang / /rdo yi nyi zla dkar thang mar khu'i mtsho/ /spen chen spen chung gser khog sgo ra yi/ /yul lha gzhi bdag lha klu ma lus spyon/ /ne'u gsing thang che 'dzin brag dkar po/ /'om lung che chung gdong dmar che chung dang / /btsong kha'i mtsho sngon lha ri de'u yag /yul lha gzhi bdag lha klu ma lus spyon/ /gzhi bdag lha klu sdebargyad 'khor bcas la/ /pad+ma ut+pal chu skyesathang skyes kyi/ kha dog rnam bkra'i me tog 'phreng ba yi/ /spel legs mdzes pa'i thod dang rgyan du 'bul/ /dbang sngon pad rā ka g.yu dang mu khyi ka /gser sbyangs mu men byu ru dngul la sogs/ /lha mi'i rin cen sna tshogs 'phreng ba rnams/ /gang sku mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan du 'bul/ /'ja' tshon ltar bkra za 'og thags kyi gos/ /'jam mnyen reg bya'i khyad par ji snyed pa/ /tse ber stod g.yogs sham thabs yug dkris kyi/ /lhab lhub na bza'i khyad par ji snyed 'bul/ /sman sna stong gi nyer sbags dri ngad can/ /phun tshogs bde ba ster ba'i nyal 'gro'i rgyun/ /gser dngul rin cen snod du legs —225

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)gtams(99ba)pa/ /sku yi gnas la byug pa'i rdzas su 'bul/ /tsan dan dkar dmar sbrul gyi snying po dang / /sman spos shing sna stong phrag rab bsregs pa'i/ /dngar ba'i dri zhim sprin phung ltar 'khrigs pa/ khangs kyi dbang po dgyes pa skyed phyir 'bul / /bskal pa'i mun pa mthar byed nyi zla'i 'od/ /shel sogs rin cen snang ba'i gzi 'bar can/ /rtsi bcud las sbar mar me'i phreng ba yi/ /'dren byed gzigs mor mngar ba'i ched du 'bul/ /ljon pa'i lo 'dab skol ba'i khu ba dang / /'bras nasargun 'brum snying po las 'ongs chang / /dkar gsum dngar gsum shing tog lha bgos sogs/ /bza' gas ro brgya'i dpal kun ljags la 'bul/ /sga srab gong ṣ+ka dar gyi cod pan can/ /rta mchog rlung gi shugs la rnam par 'gran/ /longs spyod khal gyi khur ldan dre lta dang / /'phur lding g.yo ba'i 'dab chags sna tshogs 'bul/ /in+d+ra ni la'i mdog ltar rab sngo ba'i/ /rdo rje rwa ldan 'brong g.yag rnam par 'gying / /'o ma'i rgyun 'dzin 'dod pa 'jo ba'i ba/ /ra lug ri dwags yid 'ong sna tsho gos 'bul/ /dpa' gtum rtsal ldan seng ge stag gzig dom/ /dred mo ce spyang khyi sogs mche ba can/ /rus sbal sprul dang sbal lcong klu yi nor/ /grangs med srog chags sna tshogs khyed la 'bul/ /gser dngul gnam lcags las grub go khrab dang / /mda' mdung ral gri la sogs mtshon cha'i ris/ /dung chen gling du dzornga rol mo'i sgra/ /dar zab 'ja' r+pā lta bur rnam bkra 'bul/ /mdzes pa'i gar bsgyur snyan pa'i glu len cing / /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan rnam par bsgreng / /rang rang mkho dgu'i 'byor ba ji snyed pa/ /dngos bshams yid kyis sprul te rnam par 'bul/ /ma rig zhabrul pas nyes par spyad pa yis/ /yul (100na tshe lha gzhi bdag 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /phog thug nyams chagasagyur pa ci mchis pa/ /snying nas bshags so bzod par mdzad du gsol/ /khri shog rgyal mo'i phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad du/ /'khod pa'i rje 'bangs mi nor phyugs kun la/ /nad gdon bar chad nyer 'tshe zhi ba dang / /legs tshogis yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel bar mdzod/ /mtsho sngon khri shog rgyal mo'i skor gyi yul lha gzhi bdag rnams gsol ba'i rim pa 'di ni dad stobs ldan pa ar ti da la'i hung —226

dam ༅ chos srung mngon rtog tshon la rnam bzhi lhun grub/ (getha'i jis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs dpal bzang ngo /mchod gtor rnams nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ āḥlha lan gsum brjod/ ri bo spang ljongs ljon shing skyed tshal dang / /chu klung lteng sna 'bab chu la sogs pa/ /dga' bder spyod pa'i gnas mchog dam pa nas/ /ma mo bstan ma klu bdud 'dir spyon cig /rang rang dgyes pa'i gdan la brtan par bzhugs/ /dbang po sgo lnga dgyes pa skyed byed pa'i/ /gzugs mdzes sgra snyan dri zhim ro bda' ba/ /reg bya phun sum tshogs pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /rtsi sman ngad ldan mchod yon dri chab dang / /thang skyes chu skyes me tog sna tsho gos bkra/ /sman spos ljon shing bsregs pa'i dud sprin 'khrigs/ /snang gsal sgron me bza' bca' phung por spungs/ /rta mchog 'dod 'jo'i ba dang ra lug bya/ /sbal lcong nya sbrul mtsho rta mtsho glang dang / /dar dang za 'og rin cen rnam pa lnga/ /khang bzang mtsho rdzing ne'u gsing skyed mos tshal/ /go mtshon rin cen rgyan dang dar zab gos/ /lha dang mi yi longs spyod ma lus 'bul/ /dgyes par rol la (100ba7thun rkyen dngos grub stsol/ /nyams chaṭa 'gal ga gil gyur pa dbyings su bshags/ khyad par dge bcu kun tshang ri bo'i spor/ /khrims ldan dam pa'i chos kyi khrus pa'i gling / /'khor lo gsum gyi bya ba ma lus pa/ /yar ro'i zla ltar 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzod/ /mdor na rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi/ /chos dang srid kyi mthun rkyen ma lus pa/ /bsams pa tsam gyis yid bzhin 'grub pa yi/ /'dod pa'i re ba yongs su skong bar mdzod/ /ces ri bo chos gling gi srung ma bstan ma dang / /klu bdud gnyis kyi gsol mchod 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes mchod dpon blo bzang mthu stobs kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dpal lo/ /rgyal kun gsang ba rab 'byams 'khor lo'i mdzod/ /byu rgya mtshor pad+ma'i ge sar las/ /ngo mtshar sprul pa'i rol gar thod phreng rtsal/ /skyon sangs rgyas gnyis pas byin phob cig /mgon de'i phyag mtshan ye shes rdo rje'i gzugs/ /gtsug na rab 'bar sprul pa'i chos rgyal che/ /bka' sdod —227—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)dregs pa'i dmag gi dpung tsho gis rnams//tshur gshegs dbyar gyi char sprin lta bur spyon//khyad par sku yi rgyal po mon bu nag/sprul pa dgra bcom yum wo ro langs dkar//bka' yi blon po bya khrid mig gcig pa//dgun gyi 'thor rlung bzhi du las cing spyon/shar phyogs sku yi rgyal po blon por bcas//bshan pa chen po snang srid dregs pa'i tshogs//g.yab dang rol mo snyan pa'i gdung dbyangs kyis//'bod na sngon gyi dam tshig dgongs te spyon//drag po ma tre bsgral ba'i gnas mchoge che//rin cen sna lnga las grub gzhal med khang //nyi zla pad+ma dgra bgegs bsnol ba'i 101nasang //sprul pa'i chos rgyal sku lnga brtan par bzhugs//bye brag shar phyogs dung gi gzhal yas su//seng ge la bcibs mon bu pu tra nag/men tri'i gos dang dar nag theb zhu gsol//rdo rje gseg shang 'dzin zhing rnam par 'gying //dom nag rol khrid stag gzig dom dred kyi//pho nya rab 'gyed sprul pa dgra bcom tshul//chos gos gsol zhing gseg shang spu gri 'dzin//gseg li rgyab khur spyi blugs mdun na 'amang //ro langs dar dkar gos can dam shing dang //0 snying bsnams bya khrid mig gcig pa//sprul nag thod bcings rta sngon sgab nag bcibs/khrel gyi rdo rje 'phen khyod gnas 'dir bzhugs//bstan srung pe har rgyal po 'khor bcas la//rnal 'byor dang ba'i sems kyis gus phyag 'tshal//bdud rtsi 'di bzhes bdag dang dgra lha khyod//dam bsre dpal chen khrag 'thung gzu dpang mdzod//rtsa brgyad stong sbyar myong grol bdud rtsi sman//dmar r+ṣa lha phreng 'khrigs par rak+ta'i mtsho//sku mkhar rgya phubs brten pa'i gtor ma dang //gsang 'phyis spras pa'i mchod gtor tshogs rnams kyis//rgyal chen sde lnga 'khor tsho gos bcas pa dang //pu tra nag po bya khrid mig gcig po//'khor bcas gsol lo mchod do thugs dam skong //sngags 'chang bdag gis bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrubs//dkar ser dmar ljang kha dog 'ja' ltar bkra//snyan dang mi snyan sna tsho gos sgra'i bye brag/don snying drod ldan rdza ri ltar spungs pas//sku gsung thugs la dgyes skyed rdzas mchog gis//rgyal chen sde lnga la soṭa blo ka gcig po 'gre//dam nyams sha chen g.yang gzhi'i ste/ du spungs//khrag gi zham chu ban+ta'i snod du 101ba

dam can chos srung mngon rtogs 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)bskyil/ /rkang mar rus tshogs sa gzhir gcal du bkram/ /dug gsum rnam par dag pa'i mchod sprin gyis mo/ /stag chen spre'u bya rgod spyang ki dang / /za 'og las grub rgyal mtshan rnam par sgreng / /srog chags dkar po smyug rgod rnga dar spras/ /sku 'bag bla rdo phyi nang gsang rten gyis ྾/ /ri rab gling bzhi gling phran 'dod yon rnams/ /nyer spungs mdos chen thags kyi 'ja' ris can/ /bsgos bu sha chang dkar gsum dngar gsum 'bru/ /sngo ris bza' bca' spungs pa'i tsho gos 'khor gyis za/ /rnyog med chu klung rak+ta'i mchod yon bshams/ /chu 'dam thang skyes me tog dbang po lnga/ /sman sna stong dang sha chen dud pa 'thul/ /tshil chen zhun mar me shel nyi zla yis ྾/ /bzang drug khrag zhag mkhris pa'i dri chab sgreng / /ro brgya'i zas dang sha rus spungs pa'i bshos/ /rgya gling dung chen rnga sil rkang gling sgra/ /bkra shis rtags brgyad rin cen sna bdun gyis ྾/ /dar zab 'jol ber mi dom glang stag lpags/ /theb zhu sa theb rin cen rus pa'i rgyan/ /pha rol 'joms pa'i sna tshogs mtshon cha dang / /rang bsrung sra brtan go cha'i tsho gis rnams kyis mo/ /rin cen sga srab kyis mdzes rta mchog dkar/ /'jigs rung 'brong g.yag 'dod pa 'jo ba'i ba/ /ra lug khyim bya nor skyong dkar mdzes can/ /seng ge spra spre'u rnga mo zhon khal gyis mo/ /mdor na gtsang zhing gya nom dngos su bshams/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas mang por spel/ /mi zad nam mkha' mdzod la mnga' brnyes pa/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i kun bzang mchod sprin gyis mo/ /sgeg dpa' mi sdug bgrang yas rnam 'gyur gyis/ /las kun sgrub la thogs med mthu rtsal can/ /mdzes brjid (102na7)mu rngams sku yi rol gar mkhan/ /chos rgyal sku lnga 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ /rgod drag 'jigs rung sna tshogs sgra skad kyis/ /las kun sgrub la thogs med ྾/ /snyan 'jigs nga ro gsung gi rol gar mkhan/ /chos rgyal sku lnga ྾/ /snying rje rngam zhing zab gsal ye shes kyis/ /las kun sgrub la ྾/ khro chags brtse ldan thugs kyi rol gar mkhan/ /chos rgyal sku lnga ྾/ /mig sman bye bas byugs pa'i lhun po la/ /dus kyi sbyin za'i phung po'i gos gyon pa/ /rdo rje gseg shang 'bar ba'i mtshon rnon pos/ /dgra dpung phyer 'thag mon bu pu r+shar bstod/ /dom nag —229

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)spyon pa kha gdangs phyi bzhin 'brang / /stag gzig dom dred pho nya phyogs bcur 'gyed/ /ngur smig gos kyis klubs pa'i dgra bcom gzugs/ /blo brid 'jigs rung sprul pa ston la bstod/ /stong nyid snying rje'i rang gdangs ro langs mar/ /mnyam sbyor thabs shes zung 'jug bde chen 'dren/ /srid gsum cig car mthong ba bka'i blon po/ /bya khrid mig gcig bshan pa che la bstod/ /sku yi skyong grogasa'abag seng glu gar mkhan/ /mon pa byi la spra sprel ā tsar+ya/ /sna tsho gis cir yang brdo ba'i cho 'phrul can/ /sprul pa yang sprul bye ba'i tshogs la bstod/ /sngags nag phur thogs nyan thos zhi zhing dul/ /go mtshon spras pa'i dpa' bo stag shar can/ /mi sdug gzugs can bud med ral pa gsig /ru 'dren dregs pa'i 'khor tsho gis bcas la bstod/ /brtul zhugs nus pa'i rtsal gyis 'dzam gling gi /dregasapa'i srog la dbang sgyur thod phreng rtsal/ /mnga' bdag bod kyi btsan pos spyan drangs tshe/ /lha khyod gtsug lag srung mar ma bskos sam/ /gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes la sogs pa/ khri spyab brnyesasngags 'chang rje (102bsgo bangs mang po yis/ /bka' brgyad spyi dang bye brag dkyil 'khor du/ /sngon gyi mtha' tshig gnyen po ma bsgrags sam/ /bla chen mnga' bdag nyang dang chos kyi dbang / /legasaldan bdud 'joms rdo rje la sogs pa/ /zab gter dngos brgyud bla ma'i tsho gis rnams kyis/ /bka' rtags phyag rgyas dam tshig ma bskyar ram/ /de ltar rigs 'dzin brgyud pa'i bla ma yi/ khrag 'thung rnam par rol ba'i brtul zhugs kyis/ /rdo rje gtsug bkod mna' chu lcer bzhag pa'i/ /'da' dka' dam tshig gnyen po nyer dgongs la/ /lus can kun gyi phan bde 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /rgyal ba'i bstan dang de 'dzin skyes bu dang / /mdo sngags bshad sgrub thos bsam sgom pa yi/ /rnam gsum 'khor lo'i bya ba rgyas par mdzod/ /bod yul kha bas bskor ba'i sman ljongs 'dir/ /nad rims mu ge 'byug rtsod kun zhi zhing / /rdzogs ldan dus kyi tshe dang longs spyod sogs/ /lhun grub phan bder spyod pa'i 'phrin lasamadzod/ /yangs pa'i sal gnam gyis bskos pa'i lha/ /dga' ldan phyogs las rnam rgyal pho brang che/ /mchod yon zung du la jug pa'i mtshan jus dang / /mnga' thang chab srid phyogs bcur rgyas par mdzod/ /—230

dam can chos srung mngon rtogs 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ (da)rtag tu mchod gsol bstod pa lhur blangs te/ /lha khyod dgra lhar bsten pa'i tsho gos rnams kun/ /mi mthun nyes brgya'i g.yul las rab rgyal zhing / /chos srid yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel bar mdzod/ /mthu stobs ga ba'i yab gcig las 'ongs pa'i/ /phun tshogs sdebazhi chu bo zad mi shes/ /'dod don rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i dga' ston gyis/ /lha rgyal bkra shis dbyangs snyan kun khyab mdzod/ /ces pa 'di'ang sbug chol gser rnga zung dang bcas te gsol mchod gsar rtsom zhig dgos zhes (103na)tshong 'dus lha'i lcog nas bshan pa bya khrid mig gcig pa dngos dang mchod khang gsol ja bas bskul ma byung ba ltar gtso bor dpal skyon gyi slob dpon chen po'i gsung dri ma med pa bla ma mnga' bdag nyang gi gter byon 'phrin las don bcu ma chag med gtong dgos pa gzhir bcas kyi dbang du byas te de'i kha skong dang slo bur du mgyogs rtsol gyis gtong dgos pa 'dra'i skabs su 'di tsam gyis kyang don ston pa'i dbang du byas te za hor gyi brnyes chu yos hor zla bcu pa'i nyer drug nyi ma me bzhi'i 'grub sbyor gyi thog sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas ban 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin no/ /dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i ngo bo tshar pa rje/ /bstan 'dzin 'khor lo'i mgon po gnas gsar pa/ /bka' drin 'khor med zur chen rdo rje 'chang / /byang chub bar du snying gi pad mtshor bsten/ /de la 'dir chos skyong che chung gi gtor bsngo bya bar 'dod pas/ oṃ āḥlha ha ho hriḥ zhes lan gsum gyis gtor ma byin gyis brlabs/ mdun gyi nam mkhar baṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du baṃ ro dmar ser mgo g.yas su bstan pa'i gdan la/ lhaḥ mthing nag las 'od 'phros/ dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ phyag gnyis kyi dbus na rnam 'phrul gyi gaṇ+ḍi bsnams pa/ /spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa'i zhal nasakhrag 'dzag pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can phyag rgya drug dang sprul gyis brgyan pa/ /stag sham dang dar sna tshogs kyi cod can —231—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)'phyang (103bang/ me'u thung gel ba'i 'dug stangs kyi bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas na bya nag /g.yon na khyi nag /rgyab na ce spyang / mdun na mi nag /steng na khyung chen 'bum sde 'khor ba/ ye she kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yon du pad nyi'i gdan la tre las e ka dza ṭi ral gcig ma sku mdog sngon mo khro mo'i zhal can/ phyag gnyis kyis g.yu'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/ dar dkar gyi stod g.yogs dang stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ rus pa dang rin po ches brgyan pa/sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i lto bar trag las khrag gis rgya mtsho'i dbus su dpal ldan lha mo sku mdog sngo nag zhal gcig spyan gsum phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas gnyis ral gri dang thod khrag /g.yon gnyis mdung dang ba dan 'phyang ba'i rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ glang lpags kyi stod g.yogs dang ba lang gi ko bas smad g.yogs pa/ re lde'i sham thabs la sbrul gyi ska rags bcings pa mi ro rengasapo za zhing / dug sbrul dang gser dril/ /seng ge dang g.yu dril gyi snyan g.yas g.yon brgyan pa zhabasaganyis lcags sgrog gis mdzes shing sku la byug pa'i rdzas gsum gyis sbags pa/ shin tu rid cing mi sdug pa/ nyi zla lte ba'i thod ka nas 'char ba/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na ma mo mkha' 'gro sha za 'bum sdes bskor te bzhugs pa/ gtso 'khor gsum gyi 'khor du gnod sbyin las mkhan/ ru 'dren sprul pa yang sprul gyi dmag tshogs sa gzhi bar snang gang bas bskor ba/ lcam dral de thamasacad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ /thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer los pas(104na khog min rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs ka nas/ mgon po dang rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal ldan lha mo la/ /'khor tsho gos rgya mtshos bskor ba/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ lha/ 'og min bde chen chos dbyings pho brang nas/ /bstan srung rgya mtsho'i sdod pon gur gyi mgon/ /lcam dral bka' sdod bran g.yog bcas pa rnams/ /thogs pa med par gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā lwa ya/ma hā kā lī di sa/ e ka dzā khyi/ sa pa ri wā ra e khye hi dzaḥ/ baṃ sngos bstim/ sngags de gnyis kyi rjes—232

dam can chos srung mngon rtogs tshon las rnam nga lhun grub/ 9)su/ gro ste dis: swā hā nas bzung ste shabha'i bar gyis mchode/ lcam dral gyi ljags 'od zer rdo rje'i sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud drangs par bsams la gong gi sngags gsham du/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe saḥ sarba thā 'a ud+ma te/ lpa ra ṇa i me ga ga na — gro ste rda ba ༅ di swā hā/ lan gsum mam lnga dang shā sa nas 'bul/ gong ltar arnya sogs kyis mchode cing / sngags gsham du oṃ āḥlha btags la nang mchod 'bul/ nag po chen po lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la bstan 'gro'i phan bde spel ba dang rnal 'byor pa bdag gi bar chad zhi zhing mthun rkyen bsam don lhun gyis grub par mdzad du gsol/ sangs rgyas kun gyi mthu stobs bzhu blugs khams/ /rdo rje srin po'i gzugs can gur gyi mgon/ /dpal ldan lha mo srid pa gsum gyi bdag /lcam dral bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ /bstab pa ni/ nag po chen po lcam dral 'khor bcas rnams/ /'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma sman raka sogs/ /sngar bcol legs dang da 'chol gsol 'debs su/ /'bul lo (144ba〉khyol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ ces wen las bcol/ mgon po chung ba'i gtor chog ni/ gtor ma sngar bzhin byin gyis brlabs/ /mdun du chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhir nyi ma dang ro'i gdan re re dbus kyi gdan la hūṃ las gri gug hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ phyogs bzhin hūṃ re re dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su rdo rje nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa rtsa zhal gnyis brtse ṭa pa nag po/ /g.yas g.yon gnyis ljang nag sku mdog char sprin ltar nag pa/ dgra bo'i stobs 'phrog pa'i gzugs can/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas dang pos gri gug dang / g.yon dang pos thod pa thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ g.yas 'og mas ral gri dang / g.yon 'og masarus pa'i phreng ba 'phyar stabs su bsnams pa/ dbu skra dang smin ma/ sma ra me ltar 'bar ba zhal nasak+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ dang ha ha dang hūṃ hūṃ gi sgra sgrog pa/ /thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ sbrul nag po'i mchod phyir thogs dang tshangs skud rus pa'i rgyan drug /sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag lpags—233

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung la gum/ 64 )rlon pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/de'i g.yas su g.yung mo nag mo/ /g.yon du gtum mo ljang gu/ mdun du srin mo nag mo/ /rgyan tu siṅgā li ma nag mo/ /bzhi ga'ang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ ral pa thur du 'phyang zhing / gcer bu rgyan med pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i gar mdzad pa/ lnga ga'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbusan bzhugs pa/ 'khor tsho gis rgya mtshos bskor ba'i dpral bar oṃ/(1spun〉grin par āḥ thugs gar hūṃ/ /thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros pas/ te se/ gru 'dzin/ sing gha'i gling / ha ha rgod pa'i dur khrod/ dar lung / kha'u brag rdzong / dpal ldan sa skya nas gtso 'khor rnams badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ// gangasacan gru 'dzin la sogs gnas mchog nas/ /stobs 'phrog dbang po legs ldan gdong bzhi pa/ /yab yum 'khor tshogs rgya mtshor bcas pa rnams/ /thogs pa med par gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ ma hā kā la kā la bi kā la ra ti ta/ ḍom+bhi ni/ tsaṇ+ḍasnyi/ rak+ṣa sī/ sing gha lī/ de sa sa pa ri wā ras khyo hi/ /spyan drangs/ dzaḥlha baṃ sngo sa bstim/ gong gi sngags gsham du/ gro ste rda asnye nas shabha'i bar gyis mchode/ sngags gsham du na maḥs ta thā ga ta btags pa sogs lan gsum gyis gtor ma 'bul/ sngar ltar nyer spyod kyis mchod cing nang mchod 'bul/ rdo rje nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma zhes sogs gong ltar 'phrin las bcol/ lhaḥ dus kyi sbyin za'i phung po 'bar ba'i dbus/ /char sprin ltar gnag mi'u thung srin po'i gzugs/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i steng du bro brdung ba'i/ /stobs 'phrog dbang po 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ /bstab pa ni/ gdong bzhi mgon po yab yum 'khor bcas rnams/ /tshig rkang lhag ma gsum mgon chen ltar bya/ srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ma brjod/ he ru ga'i yi ge brgya pas lhag chad bkang /rten yod na brtan bzhugs/ med na badz+ra muḥs rang gnas su gshegs/ /dge 'dis nag po chen po 'khor bcas kyis/ /dam chos sgrub pa'i bar chod kun bsal te/ /tshe 'dir rdo rje (105ba'i dzin pa'i sa thob nas/ /'gro ba ma lus 'dren pa'i dpal gyur cig /rgyal mtshan rtse mo sogs shis brjod ci —234

dam can chos srung mngon rtogs tshon las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ (gerigs bya'o/ /de ltar mgon po che chung gi gtor ma'i cho ga nyung ngu don gsal 'di ni gdong kha nas blo bzang bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal gyis bskul ba la brten nas gtor chog rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum sna tshogs 'dug pa las/ nyung ngu 'khyer bde'i dbang du byas te za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin no/ /phyag na mthu stobs 'bar ba rdo rje'i mtshon/ /gdengs pas yid srubs dpung las rnam rgyal te/ /gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin khro bo'i dbang po dang / /dbyer med drin can bla ma gtsug na bsten/ /bde stong zung 'jug chos dbyings rdo rje'i thugs/ /nam yang g.yo ba med kyang bdud sde'i dpung / /'dul phyir gnod sbyin chen po'i skur bstan pa/ /zab gter srung ma'i dbang pos rtag tu skyongs/ /mgon khyod dgyes pa skyed byed mchod pa'i sprin/ /mi mdzad nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo 'phar brgya/ /sngon rabs dam pa'i man ngag la brten nas/ /rnam par 'byed pa'i lde mig 'di na'o/ /de'ang gnod sbyin chen po rdo rje bdud 'dul gyi dam tshig gso zhing thugs dam skong ba'i ched du las byang gi rim pa nyams su bstar ba la brgyud ldan gyi rdo rje slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i zhabs pad nye bar bsten nas gsang ba'i bdag po khang bu brtsegs pa'i rjes gnang dang chos skyong 'di nyid kyi ra ba phyi nang gsang gsum/ tha ma'ang phyi sgrub kyi rjes gnang tsam sngags gsar ma'i rjes gnang gi rigs 'gre kho na lhur blangs pa ma yin pa'i lugs srol 'di ga'i rgyun nyams pa med par nos/ dam tshig dang sdom pa la gnas pa'i sgrub pa pos/ gnas khang byi dor byas/ dkon (106na starga ga spyi bye brag gi rten dkram/ gsang ba'i bdag po'i gtor ma lha bskos zlum po rgyan can dang / thugs dam bskang ba'i gtor ma nor bu 'bar ba'i rnam pa gru gsum che ba gcig la 'khor gyi dpal bzhos bzhis bskor ba'am yang na so sor bshams/ kha zas kyi bye brag bzang dgu mtshar tshad dang / rin po che/ shing rta go /'bru sna/ dar sna tshogs/ gzhan yang me tog lnga sogs phyi/ bdud rtsi lnga sogs dang / gzugs la sogs pa gsang ba'i mchod pa/ gsang 'phyi dang dam tshig gi rgya phor sogs mthun rdzas/ g.yag nag —235

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)khyi nag sogs bskang ba'i rten/ ru mtshon/ ba dan/ go cha sogs dang / gos rgyan/ nor rdzas kyi khyad par spyan gzigs ci 'byor pa bkod pas mdzes par bshams/ gzhi bdag gi gtor ma'ang spyi dang mthun no/ /thog mar mchod rdzas rnams byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra a gra ta kuṇ+ḍali ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ gnas khang rin po che sna tsho gis las grub pa'i zhing khams phun sum tshogs par rgyu las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i nyer spyod 'dod yon sogs phyi nang gsang ba'i spyan gzigs mkho dgu tshang ba bzang dgu 'byor ba mdzes dgus brgyan pa rgya nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam zhing dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs kyi bar du 'byung ba dpal kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin phung ngo bo ye shes kyi sgyu ma'i rang bzhin rnam pa bde bar 'char ba bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ oṃ ā mi dz+ra pu 〉 hūṃ nas/sha rdi'i bar brjod cing rol mo 'bud dkrol byed/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas te/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo be (106ba tha mu khe juḥ sarba thā kho ud ga te lpa ra ṇa hi me ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ zhes pasabyin gyis brlabs/ badz+ra lpa ra ṇa khaṃ zhes pas mang bar spel/ sman raka byin gyis brlab pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ 'phros pas/ sman phud kyi ma dag pa rnams bsregs gtar bkrus te yaṃ labakarlung / raṃ las me/ kai las thod pa'i skyed bu gsum gyi steng du/ a las thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du bcud lnga sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas yongs su gang ba/ rlung gis me sbar te zhu ba las phyag mtshan bcu so so'i lte bar rigs lnga yab yum lnga'i sa bon gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'khor 'das kyi bcud kun bsdus te thim pa las rigs lnga yab yum lngar gyur pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byang sems babs pa'i steng du lha rnams 'od du zhu nas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥlha sarba pañtsa a khru ta hūṃ hrīḥṭha/raṃ yaṃ byu gyis rak+ta'i snod bcud kyi ma dag pa rnams sbyangs/ pad+ma 'bar ba'i snod chen por ra las rak+ta'i rgya mtsho gzegs ma la 'dod yon gyi lha mo 'phro bar gyur/ ā+oṃ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa3/ gtor ma byin gyis brlab pa ni/ gong bzhin bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ raṃ las rlung me'i dkyil —236

dam can chos srung mngon rtogs 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ (ge'akhor gyi steng du kai las mi mgo'i skyed bu gsum gyis bteg pa'i steng du a las thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga sogs bza' bca' btung ba'i bye brag kha dog dri ro reg bya phun sum tshogs pas gang ba/ de'i steng du nyi zla kha sbyor rdo rje dang bcas pa la oṃ āḥlha gis mtshan pa las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis bskul bas rlung g.yos me sbar nas rdzas rnams khol ba'i nang du zla nyi rdo rje dang bcas zhu bsam dag pa'i skyon rnams sbyangs te ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥlha lan gsum (107na yo)sa byin gyis brlab bo/ /bdag skyed ni/ 'gro rnams bsgral 'dod bsam pa yis/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ khres rab snying brtse dang bcas pa'i/ /brtson pas sems can don du bdag/sangs rgyas mdun du gnas bcas te/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'thob par bgyi/ /zhes skyabs semasasngon du btang nas/ su bhā was stong par sbyangs/ /'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad 'od gsal gyi rang gdangs/ rdo rje'i khams las grub pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbusasu baṃ las pad+ma dang ra las nyi ma'i gdan la hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las/rang nyid phyag na rdo rje khang bu brtsegs pa sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ sku lus sbom zhing thung ba gsus khyim che ba/ yan lag rags pa/ dar sngon po'i na bza' dang stag gi pagasapa'i sham thabs can/ sprul dang rin po ches spras pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pa nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon pa bdud bshikhi khrag gis bkang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa/ zhal gdangs pa/ ljags 'dril ba/mche ba gcigs pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum sdang mig tu gzigs pa/ smin ma dang sma ra dbu skra kham ser gyen du 'khyil ba/ gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar brla dbus na bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs gar hūṃ sngon pos mtshan pa/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/rang bzhin gnas nas bsgom pa dang (107ba'i dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' la khro bo dang rig pa'i —237

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)lha mo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ ā+oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi sa pa ri wā ra a: bra titsā swā hā nas sha rdi'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥlha baṃ lhos gnyis med du bstim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ ā+oṃ pañtsa ku la sapa ri wā ra a nas shabha'i bar gyis mchod/ bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhesagasol ba btab pas/ ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shi ye hūṃ/ zhes gsungs nga bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu 'khyil ba las mi bskyod pas dbu rgyan par bsam/ rang gi thugs gar nyi gdan la rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūṃ sngon po sngags kyi 'phreng bas bskor ba'i spro bsdu'i dmigs pa dang bcas te/ ā+oṃ na mo ni ngas ra dha ra badz+ra pa ṇi ra dz+nyā pa ya ti swā hā/ zhes ci nus su bzla/ de nas bzlas gtore 'bul ba ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ gsang ba'i bdag po la bla ma rigs 'dzin dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ gong bzhin chu gnyis nyer spyod kyis mchod rtsa sngags kyi mthar i rda bha kla ta kha kha khā hi zhes btaṭa la lan gsum mam bdun gyis gtor ma 'bul/ sngags gsham du 'bru gsum btags te nang mchod kyang 'bul lo/ /brtse ldan thugs rje che las ma g.yos kyang / /gtum rngams rab 'bar mi bzad gzi byin gyis/ /nag po'i rtsa lag sdebacas 'joms mdzad pa/ /dpal ldan gsang ba'i bdag por phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod/ /mdun bskyed ni/ zlo tsakra maṇ+ḍal/ zhes brjod pas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar phun sum tshogasapa'i (108na gter dang nor bu 'bru sna tshogs kyis gtams pa'i sa gzhi/ me tog sna tshogs pas mdzes shing dpag bsam gyi ljon pas yongs su bskor ba'i dbus su hūṃ las rin po che las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang / sgo khang / rta babs/ khor yug sogs lta na sdug cing gzi brjid dang ldan pa/ rin po che sna bdun dang ba dan rgyal mtshan sogs rgyan sna tshogs kyis spros pa'i dbus su 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa'i lte bar be+eḍūr+ya sngon po'i rang bzhin gyi brag ri'i khri gdan gyi steng du srin po pho mo bsnol ba'i —238

dam can chos srung mngon rtogs 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ rtogegadan la rang gi thugs ga nas k+ṣa chad de babs pa las 'od 'phros bde bar gshegs pa mchod/'gro ba rnams kyi dbul phongs sogs sdug bsngal rnams sbyangs/ 'jig rten khams kyi dpal 'byor phun tsho gis thams cad bsdus te k+ṣa la thim/ de zhu ba las chu badz+ra rat+na tsit+ta rā ga rā ge hūṃ/ zhes brjod pa'i mthus gnod sbyin chen po rdo rje bdud 'dul sku mdog mthing nag sbom la thung zhing gsus khyim che ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan zhing / rab tu khros pa'i zhal can/ phyag g.yas pus steng du mchod sbyin gyi phyag rgyas yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang / g.yon bdud rtsisagang ba'i bum pa lte ba'i thugs kar 'dzin pa/ dbu la rin po che'i brog zhu 'od du 'bar zhing / sku la dar nag gi 'jol ber sum brtsegs su gsol ba'i 'og ma la gser rked rin po che'i phra tshom can bcings par dal bu g.yer ga'i sgra 'brol ba rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras pa/ sag lham rin po che'i 'bur can gsol ba'i zhabs gnyis rgyal po rol ba'i tshul gyis gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan pas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yon du yum gnod sbyin dbang (108bcu kun sgrub ma mthing kha zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas nad rkyal dang g.yon zas sna tshogs kyisagang ba'i rin po che'i gzheng pa yab la stob pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin pa/ dar dkar po'i na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras pa/ shar gyi rtsibs pad nyi'i gdan la dri za pho mo'i steng du rang gi thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i rja yongs su gyur pa las nor lha dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa dar dkar gyi ber gsol ba/ rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ g.yas rin po che 'bar ba dang / g.yon gser gyi sgrom bu 'dzin pa/ zhabs brkyang bskum gyis bzhugs pa/ lho'i rtsibs su pad nyi'i gdan la gshin rje pho mo bsnol ba'i steng du rang gi thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i hūṃ yongs su gyur pa las/ mgon po nag po shin tu khros pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa bdud kyi ber nag mtha' ljang can gsol ba/sprul dang rin po tshes brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas tsan dan gyi beng las 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs shing /g.yon 'chi med bdud rtsis gang ba'i par bu bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis —239

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)bzhugs pa/ nub kyi rtsibs su pad nyi'i gdan la klu gdon pho mo bsnol ba'i steng du rang gi thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i k+ṣa yongs su gyur pa las 'brog gnas mched lnga sku mdog dmar po dbu lnga'i dbus ma seng ge /g.yas gnyis rta dang lug /g.yon gnyis ra dang spre'u'i zhal can/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rin po che'i sgrom bu thugs gar 'dzin pa/ bar pa gnyis kyis gser gyi 'khor lo dang 'bras kyi gzheng pa/ tha ma gnyis kyis sman dang shing tog sna tsho gos bsnams pa/ dar dang rin po chesabargyan pa/ zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum phyi tshul du bzhugs pa/ byang gi rtsibs su pad nyi'i gdan la gnod sbyin pho (109na smra'i steng du rang gi thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i be+e yongs su gyur pa las rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa thung zhing brjid pa gsus khyim che ba/ sku la gser khrab gsol ba/ phyag g.yas gser gyi sba lcag dang g.yon pa gser gzhed rin po ches bkang ba 'dzin pa/ rin po che phrog zhu dang rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras pa/ rta mchog ngang pa sga srab can la bcibs pa/ gtso 'khor de rnams kyi 'khor du gnod sbyin bye ba'i dmag tshogs dang dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha klu dam tshig can sogs gaṅgā'i klung gi rdul gyi grangs las 'das pas bskor ba/ de thams cad kyi dpral bar ā+oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs gar hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ bdag mdun gnyis ga'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros dag pa rab 'byams kyi zhing nas bla ma yi dam rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tshogs dang / lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas gnod sbyin chen po 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/rol mo'i sgra dang snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad do/ /hūṃ/ bde stong zung 'jug chos dbyings pho brang nas/ /pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal sogs dngos brgyud kyi/ /rigs 'dzin bla ma rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs/ /gnas 'dir gshegs la byin chen dbab tu gsol/ /byang phyogs lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas/ /gnod sbyin chen po btsun mo 'khor tshogs bcas/ /mar me mdzad kyi spyan sngar zhal bzhes pa/ /ji bzhin bstan pa bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol/ /dbyangs kyi nga ro snyan brjid rol mo 'brol/ /'bod pa'i dar g.yab sbyar ba'i spos dud 'thul/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas spyan 'dren na/ /'khor —240

dam can chos srung mngon rtogs 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ (gedang bcas pa gnas 'dir da tshur spyon/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra tsit+ta sa mā ya dzaḥdzaḥ zhes gtso bo 'bod pa dang / ā+oṃ rat+na tsit+ta yak+ṣa (109ba〉ཿ zhes 'khor 'gugs pa'i sngags brjod/ e gye hi ma hā ya ka rat+na tsit+ta dzaḥlha baṃ ho sa ma ya dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs la dam tshig pa la gnyis su med par bstim/ lhaḥ rin chen sna tshogs las grub pa'i/ /yid 'phrog lta na sdug pa'i 'phreng / /cod pan gnod sbyin chen po'i dbur/ /legs par bcings te dbang bskur ro/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra rat+na tsit+ta mā le hūṃ/ zhes brjod/ de nas zil gnon lha'i brtul zhugs brtan pos nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas pa/ chos skyong 'khor bcas kyi spyi bor bzhag par mos te/ dam bsgrag dang g.yar dam lhan cig tu bskul ba ni/ ā+oṃ badz+ra rat+na tsit+ta pā sha hūṃ/ badz+ra dṛ ka swā hā/ hūṃ/ dam can rdo rje bdud 'dul 'khor bcas rnams/ /dang por mar me mdzad kyis lung bstan zhing / /bar du rdo rje 'chang gis dbang yang bskur/ /de rjes phyag rdor klu sgrub pad+ma 'byung / /lo chen be ro mnga' bdag khri srong rje/ /gter ston grwa pa mngon shes dbang phyug 'bar/ /nye gnas gra bran bsod nams ran chen dpal/ /smon lam 'bar dang gung chung ston pa'i zhabs/ /rdo rje rgyal mtshan badz+ra pā ṇi dang / /rgya ston byang sems nyang chen byang chub sems/ /brag dkar sman bla jo sras kun gzhen pa/ /mgar ston tshul gnyon bla chen chos dpal bzang / /dpal sbas grags rgyan paṇa chen pad+ma dbang / /mnga' ris rigs 'dzin bdud 'joms rdo rje'i zhabs/ /phyon rgyal po kun dga' bkra shis dang / /rdo rje 44 dngos mgon po bsod nams mchog /rtsa ba'i bla ma chos dbyings rang sar grol/ /gdams pa'i bka' babs 'phrin las lhun gyis grub/ /be+e ro'i sprul sku gter bdag gling pa sogs/ /rjes gnang lung dang bang mdzod ma lus kun/ /'bad med (110na skolo mdzad rigs rnams kun gyi gtso/ /dngos brgyud bla ma rdo rje 'dzin gyi bka'/ /da lta rnal 'byor bdag gis dam bsgrags bzhin/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i sangs rgyas bstan pa dang / /tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i bstan 'dzin dge 'dun tshogs/ /rten gnas gtsug lag khang dang dgon sde skyongs/ /'jig rten khamasakyi snod bcud legs tshogs spel/ /'phung byed nag phyogs bdud sde thal bar rlog /khyad par bdag —241—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)cag dpon slob 'khor bcas la/ /gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs dpung tsho gis cho mes/ /tshe dang longs spyod dpal 'byor lung rtogs rnams/ /rab 'phel bsam pa'i don kun lhun gyis sgrubs/ /thugs dam bskul kyang dgongs par mi 'gyur zhing / /las rnams g.yol na rgyal ba'i bka' bcag cing / /rigs 'dzin dam dral srung ma 'khor bcas rnams/ /nyams 'gyur gdon mi za na 'jigs ta re/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra ha na ha na sam ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brjod cing / rtsa brgyad stong sbyar gyis bdud rtsi 'bul/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra a la la ho khya zhes dam bsres te 'phrin las thams cad sgrub bar bsam mo/ /bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ lhaḥ yid 'phrog nor bu'i gzhal med nyams dga' bar/ /brag ri pad nyi'i gdan la 'dul byed steng / /gnod sbyin 'khor bcas brtan par bzhugs nas kyang / /dgyes pa'i zhal ston dngos grub ma lus stsole/ /ā+oṃ ma hā yak+ṣa rat+na tsit+ta sam ya ji/ phyag bya ba ni/ lha: nyin byed gosakyis klubs pa'i dbang snon ni/ /gar dgu'i nyams kyis zlos gar sgyur mdzad pa/ /dran pas mchog mthun dngos grub char 'bebs pa'i/ /gnod sbyin chen po 'khor bcas la phyag 'tshal/ badz+ra du rnyi swā hā/a ti pu ho/ pra tismo ho/ phyi (110bsgo chod 'bul ba ni/ lhaḥ me tog chun po bdug spos sprin ltar gtibs/ /mar me'i 'phreng mdzes dri chab chal chil g.yo/ /ro brgya'i zhal zas snyan brjid sgra snyan sgrog /la du la phug zho dang 'o ma mar/ /ka ra bu ram sbrang rtsi shing tog tshogs/ /'bras chan 'khur ba tshos ma bza' bca'i rigs/ /rjen btsos sha dang gsur dud rus pa khrag /dbang po lnga dang nang khrol zhag rkang tshil/ /ja dkar rgun 'brum chang sogs btung ba'i mtsho/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya mchod pa'i sprin/ /rdo rje bdud 'dul 'khor bcas spyan snga sa /'bul gyis dgyes par rol la dngos grub stsol/ /ā+oṃ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ti badz+ra mā ra da ma ka sa pa ri wā re saḥ puspro/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke /ga rnye/ni bi te/ sha rdi pā dza sa yo dzaḥ a skṛ ta rak+ṣa ba lo ga na tsakra sma par shu kā ma gu ṇa bra titsā swā hā/ bdud rtsi sman phud ni/ ྅: rtsa brgyad yan lag stong las sbyar ba yi/ /dam rdzas myong grol sman gyi mchod pa ni/ /dngos brgyud bla ma yi dam gsang ba'i bdag /gnod sbyin sdod pon 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /—242

dam mā chos srung mngon rtogs 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ (gegong gi sngags gsham du ma hā pañtsa a khra ta 'a hi/ rak+ta 'bul ba ni/ lhaḥ nyon mongs dgra bgegasabasgral ba'i rak+ta'i mtshor/ /e dbyings mtshal chen rang byung bcud kyi khrag /gzegs mar 'dod yon lha mo nyer 'phro ba/ /gnod sbyin sdod pon 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /gong gi sngags gsham du ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ lhaḥ rin cen ka pā la yi snod yangs por/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga sogs bza' gas kun/ /bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por byin brlabs 'di/ /gnod sbyin sde dpon 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra rat+na tsit+ta rā ka rā ge hūṃ phaṭa swā hā gu phya ba lo ta khā hi/ zhes lan gsum mam bdun (111na)gyis gtso bo dang / /ā+oṃ badz+ra rat+na bhan+ta bdud ma ting skyol ting dzāḥdzā: gu tho ba lo ta khā hi lan gsum gyis yum dang / ā+oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha ārla nga la lha da ya swāhā gu ༅ ba sla ta khā hi/ lan gsum gyis nor lha dang / ā+oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la ha na ha na badz+ra na swāhā gu tho ba lo ta 'a hi/lan gsum gyis mgon po dang / ā+oṃ ma hā yak+ṣa pañtsa de wa rā dza swā hā gu ༅ ba lo ta khā hi/ lan gsum gyi 'brog gnas dang / ā+oṃ ma hā rā dza be+e shwa ba ṇa ye swā hā gu tho ba kla ta 'a hi/ lan gsum gyis rnam sras/ ā+oṃ a kā ro mu kho sogs lan gsum gyis 'khor tshogs spyi la 'bul/ bkang ba la thog mar mthun rdzas kyis bskang ba ni/ dri bzang dang ldan mchod yon mtsho ltar bskyil/ /thang skyes chu skyes me tog mag par bkra/ /sna tshogs ljon shing sman sna'i dud sprin 'khrigs/ /mar dang 'bru me'i snang gsal ches cher sbar/ /ga bur gur kum gyis sbags dri chab 'khyil/ /ro brgya'i zas sna cher spungs lha bgos dang / /sil snyan dung chen sna tshogs rol mo'i sgras/ /gnod sbyin 'khor bcas thugs dam skongs gyur cig /bdud rtsi sman dang khrag gi a lha bskyil/ /phye gtsang chang mar spod sbran bza' bcar bcas/ /gsang 'phyi rin cen 'bar ba'i gtor ma dang / /rgya phor ma da nas bkang mar ze'i srog /yid 'phrog phyag rgyar mnyam sbyor bde ba che/ /dbang po'i me tog sha chen gsur dung 'chub/ /zhun chen snang gsal thod rnga rkang gling sgras/ /gnod sbyin ྾/ /bye brag ga bur sbrang sbyar zhun mar gyis/ /rdo rje bdud 'dul yab yum thugs dam bskang / /ka ra mtshal chen sbyar ba'i rdzas mchog gis/ /nor lha smugs 'dzin —243

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)'khor bcas thugs dam bskang /(111bsko khrag dmar dang sbyar ba'i rdzas mchog gis/ /srog bdag mgon po 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang / /gos dang bu ram sbyar ba'i rdzas mchoge gis/ /'brog gnas mched lnga 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang / /sman dang spos su sbyar ba'i rdzas mchog gis/ /rnam mang thos sras 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang / /thugs dam gnyen po dbyings su skong gyur nas/ /bdag sogs bsams don lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /rten rdzas kyis bskang ba ni/ nor bu 'bru sna gter gyis rab gtams shing / /pad+ma āt+pal la sogs me tog bkra/ /yongs 'du'i ljon pas legs bskor 'dzin ma'i dbus/ /rin cen bdun gyi rang bzhin gzhal med khang / /bkod pas khyad 'phags dbyibs legs lta na sdug /ba dan lce gsum dril 'khrol rgyal mtshan sgreng / /'chi med grong khyer la 'gran khang bzang gis/ /gnod sbyin 'khor bcas thugs dam skong gyur cig /g.yab dar lhab lhub nor bu'i yu ba can/ /gser dngul mu tig byu ru mchong dmar las/ /legs grub mi 'dzad gter gyi bum pa dang / /bris 'bur sku 'bag bla rdo srog 'khor bcas/ /rten gtor yid 'phrog gnas kyi khyad 'phags can/ /gri snying g.yang gzhi mtshon gyis phug pa'i bam/ /le brgan dar dang me long bya rgod mdas/ /gnod sbyin ྾/ /'brong g.yag nag po rdo rje'i rwa chen gdengs/ /sog par dar rgyan lug nag spyi bo dkar/ /mche sder khrag gis sbags pa'i khyi nag zug /sga srab rgyan mdzes rta nag rlung ltar g.yo/ /gnam lcags mchu sder bya nag 'phur zhing lding / /rlung ras dpyangs pa'i bya rog rgyal mtshan dang / /gser mig skyung ka nal bu'i rgyal mtshan gyis/ /gnod sbyin ྾/ /spyan (112na gzigasakyi bskang ba ni/rin cen sna bzhi las grub ri rab la/ /sra brtan lcags ri gcig gis bskor ba'i nang //gling bzhi gling phran gser ri rol mtshor bcas//rin cen ri bo yongs 'du sa brtol shing //yid la gang bsams 'dod pa 'jo ba'i ba/ /rtsol med lhun grub ma rmos lo tog gis/ /gnod sbyin ྾/ /za 'og gos kyi bla bre mkha' la bres/ /sna tshogs dar gyi lda ldi'i cod pan g.yo/ /srog skyob sra brtan rdo rje'i khrab rmog dang / /zhol btags lcags gzhibs rnga rgyan 'ja' ltar bkra/ /dpag chen mda' mdud —244

dam can chos srung mngon rtogs 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ (gedagra sta gri mtshon rigs/ /dar zab 'jol ber sna tshoṭa rin cen rgyan/ /gnyis 'thung dbang po ma he ba lang zhus/ /gnod sbyin ྾/ /gdugs dkar gser nya bum bzang dpal belā /pad+ma dung dkar g.yasa'akhyil rgyal mtshan gdugs/ /gser 'khor nor bu blon po bud med mchog /rta glang khyim bdag rgyal srid rin cen bdun/ /me long ghi lha zho dang rto dur ba/ /bil wa g.yas 'khyil yi khri yungs kar rdzas/ /lha klu gnod sbyin mi yi 'byor tsho gis kyis/ /gnod sbyin ྾/ /zhabrul ngor shar ba'i dgra bgegasa'ajoms pa dang / /'dod dgu'i dngos grub stsol phyir gnod sbyin cher/ /bstan kyang gdod nas dag pa'i rang sems dang / /bla ma yi dam chos skyong dbyer med du/ /ro gcig rang ngo shes pa'i rnal 'byor sogs/ /phyi nang gsang dang de nyid mchod tsho gos kyis/ /rtsa gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i lha tsho gos dang / /gnod sbyin ྾/ /bshags pa ni/ lhaḥrtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha/ /rdo rje bdud 'dul 'khor bcas spyan snga mā/bdag cag nongs pa bsgrag cing bshaṭa byed na/ /spros (112ba thad brtse chen dbyingasanas gson cing dgongs/ /snang stong dbyer med tha mal dbang du shor/ /grag stong rang sgrar tha snyad dbang gis chen/ /rig stong bden 'dzin 'ching bas bcings la sogs/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pa bshags/ /ka dag dbyings las lhun grub 'od gsal ba/ /bde stong zung 'jug rang la gdod ma nas/ /yod par ma shes gzhan nas 'tshol ba'i blos/ /sku gsum ring por spong ba'i 'khrul nyes bshags/ /lha khyod mchog thun dngos grub gter chen por/ /ma shes 'jig rten rang rgyud par bzung zhing / /don chung tsam du las sbyor bkol ba sogs/ /yon tan 'phrin las dam tshig nyams pa bshags/ /smin grol gsang sngags lam du nyer zhugs nas/ /rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig ras su bor/ /khyad par mgon khyod bsnyen sgrub bskong ba dang / /mchod gtor chag sogs nongs pa ma lus bshags//mdor na bshags bya bshags byed bshags pa'i yul/ /kun kyang rang gi sems nyid gcig pu'i rtsal/ /blo 'das byar med bshags pa'i mchog nyid kyis/ /sgrib bral tshangs pa'i dngos grub deng 'dir stsol/ /bstod pa ni/ gter gzhung dngos las/ lhaḥ mgon po rdo rje bdud 'dul ni: thugs rje'i thabs—245

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)kyis gdug pa 'dul:gzhen nu dpa' bo khros pa'i sku:khro bo'i rgyal la phyag 'tshal bstod:mgon po g.yul las rnam rgyal te:mgon po rin chen brtsegs par bzhugs phyag na rin cen thod khrag bsnams:mgon po khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod:mgon po rgyal po dbu mtha' yas:spyan gsum pa la mche ba gtsigs lha dang phaṭa sgra 'jigs drag pos 13nasgo rungs 'dul khyod la phyag 'tshal:phyag na mtshon cha sna tshogs bsnams:sbrul dang thod pa'i 'phreng bas brgyan dar nag ral ka sku la gsol:rdo rje bdud 'dul sku la bstod:'khor ni gnod sbyin stong sdes bskor mdog nag bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar rngams pa'i stabs kyi bgegs 'dul ba bgegs 'dul khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod:rigs 'dzin khro bo'i sku las 'phags mthu rtsal mi nyams yangs pa las srid pa gsum gyis mthar phyin mdzad bdud 'dul 'jigs byed khyod la bstod lhaḥdabus kyi gru gsum mthing nag na//rdo rje nor bu'i dngos grub can//gnod sbyin phrug gu gdug pa can//klu yi tsha bo zhe gnag can//bstan pa bsrung ba'i dam tshig can//dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i mthu stobs can//'jiṭa pa'i skur ston khyod la bstod//sdod pon r+ṣa po khyod la bstod//rin cen ga kho bdag khyod la bstod//bstan pa bsrung mdzad khyod la bstod//ces dang /gzhan yang /lhaḥmi 'gyur bde chen chos kyi dbyingasawo las//gdug pa 'dul ra khro bo'i skur bstan pa//gnod sbyin sdod pon chos srung kun gyi gtso//dpal ldan rdo rje bdud 'dul khyod la bstod//srin po'i gzugs can mig sman lta bu'i mdog/rin cen rgyan dang dar nag 'jol ber mdzes//yid bzhin nor dang bdud rtsi'i bum pa bsnams//rgyal po rol ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs la bstod//ha ha hūṃ phaṭa rngams pa'i nga ro'i sgras//nag po'i rtsal ga sdo bcas klad pa 'gems//dngos grub ster zhes gsung gi gdangs snyan pos//sgrub pa po rnamasadabugs dbyung mdzad la bstod//113brgya mtsho lta bur gting mtha' dpag dka' ba'i//zab gsal thugs kyis dus gsum kun gzigs nas//gang la gang 'dul zhi rgyas dbang drag dang //mchog mthun 'phrin las sgrub par mdzad la bstoX//res 'ga' rab khros brkyang bskum tshul gyis

dam can chos srung mngon rtogs 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ ldana'agying / /rtse gsum thod khrag thogs nas dgra dpung 'joms/ /gnod sbyin rnon po 'jigs byed 'khor dang bcas/ /nang gi mgon po'i rnam par rol la bstod/ /mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug gtum zhing rngams/ /rtse gsum dbyug pa gri thod zhags pa dang / /lcags kyu 'dzin zhing bdud kyi rgyal po'i tshul/ /gsang ba'i mgon po'i rnam par ston la bstod/ /gnyis med gnyis su snang ba'i sgyu dra yis/ /zag bral bde ba chen po skyed pa'i yum/ /nad rkyal rin cen zhags pa 'dzin mdzad ma/ /don kun sgrub pa'i gnod sbyin dbang mor bstod/ /gangs ri'i mdangs 'phrog mdzes pa'i rgyan gyis spras/ /phyag gnyis nor bu rin cen sgrom bu nas/ /'dod dgu'i longs spyod char bzhi 'bebs mdzad pa/ /nor bdag dzam la dkar po khyod la bstod/ /mun pa bye bas byugs pa'i lhun po'i sku/ /gshin rje ltar khros beng chen par bu can/ /zhing bcu'i dgra bgegs dbyings su sgrol mdzad pa/ /lha chen leṭa ldan mgon po khyod la bstod/ /mdog dmar dbu lnga phyag drug rin cen sgrom/ /gser 'khor sman sna 'bras sder shing rta go bsnams/ /log par blta rnams dbang du sdud mdzad pa/ /gnod sbyin 'brog gnas mched lnga khyod la bstod/ /mar gad mdangs 'dzin nyi ma'i gzi byin can/ /cang shes la bcibs gser khrab rin cen rgyan/ /sba lcag gzheng thogs tshe dpal 'byor ba kun/ /rgyas mdzad (114na snam mang thos srasakhyod la bstod/ /pho brang khor sa'i khyon kun dbyar dus kyi/ /chu 'dzin lang long lta bur rab g.yo ba/ /gnod sbyin gdug pa'i dmag gi sde dpung sogs/ /grangs med dam can rgya mtsho'i tshoṭi la bstod/ /bzlas pa byed par spro na/ /mdun bskyed rnams kyi thugs gar nyi ma'i gdan la rang rang gi sa bon gyi mthar sngags kyis bskor ba dmigs/ /de la rang gi thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer phog pas dbang du 'dus te bka' nyan gyi tshul du gnas pa la/ rang gang 'dod pa'i las bskul ba'i dmigs pa dang bcas te/ phyag rdor gyi sngags dang gtso 'khor drug po'i sngags gong gi gtor ma 'bul ba'i dus kyi gu bra ba yi ta man chad dor nas so so'i srog sngags gtso bo la stong dang 'khor lo brgya sogs mang nyung ji ltar rigs pa skabs dang sbyar te bzla'o/ /gsol da'i 'phrin las sbyar ba ni/ gsang 'phyi rin —247—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)cen 'bar ba'i gzugs can nas kyi phye chang mar rnams spos kyis sbran pa sbyar ba las brdzis shing /kha zas kyi bye brag sna tshogs dang bcas pa dang sna lngas brgyan pa lnga/ dam tshig gi rgya phor chang bzang po sman raka btab pas bkang zhing / mar gyi ze brog gis brgyan pa lnga/ zhun mar dang bu ram sbyar ba la sogs pa'i gtso 'khor lnga'i thun rdzas so sgo rnams/ sngar bkang rdzas su bshams pa/ skabs 'dir rang gi mdun du bkod/ rin po che'i snod du gsang 'phyi dang / shun rdzas so so nas ji ltar rigs pa bcad de bsre/ dam tshig gi rgya phor phud kyis sbran la 'di ltar bsngo'o/ /ā+oṃ phud kyi mnga' bdag mchog gsum dam pa'i ngo bor bzhugs pa li rdo rje slob dpon yid dam zhi khro'i lha tshogs dam can srung ma rnams la gsang ba'i phyi rgyan ldan g.yas su sbyar ba (114bsgo skang ba'i thun rdzas btab pa/ gser skyems kyi dam tshig gis sbran pa'i mchod pa dam pa 'dis gsol zhing mchod do/ /dgyes pa chen po skyed par gyur cig /mthu stobs nus pa'i byin rlabs kyis rgyal ba'i bstan pa dar zhing / 'gro ba'i phan bde rgyas pa dang / khyad par bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdud sde zil gyis mnan nas dbang du 'du zhing / dam can las la 'khol te 'phrin las mtha' dag sgrub par mdzad du gsol zhes phud gtor ru mtshon ba dan sogs 'phyar/ rol mo sna tsho gis bya'o/ /de bzhin du sbyar te/ k+ṣa dam pa chos skyong ba'i gtso bo zab mo gter gyi srung ma gnod sbyin rdo rje bdud 'dul la gsang 'phye rgyan ldan g.yos su sbyangs/ /zhun mar dang dngar gsum sbyar ba'i mthun rdzas btab pa/gser skyems kyi dam tshig gis sbran pa'i mchod pa dam pa 'dis gsol zhing mchod do/ /dgyes pa chen po skyed par gyur cig /mthu stobs nus pa'i byin rlabs kyis rgyal ba'i bstan pa spyi dang / bye brag dgon gnas 'di nyid dar zhing rgyas pa dang 'gro kun bde zhing / khyad par bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdud dang log 'dren zil gyis mnan nas dbang du 'du zhing / dam can las la 'khol te yid la brnag pa'i 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub par mdzad du gsol/ phud gtor sogs gong ltar bya zhing 'og ma rnams la'ang 'gre /k+ṣaḥ yum gnod sbyin —248

dam can chos srung mngon rtogs tshon las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)dbang mo don kun sgrub ma gsang 'phye rgyan ldan g.yos su sbyar ba/ bskang ba'i rim pa thun rdzas btab pa/ gser skyems kyi dam tshig gis sbran pa'i mchod pa 'dis gsol lo mchod do/ dgyes pa chen po skyed par gyur cig /thugs dam bskul (115na)pa'i gnyer kha bstan 'gro'i phan bde rgyas zhing nye bar 'tshe ba rnams gzhom pa dang / khyad par bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa la nad rims zhi ba dang zas nor gyi 'byor zhing dpal dang g.yang skyed pa/ cho rigs kyi srid spel bar mdzad du gsol/ dza/ shar phyogs nor lha dkar po gnod sbyin sna bha la 'khor bcas la gsang 'phyi rgyan ldan g.yos su sbyar ba/ ka ra mtshal dang sbyar ba'i mthun rdzas btab pa/ gser skyems kyi dam tshig gis sbran pa'i mchod pa 'dis gsol zhing mchod do/ /dgyes pa chen po skyed par gyur cig /thugs dam bskul ba'i gnyer kha rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'phel zhing / 'gro rnams 'byor pa rgyas pa dang khyad par bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams longs spyod kyi gter la mnga' 'byor te bsod nams kyi tshogs 'phel ba'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ lha: lho phyogasamagon po nag po legs ldan chen po 'khor bcas la gsang 'phyi rgyan ldan g.yos su sbyar ba/ sha khrag dmar dang sbyar ba'i mthun rdzas btab pa gser skyems kyi dam tshig gis sbran pa'i mchod pa dam pa 'dis gsol zhing mchod do/ /dgyes pa chen po skyed par gyur cig /thugs dam bskul ba'i gnyer kha bstan dang 'gro la 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs rnams tshar gcod pa dang / khyad par bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa la/ ngan sdig can gyis mthu byed g.yul zhabrug sogs bsam ngan sbyor rtsub rnams zlog cing tshar gcod pa dang bar gcod thams cad las bsrung skyob kyi 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ k+ṣaḥ 'byog gnas chen po mched lnga 'khor bcas la gsang 'phyi rgyan ldan g.yos su sbyar ba bu ram 'bras (115bdang sbyar ba'i mthun rdzas btab pa gser skyems kyi dam tshig gis sbran pa'i mchod pa dam pa 'dis gsol zhing mchod do/ /dgyes pa chen po skyed par gyur cig /thugs dam bskul ba'i gnyer kha mu stegs byed sogs log lta can rnams bstan pa la gzud pa dang / skye dgu —249

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)rnams phan tshun byams pa dang ldan zhing / khyad par bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la ma dad pa dang sdang bar sems pa rnams 'bangs dang gdul byar gyur zhing / phun sum tsho gos pa la dbang 'byor ba'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ be rgyal po chen po rnam mang thos pa'i sras 'khor dang bcas pa la gsang 'phye rgyan ldan g.yos su sbyar ba/ sman dang spos kyis sbyar ba'i mthun rdzas btab pa gser skyems kyi dam tshig gi sbran pa'i mchod pa dam pa 'dis gsol zhing mchod do/ /dgyes pa chen po skyed par gyur cig /thugs dam bskul ba'i gnyer kha sa spyod rgyal po'i mnga' thang rgyas shing bstan 'gro kun la rgyud pa mi 'byung ba dang / khyad par bdag cag dpon slob yon mar ga bor dang bcas pa rnams la rdo rje lta bu'i srog dang nyi zla lta bu'i tshe dang bkrag mdangs zad mi shes pa stsol ba'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ 'khor gyi gtso bo dmag dpon/ blon po/ ru 'dren/pho nya/ lha klu dam tshig can/ mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga/ bstan ma bcu gnyis yul lha gzhi bdag tu gtogs so cog /rigs dang rgyud kyi srung ma 'khor bcas la mthun rdzas dang sbyar ba'i gser skyemasadam pa 'dis gsol zhing mchod do/ /dgyes pa chen po skyed par gyur cig /'phrin las kyi gnyer kha zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las gang bcol ba sgrub par mdzad du gsol/ gong gi mchod rdzas so gos(116na)rgyas pa ma 'byor na gsang 'phye gser skyems tsam/ raṃ me khaṃ gis bsregs gtore sbyangs/ oṃ āḥlha gis bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs te phul bas kyang 'grub bo/ khyad par gyi 'phrin las gnyer gtad ni/lhaḥ gnod sbyin chen po 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis/ /bu ram shing pa'i bstan pa rgyas pa dang / /de 'dzin skyes bu rnams kyi sku tshe brtan/ /'dus pa'i sde rnams chos spyod 'phel bar mdzod/ /stobs kyi dpung pas yangs pa'i nor 'dzin la/ /dbang sgyur sal spyod pa'i tshangs pa che'i/ /sku tshe mtha' thang mtshan byus chab srid rnams/ /yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzod/ /'jig rten spyi dang khyad par gangs can 'dir/ /mi phyugs nad rims dus kyi zhakhrug pa dang / /'thab rtsod mu ge ma lus rab zhi zhing / /phan bde'i dga' ston mchog la spyod par mdzod/ /rgyal ba'i bka' rnams 'dri zhing klog pa —250

dam can chos srung mag rtogs tson las rnam sto lhun grub/ (gedang //mchod dang sri zhur byed la gegs med cing //de don sgrub pa'i sbyin pa'i bdag po yi//bsam pa'i don kun lhun gyis grub par mdzod//bshes gnyen chen po grwa pa mngon shes kyi//gtsug lag khang dang sde rnams 'phel zhing rgyas//chos nor ga kho gyi bum pa bzang po yis//'dod pa'i re ba skong ba'i dngos grub stsol//gto rag gi mchod pa ni/mchod pa rnams sngar ltar byin gyis brlabs shing /nyer spyod rol mo sogs kyis mchode cing bstod/yi ge brgya pa 'don/ma nyes yongs su ma shes dang /zhes sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu zhes so gos kyis rten la brtan bzhugs/rten med pa'i 'khor rnams lag smo swa bhā 6bsgo/zhes pas gshegs su gsol/smon lam ni/dge ba 'di yis mar gyur 'gro ba rnams//bla med byang chub mchog la 'god pa'i ched//bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sar+pā po//tshe 'dir mngon du 'gyur ba'i rgyur gyur cig mas pa brjod pa ni//dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs//brtul zhugs grub pa'i dbang por rnam rol pa//slob dpon chen bo pad+ma thod 'phreng sogs//rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tsho gos kyi bkra shis shog/rab stims rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i gsang ba kun//44 zhing bka' yi sdud pa rdo rje 'dzin/khro bo yid bang po khang bu brtsegs pa sogs//yi dam lha tsho gos rnams kyi bkra shis shog/byang phyogs gnod sbyin bye ba'i sde dpon skur//bas nas mchog mthun dngos grub sa 'bebs pa//spyo blon wo po rdo rje bdud 'dul sogs//dam can chos srung rnams kyi bkra shis shog/gzhan yang bkra shis pa'i tshigasabacad ci rigs pa bya'o//smras pa/deng dus gangs can ljongs 'dir mkhas rlome 'ga'//snga 'gyur chos kyi rang skad nyer bor nas//gsar ma'i chog sgrigs kho na lhur len pa//de dag skom 'dod smig rgyur bsnyegs pa bzhin//la la snga phyir 'gyur ba'i mgon po kun//gcig bsdus sgrub chen bka' brgyad yi ge las//rgyas bkab rang bzos gzhan mgo nyer bskor ba//dbang lung chos kyi rgyun bral nam mkha'i 'ja'//nyam can gdol gtam smra la dam pa zhes//mkhas blun dbye ba med pa'i dus ngan 'dir//gang dran yi ger bris kyang dpyad pa dang //rtsod cing rgol ba'i byed po wo skar bzhi//dzo

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4) kyang las gos rnam bzhag phra (117na stanang zab/ /kun la gces pa thub bstan yin pa'i phyir/ /brgyud ldan dam pa'i sgros dang man ngag bzhin/ /rang bzos bslad pa med pa deng 'dir spel/ /dge 'dis nam mkha' ji srid gnas kyi bar/ /gnod sbyin chen po rdo rje bdud 'dul gyis/ shākya'i bstan pa legs par bsrung byas te/ /bde skyid dpal gyis 'jig rten khyab par shog /ces gnod sbyin chen po rdo rje bdud 'dul gyi las byang yongs 'du'i 'khri shing zhes bya ba 'di ni grwa bsam dar ba mda' dpon blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis don gnyer chen pos bskul pa la brten nas/ mgon po 'di nyid kyi phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rjes su gnang ba mi dbar khyis ma chod pa'i brgyud pa ma nyams pa las 'ongs pa zur 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i drung du legs par nos pa dang slar sprul sku gter bdag gling pa'i drung du rjes gnang lung man ngag thos shing / gsang chen rnying ma'i chos tshul 'di la ring du sbyangasapa'i za hor gyi btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos bstan pa spyi la tshad thub tu gyur pa'i mkhas pa chen po lo chen bsod nams rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i las byang las btus shing rigs 'dzin brgyud pa'i gsung sgros kyis rnam par brgyan te khro mo zhes pa shing 'brug nag pa zla ba'i yar ngo'i tshes bcu'i dusapho brang chen po po ta lar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas ban 'jam dbyangs so/ /snang srid dregs pa yongs kyi cod pan du/ /zhabs sen nor bu'i 'od stong cher 'bar ba/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal/ /byang chub bar du rigs kyi bdag por bzhugs/ /de la 'dir gsang ne'u thog gi srung ma btsun rgod gnod sbyin gse'i khrab can la mchod gtore 'bul (117ba tha'i tshul ni/ rang nyid ji ltar mos pa'i yi dam gyi lha'i bdag skyed sngon du 'gro dgos pas mchod gtor byin rlabs sogs de'i lugs su byas nas/ rten bskyed pa ni/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun du pad+ma nyi ma dgra bgegs bsnol ba'i steng du/ rtsa dmar po las 'od zer 'phros gnod byed dgra bgegs rnams tshar bcad tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ gnod sbyin btsan rgod bse'i khrab can sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag 'ganyas spyan gsum dmar la zlum la/ khro gnyer smin mtshams su bsdus shing / yas —252

dam can chos srung mngon rtogs 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)sos mas mchu mnan pas mche ba gangs ri ltar 'tsher ba/ g.yas tsan dan gyi beng chen 'phyar ba las sprul pa'i dmag tshogs 'gyed pa/ g.yon dgra bo'i mgo lus 'ching ba'i zhags pa thugs kar sdigs mdzub dang bcas te 'dzin pa/ dbu la bse rmog rgyal mtshan ru dar gyis spras pa/ sku la dar dmar gyi tsi ber steng du bse khrab gsol ba/ rked la stag dong gzig shubs ral gris mdzes pa/ rta mchog rag pa sga srab dar gyi cod pan can bcibs pa/ bya pho tsha lu rol tu khrid la/ de'i g.yas su sku'i sprul pa klu btsan mthing nag rang 'dra'i mdog dang mtshungs pa'i dar thod dang 'jol ber dgu brtsegs gsol ba/ sbrul zhags 'dzin cing rta bra nag la zhen pa/ sprul pa sbrul nag 'bum sde tshwad pa/ g.yon na gsung sprul btsan rgod dmar nag dar dmar gyi thod dang tsi ber gsol ba/ g.yas btsan zhags dmar po 'phen zhing / g.yon dar 'phen dmar po sgreng ba/ rta dmar zhon zhing / sprul pa spre'u dmar po 'gyed pa/ mdun du thugs sprul lha rigs dkar po dar dkar gyi gos dang thod gsol zhing rin po ches(118na tha rgyan pa/ g.yas zhags pa dkar po 'phen zhing / rta dkar zhen pa'i srab mda' g.yon pas 'dzin pa/ dge slong gi cha byad can gyi sprul pa 'gyed pa/ rje'i rgyal po rin po che mtshar sdug can/za 'og dmar khra'i tsi ber gsol ba/ g.yas sba lcag dang / g.yon pas dung dkar 'bud pa/ rta bra nag zhen zhing stag shar pho nyar 'gyed pa/ rgyab tu yon tan gyi sprul pa gter gyi srung ma dkar po le brgan gyi thod bcings shing / dar dkar gyi ral gu gsol ba/ g.yas zhags pa dang g.yon sba lcag 'dzin pa/ bya pho tsha lu zhen zhing byi la gwa pa spra par 'gyed pa/ mtshams bzhin 'phrin las kyi sprul pa btsan gyi dmag dpon mdog dmar bse'i khrab can dar thod dmar po bcings pa/ g.yas zhags pa dang g.yon sba lcag bsnams pa/ rta rag pa rting dkar zhen pa sngags nag pho nyar 'gyed pa/ de dag gi 'khor du sprul pa yang sprul dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ gtso 'khor de rnams kyi dpral bar ā+oṃ/mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ bdag mdun gyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas chos skyong 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ dzaḥ 'chi med lha yi khang —253

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)bzang dam pa dang / /brag dmar srin po khros 'dra'i gnas mchogo nas/ /gnod sbyin btsan rgod chen po bse'i khrab can/ /'khor dang bcas pa gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /sangs rgyas kun dngosapad+ma thod 'phreng sogs/ /rtsa rgyud bla mas bka' bsgos dam bzhag pa/ ji ltar bsrung zhing rten gnasargya bod kyi/ /gtsug lag khang bzang rnams nas (118ba tshe/zhegs su gsol/ /khyad par bod yul 'jig rten mig gcig pu/ /skad gnyis smra ba blo ldan shes rab kyi/ /bstan pa bstan 'dzin dge 'dun sde bcas rnams /bsrung phyir g.yar dam dgongs te gshegs su gsol/ /ma hā yak+ṣa tsa sa pa ri wā ra dzaḥlha baṃ sngos gnyis med du bstim/ gong gi sngags gsham du a nas sha rdi'i bar btagasate chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa 'bul/ chos skyong 'khor bcas kyi ljags 'od zer sbu gu'i rnam pa can gyi gtor ma'i bcud drangs te gsol bar bsams la/ gong gi sngags gsham du i rda bā kla ta kha kha 'a hi khā hi/ lan gsum mam bdun gyis gtso bo dang / 'khor rnams la a kā ros 'bul/a: sogs kyis mchod cing sngags gzham du oṃ āḥlha btags te nang mchod 'bul/ 'phrin lasa'achol ba ni/ hoḥ rgyal po gnod sbyin chen po bse'i khrab can 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis/rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal po/ riṭa 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas/ rngog lo blo ldan shes rab sogs bla ma dam pa rnams kyi spyan sngar g.yar dam gnyen po zhal gyis bzhes pa bzhin/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa srungs/dkon cog gi dbu 'phang stod/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs/ 'gro ba'i bde skyid spel/ khyad par gsang ne'u thog gi chos grwas mtshon pa'i lo tsā ba khu dbon dang / cha gtsang yab sras rnams kyi ring lugasagang du rgyas pa'i dgon gnas 'dus sdodang bcas pa bsrung zhing bskyabs te/ sdosnod gsum gyi thosabasam dang / bslab pa gsum gyi nyams len sogs 'khor lo gsum gyi bya ba rnams 'phel ba dang /bdag sogs rnams kyi 'gal rkyen bar gcod zhi zhing mthun rkyen bsam (119na ton yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ bskang ba ni/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas byin gyis brlabs te/ hūṃ/rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rba rlabs 'brugs/ /dbang po'i me tog phung por brtsegs/ /sha gsur dud pa sprin —254

dam can chos srung mngon rtogs 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)bzhin gtibs/ /zhun chen snang gsal nyi ltar gsal/ /zhag chen dri chab snod du gtams/ sha rusabaza' dang bca' ba'i zas/ /sna tsho gis rol mo 'brug stong ldir/ /srog skyob sra brtan rdo rje'i go /pha rol 'joms pa sna tshogs mar/ /stong gsum bgrod byed cang shes rta/ /'o ma'i rgyun 'dzin 'dod 'jo'i ba/ /spra spre'u byi la mtsha' lu'i bya/ /ra lug 'brong g.yag glang seng stag /gtor ma'i ri bo mkha' la bsnyeg /ja chang btung ba mtsho ru bskyil/ /ri rab gling bzhi nyi zla zung / /rgyal srid bdun dang 'dod yon lnga/ /mdor na lha mi'i dpal 'byor kun/ /dngos 'byor bshams dang yid sprul rnams/ /nam mkha' mdzod du byin rlabs te/ /bse yi khrab can thugs dam bskang / /sprul pa rnam drug thugs dam bskang / /'khor tshogs rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang / /dam sgongs nyams chags gsos gyur cig /bstod pa ni/ lhaḥ pad+ma rā ga'i lhun po rta gdong mes/ /lan brgyar 'byud pa'i dpal 'dzin srin po'i gzugs/ /'jigs drang gar dgu'i nyams kyi rnam rol pa/ /chos 'khor skyong ba'i srung ma che la bstod/ /dbu la gsal 'tsher 'bar ba'i bse rmog gyon/ /lhag lhag 'od stong 'byug pa'i bse khrab gsol/ /sga srab chas mdzes cang shes la bcibs nas/ /srid gsum skad cig myul ba khyod la bstod/ /dmag tsho gos bye ba 'gyed pa'i beng chen (119ba phra phyar/ /dgra bgegs 'ching ba'i zhagasapa thugs gar 'dzin/ /rked la stag ral gzig shubs ral gri 'phyar/ /mthu ldan btsan rgod chen po khyod la bstod/ /sku gsung thugs dang yon tan 'phrin las kyi/ /sprul pa zhi dang khro chags rol gar mkhan/ /rnam 'gyur cir yang ston pa'i mthu rtsal can/ /lha klu btsan rgod rigs gyur rnams la bstod/ /ban sngags mon pa stag shar ā tsar+ya/ /mtsha' lu bya po sprul nag spra sprel sogs/ /grangs med sprul pa 'jigs rung 'khor chogs kyi/ /sa gzhi bar snang khyon kun 'gengs la bstod/ /zas gtsang sras kyi bstan pa rin po che/ /bshad dang sgrub pas spel ba 'i 'dus pa sde/ /de 'dzin skyes bu rgyu sbyor sbyin pa'i bdag /yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzod/ /'jig rten kun tu nad mug gzug rtsod sogs/ /dus kyi chad pa ma lus kun zhi nas/ /brgyad khri'i tshe thub 'dzam gling mi bzhin du/ /rdzogs—255

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)ldan gsar ba'i rtse dga' dgod par mdzod/ /khyad par pha rol phyin dang tshad ma sogs/ /rgyan drug mchog gnyis gzhud lugs thos bsam gyis/ /gtan la 'bebs pa'i gsang phu ne'u thog /rjes 'brang bcas kun dar zhing rgyas par mdzod/ /mdor na bdag cag dgon gnas mi nor kun//bstan srung chen po khyod la gnyer gtod na/ /nyin mtshan dus drug bsrung zhing skyob pa dang / /zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las lhun grub mdzod/ /nongs pa bzod gsol dang / rten yon na brtan bzhugs/med na gshegs gsol spyi ltar bya/ shis pa brjod cing me tog gi char dbab bo/ /srung ma 'di nyid 'phags pa'i yul du brtul zhugs grub pa'i dbang (120na)po pad+ma thod 'phreng gis dam la btags pa'i chos skyong khyad par can zhig yin 'dug na'ang / 'di pa'i sgrub skor gter byon 3 thub ma mthong zhing / lo tsā ba chen po'i rjes su 'brangs ba tsam las de nyid nas brgyud pa'i yi ge'ang ma mchis pas/deng sang gsol mchod 'dra 'dug pa rnams khungs med kyi yig hrul dang blos byas sna tshogs snang bar yid brtan dka' la/ sngags gsar rnying gang gi lugs su byed pa'i kha tshon ma chod pas/ mun par mda' 'phen tsam du zad mod/ 'on te gling smad chos rje bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/ nyang re bra yag sku skye/mi nyag 'gri ba kha pa sogs kyis don gnyer chen pos bskul ba la brten nas za hor gyi brnyes g.yar khral tsam du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sngags ban ngag dbang 'phrin las so/ /rgya gar mkhas grub yongs kyi 'khor los sgyur/ /bram ze mchog sred 'phags mchog klu sgrub zhabs/ /gangs can rdor 'dzin bye ba'i gtsug gi rgyan/ /sa skya pa zhes snyan pa'i grags pa dkar/ /gang de'i snyan brgyud mnga' bdag tshar pa rje'i/ /bstan 'dzin bka' drin mtshungs med gnas gsar ba'i/ /gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin zur chen rdo rje 'chang / /pha rgod bla ma rnam gnyis gtsug tu bsten/ /mgon po che chung las mkhan dmar nag gi /bskang bshags rgyun 'khyer tshig nyung don gsal ba'i/ /nyin byed kho bo'i blo gros mkhar shar tshe/ /don gnyer re ba'i 'dab stong rnam par bzhad/ /'dir mgon po rnam gnyis las mkhan mon bu dang gnod sbyin chen po rnams kyi bskang bshags ngag 'don nyung dur spel ba la/ dam —256

dam can chos srung mngon rtogs 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)rdzas spyan gzigs mchod gtor sogs tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos (120bsgo dzad pa'i mchod gtor gyi lhan thabs dngos grub rol mtsho dang mthong brgyud kyi phyag len las shes par byas te/ rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor zhing a skṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang dra las gzhal yas khang tshad dang mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan pa'i nang du mchod rdzas rnams a las thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i chu nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ oṃ a āḥlha/ de bzhin du 'bru gsum sbyar ba'i pā hūm̐ nas sha rdi'i bar dang / oṃ badz+ra gharnye ṇi ta sogs tshar gsum brjod/ de nas lam sdus brag rdzong sogs bdag skyed gang yang rung ba sngon du btang nas nang mchod byin gyis brlabs/ bshags pa ni/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid sogs sgro ka gcig dang / yi dam dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i lha/ /nag po lcam dral gdong bzhi pa/ /las mkhan 'khor tsho gis rgya mtshor bcas/ /phyag 'os kun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal mgon lcam dral bka' sdod dang bcas pa/legs ldan gdong bzhi yab yum bka' sdod dang bcas pa khyed rnams la gsol ba ni/ bdag cag 'khor bcas rnams kyi ma rig pa'i dbang gis srung ma khyed rnams kyi sku gsung thugs nyams chags su gyur pa mtha' dag spros bral gyi dbyings su bshags so/ /nongs par thams cad zhi bar gyur cig /phyi nang gsang ba'i dam rdzas 'di rnams kyis bstan srung dam pa khyed rnams kyi thugs dam skong bar gyur cig /de ltar gyur ba'i mthus bdag cag rnams kyi bar gcod thams cad zhi zhing dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ khyed thugs gsang ba dam pa'i (121nasgo dzod/ /dgyes pa chen po'i sgo phye la//dngos grub 'phrin las bdud rtsi yi/ /rgyun gyis bdag rgyud gtams par mdzod/ /lan gsum brjod/dam tshig nyams chags thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /bzod par gsol lo/ tshangs par stsal du gsol/ bskang rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang hūm̐ las drag po'i gzhal yas khang tshad dang mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan pa'i nang —257

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)du a las ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du bskang rdzas rnams dgra bgegs bsgral ba las byung ba'i mchod yon nyer spyod/ rol mo/ bla bre/ lda ldi/ gzhan yang rta mchog g.yag lug bya khyi/mi nag stag gzig go mtshon/ gtor ma/ bdud rtsi/ dza gad sogs mchode rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa mgon po rnam gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa'i spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig /nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags dang phyag rgya bya/ mgon chen gyi bskang gso ni/ /thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer sa pas zhes pa nas/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pa'i bar gtor chog pho nya myur mgyoṭa ltar bya/ lhaḥrnam snang thugs klong rang bzhin gnas rnams nas/ /dpal ldan ma hā kā la lcam dral dang / /gnod sbyin yab yum mo na pa ming sring sogs/ /'phrin las bsgrub phyir spyan 'dren da tshur spyon/ /ā+oṃ shrī ma hā kā wā ya zhes pa nas/ pad+ma /mā lā ye rto/ sngags mchode/ dam bsgrag /gtor 'bul/ 'phrin las 'cholab rnams pho nya myur mgyogs ltar byed/ lhaḥ khrag gi mchod yon dbang lnga'i me tog dang / /tshil rkang klad dud zhun chen til mar sgron/ /rang byung dri chab sha chen spungs pa'i zan/ /rkang gling thod (121ba)rnga rol mo'i sgra dbyangs kyis/ /gur mgon ral gcig lha mo 'dod khams ma/ /gnod sbyin yab yum pu tra lcam dral sogs/ /thugs dam skong zhing nyams chags gsos gyur nas/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /dza gad bdud rtsi sha khrag gtor ma spungs/ /gri thod khrag bkang g.yang gzhi'i bla bre dang / /rkang rus gcal bkram rgyu rlon lda ldi yis/ /gur mgon ral gcig lha mo 'dod khams ma/ /gnod sbyin yab yum pu tra lcam dral sogs/ /thugs dam skong zhing nyams chags gsosagyur nas/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /khrag zhag dri gsur rnam dag tshogasagator spungs/ /bya nag lding zhing rta mchog rlung ltar 'phyo/ /g.yag rgod ra gdengs lug nag lcags ru can/ khyi nag seng ge mi nag gar byed pa'i/ /gur mgon ྾/ /gnod sbyin ྾/ /thugs dam ྾/ /rnal 'byor ྾/ /'brang rgyas khrag gi thig btab rak+ta 'khyil/ /gsang rten gri snying 'bru sna stong gi chang / /smyug rgod bya rgod sgros brgyan mda' bo che/ /nam mkha' rgyang bu 'phan gdugs rab mdzes pas/ /—258

dam mā chos srung ma' rtog phren la rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 'digur mgon ྾//gnod sbyin ྾//thugs dam ྾//rnal 'byor ྾//lug nag rgyal mtshan snying dang g.yab dar nag/dmar nag bsgos bu sman rag gri rgod snying //gsur chen rtag gtor rgyun gtor la sogs pa//mas pa'i dam rdzas 'dod yon spyan gzigs kyis//gur mgon ྾//gnod sbyin ྾//thugs dam ྾//rnal 'byor ྾//de ltar dam skongs nyams chags gsos gyur nas//bdag sogs rnams kyi 'gal rkyen kun zhi zhing //gnod pa'i dgra bgegs rdul du rlog pa dang //mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol//zhal gyi bskang gso ni/122na ) rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer los pa zhes pa nas/badz+ra sa mā dza ༷'i bar gtor chog ltar byas/te se gra 'dzin bsil tshal ha ha dgod//dar lung kha'u dpal ldan sa skya nas//rdo rje nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa//yab yum 'khor tsho gis rgya mtsho gnas 'dir gshegs//ā+oṃ ma hā kwa la kā la zhes pa nas/pad+ma ka ma lwa ye pre gyi bar dang /sngags mchode/dam bsgrag gtor 'bul/'phrin las 'chol ba rnams gtor chog ltar bya/hūṃ/legs ldan dbang po 'khor bcas spyan lam du//g.yag rog zhol chen cang shes rting dkar 'phyo//lug nag spyi dkar bya nag khyung ltar lding /khyi nag snying dkar rgyan gyis brgyan pa 'dis//stobasa'aphrog dbang po yab yum thugs dam bskang //bka' sdod 'khor tsho gos rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang //thugs dam skong zhing nyams chags dag gyur nas//'gal rkyen kun zhi dngos grub char ltar phob//rak+ta'i a me tog nag po dang /sha tshal bdug spos zhun chen snang gsal sbar//khrag zhag dri chab bsgos bu dmar nag spungs//rkang gling sil snyan rol mo'i tsho gos rnams kyis//stobs 'phrog ྾//bka' sdod ྾//thuṭa dam ྾//'gal rkyen ྾//dam rdzas gtor ma bdud rtsi dza gad phud//gri gug ral gri rtse gsum mdung rnon mar//1 bum pa rus 'phreng mi rkang gling //rdo nag maṇ+ḍal gri snying srog 'khor gyis//stobs 'phrog ྾//bka' sdod ྾//thugs dam ྾//'gal rkyen ྾//de ltar legs ldan gdong bzhi 'khor bcas rnams//thugs dam dbyings skong dgyes pa rab bskyed nas//rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la///nod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs rdul du rlog/tshe

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya rme gsung 'bum/ 64)dang bsod nams(122brko pa la 'byor mnga' thang rgyas/ /dam chos bsgrub pa'i mthun rkyen ma lusatsha / /thun mong dngos grub bsgrub la thogs med cing / /myur du rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob mdzod/ /dam can mon bu lcam dral gyi bskang ba ni/ lhaḥ gtum drag rab 'bar gnod sbyin yab yum gnyis/ /skye 'gro'i srog bdud gshin rje pu tra nag /bdud chen bha tra shar ral gcig ma/ /'khor dang bcasapa gnas 'dir da tshur spyon/ /badz+ra kā la yak+ṣa ye/ kā li yak+ṣa si/ yak+ṣa pu tre ye/ ru trar bha dra ye/ lu ru rak+ṣa si/ sa pa ri wā ra e gye hi/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥ/ baṃ ho :ཿ dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i bshasar gshin rje'i grong / /2 chen kha sbub gan rkyal bsnol ba'i khrir/ /gnod sbyin yab yum mon pa ming sring rnams/ /dgyes par bzhugs la 'phrin las ma lus sgrubs/ /gong gi sngags gsham du sarba bisna na sha ༷ / be ta ā san tiṣ+ṭha / / bdud rtsi lnga ldan ma da na yi mtsho/ /mi bzad gdug can dgra bo bsgral ba'i snying / /rba rlabs 'khrug pa'i khrag gi a: 'di/ /las mgon yab yum sras 'khor bcasapar 'bul/ gong gi sngags gsham du ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ ma hā tsit+ta khā hi/ rak+ta khā hi/ hūṃ bh+yoḥlas mgon 'khor dang bcas pa'i spyan lam du/ /rta nag 'brong g.yag bdud lug khyi nag bya/ mi nag cher dgod drel nag rting dkar can/ /bong bu ga dmar rgyan gyis rab mdzes pas/ /gnod sbyin yab yum pu tra ming sring dang / /ru 'dren sdo bzhi dregs pa sdebargyad kyi/ /thugs dam gnyen po dbyings su skong byed na/ /nyams chags kun dag las bzhi lhun grub mdzod/ /rnga yab nal bu'i rgyal mtshan thod pa'i nang / /snying snas cher bkang dmar gtor khrag chang 'khyil/ /bza' bca' (123na phog mtshan zhwa gos nag po yis/ /gnod sbyin ྾/ /ru 'dren ྾/ /thugs dam ྾/ /nyams chags mo/ /smyug rgod mda' chen bse lcags byang bus brgyan/
