/dgra bgeṭa nya bor khram gyi ri mo btab/ /stag gzig pags pa'i ras ma g.yer kha 'brol/ /bla rdo rdzas rgod srog snying 'khor lo yis/ /gnod sbyin ྾/ /ru 'dren ྾/ /thugs dam ྾/ /nyams chags za/ /dam nyams bsgral ba las byung nyer spyod lnga/ /bla bre lda ldi rus rgyan go mtshon dang / /stag gzig dom dred shun lpags sgrub pa po/ khros pa'i rgyan spras—260

dam mā chos srung ma' rtogs wen las rnam pha lhun grub/ 9)gsang sngags cher sgrog pas//gnod sbyin ྾//ru 'dren ྾//thugs dam ྾//nyams chags ྾//thugs dam skong na lha khyod dgyes pa'i zhal//sgrub mchog rnal 'byor bdag la rab ston la//dgra bgegs dpung tshogs phye mar 'thag pa dang //bsam pa'i don kun lhun gyis grub par mdzod//las mkhan beg tse'i bskang ba ni/lhaḥbh+yoḥbyang shar dbang drag rol pa'i dur khrod nas//gnod sbyin srog bdag zangs kyi beg tse can//sring mo rig pa'i lha mo gar dbang ma//las mkhan sgrol ging 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs//oṃ ra smo bra ṇa at+pa sa pa ri wā ra ā da r+ṣa ya dzaḥdzaḥ/ baṃ ho dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur//pad+ma ka ma lā ya sto/mchod yon nyer spyod sna lnga gser skyems dang //btsun bsgos phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod rdzas rnams//bse yi skyes bu 'khor dang bcasal 'bul//bzhes nas bdag la mthu dbang dngos grub stsol//sngags mchode dang gtor 'bul 'phrin las 'cho pa ba rnams gtore chog ltar bya/kye/ra dmar khrag chang mchod yon dbang po lnga'i//me tog sha tshil dud 'thul zhun chen sgron//123ba7khris pa'i dri chab sha rus zhal zas dang //rkang gling dung chen snyan brjid rol mo'i sgras//gnod sbyin dbang po beg tse lcam dral dang //las mkhan srog bdag 'khor dang bcas rnams kyi//thugs dam skong zhing dgyes pa skyed gyur nas//rnal 'byor 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis sgrubs//ro bda'i gser skyems ra skyes kham pa dang //zhol g.yag rta dmar dur ba srin bya khra//go mar 'ug pa'i sgros brgyan mda' bo che//tshogs gtor 'dod yon rgyal srid sna bdun gyis//gnod sbyin ྾//las mkhan ྾//thugs dam skong ྾//rnal 'byor 'phrin las ྾//gnod sbyin dbang po lcam dral 'khor bcas rnams//rnal 'byor bdag gis rtag tu khyod bsten na//gnod byed gzugs can gzugs med sde dpung rnams//thal bar rlog la bsams pa'i don rnams sgrubs//chos skyong rnams spyir 'phrin las 'chol bar spro na//lha bstan srung rgya mtsho'i sdedapon rdo rje gur//stobs 'phrog legs ldan nag po gdong bzhi pa//srog gshed las mkhan pu tra ming sring che//dgra bo'i bshan pa beg tse lcam dra/ dgongs//dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag rdo

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)rje 'chang / /'phags bod mkhas grub grub brnyes lo paṇa tshogs/ /'khon ston 'jam dbyangs rim byon sa skya pa/ khyad par tshar chen yab sras brgyud bcas kyis/ /phyi rol dur khrod brgyad du rab rgyu ba'i/ khro gtum dregs pa'i dmag gi dpung tsho gis rnams/ /gtor ma'i ri bo rak+ta'i rgya mtsho bskyil/ /phyi nang gsang rten rdzas kyis bsten cing mchod/ /nang du rdo rje'i lus kyi rtsa rlung khams/ khyud gsum dregs pa'i sgyu 'phrul rol par shar/ /gsang ba gsal stong zung 'jug bde ba che/ /sems nyid gcig pur nges pa'i rang zhal bltas/ /dam tshig rdo rje'i ra ba sra zhing mkhreg /(124na8na byed dbang gi chu bo ma nub 'phel/ /las bzhi smin grol gnad gsang lngags pa med/ /man ngag mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs thul le ba/ /snyan nas snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi ldan chos/ /'dzin mkhas rdo rje'i slob dpon rim byon gyis/ /rdo rje gtsug bzhag lce la mna' chu blud/ /dam tshig bsngags pa'i g.yar dam nyer dgongs la/ /phan bde'i rtsa lag kun mkhyen shākya'i bstan/ /bshad dang sgrub pas dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel zhing / khyad par kha'u par grags slob bshad kyi/ /ring lugs srid mtha'i bar du rgyas par mdzod/ /'jig rten kun tu nag po'i gos smin pa'i/ /dus kyi chad pa ming yang mi grags cing / /bye brag gangs can kha ba'i sman ljongs 'dir/ /'gro kun bde skyid dpal la spyod par mdzod/ /yang sgosarnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /snga dgra lag dar phyi dgra yid la sems/ /da dgra gnod cing 'tshe ba'i gdug can dpung / /rgyab rten mi dang mi min bcas pa kun/ /gnam gyi 'ju thag gnyen po steng sna rtanas chad/ /sa yi brten phur rtsa ba 'og nas phyung / /bsod nams stobs ra mnga' thang kun dang phrol/ /bla srog tshe gsum spar kyis thob la bkumu/ /yid srubs las rgyal ba dan srid rtser phyor/ /med byung snyan grags rdo rje phyogs bcur sgrogs/ /mi shigs rdo rje'i srog gi ka ba tshugs/ /bsod nams nyi ma'i dngos brgya'i gzi byin skyed/ /tshe 'dir grub mtha' stogs par ma gyur na/ /'chi ba 'od gsal dpal ldan nag po ches/ /sngar 'dris mdza' bo bzhin du grogs mdzad nas/ /mkha' spyod bde chen dag pa'i zhing du drongs/ /ring por mi thogs rigs rnams kun gyi bdag /zung 'jug sgyu ma'i gar —262

dam can chos srung ma' rtogs phren las rnam sh+ka lhun grub/ 9)mkhan bcom ldan 'das//dgyes mdzad rdo rje he ru ka 124ba bo pa la gyi//go 'phang ma cane du 'gyur ba'i 'phrin las mdzod//smras pa/ljongs 'dir rmo mes 'gas rgyud dang rgya gzhung khungs//lta ci bzo yi rig pa'i cha tshad tsam//ma shes gdong phyed kha yi tshad yin zhes//smig rgyu chur rlom srung ma gsar du bzo//la la sngon rabs dam pa'i man ngag kun//bor te rna bas thos pa'i mgon po'i tshogs//mu rta'i phye bzhin bsags pa'i dkyil 'khor du//ba lang lta bu'i skye bo 'jug par byed//'ga' zhig dbang khrid man ngag phyag bzhes lung //mi 'tshol dam can rol mos 'khol du re//ham chen chos kyi rgyud med bum stong rnams//phan oṃ 'geng ba'i sgyu ma'i ltad mor g.yeng //'on te tshong 'dus ga pa'i zong bzhi du//gang byung bzang por re ba'i nyo tshong las//dag dang ma dag dbye ba'i rnam dpyod can//nyin mo'i skar ma las kyang ches cher dkon//de lta na'ang chos skyong che chung gi/zab chos mi dbar khyi yis ma chod pa//legs bshad bdud rtsi snying gi za ma tog/rnam par gang ba'i gdengs tshad cung zad mchos//lugs srol gzhan gyi rgyas bkab rigs bgre dang //gdol gtam mgal dum 'phreng bar spel min par//zhabrul med brgyud pa'i gsung sgros las btus te//don gnyer blo yi re ba skong phyir bkod//dge 'dis rdo rje srin po 'khor bcas kyi//mthu stobs gnam lcags 'bar ba'i thog mda' yis//yid srubs dpung gi brag ri phyer btags nas//nges gsang bstan pa rgyasapa'i bkra shis shog/ces rdo rje'i chos skyong che chung las mkhan rnam gnyis dang bcas pa'i bskang ba phun tshogs 'dod dgu'i dpal ster zhes pa 'di ni se dkar rigs kyi thig le 'dar pa ngag dbang 'phrin las kyis bskang ba rgyun 'byer nyung ngu 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes bskul ba la brten nas 25nang hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas btsun 'jam dbyangs so////rta thugs dkar po la brten nas dgra lha gsol ba ni/dgra lha'i spyan gzigs go mtshon/phye mar/chang phud/mda' dar/rta sga bcas/dar lcog sogs bshams/shing sna dang spos sna bsregs pa'i dud pa dang bcas/kye/sngon gyi dus su lha dbang brgya byin gyis//bsten cing mchod pa'i dgra lha 6

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)mthu bo che/ /de ring rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po yi/ /dgra lhar 'bod do rten la brtan par bzhugs/ /lha khyod sku mdog dkar po 'od zer 'phro/ /sra ba'i gnam lcags rmog mo dbu la brgyan/ /rin cen gser gyi khrab chen sku la gyon/ /mdzes pa'i sag lham yu ring zhabs la gsol/ /rno ba'i mdas gang stag dong g.yas su 'phyang / sru ba'i gzhu bcug gzig shubs g.yon na khra/ /rno ngar 'dzom pa'i ral gri rked la btags/ /sba lcag dkar po tshigs gsum phyag tu bsnams/ /rin cen sgra srab mdzes pa'i rta la bcibs/ /lcags kyi bya khra hor pa klad la lding / /phrag gong g.yas na seng ge dkar mo 'gying / /phrag gong g.yon na stag chen drus ma 'phyo/ khyi nag dom dred mang po snga phyir rgyug /sprul pa yang sprul sagazhi ma lus khyab/ /kun kyang dkar phyogs skyong ba'i ru mtshon sgreng / /bstan srung dgra lha chen po 'khor dang bcas/ khyed rnams bzhugs gnas mkhar gyi rtse 'di yin/ khyed rnams rten gnas spyan gzigs 'di dag yin/ /gnas dang rten rdzas rnams la brtan par bzhugs/ khyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po'i stong grogs mdzod/ /lha khyod dgyes pa'i mthun rdzas 'bul ba ni/ /rnam rgyal khang bzang lta bu'i pho brang dang / /smos zhing dbyar skyes myu gu'i 'phreng ba 'khrigs/ /dkar gsum (125bdang ra gsum phye mar shing gos tsā/ /bsgos bu gtsang sbyar rnga dkar 4 rgod phud/ /dar tshwa rin cen dkor nor sna tsho gos spungs/ /rang bsrung srog skyob btsan po'i go cha dang / /pha rol 'joms pa'i rno ngar mtshon cha'i ris/ /mdzes pa'i rta mchog rgyan ldan rlung ltar 'phyo/ /mi gtsang nyes kun sel ba'i bsangasamachod rnams/ /dgra lha chen po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /dgyes pa rab skyed rten la brtan par bzhugs/ kye/ dgung sngon dbyings su g.yu 'brug ldir ba bzhin/ /dgra lha 'khor bcas mi dang ma 'bral zhig /gangs dkar spo la seng ge 'phyo ba bzhin/ /dgra lha 'khor bcas mi dang ma 'bral zhig /sha ba rwa bcu spang la gnas pa bzhin/ /dgra lha 'khor bcas mo/ /chu klung chen por nya mo gnas pa bzhin/ /dgra lha 'khor bcas ྾/ /mtsho la 'dab chags lus dkar brten pa bzhin/ /dgra lha 'khor bcas zo/ /pha mas bu tsha gdung brtses skyong ba bzhin/ /dgra lha 'khor bcas ra/ /nyi zla snang ba'i —2yo

dam can chos srung mngon rtogs tshwan las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)dpal dang 'grogs pa bzhin/ /dgra lha 'khor bcas ྾/ /nor bur 'dod 'jo'i yon tan ldan pa bzhin/ /dgra lha 'khor bcas ྾/ /go mtshon dkor nor spyan gzigs yul mkhar la/ /dgra lha gnyen po dpung tsho gos rten bcas te/ /dbu 'phang ri rgyal lhun po lta bur gtod/ /dgra bo'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal bar mdzod//'jig rten mun pa sel ba nyi zla'i g.yang / /de ring bkra shis gnas 'dir g.yang du len/ /yid bzhin nor bu phun tshogs dgos 'dod gter/ /de ring ba po shis gnas mo/ /tshangs pa brgya byin la sogs lha yi dpal/ /de ring bkra shis gnas ྾/ /'khor los sgyur rgyal la sogs mi yi g.yang / /de ring bkra shis ྾/ /dga' bo 'jog po la sogs klu yi g.yang / /de ring (126na)bkra shis ྾/ /gnod sbyin tsho gos kyi 'dzad med 'byor pa'i g.yang / /de ring bkra shis mo/ /ge sar dpa' rtul 'dzom pa dmag gi g.yang / /de ring bkra shis za/ /rigs brgyud bu tsha grangs med 'phel ba'i g.yang / /de ring bkra shis mo/ /mtshon gyis mi phigs go khrab btsan po'i g.yang / /de ring bkrashis mo/ /gang bsams skad cig bgrod pa rta yi g.yang / /de ring ba po shis mo/ /phun tsho gis phyogasalas rnam par rgyal ba'i g.yang / /gnas 'dir bkra shis phyu dang g.yang du 'khyil/ /dgra lha gnyen po 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis/ /nyin gsum bya ra mtshan gsum mel tshe mdzod/ /rgyab kyi rten sa mdun gyi 'khor ba dang / /phar 'gro'i skyel ma tshur 'gro'i bsu ma mdzod/ /nad gdon chags che bar chad kun las skyobs/ /bsams don lhun gyis grub pa'i bkra shis mdzod/ /ces bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po'i rta thug dkar po la brten nas dgra lha mchod tshul zhig dgos zhes mkha' 'gro blo bzang bstan skyong gis bskul ba la brten nas za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas gsar ba 'jam dbyangs so/ /gar gyi dbang phyug bde chen chos kyi sku/ /he ru ka dpal rta mgrin longs spyod rdzogs/ /pad+ma thod phreng sprul pa'i rnam rol can/ /sku gsum dbyer med zhi khro'i lha tshogs dgongs/ /thugs dam bskul na byin chen char ltar phob/ /sman raka gtor sogs rdzas la nus pa bskyed/ rigs 'dzin rnal —265

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)lor bdag la dbang bskur la//mchog dang thun mong dngos grub deng 'dir stsol//ma tre bsgral ba'i dur khrod sa gzhi'i steng //ri rab rin cen las grub gzhal yas na//dbus phyogs thugs kyi rgyal po brgya byin che//gnyis 'thung 126ba yid na la skyil krung phyed pas rol//sna bzung mon bu yum chen shān+ti ma//sprul pa dge bsnyen blon po srog bdag che//las mkhan bka' sdod ru 'dren sdobazhing bcas//ting 'dzin pir gyis 'ja' tshon lta bur bkra/khru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas//sbu gri 'bar ba 'khor tsho gos bcas ba rnams//tshur spyon tshur spyon pad+ma nyi zla dang //baṃ chen bsnol ba'i gdan la brtan par bzhugs//gsang ba'i bdag po dbang chen rta mchog dpal//pad+ma 'byung gnas gter ston nyang ral sogs//rigs 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma'i spyan snga rtswa/zhal bzhes dran par mdzod cig sam ya//sna tsho gos gzugs kyi rol pa mtha' klas pa//snyan brjid sgra dbyangs ga stong lta bur ldir//don snying dzo ri bzhin du cher spungs pas//sku gsung thugs la dgyes pa bskyed gyur cig/dam nyams bsgral ba'i sha chen phung por sbungs//rab dmar khrag gi gsab mtsho ltar bskyil//dkar 'tsher rus pa gangs ri lta bur brtsegs//dus gsum rdzas kyi mchode pas mnyes gyur cig/dar zab sham bu rin cen tog gis mdzes//rgyal mtshan ba dan dar gyi lda ldig yo//zab chen gur phub ro brgya'i zhal zas bshams/sha chen zan dang rak+ta'i dmar rgyun sbre gser skye mas btung ba rin cen snod du gtams spos dkar tshil chen du dpasprin ltarang // // gtibs//mdzes pa'i spyan gzigs nam mkha'i khams gang bas//thugs dam bskong ngo sku yi dngosagrub stsol//dzornga rnga zlum pi wang rgyud mangs glu//sil snyan dung chen pheg rdob rgya gling sgra//gsang ba'i cang te'u mi rkang gling bu yis//thugs dam bskang ngo gsung gi dngos grub stsol//de ltar mchod bya mgo byed ma 127na sa pa//gdod nas rnam dag rang sems rig pa'i rtsal//don dam dag pa'i dbyings su nges rnyed pas//thugs dam bskang ngo thugs kyi dngos grub stsol//srin po'i gzugasacan mig sman ltar gnag sku//dar nag gos/༷ (theb zhu dom slog can//g.yas pa bdud zhags

dam ༅ chos srung mngon rtogs tshon las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ (gegayon pa spu gri 'dzin/ /sa srungs la bcibs thugs kyi rgyal por bstod/ /sna bzung mon pa nag po rngams stabs rgyu/ /rol du glog dang me lce'i phreng ba 'khrigs/ /gnam lcags thog dang ser ba pho nyar gtong / /mthu stobs rdo 'phrul mnga' ba khyod la bstod/ /dgra lha'i sprul pa dge bsnyen gzhen nu'i gzugs/ /dar dmar ber gsol shel gyi 'phreng bas brgyan/ /g.yas pa sdigs mdzub g.yon pa zangs gri 'phyar/ /cho 'phrul cir yang ston pa khyod la bstod/ /bcu drug dga' bzhi'i zag med bde ba che/ /skyed mdzad gsang ba'i yum chen ro zan ma/ /lcags kyu — don snying phyag na bsnams/ khrag zhag thig les brgyan pa khyod la bstod/ /gdong lnga la bcibs ber smug dgu brtsegs gsol/ /dar nag ru mtshon 'phyar zhing phyogs kun myul/ /bka' yi las mdzad srog bdag bya ra ba/ /dregs pa'i dmag dpon chen po khyod la bstod/ /za 'og stag seng rma bya spyang gi yi/ /sna tsho gos rgyal mtshan 'phyar ba'i las mkhan dang / /cang shes la zhen brtse yi khrab rmog gyon/ /mdung dmar zhags 'dzin pho nya'i tsho gis la bstod/ /stag shar go can bud med ral pa gsig /zhi dul khrims ldan sngags nag phur thogs sogs/ /sa gzhi bar snang khyen kun yongs gang ba'i/ /sprul pa yang sprul 'khor tsho gos rnamasal bstod/ /lha yi dge slong legs ldan nag po yi/ /(127ba〉spyan sngar khas blangs dgra lha khyung chen 'bar/ /phyag na rdo rjes dam la nyer btags tshe/ /gsang ba'i mtshan ni spu gri 'bar bar grags/ /srid gsum zil gnon mtsho skyes rdo rje yis/ /rta mgrin dbang gi dkyil 'khor du bcug ste/ /srog gi snying po blangs nas rgyal ba'i bstan/ /bsrung bar bka' bsgos dam bca' ma g.yel ba/ 'i kya'i bstan pa de 'dzin skyes bu dang / /gtsug lag khrims ldan 'dus sde bcas pa skyongs/ /'jig rten khams su dus kyi chad pa kun/ /rab zhi phan bde'i dpal la sbyor bar mdzod/ khyad par gangs risabaskor ba'i yul ljongs 'dir/ /'thab rtsod zhabrug lo mu ge nad rims sogs/ /mi mthun nyer 'tshe'i ming yang mi grags cing / /rdzogs ldan dga' ston mgron du bsu bar mdzod/ /zhwa ser bstan pa bla nas blar 'degs pa'i/ /gnam skos rgyal po'i mnga' thang chab srid rnams/ /dbyar gyi chu gter —267

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)bzhin du rab 'phel shing / /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /dgra lha che khyod rtag tu gsol mchod pa'i/ /bdag sogs dgon gnas sde dang bcas pa rnams/ /dus kun g.yel ba med par bsrung ba dang / /phun tshogs bkra shis dpal gyis khyab par mdzod/ ces sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po'i gsol mchod gar dbang bde chen zhes bgyi ba 'di ni 'phyos chos 'khor steng gi rgyal po'i bka' nyan btsan rgod kyis bskul ba ltar dngos gzhi 'phrin las don bcu ma gtong dgos pa gzhir bcas rung 'byer bde'i skabs phan pa'i ched du za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas gsar pa 'jam dbyangs so/ /phud gsum 'dus pa g.yang chags nyang yul gyi/ /phu na ri gsum rngam dang brjid ldan (128na)pa/ /gangs dkar sman ljongs rtsi snang me tog rgyas/ /mda' na chu klung chen po chad med 'bab/ /phun tsho gos dge mtshan ldan pa'i yul gru'i dbus/ zhal gyi sku mkhar gser gyi kha bad can/ /rtse mor rgyal mtshan ru mtshon rnam par bkra/ /nang du gser g.yu rin cen khri steng na/ /g.ya' mang rdo rje spun gsum mdzes brjid sku/ /dar dkar thod bcings shel gyi ber chen gsol/ /g.yas pa rgyal mtshan g.yon pa ne'u le bsnams/ /zhabs gnyis rgyal po rol pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs/ /g.yas g.yon spus ru gsum gyi sna 'dren pa'i/ /dmag dpon lha gnyen dpung gi tsho gis bcas rnams/ /tshur spyon tshur spyon gdan la brtan par bzhugs/ /lha ngo mthon por bteg la dgyes zhal ston/ /dri ldan sman chab rgyun gyis sku khrus gsol/ /ljon shing bsregs pa'i dud pas nyams chags bsangs/ /dkar gsum dngar gsum gtor ma 'bras bur spungs/ /bdud rtsi gser skyems snyo ba rgya mtshos mchode/ khrab rmog zhol btags phub chen 'ja' ltar bkra/ /rta mchog lcags gzhibs sga srab rgyan gyis spras/ /gri mdung mda' dar rno ma' rten du 'dzugs/ /dngos bshams yid sprul mthun pa'i spyan gzigs 'bul/ /khyod ni dang bor gshen rab bon gyi lha/ /bar du rgyal dbang pad+mas dam la btags/ /tha mar thu rigs lha tsa'i dgra lha mdzad/ /sngon gyi g.yar dam gnyen po ma yel bar/ /bdag cag mi nor —268—

dam ༅ chos srung mngon rtogs wen las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ rtoge'akhor dang bcas pa rnams/ /gzhis lam byes gsum gang du gnas kyang rung / /'gal rkyen bar gcod thams cad zhi ba dang / /bsams pa ji bzhin 'grub pa'i stong grogs mdzod/ /kye/ mi rta khyi dang 'ug pa'i thod pa rnams/ /brtsegs pa'i (128ba tha dud mkhar 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' nas/ /jo bo gnyer pa seng ge'i gdong pa can/ /'khor bcas tshur spyon dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs/ /sku mdog smug nag gdong lnga'i dbang po'i zhal/ kha gdangs mche gtsigs dmar ser ral pa brdzes/ /za 'og ber gsol rin cen rgyan gyis spras/ /g.yas pa sbrul zhags g.yon pa thod pa bsnams/ /zhabs gnyis za 'og sngon po'i lham gsol nas/ /rgyal po rol pa'i tshul gyis rnam par 'gying / /res 'ga' ban+de sngags pa skyes pa sogs/ /sprul pa sna tsho gos bkye nas rdzu phrul ston/ /mi nag rta nag mi sngon mdung thogs can/ /mi dmar rta dmar khyi nag dom la sogs/ /'jigs su rung ba'i 'khor tsho gos rgya mtshos bskor/ /lcam mo mtsho sman g.yu yi thor tshugs can/ /dar dkar ber gyon dngul dkar me long 'dzin/ sha ba yu mo bcibs nas stong gsum myul/ /klu sman 'bum sde'i 'khor dang bcas rnams la/ /nyams chags dag byed sman gyis sku khrus gsol/ /mi gtsang zhi byed ljon shing dud pas bsangs/ /ro brgya'i ngad ldan gtor ma ri ltar spungs/ /gser skyems sman phud btung ba mtsho ltar bskyil/ /gsol lo mchod do jo chen dgra lha'i rgyal/ /bdag sogs rgyu sbyor bsod namasadapal 'byor dang / /mi nor rigs brgyud chu bo'i rgyun bzhin spel/ /dmag tshong byes su skyabs skyel rgyab rten dang / /gzhis su gang bsams mdun ma lhun grub mdzod/ /ces g.ya' mang rdo rje spun gsum dang jo bo gnyer pa seng gdong gi gsol mchod cig dgos zhes thu rigs legs ldan dbang pos bskul ba la brten nas/ dngos gzhi bod kyi yul lha rnams kyi gsol mchod rgyas par spro na bon gzhung gi yi ge rnying pa rnams (129nasgo gung dang phan yon gnyis ka che bas de ga sor gnas byed pa'i dbang du btang ste rgyun 'byer la mkho ba'i nyung ngu 'di yang za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs dpal bzang ngo / /pad+ma thod 'phreng spyan sngar rgyal ba'i bstan/ /bsrung bar zhal 'tshes—269

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho gsung 'bum/ (4)sprul pa'i chos rgyal che//gsang yum sprul pa pho nya blon po sogs//'khor tsho gos rgya mtsho tshur spyon gdan la bzhugs//chu gnyis nyer spyod sna lnga rol mor bcas//gtor ma'i ri bo sman raka rgya mtshor bskyil//phyi nang gsang mchod nam mkha'i mdzod chen por//ting 'dzin sngags rgyas brlab te 'bul gyis bzhes//bstan 'gro'i phan bde bla ma'i sku tshe spel/khyad par rigs 'dzin bdag cag thosabasam sgom//'chad nyan rnam dkar las kun spyod pa la//gegs med bsams don lhun gyis grub par mdzod//ces pa 'di 'ang mkhan chen zha lu pa khyab bdag rin cen bsod nams mchog grub kyi thugs dam du za tor gyi brnyes bkod pa'o//gter srung zhi ba rdo rje g.yu sgron ma drag mo rdo rje gzhog rgod rtsal la ma rdzo gtor 'bul ba la/gtor ma dmar bo zur gsum pa 'khor ṣ+ka gnyis kyis bskor ba/sman raka/chu gnyis nyer spyod sogs phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa rten rdzas rnams tshogs par byas la/pad+ma nyi zla sbyor ging bsnol ba'i steng //rang wo dbang wo dreṭa pa kun 'dul dmar//be con tho ba rab 'dzin dur khrod mas//brgyad ldan zhabs gnyis dor stabs me klong bzhugs//ā+oṃ ma hā kro dha hūṃ/ā+oṃ ha ya gi wa hūṃ/ā+oṃ pad+ma ta kṛ ta hūṃ/khyoḥhrīḥhrīḥlha hūṃ hūṃ/phaṭaḥphaṭaḥphaṭaḥces bdag 129ba tha skyed gsal btab nas/mchod gtor rnams kyi ma dag pa'i skyon raṃ las ye shes kyi mes bsregs//waṃ las chos nyid kyi rlung gisagator/khaṃ las ho med kyi chus bkrus//oṃ āḥlha gis bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho ོ por gyur/nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas byin gyis brlab/bh+yoḥskyon pad+ma thod phreng spyan snga sa/bstan dang zab gter skyong bar zhal bzhes pa//pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug 'khor bcas rnams//thogs pa med par gnas 'dir da oṃ spyon//rdo rje gzhog rgod 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol//he le 'bar ma 'khor bcas mo//rdo rje g.yu sgron 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol//dung sgang wo mo ྾//dge bsnyen r+ṣa mo ྾//dpal gyi lha mo 'khor yos//pad+ma gar dbang 'khor tsos//de khamasaganas dang 'khor bams྾//klu mo kha wor lha bo/ ༷cas mo//nag mo nad bdag 'khor bams྾//

dam can chos srung mngon rtogs mun las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)rdo rje chos sgron 'khor bcas ྾/ /rdo rje gnas g.yon 'khor bcas ྾/ /klu rgyal chen mo 'khor bcas ྾/ /'khor dang bcas pa gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ oṃ badz+ra bra mo ha tsita hring hring dzaḥdzaḥ yo ru ru he dun ru ma kha kha dun drag mo du ra dun ti dzaḥ drag mo nye ra du ra du snya saḥ sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ dzaḥ zhi ba'i skur bstan rdo rje g.yu sgron ma/ /rab dkar phyag gnyis mda' dar bum pa 'dzin/ /dar gyi na bza' rma bya'i sgro thul dang / /rin cen rgyan mdzes khro chags sgeg ldem can/ /g.yas su rdo rje chos sgron sku mdog dkar/ /rnga chung 'dzin cing rgyan ldan drel rtar bcibs/ /g.yon du rdo rje gnas yon mthing nag mdog /lcags kyu zor ba 'dzin cing (130na lhag la bcibs/ /drag por khros tshe rdo rje gzhog rgod ma/ /srin po'i gzugs can dbu lnga phyag bzhi ma/ /g.yas gnyisalcags kyu rdo rje rtse lnga dang / /g.yon gnyis dgra sta thod pa khrag bkang bsnams/ /dur khrod chas brgyan drel rta rkang gsum bcibs/ /ming po klu rje thod dkar rdzu 'phrul can/ /srin po'i gzugs 'dzin sku smad sprul du 'khyil/ /brang 'gro'i gdengs ka bdun ldan phyag gnyis kyis/ /mi 'dzad rin cen gter gyi sgrom bu 'dzin/ /lcam dral bka' sdod rdo rje dge bsnyen ma/ /dar dkar gos gyon drel rta rkang gsum zhen/ /kun kyang rang rang gdan la brtan par bzhugs/ /pad+ma ka ma wā ye skyoḥ gong gi sngagasaganyis kyi mthar sa pa ri wā ra — nas/ sha rdi'i bar btags pas ma chad/ bstan skyong chen mo zhi drag gtso 'khor rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyis gsol bar bsams la/ gong gi sngagasaganyis kyi gsham du sa pa ri wā ra i rda bha smra ta kha kha khā hi khā hi btags pa bdun nam dgus 'bul ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha kha khā his sman dang / ma hā rak+ta kha ra 'a nyis rak+ta 'bul/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'dod pa'i yon to lnga dang ldan pa 'di nyid bstan skyong chen mo rdo rje gshog rgod ma mawo gzhan rdo rje g.yu sgron ma gsang mtshan pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug ma 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la gsol lo mchod do mgron no bsngo'o/ /dam rdzas rgyan dang ldan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la rigs 'dzin chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang sprul pa'i gter ston shes rab 'od zer brgyud par bcas pa'i bka' —271—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)dang dam las ma 'da' bar sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon cog gi dbu 'phang stod/ bdag cag 'khor 'bangs dang phyogs 'di'i yul grur (130bsgo cas pa bsrung skyob sba ba dang chos srid kyi bsam don thams cad lhun gyis grub par mdzad du gsol/ bh+yoḥ gter srung 'khor dang bcas pa'i spyan lam du/ /sman sna stong ldan mchod yon mtsho ltar bskyil/ /sna tshogs me tog 'ja' tshon lta bur bkra/ khreng sna stong gi dud pa lang long 'khrigs/ /nyi zla nor bu sgron me'i snang gsal 'bar/ /ro brgya'i bza' bca' btung ba snod du gtams/ /sna tshogs snyan pa'i rol mos phyogs kun khyab/ /cang shes rta drel 'brong g.yag 'dod 'arjo'i ba/ /ra lug 'dab chags nor skyong rgyan gyis spras/ /ri rab gtor ma bdud rtsi a skṛ ta/ /rak+ta'i a dbang po'i me tog dang / sha chen dud sprin tshil chen mar me sbar/ /sha rus zhal zas rkang gling thod rnga'i sgra/ /rdo rje'i go mtshon 'bru sna rin cen lnga/ /mda' dar me long dung sho bum pa dang / /lcags kyu dgra sta rdo rje bhan dmar snod/ /dar zab gos dang rin cen rus pa'i rgyan/ /dur khrod chas brgyad rgyal srid rin cen bdun/ /gling bzhi gling phran phyi nang gsang rten rnams/ /dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis rab sprul 'dis/ /zhi ba rdo rje g.yu sgron thugs dam bskang / /drag mo rdo rje gshog rgod thugs dam bskang / /bka' nyan gnas yon chos sgron ྾/ /ming po klu rje thod dkar ྾/ /las byed rdo rje dge bsnyen ྾/ /'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam skongs gyur nas/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las rnam bzhi sogs/ /rnal 'byor bsams pa'i don kun 'grub par mdzod/ /bh+yoḥ rab dkar gangs ri'i mdog 'dzin sgeg mo'i gzugs/ /zhi khro chags ldan za 'og rin chen rgyan/ /mda' dar bum pa 'dzin cing dre'ur bcibs/ /g.yu sgron pad+ma gar dbang khyod la bstod/ /(131nang ba khros mig sman mdog can dbu lnga pa/ /phyag bzhi sna tshogs mtshon thogs dre'u bcibs/ /dur khrod chas brgyad rab 'jigs srin mo'i gzugs/ /dpal chen rdo rje gshog rgod ma la bstod/ /chos sgra dkar mo 'dzum can thod rnga 'dzin/ /g.yas phyogs mdzes pa'i gar bsgyur drel rta zhon/ /gnas yon mthing nag lcags kyu zor ba bsnams/ /g.yon phyogs stag mo'i steng du 'gying la bstod/ /ro stod mi la sbrul gyi —272

dam can chos srung mngon rtogs 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)mjug mar 'khyil//gdengs ka bdun ldan rin cen rgyan gyis spras//gter sgrom bzung nas dngosagrub stsol mdzad pa//ming po klu rje thod dkar khyod la bstod//dar dkar gos gyon bud med gzhon nu'i tshul//sna tsho gos cho 'phrul ma nges cir yang ston//drel rta zhon nas stong gsum kun myul ba//las byed rdo rje dge bsnyen ma la bstod//bstan stong chen mo 'khor dang bcas pa rnams//dbang drag pad+ma rgyal po'i spyan snga mā/khas blangs dam bcas g.yel ba mi mnga' bar//bsam ngan sbyor rtsub 'chang ba'i dgra dpung choms//skye rgu'i bde skyid lung rtogs bstan pa spel//bod 'bangs spyi dang khyad par yul phyogs 'dir//nad rims 'khrug rtsod btsa' than sad ser sogs//mi 'dod nyer 'tshe nam yang mi 'byung zhing //tshe ring nad med 'bru dang rtsi bcud rgyas//mkho dgu'i dpal dang 'byor ba'i 'dod pa 'jo//cho medang srid kyi legs tshogos ma lus pa//yar ngo'i zla ba lta bur 'phel bar mdzod//lha khyod rtag tu gsol zhing mchod byed na//nyin gsum bya ra mtshan gsum mel tshe gyis//brgya phrag nyes pa kun las skyob pa dang //phun sum tshogs pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol//gang yang bdag blo rmongs131ba tha yis//zhes sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol//rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang med na gshegs gso lo bya/sangs rgyas kun 'dus pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal//rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi ba po shis shog/dregs pa zil gnon dbang chen rta mchog dpal//yi dam lha tsho gos rnams ྾//zab gter srung ma pad+ma gar dbang ma//bstan skyong chen mo 'khor bcas mo//ces spyon chen po'i sgrub gnas lha rtse brag gi srung ma bstan stong rdo rjeg khu sgron ma'am rdo rje gshog rgod mar grags pa'i rgyun gsol khyer bde ba 'di ni mchod dpon blo bzang mas stobs kyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes gter byon las btus te bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni gnas ban 'jam dbyangs so//chu bo ri'i gnas srung rnams la mchod gtor 'bul tshul ni/byin rlabs sogs spyi ltar byas la 'di skad do//྅:chu bo bzang po gang bzang nor bu bzang //rgyal ba khyu mchog tshogs bdag sdedapon lnga//gnod sbyin mched gsum bka' sdod mgon po nag/sgo srung mtha' yas 'jog po pad+ma

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)dang / /chu lha bzhi dang mtshams la gnas pa yi/ /ze bo klu btsan sgogs po mtha' dmar gyi/ /rdo rje dgra 'dul btsan sogs mched lcam 'khor/ /ma lus 'dir spyon dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs/ /chu skyes dud sprin snang gsal dri bzang chab/ /ro brgya'i bza' bca' sgra snyan rol mor bcas/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i gtor ma la sogs pa/ /phyi nang gsang mchod 'bul gyis bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā 'o ā bya nu t+pan+da tā tra na maḥsarba ta thā ga to bh+yo bi shwa mu khe 6 ཿ sarba thā zhe ldi te lpa ra ṇa i mo ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa lan gsum mam (132na tha dun gyis gtor ma phul/ mas nas sha ba'i bar gyis mchode/ dpal chen chu bo ri yi phyogs mtshams dang / /steng 'og skyed ba'i srung ma'i tshogasarnams kyis/ /sangs rgyas gnyis pa pad+ma thod 'phreng gi /spyan sngar khas blangs dam las ma 'da' bar/ /'jig rten kun bde thub pa'i bstan pa srungs/ /de 'dzin tsho gis rnams yun du brtan pa dang / /khyad par sgrub gnas sdobacas mthun rkyen spel/ /bdag gi bcol ba'i 'phrin las lhun grub mdzod/ /ma shes nongs par spyad ༷ ma yi/ /rol pa ji bzhin ka dag dbyings su bshags/ /rang rang gnas gshegs slar yang mchod bstod ched/ /byon nas dus kun bkra shis dge legs mdzod/ /cesarigs 'dzin chen po khyab bdag khra tshang pa blo mchog rdo rje dpal chu bo ri'i gnas srung rnams la mchod gtor 'bul ba'i rim pa khyer bde ba zhig dgos tshul byung ba ltar chos rje brag thog pa chen po bsod nams bzang pos mdzad pa'i yig cha nyid khungs btsun par mthong nas de nyid las bcas te za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin no/ /dregs pa'i dbang phyug mthu ldan rgyal po che/ /tshur spyon tshur spyon pad+ma nyi zla dang / /gnyis 'thung seng ge drel rta baṃ chen sogs/ /dgyes pa'i gdan la brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /rak+ta mchod yon gdangs pa'i zhal nang du/ /phul bas dbu 'phreng mche ba'i gos su klubs/ /mig sna rna ba lce snying do shal gyis/ /lha khyod brjid pa'i rgyan du mngon par spud/ /mi ro bsres pa'i dud sprin lang long du/ /'khrig pa shangs kyi dbang po tshim phyir 'bul/ /tshil zhun 'khyil dbus skra yi sdong bu la/ /sbar (132ba)—274

dam ༅ chos srung mngon rtogs mun las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)ba'i snang gsal gzigs mor tshar du dngar/ khrag zhag mkhris pa'i ngad 'thul dri yi chab/ /thugasaskar byug pa'i rdzas su nye bar gtams/ sha chen nang khrol rus tshogs cher spungs pa'i/ /bza' bca' sngags la ro mchog brgya dang ldan/ /mi rkang dung gling rdza rnga sil snyan sogs/ /thos 'dzin yul du 'jebs pa'i sgra dbyangs 'khril/ /sga srab gong rmed dar gyi cod pan can/ /rta mchog rlung gi shugasa'achang stong gsum myul/ /'brong g.yag rdo rje'i rwa rtse rnon po yis/ /log 'dren dgra bgegs snying ga thal mor 'bigs/ /grangs med 'dab chags mkha' la 'phur zhing lding / /seng ge stag gzig dom dred khyi spyang rgyug /ri dwags sna tsho gos ra lug dre'u mdzo/ /spra sprel mon pa dzo gi zlos gar bsgyur/ /khrab rmog zhol btags rnga ma dbang gzhu'i ris/ /gri mdung mda' sogs mtshon cha rno ngar ldan/ /za 'og seng ge spre'u spyang gi bya'i/ /rgyal mtshan sna lnga ba dan mkha' la bsgreng / /zhwa phod sag zhu rin cen rus pa'i rgyan/ /zhing lngags glang dom slog pa dar gyi ber/ /bla gos sham thabs lhung bzed gsil byed dang / /dam rdzas gtore ma bdud rtsi a mṛ taḥ/ /sku 'bag smyug rgod bla rdo srog 'bor bcas/ /rgyal srid sna bdun 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga/ /lhun po gling bzhi gling phran mu khyud bskor/ /rin cen ri bo dpag bsam ljon pa'i shing / /'dod 'jo'i ba dang ma rmos lo gos dud/ /nyi zla zung 'jug kun bzang mchod sprin gyis/ /bstan srung rgyal po chen po'i thugs dam bskang / /gsang yum blon po sprul pa'i thugs dam bskang / /'khor tshogs rgya mtsho'i thugs dam skongs gyur nas/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las ma lus sgrub par mdzod/ /slob dpon (133na hā zha po pad+ma thod 'phreng gis/ /phyag mtshan rdo rje spyi bo'i gtsug tu bkod/ /bdud rtsi'i mna' chu lce la legs bzhag nas/ /dam btags srog snying blangs nas bro por ba/ /ma g.yel dran par mdzod la rgyal ba'i bstan/ /de 'dzin skyes bu mdo dang sngags kyi sde/ /skyong zhing skye dgu'i bde skyid ma lus pa/ /dkar phyogs zla ba lta bur 'phel bar mdzod/ /khyad par bdag sogs dgon gnas sde bcas rnams/ /nyin mtshan dus kun gzhes med bsrung zhing skyobs/ /chos dang srid kyi legs tshogos ma lus pa/ /ji ltar bsam pa bzhin du sgrub par mdzod/ /—275

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4) ces skyid shod dga' ba gdong chos skyong gi gsol mchod 'di ni chos skyong nyid kyis sngags ram pa don grub rgya mtsho brgyud nas dgos tshul gyi 'phrin byung ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni chang khyim pa ngag dbang mkhyen brtse'o/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i gnas mchog dam pa nas/ /dpal ldan lha mo chen mo tsaṇ+ḍi ka /mkha' 'gro rnam gsum las mkhan khyab 'jug sogs/ /'khor bcas thogs pa med par gnas 'dir gshegs/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar pad+ma nyi ma dang / /bam ro'i gdan la pad+ma rā ga'i mdog /phyag g.yasaral gri phyag g.yon thod khrag bsnams/ /ral pa'i thor tshugs rma bya'i sgro yis spud/ /thod skam dbu rgyan do shal phyag rgya lnga/ /sbrul gyi chun po rin cen 'phreng bas mdzes/ /g.yang gzhis stod g.yogs stag sham re lde dkris/ /rab gtum khro chags gar dgu'i nyams kyis 'gying / /ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i klong bzhugs par/ /mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog bdug spos dang / /mar me dri chab zhal zas rol mo 'bul/ /(133bdagyes par bzhes la 'phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub/ khyad par sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga sbyar ba'i/ /dam rdzas med byung gtor ma'i mchod pa 'bul/ /zag med bde ba chen pos rab tshim nas/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /sngon tshe gshen rab mi bo bon gyi lha/ /bar du pad+ma thod 'phreng pho nya ba/ /srid pa'i lha rabs sham po 'khor bcas rnams/ /thogs pa med par gnas 'dir myur du spyon/ /'dod yon lnga dang nyer spyod rol tsho sgra/ /sman gtor rak+ta phyi nang gsang mchod rnams/ /nam mkha' mdzod kyi khams su byin brlabs nas/ /legs par 'bul na mnyes shing tshim gyur cig khro gtum zhi chags sna tshogs gzugs 'dzin cing / /dar 'jam gos gyon 'byong g.yag dkar po bcibs/ /ral gri mdung thogs grangs med pho nyas bskor/ /lha yi sde dpon chen po khyod la bstod/ /mtsho skyes rdo rje gnubs ston 'dul 'dzin sogs/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i dam tshig nyer dgongs la/ /tsaṇ+ḍi ka dang lha rabs sham po che/ /'khor dang bcas pas bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /sangs rgyas bstan dang 'gro ba'i bde skyid spel/ khyad par sde 'di'i stod smad yul gru —276

dam can chos srung mngon rtogs 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ (geyi/ /nad mug zhabrug rtsod nyes brgya kun zhi zhing / /chos srid legs tshogs ma lus 'phel bar mdzod/ /ces lha mo tsaṇ+ḍi ka dang lha rabs sham po'i gtor bsngo khyer bde ba zhig dgos zhes thos bsam dar rgyas gling pa spyi sos bskul pa ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin no/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma dgyes mdzad he ru daḥ/ /gur mgon legs ldan dbang po gdong bzhi pa/ /bka' sdod pho nyar bcas (134na tha gus gas nas/ /gtor chog dngos grub rgya mtsho deng 'dir spel/ /de'ang mchod gtor dang spyan gzigs rnams phyag len ltar bshams/ /bdag skyed kyi rnal 'byor dang bzlas gtor gzhung bzhin phul nas mgon chen la gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ dmigs pa phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ āḥlha ho gyi zhes lan gsum gyis gtore ma byin gyis brlabs/ /mdun du paṃ las pad+ma raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du bdud kyi ngo bo/ ro dmar ser mgo g.yas su bstan pa'i gdan la hūṃ mthing nag las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las nag po chen po srin po'i gzugs can zhal ga khog phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brjes pa/ phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod khrag thugs gar 'dzin pa'i dbus na gaṇ+ḍi bsnams pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang /rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ phyag rgya drug dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs dkris shing / dar sna tshogs kyi cod pan dang lhab lhub kyis klubs pa/ mi'u thung gel pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa'i g.yas na bya nag /g.yon na khyi nag /rgyab na ce spyang / mdun na mi nag /steng na khyung chen rnams 'bum 'bum 3 grangs ldan/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yon du pad nyi'i gdan la ṭaṃ las e ka dza khyi sngon mo khro mo'i rnam pa can zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i g.yu'i bum pa thugs kur 'dzin pa/ dar dkar 3stod g.yogs dang stag lpags kyi sham thabasacan/ g.yu'i ral pa lan bu gcig pa g.yon du 'byung ba/ rus pa dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ semasadapa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa de'i sto (134ba thar trag las khrag mtsho'i dbus su bh+yoḥ las —277

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)dpal ldan lha mo sngo nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum ma mi ro rengs po khar bcug pa/ g.yas gnyis ral gri dang thod khrag g.yon gnyis mdung dang rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang rlon pa lnga gas do shal can/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ glang po che'i ko bas stod dang ba glang gi ko bas smad g.yogs pa/ re lde'i sham thabs la sbrul gyi ska rags bcings pa/ snyan g.yas g.yon la dug sprul dang seng ges brgyan pa/ zhabs gnyis lcags sgrog gis mdzes pa/ byug pa'i rdzas gsum gyis sbags shing rid la mi sdug pa/ lte bar nyi zla 'char ba/ bong bu gwa pa la zhen pa ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ ma hā kā li de sa hūṃ bh+yo lhaḥlcam dral gyi mdun du pad nyi gdan gnyis kyi g.yas su mgon po'i thugs ka nas chad pa'i tri yig mam du gyur pa las/ gnod sbyin nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas gser gyi gri gug dang g.yon pa'i lag mthil nas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'char ba/ za 'og gi gos dang mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi gsol ba/ ral pa brdzes pa/ gser gyi rna cha can/ g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yon du lha mo'i thugs ka nas chad pa'i tri yig sma du gyur pa las nag mo gnod sbyin g.yas gser gyi spu gri dang / g.yon pa'i lag mthil na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'char ba/ dar nag gi gos gyon pa/ ral pa thur du nyil zhing byu ru'i lan tshar can g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ gnyis ga'ang dar men gyi ga sha dang dar gyi ang rag can/ de gnyis kyi mdun du ro'i gdan gsum gyi steng du yab kyi thugs ka nas chad pa'i (135na)tri yig dang po las pu tri nag po shang lang dang thod pa 'dzin pa dar nag lhab lhub dang dar dkar gyi ang rag gsol ba/ de'i g.yon du tri yig gnyis pa las bha dra nag po dam shing dang mi snying 'dzin pa/ dar nag gi gos dang stag slog can/ gnyis ka'ang ral pa gyen du gzings pa g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yon du yum gyi thugs ka nas chad pa'i sma las/ mon mo nag mo kha nas me 'bar ba spu gri dang rgyu ma 'dzin pa/ za 'og gi gos gyon zhing ral pa thur du 'phyang ba g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ ming sring gsum ga'ang dar men gyi ga sha dang rna ba la dung long 'brol —278

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)ṅga te/ lpa ra ṇa hi me ga ga na 'a gro ste rda ba phywa da swā hā/ zhes lan gsum mam lnga gang rigs kyis gtor ma phul/ gtor sngags kyi sa pa ri wā ri'i rjes su gro ste rda a/ nas sha rdi'i bar gyis phyi mchod dang 'bru gsum btags te nang mchod 'bul/ dpal ldan nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po/ yum chen e ka dza khyi/ dpal ldan 'dod khams dbang phyug ma 'khor bcas rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la bstan pa dang bstan 'dzin sde dang bcas pa skyong zhing khyad par rig pa 'dzin pa bdag (136na8 'gal rkyen zhi zhing bsam pa 'grub pa dang byang chub kyi bar du bsrung skyob mdzad du gsol/ bstod pa ni/ lhaḥ ma hā kā la srin po'i gzugs/ /e ka dza ḍi kun gyi yum/ /srid gsum dbang sgyur 'dod khams ma/ /lcam dral 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ /bstab pa ni/ rdo rje nag po gur mgon lcam dral rnams/ /'dir gshegs sman raka mchod gtor tsho gis bzhes shig /sngar bcol legs so dar 'chol rten du 'bul/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las ma lus sgrub —par mdzod/ /mgon po zhal bzhi par gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ ma lha lhaḥ ha hi hriḥs byin gyis rlabs/ mdun du chos khrung gru gsum gyi dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte ba dang phyogs bzhir nyi ma dang ro'i gdan re re/ dbus kyi gdan la hūṃ las gyi gug sno gis mtshan pa/ phyogs bzhin hūṃ re re dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las gtso 'khor lnga dus gcig tu grub pa ni dbus su nag po chen po zhal bzhi/ g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing steng dud kha/ /spyan gsum pa/ dbu skra gyen du brdzes shing sma ra dang smin ma 'bar ba/ mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ drag po'i nga ro sgrog pa/ phyag g.yas gnyis kyis gyi gug dang rtse gsum/ g.yon gnyis kyi thod khrag dang mdung bsnams pa/ mchan khung du bum pa dang phyag 'gag na rus phreng thogs pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ sprul nag pos mchode phyir thogs byas pa/ rus rgyan dang tshangs pa'i skud pas spras pa/ rkang gling dang dril bu g.yer kha'i sgra 'khrol ba/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs (136ba)pa de'i g.yas su g.yung mo nag mo/ /g.yon du gtum mo ljang gu /mdun du dmar —280

dam can chos srung ma' rtogs mun las rnam swo lhun grub/ 9)nag srin mo/ /rgyab tu ser nag sirnya li ma rnams srin mo khros pa'i rnam pa can gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin cing ral pa thur du 'phyang ba/ gcer bu rgyu ma'i ga sha can/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba/ 'khor pho nya dregs pa'i dmag tshoṭa kyis bskor ba ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i gtso 'khor rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs gar hūṃ/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas gangs te se/ /bsil ba tshal/ po ṭa la/ ha ha rgod pa'i dur khrod/ dar lung / kha'u skyed lhas/ dpal ldan sa skya la sogs pa'i rgya bod kyi gnas chen gar bzhugs nas stobs 'phrog dbang po 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs par bsams la/ hūṃ/ sngon tshe rdo rje 'am pa gi spyan snga sa /gas po khyod kyis ji ltar khas blangs bzhin/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi'i las la spyan 'dren na/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol/ /tshem hā kwa la kā la/ bi kā la/ ra tri ta/ ḍo bhi ni/ tsiṇ+ḍa zhi/ rak+ṣa sī/ siṅga lī/de sa sa pa ri wā ra e gye hi/ dzaḥlha baṃ sngos gnyis su med par bstim/ pad+ma ka ma lā ya sto gyis gdan phul/ gong gi sngags kyi sa pa ri wā ra'i rjes su gro ste rda rdo nas/ sha rdi'i bar gyis mchode/ dam rgya spyi bor bzhag par bsams la/ sngar gyi sngags sa pa ri wā ra'i rjes su sam ya sma ra nas/ rak+ṣa skyo'i bar dang / nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams mchod sprin gyi gtor ma sogs mgon r+ṣa gyi skabs ltar bya/ stobs log dbang po 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags rdo rje'i 'od zer sogs kyi rjes (137na tshe su/ gong gi sngags sa pa ri wā ra'i rjes su/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga to bh+yo sogasabatags la gsum mam lngas gtor ma dang / phyi nang gi mchod pa sngar ltar 'bul/ lha chen nag po zhal bzhi yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma zhes sogs 'phrin bcol mgon chen gyi skabs ltar bya/ bstod pa ni/ lhaḥ he ru ka dpal gtum drag srin po'i gzugs/ /bdud sde'i snying la bro rdung dpa' bo che/ /yum chen bzhi dang sde brgyad dregs pa yi/ /'bor tshogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la bstod/ /bstab pa ni/ stobs 'phrog gdong bzhi yab yum 'khor bcasarnams/ 'dir gshegs sogs gur mgon gyi skabs ltar bya/ las mkhan mon bu lcam dral la gtor —281—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)ma 'bul ba ni/ oṃ aḥlha ha ho hrīḥsabyin gyis brlabs la/ bod pa'i mthar i rda ba lo snu lha kha kha 'a ha khā hi/ zhes pas dbul/ badz+ra kwa la yak+ṣa nas/ ru lu ra'i sī sa pa ri wā ra a nas shabha'i bar gyis phyi mchod dang 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod 'bul/ gnod sbyin yab yum pu tra ming sring 'khor dang bcas pa rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma sogs kyis gong ltar 'phrin las 'chol/ bstod pa ni/ lhaḥ dpal ldan gnod sbyin yab yum gnyis/ /pu tra bha tra sring mo gsum/ /bka' sdod rdzu'aphrul ldan pa yi/ /mthu stobs dregs pa'i bdag por bstod/ /bstab pa ni/ gnod sbyin yab yum pu tra ming sring rnams/ 'dir gshegs sogs 'gro /las mkhan bshan pa lcam dral la gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ ma snaḥlha ha ho myi zhes pas byin gyis brlab/ mdun du rta khrag dang mi khrag gi rgya mtsho chen po'i dbus su kyi zangs ra ba gru bzhi pa rta ro mi ro brtsegs pa'i (137btsong du bra dang zangs gri las skyes pa'i gnod sbyin chen po sku mdog dmar po khro zhing gtum pa zhal gcig spyan gsum pa/ skra kham ser gyen du brdzes pa/ smin ma dang sma ra dmar ser can zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag g.yas ral gri dang g.yon mda' gzhu glo snying 'dzin pa'i mchan khung du ru mtshon bsnams pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ zangs kyi beg tse dang dar gyi ral gu dmar pos brgyan cing sag lham gsol ba/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yon du me las srid pa'i lha mo sku gzugs sngo la gdong pa dmar ba/ gcer mo zhal dang spyan bgrad pa/ g.yu'i smin ma dang dung gi so/ me'i ral pa can/ gser gyi rna rgyan 'phyang ba/ ral gri dang phur bu 'dzin pa/ dred mo la zhon pa/gtso bo'i g.yas su pra las sgog bdag dmar po bse khrab dang bse rmog gyon zhing mdung dmar dang btsan zhags bsnams pa/ ce spyang la zhon pa/ de dag gi 'khor du gri thogs bshan pa brgyad/ ra bshan nyer gcig la sogs pa'i dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs gar hūṃ/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas byang shar ma ru tshe'i dur khrod brag dmar po mchong lding gi pho brang nas gnod sbyin dregs pa lcam sring 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā —282

dam can chos srung ma' rtogs mun las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ (gedzaḥs spyan drangs par bsams la/ kyeḥ byang shar dbang drag rol pa'i dur khrod nas/ /gnod sbyin dregs pa lcam sring 'khor bcas rnams/ /'dir spyon dam tshig pa dang gnyis med bzhuṭa/ /lusang ga yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ra smo pra ṇa ād+mas pa ri wā ra ā ga r+ṣa ya dzaḥdzaḥlha baṃ (138na)sngo pad+ma ka ma lā ya ri/ gong gi sngags gsham du a lha nas sha rdi'i bar sbyar bas mchod dang / 'bru gsum btags te nang mchod 'bul/ gnod sbyin lcam dral 'khor bcas kyi ljags rdo rje'i sogasagong bzhin dang / sngags gzham du sarba ji na sha i rda ba lo ta kha kha khā hi khā hi lan gsum mam bdun gyis gtor ma dang sngags mchode nang mchod 'bul/ gnod sbyin beg tse lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma zhes sogs gong dang 'dra/ bstab pa ni/ bshan pa beg tse lcam dral 'khor bcas rnams/ 'dir gshegs sogs bya/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor ni/ oṃ āḥlha ha ho hrī yis gtore ma byin gyis brlab/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral bar bcas la/ h+pha/ oṃ badz+ra ā ra li sngo dzaḥ/ baṃ ho badz+ra ḍā gi ni sa ma ya /dṛ shu hos spyan drangs la gtor ma phul bar bsams te/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ba'i mthar se gol gtog cing / oṃ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa rāk+ṣa sa/ bhū ta/pre ta/ bi shā tsa/ un da/ a pa smu ra/ ḍā ka ḍā gi rgyu da ya/ i me ba lo grihā ( / sa ma ya rak+ṣa / / ma ma sarba sirnyi/ me bra ya tsā skyo/ ya the baṃ/ ya bes : ྅ thā/ dzi ga thā/ bi ba thā/ ma ti kra ma thā/ ma ma sa zhwa/ kā rta ya/ 'kha bi shurnya ye/ sa ha yi ka bha wastu/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul/ a: nasashabha'i bar gyis mchod/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ mkha' 'gro sdo lnga sogs gnas gsum gyis dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams mchod sbyin gye gtor ma sogs gong dang 'dra/ gzhi bdag gtor ma ni/ oṃ āḥlha ha ho lhaḥ sa phyin gyis brlab/(138ba3 mdzad kyi phyag rgya dang bhū mi ba ti ā ga r+ṣa ya dzaḥs bkug /oṃ a kā ro mu kho sarba dharmā ṭ+wāṃ a du nut+pa na tā ta oṃ āḥlha phaṭa swā hā gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ phyi nang gi mchod pas mchod/ bod yul spyi dang khyad par sgos kyi yul lha gzhi bdag rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma sogs gong ltar dang / bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni zhes sogs —283—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)brjod/ bzlas pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ yig brgya brjod/ gong gnon oṃ de wa pi tsu badz+ra hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ mgon po'i sngags ni/ oṃ ma hā kā la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lwa ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ lha mo'i sngags ni/ oṃ ru ru ro ru bi tiṣ+ṭha brlu sī ka ma la rak+ṣa sī hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ/ zhal gyi sngags ni/ oṃ ma hā kā la kwa la bi kā la/ ra tri ta/ ḍom+bhi nī/ tsaṇ+ḍasnyi/ siṅgā lī/ de sa hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ/ las mkhan lcam dral gyi sngags ni/ oṃ ro ru ro ru tri tsa pa la a shug me ma hūṃ ma bh+yo dzaḥdzaḥ a li a li ma dzaḥbyu shaṃ li shi ded/ a shwa ded/ mo snugs spu gri a li ma dzaḥdzaḥ nag mo sha la rabs dzaḥdzaḥ beg tse lcam dral gyi sngags ni/ oṃ ra smo pa ṇa ā+o d+ma khyi ru pu ru ga lu hi ta sarba sha / mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ra smo ya ma tsit+ta dz+wa la raṃ/ pra ti de sa hūṃ/ srog la ya ma dzaḥ sarba sha / mā ra ya rbad phaṭa/ces ci nus bzla/ /thun gyi mthar gtor ma skyong ba ni/ yi dam ma gtogos pa'i gtor ma rnams bte kal/ hūṃ bh+yoḥ ma hā kā la lha mo srid gsum bdag /stobs 'phrog dbang po yum chen sring mo bzhi/ /pu tra ming sring beg tse lcam dral dang / /dur khrod zhing skyong pho rgyud mo rgyud sogs/ /dam can rgya mtsho gzhi bdag 'khor bcas rnams/ /'dir gshegs sogs(139nasgo dra/ srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ma bya/ yig brgya brjod cing ma 'byor ba sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ 'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu zhes sogs dang / su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swā hās rten yod rnams la brtan bzhugs dang /rten med rnams khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad sogs dang badz+ra muḥs gshegs su gsol/dzaḥlha baṃ hoḥs dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ smon lam ni/ dge 'a sa bdud sde'i g.yul las rnam rgyal zhing / /gnas skabs dam chos bsgrub pa'i mthun rkyen tshang / /ring min bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa/ /mngon du byas nas 'gro rnams sgrol bar shog mas brjod ni/ byin rlabs ngad ldan rtsa brgyud bla ma dang / /dngos grub char 'bebs dgyes mdzad 'khor lo'i lha/ /'phrin las kun sgrub chos skyong srung ma yis/ /dus rnams kun tu dge ba'i bkra shis shog /ces pa la sogs pa ci rigs pa bya'o/ /thub gsung rgyud sdo las bstan khungs dang 'brel/ /'phags bod lo paṇa brgyud pa zam ma chad/ /sa skya'i —284

dam can chos srung mngon rtogs wen las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)'jam mgon bzhed pa ma nor ba/ /slob bshad phyag bzhes ji bzhin khrigs su bsdebs/ /rtog pa 'og 'gyur 'byams pa'i srung ma dang / /zhal gzigs rdzun gyi sdeb phyogs ma yin par/ /tshad ma bzhi ldan snyan brgyud las 'ongs ba'i/ /rdo rje chos skyong dgyes glu mgrin par len/ /dge ba'i dri bzhen gyis sbyar ye shes mes/ /sgrib gnyis bag chags bud shing kun bsregs te/ /tshe 'dir grub mtha' bsnyogs te rlung sems sku/ /dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i ngo bor ldang bar shog /ces dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bka' srung mgon po rnam gnyis las mkhan dang bcas pa'i gtor chog dngos grub rgya mtshor grags pa 'di ni/ lo chen (139ra ro tsa na'i sprul pa'i zlos gar 'gro 'dul gter bdag gling par dpal skyon chen po'i lung gis nye bar zin pa'i rig 'dzin pad+ma gar dbang 'gyur med rdo rje rtsal gyi gsung gis bskul ba la brten nas za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas btsun 'jam dbyangs so/ /bde stong rol mtshor 'khyil ba'i chos dbyings su/ /nam yang 'gog pa med pa'i rtsed 'jo yis/ /rgyal kun zag pa med pa'i bde chen du/ /dgyes dgur spyod mdzad ngag dbang dbyangasacan ma/ /mun pa bye bas byugs pa'i lhun po la/ /nyin byed 'bum gyis 'byud pa'i gzi brjid dang / /bskal pa'i me dpung gos su legs gyon pa'i/ /bstan srung gtso mo dmag zor rgyal mo yis/ /dga' chen bdag nyid dpal ldan btsong kha pa'i/ /gsung rab rgya mtsho 'du ba'i bsti gnas mchogo /bshad sgrub chos kyi gling 'di srid mtha'i bar/ /'phel rgyas yar ngo'i zla ba ltar mdzod cig /gtor ma raṃ yaṃ khaṃ oṃ āḥlha gis byin gyis brlabs/ /thod pa skam rlon brtsegs pa'i gzhal yas khang / /sra brtan rdo rje'i mu khyud tog mdzes pa/ /me rlung 'tshub pa'i drag po'i sgra sgrog dbus/ /pad nyi dgra bgegs bsnol ba'i gdan steng du/ /dam can skyes bu mthing nag srin po'i gzugs/ /dmar zlum spyan bgrad zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs/ /smin ma sma ra dbu skra dmar ser 'bar/ /dbu la rgya zhu le brgan sprul mgo can/ /dar dang za 'og 'jol ber dgu brtsegs gsol/ /btso ma'i gser sbyangs las grub ska rags bcings/ /rin cen rus pa sna tsho gos rgyan gyi spros/ /phyag g.yas tho bas dgra bgegs thal —285

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)bar rlog /g.yon pa 'thor rlung gter gyi sbud pa yis/ /mi mthun phyogs kun rgya mtsho'i pha mthar skrod/ /hor lham gsol nas ra skyes kham (140na tha bcibs/ /gsang yum mched 'khor sum brgya drug cur bcas/ /thogs med 'dir spyon dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs/ khrag chang a rgya mtsho lta bu bskyil/ /dam rdzas gtor ma ri bo ji bzhin spungs/ /phyi nang gsang mchod 'bul gyis bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra swā dhu sa pa ri wā ra sogs kyis gtor ma bsngo zhing a lha nas sha rdi'i bar brjod/sman raka 'bul/ rdo rje legs pa 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis/ /bar chad nad gdon dgra bgegs zhi ba dang / /tshe dang dpal 'byor bsod nams rgyas pa sogs/ /bsam don lhun gyis grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /'thor rlung 'tshub cing me rlung 'khrug pa'i dbus/ /dgra bgegs gan rkyal kha sbub bsnol ba'i steng / /ngam shod rgyal chen 'phrin las mtshan 'dzin pa/ /rab byung tshul can cung zad zhi ma khro/ /bla gos mthang gzham ngur smig gos kyis klubs/ /dar gyis thod bcing khra bo dbu la mdzes/ /g.yas pa sba lcag g.yon pa shel 'phreng 'dzin/ /res 'ga' bong bu byi lar zhen nas rgyu/ /btsun mo shugs sman bshan pa blon po bzhi/ /bdud dmag 'khor dang bcas pa ma lus pa/ /tshur spyon bam ro'i khri la brtan par bzhugs/ /dam rdzas gtor ma khrag chang btung ba dang / /nyer spyod sna lnga dung wo rol mo 'brol/ /rdo rje'i go mar spyan gzigs dkor nor tshogs/ /mthun pa'i rdzas kyis thugs dam gnyer skong na/ /dgyes par bzhes la 'phrin las ma lus sgrubs/ /dz+wa la nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra sogs kyi gtor ma bsngo/ /arnya sogs kyis mchode cing sman raka 'bul/ /srog bdag mi bsrun dgra lha mthu rtsal can/ /pa ku'i klung chen gzhung du rgyu ba'i tshe/ chu rgyud rgyal po'i mtshan du grags min (140ba)nam/ /lho kha ngam shod gnas srung mdzad pa'i tshe/ /lha mchog dge bsnyen chen por mi 'bod dam/ /g.yas ru gtsang gi rgyal khams myul ba na/ /dge slong bstan 'dzin zhes su ma grags sam/ /yab ni rnal 'byor thog tu rje bo ste/ /yum chen klu mo ma mo spyan gcig ma/ /sras mchog ga me 'phrin las rgya mtsho khyod/ /mthu rtsal ma chung sdang dgra rdul du rlog /gnod pa'i bgegs tsho gos ma lus phye mar —286

dam can chos srung mag rtogs tshon las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ (gethogs/ /nyin mtshan kun tu ma g.yel bya ra gzigs/ /gzhi lam byes gsum kun tu mgon skyabasamadzod/ /zhi rgyas dbang gi 'phrin las ma lus pa/ /bsams pa ji bzhin thogs med grub par mdzod/ces dam can skyes bu badz+ra thig le rtsal dang chu rgyud rgyal po'i gsol mchod 'di ni mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab kyi ngor za hor gyi brjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rig byed pa ngag dbang nam mkha' 'o/ /snang ba mtha' yas ye re ma'i 'phrul/ /mtsho las skyes pa'i rdo rje sprul pa'i skus/ /gtsug lag yongs kyi srung mar mnga' gsol ba/ /sprul pa'i cho ge rgyal sku lnga gnas 'dir gshegs/ /gang gi bka' sdod pho nyar rab bsngags pa/ /dmag dpon gangs la nyi shar mthu bo che/ /klu btsan yangs pa'i rgyal por yongs 'bod pa/ /ma g.yel ma g.yel gnas 'dir da tshur spyon/ /las mkhan shong kha rta mgrin dpal bzang dang / /lum pa sde par grags sogs dregs pa'i 'khor/ /ma lus 'dir spyon pad nyi bam ros mtshon/ /rang rang dgyes pa'i gdan la brtan par bzhugs/ /pe har rgyal po bka' sdod blon po dang / /yang sprul 'khor dang bcas pa'i tshogs rnams la/ /sman phud rak+ta'i btung ba mtsho ltar bskyil/ /dam rdzas (141na gtore ma ri bo lta bur spungs/ /dbang po'i me tog tshil chen dud pa 'thul/ /mi tshil mar me mkhris pa'i dri chab 'khyil/ sha rus bza' bca'i zhal zas tshar du dngar/ /dzornga rkang gling sbub sil dung sgra 'brol/ /cang shes rta mchog nor bu'i sgra srab spras/ /'brong g.yag rdo rje'i rwa rtse mkha' la gdeng / /rab dkar 'o ma'i 'dod pa 'jo ba'i ba/ /bya rog khra sogs 'phur dgu mkha' la lding / /seng ge khyi spyang gcan gzan grangs med rgyug /ri dwags 'phyo dgu srog chaṭa pha mtha' yas/ /sra ba'i go ngom rno ngar mtshon cha bsgreng / /za 'og stag spyang spre'u bya rgod kyi/ /rgyal mtshan ba dan lda ldi mkha' la bres/ /rgyal srid bdun dang 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga/ /rang rang mthun pa'i dam rdzas ma lus pa/ /dngos bshams yid kyis sprul pa 'bul gyis bzhes/ /bdag sogs ma rig 'khrul bas mchod pa'i tshogs/ /ma tshang 'bags dang dus kyi gtor ma chag /sku gsung thugs dang 'gal ba ci mchis pa/ /snying nas bshags so tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /grangs med sprul pa'i —287

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)rol gar mtha' klas pas/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba'i mthu stobs can/ /dpal ldan dregasapa'i sdod pon kun gyi gtso/ /chos rgyal sde lnga 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ /mig stong ldan pa'i zab phod bla gos gyon/ /sag theb gsol zhid g.yas pa 'khar gsil dang / /g.yon pa dril bu rab 'brol dge bsnyen che/ /dmag dpon gangs la nyi shar khyod la bstod/ /res 'ga' mdog sngo sbrul gyi gdengs ka can/ /chu dar gos gyon nor bu'i rgyan gyis spud/ /rta sngon zhen nas sdig sbrul pho nyar 'gyed/ /'jigs rung klu yi dbang po khyod la bstod/ /bse khrab bse (141ba glog gyon zhing mdung dmar 'dzin/ /zhags pas dgra bo'i ske nas nye bar 'ching / /myur mgyogs rta dmar zhen nas stong gsum myul/ /drag shul 'jigs rung btsan rgod chen por bstod/ khong kha lum pa bar grags mthu rtsal can/ /srog dbugs sha khrag dron mor nyer brngams pa'i/ /bka' sdod sprul pa yang sprul 'khor dang bcas/ /dpag dka'i rdzu 'phrul ldan pa rnams la bstod/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /bdag sogs mi nor sde dang bcas rnams kyi/ /'gal rkyen bar chod thams cad zhi ba dang / /mthun rkyen bsams don lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /ces pa 'di'ang dmag dpon gangs la nyi shar gyis bdog pa'i rten dang bcas bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bsdos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas btsun 'jam dbyangs so/ /phun tshogs rin cen mdzes pa'i gzhal med khang / /'jam mnyen dar gyi gur dang yol bas bres/ /pad+ma nyi zla mdzes pa'i gdan steng du/ /rdo rje g.yu sgron tshur gshegs brtan par bzhugs/ /res 'ga' rdo rje 'bar rtsal gsang ba'i yum/ /snang srid ma lus gsal ba'i pra ston pa/ /sman bcud yid 'phrog sgeg mo'i rnam rol can/ /'dam shod snang dmar gangs ri'i mgul nas gshegs/ /la lar khro gtum gnod sbyin mo yi gzugs/ /rab 'dzin sha med gangs dkar spyan gcig ma/ /rigs mthun rang rang 'khor tshogs dang bcas pa/ /ma thogs rings pa'i tshul gyis da tshur spyon/ /'dzad med nam mkha' mdzod kyi sge phye nas/ /bstan skyong lha khyod dgyes pa bskyed pa'i rdzas/ /lhung lhung dal 'bab g.ya' dang gangs kyi chu/ /brgya phrag sman snas sbran pa skyems su 'bul/ /—288

dam can chos srung mngon rtogs 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ (gepad dkar (142na mi mu u rdu wā ra sogs/ /sna tshogs me tog chun po thod du chings/ /ma la yar skyes la sogs shing sna dang / /sman spos dngar ba'i dri bsung shangs la dbul/ /nyi zla nor bu 'bru mar rtsi bcud kyi/ /sgron mes mun pa mthar byed spyan sngar bsgreng / /tsan dan ga bur gur gum bsres pa'i chab/ /rin cen snod gtams sku la byug pa'i rdzas/ /phun tsho gis ro bda'i g.yang chags lha dang mi'i/ /bza' bca'i bgos bzang ljags kyi dbang po tshim/ /snyan pa'i glu dbyangs zin dang ma zin pa'i/ /sgra snyan rol mo thos 'dzin yul du 'brol/ /gnam la 'phur dgu sa la 'dzul dgu dang / /ri dwags 'phyo dgu mtha' klas srog chags tshoṭa/ /dar zab gos dang rin cen mdzes pa'i rgyan/ /rdo rje'i ya lad rno ngar ldan pa'i mtshon/ /ri rab gling bzhi gling phran 'dod yon lnga/ /rgyal srid bdun dang bkra shis rtags rdzas sogs/ /lha mi'i dpal 'byor ma tshang med pa kun/ /bstan skyong dbang mo dgyes pa bskyed phyir 'bul/ /hūṃ las byung ba'i rin cen snod yangs su/ /oṃ yig zhu ba'i dam rdzas gtore ma'i bcud/ /med byung bdud rtsi'i ngo bor byin brlabs pa/ /bzhes nas bcol ba'i 'phrin las ma lus sgrubs/ /gur sngon pha wang long bu'i sku mkhar nas/ /btsan skya dam can chen po thig le rtsal/ /mched 'khor sum brgya drug cur bcas pa rnams/ /thogs pa med par gnas 'dir myur du gshegs/ /rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar a gra ta/ /snying gi khrag dron bskyil ba'i rak+ta dang / /sha rus phung por rab spungs gtor ma'i ri/ /yid 'ongs phyi mchod sa dang bar snang gang / /nang gi mchod pa dur khrod rdzas las grub/ /mnyam sbyor (142bang de chen gsang ba'i mchod pa yis/ /sku gsung thugs la dgyes par rab bskyed nas/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las ma lus sgrub par mdzod/ khro chags zhi ba'i nyams ldan klu ma btsan/ /chu dar gos gyon rta sngon wo nas rgyu/ /sbrul mgo'i gdengs can do sngon klu btsan pa/ /'khor dang bcas pa 'dir spyon gdan la bzhugs/ /ra dkar ba dmar 'o ma'i bcud 'khyil bar/ /grangs med klu sman tshogs kyis rab sbran pa/ /sgo gsum bde bskyed 'dod pa'i yon tan du/ /spel nas nyer 'bul bzhes la las kun sgrubs/ /gnod sbyin tsi'u dmar po'i las mkhan che/ /gcig tu ma nges du —289

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)mar rab sprul pa'i/ /bshan pa lag dmar chu rgyud 'phrin las ming / /bdag gi gdung bas 'bod na gnas 'dir spyon/ /snying khrag dron mo khol ba'i a: dang / /mig sna rna ba lce snying me tog 'phreng / sha chen dud pa zhun chen mar me sbar/ /mkhris pa'i dri chab sha rus zhal zas spungs/ /sna tsho gis rol mo dbyar rnga lta bur sgrog /go mtshon srog chags mtha' klas rgyal mtshan 'phen/ /sman raka gtor ma 'bul gyis rab bzhes la/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las ma lus sgrub par mdzod/ /ces gsol mchod 'di ni 'jam dbyangs dpal 'byor gyis bskul ba'i ngor srung ma bzhi po gtso 'khor sogs min 'dug pas lhan cig tu 'dri ma bde bas so sor bgyis te za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas btsun 'jam dbyangs so/ /chos gra r+ṣa po dpal gyi rtses thang gi shar sgo'i sgo srung brag gdong btsan rgod che/ /thogs pa med par gnas 'dir rab gshegs la/ /dgyes pa'i gdan la brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /khrag chang btung ba sha rus zhal zas dang / /thod rnga rkang gling sna tsho gos rol mo'i (143na / /tshil chen mar me sha chen dud pa 'thul/ /rta mchog sga srab mdzes pa'i rgyan gyis spras/ /rdo rje'i go mtshon stag ral gzig shubs dang / /mdung dmar ru mtshon ba dan phyogs bcur g.yo/ /'dod 'jo'i ba dang 'brong g.yag ce spyang khyi/ /sman raka gtor ma mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'bul/ /dgyes par rol cig btsan rgod 'bar ba che/ /nyams chags nyes pa'i tsho gos rnams bzod par bzhes/ /nyin mtshan dusadrug ma g.yel bsrung zhing skyobs/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las ma lus grub par mdzod/ /ces pa 'di'ang rtses dang bstan skyong chen mo dang brag gdong btsan gnyis kyis bskul ma byung ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni ngag dbang nam mkha'o/ /bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha dbyer ma mchis pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gtor bsngos rgyun 'byer nyung ngur byed pa bya bar 'dod na/ rang nyid yi dam lhar gsal thugs ka nas/ /raṃ 'phros mchode rdzas ma dag skyon rnams bsregs/ /yaṃ 'phros rlung gis ma dag skyon rnams gtore/ khaṃ 'phros chu yis ma dag —290

dam can chos srung ma' rtog lon las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ (geston rnams bkrus/ /a las thod pa hūṃ las rin po che'i/ /snod du ngo bo bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho la/ /rnam pa so so byed las rang rang gi /sgo lnga tshim byed kun bzang mchod sprin gyur/ /oṃ āḥlha/ sarba pañtsa a khru ta hūṃ hrīḥṭha oṃ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal hūṃ hrī4 ma hā ba smra ta te dz+wa ba kla ta ba la ba te gu tho sa ma ye swā hā/ oṃ — nas sha rdi'i bar brjod la byin gyis brlabs/ /rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phrosapas/ /ka dag gdod ma'i klong nas rang byung du/ /phyag rgya zil gnon rdo rje phur pa'i lha/ /dur khrod brgyad dang gar bzhugs gnas rnams nas/ /myur mdzad mgon po rdo rje gur (143bcu mgon/ /las gshin 'dod khams dbang phyug dpal lha mo/ /stobs 'phrog dbang po rnam sras beg tse dang / /thang lha sham po bstan ma bgraganyis tshogs/ /sprul pa'i chos rgyal rang rang bka' sdod dang / /'khor tsho gis dam can rgya mtshor bcas pa rnams/ /thogs med 'dir spyon badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ/ /dgyes pa'i gdan la brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /pad+ma ka ma wā ya sto/ sman chab mchod yon me rtag sna tshogasamadzes/ /dri zhis bdug spos nyi zla nor bu'i sgron/ /dri chab ro brgya'i zas dang snyan pa'i sgra/ /khrag gi byu dbang po'i me tog dang / sha chen dud pa tshil chen mar me sbar/ /mkhris pa'i dri chab sha rusabaza' bca' spungs/ /rkang gling thod pa gsang ba'i rnga chung 'brol/ /bdud rtsi sman mchod rak+ta'i btung ba spreng / /dam rja rgyan ldan gtor ma'i tshogs rnams 'bul/ /dgyes shing bzhes la thugs dam gnyen po skongs/ /nyams chags kun sos sku gsung thugs yon gyi/ /dngos grub ma lus dus 'dir stsal du gsol/ /lha so so'i ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud drangs par bsams la/ ltas ka he du na ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ 'a hi/ ma hā ba kla ta kha raṃ khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta kha raṃ khā hi/ oṃ badz+ra gī li ki lwa ya sa pa ri wā ra sngags gong bzhin btags la 'bul/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā lā ya sa pa ri wā ra i rda ba kla ta kha kha 'a hi khā hi/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ma hā kā li de sa ye ka dza ṭi sa pa ri wā ra ྾/ /de bzhin du oṃ kā la rū pa sa pa ri wā ra ྾/ /oṃ kā li de sa sa pa ri wā ra ྾/ s+t+waṃ de ri sab ri wā ra ྾/ /oṃ ma hā kā la kā la bi kā la ra ṭi ta nga ni tsaṇ+ḍa phri ra'i si sirnya lī de sa sa pa ri wā —291—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)ra ྾/ /〉be+e shra ba ṇa sa pa ri wā ra ྾/ /ra smo prad ṇa ā khru na (144na tshe u pa ri wā ra ྾/ /badz+ra thang ka ra mun nyid khu sha le sa pa ri wā ra ྾/ /srid pa'i lha rabs sham po sa pa ri wā ra ྾/ /ma ma kha kha la la le le ta ta te te sa pa ri wā ྾/ /ma hā rā dzā sa pa ri wā ra ྾/ /zhes 'bul zhing / bsdus par byed na/ e ka he du na ya ma snying khrag ma ra tsa ya/ badz+ra gī li ki lwa ya sarba dharmā pā la sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro mu kho sarba dhat+t+wa ཾ ṭ+wāṃ ār+ya nut+pa na tā ta/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo be shwa mu khe saḥ sarba thā khaṃ u tho te snya ra ṇa hi me gros rda ba byu ta ye swā hā/ zhes pa gsum mam bdun gyis phul/ arnya nas shabha'i bar gyisamachod/ nang mchod kyang 'bul/ bhū mi pa ti ā skar ṣa ya dzaḥs gzhi bdag rnams spyan drangs/ oṃ a kā ro mu kho sarba dharmā 'o ā du nut+pa na tāta/ oṃ āḥlha phaṭa swā hā/ lan gsum gyis bsngos/ yul lha gzhi bdag rnams kyis mchode sbyin gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la ko long ru nga phrag dog ma mdzad par mthun rkyen bsam don yid bzhin du sgrub par mdzad du gsol/ bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni zhesasogs brjod/ dngos grub kun stsol zil gnon phur ba'i lha/ /dpag bsam dka' ba'i mthu stobasardzu hrūl can/ /dam can chos skyong srung ma'i tsho gos rnams la/ /lusang ga yid gsum gus pasabadag bstod do/ /nad gdon bar chad dgra bgegs zhi ba dang / /mthun pa'i dngos grub ma lus stsol ba sogs/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod 'phrin las kun/ /thogs pa med par lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /yi ge brgya pa brjod/ gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ zhes sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ 'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu/ zhes sogs kyis rten yod pa rnams la brtan bzhugs (144bdang / /oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /ces sogs kyis rten med pa rnams gshegs su gsol/ 'bad dang rtsol ba ma dgos par sogs kyi shis pa brjod/ gtor bsngosanyung ngur byas pa 'di ni sa skyong blo bzang mthu stobs kyi rgyun khyer du za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dkar brag pa ngag dbang byams pa'o/ /snang ba mtha' yas gsang gsum sgyu ma'i 'phrul/ /lha sngags ye shes bdag nyid brtul zhugs —292

dam mā chos srung ma' rtogs wen las rnam pha lhun grub/ 9)can//'dzam bu'i gling na che ba'i rig sngags 'chang //thod 'phreng rtsal gyis srid gsum zil gyisaganon//mgon des dam la nyer btags btsan rgod lha//gnod sbyin chen po 'bar ba sbun bdun gyi//ya gyal brag dmar rong btsan mthu rtsal can//ma g.yel ma g.yel gnas 'dir da tshur spyon//yum wo blon po 'khor tsho gos rgya mtshor bcas//dbyar gyi glog stong 'byug 'dra bzhi du spyon//pad+ma nyi zla bam ro brtsegs pa sogs//rang rang dgyes pa'i stan la brtan par bzhugs//rba klong 'khrug pa khrag gi a — 'di//srung ma khyod kyi mchod yon tshul du 'bul//mig rna sna lce snying gi 'phreng spel ba//dpa' gtum rngams par byed pa'i rgyan du 'bul//mi ro bam por bsregs pa'i gsur chen dud//lang long 'thul ba shangs kyi yul du 'bul//tshil chen ro skra la sbar mar me'i tshogs//spyan sngar gzugs brnyan mtha' dag gsal phyir 'bul/khrag zhag mkhris pa 'khyil ba dri yi chab//thugs kar byug par byed pa'i rdzas su 'bul//phyi sha nang khrol rus klad lha ba rnams//spungs pa'i zhal zas ro bda' ljags la 'bul//thod rnga rkang gling sna tsho gos rol mo'i sgra//snyan gyi dbang po dgyes pa bskyed 145na8ra 'bul//gnam la 'phur dgu sa la 'dzul dgu dang //ri dwags 'phyo dgu go mtshon sra zhing mkhregs//'phan gdugs bla bre ru mtshon rgyal mtshan 'phyar//pa gas rlone mgo lag rgyu ma'i lda ldir bres//steng na gtor ma'i ri bo mkha' la snyeg/'og na sman raka btung ba'i rgya mtsho 'khyil//'dod yon lnga dang rgyal srid rnam pa bdun//rin cen ri bo dpag bsam ljon pa'i shing //'dod 'jo'i ba dang ma rmos lo tog smin//ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlar bcas pa yis//bas rgod 'bar ba chen po'i thugs dam bskang //gsang yum blon po'i tshogs kyis ྾//'khor tsho gos pho lha'i tshogasakyi ྾//thugs dam skongs las bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrubs//byu ru'i lhun po bskal pa'i me dpung gis//mngon par 'byud la khro chags sgeg nyams can//sga srab mas mdzes rlung gi shugs ldan ltar//zhen nas stong gsum bskor ba khyod la bstod//bse khrab bse rmog nyi ma'i 'od ltar 'tsher//dar lce cod pan 'ja' tshon lta bur bkra//zhags pas/gra bo'i ske bcings mdung dmar gyis//srog rtsa

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)dmar bo bod kyis gcod la bstod/ /khyod ni khri srong lde'u btsan skyes lha yin/ /pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal gyi pho nya la/ /gangs can gtsug lag skyong ba'i srung ma che/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi dgra lha mgon skyabs gnyen/ /mtsho skyes rdo rje'i dam las ma 'da' bar/ /sangs rgyas bstan srungs 'gro ba'i bde skyid spel/ /khyad par dgon gnas sde dang bcas pa skyongs/ /bsam pa'i don rnams lhun gyis grub par shog /ces pa 'di yang 'phyong rgyas ri bo brag btsan pas gsol mchod cig dgos tshul dgon pa'i grwa rigs rnams brgyud (145bkas byung ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas lkog pa phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /kyiḥ mdun na 'don che bran ka dpal yon zhes/ /tsi ber la thod zhang blon cha lugs can/ /res 'ga' spre'u'i gzugs 'dzin spyang zhir zhen/ /lcags kyi ber ka sal brdab cing rgyug /la lar dmar smug mdog can khro chags sgeg /dbu la smyug zhu za 'og ber chen rgyan/ /g.yas pa dbyug to g.yon pa mi snying 'dzin/ /seng ge dkar mo zhon nas phyogs kun myul/ /bstan ma bkra shis lcam mo zhi ba'i nyams/ /mdzes shing yid 'ongs dar gyi na bza' dang / /rin cen sna tsho gos rgyan gyi do shal can/ /g.yas pa mda' dar g.yon pa me long 'dzin/ /chad par blta dang tshul min gar mkhan gyis/ /dam sri'i rigs skyes bya bral gtsong ru dang / /zhags pa 'dzin cing ang rag ras gzan gyon/ /klu rgyal la sogs ma lus 'dir gshegs shig /sna tshogs 'bru sna g.yos su byas pa'i zan/ /mi g.yag mdzo glang ra lug sha tshil khrag zhang tog sgog btsong la phug sngo sna'i ris/ /dkar gsum dngar gsum la sogs bzang drug sman/ /ja chang tsha ba dngas pa'i chu klung 'khyil/ /bza' bca' btung ba 'dod yon rnam pa lngas/ /bran ka dpal yon bstan ma klu rgyal dang / /las mkhan dwags brgyud rtogs ldan rnams la 'bul/ /dga' ldan chos 'khor slob dpon grwa ris rnams/ /khyed mchod gsol na ru nga phrag dog sogs/ /gnod 'tshe ma gtong gzhis lam byes gsum du/ /mgon skyabs phan grogs ma lusamadzad du gsol/ /snang srid lha 'dre kun gyi rje btsan che/ /gnod sbyin sde dpon lag na rdo rje yi/ /dam —294

dam can chos srung ma' rtogs tshon la rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)tshig gnyen po nam yang ma bral bar//gnod 146na ngo'i sems zhi 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod//ces pa 'di ni 'phan yul thang sag dga' ldan chos 'khor bla grwa rnams kyis sa bon dang bcas dgosatshul byung ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni lkog pa phun tshogag dbang po'o//bh+yoḥrlung nag gur phub 'og tu khrag mtsho 'khyil//thod pa skamatsho rlon brtsigs pa'i gzhal yasadabus//mi bzod sga srab spras pa'i dre'u'i steng //bh+yo las dmag zor lha mo srin mo'i gzugs//be con nal thod 'dzin cing phyed skyil bzhugs//'jigs rung rgyan spud sku la me dpung 'bar//grangasamed 'khor tsho gos rgya mtsho so yongs bskor ba//ji bzhin ye shes lha tsho gos sa mā dza//gnyis med bzhus la khrag gi ji dang //dbang po'i me tog sha chen dud pa 'thul//zhing chen snang gsal mkhrisapa'i dri yi chab/sha rus lha bgos rkang gling thod rnga'i sgra//sman rag gtor gsum sna tshogs sgog chagasadang //go mtshon bzhen pa zhi dang drag po'i chas//ri rab gling bzhi nyi zla rgyal srid bdun//phun tsho gos 'dod yon dngos bshams yid sprul 'bul//oṃ kā li de sa sa pa ri wā ra i rda ba smra ta kha kha 'a hi 'a hi/bdun nam gsum gyis 'bul/— nas shabha'i bar brjod/sman raka kyang 'bul/zhi rgyas dbang drag rnam 'gyur sna tsho gis kyis//'phrin las sgrub mdzad 'dod khams dbang phyug ma//gus pas bstod cing 'dod don nyer gsol na//bsams pa'i don kun lhun gyis grub par mdzod//ces 'dod khams dbang phyug ma'i gtor bsngos khyer bde ba 'di ni rigs 'dzin sprul sku rin po che'i thuṭa dam du za hor gyi sdes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas lkog pa phun tshogs 146bdabang po'o//bh+yoḥsrid gsum dbang sgyur dpal ldan re ma tī//bka' nyan mngag gzhug bran 'khor spyan lam du//'dzad med nam mkha' mdzod kyi mchod pa'i sprin//sngags rgya ting 'dzin gyis spel thugasadam skongs//lang long khol ba'i khrag gi a sbreng //'phral bsad dbang po'i me tog 'khrig cing g.yo//bam sreg dud sprin kham nag 'thul ba 'dis//dmag zor rgyal mo 'khor bcas thugs dam skongs//tshil chen la sbar me lce srid rtser snyeg/༷ga mkhris dri chab dbyar mtsho'i rlabs ltar 'khrug/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)sha rus ro bda'i lha bsgos spungs pa 'dis/ /dmag zor rgyal ྾//rkang gling rol mo sna tshogs thig bzhin ldir/ /spyan 'dren brda yi dar nag ba dan g.yob/ /myur mgyogs shugs spyon khrag chang zhal skyems 'dis/ /dmag zor rgyal ྾/ /sga srab rgyan spras rta mchog stong gsum myul/ /'brong g.yag zhol mo char sprin lta bur rgyu/ /rwa bzhi 'khyil lug 'dab chags bya nag gis/ /dmag zor ྾/ /khyi nag gas po ce sbyang bzhi du 'phyo/ /srin po'i mgo lngags sbrul rgyan rkyang ser drel/ /be con nal thod mi lpags stag sham gyis/ /dmag zor ྾/ /skam rlon phreng ba rus rgyan byug rdzas gsum/ /re nag gosadang snyan rgyan seng ge sbrul/ /nad rkyal khram shing mtshon dru dkar nag shos/ /dmag zor ྾//rma bya'i gdugs dang nyi ma zla ba'i rgyan/ /rma nag 'tshe gur nad kyi rdzing bu dang / sru ba'i go cha rno ba'i mdzo rnon gyis/ /dmag zor ྾/ /dam rdzas gtor ma ri bo lta bur spungs/ /sman raka snyo ba rgya mtsho bzhin du 'khyil/ /lha mi'i dpal 'byor ma tshang med pa yis/ /dmag zor ྾/ /bya rog (147na)nal bu'i gsob snying sngags 'khor rdzas/ /legs bltams dbyangs can lha mor nges rnyed pa'i/ /phyi nang gsang ba de nyid rten mchog gis/ /dmag zor ྾/ /zhes dpal ldan 'dod khams dbang phyug ma'i bskang ba gsol ba'i dus nyung ngu 'byer bde zhig rtsoms shig par lo chen be+e ro'i yang srid chos rgyal gter bdag gling pas gsung gi bskul ba dang du blangs te za hor gyi ban+de gang shar rang grol gyi sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas bkras rab pa phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /'jam dpal khros pa'i gshin rje ma he'i zhal/ /bla mgon dbyer med myur mdzad ye shes mgon/ /gnod sbyin beg tse lcam dral 'khor dang bcas/ /thogs med 'dir spyon dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs/ /thod pa'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ /'bru gsum gyis sbyangs rtogs spel gtor ma che/ /ljags kyi sbu gu'i 'od kyis nyer drangs nas/ /dgyes rol phyi nang mchod pa 'bul gyi bzhes/ /sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las dpag yas par/ /lusang ga yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bdag gi 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi ba dang / /mthun pa'i dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol/ /zhes pa 'di ni dge slong bkra shis rnam rgyal —296

dam ༅ chos srung mngon rtogs tshon la rnam bzhi lhun grub/ (gegyi 'dod pa ltar za sto gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni phun dbang ngo / /bde ba can zhing mgon po gar gyi dbang / /mtsho las skyes pa'i rdo rje sprul pa'i sku/ /pad+ma thod 'phreng dam las mi 'da' ba'i/ /btsan rgod kha che dmar po da tshur spyon/ /zangs brag dmar po gnam la snyeg pa'i nang / khrag mtsho khol la rba klong 'khrug pa'i dbus/ /bse mkhar smug po rngams shing rab (147ba tharjid pa/ /ting 'dzin gyis sprul gnas 'dir dgyes bawo bzhugs/ /dmar chen khrag char — zhal du sbrengs/ /mig sna rna lce snying gi me tog 'phreng / ga chen spos dkar dud pa shangs su thul/ /tshil chen mar me spyan gyi gzigs mor sbar/ khrag dang mkhris pa'i dri chab thugasaskar byug sha rus lha pa'i zhal zas ljags la dbul/ /rkang gling thod pa gsang ba'i rnga chung dang / /dung chen sil snyan rnga sgras snyan dbang sim/ /sga srab gong rmed mdzes pa'i rta mchog 'phyo/ /seng ge glang chen ma he ra dang lug /khyim bya spra sprel ce spyang khyi nag dom/ /stag gzig gung gsum bya rgod glag mo khra/ /gna' ba dgo spyang sha ba la sogs pa/ /gnam la phur dgu sa la 'dzul dgu dang / /ri dwagasa'aphyo dgu mon pa a tsa ra/ /gar mkhan 'bag sogs mthun pa'i rdzas su 'bul/ khrab rmog par phub zhal btags 'ja' sgrigs can/ /mda' mdung spu gri ral gri dgra sta zhags/ /tho ba rdo chu me yi 'phrul sgrogs sogs/ /rang bsrung gzhan 'joms rnams kyis dgyes pa bskyed/ /dam rdzas gtore ma ri bo lta bur spungs/ khrag chang btung ba rgya mtsho bzhin du bskyil/ /'phan gdugs rgyal mtshan bla re lda ldi dang / /'dod yon sna lnga longs spyod tshogs kyis skongs/ khyun du gsol zhing mchod pa phyi yi rten/ /sba lcags rdzas la bsgrub pa nang gi rten/ /bla rdo srog gi 'khor lo gsang ba'i rten/ /bdud zhags dmar po de nyid rten gyis bkang / /ri rab gling bzhi gling phran nyi zla zung / /bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid nye ba bdun/ /lha mi'i dpal 'byor ma tshang med pa yis/ /btsan rgod 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugasadam bkang / /rlung gi shugs 'chang sga srab gong rmed can/ /rta mchog la zhon (148na stong gsum skad cig gis/ /myul nas bstan pa'i mel tshe legs mdzad pa/ /gnod sbyin kha che dmar po khyod la bstod/ /—297

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)dbang gi skyes bu khro gtum e gtsigs bsdams//nyi zla ltar 'khyil spyan gsum dgra la gzigs//sprul pa'i pho nyas log 'dren bla tshe 'gugs//zhing bcu sgrol ba'i bshan pa khyod la bstod//bse khrab ru dar tshon ris gos kyis bkra//brtsem rgyal mtshan bkra shis dgu brtsegs mdzes//zhags pasadagra bo'i ske 'a ming mdung rnon gyis//don snying 'bi gas mdzad 'khor dang bcas la bstod//li yul dge slong yid dbang gcigs pa las/khrag gi sgo nga las skyes btsan rgod che//'bar ba spun bdun 'gro la nyer 'tshe ba//dang por rta mgrin dbang gis dam la ba khas//bar du rgyal dbang pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis//srog snying blangs nas chos 'khor srung mar bskos//tha mar pad+ma dbang rgyal legasaldan rje//rigs 'dzin brgyud pa'i dam las ma 'da' bar//sangs rgyas bstan srungs dge 'dun tsho gos rnams spel//lus can ma lus bde ba'i dpal la sbyor//nad mtshon dus stig mi mthun phyogs su bzlog/bdag sogs bsams don lhun gyis grub par mdzod//ces zung mkhar mdo sngagasagling gi srung ma gnod sbyin kha che dmar pos rang nyid kyi gsol mchod cig rtsoms shig par bskul ba ltar za hor brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas bkras rab pa phun tshogs dbang po'o//gad kha sa'i lags a rgyal gyi 'phrul la brten sprul sku bsod nams dge legs dpal bzang gi sku skye brdzus ma lam du song ba smon lam log pa'i dam srir gyur te/'gro ba mang por gnod tshabs ches par rdo rje brag sprul sku rin po che/chos rgyal gter bdag gling pa/chos rje lug bya lung 1457/mnga' ris sngags 'chang dkon cog lhun grub/dpal ri sprul sku/phan bde legasabashad gling pa'i mtshams khag gnyis dang bcas sgrub khag bdun gyis bsreg pa me'i las sbyor gyisagatan med du btang skabs dpang gzur bkod pa/legs ldan phyag drug las gshin dmag zor lha//gdong bzhi mgon po lcam dral beg tse sogs//bsten mchod bsgrub pa'i srung ma dam can la//gser skyems phud kyi mchod pa 'di 'bul gyis//dam min dam brdzus grags pa rgyal mtshan zhes//smon lam log pa'i dam sri 'byung po 'dis//bstaX dang 'gro ba kun la 'tshe byed na//mgon skyabs

dam can chos srung ma' rtogs sun las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ ldanadapung gnyen ma mdzad thal bar rlog /gnod sbyin yang gha bza' sogs bstan ma dang / /rgyal po sku lnga khyab 'jug rdo rje legs/ khyad par gnas chung chos rgyal 'khor bcas la/ /gser ྾/ /dam ྾/ /smon lam ྾//bstan ྾/ /mgon ྾/ /tse dmar ba sogs 'bar ba spun bdun dang / /gsang phu bse yi khrab can gyis mtsho ni pa/ /'dre 'di'i skyabs gsol lha 'dre drag po la/ /gser ྾//dam ྾//smon lam ྾/ / bstan ྾/ /mgon ྾/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang rtsa brgyud bla ma yi/ /spyan sngar bstan 'gro'i phan bde spel ba sa /zhal gyis bzhes nas dam sri 'di skyabs tshe/ /sngon gyi dam tshig nyamasapar ma 'gyur ram/ /mi nad phyugs nad sad ser mu ge than/ /mi rung cho 'phrul sna tsho gos ston byed pa/ /'byung po sder bcas mas stobs nus pa dang / /lusang ga yid gsum rdul phran bzhin du rlog /ka ca'i rjes su wangs pa'i mi ma yin/ khal kha rgyal po'i ming can gnas 'dir spyon/ /dmar chen khrag gi btung ba skyems su 'bul/ sha khrag rus pa'i bsgos bu zas su 'bul/ /dbang po lnga la bde ba ster byed pa'i/ /mdzes(149na ga gar bsgyur sna tsho gis rol mo khrol/ /ngad ldang dri yi byug pa lha mi'i zas/ /'jam mnyen gos kyi khyad par longs spyod la/ /dge 'dun sde 'dir bshad dang sgrub pa yi/ /legs tshogos yon tan 'phel bar byed pa la/ /brlang por spyod pa'i nyer 'tshe ma lus pa/ /zhi zhing bde ba'i dpal la 'byor bar mdzod/ /ces pa 'di'ang dbu mdzad blo bzang yon to gyisadagos tshulu ltar bris/lhaḥ chos sku kun bzang gar dbang snang mtha' yas/ /longs sku khrag 'thung khro rgyal rta mgrin dbang / /sprul sku mtsho las skyes pa'i pad+ma 'byung / /sku gsum dbyer med thod 'phreng he ru gas/ /mi bzad rdo rje'i mtshon cha gtsug tu bkod/ /rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi lce la blug /gangs can bstan 'gro'i srung mar bka' bsgos pa'i/ /sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po pe
