ha ra/ /sku lnga sprul pa gsang yum blon po'i tshogs/ khyad par rje blon gnyis med rnam rol ba/ /dregs pa kun gyi sde dpon tse'u dmar/ /btsan rje gnod sbyin rdo rje drag po rtsal/ /dregs pa'i sdod pon chen po de dag gi /'bangs su gdug —299

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)pa'i sems kyis mtshams sbyar ba/ /dmag dpon gangs la nyi shar 'khor bcas rnams/ /gnasa'adir thogs pa med par tshur spyon la/ /rang rang dgyes pa'i gdan la brtan par bzhugs/ /dri bzang sman chab btab pa'i mchod yon dang / /dmar chen khrag mtsho khol ma'i a sbreng / /thang skyesachu skyes dbang po sna lnga sogs/ /sna tsho gis me tog phreng ba phang phung g.yo/ mang sna stong sbyar bsangasadang sha r+ṣa gyi/ /lang long dud sprin nam mkha'i mthongs kun 'gengs/ /nyi zla nor bu'i 'od dang rtsi 'bru'i mar/ /tshil chen ro skra la sbar snang gsal phreng / /ga pur ngad pa ldang ba'i dri chab dang / /khrag zhag mkhris pa'i byug rdzas gnod du (149ba gtams/ /lha mi'i ro brgya'i bza' bca' btung ba dang / /sha rus nang khrol zhal zas phyur bur spungs/ /sil snyan dzornga dung chen gling bu'i sgra/ /gsang ba'i thod rnga mi rkang gling bu 'bud/ /dmar chen gtor ma'i ri bo mkha' la snyeg /khrag chang rgya ja'i btung ba mtsho ru bskyil/ /rta mchog gong rmed sga srab mas kyis mdzes/ /spra dang spre'u mon pa dzo ki dang / /ban+de zhub can bud med zlos gar rtse/ /'brong g.yag gcan gzan ri dwags sgo phyugs sogs/ /gnam la phur dgu sal 'dzul dgu yi/ /grangs med srog chags sa gzhi ma lus bkang / khrab rmog zhes btagasapir phub sra ba'i go /mda' mdung ral gri dgra sta rno ba'i mtshon/ /dar gyi lda ldi 'phan gdugs bla bre dang / /zhing chen glang seng stag lpags gnam rgyan bres/ khyu ma'i srad bus dra ba la brgyus pa'i/ /mgo lag dbang po'i dra ba phyed pa 'phyang / /lha mi'i nor bu rin cen gzhed pa bkang / /sman dang ja sna rasadar snam ther rigs/ /'bru sna dkar gsum mngar gsum sha dang chang / /bcod dang zhun khan rgya skyegs rams la sogs/ /lho rdzas byang rdzas 'dod yon bsam mi khyab/ /mdor na dngos bshamasayid sprul mchod pa'i rdzas/ /dmag dpon gangs la nyi shar 'khor bcas la/ /'bul gyi dgyes par rol la bsams don sgrubs/ /gangs la nyi shar khyod kyi rje dpon ni/ /chos rgyal sku lnga blon por bcas pa yin/ /gnam lha byang chub sde bcas ma lus kun/ /mtsho skyes rdo rje'i pho nya mngag gzhug yin/ /pad+ma thod phreng bka' las nyer 'das na/ /dregs pa'i tsho gos kyi mgo bo tshal par 'gas/ /de —300

dam can chos srung mngon rtogs mun la rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)phyir rang rtags srog snying dmar po la/ /mi 'gyur rdo rjes rgyas btab nye bar soms/ /gangs can skye dgu'i bde skyid ma lus pa/ /'byung ba'i sgo gcig thub (150na tha'i bstan pa srungs/ /mi phyugs nad yams mu ge 'thab rtsod sogs/ /dus kyi chad pa thams cad rab zhi zhing / /'gro ba'i tshe dang longasaspyod dpal 'byor tshogs/ /yar ngo'i zla ba lta bur 'phel bar mdzod/ /dpag bsam shing dang yongs 'du'i ljon pa ltar/ /bsams pa'i re ba ma lus yongs su skongs/ /rgyal dbang pad+ma'i rigs 'dzin sngags 'chang rnams/ /bod 'bangs ris med skye dgu'i phan dang bde/ /spel la phrag dog med par 'phrin las kun/ /sgrub pa sngon gyi khas blangs dam tshig gnas/ /stod smad yul phyogs sa phyogs 'di nyid kyi/ /'gro rnams mi shes dbang sa lha khyod la/ /'phog thug nongs par gyur pa ci mchis pa/ /mchod bstod bskang bas nye bar dag par mdzod/ /btsan po'i go gyon rno mtshon sna tsho gos thogs/ /rta mchog rlung gi shugs can la zhen nas/ /stong gsum ma lus skad cig myul byed pa/ /dmag dpon 'khor dang bcas la bdag bstod do/ /byin rlabs char 'bebs bla ma pad+ma 'byung / /dngos grub kun stsol yi dam bka' brgyad lha/ /'phrin las yongs grub chos rgyal sku lnga po/ /yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa'i bkra shis shog /ces btsan rgod gangs la nyi shar gyi mchod bstod bskang ba 'di lta bu zhig brtson pas glengs zhes byang gling bsam grub rgyal por rgyu mtshan byas 'dug pa gzhan don gnyer chen pos bskul ba la brten nas za hor gyi brjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pas bgyis pa'o/ /raṃ me kho gis phyi nang mchod rdzas rnams kyi ma dag pa'i dngos 'dzin thams cad bsregs gtor bkrus/ /oṃ aḥlha gis bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por byin gyis brlabs te/ kye/ pho lha chen po dpal 'byor rgyal po khyod/ /rnga gzhang sgra dang snyan pa'i dbyangs snyan (150ba phros/ /'bod pa'i ched du bskul na ma g.yel bar/ /thogs med gnas 'dir tshur spyon stan la bzhugs/ /pho lha chen po 'khor bcas mchod pa'i rdzas/ /'chi med bdud rtsi pañtsa a mṛ taḥ/ /zhim dgu'i zas mchog sbyar ba'i —301 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa pag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)gtor ma dang / /dmar chen khrag zhag 'khrug pa'i btung ba bskyil/ /chang phud rin cen phye dang bsresapa'i skyems/ /rnyog bral chu dang rgya ja'i mchod yon bshams/ kha dog sna tsho gos bkra ba'i me tog phreng / /brgya phrag shing dang sman sna'i bsangs dud 'thul/ /rtsi mar zhun gyi sgron me rab tu gsal/ /gur kum ga bur sbyar ba byug pa'i dri/ /ro brgya'i dpal ldan bza' bca'i zhal zas spungs/ /sna tsho gis rol mo 'brug stong lta bur ldir/ /khrab glog zhol btags pir phub rang srung go /mda' mdung ral gri dgra sta phar 'joms mtshone/ /bra nag rting dkar rta mchog rlung ltar 'phyo/ /g.yag rgod zhol po ba lang ra lug bya/ /seng ge gnyis 'thung stag gzig ce spyang khyi/ /spang dkar bya pho khra sogs 'dab chags bya/ kha ba gna' rkyang gis mtshon ri dwaṭa dang / /gos gro nas sran 'bru yi bye brag rigs/ /sna tshogs rin cen dar zab ras sna ja/ /rgya bal hor dang tsi na'i yul gru sogs/ /las sgo nas 'ongs mkho dgu'i yo byad rdzas/ /mdzes sdug gar gyi rtsed 'jo snyan pa'i glu/ /gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla rgyal srid bdun/ /mdor na lha mi'i longs spyod ji snyed pa/ /sgo gsum dgyes pa bskyed pa'i ched du 'bul/ /bzhes nas bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /zla zhun lta bur mdzes brdzid sku mdog dkar/ /la thod za 'og sngon po'i tse gos rgya ne/ /sba lcag zhags 'dzin bra nag rting dkar bcibs/ /lha chen dpal 'byor rgyal po khyod la bstod/ /bdag cag ma rig nongs par bgyis pa'i tsho zhe/ /lha khyod (151na)bzod par bzhes nas mi nor kun/ /nyin mtshan dus rnams bsrung zhing skyob pa dang / /bsams pa'i re ba lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /sangs rgyas bstan srungs dkon cog dbu 'phang bstod/ /ces soṭa kyi 'dod gsol dang / /gang yang bdag blo rmongs pa yis/ /zhes sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra muḥs rang gnas su gshegs par gsol nas bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad ci rigs bya'o/ /zhesapa 'di yang mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje/ /gcig tu 'khyil ba 'ja' lus 'pho ba che/ grub —302

dam mā chos srung mdzo rtog tshon las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)pa'i tshe dbang rigs 'dzin sprul pa'i sku/ /pad+ma thod phreng byin wo char du phob/ /mgon khyod mthu stobs gzi byin bzhu blugs khams/ /mi bzad rdo rje 'bar ba'i phyag rtags rjes/ /spyi bor nyer bkod dregs pa'i sde dpon gtso/ /yab rje srog bdag lha chen tshangs pa dkar/ /gcig las du mar snang ba'i 'phrul po che/ /sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las rgyal po lnga/ /sprul pa gsang yum blon po las byed tshogs/ /sgos kyi ging chen srog bdud bse sku ba/ /'khor bcas snang srid dmag gi sdedapung rnams/ /rkang gling dung chen snyan pa'i rol mo dang / /'bod pa'i brda thabs dar tshon g.yab byed na/ /tshur spyon pad nyi bam ro'i stan la bzhugs/ /pad+ma rgyal pos srog snying rab blangs nas/ /'da' da'i dam tshig gnyen po bsgrags pa bzhin/ /thub pa'i bstan dang 'gro ba'i bde skyid la/ /dusadrug mel tshe'i bya ra rtag tu mdzod/ /rta drel ra lug bya khyi la sogs pa/ /phyi rten srog yig mdzes pa'i dar tshon spras/ /smyug rgod (151bcu rgyan rnga ma 'ja' tshon ltar/ /rnam bkra dar gyis leṭa spud nang gi rten/ /sku 'bag mdos dang srog gi 'khor lo sogs/ /bla rdo zhabrul med bcas pa gsang ba'i rten/ /lha chen tshangs pa chos rgyal mched lnga dang / /'khor tsho gos dregs pa dam can rgya mtsho'i dpung /khyad par bka' yi las byed bse sku ba/ /ma lus thugs dam gnyen po skong phyir 'bul/ /dgyes par bzhes la bdag sogs rgyu sbyor gyi/ /'gal rkyen kun sol mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi a mṛ taḥ/ /myong grol rin cen thod pa'i snod du bskyil/ /ri rab rten bskang dam rdzas gtor ma kun//phyur bur spungs pa sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras/ /bsad khrag rang byung rak+ta la sogs pa/ /dmar chen arga'i rba klong chal chil 'khrug /lha chen sogs tshig rkang drug po sbyar ba 'gre ྾/ /nyams chags dri ma dag pa byed pa'i bsangs/ /mngar ba'i ngad ldan shing sna'i dud pa 'thul/ /'bru bcud snying po phyungs pa'i ma da nar/ /rin cen sna lnga btab pa'i skyems bzang sbrang / /bgrang yas ro ldan bza' bca' btung bas gtams/ /zag med bdud rtsi tshogs kyi 'khor lo che/྾/ /gtsang ma'i chu rgyun khrag gi mchod yon bskyil/ /thang chur skyes dang dbang po'i me tog phreng / /sman spos sha chen —303

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)bsregs po dud pa'i sprin/ /nyi zla rtsi bcud zhun chen mar me gsal/ /ga pur mkhris pa'i dri chab byug pa'i rdzas/ /lha mi'i zas dang sha rus bsgos bu mchog ྾/ /thod pa'i cang te gsang ba'o rde'u chung / /mi rkang gling bu rdza rnga zom rnga dang / /dung chen rgya gling sil snyan pi wang sgra/ /gzugs mdzes gar dang rgyud mangs las drangs glu/ /gur kum ngad ldan dri yi dung cho me spel/ /bza' btung bye brag dar zab lhab lhub g.yo/྾/ /rin cen 'phru (152na dzin za 'og spel legs bkra/ /rngams byed stag dang rab 'jigs gdong lnga pa/ /mdzes sdug rma bya za byed spyang zhi'i gdong / /nam 'phang mthor gcod bya rgod rtsal chen sprel/ /mi bzad byi la'i mgo tog pags pa yi/ /lhab lhub srid rtser bsgreng ba'i rgyal mtshan brgyad/྾/ /sra ba'i go khrab sram skor gos gsham mdzes/ /rmog chen ang zing dom phru rnga ga spyos can/ /zhol btags lcags gzhibs rnga chas 'ja' ltar bkra/ /dpag chen mda' mdung ral ga spu gro da nga / /me chu rdo shing rnam mang 'phrul gi skyogs/ /dgra sta tho ba sna tsho gos mtsho ni cha'i rigs/྾//gong ṣ+ka sga srab mas mdzes gyi ling rta/ /'brong g.yag rdo rje/rwa rtse mkha' la bsnyeg /'dod las ba dang gnam la 'phur dgu'i bya/ /sal 'dzul dgu ri dwags 'phyo dgu dang / /glang chen seng ge stag gzig gcan gzan rigs/ /mdor na srid do cog gi srog chags tshogis/྾/ /tse ber ber zlam bla gos slong ba'i snod/ /gseg shang sag theb thib zhu mthing nag zhwa/ /phod ka tse gos rus pa rin cen rgyan/ /sag lham zhing chen glang shun stag sham sogs/ /mche can pags rigs mgo phreng skam rlon rnyid/ /dar gyi ang rag ga sha sprul chun tshogs/྾/ /'bag dang seng ge spra dang spre'u dang / /byi la dzo gi mon pa zhus can dpung / /dge slong dgra bcom sngags pa phur bu thogs/ /bud med gos nag g.yab cing 'o dod 'bod/ /lus kyi rnam 'gyur bro gar shon gyi rigs/ /gdangs dbyangs glu gzhag mgrin las byung ba'i sgra/྾/ /be+eḍūr+ya dang pad rā ga an+da rnyil/ /mar gad g.yu dang byu ru mu khyi taḥ/ /gser dngul zangs sogs sna tsho gos rin po che/ /dar zab sman sna snam ras btsod zhun skog /dkar gsum mngar gsum shing tog 'bru sna ja/ /lho dzos byang rdzas 'dod (152ba nyan na grangs med pa/྾/ /lhun po —304

dam can chos srung ma' rtogs tshon las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)gser gyi ri bdun rol mtsho 'khyil/ /gling bzhi gling phran brgyad kyi phyoṭa mtshams bskor/ /gsal byed nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor zung du 'brel//'khor los sgyur rgyal sngon 'gro rin cen bdun/ /bkra shis rtagasabargyad la sogs lha dang mi'i/ /phun tsho gos mkho dgu'i dpal 'byor ma lus pa/྾/ /gangs ri'i mdangs 'dzin zhi ma khro yi sku/ /gnag snum dbu skra'i thor tshugs mdzes pa'i rtser/ /bkra shis g.yasasu 'khyil bas rab mtshan pa/ /lha chen tshangs pa'i rgyal po khyod la bstod/ /dar dkar lhab lhub g.yo ba'i tse gos rgyan/ /rin cen rgyan spras shel gri zhags pa sogs/ /sna tshogs mtsho ni chas dgra bgeṭa 'joms mdzad pa/ /mas chen srog gi bdag po khyod la bstod/ /sga srab gong rmed spu len ze long khebs/ /gser sbyangs rgyan mdzes rta mchog rlung shugs can/ /zhon nas stong gsum skad cig bskor mdzad pa/ /dregs pa'i sde dpon chen po khyod la bstod/ /ye nas dug lnga kodag rigs lnga'i dngos/ /rnam pa ye shes sgyu ma 'phrul po che/ /chos rgyal sku lnga gsang yum blon po sogs/ /dam can bka' nyan bye ba'i tsho gis la bstod/ /khyad par rab dmar bse yi khrab rmog gyon/ /mi bzad mtshon thogasadapa' gtum khro tshul can/ /las rnams kun sgrub bshan pa bse sku ba/ /lha srin dpung gi sna 'dren khyod la bstod/ /ka pā la ru dgra khrag mtshor bskyil ba/ kha gdangs mche gtsigs ljags bskyod hub kyis 'thung / /ga sha mi mgo'i do shal rngams shing brjid/ /nga ro drag pos log 'dren 'gugs la bstod/ kho co'i dbyangs dang rol mo'i sgra yis bos/ /ma shas kun tshang dam rdzas gtor ma bshams/ /ja chang skyems kyi mchod yon sbrengs pa na/ /nya rgyas zla 'dra'i zhal khyim ston la bstod/ /ta la'i lo mar bris pa'i nya bos la/ /tha ba'i sems (153na mong 'a dgra bgegs bla tshe srog /da lta nyid du rigasapar bkug nas kyang / /na 'chi'i duḥkhas mnar bar mdzad la bstod/ /pa sangs bzhin du sdebargyad skar tshogs dbus/ /pha rol zil gyis gnon pa'i tshangs pa ches/ /ba mo nyi mas zhu ltar yid srubasadapung / /ma lus thal bar rlog byed khyod la bstod/ /tsa na yin kyang mthun pa'i dam rdzas bsags/ /tsha grang khyad du gsad pa'i bka' thub bsten/ /ja bod mā rwa'i bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gyi/ /wa ler ting —305

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)'dzin gsal na lha khyod dgongs/ /zhwa ltar mtho ba cher rlom dgra bo'i dpung / /za ma tsam yang 'jog pa'i long med par/ /'a 'ur las kyi rlung shugs kyis ded nas/ /ya ma rā dza'i zhal du myur du thob/ /ra gdengs rdo rje lta bur rgyu sbyor srog /la la mā yin rtag tu mi 'gyur brtan/ sha stag gtan mdun sgrub pa'i chos byed kyis/ /sa chen khong la thub bstan rgyas par mdzod/ /ha la ltar rtsub cher snyigasadusang na nad/ /a mṛ ta mtshudas nus pas gzhe mes byas nas/ /ha har bzhed pa'i phun tsho gos dga' ston rnams/ /a bru'i 'bras ltar smin pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /rgyal kun 'dus pa'i ngo bo pad+ma 'byung / /'dzam gling che ba'i rig sngags yong ba des/ /sgrub chen bka' brgyad lha yi dkyil 'khor du/ /dbang bskur bstan pa'i srung mar ma bskos sam/ /he ru ka dpal mi yi gzugs 'dzin pa/ /rje 'bangs nyer lnga so zur gnubs sum pa/ /nyang ral chos dbang la sogs bka' gter gyi/ /rigasa'adzin brgyud pa'i dam tshig rab dgongs la/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas rnam 'dren bzhi po'i bstan/ /bod skyong rgyal po'i mnga' thang ra srid rgyas/ /ljongs 'dir nad mug 4ba rtsod nyes pa'i tshogs/ /yongs zhi skyid pa'i nyi ma gung (143bskor mdzod/ khyad par srong btsan thugs dam lha kun dang / /mtha' 'dul yang 'dul ru gnon gtsug lag khang / /bye brag dpal gyi khra 'brug rten brten pa/ /'gro ba'i bsod nams zhing du dar bar mdzod/ /mdor na yon sbyor sbyin pa'i bdag pos ma rdzo/ /bdag cag rnams kyi 'phrin las rnam pa bzhi/ /bsams pa ji bzhin lhun gyis rab 'grub pa'i/ /bkra shis dga' ston phyogs bcur rgyas par mdzod/ /ces khra 'brug gi gnas kyi srung ma dpal ldan tshangs pa chen pos sde brgyad go rim bsgrigs pa'i gsol mchod cig rtsoms shig par rdo rje'i gsung gis bskul ba dngos gzhi 'phrin las don bcu ma gyer dgos par de ga'i cha lag tu sbyar rung ba'i gsol mchod tsam du shing yos mgo zla'i gral tshes dge bar za hor gyi sngags spyon bzhad pa rtsal gyis pho brang chen po po ta lar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /sngon tshe laṅka'i sgo srung chen po pa/ /deng sang rwa sgreng rgyal soṭa gnas skyong mkhan/ /phying dkar —306

dam ༅ chos srung ma' rtogs tshon las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ rtodapejo bo rgyal mtshan 'khor bcas rnams//thogs pa med par gnas 'dir da tshur spyon//rnyog med dngasapa'i chu klung sman chab mtsho//khrag dang zhag gi btung ba chal chil g.yo//thang skyes chu skyes dbang po'i me tog dang //brgya phrag ljon shing bsregs pa'i bsangs dud 'khrigs//rtsi mar 'bru mar rkang gi sgron me sbar//dam rdzas gtor ma bgos bu'i bye brag spungs//sil snyan dung wo rnga bo che yi sgra//rnga dang g.yag rgod bya khyi ce spyang sogs//gcan gzan ri dwags 'dab chags pha mtha' yas//rdo rje go mtshon bse phub mda' mdung zhags//sbu gri ral gri mtshon cha sna tshogs bsgreng //dngos bshams yid sprul mchod pa 'bul byed na//sangs rgyas bstan srungs rnal 'byor bdag cag gi144na/nad gdon bar gcod mi mthun phyogs zhi zhing //tshe dang bsod nams bshad sgrub bya ba sogs//yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel ba'i 'phrin las mdzod//gtor ma a kā ros bsngos la 'bul lo//zhes pa 'di'ang lha nyid khog tu zhugs nas bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o//gzhom med 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku brnyes nas//'khor 'das rgyal po pad+ma thod phreng rtsal//zhabs sen bung ba gtsug tor 'dab stong gi/ge sar rtse mor byang chub bar du bsten//kha ba'i rdul brtsegs kyis bskor sman gyi ljongs//legs skyong bcu gnyis bstan ma'i sgra bo che//phyogs bral lusaphra'i rna rgyan 'od 'bar yang //tshul bzhin rtogs nyung phal cher na yams tsam//bdud mo mched lasardo rje kun bzang ma//gangs dkar skyong ba'i yum chen bkra shis lha//tshe ring 'byor ba stsol de'i mchod chog 'phrin//dpyad gsum dag pa'i rgyud mang 'di na'o//de yang bod kha ba can gyi rgyal khamasa'adi nyid skyong ba'i bstan ma bcu gnyis zhes mthu stobs rdzas la dpag par dka' ba rnams rje khri srong lde'u btsan yan chad du g.yung drung bon gyis bsten pa'i lha yin la/sangs rgyas gnyis pa skyon gyi mkhan po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis btul zhing dam la btags pa nas bzung gsang chen rnying ma'i chos skyong du mdzad pas 'phrin las tshogs kyi mchod pa/ ༷jug tu bstan ma skyong ba nges par dgos la/rje

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)btsun mi las gzung mar mdzad pa'i rnam mgur tshe ring ma'i skor gyi lo rgyus la brten dwags brgyud pa phyogs la grags che yang / bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi khrod du yod pa ma rtogs par lha zur pa (154ba)zhig tu 'khrul zhing de'i rgyun 'byams pas rang gzhan mang por tshe ring mched lnga dang bstan ma bcu gnyis zhes na yams smra ba la snying po med mod/ 'on kyang bla ma snga ma 'dras sger du gsol rgyun byung ba 'dir ma zad bstan ma gzhan la'ang sgos mgron du bya mi rung ba ma yin pas lhag skyon du 'gyur bar mi sems/ /de yang gter kha gong 'og sogs mang por gangs kyi yum chen bkra shis tshe ring legs sbyor yi ge'i ser thang sogs mtshan gyi rnam grangs dang sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha'i rnam 'gyur mi 'dra ba du ma byung bas shes bya mtha' bkag gi gu dog mi dgos shing / deng sang yongs grags dang nyang gter gnyis phyogs mthun pa'i rjes su 'brangs/ bskyed chog dang mchod bstod gter kha gzhan nas kyang kha bkang ste bgyi ba la mchod gtor spyan gzigs mthong brgyud kyi phyag len ltar 'du byas/thog mar rang nyid khro bo'i nga rgyal bskyed pa ni gter kha 'og ma'i dgongs don gyi snying po bsdus pa 'di lta ste/ su bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ pad+ma nyi ma ru tra pho mo gan rkyal kha bug tu bsnol ba'i steng du rang nyid skad cig gis khro bo rdo rje gnod sbyin sku mdog mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing ba/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje thod khragabar pa gnyis rdor dril/ tha ma gnyis zhing dbyug ri rab bsnams pa/ dur khrod kyi chas kyi rgyan pa/zhabs gnyis g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gis ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsam/ bdud rtsi ni/ chos sman chang la btab na byin rlabs bya mi dgos shing ma rnyed na/ a mṛ tasabasangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung raṃ las me kai las thod pa'i skyed bu gsum gyi steng du a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ dbus na phyogs bzhir rim (155nasgo zhin byang sems seng ge'i sha dri chen glang po che'i sha ga chen rta'i sha /pad+ma rak+ta rma bya'i sha /dri chu khyung sha /sman bzang po drug dang bcas pa de'i steng du hūṃ ā+oṃ swā e hā 4 lo me —308

dam can chos srung mngon rtogs sun las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)paṃ snya las rigs lnga yab yum gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros 'khor 'das kyi ro bcud rnams bkug pa dang sbyor mtshams nas byang chub kyi sems dkar dmar gyi rgyun babs te rigs lnga yab yum 'od du zhu nas 'dres pas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho zad mi shes par bsam/ ā+oṃ āḥlha sarba pañtsa a khra ta hūṃ hrī4 zhes lan gsum mam bdun gyis byin gyis brlabs/ gtor ma ni/ rlung me thod pa'i skyed bu gsum gyis bteg pa'i ka pā la stong gsum dang mnyam pa'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga zhu zhing khol ba'i steng du ā+oṃ āḥlha dkar dmar mthing gsum brtsegs pa las 'od zer 'phros 'khor 'das kyi nus pa thams cad bsdus te yi ge gsum dang lhan cig par 'od du zhu nas thim pas kha dog dri ro reg bya phun sum tsho gos par bsam/ ā+oṃ aḥlha ma hā ba lo ta hūṃ lha'i/ rak+ta ni/ ā las thod pa'i nang du ra las rdo rje sgeg mo'i mkha' nas rak+ta'i rgyun babs te gang bas nyon mongs pa 'dod chags 'joms pa'i nus pa dang ldan par bsam/ ā+oṃ āḥlha ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal hūṃ hrīḥṭha/ nyer spyod brlab pa ni/ ā+oṃ las rin po che dang a las thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du phyi nang gi nyer spyod rnams rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i so so'i rnam par gsal zhing byed las dang ldan par gyur/ ā+oṃ — nas sha rdi'i bar brjod/ rten bskyed pa ni/ a khra tas bsangs/ ༷ was sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las gangs ri dkar po shel dkar gyi ri bo ltar 'od du 'tsher ba la rked par na bun tshogs pa/ chu klung mang po dal gyis 'bab pa/ g.ya' chu sil ma dang (155bzha'u gsing gi ljongasakha dog sna tsho gos pa'i me tog bkra ba/ ljon ba'i tshal gyi rtse mor bya rnams skad snyan sgrog pa/ phyogasakun tu ri dwags dang gcan gzan rnams rgyu ba sogs 'khor yug gi nang du hūṃ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i pho brang mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi so sor a las zla'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du dbus nas brtsams te g.yas bskor du me dkar mthing ser dmar ljang lnga yongs su gyur pa las dbus su dpal ldan rdo rje kun tu bzang bo tshe ring ma sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa khro 'dzum chags pa'i nyams can phyag —309

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)g.yas gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa gdengs shing g.yon bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thugs dar 'dzin pa/gter la gong mar sngon mo 'og mar dkar po las dmar ser sog gter gzhung tshor sku'i rnam 'gyur phyag mtshan ma gcig pa sna tsho gos pas mtha' gcig tu ma nges kyang sku mdog rigs 'dzin yol mo ba'i bri sku'i rjes su 'brang shing bdud mo bzhir spyan gsum sam skas brag gi ga kho mar shad do/ /dar dkar dang dar dmar gyi tse gos dang dar ljang gi lhab lhub can dbu skra gnag snum gyi thor tshugs bcings pa'i lhag ma'i zar bu dpung pa'i thad du sleb pa ni rin po che'i brog zhu snyan rgyan mgul rgyan gdu bu se mo do do shal 'og pag sogs rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa seng ge dkar mo'i steng na rgyal po rol pa'i 'dug stangs kyi bzhugs pa/ shar gyi 'dab ma la mthing gi zhal bzang ma sku mdog mthing kha zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pas snang srid gsal ba'i me long dang g.yon ba dan 'dzin pa rkyang la bcibs pa/ lho'i 'dab mar mi g.yo blo bzang ma sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi phyag g.yon pas gser gyi gzhed pa zas sna tshogs kyis bkang ba bzung ba nas/ g.yas pas sgrub pa po la stsol ba'i phyag rgya can stag la bcibs pa/ nub kyi 'dab mar cod pan mgrin bzang ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas nor bu dang g.yon gter gyi sgrom bu 'dzin (156na tsā nga sha ba yu mo la bcibs pa/ byang gi 'dab mar gtad dkar 'gro bzang ma ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas rtswa du bo dang g.yon sbrul zhags 'dzin cing g.yu 'brug sngon mo la bcibs pa/ bzhi ga'ang zhi zhing 'dzum la yid tsam khros pa dbu skra'i thor tshugs la na bu'i zar bu can dar dmar po'i steng du dkar po'i tse gos lhab lhub tu brtsegs pa rin po che'i thod dang snyan cha mgul rgyan/ /do shal gdu bu sogs rgyan thams cad kyis mdzes par brgyan pa bdud mo dang sman mo sogs sprul pa'i 'khor dpag tu med pas bskor bar bsam/ spyan drang zhing bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ ga kho kha'og ma/ gangs kyi yum chen rdo rje kun tu bzang : ber dmar gyon nas phyag na thod khrag 'dzin bong bu ga pa zhen nas stong gsum myul btsan thogs 'dul phyir la phyi'i gangasanas gshegs sngo nag mo bzhin mi sdug gi bdud mo'i rigs/ /sngon tshe a su ra yi brag phug dben —310

dam tso chos srung ma' rtogs 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ (geganas su//slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang //bshes gnyen rlangs chen dpal gyi seng ge yis//zhing chen bsgyel ba'i steng du bzhag nas kyang /ga kho kha'og mnas4'a ris paṇa ོ gyis gsalalas dmig bsal gyi ra du byungs//rdo rje lag gtad bdud rtsi lce la bzhag/de tshe khas blangs dam lasam 'da' bar//tshur gshegs tshur spyon bod skyong bstan ma rnams//kun kyang lhab lhub mang po brgyan dang bcas//rol mo sil snyan mang po'i sgra dang bcas//bran g.yog mang po'i 'khor dang bcas te spyon//'dir gshegs dam skong 'phrin las grub par mdzod//lha:sngon nyang gter la tshig zur cung zad bcos pa tshe dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal:ye shes mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong can gyi spyan sngar thugs dam zhal bzhes dam bcas pa'i bkra shis tshe ring 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs sngon tshe bal po kha la rong 156ba bo gu phu slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi spyan sngar thugs dam zhal bzhes dam bcas pa'i rdo rje kun bzang 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs rang rang sde brgyad du ma'i 'khor bcas rnams dam can rnal 'byor sgrub po 'khor bcas la:thuṭa ni brtse bas rjes su nyer dgongs la spyan 'dren mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol phyi ltar gsar rtsom/kha ba'i rdul brtsegs she la dkar ni//nang du yid 'phrog rin cen pho brang nas//'chi bdag g.yul las rgyal byed kun bzang ma//gtso mo bkra shis tshe ring gnas 'dir gshegs//snang zhing srid pa'i chos kyi gzugs brnyan kun//ma 'dres me long ngos su yongs shar bas//bzang ga bra rtags ma lus ston byed ma//mched zla mthing gi zhal bzang ྾//mtho ris bdag pos longs su nyer spyod pa//phun tshogs ro brgyas gang ba'i gser gzhong nas//mi 'dzad zas kyi dngos grub stsol mdzad ma//mched zla mi g.yo blo bzang ྾//lha klu gnod sbyin mi yi bang mdzod kha//phye nas gter gyi sgrom bu legs bkang ste//'dod dgu'i dpal 'byor mtha' dag stsol byed ma//mched zla cod pan mgrin bzang ྾//rta mchog glang chen ma he 'brong g.yag lug/sa la 'dzul dgu ri dwags 'phyo dgu sogs//sna tshogs rkang bzhi'i dngos grub sbyin byed ma//mched zla gtad dkar 'gro bzang ྾//hūṃ lam 'greng

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)ba dz+ra ti blta bting ting badz+ra ma sa pa ri wā ras khye hi/bh+yoḥgan kha gomar+sā mi kha ra rtsa hud baṣ+ṭha la/bdud mo r+ṣa mo gangs kyi yum r+ṣa ma bzhi mi sdug gi bu mo ser nag rgyan:rnal 'byor dbang gi wen las bsgrub pa'i phyir dmar nag ro yig dan la bzhugs su gsol sam ya phebs/lhaḥg kho kha'og mo las sa da lo pa/nga ni che mchog he ru ga:sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam sbyar ba'i ji snyed 157nasangs rgyas thams cad kyi de bzhi sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis ming sring bzhin du dam bsres pa'i dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab rdo rje dri chu bdud rtsi mchog:pañtsa a skṛ ta sbyar te legs sbyor yi ge'i ser thang mo:khro bo rdo rje gnod sbyin gyis lce la bdud rtsi bzhag nas sngon tshe ji ltar mna' bor bzhi nga yang dam las mi 'da'o khyed rnams dam las ma 'da' smo gal te dam las khyod 'das na khro bo rdo rje gnod sbyin gyis snying khrag bzhe me te las bar byed:de bas dam las ma 'da' bar bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod badz+ra ya spru hūṃ hūṃ/mchod pa 'bul ba ni/bcom ga kho kha'og ma las mi khur sa da ༅la pa/ldan che mchog yab yum dang :nyi zla 'od kyi dkyil 'khor na gangs kyi yum r+ṣa 'khor yos la rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam tsosamanyes ma rdzo 'bul thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol:ma hā pañtsa a : ta kha raṃ khā hi/bh+yoḥgangs kyi yum wo 'khor sa sa la phyi yi mar pa 'bul ba ni/mdzes pa me kho dbu la 'bul dri zhim bdug spos shangs la 'bul snang gsal mar me spyan la 'bul dam rdzasagator ma ljags la 'bul:thod rnga gling bu snyan la 'bul mi lpags g.yang gzhi sku la 'bul sha r+ṣa spos kyi ma rdzo pa 'bul:sa r+pā mar me'i mar pa 'bul:rdo rje dri chu byug pas mar 6 badz+ra adhū pe/ā lo geg rje/ni wa te/shabha pā dza me gha sa mu dra skyo ra ṇa sam ya lha bh+yoḥrang byung nang mtsha 'bul ba ni:gos kho 'khur ba zan dang ma pa mi sha la sogs sha lngas brgyan:gti mug sha ni zlan las zhimaḥ 157ba'i dod chags khrag ni chang las zhim:zhe sdang keng rus ga ltar phungasanang gi mchod par bzhes su gsol ma hā pā dza ho:bh+yoḥganyis med gsang mchod 'bul ba ni/zag

dam can chos srung mtho rtogs 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)bcas phung po rnam pa lnga sku yi mchod par bzhes su gsol 'dod chags zhe sdang nyon mongs lnga gsung gi mchod par bzhes su gsol:thig le dkar dmar bde gsal dbyings:thugs kyi mchod par bzhes su gsol bla med gsang ba'i blo bral dang :blo dang ldan ba sna tshogs rnam gzung 'dzin med par 'bul lags kyis:dug gsum lusang ga yid dang gsum:sku gsung thugs kyi mchod par bzhes:ma hā pā dza ho thugs dam skong ba ni/a tho tas bsangs/su bhā was sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las mchode rdzas rnams rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i spyan gzigs sa dang bar snang gi khyon gang ba sku gsung thugs dgyes pa bskyed cing thugs dam gar+sā po dbyings su skong ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/oṃ sarba bid pā ra pā ra su ra su ra a warta ya a wa rta ya ho badz+ra snya ra ṇa khaṃ swā hā zhes sngaṭa rgyas byin gyis brlab/bh+yoḥgasar rtsom/brgya phrag chu bo 'dus pa rnyog med klung //skyems dang dri ma sel ba'i rdzas su 'bul//pad+ma ut+pal la so zhe chu skyes rigs//stong phrag sa po dbu yi thod du 'tshing /mang sna sman spos sbyar ba dud pa'i sprin//lang long nam mkha' khyab pas nyer tsho gos bsangs//nyi zla me shel rtsi mar 'byu bcud las//sbar ba'i sgron me'i 'od kyis phyogs kun gsal//ga bur gur kum dri ngad yongs 'thul ba'i//brlan gsher thugs kar byug pa'i rdzas su 'bul//lha mi'i bza' bca' ro mchog brgya ldan pa//zhal zasari bo'i rjes su 'gro ba bzhin//sil snyan dzornga 158na khung wo gling bu sogs//rna bar snyan cing brjid pa'i sgra dbyangs 'brol//dmar chen khrag gi a lha rba klong 'khrug/mig sogs dbang po'i me tog 'phrig cing 'dar//bem ro bsregs pa'i kham nag dud sprin gtibs//tshil zhun skra sdong lasasbar mar me'i 'phreng /khrag zhag mkhris pa nyer bsres dri chab 'khyil/sha khrag rus pa'i lha bsgosaphyur bur spungs//rkang gling thod rnga gsang ba'i rnga chung 'khrol//seng ge rkyang stag sha ba g.yu 'brug sogs//sna tsho gos bzhen pa'i khyad par ji snyed dang //gnam la 'phur dgu sal 'dzul dgu'i rigs//ri dwags lho dgu srog chags bgang las 'das//be+eḍūr+ya pad rā ga dbang sngon ma rga ta//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)gser dngul g.yu dang mu tig la sogs pa/ /rin cen rgyan dang dar zab las grub pa'i/ /tse gosayug rgyan la sogs na bza'i rigs/ /rus rgyan mgo phreng zhing chen glang seng dang / /stag lpags g.yang gzhi la sogs drag po'i chas/ /bdud rtsi bum pa kun gsal me long dang / /zas kyi gzhed pa rin cen gter gyi sgrom/ /du bo sbrul zhags thod khrag 'khor lo gri /nor bu pad+ma mdung thung dpag chen mda'/ /dgra sta rtse gsum lcags kyi tho ba dang / /lcags kyi gsal shing la sogs sna tshogs mtsho ni/ /khrab rmog phub dang zhol btags 'ja' ris can/ /lcags gzhibs kyis mtshan rang srung sra ba'i go /phyi nang nyer spyod sman gtor khrag chang skyems/ /lhun po gling bzhi gling phran rin cen ri/ /yongs 'du 'dod 'jo'i ba dang ma rmos thi/ /rgyal srid sna bdun gter chen bum pa bzang / /sgeg sogs brgyad dang nyi zla rgyal mtshan gdugs/ /mdor na lha mi'i dpal 'byor longs spyod kyis/ /dpal ldan bkra shis tshe ring thugs dam bskang / /pra ston mthing gi zhal bzang ྾/ /zas ster mi g.yo blo bzang ྾ /nor stsol cod (154)pan mgrin bzang ྾/ /rkang bzhi spel mdzad gto dkar ྾/ /bdud dang sman mo gnod sbyin gdug pa'i rigs/ /ma tsho gos bka' nyan 'khor gyi ྾/ /bdag sogs ma rig nongs pa'i nyes pa kun/ /snying nas bshags so tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /thugs dam gnyen po dbyings su skongs gyur nas/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /bstod pa ni/ lhaḥrdo rje dbang phyug chos dang gig kho byon/ ye shes khro rgyal gnyu gdug pa'i dbang gis khro bo'i skur bstan paḥ dur khrod chas kyis sku la rab tu brjid: phyag drug phyag na mtshon cha sna tsho gis bsnams: zhabasaganyis ru dra'i steng na stabs kyis bzhugs khro bo rdo rje gnod sbyin sku la bstod bong bu zhen nasabadud dpung g.yob par byed: gangs kyi yum chen sku la phyag 'tshal bstod bh+yoḥ rab mdzes shel gas rtsom/ dkar zhun ma'i lhun po la/ /'bum phrag ston zla byugs 'dra'i yid 'phrog sku/ /dar zab gos dang nor bu'i rgyan spras pa/ /tshe yi dpal ster bkra shis lha mor bstod/ /'gas rung mtshon dang mi sdug na bza' gsol/ /sna tsho gos bzhe zhe pas stong gsum skad cig myul/ /log 'dren dgra bo —314

dam can cho srung ma' rtogs phren las rnam sto lhun grub/ rtogecham la 'bebs mdzad ma//mas stobs dbang phyug bdud mo che la bstod//zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las bsgrub pa'i phyir//ma nges sku yi rnam 'gyur cir yang ston//dpag par dka' ba'i 'phrul ldan gangs kyi yum//dpal ldan rdo rje kun bzang ma la bstod//mtha' klas srid pa'i khongs su snang ba'i gzugs//dri bral me long ngos la bra phab nas//bzang ngan ma lus ma 'dres ston mdzad pa//ma mo mthing gi zhal bzang ston la bstod//phun tsho gos ro brgya bda' ba zas kyi g.yang //rin cen gser gyi gzheng par yongs khugs pa//ci dgar stsol la gtang ba'i sgo 'byed mkhan//ma mo mi g.yo blo gros bzang la bstod//rmugs 'dzin dbang po'i gan mdzod 'byor pa kun//rin cen sgom du phyur bur nyer spungs nas//phun tsho gos 'dod dgu'i mchod sbyin stsol mkhas pa//ma mo cod pan mgrin pa bzang la bstod//seng ge rkang pa brgyad ldan gyi ling rigs//rta drel glang po khyu mchog rkang bzhi'i tshogs//kun bzod lta ba khyab par spel mdzad pa//ma mo gtad dkar 'gro bzang khyod la bstod//bzhin mdzes lha sman gzuṭa dang chags nyams can//res 'ga' mi sdug bdud mo gnod sbyin tshul//thogs med las kun sgrub pa'i giṅka ra//bka' nyan 'khor tshogs rgya mtshor bcas la bstod//'phrin las 'chol ba ni//bh+yoḥslob dpon chen po pad ma thod 'phreng gis//brin gyi la phyi chu dbar gnasamachog tu//legs sbyor yi ge'i ser thang mo khyod kyi//gsang mtshan rdo rje kun bzang mo ru btags//slob dpon rlangs chen dpal gyi seng ge yis//zhing chen gdan bzhag dam tshig ma bsgrags sam//sngags 'chang gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes kyis//dbang bskur bdud rtsi lce la ma bzhag gam//gter ston nyang ral yab sras chos kyi dbang //pad+ma dbang chen dmar zhabs ral pa dang //gragasargyan bkra shis mas can shes rab 'od//chos blo dbang phyug blo gros bsod nams seng //'jam blo dam pa chos tshul nam mkha' dpal//'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan paṇa chen pad+ma dbang //lha rigasalegs ldan rdo rje mkhyen brtse'i zhabs//dbang phyug rab brtan rje btsun bka' 'gyur ba//bka' drin mnyam med chos dbyings rang grol sogs//dngos brgyud bla ma'i spyan sngar zhal bzhes bzhin//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)thub pa'i bstan dang skye rgu'i bde skyid spel/ /bdag gi chos dang srid kyi 'dod don sgrubs/ khyad par kha bas bskor ba'i bod yul 'dir/ /mi nad phyugs nad mu ge dbul phongs dang / /stod smad gdug pa'i dmag dang 'thab rtsod g.yul/ /dus kyi chad pa ma lus zhi bar (159bsgodzod/ /bye brag stod hor glo mon la sogs nas/ /bsam ngan sbyor rtsub 'chang ba'i dgra bo'i dpung / /sdebacas sha khrag tshogs su nyer rol te/ /tshe srog stobs lhor rdul du brlag par mdzod/ /lo tog sbrum pa mtha' bzhi'i las sgo dang / /sgo gsum sim pa'i tshor ba rtag tu myang / /ring por 'tsho sogs legs tshogisam lus pa/ /brgyad khri'i tshe ldan skye rgu ltar 'phel mdzod/ /khyad par la phyi chu dbar yul phyi 'dir/ /kun mkhyen blo bzang grags pa'i ring lugs srol/ /legs 'dzin bslab gsum 'chad pa'i 'dus pa'i sde/ /skye rgu'i bsod nams zhing du rgyas par mdzod/ /mdor na zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod kyis/ /yid la 'dod pa 'jo ba dpag bsam dbang / /nyer sdud re ba'i 'bras bu ma lus pa/ /smin pa'i dga' ston dar ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /gsol mchod ni/ phye gtsang mar sman spos btab cing mar chang gis brdzis pa'i bgos bu gtso 'khor lnga pa'am rgyas par spro na snod so sor rgyan gyis mdzes shing kha zas sna tshogs kyis bskor bar mda' dar btsugs pa rgya phor bzang po chang gis bkang bar mar gyi ze sgron byas pa/ gzhan yang mchod bskang gi gtor ma'i phabs dang tsho gis kyi phud dang mthun rdzasarnams bshams par bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs la/ ā+oṃ mchod do phud kyi mnga' bdag rgyal ba dgongs brgyud rigs 'dzin brda brgyud gang zag snyan brgyud smon lam dbang bskur brgyud pa bka' babs las 'phro brgyud pa shog ser tshig gi brgyud pa sogs dngos brgyud kyi bla ma spyi dang khyad par slob dpon pad+ma thod 'phreng gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes slob dpon rlangs chen dpal seng mnga' bdag nyang ral yab sras gter ston chos kyi dbang phyug sogs sgos brgyud kyi bla ma dam pa rnams dang / dkon cog gsum 'dus yi dam (160na ba sdebargyad kyi lha tsho zhe/ khyad par khro bo rdo rje gnod sbyin dang phyi nang gsang ba'i dam can rgya mtsho rnams la dam rdzas rgyan ldan g.yos su sbyar ba/ gser —316

dam can chos srung mngon rtogs 'phrin la rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)skyems sman gyis bran pa'i phud kyi mchod pa dam pa 'dis gsol zhing mchod do/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rgyud mnyes shing bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa dang / de tshul bzhin du 'dzin pa'i skyes bu mdo sngags kyi sde gnyis dang 'gro ba'i phan bde rgyas pa dang / rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub bde blag tu stsal du gsol/ phud gtor rol mo dkrol ba'i 'og mar 'gro/ sngo sman btsun mdzes ma'i tshul gyis zhi ba'i las/ gzi 'bar brjid ldan nyams kyis rgyasapa'i las/ rjes chags dbang gi mdangs kyis 'gugs pa'i las/ 'jigs rung bdud mo'i gzugasakyis drag po'i las/ thogs med du bsgrub pa dpal ldan bkra shis tshe ring / gsang mtshan gangs kyi yum chen rdo rje kun bzang mar dam rdzas rgyan ldan g.yos su sbyar ba/ gser skyems sman gyis bran pa'i phud kyi mchod pa 'dis gsol lo mchod do sku gsung thugs kyi rgyud mnyes pa dang bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde dar zhing khyad par bod kha ba can gyi rgyal khams 'dir mi phyugs kyi nad rims mu ge 'thab rtsod 'khrug long stod hor sogs mtha' dpung gi 'jigs pa mtha' dag zhi ba dang / lo phyugasalegs pa mtha' bzhi'i longs spyod 'du ba tshe ring nad med bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ba dang /yang sgos rgyu sbyor sbyin pa'i bdag po dang bcas pa rnams la 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub stsa la du gsol/phud gtor ba sogs 'gro/ bh+yoḥ gtso mo dpal ldan kun bzang ma'i mched 'khor mthing gi zhal bzang mar dam rdzas rgyan ldan/ zhes pa nas rgyu sbyor sbyin pa'i bdag po dang bcas pa (160bsgomasal snang srid gsal bar ston pa'i pra'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ mthing gi zhal bzang ma'i tshab tu mi g.yo blo bzang ma dang / mtha'i 'dod gsol lha dang mi'i ro brgya bda' ba'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ de bzhin du cod pan mgrin bzang mar lha klu gnod sbyin mi'i phun tshogs nor gyi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ gtad dkar 'gro bzang mar/ rta dang khyu mchog ma he sogs rkang bzhi srog chags kyi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ bh+yo: gangs kyi yum chen mched bran 'khor bcas rnams/ /phyi nang gsang bas mchod bstod gsol ba 'di/ /sngar bcol las rnams—317

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya 4'gasung 'bum/ lo4)'grub pa'i gtang rag dang / /slad nas sgrub pa'i rten du 'bul byed na/ /dkon cog rten gyi bzhugasaganas ga smyo la/ /bshad dang sgrub pa lhur len 'dus pa'i sde/ /rnam gsum 'khor lo'i bya ba ma lusapa/ /srid mtha'i bar du mi nyams 'phel ba dang / /sangs rgyas sras dang slob mar bcas pa yi /thugs rjes gdugs dkar grib bsil khor yug 'og /'jig rten gsum gyi sdug bsngal tsha gdung kun/ /rab zhi sim pa'i tshor ba rtag tu myong / khyad par dum bu bcu gnyis las kyi sa'i/ /'gro rnamasardzogs ldan skye bo ji bzhin du/ /mi dge de 'bras ming yang rab spangs shing / /dge legs gsar ba'i dpal gyis khyab par mdzod/ /la phyi gangs kyi ra bas yongs bskor 'di/ /gsang du nyer bskrun thub pa'i rjes 'jug ste/ /bslab gsum rnam dag gser gyi dra ba yis/ /legs brgyan thos bsam lusastobs nye bar rgyas/ /lung rtags snyi ka yi nags yangs por/ /bag yod khrims kyis lhod par rab rgyu zhing / /bu ram shing ba'i ring lugs mi stong can/ /'degs pa'i skal pa bzang bor 'jug par mdzod/ khres sogs 'dod don gyi 'phrin las(161na tsho yo le/ yi ge brgya bas lhag chad kha bskang /nongs pa bzod par gsol/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang med na gshegs gsol bya'o/ /mtsho skyes rdo rje gnubs chen dpal seng zhabs/ /nyi ma 'od zer chos kyi dbang phyug sogs/ /thugs rje chen pos byin gyis brlakhas mdzad pa'i/ /dngos brgyud bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /zhi dang khro bo'i bde bar gshegs pa kun/ /ma lus 'dus pa sgrub pa ldebargyad sogs/ /mchog mthun dngosagrub char ltar 'bebs mdzad pa/ /yi dam lha tsho gis rnams mo/ /gangs can ra ba dkar po'i khor yug gi /'gro rnams bde bar skyong ba'i mthu rtsal can/ /rdo rje kun bzang mched bran pho nyar bcas/ /bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho'i ྾/ /gzhan yang shis brjod ci rigs pa bya'o/ khungs med 'gal dum spel ba'i yig nag dang / /dam rdzas gnad gsang mi shes mchod bstod bskang / /bya bral zag zog blos byas rjes 'brangs nas/ /'ban btsun chang gral gyer ba des kyang nongs/ /rgyal kun 'dus pa rnga yab gling pa yi/ /zab gter bstan ma'i sgrub thabs mchode 'phrin nas/ khyung las a ma'i rmi lam a —318

dam mā chos srung ma' rtogs mun las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)ma'i nyams/ /bzang bzang rdzun gyi mchod 'phrin 'di na med/ /de phyir dpyad gsum dag pa'i zhing sal/ /ma tsho gos dga' ston rgyas pa myu gu'i bskyed/ /dam skong char gyis sbran pa'i gos bu'i tshogs/ /rab bsdus bde skyid longs spyod 'phel bar shog /ces rdo rje kun bzang ma'i gsol mchod dpyad gsum dag pa'i rgyud mang zhes pa 'di ni la phyi chu dbar du zhwa ser 'chang ba'i sde btsugs pa'i chosaskyong blo bzang sbyin pas rtsoms shig par brten za hor gyi brjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa (161bang ga dbang dge legs so/ /lhaḥ pad+ma thod phreng rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal/ /gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje'i spyan snga sa /zhalabazhes dam bcas sku yi rgyal po ni/ /tshur spyon bam chen brtsegs pa'i gdan la bzhugs/ /lha khyod dgyes pa bskyed pa'i dam tshig rdzas/ khrag gi a: dbang po'i me tog 'khrigs/ sha chen dud pa tshil r+sā mar me sbar/ /mkhris pa'i dri chab sha khrag rus pa'i bsgos/ /thod rnga rkang gling dung wo snyan pa'i sgra/ /bdud rtsi sman mchod dmar chen gtor ma spungs/ /rak+tas lang long khol ba'i btung ba rnams/ /dngos bshams yid sprul nam mkha' bkang ste 'bul/ /mon bu pu tra sku mdog mun ltar gtibs/ /mon ti'i gos dang dar nag thib zhu can/ /gser gyi rdo rje sher shing gseg shang bsnams/ /seng ge la zhen rol du dom nag khrid//stag gzig dom dred sna tshogs pho lhar gtong / /sprul pa dgra bcom gsang yum ro langs ma/ /blon po bya khrid mig gcig la sogs pa/ /'khor bcas gsol lo mchod do 'phrin las sgrubs/ /sku yi rgyal po 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis/ /bdag sogs rnams kyi nad gdon bar chad zhi/ /tshe dang bsod nams bshad sgrub legs tshogos kun/ /bsams pa bzhin du 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /ces pa 'di yang sngags ban blo bzang mthu stobs kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o/ /in+d+ra ni la'i ri bong rta ljang can/ /rab byugs gar dgu'i nyams kyis rnam rol ba/ /gnod sbyin yongs kyi sdod pon mthu bo che/ /rdo rje bdud 'dul khyod la bdag bstod do/ /ting 'dzin mi gsal 319

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)dam rdzas nyams dang chad/ /cho ga ma dag zhakhrul pa'i dbang gyur sogs/ /nyes par byas kun lha khyod spyan (162na snga sa /mthol zhing bshags nas tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sgom bzlas mchod dang thugs dam rgyud bskul nas/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las ma lus pa/ /ji ltar bsams pa bzhin du 'grub par mdzod/ zhes pa'ang rje bla ma'i bka' stsal ltar za hor gyi bzhes bkod/ /pad nyi tshogs kyi bdag po'i steng / /rang sems/ yig yongs gyur las/ /phyag drug mgon po srin po'i gzugs/ /gri gug thod phreng cang te'u g.yas/ /thod khrag rtse gsum zhags pa g.yon/ /skam rlon thod phreng glang lpags dang / /zhing chen stag sham rus rgyan sprul/ /sis ra yi thig les spras/ /me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus bzhugs pa'i/ /g.yon du lha mo re ma tī/ /lus dang grib ma'i tshul bzhin 'grogs/ /gnod sbyin bzhi sogs 'khor gyis bskor/ /thugs kar hūṃ las 'od 'phros pas/ /ye shes sems dpa' sa mā dzaḥ/ /dam tshig pa dang gnyis med gyur/ /mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog dang //bdug spos snang gsal dri chab tshogs//zhal zas rol mo ba lin+ta//bdud rtsir bcas pa legs 'bul gyi/ /bzhes nas dngos grub rnam gnyis stsole/ /thugs ka'i sngags phreng sa bon las/ /'od 'phros gdug can ma lus bsgral/ /sems can don byas sangs rgyas mchode/ /byin rlabs dngos grub bdag thim bsam/ /sngags rnams bzla/ dge 'dis myur mdzad mgon po yis/ /skye ba kun tu rjesabazung nas/ /bar chad ma lus zhi ba dang / /mchog thun dngos grub 'grub par shog zhes pa'ang 'phyong rgyas blo bzang dge 'dun gyi kha ton du 'di 'dra zhig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong (162ba'i jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /oṃ su sti/ 'dir gnam mtsho dang 'dam sogs kyi tsher mal rnams su nye bar mkho ba'i mchod pa mdor bsdus lag tu blang ba la/ ras dkar ram g.yang shun lta bu dri ma med pa'i steng du gser dngul zangs shing sogs las grub pa'i snod gtsang mar phye phyur bur spungs pa'i steng dang phyogs —320

dam can chos srung mngon rtogs 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ (gebazhir mar gyis sgron pa'i phye mar/ snod cig tu 'o ma la tsan+dan dkar dmar bzang drug dang / ka ra bu ram sbrang rtsi sogs btab pa'am/ ma 'byor na 'o ma tsam dang de min dar ba phyur khu gtsang mas kyang 'thus/ snod cig tu chang la gser sogs rin po che gtsang ma btab pa'am ma rnyed na chang gtsang masakyang go chod/ snod cig tu ja bkol zin pa'am yang na chu la ja'i phye ma btab/ mar me spar dkar mo'i lag g.yas/ mda' la dar tshon sna lnga btags pa rnams dang / 'byor zhing rgyas par byed na rta g.yag ra lug go mtshon spyan gzigs kyi rigs kyang bsham/ bsangs chas la/ spa ma/ ba lu/ su lu/ shug pa/ stag pa/ mkhan pa/ spos dkar/ a ka sa dri bzang ba'i rigs gang 'byor gsog /mchod rdzas rnams chu gtsang gis sbran/ sangs rgyas chos tshogos ma lta bus skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas rang nyid skad cig gis pad nyi'i gdan la dpal rta mgrin sku mdog dmar po gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin ba/ yum rdo rje phag mo dang snyoms par zhugs pa'i sku can du gyur/ mchod rdzas la dmigs( su bhā wa shurnya sarba dharmāḥsu bhā wa shurnyo3lha/ stong pa'i ngang las ma las rin po che'i snod yangasashing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod rdzas rnams gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya la sogs pa 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa dngas shing thogs pa med pa/ mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam gyis mi khyab pa yul (163na tshe lha gzhi bdag 'go ba'i lha tshogs thams cad kyi dbang po drug la med du byung ba'i bde ba khyad par can bskyed pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ āḥlha lan gsum/ oṃsarba yid pā ra pā ra su ra su ra ā brta ya ā brta ya ho badz+ra ྅ ra ṇa khaṃ swā hā/ zhes nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlab/ rang rta mgrin du gsal ba'i thugs ga'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas gnam mtsho dang 'dam shod snar mo sogs byang rgyud kyi ri brag mtsho rtsi shing nags tshal la gnas pa'i yul lha gzhi bdag lha klu thams cad skad cig gi mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par gyur/ kye/steng phyogs tshangs pa 'phrul gyi gzhal yas dang / /'dam shod snar mo la sogs gnas rnams nas/ /gnyan chen thang lha dri za'i rgyal po che/ /mched 'khor sum brgya drug cu gnas 'dir gshegs/ /gnam —321—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)mtsho'i rgyal mo rdo rje g.yu sgron sogs//bstan ma bcu gnyis skyong ma bcu gnyis dang //yang ma bcu gnyis to ṣi ṣi mo sman//mdor na byang rgyud stod smad la gnas pa'i//lha klu gnod sbyin bdud dang rgyal btsan sogs//so so'i yul grur dbang ba'i gzhi bdag kun//thogs pa med par gnasa'adir da tshur spyon//rang rang dgyes pa'i stan la brtan par bzhugs//dri zhim dud pa dbyar dusachar bzhin du//lang long g.yo ba'i phyogs bcur khyab pa yi//yul lha gzhi bdag rnams la mi gtsang ba'i//nyams grib 'phog thug nyes tshogos bsangs gyur cig/phye mar ro brgya ldan pa'i bsgos bu yis//ljags kyi dbang po kun nas tshim gyur cig/'o chol ja chang gas ba'i tsho gis rnams kyis// gzhi bdag ma lus ngoms shing tshim gyur cig/lug sha lag g.yas mda' dar sna lnga dang //rlung gi shugs ldan rta mchog sga mas spras//dbang sngon rwa gdengs 'brong g.yag zhol r+pā ngur//'o ma'i rgyun 'dzin mdzo mo 'dod 'jo ba//ra lug bya khyi gas gzan ri dwags stos//rang srung sra mkhregs rdo rje 'bar ba'i 163bgo/pha rol dpung 'joms sna lis ma sto 'a rigs//dar gyi tse ber thod dang rin po che//rus pa sbrul chun la sogs sna tsho gis rgyan//seng glang stag gzig mi lhags g.yang shun gos//'ja' wo ltar bkra za 'og ber po che//so sor mthun rdzas dngos bshams yid sprul 'bul//gzugs mdzes gar gyi mchod pa spyan la 'bul//rab snyan sgra yi mchod pa snyan la 'bul//dri zhim spos kyi dud pa shangs la 'bul//lha mi'i zas skom bdud rtsi ljags la 'bul//reg na bde ba'i na bza' sku la 'bul//'dod yon sna lngas thugs dam skong gyur cig/thugs dam skongs la 'gal rkyen bar chad sol//lus dang grib ma ltar 'grogs bsrung skyob mdzod//bdag sogs ma rig rmongs pa'i las dbang gis//gzha sar ltar bshas byas dang bshang ba dor//dkar dmar thab gzhed btang dang mtsho gnyan dkrugs/mang gnyan bcad sogs 'phog thug ma lus pa//nyesapa'i tshogs kun snying nas mthol zhing bshags//lha srung khros dang 'khu dang sdang ba sogs//rab zhi dgyes pa'i spyan gyis gzigs nas kyang //tshangaX 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol//bdag

dam yo chos srung mngon rtogs 'phrin la rnam bzhi lhun grub/ (dpesogs mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /yul lha gzhi bdag srung ma khyed rnams la/ /skyabs su gsol dang phyogs 'dir gnas byed na/ /'gal rkyen kun sol mthun rkyen ma lus sgrubs/ /mi phyugs nad rims god kha gdon bgegs sogs/ /bar chad ma lus zhi ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor mnga' thang sogs/ /yar ngo'i zla ltar rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//srid dang zhi ba'i yon tan ma lus pa/ /thogs med dbang du bsdu ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /pha rol dgra dpung thal bar rlog byed pa'i/ /mthu (164na lta bas nus pa drag po'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /yid bzhin nor dang dpag bsam yongs 'du ltar/ /chos dang srid kyi legs tshogs ma lus pa/ /bsams pa ji bzhin lhun gyis grub pa yi/ /bkra shis chen pos phyogs kun khyab par shog /ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang / /gang yang bdag rmonges blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal pa/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par gsol/ /oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sa rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /badz+ra mu chigarang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ /'bad dang rtsol ba ma dgos pa'i/ /yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam shing / /sems can re ba skong mdzad pa'i/ /bsam pa 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog zhes sogasashis brjod ci rigs pa bya'o/ /thang lha dang gnam mtsho gtso bor gyur pa'i byang rgyud kyi yul lha gzhi bdag rnams la gsol mchod bshags pa 'phrin bcol gyi rim pa tshig nyung don rgyas 'dod 'jo'i dpal ster ni dad stobs ldan pa dga' ldan tshe dbang dpal bzang gis bskul ba la brten nas sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rig byed pa bstan 'dzin dbang po'o/ /las kyi gshin rje dang dpal ldan 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug mar mchod gtor mdor bsdus par 'dod pas rang yi dam gyi lha gang yang rung ba'i ngang nas/ oṃ āḥlha ha ho ཿhrīḥs bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs/ /rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas lho phyogs rim pa bdun gyi sa 'og gshin rje'o grong khyer nas dam can gshin rje'i rgyal po/ /yum tsa murnyi/ las byed pho —323

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)brgyad mo brgyad sogs bka' nyan 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho'i (164bstan gas rnams oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ /dza lho phyoṭa rim pa bdun gyi sa 'og nas/ /las kyi gshin rje 'chi bdag ma he'i zhal/ /yab yum 'khor bcas gnas 'dir spyan 'dren na/ /thugs dam dbang gis thogs med da tshur spyon/ /oṃ kā la ྅ pa sa pa ri wā ra e gye hi dzaḥdzaḥ/ pad+ma ka ma la ye ri/ gshin rje'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas/ /dam tshig dbang gis 'dir stan bzhugs/ /mchod pa tshul bzhin bzhes nas kyang / /'phrin las sgrub phyir ji srid du/ /las sgrub bar du brtan par bzhugs/ /oṃ kā la ྅ pa ya ma rā dza sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya sto/ oṃ kā la ྅ pa sa pa ri wā ra a:/ puskro nas/ shabha'i bar brjod/ oṃ kā la rū pa sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥlha gis nang mchod phul/ las kyi gshin rje'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags hūṃ las skyes pa'i rdo rje rtse gcig pa dmar po 'od kyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud drangs te gsol bar gyur/ chakā la rū pa sa pa ri wā ra bi na sha rtsu mā ra ya i dam bha kla ta kha kha 'a hi khā hi/ tsa murnyi sarba bisna na sha / i rda bha sla ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ kā la ྅ pa sa pa ri wā ra ji nas rdi'i bar brjod/ nang mchod kyang 'bul/ khrag zhag mtshor 'khyil bam ro gcal du bkram/ /me rlung 'tshub ma drag po 'byug pa'i dbus/ /rno ngar rwa gdengs ma he'i gdan steng nas/ /g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gar gyis rol la bstod/ /sbom thung yan lag rags la gsus pa 'phyang / /mi'u thung srin po'i gzugs la ma he'i zhal/ /blta bar mi bzod gcer bu rus pas spras/ /'chi bdag gshin rje'i rgyal po khyod la bstod/ /phyag g.yas thod dbyug dgra bgegs thal bar rlog /g.yon pa bdud zhags yan lag rnam par 'ching / /lang long 'khol ba'i khrag dron hub kyi 'dren/ /sdebargyad kun gyi dmag (165na)dpon khyod la bstod/ /ma mo bye ba'i gtso mo tsa 3 / /phyag g.yas rtse gsum dgra bo'i gnas gsum bsnan/ /g.yon pa thod khrag gtso bo'i zhal du stob/ /yams rims nad kyis dgra bo 'phung la bstod/ /gnam sa bar snang khyab pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /thogs med myul nas mi srun sdebargyad 'joms/ /sangs rgyas bstan dang de 'dzin skyong byed pa'i/ /las rnams kun sgrub bka' sdod bcas la bstod/ /—324

dam can chos srung ma rtogs 'phrin la rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)dmag zor ma'i gtor ma gong ltar byin gyis brlabs/ /rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas byang shar mu le ding gi rgya mtsho chen po nas 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ bh+yoḥ gshin rje'i sbyor yum rdo rje dbyings phyug ma/ /gdul bya'i don du dbyangs can ngag gi lha/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir dpal ldan re ma tī/ /'khor dang bcas pa thogs med da tshur spyon/ /oṃ kā li de sa sa pa ri wā ra e khyu hi dza:dzaḥ pad+ma ka ma la ye ri/ oṃ kā li de ldi sa pa ri wā ra a lha nas/ sha rdi'i bar dang / oṃ kā li sogs rū pa nas/ spar+sha'i bar brjod/ gong gi sngags gsham du ma hā pañtsa a khra ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ dpal ldan lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags lha las skyes pa'i rdo rje rtse gcig pa dmar po 'od kyi sbu gus gtore ma'i bcud drangs te gsol bar gyur/ oṃ kā li de sa sa pa ri wā ra sarba bi na sha rtsu mā ra ya i rda bha le ta kha kha 'a hi khā hi/ shrī de sa sa pa ra ྾/ /badz+ra sa ma ya ḍā ka ni sa ྾/ /oṃ a kā ro sogs kyi mjug tu a nas shabha'i bar brjod/ kā li de lti'i zhal du oṃ āḥlha/shrī de lti'i zhal du oṃ āḥ// tshe ring mched lnga bod khams skyong ba'i bstan ma bcu gnyis yul lha gzhi bdag 'khor (165bdang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥlha/ bh+yoḥ stong zil brtsegs pa'i lhun po dus mtha'i mes/ /rab klubs srin mo'i gzugs can be con dang / /thod khrag 'dzin mdzad rkyang ser dre'u'i steng / /legs long 'dod pa khams kyi dbang mor bstod/ /snga phyir rgyu ba'i chu srin seng ge gdong / /dus bzhi'i las sgrub sprul pa'i lha mo bzhi/ /bod khams skyong ba bstan ma bcu gnyisasogs/ /'khor tsho gis dam can rgya mtshor bcas la bstod/ shākya seng ge'i bstan pa bsrung ba la/ /smon lam btab cing zhal 'tshes ji bzhin du/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyong zhing bdag sogs kyi/ /bsams pa'i don rnams lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /de nas yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bkang / /ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ sogs kyis ye shes pa rang gnas su gshegs/ smon lam dang bkra shis sogs ci rigs pa bya'o/ /las kyi —325

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)gshin rje ma he'i zhal can dang //dpal ldan 'dod khams dbang phyug gi gtor 'bul 'khyer bde 'di ni khams ri bo che nas dpal stag lung thang pa rin po che'i lugs gnyis bstan 'dzin gsi ngag gi dbang phyug gis rtsoms shig pa'i bkas bskul ba ltar za hor gyi ban+de 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen gyis sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so//rnam dag smon lam rnyog bral rdzing bu 'khyil//dal brgyad 'byor bcu'i chu skyes 'dab ma bzhad//bag yod khrims kyi dri bsung ngad pa 'thul//dbang rnon rig pa'i snang gsal kha dog bkra/mang thos dri chab rgyun gyis lang tsho dang //lhag bsam ze'u 'bru'i lha bsgos ro brgya bda'//rtsod ngag rkang drug rab snyan rol mo 'brol//las to sbrang rtsi dngar po'i mar rdzos kyis//17nabastan srung pe har rgyal po mnyes byed na//ba po shis sgo mang brgya phrag dus gcig tu//rab 'byed khrims ldan dge 'dun 'dus pa'i sde//srid mtha'i bar du dar rgyas 'phrin las mdzod//gzhan yang dngos bshams yid sprul ma rdzo rdzas kyis/chos skyong wo pho thugs dam legs skong na//bka' pod mang por klog pa thos bsam bstan//rnam dag ring lugs dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel mdzod//'jam dpal dbyangs dngos bkra shis dpal ldan gyi//dgongs ba ched rgyan drug mchog gnyis gzhud lugs la//'chad nyan lhur len blo gsal mkhas mang gis//yangs pa'i nor 'dzin kun khyab bkra shis shog/ces dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi bkra shis sgo mang par gnas chung nas sprul pa'i chosargyal chen pos mchode gtor 'bul ba'i tshigs bcad nyung ngu zhig gsar du bskul nas 'dzugs dgos tshul gsungs pa'i rgyu tsho mos byung bar brten za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so//lhaḥhe ru /dpal mi'u thung srin po'i gzugs//phyag bzhi mgon po rnam sprul bya rog gdong //'khor bcas bka' sdod rgya mtsho ma lus pa//'dir spyon pad nyi ro yi gdan la bzhugs//pad+ma thod 'phreng spyan sngar thub pa'i bstan//skyong bar zhal 'tshes dam can skyes bu che//rdo rje legs pa mched

dam mā chos srung mge rtogs tshon las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)bran sum brgya dang //drug cur bcas pa'i 'khor tsho gos gnas 'dir gshegs//a sgo'i klung sbreng me tog 'phreng ba dang //dri zhim bdug pa snang gsal mar me sbar//dri chab lha bsgos snyan brjid rol mo'i tshogs//dngos bshams yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa 'bul//rab yangs thod par sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga//sbyangs rtogs sbyar byas zag med ba lin+ta//lha 166bsgo gon lcam dral las mkhan bya rog gdong //rdo rje legs pa 'khor tsho gos rnams la 'bul//bzhes nas thub pa'i bstan dang khyad par du//dgon gnas 'di nyid rtag tu bsrung zhing skyob//bdag sogs dpon slob chos bzhin sgrub pa yi//'phrin la ri mtha' dag lhun gyis grub par mdzod//ces dpal ldan dmag zor ma'i gtor bsngosadang lhan du mgon po phyag bzhi pa dang rdo rje legs pa gnyis la gtor 'bul 'byer bde 'di ni zhogos gur smon gyi dge bskosang ga dbang rgya mtsho dang dbu mdzad dge legs kyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o//bh+yoḥ'ajam dpal gshin rje'i sbyor yum dbyings phyug ma//'dod khams dbang sgyur dung skyong lha mo dang //bka' brgyad sgo srung ser mo las mkhan ma//gnod sbyin rma ri rab stims 'khor bcas gshegs//tshur spyon tshur spyon dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs//phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin tshogs rnams dang /khyad par bdud rtsi rgya mtsho'i gtor ma 'bul//bzhes nas thugs dam gnyen po stong gyur cig/dpal chen khrag 'thung srong btsan sgam po'i zhabs//mtsho skyes rdo rje dngos brgyud bla ma yis//rdo rje gtsug bzhag bdud rtsi lce thog blug/dam tshig gnyen po bsgrags pa deng dgongs la//bstan dang bstan 'dzin dge 'dun sde rnams skyongs//bod skyong rgyal po'i sku tshe mnga' thang rgyas//nad rims dbul phongs dus kyi 'khrug pa zhi//'jig rten kun tu bde skyid dar bar mdzod//lha 'jig ༷rten mchod bstod dkyil 'khor gru 'dzin pa//dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu'i nang tshan nas//pe har rgyal po sku lnga gsang yum dang //blon po 'khor tsho gos rgya mtsho da tshur spyon/khyad par dgra lha skyes67na poXg gsung gi rgyal//blon po rdo rje gragaX ldan mthu rtsal can//sku lnga'i rnam rol gcig tu

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)ma nges par//ston mdzad sprul pa'i chos rgyal gnas 'dir gshegs//khrag gi sgo nga bdun las nyer brdol ba'i//bas rgod dmag dpon 'bar ba skrun bdun dang //khyad par tse'u dmar po yang le ber//pho nya mngag gzhug 'khor bcas gnas 'dir spyon//dmar chen gtor ma'i ri bo mkha' la bsnyeg/khrag chang btung ba rgya mtsho lta bur bskyil//phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul byed na//rol zhig kha khā nyis zhal du 'bul//pad+ma thod 'phreng so zur gnubs nyang sogs//sngags 'chang rnamasakyis khrag 'thung dkyil 'khor du//dbang bskur dam tshig gnyen po nyer phab nas//thub bstan skyong ba'i srung mar ma bskos sam//ma g.yel ma g.yel sngon gyi tha tshig dgongs//gsang ba sngagasakyi dam tshig rgya ma bral//rdo rje'i ri mo spyi bo'i gtsug ma yal//lce la bdud rtsi ro mchog ma nyamasapas//bshad sgrub bstan pa yar ngo'i zla ltar rgyas//bstan 'dzin skyes bu bla mchod sde gnyis spel//gangs ljongs yul 'dir 'thab rtsod mu ge nad//dus kyi 'khrug pa ma lus zhi bar mdzod//dga' ba'i dpal ldan sde bzhi'i pho brang che'i//chos srid zung du 'jug pa'i mnga' thang dar//byu srid brtan cing dbu glog btsan pa sogs//zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las ma lus sgrub//hūṃ/srin po'i rgyal po gza' bdud rā hu la//dus g.yi brgyad du rgyu ba'i sprul pa brgyad//gdong mo bzhi dang gza' brgyad rgyu skar sogs//mkha' la glog dmar 'khyug pa ji bzhin spyon/khru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus//pad nyi dgra bgegs bskyel ba'i gdan la bzhugs//dmar zlum spyan stong snang ba'i dgra la gzigs//mthong reg dug gi rlangs167ba ngos 'phung du chug/bsad khrag dron mo'i ji dri ngad ༅//rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar bdud rtsi'i skems/sha khrag rus pa'i bsgos bzang zhal du 'bul//dgyes par rol la drag po'i rkan sgra gtogs//pad+ma thod 'phreng sprul sku las 'brel rtsal//kumā rā dza klong chen rab 'byams sogs//rtsa brgyud bla ma'i dam tshig nyer dgongs la//zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las myur du sgrubs//〉skyes bu dam can chen po thig le rtsal//seng ge ra skyes ma nges bzhen pa can//suX8 brgya drug cu'i sprul pa grangs med pa//ma thogs

dam can chos srung mngon rtogs 'phrin la rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)rings pa'i tshul gyis da tshur spyon/ /dam nyams dgra bgegs bsgral ba las byung ba'i/ sha rus zasamachog dam rdzas rgyan ldan che/ /sman skyems rak+ta'i mchod pa 'bul byed na/ /dgye sa par rol la bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /ces pa 'di'ang sa lug hor zla drug pa'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin gnasachung nas sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen pos tshog nyung don tshang 'khyer bde zhig rtsoms zhes dbu mdzad blo bzang yon tan la gsung 'phrin byung ba ltar dung skyong ma dang drag rgyal ma gnyis sde tshan rgyal btsan gnyis sde tshan/ /khyab 'jug dang rdor legs so sor byas te gang 'dod lhu btan nas btang rag rtsisa'adi'ang za hor sngags spyon gyis bkod pa 'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /rigs kun khyab bdag rtsa brgyud bla ma dang / /he ru ka dpal 'khor lo sdom pa che/ /thub bstan skyong mdzad legs ldan a gha ra/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub char du phob/ /chos dbyingasabade chen klong du rtag zhi yang / /yid srubs gnyen por rab khros srin po'i gzugs/ /gtum chen khro bo'i gad brgyangs seng ge'i sgras/ /log 'dren ri dwags klad pa cig car 'gems/ /de phyir nag po chen pos ma' sum du/ /ka mā (168na sgor bstan dri med khros pa'i rgyud/ /dam pa sangs rgyas rang 'gyur dgongs don la/ /'khrul zhig nyi seng phyag bzhes ji bzhin 'god/ /de la 'dir sangs rgyasakyi bstan pa bsrung zhing skyong ba 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos srung mtha' klas pa'i nang nas ka liṅka'i dur khrod du dpal mgon po nyid kyis rang gi rgyud dang man ngag rnams paṇ+ḍi ta chen po pad+ma'i ngang tshul la dngos su gsungs shing / de nyid rnam par 'phrul po ches rgya gar gyi paṇa grub dam pa sangs rgyas kyis rgyud dang man ngag la brten 'khrugs bsdebs su mdzad nas thugs nyams su bstar bas chos skyong gi gtso bor gyur/ bod yul 'dir dam pa'i rjes 'brangs zhi byed snga phyi bar gsum gyi lugs 'dzin rnams la dar rgyas su gyur pa legs ldan nag po 'di la sto ra zhes pa rta 'am dri ma sngon du dgag pa'i a bzhag pa bod skad du rta med dam dri med mgon por grags pa 'di nyid la lhag pa'i lhar 'dzin pa rnams kyis nyams su blang bar bya ba ni/ dur khrod dang chu gling bas mtha' 'am —329—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)bla ma gong ma rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas sam yang na gnas khang yid du 'ong zhing bkra shis pa'i sar sa rgyan gnam rgyan sogs bkod pas mdzes par byas nas dkon cog spyi'i rten dang bye brag yi dam 'khor lo sdom pa dang chos skyong 'di nyid kyi bris 'bur sku rab gnas can bzhugs su gsol/ man ngag las byung ba'i phyi nang gsang ba'i rten rnams tsho gis pa'am/ de tsam ma 'byor kyang rtag gtor/ rgyun gtor/ bkang gtor sogs srol 'di ga'i sngon rabs kyi phyag bzhes ltar bshams pa'i mdun du phyi nang gi mchod pa spyan gzigs rnams bkod pas mdzes pa 'du byas/ de yang ma mgon lcam dral sogs srung ma'i rigs la so so'i sgos kyi gong gnon yi dam dang gtor chog dang bkang ba'i 'khrigs rim kyang / snga 'gyur sa (168ba bo ge dwags shangs zhi gnyos sogs grub mtha' rnams la lo paṇa dang rgyud 'dzin rnams kyi bzhed srol ma 'dra ba'i khrigs mang du snang ba so so'i luṭa bzhin bslad pa ma zhugs pa byung na legs par mngon na'ang 'dir dmag zor ma sogs chos skyong gzhan dang nyis bsres su gtang bar go rim mthun na 'jug pa bde zhing bskul ba po'i blo dang mthun par mngon bas dmigs bsal gyi khyad chos dgos nges rnams ma gtogs de don bzhin bkod pa la/bdag bskyed lhan cig par bsgom du mi btub pas bde mchog bshad pa btang sgoms su bzhag /'jigs byed lta bu rgyun gyi yi dam gang byed kyis go bcad/ mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ gyi nyisabasangs/ su bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūṃ hūṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me rtag /bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas rol mo la sogs pa rnams rang bzhin bde stong / rnam pa mchod rdzas byed las dbang po drug gi spyod yul du zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can skyed par gyur/ oṃ a: āḥlha/ de bzhin du pā hūm̐/ badz+ra pulge badz+ra/ pe/ badz+ra a lo ge /badz+ra garnye/ badz+ra ni li te/ badz+ra shabha āḥlha/ lta rā pa/ shabha/ 5 / rā sa/ spar+sha āḥlha/ zhes rol mo dang bcas pas byin gyis brlabs/nang mchod la bdud rtsi ril bu'am chos sman lta bu btab na byin gyis brlab mi dgos shing / med na/—330

dam can chos srung mngon rtogs 'phrin la rnam bzhi lhun grub/ (na)oṃ hrī ༷rdziḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ phaṭa/ su bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ya ཾ las rlud gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs lta bu ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa/ de'i steng du āḥlas mi mgo'i skyed bu gsum gyi steng du/ āḥlas byung (169na)ba'i thod pa dkar po/ de'i nang gi shar du zhu las byung ba'i ba lang gi sha gos mtshan pa/ lhor e lasabyung ba'i khyi'i sha kus mtshan pa/ nub tu dzi las byung ba'i glang po'i sha das mtshan pa/ byang du khaṃ lasabyung ba'i rta'i sha has mtshan ga dbus su hūṃ las byung ba'i mi'i sha nas mtshan pa/ shar lhor lī lasabyung ba'i dri chen bis mtshan pa/ lho nub tu māṃ las byung ba'i rak+ta ras mtshan pa/ nub byang du — lasabyung ba'i byang sems dkar po shus mtshan pa/ byang shar du / las byung ba'i rkang mar mas mtshan pa/dbus su baṃ las byung ba'i dri chu lhas mtshan pa/ de dag gi steng du oṃ dkar po/ āḥdamar po/ hūṃ sngon po gsum steng nas steng du brtsegs par gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros rlung la phog /rlung g.yos me sbar/ thod pa'i nang gi rdzas rnams zhu zhing khol bar gyur/ yi ge gsum pas 'od zer rim pa bzhin du 'phros pas/ sku rdo rje / gsung rdo rje/ thugs rdo rje rnams bkug nas yi ge gsum la rim gyis thim pa rnams thod par lhung nas zhu bas/ hūṃ gis kha dog dri nus kyi skyon sbyangs/ āḥsabadud rtsir rtogs par byas/ cha gyis mang por sbar zhing spel bar gyur/ oṃ āḥlha lan gsum brjod/de nas rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs shing bdun rnam dag bya ba ni/ yig rnying las/rang nyid yi dam lha ru gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa/ nyi zla rin chen dar zab dang bcas pa'i gdan la/ rang gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma bka' brgyud chos 'brel thob pa dang bcas pa mos gus kyi sa nas su gyur pa'i bla ma rnams gsal bar gyur/ de'i gtsug tu sprul sku dam pa sangs rgyas sku mdog smug nag rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ phyag gnyis(169brdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ gar nyams dang ldan pa/ de'i g.yas su grub thob pho mo lnga bcu rtsa bzhi/ g.yon du mkha' 'gro khyad par gyi brgyud pa/ rgyab tu dpal —331

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)ldan sum cu rtsa drug /mdun du dam can rgya mtsho/ gtsug na bde gshegs bcaganyis/ yi dam zhi khro/gsang sngags gsar rnying gi lha tsho gis rnams kyis nam mkha' gang ba/ pha rgyud g.yas la ma rgyud g.yon gyi tshul du bskor bar gyur/ na mo bla ma dkon cog yi dam la/ /dang ba'i sems kyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad la/ /yid kyis sprul nas mchod pa 'bul/ /bdag gis sdig pa ci bgyis pa/ /de dag thams cad so sor bshags/ /sems can don mdzad rgyal sras gang / /de dag kun la rjes yi rang / /ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs par/ /mya ga mi 'da' gsol ba 'debs/ /mgon po thugs rje che ldan la/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /'gro kun bsags pa'i dge ba gang / /byang chub tu ni bdag gis bsngo/ /rten bskyed yig rnying la zur cung zad bcos pa/ su bhā was sbyangs/mdun gyi rten mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun du ka liṅka yi dur khrod ོ bo 'jigs su rung ba/ dur bya sha za zhing ce spyang phem sgra sgrog pa/ ro langs gar byed cing 'byung posaki 'debs pa/ keng rus gad mo dgod pa la sogs dur khrod chen po 'jigs su rung ba'i dbus su/chos 'byung mthing nag gru gsum pa'i steng du/ gdug pa dgra bgegs kha sbub tu mnan pa'i gdan/de'i steng du paṃ las pad+ma/ a las zla ba raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du mi ro dang rta ro bsnol ba'i gdan/ de'i steng du bdag gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las hūṃ mthing nag cig chad/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ dgra (1 na tha ge ṭa gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad tshur 'dus/ hūṃ la thim/ hūṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i tsan+dan gyi beng hūṃ mthing nag gis mtshan pa zhig tu gyur/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ bstan pa la gnod pa'i dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus beng la thim ma a sto ra ma hā kā la du re swā hā hūṃ hūṃ zhes brjod pas/ sdo dan gyi beng hūṃ mthing nag dang bcas pa 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i dpal ye shes kyi mgon po a sto ra bshan pa lta bu/ 'jigs shing rngams pa/ za zhing 'cha' ba/ sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas tsan dan gyi beng chen —332

dam ༅ chos srung mngon rtogs 'phrin la rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)bsnams pa/ g.yon thod nang khrag dron lang long 'khol ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ /spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa/ shangs mtho ba/ zhal gdangs pa/ mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ khro gnyer smin ma 'byug cing sma ra ser ba/ dbu skra kham ser gyen du brdzes pa la dar nag gi thod bcings pa mi mgo skam po lnga yi phreng bas dbu la brgyan pa/ sbrul gdug dang rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ sku la dar nag gi 'jol ber gsol ba/ gser sked rin cen ska rags su bcings pa/zhabs la zangs kyi lham bu gsol ba/ mi ro'i steng na 'gying ba/ ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs pa'o/ /de'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 2bor gyi steng du hūṃ mthing nag gis mtshan pa de las hūṃ zhig g.yas dang g.yon du chad pa las/ oṃ ma hā kā la trag da ma ma ru ru tse zhes brjod pas/g.yas su raṃ yig dmar nag las bdud po legs ldan nag po rta nag po rting dkar la bcibs pa/phyag g.yas mdung dang ru mtshon 'phyar ba/ g.yon pa dgra snying dron mo zhal (170bcu gsol ba/stag ral gzig shubs g.yas dang g.yon du 'byug pa/ ral pa nag pos lus khebs pa/ 'khor du bdud pho'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i/ g.yon du bh+yo smug nag las dpal lda na lha mo re ma twe sku mdog sngo skya zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas bdud kyi khram shing bsnams pa/ g.yon na nad kyi rkyal pa bsnams pa/ ko rlon re lde gos su rgyan pa/ chibs su dre'u rta rkang gsum bcibs pa/ dra ba dgu yi te lan byas pa/ 'khor du ma mo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/rlung nag 'tshub ma 'khyil ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /mdun du trag nag po las las mkhan g.yag mgo can nag po kha dmar la mche ba dkar ba/ lag na srin po'i lcags sgrog bsnams pa/ lcags kyi sen mo rno bas dgra bo'i srog khung kha phye nas 'dag pa/ kha nas zhe sdang gi me 'bar ba/ 'og sgo nas phrag dog gi rlung 'tshub pa/ gsang sgo nas 'dod chags kyi chu khol ba/ bskal ba'i mun nag gtibasapa'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /g.yas su k+ṣiṃ yongs su gyur pa las/ phyag brnyan rgya gar nag po sku mdog smug nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas gri gug gshin rje'i lce 'dra ba nam mkha' la —333

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho gsung 'bum/ (4)'phyar ba/phyag g.yon thod pa khrag gis bkang ba zhal du gsol ba/chibs su dom nag spyon pa la bcibs shing /tsham tshom med par dgra la rgyug pa/kha gdangs 'o dod dgra la 'bod pa/dam tshig can la brtse zhing dungs pa/dam nyams dgra la khro zhing gtum pa/ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o//g.yon du hūṃ yongs su gyur pa las/srog gcod bshan pa dmar po/sku mdog khrag gi mdog can sku la sha lpaṭa mnyen po gsol ba/dbu la ba sermo go dmar po gsol ba/phyag gnyis171nalcags mda' lcags gzhu bsnams pa/klad la lcags kyi bya khra lding ba/phyi la sha khyi dri snom khrid pa/khrag gi rba klong 'khrug pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o//rgyab tu bh+yo yongs su gyur pa las/pho nya lcagasaspyang sngon po/mig ni nyi ma'i zer ltar rno wo dmar ba/skad ni nam mkha'i 'brug ltar ldir ba/bang ni rkyang ser rma ltar mgyogs pa/'bor du dur khrod ce spyang tsho gos kyis bskor ba/rma nag las ma 'khyil ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o//mtshams su ) las gnod sbyin rdo rje legs pa sku mdog smug nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/lcags kyi ral pas rked par slebs pa//spyan ldog pa/mche ba gtsigs pa/sku la ngur smig gi na bza' dang /dbu la dar gyi thang zhu gsol ba/phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa bsnams nas dgra bgegs kyi klad pa'i steng du brdeg pa/g.yon dgra snying bran mo srog rtsa dang bcas pa zhal du gsol ba/chibs su seng ge dkar mo la chabs shing /me rlung rab tu 'khrug pa'i klong na bzhugs pa'o//de'i phyi rol 'dab brgyad pad zla'i steng du mdun nas g.yasabaskor gyis/gtum chen sha la brngam pa'i srin po stong /khred gsum khrag mtsho 'thung ba'i ma mo stong //dus ba/ srangs la rgyu ba'i gza' bdud stong //las su rgyu zhags 'phen pa'i bas dmar stong //skye 'gro srog rtsa gcad pa'i ging po stong //snang srid g.yab mos 'debs pa'i bdud pho stong //bden brdzun shan thang tsod pa'i dmu rmod stong //mthun pa gnyis su khed pa'i gshin rje stong //gas yang 'khor du bdud pho 'bum/bdud mo 'bum/bshan pa 'bum/lings pa 'bum/srog bdud 'bum/ma mo bye ba'i tsho gos kyis bskor ba'o//gtso 3 3 4 de thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/mgrin

dam ༅ chos srung mngon rtogs 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ rtogepar (171— ཿdmar po/ thugs kar hūṃ sngon po/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer sa pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lha tsho gos ma dang mkha' 'gro/ dur khrod chen po ka liṅka/u tsa la/ me ri 'bar ba/ dpal gyi rgyu skar/ bsil ba tshal sogs dur khrod brgyad/ rdo rje gdan nā la spro'i gtsug lag khang la sogs pa nas legs ldan nag po a sto ra 'khor tshogs dam can rgya mtshor bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs par bsams la/ bzhengs bskul spyan 'dren gsar sgrigs ni/spos sbyor bsregs rol mo dbyangs dang bcas pas/ bde chen chos dbyings dag pa'i klong yangs nas/ /rgyal ba shāka thub phyag na rdo rje dang / /pad+ma'i ngang tshul dam pa sangs rgyas sogs/ /dngos brgyud bla ma ma lus dbyings nas bzhengs/ /zung 'jug bde stong rin cen gzhal yas khang / /sum cu rtsa gnyisanyer bzhi'i gnas yul nas/ /bde mchog 'khor lo la sogs yi dam lha/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma lus dbyings nas bas/ /ka liṅka sogs dur khrod wo po brgyad/ /rdo rje gdan dang rgyun gyi dbang bo yi/ /gtsug lag khang nas dri med legs ldan mgon/ /yab yum sprul pa pho nya dbyings nasabazhengs/ 'i kya thub pa dam pa sangs rgyas sogs/ /rgya bod brgyud pa'i bla ma byin rlabs can/ /bde mchog 'khor lo yi dam dkyil 'khor lha/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma lus gshegs su gsol/ /thub dbang lag na rdo rje la sogs pa'i/ /spyan sngar bstan pa skyong bar zhal bzhes pa/ /lha chen dpal ldan nag po a sto ra/ /dur khrod gaṅka liṅka nas za/ /gang gi las sgrub mas stobs nus pa'i bdag /rnal 'byor skyong ba'i dgra lha dam tshig can/ /legs ldan nag po bdud kyi dmag dpung bcas/ /rju'aphrul shuṭa kyis thogs med ྾/ /zag (172na thad bde ba bskyed pa gsang ba'i yum/ /ma mo bye ba'i tsho gis la dbang sgyur ma/ /ma gcig dpal ldan lha mo nam gru ma/ /rlung nag 'tshub ma'i dbusanas mo/ /las mkhan traka da nag po g.yag mgo can/ /phyag brnyan rgya gar nag po mthu bo che/ /dam nyams srog gcod bas rgod bshan pa dmar/ /rang rang 'khor tsho gis dang bcas mo/ /rlung ltar 'phyo ba'i pho nya lcags spyang sngon/ /dam can skyes bu chen po rdo rje legs/ /sna tsho gis 'phrin las sgrub —335

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)pa'i bka' sdod lnga//thogs pa med par gnas 'dir ྾//gtum chen srin po khrag 'thung ma mo'i tshogs//gza' bdud wo po bsdo rgod kiṅka ra//bdud nag dmu dang srog gcod gshin rje sogs//lha srin sdebargyad dmag tsho gos mo//mdor na sprul pa yang sprul gnam sa'i khyon//kun khyab lus kyi cho 'phrul glog bzhin 'khrug/nga ro 'brug ltar ldir zhing gtum rngams can//dngom pas dpa' ba'i nyams kyis za//yig rnying lag rkang ring thung byung ba zur sa da lo pa/dpal ldan mgon po'i thugs dam bskang ba dang //sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyen po'i bka' bsrung zhing //gzhan gyis gnod cing 'tshe ba bzlog pa dang //rnal 'byor bdag gi las bcol sgrub pa'i phyir//ye shes mgon po nag po spyan 'dren gyi//bde stong zung 'jug 'bral med klong dkyil nas//yang dag 'gyur med skug khyig gshegs su gsol//lha chen dpal 'bar mthu bo spyan 'dren gyi//nag po chen po gnas 'dir ྾//mthu wo dpa' bo chos skyong a sto ra//dad pa dang ni dam tshig gtsang ma yis//tshur gshegs tshur gshegasadapal ldan mgon po'i tshogs//thugs dam brtser dgongs gnas 'dir〉//ma hā kā la ye shesa'abar ba'i sku//lha chen dpal 'bar bdud 'dul mthu bo che//rnal 172ba po byor dgra lha rig 'dzin srung ma'i gtso//nag po stobs can dpal ldan lha mo dang //dpal gyi srung ma 'khor bcas mo/dri za me lha gshin rje bden bral dang //chu lha rlung lha gnod sbyin dbang ldan dang //lha dang tshangs pa ma mo srin po dang //ro langs gsod byed klu yi bu mor cas//gnod sbyin yang po dang ni sgyu rtsal ༅ //nyi zla sa bdag rgyu skar la sogs pa//sdebargyad phyogs skyong rgyal chen sdebazhin bcas//nag po stong gzugs sha za ma mo dang //bka' srung bstan skyong dam can pho nya'i tshogs//dur khrod 'bar ba'i gnas nas mo//ma hā kā la du beng dzaḥdzaḥlha baṃ sngo yig ṣi /lhaḥm bcos bde chen lhun grub chos kyi dbyings//rnam dag 'od lnga rin cen gzhal yas khang //bkod mdzes pad sdong nyi zla 'bar ba'i gdan//'dod yon zag med phun tshogs mchode gnas 'dir//bla ma bka' brgyud rgyal sras 'phagasatsho gos dang //sprul sku dam pa byin rlabs bka' baX'i brgyud//zhi khro gsang ba'i dam can srung ma'i

dam can chos srung mgo rtogs tshon las rnam rga lhun grub/ 9)tshogs//gnyis med thugs rjes brtan par bzhugs su gsol//gu ru de wa ḍā gi ni dharma pā la sam ya tiṣ+ṭha snu/mig kho las/lhaḥchos dbyings kun mkhyen ye shes phung po tso//sku lnga mchog gyur 'dod dgu'i rin wo ga kho//skyabs gsumango bo rnam khu rdo rje 'chang //gnyis med bla ma mchog la phyag 'tshal lo//rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob rgyud sde'i snying po can//stobs bstod pa ga yas mchogo gi nor bus gtams//'dod dga' dpal 'byor re ba bsam pa bskong //sprul sku dam pa'i zhabs la ྾//zag med mchog ston bde gshegs yi dam lha//ngo mtshang yon to dpal ldan sum sto drug khyud sde'i bcud ldan grub chen rnal 'byor tshogs//ḍā gi ye shes dngos grub khyad ra 173na khyud//'phrin las rtsa ba'i dam can srung ma'i tshogs//byin sa stobs mchogo rnams la ྾//a ti pu lho pra tisnro homig kho wo/〉ཿmchod yon me rta ge bdug spos snang gsal dang //dri chab zhal zas dbyangs snyan rol mo'i tshogs//sgeg mo 'phreng ba glu gar 'dod dgus mdzes//bkod mdzes rin cen sna tshogs gzhal yas khang //nyi zla snang gsal mchod sprin nam mkha'i rgyan//kun bzang rnam sprul dpag yas bde wo mchog/bla ma yi dam chos skyong srung mar 'bul//thugs rjes brtser dgongs bla med dngos grub stsol//oṃ gu ru de wa ḍā gi ni dha rma pā la sa pa ri wā ra a nas sha rdi pā dza me gha sa mu dra lpa ra ṇa sam ye hūṃ/gas sa/mgo do sku bzhi'i ye shes lnga'i bdag wo drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che'i zhal du oṃ āḥ//bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i zhal du ྾/gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje'i zhal du ྾/dpal ye shes kyi mgon po'i zhal du ྾/paṇ+ḍita kā ma la shī la'i ྾/dam pa rin po che mi pham mgon po'i ྾/byang chub sems dpa' kun dga' bzang po'i ྾/pa tshab tshul khrims 'bar gyi ྾/grub chen rgyal ba te ne'i ྾/zhig po nyi ma seng ge'i ྾/'byul zhig dar ma seng ge'i ྾/rog spyan snga dpal
