chen ྾/gtsug rgyan kun dga' lhun grub ྾/drin can chos kyi rgyal po'i ྾/rgyal srasashes rab bzang po'i ྾/rtogs ldan byang tso bzang po'i ྾/rgyal sgo dpal ldan dbang phyug gi ྾/chos rje dpal ldan byang tso kyi ྾/'gro mgon /ga dbang chos rgyal gyi ྾/sdum po ba rkarma chos

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)grags kyi ྾/ ri khrod pa nyi zla grags pa'i ྾/ grub dbang bsod nams rin cen gyi ྾/ sprul sku shākya rin cen gyi ྾/ chos rgyal gter bdag gling pa'i ྾/ drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma (173ba)rin po che ྾/ gzhan yang dbang bskur rgyud bshad man ngag gnang ba'i bla ma dam pa yab sras brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du ྾/ oṃ hrīḥha ha hūm̐ hūṃ phaṭa oṃ āḥlha/ oṃ ḍā ka ḍā ko ni ltar/ oṃ a sto ra ma hā ka la du beng dza hūṃ hūṃ oṃ ྾/ ma hā kā la tra r+sha ma ma ru tse sa pa ri wā ra ྾/ oṃ hūṃ shrī de li kā li ma hā kā li de li sa pa ri ྾/ las mkhan traka da nag po'i ྾/ phyag brnyan rgya gar nag po'i ྾/ srog gcod bshan pa dmar po'i ྾/ pho nya lcags spyang sngon po'i ྾/ dam can rdo rje legs pa'i zhal ྾/ srin po/ma mo/ gza' bdud/ btsan dmar/ ging po/ bdud pho/ dmu rgod/ gshin rje rnams kyi zhal྾/mdor na 'khor tshogs dam can rgya mtsho pho nya mngag gzhug dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥlha/bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung mar bcas pa'i ljags/ las skyes pa'i rdo rje rtse gcig pa dmar po 'od kyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud drangs te gsol bar bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra gu ru i dam ba lin+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gu ru ka mā la shī la sa pa ri wā ra i rda ba li ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ badz+ra gu ru shrī tsakra sam+bha ra sa za/ pañtsa ḍā gi ni sar/ oṃ a sto ra ma hā ka du re swā hā/ ma hā kā la dz+nyā na dharma pā la sa ྾/ma hā kā la traka da ma ma ru tse sa ྾/ oṃ hūṃ shrī de li kā la ma hā kā li de li a ྾/ oṃ a kā ro mu kho sogs kyis gtor ma phul/ oṃ badz+ra gu ru ka mā la shrī dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra a: sogs dang /gong gi sngags gsham du nang mchod phul/ yig ṣi / lhaḥ ston pa bla med chos rje'i bka' bzhin du/ /bde mchog 'bor lo'i rgyud rnams rgyas mdzad cing / /klu yi cod pan mi bzad bcings nas kyang / /bstan pa gnyen srung sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mgon po'i nang 'dab dur khrod chen po nas/ /rab 'jigs ma mo'i tsho gis kyis yongs (174na bskor nas/ /sgrub pa po la dngos grub ster ba'i lha / /srog skyob dngos grub ster la ྾/ /sangs rgyas bstan bsrung bka' yi bya ra ba/ /gtsug lag khang na chos skyong tsho gos pa'i dpon/ /dam nyams dgra 'dul bgegs dpung brlag par mdzad/ /mthu chen —338—

dam mā chos srung mngon rtogs phren la rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)drag rtsal can la ྾/ bshags pa gsar sgrigs ni/ /lhaḥ shākya'i rgyal po dam pa sangs rgyas sogs/ /dngos dang brgyud ldan bla ma'i tshogs rnams la/ /rmongs pa'i dbang gis sgrib pa cher bsags nas/ /dngos grub gegs gyur snying nas mthol lo bshags/ /dpal ldan he ru ka dpal yab yum gyi/ /smin byed dkyil 'khor chen por ma zhugs shing / /grol lam bskyed rdzogs nyams len dang bral te/ /bag med le lo'i dbang gyur ྾/ khyad par dpal ldan mgon po 'khor bcas kyi/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i dam rdzas gsog pa dang / /bsnyen sgrub lo zla dus kyi mchod pa rnams/ /g.yeng ba'i dbang gis ma bgyid ྾/ /thub bstan 'jig cing 'gro ba'i bde skyid tshogs/ /'phrog byed zhing bcu tshang ba'i log 'dren dgrar/ /ma' spyod las sbyor ma bgyis dbang bskur zhing / /brtse bas phan gdag byas pa ྾/ / rtsalhung bcu bzhi la sogs gsang sngags kyi/ /dam tshig nyams par bdag 'jug blang ba dang / /stobasabazhi'i sgo nas phyir bcos bshags sdom sogs/ /ma bgyis yal bar gyur pa ྾/ /mdor na thog med du nas rang rgyud la/ /nyer gos ma rig stug po'i bag chags kyis/ /bla ma yi dam chos srung thugs 'gal rnams/ /bshags pas nyes tshogs ma lus dag gyur cig /thugs dam skong ba ni gzhung nas byung ba'i bskang rdzas rnams tsho gos par byas/ bskang gtor byin rlabs gong ltar la bkang rdzas brlab pa ni/ gyi rdzi sa bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang rang gi ming yig (174ba)dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i mgon po a sto ra 'khor dang bcas pa mnyes par byed pa'i dam rdzas spyan gzigs mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig mgon po a sto ra 'khor dang bcas pa'i spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig /oṃ re bid pā ra pā ra/ su ra su ra/ ā wa rta ya/ ā warta ya ho/ badz+ra lpa ra ṇa kho/ zhes dpral bar nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya sngags dang bcas pa lan gsum dang / oṃ su bhā ba bi shu khye dharma te badz+ra sirnyi hūṃ/ na maḥs spru ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu kha saḥ sa khyu thā khi ud ga te slar ṇa i me ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ oṃ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sa spru ra 'o/ ā du nud pan tā ta/ na maḥs spru ta thā ga ta a wa lo gi te oṃ sam+bha ra saṃ bha ra hūṃ/ oṃ ru ru sbu ru —339

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)lhun chags brjid//'bru gos sbrang bur sa las byung ba'i chang //sna tsho gos khrag gi btung ba mtsho ltar skyil ྾//la phug sgog btsong nya sha la du'i rdzas//'bru yi tsha ba rgyan 'brum gyis mtsho ni pa'i//shing tog ris dang sman sna'i bye brag tshone/sha sna spu kur sna bza' dang bca' ba yis za//gnas kyi khyad par rin cen pho brang che//pre skam rlon brtsegs pa'i khang bzang dang //zhwa gos nag po g.yab dar pha wang rdo//lhang 'tsher srog sngags mi 'bral 'chang ba'i rten ྾//lhun po gling bzhi gling phran lcagasaris bskor//ri bo sa brtol ma rmos lo tog pa//rgyal srid sna bdun bum bzang nyi zla zung //mdor na mtho ris dpal 'byor longs spyod kyis ྾/sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga las grub pa'i rdzas//ma dag skyon sbyangs a khra ta'i ngo bor//rab rtogs rgya cher spel bas zag med kyi//ngo bo nang gi mchod pa bla med kyis za/zhu 'bur bha ga mngon rgyas rked skabs phra//lang tsho bcu drug dar bab mdzes sdug can//gsang ba'i phyag gyo ma dang lhams zhugs bas//dga' bzhi'i 'gros kyis gsang ba'i mchod pa yis ra//sna tsho gos sprul kun mtshan ma ma lus pa//gzhi med rtsa bral stong chen dag pa'i dbyings//gang shar chos skur 'char ba phyag rgya che//gnyug ma don gyi de nyid mar pa yis za//log 'dren gshed du sha khrag srog dbugs la//rab rngams srin po khros pa'i gzugs nga yang //don gyi snying por khyab bdag he ru rkar//yid ches nges pa rnyed pa'i rten mchog gis mo//bzlog pa ni/lha dpal ldan mgon po nag po ni//ri rab rtse la gshegs pa'i tshe//tshangs pa brgya byin dbang du sdud//nye dbang 'bum ga klad la 'gyed//dang po sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung //bar du rnal 'byor 'khor bcasaskyong //tha mar gnod pa'i dgra bgegs bzlog/steng gi dgra bgegs steng du bzlog/dpal ldan mgon po nag po ni//ri rab shar la gsheṭa pa'i tshe//yul 7ba phra khor bsrung ni dbang du sdud//dri za 'bum sde klad la lo//dang po rnas rgyas//bar du skar wor ྾//tha mar gnod pa'i ྾//shar gyi dgra bgegs shar du bzlog/dpal ldan mgon po ྾//ri rab lho la gshegs pa'i tshe//'phags skyes po ni dbang du sdud//gshin rje 0 3 4 4 sdo klad la tshwad//dang po ྾//bar du ྾//tha

dam can chos srung mngon rtogs 'phrin la rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)mar ྾/ /lho yi dgra bgegs lho ru bzlog /dpal ldan mgon ྾/ /ri rab nub la gshegs pa'i tshe/ /spyan mi bzang ni dbang du sdud/ /klu dbang 'bum sde las la 'gyed/ /dang po ྾/ /bar ྾/ /tha mar ྾ /nub kyi dgra bgeṭa nub tu bzlog /dpal ldan mgon po ྾/ /ri rab byang la gsheṭa pa'i tshe/ /rnam thos sras po dbang du sdud/ /gnod sbyin 'bus sde klad la tshwad/ /dang po ྾/ /bar du ྾/ /tha mar ྾//byang gi dgra bgegs byang du bzlog /dpal ldan mgon po ྾/ /ri rab 'bar la gshegs pa'i tshe/ /lha srin sdebargyad dbang du sdud/ /lha phran 'bum sde klad la 'gyed/ /dang po ྾/ /bar ྾/ /tha mar ྾/ /bar gyi dgra bgegs bar du bzlog /dpal ldan mgon po ྾/ /rgya mtsho'i gling la byon pa'i tshe/ /klu chen brgyad bo dbang du sdud/ /sa bdag 'bus sde las la da/ /dang po ྾/ /bar ྾/ /tha mar ྾/ /'og gi dgra bgeṭa 'og tu bzlog /bh+yo bh+yo sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo/ /bh+yo bh+yo gnod ba'i bgegs la bh+yo/ /bh+yo bh+yo za ba'i sri la bh+yo/ /bh+yo bh+yo phung po'i 'dre la bh+yo/ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa la sdang bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs kyi steng du bzlog tu gsol/ bsnyen pa bya ba ni/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas mdun bskyed kyi mgon po'i thugs dar nyi gdan la sa bon gyi mthar sngags 'phreng gis bskor (177na tha la 'phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis 'khor rnams las la bkol te sprul pa yang sprul bsam gyis mi khyab pa spros pas dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad pa sogs 'phrin las rnam bzhi thogs pa med par bsgrub par bsams la/ mgon po'i snying po ni/ oṃ a sto ra ma hā kā la du re swā hā hūṃ hūṃ/ bdud mgon gyi snying po ni/ oṃ ma hā kā la traka da ma ma ru ru tse hūṃ/ lha mo'i snying po ni/ oṃ hūṃ shrī de li kā li ma hā kā li de li hūṃ/ las sngags ni/ oṃ ma hā kā la ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ gha ta gha ta/ dgra bgegs mā ra ya phaṭa/ dzhai paṃ rta ha ra ha ra hūṃ phaṭa/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ma hā rak+ṣa/ /la rak+ṣa/ tsit+ta rak+ṣa/ le le/ dha ra dha ra/ /ghi la ghi dgra bgegs mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces dmigs pa dang bcas bzlas pa'i mthar yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang gtor ma byin gyis brlabs nas 'bul ba gong bzhin bya/ga kho rdzongs gtso sgrigs—343—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)ni/ho/mchod sbyin gyi gtore ma 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di nyid 'bul zhing bsngo ba'i gnasasu gyur pa ni/dpal ma hā kā la a sto ra/bdud mgon nag po chen po//dpal ldan lha mo nam gru ma//las mkhan tā 'dan ga po//phyag ba ho rgya gar nag po/khro gagacod bshan pa dmar po//pho nya lcagasaspyang sngon bo//dam can rdo rje legs pa/gtum chen srin po//khrag 'thung ma mo//gza' bdud rā hu la/gzer stong bas dam gag gcod ging po//'jigs rung bdud dmag/gshan 'byed dmu'i rigs/'chi bdag gshin rje/mdor na snang srid las byed dreṭa pa'i dmag tsho gis rnams la 'bul lo dgyesapar bzhes la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa skyongs/dkon cog gi dbu 'phang bstod//dge 177ba'adun gyi bshad sgrub spel//'gro rnams bde skyid la 'khod/khyad par rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor bcas la bsam ga sbyor rtsub 'chang ba'i gnod dgra bgegs thams cad thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du rlog/bdag sogs rnams kyi tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor mnga' thang lung dang mngon par rtogs pa'i yon to gong nas gong du 'phel ho rgyas pa dang /ring por mi thogs par myur du rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig zhes wen las bcol/gzhi bdag gtor ma gtong /bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni zhes sogs brjod/stod pa ga4bskyo'/rol mo dbyangasadang 4sa pas/gzod ma wo nas nges pa lnga ldan skur//bgos kyang zhing 'dir 'dren pa nyi ma'i gnyen//gsang ba'i bdag po dam pa sangs rgyas sogs//rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tsho gos la gus pasabastod//bye ba phrag brgya'i dkyil 'khor 'khor lo yi//khyab bdag wa yig dpal ldan he ru ka/e dbyings rdo rje phag mor mnya sbyor ba//grangs med pad stong zung 'jug ngo bor bstod/shes rab mkha' spyod rdo rje btsun mo'i gar//zhing skyes lhan cig skyes dang sngags skyes kyi//mtha' yas pho ba'i bgrod pas tshe gcig tu//zung 'jug sku gsum go 'phang stsol la bstod//yig kho/lhaḥdur khrod wo po ka liṅka yi dbus//'od phung bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong //nyi zla pad+ma mi ro'i gdan steng nas//hūṃ las skyes pa'i dpal ldan mgon po ni/slo tu mi bzad ma hā kā la'i sku//zhal gcig

dam can chos srung ma' rtogs wen las rnam pha lhun grub/ (dpephyag gnyis mdog nag 'jigs pa'i tshul//dar nag ber gsol gser sked rin cen bcings//dbu skra kham nag srid gsum rgyan la brdzes//zhal gyi khro gnyer spyan gsum glog ltar sig shangasanas hūṃ 'byin zhal nas phags sgrog cing //78na tsho lta gdangs ljags 'dril rno dkar mche ba gtsigs//g.yas g.yon phyag na beng dang par bu bsnams//sprul dang thod rlon phreng ba'i rgyan gyisabargyan//dpal ldan mgon po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod//lhaḥston pa bla med chos rje'i bka' bzhin du//bde mchog 'khor lo'i rgyud rnams rgyas mdzad cing //klu yi cod pan mi bzad changs nasakyang //bstan pa gnyen bsrung sku la phyag 'tshal bstod//mgon po'i nags 'dab dur khrod chen po ni//rab 'jigs ma mo'i tsho gis kyi yongs bskor nas//sgrub pa po la dngos grub ster ba'i lha/khrog skyob dngos grub ster la phyag 'tshal bstod//sangs rgyas bstan bsrung bka' yi bya ra ba//gtsug lag khang na chos skyong tsho gis pa'i dpon//dam nyams dgra thabagegs dpung brlag par mdzad//mthuchen drag rtsal can la phyag 'tshal bstod//lhaḥbaskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na//thugasarje'i sprul pa nag po chen po ni/man tu mi bzad sku mdog mthing nag la//brjid pa'i na bza' ber chen sku la gsol//thugs rje'i rtags kyi thod pas dbu la brgyan//g.yas kyi phyag na tsan+dan beng chen bsnams//g.yon gyi phyag na thod khrag sku la brten//dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshun gcig tu bcings//sku mdog mthing nag 'jigs par bstan pa ni//chos rnams thams cad mnyam nyid yin pa'i rtaṭa//sku la dar nag 'jol ber gsol ba ni//thugs rje'i sprul pas 'gro don mdzad pa'i rtags//dbu skra kham nag gyen du brjes pa ni//thams cad chos kyi dbyings su gcig pa'i rtags//thod pa'i phreng bas dbu la brgyan pa ni//thugs las sprul pa sna tshogs 'byung ba'i rtags//gdug pa sprul gyi chun pos brgyan pa ni//nyon 74tshesangs du ga gsum ma lus spangs pa'i rtags//phyag g.yas tsan+dan beng chen bsnams pa ni//lha dmag 'bum gyis lha min 'dul ba'i rtags//g.yon na bas khrag bkang bsnams pa ni//nyon mongs rnam rtog zhaX du gsol ba'i rtags//spyan gsum sdang mig

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)phyogs bcur gzigs pa ni/ khams gsum sems can gyen la 'dren pa'i rtags/ /me stag tsha tsha skar ltar 'phro ba ni/ /chos 'od chen pos khams gsum 'gengs pa'i rtags/ /me lces stong gsum khyab par 'bar ba ni/ khams gsum sems can mun pa sel ba'i rtags/ khro rgyal stong phrag tsho gos kyisabaskor ba ni/ /bdud rnams kun la zhum pa med pa'i rtags/ /bgegs rigs stong phrag gdan du bting ba ni/ /log 'dren tsho gos rnams ma lus 'dul ba'i rtags/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tsho gos kyisabaskor ba ni/ /btsun mo'i bde ba sku la brten pa'i rtags/ /bstan pa gnyen bsrung bka' yi bya ra mdzod/ /thugs rjes bstan pa gnyen po bsrung du gsol/ /nag po chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod//lasang na sdig can thal ba'i rdul du rlog /bdag gis bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod//mgon po'i mkhar bstod ni/ /lhaḥ phyogs phyogs de ni pha gi na/ /nyi ma lho nub pha gi na/ khran bo rgyu ba'i mtshams shed na/ /srin yul laṅka pu ra na/ /thang rnams thams cad pags pa'i thang ri bo thams cad rus pa'i ri/ /rtsi shing thams cad mda' dang mdung / /chu 'bab thams cad khrag dang rnag /gzugs rnams thams cad he ru ka /sgra skad thams cad mkha' 'gro'i skad/ /mtsho rnams thams cad dug gi mtsho/ /dug mtsho khol ma'i nang shed na/ /rje yi sku mkhar lam sel ma/ /sku mkhar de yi rgyu bzhi ni/ shar phyogs mi yi thod pas brtsigs/ /mi thod gad mo yal la la/ /lho phyogs(179na) rta yi thod pas brtsigs/ /gyi ling rta skad rtser re re/ /nub phyogs spre'u'i thod pas brtsigs/ /'dur mo nyal skad lhangs rtse lhang / /byang phyogs lug gi thod pas brtsigs/ /g.yang mo 'ba' sgra dir ri ri/ /lha chen brgyad kyis ka ba byas/ /klu chen brgyad kyis gdung ma byas/ /gza' chen brgyad kyis dral phyam byas/ /srin po'i pags pa'i thog phug cing / /tshangs pa'i mgo bo'i rtag gis brgyan/ /sgo bzhi chu srin rta babs byas/ /sku mkhar de yi rtse mo na/ /nad kyi na bun thul lu lu/ /mi ro'i rgyal mtshan rong rtserong / /mi lpags g.yab mo lings se ling / /bya nag khyung chen ldings rtse lding / /sku mkhar de yi zur bzhi la/ /mi mgo rta mgo hril le le/ /sku mkhar de yi logs bzhi la/ /khyi khrag rta khrag shamasase 346

dam can chos srung ma' rtog lon las rnam pha lhun grub/ 9)sham//sku mkhar de yi shar phyogs na//sprul nag chun po nyil li li//sku mkhar de yi lho phyogs na//dur bya rkang stabs lings se ling //sku mkhar de yi nub phyogs na//srin bya khus 'debs lhangs se lhang //sku mkhar de yi byang phyogs na/ṇi spyang ngu zug di ri ri//sku mkhar de yi 'gram gzhi la//keng rus gar byed khrol lo lo//sku mkhar de yi phyogs mtshams na//'ug ba rkan sgra chems se chems//bya rog sha skad tongs se lha me //sku mkhar de yi mong gzhi la//rlung lha lcags skad rtser re re//sku mkhar de yi mtha' skor la//sdebargyad gad mo yal la la//ro langs mcho me rgyug lings se nga //rta nag rting dkar rtser re re//g.yag rog zhol bo dar ra ra//lug nag spyi dkar 'bab se 'bas//khyi nag dom bu khangs se khang //bya nag pho rog lings se ling //mon nag gyon po shar ra ra//dam can las byed khyugs rtse khyug/sku mkhar de yi nang shed na//mi 179bajo 'bum ni khri ru brtsigs//rta ro 'bum ni bcal du bkram//mi khrag rta khrag mtsho ru skyil//zhing chen bsnol ba'i gdan steng na//dpal ldan mgon po bzhugs pa ni//sku mdog mthing nag 'jigs pa la//sku la dar nag 'jol ber gsol//gser sked rin cen sked la bcings//sag chen yu ring zhabs la gsol//dbu skra kham ser gyen du brdzes//spyan gsum sdang mig phyogs bcur gzigs//mche ba rtsang phur bsnol ba 'dra//phyag g.yas tsan+dan beng chen bsnams//tsan+dan beng gi beng stod nas//lha dmag nyi khri tshig stong 'gyed//tsan+dan beng gi beng smad nas//bdud dmag nyi khri tshig stong 'phro//g.yon pa lcags par sku la brten//zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum tshul du bzhugs//dgra bgegs 'chor med btson du bzung //'khor du srog bdud 'bum gyis bskor/khyed la mchod pa 'bul ba ni//bsad pa'i sha dang myos pa'i chang //bsregs pa'i gsur dang btsos pa'i zhag/khu ba khrag dang lha ba rkang //nang khrol glo snying mkhal mar bcas//gsol zhig rol zhig dgyes par mdzod//de nas legs ldan la bstod pa ni//lhaḥrlung nag 'tshub ma 'khol ba'i dbus//thod mkhar 'bar ba'i gzhal yas nas//las kyi bshan pa gshegasasu gsol//bshan pa nag po rol sa ni//ral ༷ /ga po gos su gyon//bdud kyi g.yang gzhi phrag

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)la bkal//zhags pa nag po mchan na bcug/phyag na srog gi ne le bsnams//bra nag rting dkar chibs su bcibs//stag ral gzig shubs g.yas g.yon 'byug/gzhu mo mchog dkar ru mtshon 'phyar//mda' mo stong dmar dgra la 'phen//bsgrub pa'i dam rdzas 'di gsol la//dmigs pa'i dgra la rtags thon cig/bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub 80na sgor mdzod//gas gas ni/lhaḥhe ru kod pa la bde stong zung 'jug gi/ye shes rnam par rol ba'i 'phrul po che//lha chen dpal 'bar legs ldan mthu rtsal can//rdo rje 'chang gi bka' stod khyod la bstod//dus mtha'i me ltar rab 'bar klong dkyil dbus//pad+ma nyi zla log 'dren bsnol ba'i khrir//mig sman lhun po za byed srin po'i gdong //srid gsum ma lus skrag par mdzad la bstod//dmar zlum spyan gsum nyi zla lta bur 'khyil//sma ra smin ma glog stong rjes 'gror 'khyug/zhal gdangs mche gtsigs kha nas khrag rgyu'i 'dzag/gtum rngams khro gnyer smin mtshams bsdus la bstod//phyag g.yas tsan+dan beng chen sgo gsum nas//lha bdud btsan dmag 'bum ther phyogs bcur 'gyed//g.yon pa snying khrag dron mo lang long du//khol ba'i thod pa baṃ hril 'dzin la bstod//sku la dar nag tse ber lhab lhub tu//mnabs pa gser gyi phra tshom ska rags bcings//rin cen rtse phran thod skam dbu brgyan pa//dar gyi cod pan 'phur lding mdzes la bstod//khrag 'dzag lnga bcu'i mgo rlon rgyu ma yi//srad bur nyer brgyus do shal ring du 'phyang //rus pa'i rgyan gyis sku dang lhu tshigs brgyan//sag lham sngon pos zhabs zung mdzesal bstod//pad nyi mi ro gsar rnying khri brtsigs pa'i//steng na zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ste//sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug rnam rol gyis//ye shes me dpung 'bar dbus bzhugs la bstod//ljags ril ha ha'i gad brgyangs bsgrags pa'i mod//'jig rten khams rnams ma lus g.yo ba yi/khu'i sgras bstan dgra 'gugs shing rgod pa dang //drag shul 'jigs su rung ba'i gsung la bstod//ris med kun la snying rje chen po'i gdangs//ma 'gags khro gtum 80ba jam pas log 'dren rnams//'gum yang zhi ba'i dbyings nas/8 kun//mya ga 'das la yongs sbyor thugs

dam mā chos srung ma' rtog mun las rnam sto lhun grub/ (gel bstod//bdud mgon ru mar 'phyar zhing dgra snying za//stag ral gzig shubs sked changs rta nag bcibs//ral pas lus khebs stong gsum phyogs bcur myul//dmag dpon legs ldan chen po khyod la bstod//ma mo'i gtso mo khram shing nad rkyal thogs//ko rlon re lde'i gos rgya ne dre'u rta bcibs//rlung dga' 'tshub ma'i dbus bzhugs dam nyams kyi//bla tshe srog sdud re ma ti la bstod//traka da g.yag mgo zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs//lcags sder brang gi kha phye sha khrag rngubs//bu ga gsum nas me rlung chu bo zhabrug/dgra bgegs sdom phyir lcags srog 'dzin la bstod//phyag brnyan dom nag spyon pa la zhen nas//tsham tshom med par dgra bo'i steng du mchong //gri gug thod khrag 'dzin zhing 'o dod 'bod//las byed rgya gar nag po khyod la bstod/khrog gcod bshan dmar sha ba'i pags pa dang //bse glog gsol nyid lcags kyi mda' gzhu 'gengs/khra lding khyi khrid khrag gi rba klong nas//rta dmar zhen nas las kun bsgrub la bstod//rlung nag 'tshub dbus nyi ma ltar 'khyil mig/dbyar rnga lta bur drag po'i skad gsang ldir//bang rtsal rjes su dri bzhen ngal byed pa//pho nya lcagasaspyang sngon po khyod la bstod//gser gyi rdo rje don snying rtsa lag 'dzin//ngur smig gos yo dar theb 'phrog byed bcibs//dmar zlum spyan ldog mche gtsigs mas stobs can//dam can skyes bu chen po khyed la bstod//'bod grogs tshogos rnams dgra sha sbar gyi 'debs//rak+ta'i mtsho la hub skor ma dang srin//dus brgyad phyogs mtshams rgyu ba'i sgra gcan che/khyu ma'i zhags 'phen (181na btsan dmar tshogs la bstod//kiṅka ra rnams srog rtsa 'bral la rngams//g.yab mos bla tshe 'gugs pa'i nag po bdud//dmu rnams dkar nag shan 'byed drang thig 'debs//dbye dkrugs las byed gshin rje'i tsho gos la bstod//bdud dang bdud mo sprin nag lta bur gtibs//bshan pa gsod byed gri la rno ngar 'dogs//log 'dren rjes bsnyeg ling pa mda' gzhu 'dzin//srog bdud ma mo 'bum sde'i tsho gos la bstod//bka' sdod pho nya sprul pa yang sprul sogs//sa gzhi bar snang khyon gang steng 'og dang //phyogs mtshams gas shing rnal 'byor // 9myul ba//dam ho rgya mtsho'i tsho gos dang yosal

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)bstod/ /ga tshos gas/ /lhaḥ ka pā la brtsegs rngam brjid dgu thog mkhar/ kha bad mgo rlon lcang lo'i dra phyed 'phyang / /ga bur ngad ldan khrag gi zham chu 'bab/ /nga ro'i sgra sgrog gnas kyi gtso bor bstod/ /ca re rnal 'byor srung la 'bral med kyang / /cha lugs ma nges bzung nas stong gsum myul/ /ja kha la sogs kha dog sna tshogs can/ /nya bzhin 'byug pa'i sprul pa 'gyed la bstod/ /ta la'i lo mar brisapa'i liṅga la/ /tha chad btsan po'i las mkhan nyer spros nas/ /da lta nyid du dbang med rab bkug ste/ /na tsha drag pos srog rtsa gcod la bstod/ /pa sangs ltar dkar dgyes pa'i zhal dngom nas/ /pha rol dgra bo'i g.yul las rgyal lo zhes/ /ba dan srid rtser bsgreng ba'i mas rtsal can/ /ma lusabastan pa'i srog shing khyod la bstod/ /tsa ri'i snying sogs dam rdzas mchode gtor bshams/ /tsha grang khyad bsad bsnyen sgrub las sbyor ched/ /dza po sa dus drug bos na 'thor rlung bzhin/ /wa ler thogasamed 'khyug bzhin 'byon la bstod/ /zhwa ltar gtsug bzhugs rtsa brgyud bla ma dang / /za byed zhal gdangs yi dam khrag 'thung lhas/ /'a 'ur (181brdza yis dam bzhag ma g.yel bar/ /ya mtshan 'phrin las rnam bzhi bsgrub la bstod/ /rwa gdengs rdo rje la sogs mtshon cha 'dzin/ /la klungs mang po bgrod nas dgra bgegs kyi/ sha khrag dron mo'i zas kyis ma tshim par/ /sa 'og sa steng sa blar myul la bstod/ /ha la'i dug gis yid brnag dgra bgegs kun/ /a don skye med dbyings su rab bsgral nas/ /ha ha'i gad brgyangs dang bcas thub pa'i bstan/ /a la la zhes skyong bar mdzad la bstod/ /tshon la la po gsar gas ni/ /dpal ldan dri med mgon po 'khor bcas kyis/ shākya seng ge'i lung dang rtogs pa'i bstan/ /khyad par dam pa rgya gar shing rta'i srol/ /rab phye ring lugs dar zhing rgyas par mdzod/ /gangs can nor 'dzin dpal mo'i sto ba mā /gser mdog cod pan 'dzin pa dga' ldan bstan/ /rgya hor bod 'bangs skye rgu'i skyabs mgon du/ /srid mtha'i bar du dar zhing rgyasapar mdzod/ /'jig rten spyi dang khyad par gangs can 'dir/ /nad rims mu ge dus kyi zhabrug pa sogs/ /rab zhi tshe dpal longs spyod bde skyid kyis/ /dga' ston mchog la yun du sbyor bar mdzod//—350

dmog chos srung ma' rtog phren las rnam sto lhun grub/ rtogedus kyi bdag por btsan po'i las shugs can//chos ldan rgyal po'i sku tshe mnga' thang rgyas//lugasazung khrims kyis 'bangs rnams ma lus pa//rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i dga' ston dar bar mdzod//khyad par g.yu ru las sa pa brtson seng ge/brgyud 'dzin chang khyim gzhis ka 'di nyid du//g.yo med rtag bzhugs mi nor 'khor yos rnams//wo mas dus drug srung skyob sba bar mdzod//rigasabargyud gaṅgā'i rgyun ltar chad med cing //tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor snyan grags sogs//chosadang srid kyi yon to ma lus pa//yar ngo'i zla ba lta bur rgyas par mdzod//mdor na mgon khyod lhag pa'i 182na por 'dzin pa//rnal 'byor spyod pa yon gyi bdag por cas//zung 'jug rdo rje lang dbang ma thob par//'bral med rjes su skyong ba'i srung ma mdzod/khyud las/lhaḥm hā kā lam cu bo che//yab ni tshogs bdag dbang phyug la//yum ni lha mo dam tshig can//bu ni rigs 'dzin mas bo che//sku ni mthing nag 'bar ba la//sku la mthing nag ber chen gsol//dbu skra ral pa gyen du brdzes//mthing nag dar gyi cod pan 'phyar//ral ba gsig cing srid gsum 'dul//spyan gsum skar chen me dpung 'khrug/log lta 'dul phyir sdang mig ldog shangs nas rlung nag 'tshub ma gtor//bstan pa 'jig pa'i srog rtsa gcod//za 'ug phyags lham sngon po gsol//stong gsum bdud 'dul rta nag bcibs//g.yas na tsas beng chen bsnams//lha dmag nyi khri tshig stong 'gyed//g.yon na mdung thung ru mtshon 'phyar//bdud dang mu stegs log 'dren 'dul//sngon yang lha dmag dgra 'dul zhes//da lta dgra bgegs gnyen por gshegs//bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/zhesadrag tu bskul lo//lhaḥdur khrod r+ṣa po rab 'jigs pa//me dang rma nag las ma'i klong //thod pa skam rlon brtsigs pa'i nang //u tsa la yi gzhal yas na//'jigs byed chen po bzhugs pa ni//ma rungs 'byung po skrag mdzad cing //sngo nag rngams pa'i cha lugs can//gdug pa'i gad brgyangasa'abrug stong sgrog/spyan dmar shin tu 'byug pa yis//bstan pa'i dgra bo zil gyis gnon//mche ba zangs yag gtsigs pa yis//log par lta la brngam zhing 'khrug/g.yas kyi dar nag ru mtshon gyis//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)bdud dmag thams cad g.yab mos g.yob//g.yon gyi dgra snying dron mo ni//rtag par za zhing longs spyod che//182ba༄dud rnams kun kyis mnga' gsol ba//brjid pa'i sku la ber nag gsol//kha rlangs me yi 'phro 'du yis//stong gsum gdug pa nad kyis 'geng //bra nag rting dkar bskyod pa'i tshe//myur ba'i rdzu 'phrul stong gsum 'khor//srog bdud wo po las kyi lha//zhal nas gdug pa'i yob zlos shing //gling bzhi srid pa 'dar ṣ+ka brngam//sngon tshe dpal r+pā he ru gas//dge bsnyen chen bo legs ldan zhes//mtshan btags khyod kyi srog snying phul//bstan pa bsrung bar zhal gyisabazhes//de yang rig 'dzin bdag la sogs//chos mdzad yongs la gnod pa dang //bstan pa bzhig pa'i dgra bo rnams//dpa' bo khyod kyi zhal du bzhes//bla ma mgon dang chos kyi spun//phyogs bas bzhugs pa'i sgrub pa po//zhi ba chen po'i 'phrin las kyi//yengs pa med par khyod kyis skyong //bdag cag rig 'dzin sgrub pa pos/sgyu chom nus mad pas khyode mchod kyis//sngon gyi khas blangs dran gyis la//da lta wo du 'phrin las mdzod//bh+yoḥsmon lam stobs kyis sangs rgyas bstan bsrung dang //las kyi 'brel bas ming po'i las mdzad ma/shan+ti ro zan bdud kyi lcam gcig ma/khams gsum dbang sdud mgon po'i sring gcig ma//sku mdog mthing nag gcer bu rab 'jigs ma//dbu la khrag gi ral pa sprin ltar gtibs//ral pa sprugs pa'i skra gseb nas/khrag gi bu mo stong gsum shar ra ra/khros pa'i kha rlangs ser pos stong gsum gang //srung ma ma mo'i tsho gis kyis stong gsum gang //g.yas kyi phyag na bdud kyi khram shing bsnams//g.yon gyi phyag na nad kyi rkyal pa bsnams//korlone re lde gos su rgyan//chibs su drel rta rkang gsum bcibs//dra ba dgu yis te len byas//'khor du ma tsho gis 'bum gyis bskor//ma tshogs183na〉bum dang yos la//dam rdzas bas pa'i gtor ma 'di 'bulagyi//'khor dang bcas pas dgyes par bzhes nas kyang //rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod//(ཿbrag nag brtsegs pa'i gzhal yas nas//legs ldan nag po gshegs su gsol/khros pa'i rgyal po ྾//bdud kyi rgyal po ྾//g.yag mgo bdun pa ྾//bshan pa khyod kyi mtshan

dam ga chogazung ma' rtogs mun las rnam tso lhun grub/ 9)nyid ni/ khyod kyi rwa rtsegayas pa la/ /srid pa'i me 'bar lhabs rtse lha ba/ /ya rabs rnams kyi bdud yin bas/ /bdud kyi rgyal po khyod kyis ni/ /sdang ba dgra yi bla tshe la/ /ma thogs myur du las 'di mdzod/ /yal bar ma gtong g.yag mgo can/ khyod kyi rwa rtse g.yon pa la/ /srid pa'i chu 'bab sil li li/ /bud med rnams kyi bdud yin pas/ /bdud kyi rgyal po khyod ྾/ /sdang ba dgra bo'i bla tshel/ /ma thogs myur du ྾/ /yal bar ma gtong ྾/ khyod kyi spyan mig g.yas pa la/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor skyil li li/ /sngaṭa pa rnams kyi bdud yin pas/ /bdud kyi rgyal po ྾/ /snang ba'i dgra bo'i ྾/ /ma thogs myur du ྾/ /yal bar ma gtor ྾/ khyod kyi spyan mig g.yon pa la/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor tal la la/ /bon po rnams kyi bdud yin pas/ /bdud kyi rgyal po ྾/ /sdang ba dgra bo'i ྾/ /ma thogs myur ྾/ /yal bar ma ྾//khyod kyi shangs sbug g.yas g.yon nas/ /me tshub nang tshub bun nu nu/ /sems can kun gyi bdud yin pas/ /bdud kyi rgyal po ྾/ /sdang ba'i dgra ྾/ /ma thogs mo//yal bar ma ྾/ khyod kyi zhal kha chen po nas/ /zhe sdang me 'bar 'ur ru sa /sdang ba dgra bo'i bla tshe la/ /tsha ba'i nad rnams da thong zhig /khyod kyi gsang ba'i gsang sgo nas/ /'dod chags rgya mtsho khol lo lo/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i bla tshe la/ /grang (183ba tha'i nad rnams da thong zhig khyod kyi gsang ba'i 'og sgo nas/ /phrag dog rlung 'tshub bun nu nu//dam nyams dgra bo'i bla tshe la/ /yams dang rims nad da thong zhig /khyed kyi lag pa g.yas g.yon na/ /srin po'i lcags sgrog sil li li/ /srog chagasakun gyi bdud yin bas/ /bdud kyi rgyal po khyod kyis ni/ /sdang ba dgra bo'i bla tshe la/ /ma thogs myur du las 'di mdzod/ /yal bar ma gtong g.yag mgo can/ /de nas rgya gar nag po bstod cing bskul ba ni/ /lhaḥ phyag bas rgya gar nag po ni/ /nag po gcer bu ral pa can/ /dbu la bha ti thod nag bcings/ /phyag g.yas mtsho ni cha 'bar ba bsnams/ /mtshon cha dgra bo'i snying la rgyob/ /phyag g.yon brnya khrag bkang bsnams/ /dgra bo'i snying khrag dron mo 'thung / /kha gdangs 'o dod dgra la bod/ /dam tshig can la brtse zhing dungs/ /dam nyams dgra la khro zhing gtum/ /chibs su dom nag smyon pa bcibs/ /—353

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)tsham tshom med par dgra la rgyug /dgra bo glang thabs gri ru sad/ sha khrag sogs la brngams par rol/ /ma thogs myur du las 'di mdzod/ /de nas bshan pa dmar po'i bstod bskul ni/ lhaḥ srog gcod bshan pa dmar po ni/ /srin po'i shugs can glog las 'byug /dbu la bse rmog dmar po gsol//sku la sha lpags mnyan po gsol//phyag na lcags mda' lcags gzhu bsnams//klad la lcagasakyi bya khra lding / /phyi la sha khyi dri snom khrid/ /srog la mda' rgyab dbugs rngubs shig ga la brkos kyis klad la khyer/ /dgra bo mda' gri mdung grir sod/ sha khrag srog la brngams par rol bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /de nas lcags spyang sngon po bskul ba ni/ /lhaḥ pho nya lcags sbyang sngon po ni/ /sdang ba dgra la 'dur tsa na/ /bang ni skyi ser rlung las mgyogs/ /skad ni nam (184na7kha'i 'brug las che/ /mig ni nyi ma'i zer las rno/ /dur khrod ce spyang tsho gis kyis bskor/ /gcan gzan tsho gos kyis ngu 'bod byed/ /ltasang na 'bebs shing cho 'phrul bdag /dgra bo smyo 'bog gri ru sod/ /sha khrag srog la brngams par rol/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /de nas dam can rdor legs la bstod pa ni/ /kye/ sum cu rtsa gsum dga' ldan lha yi yul/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang dam pa na//gdod nas ma skyes rang bzhin dag pa'i lha//mnyam nyid rig pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ston pa shākya thub pa'i bstan pa la/ /bstan pa bsrung zhing legs nyes stangs 'dzin pa/ /dge bsnyen chen po rdo rje legs pa khyod/ /'jig rten skyong ba'i lha la phyag ྾/ /gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje'i bka' nyan pa'i/ /smon lam dbang gi 'jig rten phud la rol/ /mthu rtsal rab ldan bdud kyi ser chen 'bebs/ /dge bsnyen ser skya khyod la phyag ྾/ khyod kyang bdag gi bga' las ma 'da' zhig /bdag kyang khyod kyi dam las mi 'da' 'o/ /dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /ces dang / dpal ldan mgon po nag po ni/ /ri rab rtse lagashegs pa'i tshe/ /zhes sogs kyi bzlog pa'ang bya'o/ /gtor ma skyong ba ni/ mtshan mo yin na dpal 'bar btsugs bdud rtsi sbran la/ lhaḥ dpal ldan mgon po ma hā kā wā ya/ /lha chen dpal —354

dam ༅ chos srung ma' rtogs tshon las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)'bar nag po mthu bo che/ /ma hā de wa'i sras po drag shul can/ /tshogs bdag chen po ma hā kā la ya/ /dpal ldan lha mo mi pham srid gsum bdag /lcam dral khyed kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba'i/ /dur khrod bdag po zhing skyong 'khor dang bcas/ /snang srid lha srin sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas/ /dregs pa pho brgyud mo rgyud 'khor dang bcas/ /'dir (184ba(zhags brgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig ga khrag dmar gyi ྾/ /'dzam bu ti ba'i zhal zas ra/ /dza gad sman phud mchod pa ྾/ /sngar bcol legs pa'i gtang rag gnyen por gtong / /da bcol legs pa'i gsal 'debs gnyen por bzhes/ /'khor rnams skyong zhing rkyen rnams bzlog pa dang / /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs la sogs/ /bdud dang bar du gcod pa rnam mang po/ /thams cad rdul phran bzhin du brlag pa dang / /bstan pa rgyas pa'i las 'di khyed sa sgrubs/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /ces thog tu 'bul/ srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ma lus khrung ba'i gzhi/ /thub pa'i bstan pa yun ring gnasapa dang / /de 'dzin byed pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams/ /dpal 'byor gyis brgyan yun ring zhabs brtan shog /bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas rnams/ /tshe ring nad med bde skyid phun sum tshogs/ /bsams pa'i don rnams yid bzhin 'grub pa dang / /'gro ba'i don la mthu dang ldan par shog /gtang rag mchod pa ni/ gong ltar brlabs la/ gu ru de ba sogs a nas shabha'i bar gyisamachod/ gas rtsom ni/ byin rlakhas gter mdzod rtsa brgyud bla ma dang / /dngos grub 'byung gnas yi dam dkyil 'khor lha/ /'phrin las lhun grub legs ldan dri med mgon/ /'khor tshogs dam can rgya mtshor bcas la stod/ /yi ge brgya pas chad lhag kha bkang / /ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang / /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyid pa dang ni bgyid stsal yang / /de yang bzod par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes nongs pa bzod par gsol/ /rten yod na 'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhugs nas kyang / /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol/ /zhes brtan bzhugs dang /(185na thad na oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes —355

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes gshegs gsol bya/ mang 'gasol gsar sgrigs ni/ lhaḥ lha rnams kun gyi dmag dpon legs ldan che/ /rnal 'byor rgyud la byin rlabs gzi 'bar bas/ /dngos brgyud bla ma tsho gis rnamasagacig pu nyid/ /sgyu ma'i gar gyis rol par mnga' gsol lo/ /cho medabyings mkha' la sna tshogasagazugs sku'i zla/ /gdul bya dad pa'i rdzing bur yongs shar ba/ /bgrang yas dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i bdag nyid kyis/ /rnam par 'phrul po che ru mnga' ྾/ /'gog lam mngon gyur sangs rgyas zhal sgo nas/ /legs gsungs bden gnyis dam chos de don bzhin/ /bsgrub mdzad dge 'dun srid zhi'i gling dang mgon/ /bslu med 'dus pa'i skyabs su mnga' ྾/ /rab stims rgyal ba'i thugs rje bzhu blugs pa/ /dpal ldan nag po chen po'i snang brnyan du/ /yongs shar gtum drag khro bo yongs kyi rje/ /thub bstan kun gyi srung mar mnga' ྾//ka liṅka sogs dur khrod chen po brgyad/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas yul ma lus pa'i/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma sring blos byan dang / /lha srin sdebargyad dpon du mnga' ྾//rdo rje gdan dang nā la spro la sogs/ /rgya gar bod kyi gas lamang po/ /paṇa grub du masaganyer du legs gtad pa/ /bsrung skyob spel phyir byed por mnga' ྾/ /pad+ma'i ngang tshul dam pa sangasargyas sogs/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i mnga' bdag ches mang pos/ /sdug bsngal de rgyu ma lus zhi byed bstan/ /srid mtha' rab rgyas srung mar mnga' ྾/ /phyi nang gsang gsum dam rdzas mchode gtor dang / /spyan gzigs dngos/ bshams yid sprul mang spel nas/ /rtag tu mchod rten rnal 'byor rgyu sbyor la/ /'go ba'i dgra lha chen (185ba khor mnga' ྾//deng nas bla med byang chub ma thob bar/ /bdag cag dgon gnas mi nor ldebacas dang / /'bral med nyin mtshan dus drug mel tshe gyis/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /shi brjod gas sgrigs ni/ /skyabs gnas 'dus pa'i ngo bo rdo rje 'dzin/ /rin cen phreng ltar chad med spyi bo'i gtsug /bsgoms pas byin rlabs snying dbus 'jug mdzad pa/ /dpal ldan bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /skye shi bar do sku gsum lam du khyer/ /dpyid —356

dam ༅ chos srung ma' rtogs skrun las rnam sto lhun grub/ 9)thig rim bzhi rim lnga'i grol lam gyis/ kha sbyor bdun ldan tshe 'dir mngon 'gyur ba/ /bde chen rgyal ba yab yum ྾/ /mkha' dang sa 'og sa blar nyer spyod pas/ /sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lo'i dpa' bo dang / /dpa' mo rnal 'byor ma tshogs sgrub pa bor/ /rtag tu brtse ba'i rjes 'dzin ྾//gnam sa ltar bkra srin po rab khros khas/ /yid srubs sde bcas snying rtsa 'dar byed kyang / /dam tshig can la dgyes zhal ston mdzad pa/ /legs ldan dri med mgon po'i ྾//pha ltar legs skyong ma bzhin brtse ba can/ /bdud mgon re ma ti dang bka' sdod lnga/ /las mkhan dam can rgya mtsho'i tsho gos rnamasakyis/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub pa'i ྾/ /gzhan yang shis brjod ci rigs pa bya'o/ /e ma rgyalaba'i spyan sngar bstan pa dang / /bstan 'dzin skyes bu 'dus sde lus can gyi/ /bde skyid spel bar g.yar dam nyer stsal ba/ /a lto ra zhes snyan pa'i grags pa 'bar/ /gang 'di'i bskang bstod gtor chog zung 'brel ba/ khyud dang gong ma'i dgongs don la brten nas/ /yongs 'du'i 'khri shing kho bo'i blo gros kyis/ /sa bon smin pa'i cho ga rdzogs las bskrun/ /legs byas rnga yab dkar pos drangasapa'i rlung / /'khor ba'i tsha gdung ma lus yongs bcil te/ /phan bde bsil ba'i reg bya byang chub bar/ /'gro kun (186na cung ba'i skal bzang thob gyur cig /dpal ye shes kyi mgon po a sto ra gtso 'khor rnams kyi gtor chog bkang bstod zung du 'brel ba yongs 'du'i 'khri shing zhes pa 'di ni yar klungs 'phyos nas 'a cas pa dar brtson dang brtson 'grus seng ge'i rigs brgyud 'dzin pa chang khyim pa'i pha mes kyi lha chos skyong 'di nyid yin 'dug pa li gtor khungs bar skabs su stongs pa slar gsos na legs tshul brtag par shar ba dang mthun par sger gzhis su gtor gzhi sogs mgon khang btsugs pa'i skabs/ rgyun 'don gyi bkang gso dmag zor ma sogs dang phyogs mthun du snga rabasakyi yig rnying rnams las bde ba zhig dgos zhes brtson pa chen po bskul ma byung ba'i tshe gsang sngagasakyi chos la rang nyid kyis thob thos gang yang med par tshig sbyor shes pa rgyu mtshan du byas nas bla ma las brtsoms pa tshad ldan du ma mthong zhing rang nyid zhi byed pa'i phyogs la 'dris pa chung bas rgyal khang —357

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)pad+ma'i gdung 'tshob chos rgyal gter bdag gling par rjes gnang glo bur du zhus te gnang ba nos nas rgyud dang gong ma'i yi ge la gzhi byas sgos chos rnams sbyar/ de phyin 'byugs sdebs 'byer bde bar za hor gyi ban rgan 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen du 'bod pas sa lugs smal po zla ba'i dkar cha'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i yar tshes brgyad la pho brang chen po po ta lar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs kyis bgyis pa shrī dza / / /gtor ma chang phud/ gsur dud sogs bshams la/ oṃ su bhā wa shu snyi sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shurnyo3nya/ mchod gtor rnamasami dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du mchod gtor rnams kha dog dri ro reg bya phun sum tshogs pa'i steng du oṃ āḥlha gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ (186ba༄khor 'das kyi bcud thams cad bsdus nas mchode gtor la thim pas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ o.āḥlha/ chas bo bid pā ra pā ra su ra su ra/ ā a rta ya ā warta ya ho badz+ra lpa ra ṇa — lan gsum/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang bcas pas byin gyisabarlabs/ kye/ phag rgod chen po'i mag pa sogs/ /sprul pa sna tsho gos ston mdzad pa/ /nor rgyal chen po mthu rtsal can/ /tshur spyon tshur spyon gdan la bzhugs/ khyod la dgyes mchode 'bul ba ni/ /dam rdzas gtore ma ri ltar spungs/ /myos byed gas ba mtsho ltar bskyil/ /gsur chen dud pa sprin ltar gtibs//nyi zla mar me 'od mdangs gsal//sna tshogs me tog kha dog bkra//snyan brjid rdza rnga 'brug ltar sgrog 91ga chags sna tsho gos go mtshon sogs/ /dngos bshams yid kyis rab sprul nas/ /sadang bar snang bkang ste 'bul/ /bdag sogs rnams kyis ma rig pa'i/ /nyes pa thams cad bzod par mdzod/ /mi phyugs rnams kyi tshe srog la/ /nye bar 'tshe ba'i bar gcod dang / /nor rdzas lor par god kha sogs/ /mi mthun phyogs rnams zhi bar mdzod/ /dngos po phyi 'gro'i rjesangs nas/ /gnod pa'i dgab 'dre mi mdzad cing / /gzhis 'dir brtan par bzhugs nas kyang / /mi nor mgon skyabs dpung gnyen mdzod/ /mdor na srung ma 'khor bcas rnams/ /mchod pas thugs dam rab —358

dam can chos srung mngon rtogs 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)bskongs nas/ /bdag sogs 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /bkra shis bde legs phun tsho gos mdzod/ /shel grong gnas bdag gi gsol mchod 'di yang drung 'tsho dar mo ba blo bzang chos grags kyi ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni mthar rgyas pa blo bzang dbang po'o/ /na ma shrī mahā kya ka mu 'a ya/ 'khor lo'i dra ba sdom pa khrag 'thung gi /ma mgon gtso 'khor phyi nang gsang (186na tha yi/ /bya rog mtshan can legs ldan phyag bzhi pa'i/ /gtor bkang rgyun khyer nyung ngu cung zad spel/ /de yang dpal mgon lcam dral mchod cing bskang bar 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas mgon po'i bris sku sogs rten byin rlabs can gyi mdun du stegs kyi khar/ gtor ma sum cha zlum po/ sum gnyis gru gsum gyis rno ba be ta'i rnam pa lta bu/ de las sum gcig gis chung ba yum dang gtso bo'i phyed char slebs pa'i gdong can gsum/ de las cung zad chung ba'i mkha' 'gro brgyad/bya gdong gsum legs ldan/ dpal mgon bdun cu sogs la mtheb skyus bskor ba mar rgyan ci mdzes dang / chu gnyis nyer spyod nang mchod rdor dril sogs mkho ba'i yo byad rnams tshogos par byasal/ rab bde mchog gam/ yang na rang gang byed kyi yi dam gyi bdag bskyed song nas/ mdun bskyed kyi mchod gtor rnams byin gyis brlabs/ rten bskyed pa ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar pad nyi'i steng du hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa las rdo rje'i gur khang me rab tu 'bar ba/ dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i nang du/ lha snam sngon po'i dbus su chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag /de'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad ba'i lte bar/ nyi ma mi ro'i steng du hūṃ las ral gri sngo sangs yu ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros/ dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs thamasacad tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa/ mche ba gcigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ sma ra dang smin ma/ dbu skra kham ser gyen du brdzes pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis be ta'i gos bu dang thod khrag thugs dar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis ral gri dang rtse gsum 'phyar ba/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i —359

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)dbu rgyan (187bdang /rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rgyan drug dang sbrul gyis spras pa/ dar nag po'i stod g.yogs dang stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs gsol ba/ skyil krung phyed pa'i tshul gyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i steng gi cha la g.yas su gnod sbyin gang po dang / g.yon du mdzes ldan gnyis sku mdog ser po phyag gnyis kyis bum pa lha'i bdud rtsis gang zhing yid bzhin gyi nor bus kha brgyan pa/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs gnyis skyil spung phyed pas bzhugasapa'o/ /g.yin yang mkha' lding bya nag /mi nag ce spyang la sogs pas bskor ba/ de'i g.yon zur du pad+ma nyi ma mi ro'i steng du bh+yoḥlas tsaṇ+ḍi ka sku mdog dmar nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ spyan gsum dmar la bgrad cing / ljags 'dril ba/ phyag gnyis na ral gri dang rtse gsum/ g.yon gnyis na mda' gzhu dang dgra mgo 'dzin pa/ rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa/ g.yang gzhi'i stod g.yogs dang /gzig lpagasang kyi sham thabasang can/ zhababang g.yas bskum zhid g.yon brkyang ba'i rol bas bzhugs pa/chos khrung gi nang gi zur gsum du/ pad+ma nyi ma mi ro'i steng du g.yas zur du/ hūṃ dang ral gri las/sku'i sprul pa seng ge'i gdong pa can rab tu 'jigs shing g.yas ral gri dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ g.yon zur du dzam dang gri gug las gsung gi sprul pa ce spyang gi gdong pa can mche ba gtsigs pa/g.yas gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ gdong zur du rka dang gri gug las thugs kyi sprul pa bya rog gi gdong pa can kha gdangs pa g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ gsum ga'ang thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ stag pags kyi sham thabs can/ drag cing rngams pa/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis me dpung gi dbus na bzhugs pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la nyi ma dang mi ro'i (18shasting du hūṃ brgyad las shar du bya rgod kyi gdong pa can/ byang du bya khyung gi ྾/ nub tu khā ta'i ྾/ lhor lug pa'i ྾/ /mer phag gi ྾/ /bden bral du khyi'i ྾/ rlung du ce spyang gi ྾/dbang ldan du stag gi gdong pa can thams cad kyang sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do —360

dam can chos srung mngon rtogs 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ ldanashal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ skra dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba/ zhabs gnyis gar stabs kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ chosa'abyung phyi ma'i zur gsum du pad nyi'i steng du gdong zur du bhe las gnod sbyin bya rog gdong can g.yas rin po che dang g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/ seng ge sngon po'i steng na bzhugs pa/g.yas zur du ya las srog bdag bya rog gdong can g.yas dus kyi dbyug pa dang g.yon zhags pa 'dzin pa ma he smug po'i steng na bzhugs pa/ g.yon zur du ke las bdud po bya rog gdong can g.yasachu srin gyi rgyal mtshan/ g.yon ra'i mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ stod mi la smad sbrul mjug 'khyil ba/ lusathams cad mig gis spras pa/ gsum ga'ang drag cing rngams la gtum pa/ mi mgo'i 'phreng ba dang mi sdug pa'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ stag lngags kyi smad dkris pa'o/ /chos 'byung phyi ma'i kha khyer la rgyal chen bzhi la sogs pa'i gtsang ris kyi dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga dang / khor yug la mgon po beng 'dzin sogs dregs pa'i dmag dpung bsam gyis mi khyab pa thams cad mi gdug pa'i cha lugs can mtshon cha sna tsho gis 'dzin pa/ dur khrod brgyad du nag po stong / sha za 'bum la sogs pas yongs su gang ba thams cad kyang drag po'i cha lugs can/ me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /de (188ba)thams cad kyi dpral bar rmadakar po/ mgrin par a dmar po/ thugs kar hūṃ sngon po/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer los 'og min dang / rdo rje'i gdan nā la spro bsil pa'i tshal nas ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi ba 'khor dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ thel lugs yig rnying las byung ba ltar/ lhaḥ 'og min chos kyi pho brang dang / /bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod dang / /nā lan+da yi gtsug lag dang / /phyi yi rgya mtsho'i 'gram dag dang / /rang bzhin gar bzhugs gnas mchag nas/ /chosaskyong ma hā kā la'i tshogs/ /dpal ldan mgon po 'khor bcas rnams/ /spyan 'dren mchod kyis da tshur spyon/ /sngon gyi bde gshegs spyan snga ma khas blangs dam tshig dran gyis la/ /bka' bzhin bsgrub pa'i dam can la/ /thugs rjes dgongs la gshegs su gsol/ /lhaḥ nag po chen po khro bo'i rgyal/ /—361—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)bya rog mtshan can gnas 'dir spyon/ /las mkhan ma mo khyab 'jug can/ /yum mchog rtsa 'jib gnas 'dir spyon/ /las mgon nag po 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /bya rog gdong can gnas 'dir spyon/ /gsod byed bdud po seng ge'i gdong / /mkha' 'gro drug skor ྾/ /mon mo nag mo dbang mo che/ /lha mo tsaṇ+ḍa mo/ /dgra bgegs cham la 'bebs mdzad pa'i/ /nag po stong tshogs ྾/ /gnod byed tshe srog gcod mdzad pa'i/ /ma mo bye ba ྾/ bcol ba'i 'phrin las bsgrub mdzad pa'i/ sha za 'bum tshogs ྾/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang chen gyi/ /bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ /ma 'gying ma 'gying gnas 'dir spyon/ /ma 'gor ma 'gor la 'ur spyon/ /rings pa'i tshul gyis gnas 'dir spyon/ /'dir spyon gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ /'dir spyon tshogs gtore bzhes su gsol/ /'dir spyon byin gyis brlabatu gsol/ /oṃ ma hā kā la tsa tu ra ha sta sa pa ri (189na po ras gye hi/ zhes pas spyan drangs nas/ pad+ma ka ma lwa ye ri/ zhes gdan 'bul/ oṃ ma hā kā la nas lha ra chabadz+ra a sogasakyis mchode/ dzaḥlha baṃ sngos gnyis su med par thim/ yang thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'phros pa'i 'od kyisadabang lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ oṃ pañtsa kū la sa pa ri wā ra a nas shabha'i bar gyis mchode/ oṃ a bhi ṇiñtsa tu mo sarba ta thā ga ta zhes gsol ba btab/ dbang lhas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūṃ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ 'khor rnams la rdo rje rtse lnga pa re res dbu brgyan par bsam/ thal mo kha phye la ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud drangs te sa/sol bar bsam la/ oṃ ma hā kā la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ka wu wa ma hā kwa la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ā 7 nya raṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā'i mthar i rda ba lin+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi zhes lan bdun/ shā san lan gsum dang / oṃ hūṃ shrī ya de skyi kā li ka li/ ma hā kā li hūṃ bh+yoḥ dza zhes pa'i mthar i rda ba li sogs btags pa lan lnga/gdong can rnams la/ oṃ ma hā kā li/ ka kwa phye hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces thog mtha' 'dra ba las/ bar gyi si ha phye/dzaskru kā phye/ ṇ+ḍadha phye/ ga ru ḍa phye/ kroṇ+ḍa ka kā gye/ u lha kā phye/ su sna rā phye/ shra nā gye/ shrī kham phye/ bya —362

dam ༅ chos srung ma' rtogs tshon las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ (dpegh+ra phye/ hūṃ phaṭa kyi gsham du ba kla ta btags pa gsum gyis phul/ pho nya beng 'dzin dpal mgon bdun cu sogs la/ na ma a rba ta thā ga te bh+yo sogs gsum/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gtang bar spro na bya zhing / mi bya yang btang snyoms su bzhag ste/ gzhi bdag gtor ma 'bul/ dus gtor sogs la bkang ba byed par 'dod pas/ bkang gtor spyan gzigs bshams (189bsgo gtor ma byin rlabs dang bkang rdzas sngags drug phyag rgya drug gi byin gyis rlabs/ lha: rang bzhin rnam dag chos dbyings ngang nyid nas/ /zag med bde ba chen po'i ye shes kyi/ /rnam rol phyi nang spyan gzigs mchod pa'i tshogs/ /mgon po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul ba ni/ /dmar chen snying khrag a: mtsho ltar 'khyil/ /dgra bgegs dbang po'i me tog ri ltar spungs/ sha chen dud sprin nam mkha'i khams kun gang / /tshil chen sgron me tshar du dngar ba 'dis/ /ye shes mgon po lcam dral thugs dam bsnang / /las byeng mgon po sde lnga'i thugs dam bskang / /sgo mtshams skyong ba'i mkha' 'gro brgyad dang ni/ /dam can rgya mtsho'i tsho gos kyi thugs dam bskang / /'khor bcas bde ba chen pos mnyes gyur nas/ /rnal 'byor nyams chags dbyings su dag gyur te/ /dam chos bsgrub pa'i bar chad kun zhi zhing / /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma lus stsol/ stu1 ka phyi ma gnyis po 'di 'og ma rnams la'ang 'gre'o/ /ga bur ngad ldan khrag zhag rgya mtsho dang //lcags kyu lnga dang sgron ma lnga sbyar ba'i//zag med bdud rtsi'i btung ba mtsho ltar bskyil/ sha khrag zhal zas ri ltar spungs pa 'di/ /ye shes mgon po ྾/ /mkha' 'gro dbang du sdud byed cang teg /rdo rje dril bu zangs dung rnga bo che/ /rkang gling gsang ba'i rde chung dril chen sgra/ /dbyar dus 'brug gi sgra dang mtshungs pa 'dis/ /ye shes mgon po ྾/ /rta nag rting dkar tshogs rnams rlung bzhin 'phyo/ /rno ba'i rwa dang 'jigs pa'i ngar sgra can/ /g.yag rog zhol chen tshogs rnams 'gying zhing rol/ /dar gyis brgyan pa'i lug nag tsho gos rnams kyis/ /ye shes mgon po ྾/ /lang ling gar gyis nam mkha'i khyon bkang nas/ /dgra bo'i snying 'byin bya nag tsho gos rnams dang / /dar gyi rgyan ldan 'jigs pa'i (190nang ro can/ / seng ge'i stobs ldan khyi nag tsho gos rnams kyis/ /—363—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)ye shes mgon po ྾/ /mtshan ldan yangs shing rgya che'i thod pa'i nang / ga khrag ri ltar spungs pa'i gtor ma ni/ /zag med ye shes rnam lngar byin brlabs pa/ /dmar nag dar gyi 'phur lding rol ba 'dis/ /ye shes mgon po ྾//stong gsum khyon kun 'gengs pa'i dri bzang can/ /na rga'i 'jigasa'aphrog 'chi med dpal ster ba/ /sman sna stong rtsa brgyad las sbyar ba yi/ /'dza' gad sman phud mtsho ltar bskyil ba 'dis/ /ye shes mgon po ྾/ /gzhan yang gser dang dngul sogs rin cen lnga/ /dkar dmar byang chub sems sogs bdud rtsi lnga/ /mi dang glang chen sha sogs sha lnga dang / /zag med bde ster 'dod yon lnga rnams kyis/ /ye shes mgon po ྾/ /lha dang mi yi bza' dang bca' ba'i tshogs/ /ro brgya ldan pa'i kha zas du ma dang / / 'bras chang rgun chang la sogs gaṇa ba'i tshogs/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mnyes byed tsho gis 'khor gyis/ /ye shes mgon po ྾/ /bye ba phrag brgya'i gling dang gling phran tshogs/ /nyi zla ri rab rin cen bdun rnams dang / /rdo rje gsum dang phyi nang gsang ba'i rten/ /dngos bshams yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod sprin 'dis/ /ye shes mgon po ྾/ /bdud dpung 'jomasaphyir drag po'i skur bstan kyang / /rgyal ba kun gyi lhan cig skyes pa'i dngos/ /bla ma mchog dang dpal ldan he ru gzhi/ /ngo bor yid ches rtsegacig gsol 'debs kyis/ /ye shes mgon po ྾/ zhes bskang bshags byas nas gtor ma gong bzhin 'bul/ bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugasaka nas 'od zer 'phros mdun bskyed kyi lha tsho gos rnams kyi thugs kar 'phog /thugs rgyud bskul/thugs ka nas pho nya bsam gyis mi khyab pa spros dgra bgegs gdug pa can (190ba)thams cad tshad bcad/ tshur 'dus/ 'phrin las thams cad thogs pa med par bsgrub par bsams la gong gis yab yum gdong can rnams kyis sngags dang / spyi sngags shā san bzla/ thun mthar yi ge brgya pas chad lhag kha bskang / bstod pa tsa mis mdzad pa ni/ lhaḥ bdud dang bdud kyi phyogs gyur pa'i/ /sems can ma lus myur bar ni/ /rtsad bcad bsad nas khrag gi rgyun/ /gsol mdzad nag po chen po ni/ /rab 'jigs mdog nag gzugs thung po/ /gsus pa 'phyang zhing dbu skra ser/ /'jigs pa'i me dpung —364

dam can chos srung ma rtogs 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)nang na bzhugs/ /gtum chen khros pa'i gad mo ni/ /ha hūṃ phaṭa kyi sgra sgrogs pas/ /lha dang lha min skrag gyur nas/ /bros shing 'gyel ba'i mgo bcad de/ /zhabs kyis ro mnan drag po'i tshul/ /ska rags ril bu g.yer khas brgyan/ /sil sil ḍā ma ru yi sgra/ /dhi dhi dhu ha dha sgra ni/ /thog gi na ra ni ri'i sgra/ /sgra sgrogs snyan dang mi snyan pa/ /gar byed lha dang lha mo yi/ /tshogs kyis yongs su bskor nas ni/ /dud khrod gnas su rol bar mdzad/ /thung la sbom pa'i spyan gsum po/ /me tog bhan+dha ra ltar dmar/ /bgegs rnams skrag cing dngangs mdzad pa'i/ /ljags ni glog ltar 'byug par byed/ /mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa yis/ /ma rungs gdug pa'i sems can gyi/ sha rus khrum khrum 'cha' bar byed/ /lha ba zhag rnams 'jib par byed/ /phyag rgya lnga dang klu'i do zhal/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par spras/ /stag gi pags pa'i stod g.yogs dang / /sku rags dang ni sham thabs mdzad/ /mi bskyod pa sogs bde gshegs tshogs/ /dbu la brgyan cing sku la 'phro/ /mi yi rgyu ma'i thag pa la/ /mi mgo lnga bcu 'phyang ba yi/ /'phreng ba yis ni do shal byas/ /drag po dang ni chu bdag sogs/ /bzlog par dka' ba'i tsho gis rnams kyang / /zhal du gsol mdzad (191na phyag g.yon du/ /rtse gsum 'dzin cing thod khrag 'thung / /gshin rje'i lce 'dra'i gri gug dang / /ral gri phyag g.yas bsnams nas ni/ /gdug pa can rnams brlag mdzad cing / /mi shes sdig pa ring du spong / /mdzes pa'i lha mo gar byed ma/ /brgyad dang rol ba'i rje btsun dpal/ /rdo rje nag po chen po la/ /sangs rgyas grags pas bskul ba ni/ /gang gis nyin mtshan 'di bstod pas/ /sgrub pa'i don rnams grub pa dang / /sems can ma lug khyod lta bur/ /sa bcu la ni gnas par mdzod/ /lhaḥ ka ra'i ro ltar don snying khrag gi rgyun/ kha gdangasahub kyis drangs nas rkan sgra gtog /ga sha mi mgo khrag 'dzag rgyu rlon brgyus/ /nga ro drag pos bdud dpung spa bkongs shig /ca co sna tshogs sgra sgrog dur khrod dbus/ /cha lugs ma nges sna tsho gos cho 'phrul can/ /ja kha'i ral pa gyen brdzes dgra bo'i srog /nya mo chu 'byug ltar mchonges gcod par mdzod/ /ta ler 'phags pa'i yul nas gangs can bstan/ /tha chad btsan pos skyong bar byon pa'i —365

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)don//da lta bdag sogs tshul ldan sde skyong zhing //na tsha 'tshe bas log 'dren 'joms par mdzod//pa sangs ltar dkar cher rno mche ba'i rtse//pha rol yid sra snying ga thal mar 'bigs//ba mo'i sad kyis lo tog 'joms pa ltar//ma rungs zhing bcu ming mtha' tsam du sgrod//tsa ma ra sogs bstan pa'i dam rdzas bsags//tsha grang khyad sad lha khyod mchod bsgrub na//dza lang rgyas pa cho glegazugs kla klo'i sde//wa skyes ltar gzhes rang gshed myur du phob//zhwa ser ring lugs rnam dag thub bstan la//za 'dod mna' zan chad las 'dus pa'i sde//'a 'ur sgra sgrogs gnam lcags thog mtshon dang //ya ma'i dpung gis tshe srog mnga' thang choms//ra ba gangs kyis bskor 191bsil phan dang bde//la 'ur 'phel la gnod thob ngan g.yo mkhan/sha za phra men lta bu'i ma rungs tshogos//sa 'og rim pa bdun gyi 'og tu chug/ha har bzhad sgras pha rol klad 'ge mas nas//a don skye ba med pa'i dbyings bsgral te//ha la'i 'dab 'dra mchu sgros cher 'dzum pas//a la la zhes dga' ba'i dbugs dbyung shog/lhaḥrdo rje 'chang dbang 'phags mchog klu sgrub zhabs//ā r+ya de ba mar me mdzad bzang po//dus 'khor zhabs pa tsa mi sangs rgyas grags//dpal chen rga lo bde gshegs phag gru pa//'bri gung skyob pa skyid shod bkra shis 'bum//grags pa ye shes sangs rgyas ga the ne nu dang //ma ṇi ka shrī sa bzang 'phags gzhen pa//rdor 'chang kun bzang paṇa chen grags rgyal rje//bsod nams lhun grub sa lo kun bsod dang //grags pa blo gros sangs rgyas seng ge'i mtshan//thar rtse paṇa chen musapa nam mkha' dpal//dpal ldan don grub de dbon dpal mchog pa//rdo rje 'chang dngos mkhan chen zha lu pa//rtsa brgyud bla mas lcam dral 'khor bcas gtsug/dam tshig rdo rje 'bar ba'i ri mo bkod//mi 'bral gsang ba'i mna' chu lce thog blug/sngon gyi mtha' tshig gnyan po nyer bsgrags shing //bka' dang dam tshig khas blangs ma 'da' bar//bcom ldan shākya seng ges legs gsungs pa'i//bstan pa'i rtsa ba tshul khrimasang da ma yal//snying po theg chen sdosnod bshad sgrub dar//gos bu nges gsang smin grol gdams pa'i gnad//bka' dang bsta/6 bcos dbang po tshad thub dang //sdeb bya sangs

dam can chos srung mngon rtogs wen las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)rgyas lugs las phyir phyogs pa/ /tshur mthong skye bos phyogs tsam rtogs gyur na/ /spyan dang mngon par shes pa mnga' ba yi/ /dam can chos srung rnams kyis cis mi gzigs/ /mkhyen bzhin yal bar 'dor na dam pa'i chos/ /skong bar zhal gyis 'ches la mi gnod dam/ /(192na snam dag bstan dang zas skom 'byor pa gnyis/ /gdam nga nor na tha shal dman par gol/ /'gogs gzhung tsam la zhen na gcan gzan ma/ /bu la brtse ltar 'dod chags thugs rjer 'khrul/ /ma 'dris 'gro ba mtha' dag byang chub la/ /sbyor 'dun med na 'jig rten ga la 'das/ /de phyir he ru ka dpal gdul dka'i 'gro/ /'dul la rdo rje srin por sprul don bzhin/ /bstan dang de 'dzin 'dus pa'i tshogs rnams rgyas/ /sa dbang zhabs brtan mnga' 'bangs bde zhing skyid/ /rnal 'byor bdag sogs bsams don lhun grub mdzod/ /mjug chog rnams chos skyong gzhan gyi gtor chog bkang ba ltar byas pas tsā ba bo/ /dpal ldan mgon po bya rog mtshan can 'di nyid kyi bka' ma'i chos skor dpal chen rga lo nas/ bde gshegs phag mo gru pa dang / zhang 'gro ba'i mgon po gnyis la bka' babs pa'i rgyun bzang po rnams rjes 'brangs la las mthong thos kyi srung ma yin no cog bsnan te tshong 'dus kyi 'o ma ltar bslad pa la yid gtan du ma thub pas/ sngon rabs dam pa'i yi ge'i rjes su 'brangs te gtor chog dang bskang gso zung du 'jug pa legs ldan dgyes pa'i mchod sprin 'di ni 'jam dbyangs dpal 'byor gyis snga thog nas bskul ba 'dri 'dun rim 'gyangs su song ba dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs kyis yang bskyar du bskul zhing / me rag bla ma blo gros rgya mtshos kyang mtshams sbyar ba la brten nas za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni mthar rgyas pa blo bzang dbang pos bgyis so/ /su sti si// dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i ngo bo gnas gsar ba/ /ma hā kā la chos dbyings rang grol rje/ /drin can bla ma rnam gnyis zhabs pad la/ /btud nas dpal ldan lha mo'i mchod thabs 'bri/ /chos srung 'di nyid bris sku rab gnas can gyi mdun du nas nag gi rjen btags dang / sha khrag (192ba)dkar gsum dngar gsum/ 'khur ba sogs zas sna tshogs kyis spras pa'i gtor ma dar sna lngas —367

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)brgyan pa/ phyi nang mchod pa sogs mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len ltar bshams/ rang bde dgyes gang rung ngam de min yi dam gang byed kyis go chod/ mchod gtor rnams spyi ltar byin gyis brlabs pa'i mthar/ oṃ āḥ/ ha ho hrī lan gsum brjod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar paṃ las pad ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du tre las ye ka dzā khyi mthing nag g.yu ral lan bu gcig tu gyur pa/ phyag gnyis kyis thugs kar bdud rtsi'i bum pa 'dzin pa/ dar dkar gyi stod g.yogs dang stag sham rus pa dang rin po chesabargyan pa/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis 'od zer 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'ang rtsub lugs dang 'jam lugs su bsgrub pa gnyis las/ phyi ma'i lugs su byas te/ de'i sto ba yangs pa'i nang du thog las khrag gi rgya mtsho'i dbus su/ bh+yo las 'dod khams dbang phyug ma sku mdog sngo nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ spyan gsum dmar la 'byug pa/ mche ba gtsigs shing / mi ro rangs po za ba/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ g.yas gnyis ral gri dang thod khrag /g.yon gnyis mdung thung dang dar nag gi ba dan 'phyar ba'i tri shul 'dzin pa/ thod skam lnga'i 'phreng ba lha min la sogasapa'i mgo bo'i do shal 'phyang ba/ snyan g.yas g.yon dug sprul dang seng shes brgyan pa/ glang po che'i ko bas stod g.yogs/ba lang gi ko bas smad g.yogs/ re lde'i sham thabs la klu'i dbang po nyis gshibasakyi ska rags bcings pa/ sku la khrag gi thig le/ zhag gi sor ris/ thal chen gyi tshom bu bkod pa/ lte ba'i thad nas nyi zla 'char ba/ shin tu rid cing mi sdug pa/ bong bu ga dmar gyi steng na btsan skyil gyi zhabs gnyis lcags sgrog gis mdzes pa/ dur khrod brgyad kyi dbus na bzhugs pa'i 'khor du bka' nyan gyi ma mo (193na snyigs rkang sgog zer dung skyong ma khrag mdog ma/ phra men ma la sogs pa ma mo'i tshogos 'bum sdo rnams thod pa'i rtser la gas brgyan zhing / brnya dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ gzhan yang 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i ma mo mkha' 'gro rgyan cha lugs rnam 'gyur phyag mtshan mi 'dra ba'i tsho gos dang / dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa gnyis sha za srin po dpag tu med pasabaskor ba'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ /thugs kar hūṃ sngon po/ thugs ka'i hūṃ —368

dam can chos srung ma' rtogs wen las rnam sto lhun grub/ 9)las 'od zer 'phros pas de wi ko ṭi la dang /yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi nas dpal ldan lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/bh+yoḥdad pa dang ni dam tshig gis//tshur gshegs mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshogs//lha mo 'dir gshegs gdan la bzhugs//da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus//gshegasashing bzhugs pa'i gnasang na yang /shwakya'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang //bdag cag rnams la phan gdags phyir//gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol//cham hā kā li de li sa pa ri wā ra e gye hi/zhes lan gsum brjod/pad+ma ka ma lā ya ri gyis gdan 'bul/gong gi sngags gsham du chu gnyisanyer spyod kyis mchode/dzaḥ/ baṃ ho los bstim/dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcas par mos te/ltam hā kā li de sa ye/ye ka dzā ṭī de sa sa ma ye/sa ma ya sma ra/sam ya/sī ta kra ma/sa ma ya rak+ṣa snu/dpal ldan lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang nas bzung sa rngog brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi bka' dang dam la btags pa'i dam tshig gnyen po dran par mdzod la/gzhi bslab khrimasal gnas/byang sems kyi sde snod la sbyangs/gsang sngags kyi smin grol la spyod pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/de 'dzin pa'i skyes bu dge 'dun chos skyong rgyal po'i sku 193bas mnga' thang spel zhing chab 'bangs rnams bde skyid la sbyor/khyad par bdag sogs mchode yon 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod byed mna' zin tshad la mi brtsi ba'i dgra bgegs thams cad gang la gang 'tsham gyi chad pa drag pos tshar chod/bdag sogs rnams kyi chos srid kyi legs tshogs thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang /'ag rten kun tu bde legs rgya wo po khrung bar mdzad du gsol/zhes brjod/rdo rje thal mo kha phye nas gong gi sngags gsham du/na maḥsarba ta thā ga to bh+yo bi shwa mu khe saḥsarba thā ṇa ca te lpa ra ṇa i me ga ga na khaṃ gro sno rda ba smra ta ye swā hā/zhes lan bdun dang 'khor rnams la a kā ro lan gsum gyis phul/gong bzhin chu gnyis nyer spyod kyis mchode/sngags gsham du ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ma hā rak+ta khā hi zhes sman raka gnyis kyang 'bul/thugs mnyes pa'i bzlas pa bya na/rang gi thugasaka nas 'od zer gyi sna la mchod pa'i tsho gos spros/6/ mo 'khor bcas mnyes nas 'phrin las thams

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)cad sgrub par bsams la/ oṃ ru ru ro ru bi tiṣ+ṭha ba to gi ka ma la rak+ṣa si hūṃ bh+yoḥbh+yoḥ// bstod pa ni/bh+yoḥrak+ta'i rgya mtsho'i dbus na thod pa'i mkhar/ /zhing lpags bla bre rgyu rlon dra ba la/ /glo snying mgo lag 'phan 'gyas rab spras pa/ /mthong bas 'jigs rung pho brang che la bstod/ khren po'i gzugs can mi ro rangs po za/ /dmar zlum spyan bgrad ral pa gyen du brdzes/ /skam rlon thod 'phreng sbrul seng rna ba'i ༅/ /lte bar nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor lang la bstod/ /stod smad gnyis lho ba lang ko ba rgyan/ /khrag zhag thal chen tshom bus lus byugs pa/ /ral gris dgra srog gnod cing ka pā las/ khrag zhag dron mo 'thung ba khyod la bstod/ /mdung thung snying gi dkar nag mtshams su gzer/ /gnas gsum bsnun pa'i tri shu ba dan 'dzin/ /bong bu'i steng na btsan skyil rnam 'gyur can/ /me rlung gcig (194na)pa'i dbus na bzhugs la bstod/ /lha mo kun gyi yum chen ral gcig ma/ /dar dkar stod g.yogs stag sham rus pa dang / /rin cen rgyan spras bdud rtsi'i bum pa 'dzin/ /sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gisabazhugs la bstod/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro bye ba gtsang ris kyi/ /dpal mgon bdun cu snang srid lha 'dre sogs/ /bka' nyan dam can 'khor tshogs rnams la bstod/ /dpal ldan 'dod khams dbang phyug 'khor kyi bcas sa/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde rab spel zhing / /rnal 'byor bdag sogs mchode yon 'khor bcas kyi//'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /de nas gtor ma la sman rag sbran/ /mtshan mo yin na dpal 'bar btsugs te/ bh+yoḥ dpal ldan lha mo mi pham srid gsum bdag /e ka dzā smi ma mo kun gyi yum/ /lcags rkang srog gzer dung skyong phra men ma/ /ma tsho gis pho nya bka' sdod dam can rnams/ /'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig zhes sogs dkyus ltar btang nas yang thog tu bstab pa bya/ srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ma sogs/ mjug tshig spyi ltar bya'o/ /sna tshogs za zi'i bslad pa ma zhugs pa/ /rdo rje 'chang nas rtsa ba'i bla ma bar/ /chad ji med som nyi bral ba'i bzhed srol ltar/ /bkod pas bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal bar shog /dpal ldan dud pa'i sol ba can gyi gtor chog khyer bde ba zhig dgos zhes me rag bla ma blo gros rgya mtshos bskul ba'i ngor za —370

dam ༅ chos srung ma' rtogs skrun la rnam bzhi lhun grub/ (gehor gyi bzhes bdag chen rdo rje 'chang chen po'i gsung rab las btus nas bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni mthar rgyas pa blo bzang dbang po'o/ /pad+ma thod phreng dge bsnyen srog bdag dmar/ /drag sngags bdag po gnubs kyi kiṅka ra/ /rdo rje yang wang zab gter dgongs don las/ /byung ba ji bzhin mchod thabs cud zhig 'dri/ khrog bdag dmar (194ba)po'i bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gyi man ngag gi dgongs don dang mi 'gal bar gsol mchod bya bar 'dod pas/ stegs kyi khar bse phor dmar po'i nang du gri bsgos tsa ra'i khrag gisabyugs pa mtha' mtheb skyus bskor zhing dkar rgyan dmar rgyan gyis spras la/ mda' dar dmar po btsugs pa/rgyas par spro na sman rag sogs phyi nang gi mchod pa dang spyan gzigs kyang bya/ rang tha cubasalugs bka' gter las byung ba'i gshin rje dmar nag gi rigs ma sgrub pa bka' brgyad spyi bye brag gzhan gyis kyang rung zhing / rgyun gsol la rang gi yi dam gang byed byas kyang 'gal ba med/ mchod gtor rnams las gzhung gang 'brel de ga'i byin rlabs bya/ de nas spyan 'dren pa gter gzhung gi bskul gyi stod cha rnams la tshig zur cung zad bcos shing / ma can ga4 du chugs pa ni/ kye/ srog gi mnga' bdag chen po ni/ /ri rab shar phyogs pha gi na/ /ri dmar de ni lung du dmar/ /thang dmar de ni zangs rtse zang / /zangs mkhar de yi nang shed na/ /ltasang na stong gi dmag dpon bzhugs/ /sgrol ging dmar po srog gi gshed/ /chibs su bse bya ldan dmar bcibs/ /sku la brtse khrab dmar po gsol/ /dbu la bse rmog 'od dang bcas/ /phyag g.yas bse yi mdung dmar la/ /khrag gi ba dan yengs se yeng / /g.yon pa mi snying dkrug cing sdeb/ /btsan bran stong gi dmag dpon mdzad/ /lasasu mi srog rta srog gcod/ /zas su mi sha rta sha za/ /pho nyar gcer bu mi dgu 'gyed/ /g.yas kyi ru 'dren rta pa dgu /g.yon nas ru 'dren mi reng dgu /sngon la zangs kyi 'phar ba dgu/ /slad kyi de ni rjes shul nas/ /'tshub ma dmar po tshongs se 'breng / /sku yi 'od zer gzi mdangs las/ /'od zer dmar po ldibs se ldib/ /gsung gi de ni gzi mdangs las/ /bshug pa de ni kyu ru sa /(195na)—371—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho gsung 'bum/ (4)thugs kyi de ni gzi mdangs las//mi dmar de ni gcer bu dgu/gri bdar de ni rad de rad//brtseldem de ni khrigs se khrig/dmag dpon btsan rgod chen po ni//'jam dpal gshin rje rta mgrin rgyal//dregs pa kun 'dul gsang ba'i bdag/rgyal dbang pad+ma thod phreng rtsal//gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs//sprul sku ga kho ston rgya zhang khrom//rigs 'dzin dngos grub rgyal mas nas//khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol bar//rtsa brgyud bla ma'i dam li rnams//dran par mdzod la gnas mchog 'dir//thogs pa med par da tshur spyon//ya ma shu tri sa ma ya/tri ri ra tsa hūṃ dzaḥdzaḥbadz+rasam ya a gas bzhugs phyag dam mchod/sa ra kag gsum mas ༅ dmong tshol bag4 phug ni/kyai/mdun du bde stong shel gyi rtsig ngos la//ting 'dzin pir gyis bris pa'i 'ja' ris༅//'jigasarung srin mkhar smug po'i pho brang nang //bam ro rta g.yag srog chags sna tshogs kyi//khrag mtsho 'khyil zheng mam sa'i lhu dum nyil//rus pa gcal du bkram steng bad nyi'i gdan//dgra bgegs gan rkyal kha sbub bsnol ba'i steng //sgrol ging btsan rgod 'khor bcas bzhugs su gsol//sam ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/rnal 'byor rig pa'i rtsal las rang byung zhing //rang shar phyi rol dregs pa'i dmag tsho gos su//snang yang gdod nas dag pa'i he ru skar//dbyer med ngo bo gcig pas brda phyag 'tshal//a ti pu ho/pra la ho//gtsug tu gnam lcags 'bar ba'i rdo rje bkod//lce thog bdud rtsi a mṛ ta bzhag nas//rnal 'byor bdag dang dam tshig gcig bsre na//dam bca' ma g.yel bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrubs//oṃ badz+ra sam ya ha na ha na hūṃ/lhaḥgatum chen dpa' bo dgyes pa'i mchod pa ni//dmar chen 195bakhrag gi a sgo'i chu rgyun sbreng //'phral bsad dbang po'i me tog 'dar zhing 'phrig sha chen bsregs dud char sprin lta bur g.yo//tshil zhun ro ska'i mar me 'od bkrag gsal//zhag dang mkhris pa'i byug pa dri ngad 'thul/kha rus phung por sbungs pa lha yi bskos//sna tsho gos rol mo 'brug stong ltar sgrog 'bul//rtsa brgyad stong las sbyar ba'i myong grol dang //dmar r+pā rak+ta'i dngas ma mtsho ltar 'khyil//dam rdzas gtor ma ri ltar spungs pa yis//bas /da 'khor bcas mnyes pa'i ma rdzo par 'bul//

dam tso chos srung mag rtogs tshon las rnam swo lhun grub/ 9)gong gi sngags gsham du ma hā rak+ta kha raṃ khā hi/ ma hā ba kla ta kha raṃ khā hi/ mthun rdzas 'bul ba ni/sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis byin gyis brlabs la/ lha rta dmar rlung gi shugs can rin po che'i/ /sga srab gong rmed mdzes pa'i chas spras pa/ /sgrol ging chen po chibs pa'i rten du 'bul/ /stong gsum skor la dgra bgegs rings par khug /bse khrab bse rmog nyi ma'i 'od ltar 'tsher/ /rgyal mtshan dar lcog cod pan 'ja' ltar bkra/ /btsan po'i go cha gnod sbyin rten du 'bul/ /rnal 'byor bdag sogasasrung skyob 'phrin las mdzod/ /mdung dmar dar lce lhab lhub rnon po'i mar/ /drod rlangs ma yal dgra snying rtsa lag bcas/ /dpa' rtags g.yul las rgyal ba'i phyag mtshan 'bul/ /log 'dren phye mar 'thag pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /za 'og gsham ldan khrab chen gangs ltar dkar/ /dmag chas lha yi dpung gi gzi brjid 'phrog /rnga ma'i 'ja' ris zhol btags lcags gzhibs sogs/ /srung skyob rdo rje'i go cha khyod la 'bul/ /dpag chen mda' mdung ral gri chu gri dang / /spu gri dgra sta me rdo chu yi sgrogs/ /pha rol phye mar 'thag pa 'phrul 'khor gyi/ rno ba'i mtshon cha sna tsho gos khyod la 'bul/ /seng ge glang chen ma he 'brong g.yag dang / /'dod (196na'i jo'i ba mo ra rgod lug nag khyi/ /gnam la 'phur dgu sal 'dzul dgu dang / /ri dwags 'phyo dgu ma lus khyod la 'bul/ /'bral med 'grogasapa'i rtag ga 'a nar ma sa /dbul ba'i mar ga kho rdzos kyi 'bor lo spungs/ /mda' dar don snying sngags 'khor bla rdo sogs/ /dam rdzas gol med gsang ba'i rten du 'bul/ /ri rab gling bzhi nyi zla rgyal srid bdun/ /mdor na lha mi'i dpal 'byor longs spyod kyis/ /sgrol ging btsan rgod 'khor bcas mthun rdzas su/ /'bul gyi thugs dam skongs la 'phrin las sgrubs/ bstod pa ni/ lhaḥ pad+ma rā ga'i phye ma brdal ba'i thang / /zangs dmar ri bo mkhar bsnyeg khor yug nang / /bse yi btsan mkhar mchong gi ba gam can/ /'jigs shing skyi g.ya'i dur khrod wo por bstod/ /de dbus chu skyes nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gdan/ /gsar rnying baṃ ro'i khri la 'gying zhing bzhugs/ /drag po'i las la bskyod tshe brtse bya dmar/ /rlung gi shugs can rta mchog bcibs la bstod/ /byu ru'i lhun po brgya phrag nyi ma yis/ /—373

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)'byud pa'i gzi 'bar skyes bu dbang gi mdog/bse yi beg tse rmog zlum dar phru can//btsan rgod bye ba'i dmag dpon khyod la bstod//phyag g.yas khrag gis sbags pa'i dar lce can//mdung dmar rnon pos dgra srog thal bar 'bugs//g.yon pa sbar mos don snying rtsa phran bcas//phyungs nasadakrug cing brdeg pa khyod la bstod//phyogs bcur pho nya 'gyed pa'i gcer bu dgu//g.yas g.yon ru 'dren rta pa mi reng dgu//sngon du 'phar ba rjes 'brang 'tshub ma sogs//sprul pa'i rnam rol sna tsho gos ston la bstod//dgra srog la brngams btsan rgod bshan pa sogs//pho nya lha srin mtha' klasadamag dpung tshogs//las byed bka' nyan gnam sa bar snang kun/khyab pa'i 196ba bka' stod dam can tsho gos la bstod//dus gtore sogs kyi tshe/sman spos tsā sna'i phye ma sbyar ba'i phye la btsan bgos mtheb skyu bza' bca' sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/rgya phor du chang bzang po la rin bo che'i phye dang sman sna btab ste mar gyi ze brog gis brgyan pa/sna cig tu ra dmar gyi khrag chang sbyar ba rnamasabashams te byin gyis brlabs/oṃ/phud kyi mnga' bdag rdo rje slob dpon/zhi khro bka' brgyad lha tshogs/chos skyong srung ma'i tsho gis dang bcas pa rnams la g.yos su sbyar ba'i bza' bca'/skyemasakyi mchod pa dam pa 'di gsol zhing mchod do//dgyes pa bskyed par gyur cig/thugs rje'i byin rlabs kyis bstan 'gro'i bde skyid dar zhing /bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod rnams kyi pha rol bdud tshogs 'dul zhing dam can bran du 'khol nas 'phrin las thams cad bsgrub par mdzad du gsol/tri chos skyong sgrol ging btsan rgod chen po la/g.yos su sbyar ba sogs gong ltar/sprul pa pho nya las mkhan gyi tsho gis la g.yos su sbyar ba sogs gong ltar/dam bsgrag cing 'phrin las 'chol ba ni/lhaḥdang po sangs rgyas gnyis pa pad+ma 'byung //bar du gnubs chen rdo rje 'od 'bar zhabs//tha mar rigs 'dzin rgod kyi ldem phru yi//spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas ma g.yel bar//tshul ldan mdo sngags bshad sgrub thub pa'i bstan//de 'dzin skyes bu 'dul ba'i sde rnams skyongs//bod skyong rgyal po'i sku tshe mnga' thang spel//sngags 'chang ba/ga gi las kun thogs med sgrubs//mna' dang

dam ༅ chos srung ma' rtogs mun las rnam sto lhun grub/ 9)chad la mi brtsi ngan g.yo'i 'phrul//thabs kyis 'gro mang 'phung sbyor kla klo'i sde//dug mtshon dmag 'khrug gtad ser sbyor ba kun//rang gshed phob la snying khrag hub tu 'thung //las 'bras bden rdzun gsal ba drang po'i thig/btab nas dri med spyan gyis rab gzigs te//dkar 197log ma 'dresadabye ba mngon sum du//so sor dbye ba'i 'phrin las dus la bab//mdor na yongs 'du'i shing dang gter gyi bum//yid bzhin nor ltar 'dod pa'i re ba kun//'bad med 'byung ba'i legs tshogosachar chen pos//phyogs bcu kun tu khyab pa'i bkra shis shog/chad lhag bzod gsol//rang gnas su gshegs shing bkra shis sogs spyi ltar bya'o//pad+mā ka ra'i zab chos ma thob par//rang gi mthong dang dam btags zog rdzun gyi/khyud mangs la drangs jag len dgra 'dul sogs//blos byas mar mesablun po phye leb 'drid//mkha' rlom rtog bzo'i snyan tshig thang legs 'dri//la la gnag rdzi rgan po'i bgros rjes 'jug/sems kyi 'char sgo'i gzugs med phan gnod 'bras//rnam rtog rjes 'brang tshad pa kha tsam dbri//sgrol ging mchod thabs khungs 'brel 'phrin las kyi//rlabs 'phreng me rag blo grosargya mtsho yis//bskul tshe za hor bzhes nyer bkod 'di//yi ge'i 'du byed blo bzang dbang po'o//dge ba 'dis kyang gtsang byed pad+ma'i sbubs//legs 'khrungs srid gsum dregs pa zil gnon de'i//bka' rtags rdo rje'i ri mo sdebargyad g.yug/nam yang yol med bsam pa lhun grub shog/tsa ri'i gnas srung cig car dmar po la gsol mchod 'bul bar 'dod pas/rdo rje 'jigs byed sogs gang mos pa'i yi dam gyi nga rgyal dang ldan pa'i sgo nas/mchod gtor rnams spyi 'gro ltar byin gyis brlabs la/྅:bde chen ye shes 'khor lo tsa ri3//cig car brag dmar de'u'i mkhar rdzong nas//gnas chen srung ma 'khor tshogs ma lus pa//thogs med 'dir spyon dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs//srung ma khyod la mthun pa'i dam rdzas ni/khrag chang mchod yon dbang po'i 197ba tha rtag bkra//gsur chen dud pa zhun chen mar me gsal//mkhris pa'i dri chab sha rus zhal zas spungs//thod rnga rkang gling rol mo sna tshogs 'brol/sha khraX dkar dmar rgyan ldan ba lin+ta//phyi nang gsang

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)ba'i spyan gzigs dngos bshams dang //yid kyi sprul nas 'bul lo thugs dam skong //ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus gtore ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar bsams la/oṃ a kwa ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇa ā sdi nu khru du tā ta oṃ āḥlha phaṭa swā hā/lan gsum mam bdun gyis phul/oṃ a nas sha rdi'i bar dang //'jigs rung dur khrod byu po'i dbus//chu gang dmar po la zhon pa//pad+ma rā ga'i mdog 'tsher ba//srin po'i gzugs can khyod la bstod//zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche ba gtsigs//sma ra ag tshom smin ma 'byug/ral pa dmar ser gyen du brdzes//thod skam dbu rgyan gsol la bstod/khrag 'dzag mgo 'phreng do shal dang //rus pa'i rgyan drug sprul gyis spras//g.yang gzhi'i stod g.yogs stag sham gyon//me dpung dbus na 'gying la bstod//phyag gnyis mda' gzhu rab bkang ste//log 'dren dgra bgegs snying la 'bigs//sna tsho gis sprul pa phyogs bcur 'gyed//dam can 'khor dang bcas la bstod//sangs rgyas kun dngos pad+ma 'byung //gnyos ston r+ṣa po lha nang pa//dam pa mgar dang chos ye shes//rtsa brgyud bla ma'i dam tshig dgongs//gangs can bstan 'gro'i phan bde spel//bstan 'dzin skyes bu 'dus sde skyong //sa skyong mnga' thang sku tshe spel//bdag sogs bsam don lhun gyis grubs//mna' zan chang la mi brtse ba'i//ma rungs kla klo'i dpung tsho gos cho mes//mdor na 'phrin las ma lus pa//thogs pa med par sgrub par mdzod/zhes cig car dmar po'i gsol mchod cig dgos zhes me rag bla ma blo gros 198na ) rgya mtshos bskul bar 'di dang jag len du ming btags pa gnyis la gzug phyogs su yi ge 'ga' zhig snang ba rtsom chos kyi nang gses rnamasakyang mi mthun zhing /bris thang yang rigs mi gcig pa dang /lhag tu khro bo la mi 'os pa'i rin cen rgyan cha sogs rgya gral blo lhag gi gtam la nges pa mi 'dug rung /lha 'di ga'i yong babs dang bstan pa'i 'gal med kyi lugs su za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni mthar rgyas pa blo bzang dbang po'o//rang byung lus kyi 'khor lor zhi khro'i lha//chu zla ltar shar rnga yab gling pa yi//gsung gi gnasamachog mchims phu'i srung ma che//ral gcig lha ༷ mchod thabs 'phrin las spel//de yang he ru ka

dam can chos srung ma' rtogs 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)rang byung gi gtsug lag khang dang mtshudas pa mchims phu gsung gi dben gnas kyi srung ma bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i chos skyong dpal ldan lha mo ral gcig mchod gsol bstod pa las 'chol gyi rim pa bya bar 'dod pas/ lha mo 'di nyid la zhi drag gi rnam 'gyur sna tsho gis kyang yongs su grags pa zhi ba'i rnam pa can du mdzad pa shas che bas 'bru sna lnga la sogs pa'i dar phye la sman spos rin po che/ /bdud rtsi a khra ta sogs bsres pa'i bsgos bu dkar zlum zhi rgyan sna tshogs kyis mdzes par spras pa/'khor grangs ci rigs pa dang / mtheb skyu kha zas sna tshogs kyis bskor ba dang bcas pa/ chu gnyisasngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod/ sman phud/ tshogs/ phyi nang gsang ba'i spyan gzigs/ gsol kha la dgos pa'i rgya phor chang gis bkang bar sman phabs btab pa mar gyi ze brog can sogs yo byad rnams 'du byas/ bka' brgyad spyi bye brag gam bla ma dgongs 'dus lta bu gang mos kyi las byang gzhud bsrang ba'am/ bsdu na rgyun 'khyer gyi/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa sogs byas nas/ las sngags kyis bsangs/su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang (198bsgos : las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i dpal ldan lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa mnyes par byed pa'i phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa ngo bo bde ba/ rang bzhin stong pa/ rnam pa mchod rdzas/ byed las dbang po drug gi spyod yul du zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can bskyed par nus pa dpal kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung zad mi shes par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra a: nas shabha'i bar/ rū pa nas spar+sha'i bar/nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya dang /sngags drug /phyag rgya drug gis byin gyis brlabs gtore ma la dmigs nas bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i
