snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ lha rdzas las grub pa'i gtor ma kha dog dri ro reg bya phun sum tshogs pa'i steng du oṃ āḥlha gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ 'khor 'das kyi bcud bsdus nas yi ge gsum la thim pa rim gyis zhu ba las/ hūṃ gis kha dog dri nus kyi skyon sbyangs/ āḥs bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor byas/ oṃ gyis rgya cher spel zhing byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ oṃ āḥlha ma hā ba —377—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)lin+ta/ te dz+wa ba lin+ta/ ba la bha te/ gu phya sam ye swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ rten bskyed pa ni/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las po las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i gdan 7steng du yi ge bh+yo dkar po yongs su gyur ba las/ dpal ldan lha mo ral gcig ma sku mdog ston ga'i zla ba ltar dkar ba/ zhi 'jam chags pa'i nyams ldan la yid tsam khros pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dbang du sdud pa'i cang te'u 'brol zhing / g.yon snang srid ma lus pa gsal ba'i me long 'dzin pa/ dbu skra gnag snum ral pa'i thor tshugs bcings pa'i lhag ma'i zar bu lan bu gcig tu gyur nas lung ba/(199nang 'og kha dog lnga ldan gyi sha gos la rin po che'i phras spras pa'i gser gyi ska rags bcings pa/ de'i steng du dar dkar 3 tsi gos phu dung lhab lhub g.yo bar za 'og tshon khra'i gong pa dang mtha' 'jag can g.yang klubs su gsol ba/ rin po che'i brog zhu/snyan cha/ 'gul rgyan/ do shal/ phyag zhabs kyi gdu bu sogs rgyan thams cad kyis spras pa/ zhabasaganyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyi bzhengs pa de'i 'khor du ma mo 'bum/ sha za stong / snang srid dregs pa'i dmag tshogs kyis bskor ba rnams kyis dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs gar hūṃ/ bdag mdun gyi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ gnas sum cu rtsa gnyis/ dur khrod chen po brgyad/ bod kyi gnas chen gangs brag khyad par can rnams nas dpal ldan lha mo ral gcig ma 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sam ya dzaḥdzaḥ spyan drangs pa ni/ bh+yoḥ sangs rgyas kun 'dus pad+ma thod 'phreng gi /spyan sngar zab gter chos dang gnas chen gyi/ /srung mar khas blangs ye ka dzā khyi ma/ /'khor dang bcas pas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /mchims phu gri khu ge'u gong phug pa sa /pad+ma badz+ra 'khor lor rab smin pa/ /hūṃ ga'i sras mo dpal mo 'dzom pa skyid/ /ḍā zhi'i dbang mo'i skur bstan ྾/ /chos bdag nyi ma rgyal mtshan spyan snga mā /dmar nag khram shing thod pa snying 'dzin pa'i/ /res 'ga' khro mo'i skur ston srid gsum sha /za ba'i kha mo che khyod ྾/ /zan g.yang lhun grub gong pa mchims phu'i gnas/ /skyong zhing dgongs 'dus sgos kyi bka' srung che/ /a ma rigs 'dzin lha mo —378

dam ༅ chos srung ma' rtogs tshon la rnam swo lhun grub/ 9)ral gcig can//ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas ྾//sil snyan rdza rnga dung chen bshug pa'i sgra//dri zhim spos thul dar tshon sna lnga g.yab//dam rdzas mchode pa'i yo byad kun bshams na//ral gcig lha 199bstos 'khor dang bcas pa rnams//gangs ri ltar dkar zhi ba'i chas kyis spyon//brjid ldan gser mdog rgyas pa'i tshul gyis spyon//rjes chags dbang sdud dmar 'od zhabrug cing spyon//mthing nag khro gtum gnam lcags thog ltar spyon//'thor rlung drag po'i 'tshub ma ji bzhin spyon//char sprin stug po dang mtshungs lang long spyon//glog stong 'byug pa lta bur myur du spyon//thogs med rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis da tshur spyon//de sa kū la dha rī ḍā ki nā e ka dzā khyi sa pa ri wā ra dzaḥlha baṃ sngobazhugs su gsol ba ni/'jam mnyen chu skyes ba 'ad pa'i ge sar rtser//ri bong 'dzin pa'i dkyil 'khor nya gang steng //lha mo rigs 'dzin ral gcig 'khor bcas rnams//dgyes pa'i tshul gyisabartan par bzhugs su gsol//sam ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/mchod bskang ni/bh+yoḥdapal ldan mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug spyan snga sa/mtho ris chu klung dngas shing rnyog bral ba//skyems kyi mchod yon tshul du rab dbul zhing //zhabs zung dri ma bkru ba'i bsil byed sbreng //man+ta ra ba u dum wā ra dang /ut+pal pad+ma la sogs chu dang ni//thang las skyes pa'i me rtag sna tsho gos pa//rigs 'dzin lha mo'i rgyan dang thod du chings//tsan+dan dkar dmar lha shug mkhan pa dang //ba lu su lu stag pa a ka mā/sposadakar bzang sman sna tsho gos bsangs dud kyis//ma dag kun sel shangs kyi dbang por 'bul//nyi zla'i 'od zer me shel la sogs pa//brgya phrag nor bu'i tsho gis kyi bkrag mdangs dang //rtsi bcud 'bru mar las sbar sgron me yis//mun pa kun bsangs spyan gyi gzigs mor 'bul//ga pur gur gum dri ngad bzang po sa/'thul ba'i spos sna nyal 'gror legs btab pa//dung chos snod du mtsho ltar rab bskyil ba//'jam mnyen snyim pas sku yi gnas su byug/mngar skyur 200nasgo ska kha tsha dang lan tsha sogs//ro brgya ldan pa'i bza' bca' ri ltar spungs/a mṛ ta sbyar bdud rtsi'i zhal skyemasadang //rgya ja'i gas ba ljags kyi dbang por 'buX//sbug sil rnga dang dzornga ṣi ting shags//dung

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)dkar rgya gling dung r+ṣa rgyud mang dang //wen las gyer dbyangs glu yi 'gyur khugs sgra//ma sring thosa'adzin 'jebs pa'i rgyan du 'bul//rin cen sga srab gong ṣ+ka dar dpyangs kyis//brgyan pa'i rta mchog stong gsum yud kyis bskor//'o ma'i rgyun 'dzin 'dod 'jo'i ba dang mdzo//'brong g.yag zhol r+pā dbang sngon rwa rno gdengs//mkha' lding bya rgod khra dang khā ta sogs//nam mkha'i khyon 'gang 'dab chags 'phur dgu dang //seng ge stag gzig dom dred ce spyang gsa'//sna tsho gis gcan gzan sa gzhir 'dzul dgu'i tshogs/sha ba gna' ba gla ba dgo ba sogs//sa 'dzin ngos rgyu ri dwags 'phyo dgur bcas//ra lug ma he ba glang sgo phyugs sogs//srog chags sna tsho gos bsten pa'i rdzas su 'bul//sra mkhregs byang brtsegs khrab chen gos gsham can//rmog dkar rgyal mtshan lcog dar mas kyi dpa'//rnga ma'i 'ja' ris zhol btags lcags gzhibs sogs//bsrung skyob bsten du rdo rje'i go cha 'bul/spu gri chu gri ral gri dpag chen mda'//mdung rnon dgra sta me rdo chu sgrogs kyi//sna tshogs 'phrul 'khor pha rol dgra bgegs dpung //thal ba'i rdul du brlag pa'i rten du 'bul//dar dkar la sogs za 'og tse gos dang //rin cen rgyan phreng mda' dar cang teg/me long 'khor lo rdo rje rin po che//pad+ma rgya gram las bzhi'i rgyal mtshan 'bul//sna tsho gos rgyan spras gtor ma'i ri bo brjid//ro bda'i bcud ldan btung ba mtsho ltar bskyil//'phan gdugs bla bre rgyal mas ba dan dang //dar 2—bcu lda ldi rnam bkra'i spyan gzigs 'bul//bsgos bu rgyan ldan me sam da na//dkar gsum mngar gsum shing rtag sngo yi rigs//bca' yos 'khur ba thug pa'i bye brag sogs//longs spyod tsho gis kyi 'khor lo'i mchod pa 'bul//smyug rgod rtse rgyal bla rdo srog sngags dang //gser g.yu mu tig ḍā gi gsang ba'i rdzas//ri rab gling bzhi rgyal srid rin cen bdun//lha mi'i dpal 'byor longs spyod ma lusa'abul//mkha' la dam tshig rdo rje'i gur ma dral//sa la dkyil 'khor tshon mdangs bkrag ma yal//bar du lha sngags ye shes rgyun ma chad//rang byung rang shar rig rtsal mchod pa 'bul//log 'dren gshed du sha za ma mo'i rigs//rnal 'byor skyong ༷ yid 'phrog lha mo'i gzugs//nges pa'i don du

dam ༅ chos srung ma' rtogs phren la rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i gtsor/ /yid ches mos pa'i rten mchog dam pa 'bul/ /de ltar phyi nang gsang ba'i dam rdzas kyis/ /rigs 'dzin ral gcig lha mo'i thugs dam bskang / /ma sring mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi thugs dam bskang / /lha srin kiṅka ra tsho gos mo/ /thugs dam gnyen po dbyings su skongs gyur nas/ /dam tshig nyams chags 'gal 'byug ma lus sos/ /bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi/ /bar chad kun zhi mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /gong gis sngags gsham du mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ ma hā ba lin+ta kha raṃ khā hi/ sarba pā dza me gha sa mu dra snya ra ṇa khaṃ swā hā/ zhesamachod gtor rnams bsngo zhing 'bul/ /bstod pa ni/ shel dkar rdul mang brtsegs pa'i lhun po la/ /zla zhun lan brgyar blugs pa'i 'od bkrag can/ /za 'og gos dang rin cen phyang phrul gyis/ /rab spras mdzes brjid yid 'phrog sku la bstod/ /rdo rje'i tshig phreng mgrin pa'i rgyud mang glur/ /nyer blangs gangs kyis ma sring mkha' 'gro'i (201na stags/ /pad+ma'i rdzing bur bung ba ji bzhin du/ /thogs med sdud mdzad snyan 'jebs gsung la bstod/ /srid zhi'i rnam rtog sgyu ma'i gar mkhan ma/ /kun rdzob zhakhrul ngor shar rnams dri bral spyan/ /'khor ba'i pha mtha' dkyus ring gis 'jal bar/ /thogs med ye shes slong yangs thugs la bstod/ /'bum phrag nyi ma'i 'od kyis cha tsam du/ /sgrun par nus pa min pa'i gzi byin gyis/ /tshe dpal 'byor pa rgyas la rnam thos bu/ /bsnyems pa'i ngal ba gtong bar mdzad la bstod/ /sems ldan lta ci sa rdo ljon shing sogs/ /brtan pa 'phrog byed dgyes chagasarnams 'gyur gyis/ /'dod pa'i mda' lnga nyer skyengs mgrin sngon gyi/ /rdzu 'phrul mngon sum ston par mdzad la bstod/ /dmar nag srin mo khros pa'i drag shul gyis/ khrag 'dzag g.yang gzhi'i gos gyon don snying za/ khyu rlon la brgyus mgo 'phreng do shal can/ /mag spyod thogs med 'phrin las sgrub la bstod/ /ma nges mas dang sna tshogs mtsho ni cha thogs/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag sgrub la ches dpa' ba/ /ma mo sha za mkha' 'gro lha ma srin/ /dam can dregs pa'i tshogs dang bcas la bstod/ /gsol kha ni bkang ba'i dus kyi gtor ma dang chang phud sogs sgrigs/ /rin po che'i snod du gtor ma so so nas ci —381—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)rigs bcad pa dang /zas sna tshogs blug pa la rgya phor gyi chang phud nas sbran te/'phud kyi mnga' bdag rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs rnams la dam rdzas rgyan gyi bza' bca' sna tshogs phud kyis sbran pa 'di nyid kyis gsol lo//mchod do//dgyes pa wo po bskyed nas/bstan pa dar zhing de 'dzin rnamasazhabs pad brtan pa/mdo sngags kyi sde gnyis dar ba/bod skyong rgyal po'i sku tshe mnga' thang rgyas shing /mnga' 'bangs rnams bde zhing skyid pa/bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyi 20bsgos mas pa'i don chos dang mthun par yid bzhin 'grub par mdzad du gsol/phud gtor/ru mtshon sgreng zhing rol mo bya/bh+yoḥdapal ldan lha mo rigs 'dzin ral gcig ma la dam rdzas rgyan ldan zhes sogs gong dang 'dra ma mo sha za/bka' sdod dregs pa'i tsho gis rnams la dam rdzas rgyan ldan zhes sogs 'dra/'phrin las 'chol ba ni/ral gcig lha mo 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis//snang ba mtha' yas rigs lnga spyan ras gzigs//pad 'byung khri srong lde btsan mkhar chen bza'//dam 'dzin lha sras gter ston sangs rgyas gling //dpal ldan seng ge cho ge rgyal bkra shis dang //dpal 'bar dbang phyug bya khyung ngag gi dbang //phyon dpal 'byor kun bzang rnam par rgyal//'phrin las lhun grub chos dbyingasarang grol zhabs//rtsa brgyud bla ma'i dam tshig nyer dgongs la//sangs rgyas bstan pa phyogs bcur dar zhing rgyas//gangs can ljongs 'dir mi phyugs nad yams rims//sad ser btsa' 'than mu ge dbul phongs dang //'thab rtsod g.yul zhabrug mtha' dmag gnod pa sogs//mi mthun phyogs rnamasam lus bzlog pa dang //'bru bcud 'phel zhing mtha' bzhi'i las sgo dar//sman rnams mas ldan tshe dpal rgyas par mdzod//za hor rigs 'dzin che mchog 'dus rtsal gyis//bstan 'gro'i bde skyid spel ba'i 'khor 'das kyi//yon tan ma lus bsams pa ji bzhin du//yar ngo'i zla ltar rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//dga' ldan lugs gnyis pho brang rgyal khab cher//sangs rgyas bstan pa rgya mtsho legs skyong ba//gnam sa'i dbang phyug rigs brgyud mnga' thang sogs//rnam mang thos pa'i srasadang mtshungs par mdzod//chos dang srid kyi khrims gnyis gser gyi shing //mchog dman kun gyi 8

dam can chos srung ma' rtogs wen las rnam pha lhun grub/ 9)gnya' bar rab lci bas//'bangs202na snams rdzogs ldan dus kyi skye rgu bzhin//bde zhing skyid pa'i dpal la sbyor bar mdzod//bsil ba'i tshal mtshungs mchims phu'i gnas 'dzin pa//dpal gyi ri bor gsang sngags 'amang ba'i gling //'khor lo gsum gyis srid mthar dar rgyas shing //rgyal dbang pad+ma'i bzhed pa 'grub par mdzod//dug mtshon g.yul dang rdzas sngags 'khrul 'khor sogs//sna tshogs thabs kyi bsam ngan sbyor rtsub pa'i//gzugs can dgra dang gzugs med bgegs kyi dpung //tshe srog mnga' thang mthu stobs nus pa phyung /khyad par mna' dang chad la mi brtsi bar//thabs kyi bod phung sna 'dren lho mon nas//sgom grar brdzu ba'i brlang spyod sder bcas rnams//snying gi khrag dron 'thung la rdul du rlog/mdor na dus gsum kun tu bde legs pa'i//bkra shis rgya mtshor gser gyi snye ma'i 'bras//rab smin 'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan dam par//yongs 'du'i dpal gyi 'khri shing dar bar shog/mjug tu nongs pa bzod par gsol zhing rten med na gshegs gsol/yod na brtan bzhugs/smon lam shis brjod sogs spyi ltar bya'o//sangs rgyas gnyis pa pad+mā ka ra'i gsung gi gnas chen mchims phu'i srung ma lha mo rigs 'dzin ral gcig ma'i spyan 'dren/gtor bskang /bstod 'phrin dang bcas pa phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa 'phrin las myur mgyogs 'di ni srung ma chen po nyid kyis rtsoms shig pa'i gsung gis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes lcags sprel sa ga zla ba'i nyer lnga la sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni mthar rgyas pa blo bzang dbang po'o//dgung sngon mthon po'i steng dang dbus phyogs mtshams//rin cen gzhal yas gar bzhugasaganas gzhan nas//dmu bdud klu tsha rgyal chen rje blon lnga//'khor dang bcas pa dbyings nas sku bzhedas 202brga/rang rang gnas nas gnod sbyin mched lnga dang //sprul pa gsang yum blon po phyag brnyan sogs//bka' sdod dregs pa'i dpung gi dmag tsho gos bcas//thogs pa med par gnasa'adir da tshur spyon//dgra lha skyes gcig mdzes byed pad+ma skyes//rdo rje grags ldan 'khor tsho gos rgya mtshor bcas//tshur spyon mthun pa'i dam rdzas baXms la gsan//dgyes skyed 'phrin las bsgrub

rgyal dbang lnga pa sha dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)phyir gshegs su gsol//zhes pa'am bzhengs bskul spyan 'dren gtso bor 'phrin las don bcu ma dang gas ma'i gsol mchod thor bu 'dug rung khog par myur phebs kyi dus gas rnams long med pa'i rtsol khyad la sgro ka gsum tsam zhig gyis zhes chos skyong chen pos gsungs pa ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i ye ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o//hūṃ/'od mas gar dbang mchog gi rnam 'phrul las//spyo rgya mtshor rdzus skyes sprul pa'i sku//dus gsum sangs rgyas spyi gzugs pad+ma 'byung //mthu stobs dpung gis snang srid zil gnon zhing //mgon de'i dam tshig rdo rje ri mo'i rjes//spyi bor gsal zhing lce la a skṛ ta//nyer blud sprul pa'i chosargyal sku lnga pa//gsang yum blon po 'khor tsho gos gnas 'dir spyon/khyad par skyid gshod dga' gdong gnas mchogo nas//mthu stobs rdol ldan pa shing bya can//bka' sdod las byed pho nya bcas pa rnams//thogs pa med par gnas 'dir tshur spyon zhig/rab 'jigs dur khrod rol pa'i sa gzhi'i dbus//pad+ma nyi zla dgra bgegs bsnol ba'i steng //chos skyong rgyal chen sprul 'khor bcasapa rnams//phyi nang mchod pa'i yul du tiṣ+ṭhaṣ+ṭha//dngas bsil mtho ris nyal 'gro'i rdzo sbreng //thang dang chu las skyes pa'i me tog bkra mang sna'i bsangs dang sman spos dud sprin 'thul//rtsi bcud 'bru mar sgron me rab tu gsal//ga bur gur gum 203na ste dri ngad 'jibs//lha mi'i bza' bca'i bsgos bu ri ltar spung //rol mo'i sgra yis gnam sa'i khyen kun 'geng //phyi mchod chos skyong 'khor bcas dgyes phyir 'bul/khrag chang btung ba'i rba rlabs mkha' la 'phyo//mig sna rna lce don snying 'phrig cing 'dar//bam ro gsar rnying bsregs pa'i dud sprin 'thul//tshil chen ro skra las sbar mar me 'bar/khrag zhag mkhris pa'i byug pa mtsho ltar 'khyil/sha rus nang khrol zhal zas phung por spungs//thod rnga rkang gling sgra dbyangs 'brug ltar sgrog/nang gi nyer spyod mkha' dbyings bkang nasa'abul//srab rmed sga srab mdzes pa'i rta mchog 'phyo//'brong g.yag 'dod pa 'jo ba'i ba dang mdzo//ra lug bya khyi ri dwags gcan gzan rgyu//sra brtan spya cha sna tshogs rno ba'i mtshon//za 'og seng spyang rma

dam mā cho srung ma' rtogs tshon las rnam pha lhun grub/ 9)bya spre'u yi//rgyal mtshan zhing lngags glang chen stag lngags gos//zab ber 'theb zhu mgo 'phreng rusapa'i rgyan//bstan srung gnod sbyin 'khor dang bcas la 'bul//gtor ma'i ri bo rgyan ldan mkha' la bsnyeg/ja chang khrag gi btung ba mtsho ltar bskyil//'phan gdugs bla bre rgyal mtshan lda ldi dang //mon pa dzo gi spre'u zlos gar rtse//ri rab gling bzhi nyi zla 'dod yon lnga//rgyal srid bdun dang nye ba'i sna bdun sogs//lha mi'i dpal 'byor longs spyod tsho gos rnams kun//rgyal chen 'khor bcas la 'bul 'phrin las sgrubs//sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las med po ches//gar dgu'i nyams ldan sku lnga'i rnam rol can//sprul pa yum blon skyo sangs 'bag seng gar//bka' sdod pho nya las byed tsho gos la bstod/khyad par dgra bo'i srog la ches brngams pas//stong gsum skad cig myul ba'i rdzu'aphrul che//dpal ldan gnod sbyin chen po shing bya can//dam can 203bcu mtsho'i tsho gos dang bcas la bstod//gsang bdag dregs 'dul rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal//pad+ma thod 'phreng nyi ma 'od zer sogs//rtsa brgyud bla ma'i dam tshig nyer dgongs la//tso bstan spyi dang mnyam med btsong kha pa'i//bshad dang sgrub pa'i bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas//de 'dzin skyes bu 'dus pa'i sde rnamasa'aphel//bod skyong rgyal po'i sku tshe mnga' thang dar//mnga' yongs kun tu nad med tshe ring zhing //'bru bcud khe dpogs mtha' bzhi'i las sgo 'du//dpal 'byor longs spyod snyan pa'i grags pa 'bar//sum rtsen yul gyi dga' ston ma lus pa//mngon sumanyams su myong ba'i 'phrin las mdzod//khyad par dge mas ༅ dang ldan pa yi//skyid gzhod nor 'dzin dpal mo'i lte ba sa/dga' gdong chos sde'i lugs gnyis phun tsho gos kun//yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel ba'i 'phrin las mdzod//bstan dang 'gro la 'tshe ba spyi yi dgra//rnal 'byor bdag la bsdob sgos kyi dgra//gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tsho gis rnams kun//steng 'og phyogs mtshams gang du gnas kyang choms//sngon gyi las dang 'phral rkyen gyis bsgyur ba'i//lus ngag yid gsum mnar ba'i nyer 'tshe kun//zhi zhing 'khor 'das legs tsho gos ma lus pa//bsamaXpa ji bzhin lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod//nam

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)mkha' gza' skar dus sbyor 'phrod kyis dge/ /sal bkra shis phun tsho gos g.yang du chags/ /phyogasadus kun tu bde legs char chen pos/ /phan bde'i snye ma smin pa'i bkra shis shog zhes dga' ba gdong gi gnas srung chen po shing bya can gyis/ /gsol mchod 'byer bde kun phan zhig rtsoms shig par bskul ma mdzad pa ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so/ /sgo gzhod rgyal po chen por mchod gtor 'bul tshul ni/ /rang dpal rta mgrin du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i raṃ las ye shes kyi mes gtor ma'i dngos 'dzin bsregs/ yaṃ lasarlung gis gtor/ kho las chus bkrus/ kai las mi mge'i snyed bu gsum gye steng du a las thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma sha khrag gi rgya mtsho chen po'i steng du oṃ āḥlha brtsegs pa las 'od zer 'phros 'khor 'das kyi bcud thams cad bsdus nas yi ge gsum la thim pa 'od du zhu ste bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'dod pa'i yon to lnga dang ldan par gyur/ /sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis byin gyisabarlabs/ /spyan drang ba ni/ lhaḥ rang nyid yi dam lhar gsal thugs ka nas/ /'od los gtsang chu'i chu klung la rgyu ba/ /ngam gzhod rgyal chen ku me 'phrin las pa/ /thogs pa med par gnas 'dir da tshur spyon/ /mdun du me rma zhabrug pa'i gur gyi nang / /mi ro rta ro kha sbub gan rkyal du/ /bsnol ba'i khri la 'khor tsho gis ma lus ga /dgyes pa chen pos mchod pa'i yul du bzhugs/ /srung ma khyod la mchod pa'i dam rdzas ni/ khrag gi a lha dbang po'i me rtag bkra/ sha chen spos dang mil chen mar me gsal/ /mkhris pa'i dri chab sha rus zhal zas spungs/ /rkang gling thod rnga rngam brjid rol mo'i sgra/ /rta g.yag ra lug bya khyi seng ge glang ta/gnam la 'phur dgu sal 'dzul dgu dang / /ri dwags 'phyo dgu sra ba'i go dang mtshon/ /rab byung mas gos sba lcag shel gyi 'phreng / /'khar gsil ral gri mdung rnon zhags pa dang / /'phan gdugs bla bre dar gyi lda ldi bres/ sha khrag gtor ma ri bo lta bur spungs/ /khrag chang btung ba rgya mtsho lta bur 'khyil/ /ri rab gling bzhi gling phran 'dod yon lnga/ /nyi zla rgyal srid bdun —386

dam mā cho srung mag rtogs tshon las rnam pha i grub/ (gesogs lha mi yi/ /dpal 'byor nam mkha'i khams (204bsko/na bkang nas 'bul/ /dge bsnyen chen po 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags hūṃ las skyes pa'i rdo rje rtse gcig pa dmar po 'od kyi sbu gu can gyis gtor ma'i bcud drangs te gsol bar gyur/ ga rna ma hā rā dza sarba sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro mu byu sogasagator sngags btags la lan gsum gyis phul/ sngags gsham du a sogs dang / ma hā pañtsa khā hi/ma hā rak+ta khā hi zhes brjod/ bstod pa ni/ lhaḥ dmar nag me rlung zhabrug pa'i dbus/ /dgra bgegasabam ro'i gdan steng na/ /zhi khro'i gar gyi rnam rol pa/ /ngam shod rgyal chen khyod la bstod/ /bla gosamathang sham rtsar mo sogs/ /ngur smig rab byung chas gos kyis/ /nyer klubs chu bo'i gzhung myul ba/ /rkarma 'phrin las khyod la bstod/ /res 'ga' gseg shang lhung bzed 'dzin/ /skabs 'gar ral gri zhags pa thogs/ /ngam gshod la sogs sa mtha' kun/ /thogs med myul ba khyod la bstod/ /dbu la dar khra'i thod bcings shing / /sba lcag shel gyi phreng ba 'dzin/ /bong bu byi la zhen nas rgyu/ /sna tshogs sprul pa ston la bstod/ khyod kyi btsun mo shugs sman ma/ khrog gcod blon bo bshan pa bzhi/ /bdud kyi dmag dpung dang bams pa/ /'khor dang bcas la bdag bstod do/ /skyon pad+ma thod phreng dang / /rje bas blo bzang grags pa sogs/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i dam tshig dang / /dbang r+ṣa rta mchog bka' bzhin sgrubs/ khyad par rig 'dzin bdag cag gis/ /bcol ba'i las 'di dang long la/ khe gsum rgyal dar grong pa yis/ /ma rig dbang gis 'gal rnams la/ /ru nga phrag dog ma mdzad par/ /brtseba'i sems kyis bzod par mdzod/ /mchod bstod gtor ma phul ba rnams/ /dga' ba'i sems kyisadang du long / /mdor na mi nor 'khor bcas kyi/ /'gal rkyen (1san thar chad zhi ba dang / /tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor sogs/ /yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel bar mdzod/ /ma 'byor ba dang zhesasogs kyis bzod par gsol/ badz+ra muḥs gshegs su gsol/ mjug tu bkra shis ci rigs pa bya'o/ /zhes sgo gshod rgyal chen dme 'phrin las la mchod gtor 'bul tshul rgyas pa zhig dgos zhes mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab kyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong —387

rgyal dbang pad+ma thod 'phreng gi /pho lha lha rabs sham po dang / /dgra lha rdzong btsan chen po yi/ /gsol mchod rim pa 'di ltar ro/ /de yang sham po la rgyas par bang rim nyis brtsegs kyi steng du mkhar thabs rgya phibs tog can/ mdun du mchod gtor bgos bu dkar po zur gsum g.yag dkar gyi mgos mtshan pa/ de'i phyi rol du 'khor brgyad mtheb skyus bskor ba/ bdud rtsi a skṛ ta/ g.ya' chu gangs chu'i mchod yon/ me rta go sna tshogs/ spos dkar/ bzang sman/ bsangs shing gi dud pa/ rtsi bcud dam 'bru mar gang 'byor gyi mar me/ sman gyi kha bsgyur ba'i dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo mar gyi g.yag dkar/ g.yin yang ci 'byor ba'i mchod pa bshams la/ yi dam rab phyag na rdo rje dregasa'adul/ de min bka' brgyad spyi bye brag gi yi dam gang rung gi nga rgyal dang ldan pa'i sgo nas mchod gtor rnams a khra tas bsangs/ oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo sogasaphyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa ngo bo bde ba/ rang bzhin stong pa/ rnam pa dbang po drug gi spyod (25ba)yul du bde ba khyad par can bskyed par nus pa'i mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/oṃ badz+ra a nas sha rdi'i bar brjod/ gtor ma bsangs sbyang / stong pa'i tswa las las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa'i steng du oṃ āḥlha gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas 'khor 'das kyi bcud thams cad bsdus te gtor ma la thim pas bdud rtsi rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥlha ma hā bha kla ta te dzo bha kla ta ba la bha ta gu ༅ sam ye swā hā/ sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis byin gyis brlabs/ rten bskyeng pa ni/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gangs dkar gyi ri bo ches mtho ba'i rtse mo mkha' la bsnyeg pa khor yug gi steng thams cad gangs ri'i 'phreng ba/ bar rnams g.ya' chu bsil ma/ smad kyi char spangs ljongs nags tshal me rtag rnam par bkra bas mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba'i ljongs chen po'i dbus su bye las byung ba'i shel dkar —388

dam mā chos srung mngon rtogs wen las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)gyi rtsig pa la rin po che sna tshogs kyi kha bad dang phra tshom gyis rab tu mdzes par byas pa'i pho brang brjid chags shing / khor yug sgo lcog lcags ri khang brtsegs kyi rnam par bskor ba'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma dgra bgegs pho mo gan rkyal kha sbub tu bsnol ba'i steng du tri dkar po yongs su gyur pa las/ srid pa'i lha rabs sham po sku mdog shel gyi ri bo la nyi ma shar ba ltar gsal zhing gdangs pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa khros pa'i rnam pa can zhal dngas shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa/ sma ra dang smin ma dmar ser 'bar ba/ dbu skra ral pa kham nag rgyab tu bsnyil ba'i gtsug na rdo rje ser po phyed pas mtshan pa/ phyag g.yas ral gri nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing g.yon pas mdung rnon dar dkar gyi ba (206na bon sham bu dmar po can 'phyar ba/ sku la dar dkar gyi tse gos za 'og sngon po'i mtha' can/ rin po che'i thod dang phyag zhabasakyi gdu bu snyan cha do shal sogs kyis spras pa/ zhabs la sag lham dmar po gsol ba/ 'brong g.yag dkar po'i rwa dang rmig pa be+eḍūr+ya'i mdog ltar 'tsher zhing kha rlangs na bun ltar 'thul ba la bcibs nas/ me rlung 'tshub ma'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i phyogs mtshams su dgyes bskyed gsang ba'i yum chen/ bka' nyan las byed blon po/ /pho nya mngag gzhug bran g.yog dpag tu med pa/ la la dkar po lha'i sde/ la la dmar po btsan gyi sde/ la la nag po bdud kyi sde sogs lha ma srin sdebargyad kyi tshogasazhi ba'i nyams rgyas pa'i gzi byin/ dbang gi bkrag mdangs/ drag po'i gtum rngams sogs las thams cad bsgrub pa la thogs pa med pa'i gtso 'khor thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par aḥ thugasadar hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ lha chen gyi dbu gtsug tu pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la o rgyan chen po pad+ma thod phreng rtsal zhi ma khro'i rnam pa can gsang gos snam sbyar/ zab ber sum brtsegs dbu la sha ba'i mnyen zhu rgod kyi ldem phru can nyi zlas brgyan pa gsol ba/ phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs ka dang g.yon mnyam gzhag gi steng na bdud rtsis gang ba'i ka pā la 'dzin pa'i gru mo na yum sbas pa'i tshul gyis kha two rtse gsum 'chang ba zhabs la hor lham gsol nas rgyal po rol pa'i 'dug stangs kyis —389

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)khams gsum dbang du sdud cing srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa'i bdag nyid du bzhugs par gyur/bdag lhar gsal ba dang slob dpon chen po'i thugs ka gnyis nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas yar stod sham po gangs kyi ra ba sogs gar bzhugs (206ba)kyi gnas nas srid pa'i lha rabs sham po yum sras blon po/ /bka' nyan dregs pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa skad cig gis badz+ra a du sha dzaḥkyeḥ nub byang mchod bstod dregs pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pas legasabacug nas/ /gsang bdag he ru ka dang dbyer med pa/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor lha chen gnas 'dir gshegs/ /sngon tshe gangs can bod kyi srid pa 'di/ /chags pa'i dus nas skyong ba'i lha chen po/ /g.yung drung bon gyis khyod bsten bsgrubs pa yi/ /lha chen sham po 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs/ /pad+mā ka ra'i mthu stobs rdzul gyis/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung bar dam bsgrags nas/ /mchod bstod dregs pa'i srung mar bka' bsgos pa/ /srid pa'i lha rabs sham po da tshur spyon/ /rje 'bangs nyer lnga so zur gnubs nyang dang / /chos dbang rgya ston pad+ma dbang phyug sogs/ /sngags 'chang rim par byon nas dam btags pa/ /zab mo gter gyi srung ma gnas 'dir gshegs/ /lha khyod mthun pa'i mchod gtor spyan gzigs bshams/ /dgyes dbyangs rol mo'i sgra dang g.yab dar gis/ /'bod na gnasa'adir thogs pa med spyon nas/ /pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ /ā+oṃ de wa a she lha sa pa ri wā ra dzaḥlha baṃ sngo sam ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ srid pas bskos pa gtsang ris lha chen la/ /g.ya' gangs dngasachu bsil ba'i mchod yon sbyang / /pad+ma ut+pal la sogs me tog gi /chun po dbu la 'ching ba'i thod du 'bul//tsas shug pa a ka ru la sogs//sman shing dud sprin shangs kyi dbang por 'thul/ /nyi zla nor bu'i 'od dang sgron me'i tshogs/ /lha mig dag pa'i spyan sngar rab tu sbar/ /ga pur gur gum ngad (207na)ldan dri yi chab/ /thugs ka la sogs sku yi cha la 'byug /ro brgya ldan pa lha mi'i bza' bca' rnams/ /phung po spungs pa ljags kyi dbang pos rol/ /bi wang sil snyan dung dang rnga chen sogs/ /snyan brjed rol mo thos 'dzin rgyan du spel/ /rin chen gdu bu do shal rna cha dang / /dar dkar gos bzang ral gri —390

dam can chos srung ma' rtog phren las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)rnon po'i mdung //'phrong g.yag gangs ri'i dum bu chad 'dra ba//lha wo mthun pa'i nyer spyad rdzas su 'bul//khrab rmog zhes btags lcags gzhibs go cha dang //mda' mdung ral gri dgra sta 'phrul skyogs sogs//sna tsho gis mchod pa'i khyad par ji snyed pa//rang bsrung pha rol 'joms pa'i rten du 'bul//be+eḍūr dbang sngon pad rā ga mar gad spug/gser dngul zangs lcags byu ru muk+ki ka/spur len shel sogs lha klu mi'i nor bu//phun tshogs 'byor pa spel ba'i rten du 'bul//kha dog sna tsho gos bkra ba'i za 'og gi/'phan gdugs bla bre rgyal mtshan ba dan dang //sna tshogs dar gyi lda ldi spel ba sogs//rin cen khang bzang mdzes pa'i rgyan du 'bul//rta drel mdzo g.yag ra lug khyim bya khyi//glang seng dom dred stag gzig 'phar pa gung //bya rgod gong mo khra 'ol khrung khrung sogs//gnam sar 'phur 'dzul srog chags thams cad 'bul/sha ba dgo ba gla ba gna' ba gnyan//ri dwagasa'aphyo dgur gtogs so cog rnams dang //ri rab gling bzhi rgyal srid sna bdun sogs//mtho risa'abyor pa'i yon to thams cad 'bul//myong grol bdud rtsi sman gyi mar pa dang //dam rdzas gtor ma 'dod yon lnga ldan pa'i//longs spyod tsho gos kyi 'khor lo'i mchod pa 'bul//lha chen 'khor bcas thugs dam bskong gyur 207bcug/bdag sogs rnams kyis ma rig zhabrul ba yi//'khor bcas sku gsung thugs dang 'gal gyur pa'i//nyes tshogos mtha' dag snying nas bshags byed na//bzang por bzhes la tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol//lha chen 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags/ las skyesapa'i rdo rje rtse gcig pa dmar po 'od kyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud drangs te gsol bar bsams la/oṃ badz+ra sa du tri ma hā de wa sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro mu kha sogs kyis phul/sngags gsham du a: nasasha rdi'i bar brjod cing nang mchod 'bul/lhaḥdagung sngon dbyings su bsnyegs pa'i gangs ri'i 'dabs//rin cen rngam brjid mdzes pa'i pho brang dbus//khro chags zhi rgyas rnam par 'phrul po che//cir yang ston pa'i lha chen khyod la bstod//pad nyi 'byong g.yag dkar po 'phyo ba'i steng //khro gtum brngam brjid ral gri mdung rnon thogs//dar daXr gos dang rin cen rgyan spras pa//srid pa chags

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)pa'i lha rabs sham por bstod/ /zag med bde ba skyed byed gsang ba'i yum/ /rigs kyi lha sras las byed blon po dang / /rnga thogs steng dang lha srin kiṅka ra/ /bka' nyan dregs pa'i dmag gi tsho gos la bstod/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi/ /phyag rtags rdo rje rtse lnga gtsug tu bkod/ /rtsabargyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi lce la blud/ /sgrub chen bka' brgyad dkyil 'khor gral du bkod/ bod yul bstan 'gro'i bde skyid spel ba sa /bka' bzhin bsgrub pa dregs pa'i tshul bzung yang / /don du 'jig rten las 'das gsang bdag gi /ye shes rang gdangs 'khor gyi rnam par shar/ /tshul desamatsho skyes rdo rje'i rjes zhugs pa'i/ /sngags 'chang rnams kyis dregs pa'i sde dpon srog /rim bzhin chad med gtad cing thob rnams kyi/ /dam las 'das na mgo bo tshal bar 'gas/ /de phyir ru (208na)bzhi'i rgyal khab chen po 'dir/ /nad mtshon mu ge 'thab rtsod nyer zhi zhing / /ring po'i tshe dang 'dzad med longs spyod sogs/ /bde skyid dga' ston tsho gos la sbyor bar mdzod/ /spyi dang bye brag rgyal ba'i lung rtogs bstan/ /'dzin pa'i mdo sngags sde rnams dar zhing rgyas/ /sa skyong rgyal po'i sku tshe mnga' thang dang / /mtshan jus chab srid phyogs bcur rgyas par mdzod/ khe gsum bkra shis rab brtan mi nor gyi/ /nad gdon bar chad nyer 'tshe zhi ba dang / /tshe dpal 'byor pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa/ /bla nas blar yang 'phel ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /bla ma yi dam sgrub sdebargyad kyi lha/ /dregs pa'i sdedapon dam can srung ma'i tshogs/ khyad par lha chen sham po 'khor bcas kyis/ /dus rnams kun tu dge ba'i bkra shis shog /yi ge brgya pas chad lhag kha bskang / ma wor ba sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gso le/ khyod kyis sems can so gos kyis rang gnas su gshegs/ /bltas pa tsam gyi srid gsum dbang du sdud/ zhes sogs kyi shis brjod bya'o/ /rdzong bawo pa 'i gsol mchod ni/ btsan bgosadamar po 'khor grangs ci rigs pa'i mthar mtheb skyus bskor ba/ sman rag /phyi nang gi nyer spyod/sbyan gzigs sogs ci 'byor ba bshams/ bdag bskyed gong dang 'dra/ mchod pa rnams a mṛ tasabasangs/ a las byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du rang rang gi ming yig dang po zhu ba —392

dam can chos srung mngon rtogs 'phrin la rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)las byung ba'i phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod rdzas rnams dngas shing thogs pa med pa btsan rgod 'khor dang bcas pa mnyes shing tshim par nus pa mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ oṃ a nas sha rdi'i bar brjod/ gtor ma dang rak+ta la dmigs nas bsangs sbyangs a las thod pa'i sdod/(204rdzangs shing rgya che ba gnyis kyi nang du sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin rnam pa dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag rus rkang lha ba tshil bu phung por spungs pa ro mchog brgya phrag ldan pa dang / — lcang lo can gyi nang du rak+ta'i rgya mtsho'i rba klong phyogs bcur 'phro bar gyur/ oṃ bha lo sogs dang / ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal hūṃ khriḥ sngags drug dang phyag rgya drug gis byin gyis brlabs/ su bha was sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun du bam ro sha khrag rus pa gcal du bkram pa'i dur khrod chen po 'jigs su rung ba khor yug zangs ri dmar po gnam du bsnyeg pa 'dra bas bskor ba/ de'i dbus su bse dang zangs lcags las grub pa'i btsan mkhar dmar po thod pa skam rlon snying pa'i kha bad can mi'i rgyu ma dang / rus pa'i 'phreng ba'i dra ba la dbang po lnga dang yan lag gi dra phyed 'phyang ba/ zhing lhags kyi rgyal mtshan la tsit+ta'i tog gis spras pa/ gsur chen gyi dud pa 'thul zhing / khrag gi zham chu 'bab pa/ 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' ba'i pho brang gi dbus su pad+ma nyi ma'i steng du gnod sbyin chen po kong ma grib btsan rdo rje mchog rgod rtsal sku mdog pad+ma rā ga'i lhun po la nyi ma shar ba ltar dmar ba/ ya sos ma mchu mnan pa'i am tshigs bsdams shing dmar zlum spyan gsum glog ltar 'khyug pa/ sma ra dang smin ma me ltar 'bar ba/ sku la bse khrab dang dbu la bse rmog dmar po zhol can rgyal mtshan bkra shis dgu brtsegs ru dar dung ru gling sing rmog gcus sogs rgyan rnams kyis spras shing / sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun dang ldan pa/ sku rgyab tu rgyal mtshan lcog dar 'ja' ltar bkra ba/ phyag g.yas zangs mdung dmar po dar gyi cod pan can dang / g.yon pa na tsit+ta dmar po rin cen 'phrul gyi lde mig dang bcas pa 'dzin pa/ zhabs la (209na tshes ga lham dmar po gsol ba/ rta mchog dmar po sga srab gong rmed spu len ze long gi khebs sogs rgyan rnams kyis spras pa la bcibs pa/ 'khor du —393

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)rang 'dra'i klu btsan drug/btsan 'khor sum brgya drug cu/sdom dang sdig pa bya khra la sogs 'jigasasu rung ba'i sprul pa sna tsho gos kyis bskor ba'i gtso 'khor thams cad kyi dpul bar oṃ/mgrin par āḥthugs kar hūṃ gis mtshan pa/thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer los pas rgya yul zangs thang dmar po/yar klungs shel gyi brag phug/'phyos kyi lha lung btsan mkhar/skyid gshod grib kyi rdzong ri/kong po bu chu lha khang /spu ri phug mo che/rtse wo brag la sogs pa'i gnas rnams nas btsan rgod 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥbasto/dpal chen che mchog he ru gaḥ//rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal po dang //gsang bdag dregs pa kun 'dul gyi//spyan sngar bstan 'gro legs skyong bar//dam tshig gnyen po gnyer gtad cing //khas blangs dam bca' ma g.yel ba//dgra lha rdzong btsan 'khor bcas rnams//gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol//rigs 'dzin pad+ma sam bha was//bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho dang //bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa yi//zab gter gnyer du gto pa bzhin//bsrung zhing lasa'aphro skal ldan la//rang nor lag tu sprad mdzad pa//grib btsan rdo rje mchog rgod rtsal//gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol//oṃ badz+ra ging ka ra shu la rā tsa sa pa ri wā ra dzaḥ/ baṃ sngos ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/mchod pa ni/dngas bsil mchod yon rak+ta'i a sbreng /sna tsho gos chu skyes dbang po lnga'i me tog/sman dang shing sna sha r+ṣa dud sprin 'thul//rtsi bca 'bru mar sha tshil mar me sbar//ga pur gur 209ba mi ma mkhris pa'i dri yi byug/ro brgya'i zas dang sha rus zhal zas spungs//thod rnga rkang gling snyan pa'i rol mo yis//rdzong btsan 'khor bcas thugs dam skongs gyur cig/sga srab gong rmed dar gyi cod pan gyis//rab spras rlung gi shugs 'chang rta mchog che//bse yi khrab rmog gru bzhi lcog dar dang //ru mtshon rnon po dar lce mkha' la 'phyo//tsit+ta rin chen 'phrul gyi lde mig 'dzin//gnam la 'phur dgu sal 'dzul dgu dang //ri dwags lo dgu sgo phyugs tshogos rnams kyis/rdzong btsan/྾/khrab rmog zhol btags lcags gzhib pir phug go shang lang skru gri dgra sta mda' mdung mtshon//'phan gdugs bla bre rgyal mtshan lda ldi g.yo//sma/ zhe gtor gsum tsho gis kyi 'khor lo dang //ri

dam ༅ chos srung ma' rtogs tshon las rnam pha lhun grub/ 9)rab gling bzhi nyi zla rgyal srid bdun//rin wo ril bu dpag bsam ljon pa'i shing //'dod 'jo'i ba dang ma smos lo tog gis//rdzong btsan 'khor bcas thugs dam skongs gyur cig/btsan rgod 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags hūṃ las skyes pa'i rdo rje rtse gcig pa dmar po 'od kyi sbu gu can gyisagator ma'i bcud drangs te gsol bar gyur/gong gi sngags gsham du a kā ro mu — btags la gtor ma phul/nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchode cing sman raka kyang 'bul/bstod pa ni/lhaḥpad+ma ra gā'i lhun po la//nyin byed 'bum gyis byug pa'i gzi//rab 'bar gtum drag rngams pa'i gzugs/ston mdzad bsto rgod chen por bstod//pad+ma nyi zla dgra bgegs steng //rdzu hrūl shugasaldan rta dmar la//zhen nas stong gsum skad cig gis//rab bskor srog bdag chen por bstod//bse yi khrab glog 'od stong 'tsher//tsit+ta rin wo lde mig 'chang //rnal 'byor drod myul srung zhig skyong //gter 210thad ga chen po khyod la bstod//rang 'dra'i las byed sprul pa drug/sum brgya drug cu'i btsan rgod 'khor//sdig sbrul khra sogs chol gyi//sprul pa sna tsho gos ston la bstod//rgyal dbang pad+mā snar dang //yab rje skyon gling pa'i zhabs//gar gyi dbang phyug nas bzung ste//zur wo rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar//rigs 'dzin rim par byon rnams kyi//bka' dang dam la btags pa yi//dam tshig gnyen po'i rgya ma ral//sngags 'chang bdag gi ngag mi gcog/gangs can skye rgu'i bde skyid kyi//'byung gnas spyi dang bye brag gi/bstan pa rin cen 'phel zhing rgyas//de 'dzin skyes bu'i tshogasarnams brtan//ma rdzo gnas sdoganyis bshad sgrub 'phel//bod skyong sa dbang rgyal po yi//sku tshe mnga' thang chab srid rnams//phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//khe gsum bkra shis rab brtan pa'i//mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa la//nad gdon bar chad mi 'byung zhing //bde skyid phun tsho gis spel bar mdzod//mdor na bdag cag dpon slob la//gnod pa'i dgra bgegs rdul du rlog/chos dang srid kyi 'dod pa'i don//bsams pa ji bzhin lhun gyis sgrubs//mjug tu nongs pa bzod par gsol//mgron rnams rang gnas su gshegaXnas smon lam dang bkra shis ci rigs par bya'o//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)zhes lha chen yar lha sham po dang shel brag rdzong btsan gnyis la gsol mchod 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o//'dir sger gsol nyer mkho'i rigs 'ga' zhig 210bags gcig tu bkod pa la/rang dpal rta mgrin du gsal ba'i thugs ga'i hūṃ las re yaṃ khaṃ gsum rim pa bzhin du los pas phyi nang gi mchod gtor gyi ma dag pa'i dri ma thams cad mes bsregs/rlung gis gtore/chus bkrus/oṃlas byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig lesabargyan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod rdzas rnams mig gi yul du gzugs mdzes pa/rna ba'i yul du sgra snyan pa/sna'i yul du dri zhim pa/lce'i yul du ro mngar ba/lus kyi yul du reg bya 'jam pa sogasa'adod pa'i yon to bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/gtor ma rin po che'i snod du lha mi'i bza' bca' btung ba gya nom pa'i steng du/oṃ āḥlha las 'od 'phros pas 'khor 'das kyi bcud thams cad bsdusayi ge gsum la thim pa zhu ba las bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho zad mi shes par gyur/oṃ āḥlha lan gsum dang /nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs te/rang gi thugs ka nas 'phrosapa'i 'od zer gyis mgron rnams bkug par bsams la/kye/bos so ma cu stobs rdzu 'phrul mnga' ba'i lha//dpal 'byor rgyal po 'khor dang bams pa rnams//dbyar gyi char sprin lta bur lang long du//thogs pa med par gnas 'dir tshur spyon zhig/mdun du rin cen las grub pho brang dbus//bra nag rting dkar sga srab gong rmed steng //rab dkar mdzes byed yid 'ong nga nu'i gzugs//za 'og sngon po'i tsi gos la thod gyon//g.yas pa sba lcag 'phyar zhing g.yon pa yis//zhabs khra lcags kyu a lung dgra la 'debs//phyogs mtshams kun tu rang 'dra'i sprul pa sogs//bga' nyan 'khor 211natshogs kyis bskor brtan par bzhugs//'gi ra kha yi btsan rgod mthu rtsal can//khrab rmog gyon zhing gri mdung zhags pa thogs//stag ral g.yas la gaXg shugs g.yon du 'chang //rta mchog la zhen rang

dam can chos srung mngon rtogs tshwan la rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)'dra'i sprul 'khor bcas/ /bdag gis gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis 'bod byed na/ /ma thogs rings pa'i tshul gyi me tshur spyon la/ /ting nge 'dzin gyis sprul pa'i gnas mchogo 'dir/ /dgyes pa'i gdan la brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /g.yin yang sa phyogs gnas gzhi 'di dag kun/ /skyong ba'i yul lha gzhi bdag thams cad dang / /bye brag khe gsum phyogs rgyu'i btsan rgod che/ /mchod gtor len phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /pho lha yul lha skyes lha dgra lha sogs/ /so sor dgyes pa'i mthun rdzas 'bul ba ni/ /rin cen phye mas brgyan pa'i chang phud dang / /dmar ser rgya ja g.ya' gangs gtsang ma'i skyems/ /thang dang chu las skyes pa'i me tog gi /myu gu gsar pa kha phye spel legs 'phreng / /ba lu su lus dar tsan+dan spos/ /nyi zla nor bu'i 'od dang rtsi bcud kyi/ /snang gsal sgron mes phyogs kyi mun pa sel/ /sman mchog bzang dgu legs sbyar byug pa'i rdzas/ /dkar gsum mngar gsum shing rta ge 'bru sna dang / sha tshil nang khrol g.yos su sbyar ba'i bgos/ /dung chen sgra snyan ga rnga rol mo'i tshogs/ /kashi ka yi la thod za 'og gos/ /sba lcag zhags pa sga srab gong rmed kyis/ /rab spras bra nag rta mchog rting dkar can/ /sra mkhregs go dang sna tshogs rno ba'i mtshon/ /'brong g.yag (211bsgo mdzo ra lug khyim bya khyi/ /seng ge glang chen stag gzig dom dred gung / kha rkyang gna' ba gla ba bse ru bcod/ /thang dkar go bo glag mo bya rog khra/ /srid 'dir rgyug go cog gi srog chags dang / /mu tig byu ru g.yu shel sbur len gser/ /dngul dkar zangs lcags gos dar snam ras ja/ /lho rdzas byang rdzas nyi zla rgyal srid bdun/ /gling bzhi gling phran lha mi'i longs spyod tshogs/ khyad par dkar dmar bha lo rgyan ldan dang / /ja chang rak+ta btung ba a mṛ ta/ /rin cen rkam cha btab pa'i gser skyems sogs/ /dbang po sgo lnga dgyes bskyed mthun rdzas 'bul/ /nyams chags 'gal 'byul nongs pa thams cad bshags/ /thugs dam bskong la mthun rkyen ma lus sgrubs/ /pho lha dpal 'byor rgyal po/ /'gi ra kha'i btsan rgod/ yul phyogs sa phyogs 'di dag bsrung ba'i yul lha gzhi bdag rgyun du gnas pa dang glo bur du lhags pa'i mgron rnams kyi ljags hūṃ las skyes pa'i 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud thams —397

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)cad gso6lha bar bsams la/ lta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa/ ༷ sa/ bhū ta/ pre ta/ pi shā tsa/ rna da/ a ) ra/ ḍā /shā ki rgyu da ya/ i me bha kla sgyu sna rtsa sam ya rak+ṣa skyo/ ma ma sarba — / me pra ya tsān+ta/ya ze baṃ/ ya the sna/ snurdzi tha/ pi ba tha/ dzi gh+ra tha/ mā ti kra ma tha ma ma sarba ga rlo/ sa tā kha bi shu d+dha yi/ sa ha yi ka bha / hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/tshar gsum dang / a kā ro sogs lan gsum gyis bsngo/ /a sogs kyis mchode/ riḥlha gis nang mchod phul/ bra nag rting dkar sga srab rgyan spras steng / /skyes bu mdog dkar la thod tse bar sde/ /sba lcag (212na tshogs 'dzin dpal 'byor rgyal po zhes/ /dgra lha chen po khyod la bdag bstod do/ /bse khrab bse rmog chas spras dar mdung zhags/ /sna tshogs mtshon 'dzin rta dmar rgyan ldan zhen/ /'gi ra kha yi btsan rgod dam can che/ /rdo rje legs pa'i pho nya khyod la bstod/ /gzhan yang yul phyogs sa phyogs gnas gzhis sogs/ /so sor gnas shing skyong bar byed pa yi/ /lha klu gnod sbyin bdud btsan sa bdag gnyan/ /gshin rje dmu rgyal dregs pa'i tsho gis la bstod/ /pad+ma thod phreng rta mgrin dbang rgyal gyi/ /mthu stobs rdo rje wor bsal mnan zhing / /sngags44 bdag gi dam tshig bsgrags pa bzhin/ /gangs can bod kyi bde skyid 'phel zhing rgyas/ khyad par khe gsum bkra shis rab brtan pa'i/ /mi nor rnams la phrag dog gnod 'tshe spongs/ /nad gdon nyer 'tshe zhi zhing mthun rkyen rnams/ /'bad med lhun gyis grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /sangs rgyas bstan srungs dkon cog dbu 'phang bstod/ /ces sogs kyi 'dod gsol dang / nongs pa bzod gsol/ oṃ badz+ra muḥs mgron rnams rang gnas su gshegs/ /bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad ci rigs bya'o/ /zhes spyi bye brag gi gsol mchod phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa 'di yang mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab kyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so/ /pad+mā ka rā ya/ 'dir gser mdongs dkar po dang thang rtse btsan po gnyis la mchod gtor 'bul bar 'dod pas/ rang dbang chen rta mchog dmar po zhal gcig (212btsig gnyis pa dbu —398

dam mā chos srung ma' rtogs tshon las rnam pha lhun grub/ 9)tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du slebs pa zhabs rgya mtsho'i gting du bgrod pa/ g.yas pas gzugs khamasa'adegs shing g.yon pas 'dod khams gnon pa dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan pa ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros mchod gtor rnams kyi ma dag pa raṃ las mes bsregs/ yaṃ las rlung gis gtor/ khaṃ las chus bkrus ma las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du mchod pa'i spyan gzigs rnams rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod rdzas 'dod pa'i yon to lnga dang ldan pa/ gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tsho gos pa'i steng du oṃ āḥlha gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros pas 'khor 'das kyi bcud thams cad bsdus yi ge gsum la thim pas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥlha gis byin gyis brlabs/kye/ lha chen tshangs pa'i rigs brgyud sras/ /gser mdongs dkar po gshegs su gsol/ /thang rtse btsan po gshegs su gsol/ /sku la dar dkar na bza' gsol/ /dbu la za 'og thod bcingasamadzes/ /rin chen rgyan cha khrol lo lo/ /ru mtshon zhags pa nor gshod dang / /mda' dar phyag mtshan bur ru sa /zhabs la sag lham khra 'bur btab/ /rta dkar sga srab gong rmed can/ /bcibs nas rang 'dra'i 'khor tshogs bcas/ /thogs pa med par gnas 'dir spyon/ /nyi zla pad+ma dar zab sogs/ /yid 'ong mdzes pa'i gdan la bzhugs/ /lha chen 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /bkur sti sri zhu 'bul ba ni/ /rin cen snod du g.ya' gangs chu/ /rnyog bral dngas pa'i mchod yon (213nasgo bul/ /rol zhig arnya pā dza hūṃ/ /ri thang chu las skyes pa yi/ /me tog sna tshogs thod chings su/ /'bul lo badz+ra thi hūṃ/ /shing sna dud sprin sna ba'i yul/ /'thul lo badz+ra dhū pe hūṃ/ /gsal byed mar me spyan snga sa /sbar ro badz+ra di pa hūṃ/ /dri zhim chab kyis thugs ka sa /'byug go badz+ra — hūṃ/ /ro brgya'i zas mchoge ljags kyi yul/ /dbul lo badz+ra ni we te hūṃ/ /sna tshogs rol mo sgra 'dzin du/ /'khrol lo badz+ra sha rdi hūṃ/ /lhaḥza 'og tsa ber hor lham rin cen rgyan/ /nor gzheng sman gyi par bu ru mtshon gri/ /stag ral gzig shubs go mtshon lda ldi 'phan/ /rgyal mtshan bla bre smyug rgod dar tshon bkra/ /bdud rtsi sman phud gser —399

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)skye mas tshogos 'khor dang //dam rdzas gtor ma 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga//rdzu 'phrul rta mchog sga srab gong rmed spras//sgo phyugs mkha' la 'phur ba bya yi rigs//g.ya' gangs spang ljongs 'grim pa ri dwags tshogos//mche sder rno ngar ldan pa gcan gzan dang //mdor na lha mi'i dpal 'byor longasaspyod tshogs//dngos bshams yid kyis sprul nas 'bul byed na//lha mchog 'khor dang bcas pa ma lus pa//dgyes pa chen po'i sgo nas bzhes su gsol//lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags rdo rje'i 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtore ma'i bcud drangs te gsol bar gyur/a kā ro mu khaṃ lan bdun nam gsum gyis gtore ma 'bul/nyer spyod rol mo'i bar dang /bdud rtsi phul/mtho ris yul sar dbang sgyur tshangs pa che//lha rigs gar+sā rgod ོ po dri za'i 213bab//rigs brgyud 'dzin pa gser mdongs dkar po dang //thang rtse bas po 'khor dang bcas la bstod//dngos bshams yid sprul mchod gtor phul ba'i mthus//bdag sogs mi nor 'khor dang bcas rnams kyi//'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang //mthun rkyen dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol//mkha' la gza' skar 'phrod sbyor phun sum tshogs//sa la khri gdugs nyi ma 'od du dro//gtsang ris lha gnyan dri za'i tsho gos rnams kyis//bkra shis dpal gyi dga' ston rgyas par shog/ces gser mdongs dkar po dang thang rtse bas po gnyis kyi gsol mgo 'di ni mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o//rang lhar gsal bas mchode gtor rnams byin gyis brlabs la/kye/dkor mdzod gling sogasagar bzhugs gnas rnams nas//bkras rab bsod lhun rgyal po chen po khyod//mchod gtor spyan gzigs mthun pa'i dam rdzas bshams//rol mo dbyangs kyis 'bod na da tshur spyon//dar 'bol stag gzig pags pa'i stan la sogs//rang rang dgyes pa'i gdan la brtan par bzhugs//chang rgod phud dang rak+ta'i — sbreng /kha khrag dmar chen gtor ma phyur bur spungs//sna tshogs dri zhim shing sna'i dud pa 'thul//snang gsal sgron me // 0pa'i rol mo 'khrol//rta mchog gong rmed sgra srab

dam ༅ chos srung ma' rtogs mun las rnam tso lhun grub/ 9)brgyan gyis spras//stag dong khra mo thog chen mda' yis khengs//gzig shubs sra ba'i mchog dkar gzhu mo bcug/rno ba'i ral gri 214na〉dung rnon /yar ngo'i zla ba lta bur 'phel bar mdzod/ /stobs kyi 'khor lo yangasapa'i sa chen por/ /dbang sgyur dga' ba'i dpal ldan pho brang che'i/ /mi bdag rigs brgyud sku tshe mnga' thang dang / /chab srid rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)bskyed mchod gtor brlab pa dang 'bul ba sogs gsol mchod spyi dang 'dra bas kha 'phangs te za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so//gshin rje gshed yum rdo rje dbyings phyug ma//thun mong 'gro ngor dbyangs can ngag gi lha//gdug pa 'dul phyir dmag zor rgyal mo'i skur//legs bstan 'dod khams dbang phyug ma la bstod//chos dbyings bde ba chen por nyer zhi yang //gdug pa 'dul la sna tsho gis gzugs kyi sku//gtum chen srin mo khros 'dra'i sgyu phrul gar//ston mdzad dpal ldan re ma ti la bstod//bskal bzang rnam 'dren gsum pa 'od srungs kyi//bstan pa'i mjug tu shākya seng ge yi//ring lugs skyong bar smon lam lhan cig tu//legs btabs srid gsum bdag mo khyod la bstod//nges pa'i don du rgyal ba kun gyi yum//kun rdzob 'jig rten rang rgyud par bstan tshe//rdo rje 'am ri dang rta mchog phyag rdor gyis//dbang bskur dam bsgrags bstan pa'i srung mar bskos//paṇa chen lu ba dmar bo nas bzung ste//rtsa ba rgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad kyis//bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde spel 219nang yi//byed por mnga' gsol dam tshig gnyer du gto//deng 'dir dga' ldan bstan 'dzin bo shog thu//rigs dang brgyud par bcas rnams gnyer gtad pas//nyin mtshan kun tu mel tshe legs mdzad nas//gnod byed dgra bgegs bar chad kun las skyobs//tshe dang bsod nams dpal ra mnga' thang dang //chos dang srid kyi yon tan ma lus pa//yar ro'i zla ba lta bur yongs spel nas//don gnyisalhun gyis grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//dga' ldan bstan 'dzin bo shog thu rgyal por srung ma gang 'go'i brtag pa dang gang babs la 'phrin bcol gnyer gtad dgos tshul byung ba ltar da lta bsten pa'i srung ma rnams 'brel mi chags pa mi 'dug rung dpal ldan dmag zor ma gtso che bar shar ba bzhin za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa'o//na ma ār+ya lo ke shwa rā ya/gdengs can tsho gis kyi lha gcig bad dkar 'chang //zhabs zung gtsug tu bsten nas gangs ljongs kyi//klu rgyaXl gro gzi chen dgyes bskyed pa'i//mchod sprin

dam can cho srung ma' rtogs tshon las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)phan bde'i 'byung gnas deng 'dir spel/ /klu rgyal mal gro gzi chen la mchod gsol bya bar 'dod pas/ mchod gtor/ klu sman/ 'o 'chol sogs phaṭa kyis rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du klu rnams dga' bar byed pa'i bdud rtsi/ rgya mtshos gang bar bsam/ rdo rje bsdams pa'i phyag rgya 'debs pa'i tshul dang /oṃ a kā ro mu zhe sarba dharmā ḍā (219ba'i bya na shā nā tā ta oṃ aḥlha phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyisagator ma las klu rnams ji ltar 'dod pa'i yo byad thams cad thogs pa med par 'byung bar bsamasal/ 'dod rgyal gyi phyag rgya dang bcas rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer los pas/ klu'i rgyal po mal gro gzi chen la bod yul na gnas pa'i klu gnyan sa bdag thams cad kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mādzaḥsaspyan drangs par mos la/ oṃ ba ta li ba ta li ma hā ba ta li hūṃ hūṃ dzaḥdzaḥswā hā/ lan gsum dang / kye/dbus gtsang ru bzhi'i yul khams su/ /dbang bsgyur klu rgyal gzi chen la/ /klu gnyan sa bdag grangs med kyis/ /bskor ba gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ ā la ā gats+tsha ma hā nā ga dhi pa ta ye sarba bhu waḥ/ / swā hā/ zhes pas mdun du byon par bsam/ pad+ma snam lā ya / gyis gdan dbul/ oṃ ma hā nā ga a ti pa ta ye gra sne da na a swā hā/ de bzhin du a: gyi gnas su phre dhū paṃ/di paṃ/ ga bcug pas mchode/ klu dga' bar byed pa'i phyag rgya dang / cha hi li hi li ma hā hi li / sbyo swā hā/ che lta / se gol gtog pa dang bcas/ lan gsum dang / 6bhak+ṣa ya bhak+ṣa ya sam ya tiṣ+ṭha / sbyo swā hā/ zhes pa lan gsum gyis gtor ma bsngo/ klu rnams la bde ba byin pa'i gzungs ni/ ta bya thā/ ṅgā ra ṇi dha ra ṇi ādz+nyā ra ṇi/ 6bra tiṣ+ṭha te bi dza ya brja/ sa tu pra ti dz+nyā sar hā/ dz+nyā na pa ti/ ut+pa da ni bi nā ma ni/ a bhi ṇiñtsa ni/ a bhi bya hā ra/ shu sgyi bi hi/ adzi ma sa ye hi kum bā na/ mā ha ha ra kle shā na/ dhu na pā pa ma/ sho dha ya/ mā rga na/ bi rā hi ka dharma hā shu/ lo /bi ti ma ti rā dza sa du kha/ sha ma ṇa sarba bzhe a pa lo ke na a — te bra dz+nyā dz+nyā na bhe su hā/ lan gsum 'don/ kye/ dri (220na〉lta sman gyis—409—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)sbags pa'i mchod yon 'di//klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du 'bul//pad+ma ut+pal chu dang thang skyes pa'i//me rta ge sna tshogs sku yi rgyan du 'bul//dri zhim shing dang sman sna dkar gsum gyi//gsur dud bdug spos shangs kyi dbang por 'bul//nyi zla nor bu rtsi gan mar dkar gyi//snang gsal sgron me spyan gyi yul du 'bul//bzang drug tsas dkar dmar ga pur gyi//dri ldan sku la byug pa'i rdzas su 'bul//lha mi'i bza' bca' btung ba'i bye brag tshogs//ro brgya ldan pa'i zlas mchogo zhal du 'bul//sil snyan gling bu ting ting shags la sogs//rol mo'i sgra dbyangs snyan gyi dbang por 'bul//kha dog sna tshogs bkra ba'i me tog 'dzum//dpag bsam ljon pa tsan+dan byug pa dang //'bras bu can dang ri klungs shing nags 'phreng //mtsho rdzing klung chen klung phran lu ma dang //spang ljongs skyed tshal rin cen khang bzang brag/yid bzhin nor bu dbang sngon be+eḍūr+ya//bad rā ka ma rgad pug dang ke kos/man shel pha lam gser dngul muk+ta rkaḥ//byu ru sbur len sna tsho gis rin po che//za 'og bla bre 'phan gdugs rgyal mtshan gos//dar tshon 'bru sna dkar gsum ja yi rigs//ga pur dzā ti kur gum tsan+dan gnyis//dbang lag nā gi da chung dkar dmar dung //rgya dar zi shun zho sha rnam gsum gzi//rab dmar sbu shel rtse dang rma bya'i mdongs//sprul shun thang lo smyugs lo 'dam bu dar//spos dkar dngar gsum dri zhim me tog tshogs/mang tog rin cen rgya mtsho lha ba dang //sle tres li shi sug smel ge sar gsum//dkar nag za ra āt+pal a bar skyar//spang spos dkar nag til dang rdo rje gnyis//so ma ra tsa 220ba na 'brum shing dngar dang //ka med daṇ+ḍa ka ri ka ko la//ru rta go yu a 'brasasra 'bras dang //ar nag ka ra bu ram sbrang rtsi mngar//ba dmar ra dkar 'o mar sbyar ba'i sman//rgyal srid bdun dang bkra shis rtags brgyad rdzas//rin cen ri bo ma rmos lo tog tshogs//'dod 'jo'i ba mdzo sdom sdig sbal sprul nya//lcong mo la sogs dkor nor yin no cog/klu rgyal 'khor tshogasamanyes pa'i mchod par 'bul//dgyes pa chen por rol zhing tshim pa yis//sku gsung thugs la zug rngu'i nad dang sgrib//nyes pa'i tshogs kun byang ༷༷ dag gyur cig/bcom ldan shākya thub pas klu yi

dam ༅ chos srung ma' rtogs lon las rnam pha lhun grub/ 9)tshogs/ /rjes bzung chos bstan thar pa'i sa bon bzhag /klu sgrub snying pos klu yi yul byon nas/ /phan bde la sbyar 'dod pa'i re ba bskang / /skyon mkhan po pad+ma saṃ bhā was/ /snang srid lha srin mtha' dag dam la btags/ /khyad par bsam yas gtsug lag bzhengs pa'i dus/ /mal gro'i mtsho 'gram dong sprug cho ga mdzad/ /mi yi btsad po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi/ /grogs su klu yi rgyal po khyod bkug nas/ /phan 'dogs gnod pa spong bar bka' bsgos pa/ /dam tshig gnyan po ma g.yel nye bar dgongs/ /gzhan yang gshen rab mi bo'i rjes gong bon/ /gsang chen rnying ma'i sngags 'chang du ma yis/ /mthun pa'i rdzas bsags gta' bsdams klu rten btsugs/ /nyes sel mthun rkyen bsgrub par ma chad dam/ /deng 'dir bdag gis mthun pa'i yo byad bsags/ /sngags rdzas phyag rgya ting 'dzin ma nor bar/ /klu rgyal 'khor dang tsos pa mchod byas pa'i/ /yid la brnag pa'i 'dod don zhu ba ni/ /snyigs dus mi rnams rtsing spyod ches dar bas/ /sa gnyen brkos shing rdo g.ya gshags pa dang / /shing (221na gnyen bcad cing mtsho gnyan dkrug pa yis/ /klu gnyan sa bdag rnams la 'phog thug gi/ /nyes par gyur rnams bshags so tshangs par mdzod/ /'jig rten spyi dang khyad par bod yul 'dir/ /klad gzer gag lhog gzer thung bshal rams dang / /nywa log 'khru skyug be ge 'byum pa'i rigs/ /'on long zha rengs dmu chu rdel nad sogs/ /sna tsho gos nad dang btsa' than sad ser 'bus/ /lo nyes bkres phongs chu rgod brdol ba dang / /ma rung sa g.yos 'thab rtsod g.yul bshams sogs/ /mi mthun nyes pa'i tshogs kun zhi bar mdzod/ /bdag sogs rgyu sbyor mi nor 'khor bcas la/ /ban bun gdug bas skam gsher gtad khram rigs/ /gang byas dang du mi len rul pa dang / /rbod gtong kho rang rnams kyi gshed du phab/ /char chu dus su snyoms shing 'bab pa yi/ /lo tog smin zhing ljon shing rto rnams 'phel/ /mi phyugs mtha' dag nad med ring du 'tsho/ /bde zhing skyid pa'i dpal la sbyor bar mdzod/ /ye dharmā he tu bra bha wā he tu rnye ṭha thā ga to phya wa da ta/ te ṣ+ṭhañtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā di ma hā shra ma ṇa chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung / /de rgyu de bzhin gshegs pas bstan/ /rgyu la 'gog pa gang —411—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)yin pa/ /dge sbyong chen pos 'di skad gsungs/ /sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste/ /dge ba phun sum tshogasapar spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su gdul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /lus kyi sdom pa legs pa ste/ /ngag gi sdom pa legs pa yin/ /yid kyi sdom pa legs pa ste/ /thams cad du ni sdo me pa legs/ /thams cad bsrung ba'i dge slong dag /sdug bsngal kun las de grol lo/ /cho so rnamasagazugs bas (221brdzo bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /bzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las la kun tu 'byung / /ngo bo nyid med gnas med par/ /de ltar chos rnams shes gyisal/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skye/ /zhes chos kyi sbyin pa bya/ /dkon cog gsum gyi bden pa dang / /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad byin gyisarlabs dang / /tsho gos gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang / /chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mthus klu gnyan sa bdag thams cad mkha' lding dang bye tshan dang me dang rdzas sbyor ngan pa'i 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral nas lusang ga yid gsum bde skyid phun sum tsho gos pa dang ldan par gyur cig /klus kyang dus su char 'bebs shing / /lo tog phun sum tshogasapa dang / /rgyal po chos bzhin spyod pa dang / /'jig rten dag kyang dar bar shog /sman rnams mthu dang ldan pa dang / /gsang sngags bzlas brjod 'grub pa dang / /mkha' 'gro srin po la sogs pa/ /snying rje'i sems dang ldan gyur cig /sems can nad pa ji snyed pa/ /de kun nad las thar bar shog /'gro ba'i nad rnams ma lus pa/ /rtag tu 'byung ba med par shog /'jam dpal dpa' bos ji ltar mkhyen pa dang / /kun tu bzang po de yang de bzhin te/ /de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag slob cing / /dge ba 'di dag thams cad rab tu bsngo/ /dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba thams cad kyis/ /bsngo ba gang la mchog tu bsngags pa de/ /bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dag kyang / /bzang bo spyod phyir yongs su bsngo bar bgyi/ /med byung sras bcas rgyal ba'i byin rlabs dang / /rten 'brel bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang / /bdag (222na8 lhag bsam dag pa'i mthu stobs kyis/ /rnam dag smon pa'i —412

dag ༅ chos srung ma' rtogs skrun las rnam tso lhun grub/ 9)gnas 'di 'grub par shog /ces smon lam btab/ /oṃ nā ga a dhi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra la zhesapas dkar phyogs kyi klu rigs rnams rang gnas su gshegs/ /bya khyung gi phyag rgya dang / /oṃ ga ru ḍa nya sa he tsa le tsa le swāhā/ /zhes pas nag po'i klu rigs rnams bskrad par mos/ nyin mo bde legasamatshan bde legs/ /sogs bkra shis ci rigs bya'o/ /lhag bsam bad rtsa lta bu dkar ba yis/ /klu rgyal sgo gsum tshim pa'i dge ba la/ /brten nas 'gro kun las nyon sdig sgrib dang / /nad gnod sdug bsngal mtha' dag zhi bar shog /ces klu rgyal mal gro gzi chen la brten nas klu mchod bya ba'i tshul rgyasapa zhig dgos zhesang rgyas kyi bon po zla ba rgyal mtshan/ bkra shis tshe brtan/ chags ma ba gsum gyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni mthar rgyas pa blo bzang dbang po'o/ /dmag dpon gangs la nyi shar gnas 'dir spyon/ /dgyes pa'i gdan la brtan par bzhugasasu gsol/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod tsho gos ma lus pa/ /dngos su bshams dang yid kyi sprul nasa'abul/ /tshe dbang rdo rje rigs brgyud g.yog 'khor gyi/ /ma rig dbang gis nyams grib mi gtsang dang / /dus kyi mchod gtor chag sogs nyes pa kun/ /mthol zhing bshags na tshangs pa'i dngos grub rtsol/ srung mtho kyi bga' dang 'gal ba rnams/ /sngon ho mnong nyid 4 'gyod deng nas bsang / /mi shes gong phud sgo gsum ci nus su/ /rnam dag bsam pas bsgrub par dam bca'o/ /lus kyi na tsha sems la sdug bsngal (222bdang / /bsam par bar gcod tshe srog 'phrog 'joms pa'i mi bzad zug rngu drag pos ches mnar ba/ /'bu ldog byad dang chad pa las grol mdzod/ /tshe ring nad med longs spyod phun sum tshogs/ /lusang ga yid gsum tshor ba bde chen myong / 'bad dang rtsol bar bstos min bsams don kun/ /lhun gyis grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ /zhes pa'ang gangasal nyi shar gyi khog par lha nad drag po byung skabs 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge ba ni dpal grong sngags rams ba'o/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi/ /spyan sngar srog gi snying po legs phul nas//—413

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)bstan 'gro'i srung mar khas blangs ma cu rtsal can//tha 'og chos rgyal 'khor bcas gnas 'dir spyon//phyi ru rin cen sna lnga'i pho brang mdzes//nang du dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal yas khang //pad+ma nyi zla dgra bgegs gan rkyal dang /kha bub bstol ba'i rab brjid gdan steng du//sku mdog smug nag khro gtum 'jigs pa'i gzugs//zab ber khra bor gser 'od bkra can dang //gsag theb rgyan zhing rdo rje gseg shang thogs//'phrog byed steng na brkyang bskum tshul gyis 'gying //gsang ba'i yum gcig bka' bsdod blon po dang //sprul pa yang sprul las byed pho nya sogs//bka' nyan 'khor tsho gis dam can rgya mtsho rnams//rang rang dgyes pa'i gdan la brtan par bzhugs//g.ya' gangs chu klung gtsang ma'i mchod yon dang /khrag gi a dmar ser lha 'phreng 'khrigs//pad+ma ut+pal chu skyes ma dngasabakrag mtshar//dbang po sna lnga'i me rta go 'phrig cing 'dar//bzang sman shing sna'i bsangs dud 223nalang long g.yo//bam chen ro sol mer bsregs bdug spos 'thul//nyi zla nor bu zhun ma'i snang gsal dang //tshil chen ro skrar zhugs phung po 'bar//ga bur thos gur gum dri ngad 'thul//khrag dang mkhris pa thugs kar byug pa'i rdzas//lha mi'i zas mchogo ro brgya bda' ba'i bshos/sha rus nang khrol zhag tshil phung por spungs//pi waṃ gling bu ga rnga sil snyan 'brol//thod pa'i cang te'u mi rkang gling bu 'bud//dam rdzas gtor ma'i ri bo mkha' la bsnyeg//khrag chang rgya ja'i btung ba mtsho ltar 'khyil//seng ge glang chen dre'u rta 'dod 'khro'i ba//'brong g.yag zhol mo ra lug ce spyang khyi//stag gzig dom dred g.yi gung 'phar spyang gsa'//rgod khra bya 'ug khrung khrung ngang ngur khyung /kha dgo gla rtsod khri gnyan bse ru rgya/phag rgod khyim bya spra sbrel byi ba dang /mon pa dzo ki 'bag seng bro shon gzhas//go mtshon par bu lhung bzed ka pā la//snam sbyar tse ber phod ka rin r+pā sbrul//rus rgyan theb zhu sag lham ska rags dang //'phan gdugs bla bre rgyal mtshan lda ldi bres//'dod yon sna lnga lhun po gling bzhir bcas//lha mi'i dpal 'byor yod do cog rnams kun//stobs ldan rgyal po chen po 'khor bcas la//dngos bshams yid kyis /༷ pa legs 'bul gyi//bzhes nas bcol ba'i

dam can chos srung mngon rtogs 'phrin la rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)'phrin las bsgrub par mdzod/ /na tshod yar rgan cung zad 'gram sha gzar/ /snam sbyar bla gos mthang sham ngur smig chas/ /dge slong sdom brtson zhi dul rnam 'gyur ldan/ /sprul pa sna tshogs ston pa khyod la bstod/ /za 'og khra bo gser gyi ri mo can/ /'od 'bar tse ber gsag theb chas kyis brjid/ /phyag g.yas 'khar gsil g.yon pa lhung bzed 'dzin/ /nyan thos (223brko gra bcom tshul 'dzin khyod la bstod/ /zhal gdangs mche gcigs sma ra dbu skra ser/ /dmar zlum spyan bgrad gsag theb ber chen gsol/ /rdo rje seg shang thogs nas gdong lnga'i steng / /rgyal po rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs la bstod/ /gzhan yang rta nag gnyis 'thung la sogs pa/ /sna tsho gos zhe ne par bcibs dang gom 'grosakyis/ /steng 'og phyogs mtshams myul ba'i mas mnga' ba/ /sprul pa'i rgyal po chen po khyod la bstod/ /bde chen dga' bzhi ster ba gsang ba'i yum/ /las kun thogs med bsgrub pa mdun na 'don/ /mngag gzhug kiṅka ra sogs rdzu 'phrul rtsal/ /thogs med bka' nyan 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ /rgya gar e ṇ+ḍi rmā na'i paṇa chen gyis/ /gtsug tu rdo rje lce thog a mṛ ta/ /blud nas bka' bsgos ji bzhin khas blangs pa'i/ /dam tshig gnyan po ma g.yel nye bar dgongs/ /thub pa'i bstan srungs bla ma'i sku tshe spel/ /dge 'dun tsho gos rnams thugs mthun bshad sgrub 'phel/ /sa spyod rgyal po'i sku tshe chab srid rgyas/ /'jig rten khams su bde skyid dar bar shog /khyad par phyogs 'dir lha khyod gsol mchod pa'i/ /'gro rnams nad rims gdon bgegs dbul phongs sogs/ /bar chad nyer 'tshe kun zhi tshe 'byor dpal/ /bde skyid yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel bar mdzod/ /yang sgos se shing ra bas yongasabaskor ba/ /theg chen gling spyi bye brag gra tshang smad/ /'khor 'das yongs kyi legs tshogos ma lus pa/ /srid mtha'i bar du rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ ces tha 'og chos rgyal gyi gtor 'bul dang 'brel ba'i gsol mchod rgyas tsam zhig dgos zhes se ra theg chen gling smad grwa tshang gi slob dpon blo bzang don grub kyi 'bad pas bskul ba ltar za hor gyi (224na tha zhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon cog go /—415

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)mtsho skyes rdo rje nyi ma 'od zer dang / /chos dbyings rang grol zhabs pad gtsug bsten nas/ /rtsa gsum lha tsho gos mchode gtor bstod pa yi/ /las rim tshig nyung don tshang deng 'dir spel/ /'dir thing ma ba 'gro mgon smyos zhig chen po yab sras kyi rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tsho gos la mchod gtor 'bul ba'i rim pa mdor bsdus pa ni/ /bla ma bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku: zhes sogs blo ka gnyis kyisaskyabs sems/ bla ma bde gshegs mkha' 'gro gnas 'dir gshegs zhes sogs kyi yan lag bdun pa bya/ /rang nyid skad cig gis che mchog zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dung khrag 'dzin pa dur khrod dang dpal gyi chas kyis brgyan pa'i sku gsal ba'i thugs ka nas khro bo me mtshon gyi tshogasaspros/ /gnod byed gdon bgegs thams cad bskrad/ /steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i gur khang me 'bar bar bsam/ /thugs ka nas re yaṃ kho 'phros pas/ /sman raka gtor gsum phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod rdzas rnams kyi ma dag pa rnams bsregs gtor bkrus/ /a las ka pā la yangasashing rgya che ba'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i steng du ā+oṃ lha/ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ 'khor 'das kyi bcud thams cad bsdus nas yi ge gsum la thim pa gtor ma'i rdzas 'dres pas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por bsam la/ ā+oṃ lha3 dang nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs par bsams la/(224bskos rnga yab zangs mdog dpal ri'i pho brang nas/ /sangs rgyas kun 'dus pad+ma thod phreng la/ /sku gcig mtshan brgyad gsang yum mkha' 'gro gnyis/ /rgya gar rigs 'dzin brgyad dang bod yul gyi/ /rje 'bangs nyer lnga so zur gnubs gsum sogs/ /bka' nas bkar brgyud mdo sgyu sems phyogs kyi/ /bstan 'dzin he ru ka dpal mi gzugs can/ /mnga' bdag myang ban chosadabang rgod ldem can/ /gling pa bcu gcig la sogs zab gter sgo/ /'byed mdzad rigs 'dzin rtsa rgyud bla ma la/ gu ru zhi drag sgrub chen bka' brgyad lha/ /'khor lo'i dbang phyug ma lus gnas 'dir gshegs/ /ma hā kā la 'bar ma phyag bzhi pa/ /dpal mgon ma ning nag po dur khrod bdag /—416

dam ༅ chos srung mngon rtog phren la rnam ba ni lhun grub/ 8)dzam bha la dang stag zhon gnod sbyin mched/ /khyab 'jug chen po bshan pa dmar nag dang / /sprul pa'i chos rgyal las mkhan ci'u dmar ba/ khregs pa'i sde dpon chen po sum cu sogs/ /pha mes brgyud pas bsgrub rten gsol mchod pa'i/ /bstan srung 'khor bcas tshun spyon gdan la bzhugs/ /phyi yi mchod yon nyer spyod sil snyan rnams//mdzes sdug dri ro reg bya phun sum tshogs//nang gi a nyer spyod rol mo kun/ /'jigs rngam skyi g.ya' dur khrod rdzas las grub/ /myong grol sman mchod ba kla ri ltar spungs/ /rak+ta mtshor 'khyil gnam la 'phur dgu dang / /sal 'dzul dgu ri dwags 'phyo dgu rgyug /go mtshon spyan gzigs ri rab gling bzhi dang / /dkar gsum dngar gsum sman dang 'bru sna ja/ /dar zab rin cen lha mi'i dpal 'byor rnams/ /dngos bshams yid sprul nam mkha' bkang ste 'bul/ /bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub 'phrin las stsole/ /ā+oṃ gu ru de wa (2252)shā ka ḍā gi ni dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra a nas sha rdi'i bar/ rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tsho gis rnams kyi ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gusagator ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar bsams la/ bla ma zhi drag la/ ā+oṃ badz+ra gu ru krodha rā dza sa pa ri wā ra i rda ba kla ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum/ bka' brgyad la/ oṃ sto dhi tsit+ta sogs dang drag sngags sgo lnga pa'i mjug i rda ba smra gong bzhin lan gsum/ 'bar ma las ma hā kā lā kha ka mu kha/ ma ma rag mo dza li/ sidha mu kha hūṃ phaṭa/ rag ra hū la/ giṅka ra/ ya ma ra tsa/ tsa tri shu la/ya ka sarba du gi na/ ḍā ki ni sa pa ri wā ra i rda sogs ni gsum/ ma ning la/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lag na gu phya raṃ sirnyi hūṃ i rda ba sla ta kha kha 'a hi khā hi/ lan gsum/ dur khrod bdag po la/ ( rā dzā kum ༄ this swā hā/ shrī sma sha na a ti pa ti/ ma hā bi shi tsa ba lo ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gnod sbyin mched dgu la/ ā+oṃ ji bha la dza len+d+ra ye/ ba su dha ri ṇi sa pa ri wā ra i rda ba kla ta kha kha 'a hi khā hi/ lan gsum/stag zhen la/ ā+oṃ shrī ma hā kā la tri yaṃ dzaḥdzaḥ trag rag sha kha la dzaḥdzaḥ dun tu tra ru /bha ting dzaḥ shu larā dza tri she dzaḥme dzabadz+ra trin pa dhu kha ṭaṃ tri sa pa ri wā ra sarba bigha na sha / mā ra ya i rda ba lo ta kha kha khā hi 'a hi/ lan gsum/ gnod sbyin mched lnga la/ ā+oṃ ma hā kro dha r+ya rjo bha ri/ ā+oṃ rat+na tsit+ta ka ra ti rat+na'i —417

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)tsit+ta/ oṃ hri a pa ra tsit+ta sa pa ri wā ra i rda lan gsum/ khyab 'jug la hrīḥgag ru raṃ nā ga tsit+ta gre ma ma yong za gre ha hi yo ke sha la dzaḥdzaḥ sa pa ri wā ras rda lan gsum/ gnod sbyin bshan pa dmar nag la/ oṃ stos ma ru tse su ṇa hri tri sa pa ri wā ras rda lan gsum/ rgyal po sku lnga la/ badz+ra (225ba)rag yag sha 'a hi/ dun ting dun ting ྾/ /yag sha nag po ྾/ sha grol he ru ྾/ /kyi grol hu ru ྾/ri/tsi ta ma hā ྾/ /'dzin po ru tra ྾/ /sdom po chang rgyud ྾/ /ru tra ru tra ྾/ /su tra ru tra ྾/ /go ro tsa na ྾/ /rak+ta tshul pa ྾/ sha rgyud snying rgyud ྾/ /dbang po sna lnga ྾/ sha ma ru tra ྾/ /a lha bra ti dza ho/ byu tsa badz+ra du ru he lan gsum/ tsi dmar ba la/ shu la rā dza sa pa ri wā ra i rda lan gsum/ dregs pa'i sdedapon sum cu la/ ma hā de ba e/ u ma de ba e/ ya ma ra tsa ya/ ya ma dan+ti ya/ ma ma ru lu ma/ ye ka dza ti tra/ du khrag du/ du rnyi du/ ra tsa tsa/ ging ka ra na tri/ badz+ra su :tri/ rā hu la sa/ raka ra/ raka mor/yaklo k+ṣa/ ma hā kā la k+ṣiṃ/ ru tra sgri/ mun mun sa/ tir ti ka tha/ de wa a/ a se la a/ tiṣ+ṭha dri zu tsa/ a pi shu k+ṣu/tri pa sha lidha/ lha she tri/ bhi na ya /u/ ḍa kyi me/ nā ga phu/ nā ga kro ti shwa ri phu/ sarba du gi na sa pa ri wā ra i rda ba kla ta kha kha khā hi khā hi lan gsum/ gong gi 'khor spyi la a kā ro mu sogs dang /gtso 'khor thun mong du sman raka kyang 'bul/ bstod cing 'phrin las bcol ba ni/ snang ba mtha' yas ye shes rol pa las//pad+ma thod 'phreng zhi dang khro bo'i gar//sgrub pa sde brgyad bgrang yas dkyil 'khor gyi/ /lha tsho gos 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ye shes mgon po 'bar ma tsaṇ+ḍi ka /ma ning nag po dpal ldan dur khrod bdag /nor lha pho dgu mo dgu stag zhon dang / /gnod sbyin mched lnga 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ khyab 'jug chen po bshan pa dmar nag dang / /rgyal po sku lnga las byed tsi'u dmar ba/ /snang srid dregs pa'i sde dpon sum stos ṭa/ /chos skyong gter srung bcas pa'i (226na)tshogs la bstod/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas pad+ma thod phreng rtsal/ /gter chen chos kyi rgyal po myang ral pa/ /bka' babs 'gro mgon spyos zhig chen po sogs/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i dam las ma 'da' bar/ /dpal ldan mgon po nor lha gter srung gis/ /sangs rgyas bstan srungs bla ma'i sku tshe dang / /bka' —418

dam mā chos srung ma rga rtogs wen la rnam sto lhun grub/ 9)gter bstan pa rgyas shing gangs can ljongs//lugs zung khrims kyis bde skyid phun tsho gos mdzod//khyad par sngags 'chang bdag cag skrun tsha bu//rigs brgyud bcas pa'i chos srid legs tshogos kun//yar ngo'i zla ba lta bur 'phel ba yi//'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub par mdzod//ces smyosasngags 'chang gong ma rnams kyi rgyun khyer mchod gtor gyi rim pa rnams nas don tshang zhing tshig nyung ngu bsdus pa zhig dgos zhes smyos btsan chos rje dbang rgyal lhun grub kyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bsdos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 47sa dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon cog go/ phur mo'i klu bdud kyi gsol kha ni/raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis gtore ma'i dngos 'dzin bsregs gtore bkrus/hūṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro reg bya phun sum tsho gis pa'i steng oṃ āḥlha gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/'khor 'das kyi bcud thams cad bsdusanas yi ge gsum la thim pa 'od du zhu nas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/oṃ āḥlha lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/kye/gangs can sman ljongs sa yi bye brag gi/dbu ru mal gro rkyang bu'i skyed tshal nas//klu rgyal rgyun dal dung skyong 'khor dang bcas//gnas nas thogs pa med 6ba ) par gshegs su gsol//dus gsum sangs rgyas pad+ma /bha was//bka' bsgos dam bzhag gsang ba'i mtshan btags pa//klu yi sdod pon rdo rje drag po rtsal//rdzas la shugs kyis gnas nas da tshur spyon//mnga' bdag bcod po khri srong lde'u btsun gyis//grogs su bkug nas gtsug lag srung ma sa/nyer bskos rgyun dal mas gsol gdengs can dbang //dgyes pa'i tshul gyis gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol//'phying yul rmis ris gzhi bdag ces grags pa//'ol khar khye chung g.yu yi zur phud can//gser po stong du phur mo klu bdud nag/sngon gyi dam tshig dgongs la gshegs su gsol//gsang ba'i pho brang g.yu yi sgron ma dang //gangs dkar shel gyi gnas mchogo dam pa nas//klu wo lto dkar mgo bo mkha' la bsnyeg/gnas dang yul gyi gzhi bdag da tshur spyon//nā ga rā dza sam ya dzaḥdzaḥbaza' shing rkang 'thung phreng bas yongs su ༷/ra//spang ljongs me tog mtsho rdzing lteng ka can//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo r+sāng rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)rin cen pho brang dbus na pad zla la//klu rgyal 'khor bcas brtan pa bzhugs su gsol//gong gi sngags gzham du tiṣ+ṭha lhan//g.ya' gangs rnyog bral dwangs bsil chu klung la//tsan+dan gur kum gyisabran mchod yon bshams//pad+ma ༄ la u dum wā ra sogs//chu dang thang las skyes pa'i me rtag bkra//dri zhim shing ris sman sna bsregs pa yi//bsangs kyi dud pa chu 'dzin lang long bzhin//nyi zla nor bu'i 'od dang rtsi dmar gyi//snang gsal sgron mes mun pa'i go skabs 'phrog/ga pur gur gum la sogs dri zhim po//yid 'ong sku la byug pa'i rdzas su sbyar//dkar gsum dngar gsum 227na thang tog 'bru sna'i rigs//ro brgya ldan pa lha mi'i bza' bca' gos//sil snyan bi waṃ gling bu ting ting shags//snyan gyi dbang por 'jebs pa rol mo'i sgra//gzugs mdzes skad snyan dri ngad bzang po'i chab//ro bda'i rig 'jam 'dod yon mchod pa 'bul//gong gi sngags gsham du sa pa ri wā ra byu nas sha rdi'i bar dang /rū pa na pā shu'i bar gyis mchode/rgyal srid sna bdun nye ba'i rin cen bdun//ba po shis rdzas rtags lha klu mi'i nor bu//'phan gdugs bla bre dar ba lda ldi sogs//srid pa'i 'byor ba ma lus 'bul gyis bzhes//gong gi sngags gsham du ba sa bha rat+na aṣ+ṭa maṅga la kā ma gu ṇa sarba bhū ti pā dza te āḥlha/dkar gsum dang ra gsum rtsi sman dang sbyar ba'i//gtsang zhing gya nom mchod gtor rgyan ldan pa//mi zad bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor byin brlabs nas//klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas la 'bul gyis bzhes//gong gi sngags gsham du oṃ hi li hi li ma hā hi li / phu swā hā/oṃ bhak+ṣa ya bhak+ṣa ya sam ya tiṣ+ṭha / phu swā hā/lan gsum gyis gtore ma 'bul/ga bur gur kum tsan+dan dkar dmar dang //dza ti chu srin sder mo dbang lag mtshal//dung gzi dar dmar zho sha rnam pa bzhi//pu shel tse dang sgro mdongs dar sna lnga//thang lo smyug lo rdo rgyus spos dkar dang //mngar gsum me tog sna tshogasashing tog rigs//rin cen rgya mtsho'i lha ba ge sar gsum//sle tres li shi sug smel zi ra dkar//ut+pal sngon po spang spos a bar skyur//til dkar thal ka rdo rje rgun 'brum dang //sgom ra tsa shing dngar ka bed dang //daṇ+ḍa ka ri ru rta ka ko la/// ḍi a 'bras sha 227ba〉lbas a /sa/'dam

dam ༅ chos srung mdzo rtogs lon la rnam tso a grub/ 9)bu ka ra 'bru sna klu sman rnams/ /ra dkar ba dmar 'o ma gtsang ma dang / /sbyar ba'i gser skyemasamachod pa dam pa 'di/ /klu rgyal rgyun dal sku stod lha yi gzugs/ /sku smad sto 'gro sbrul mgo gdengasaka dgu/ /g.yu yi smin ma dung sogs gser gyi lag /rngul ba'i bdud rtsi'i zil ma sku la 'phro/ /rin cen rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' klubs/ /phyag gnyis yid bawo nor bu shing lo 'dzin/ /ri rab stegs byas ma sdug ma rgya mtshor brkyang / /rigs bzhi'i klu yi sde dpon chen bo la/ /'o chol sman gyi mchod ba dam pa 'bul/ /bzhes nas bdag sogs mi nor yon bdag gis/ /'gal 'khrul nyamasachags thams cad byang zhing dag /tshe dpal longs spyod thams cad 'phel bar mdzod/ sgro migacig po 'di 'og ma rnams la 'gre/ /mdzes pa'i sring mo klu yi na chung bzhi/ /'phrul gyi me long 'dzin cing gser sked bcings/ /snyan pa'i glu len zas nor chung srid spel/ /'khor gyi g.yog mo bzhi dang bcas pa la ྾/ /klu rgyal btsun mo sman gcig 'phrul mo che/ /gnag snum dbu skra g.yu yi lan tshar can/ /gzi mchong spel ma'i do shal gser gyi rgyan/ /dar dkar na bza' bum pa 'dzin pa la ྾/ /g.yas kyi ru 'dren rmos mda' phag tshang klu/ /sngun gyi sna 'dren mar me steng gi klu/ /slad kyi rjes 'brang nag bo klong gdol klu/ /g.yon gyi ru 'dren brag dmar rdzong gi kur/ /klu rgyal bzhugs gnas gcig tu ma nges pa/ /ston dpyid dbyar gsum za khur rkyang bu'i tshal/ /dkor nor longs spyod thams cad skyong ba'i sa/ /'on bu sding sding g.ya' mo 'brog skyong ba/ /'bru yi bang mdzod spel dang g.yang khug nas/ /byang tshal nags ma'i rdzong (228na khu skyo sang mdzad/ /dbu ru'i spungs brgyud zal mo'i snang la bzhugs/ /gos kyi shul zhing 'bebs pa phag tshang klu/ /dgun gyi bzhugs klu shod 'on bu'i tshal/ /pho brang nang na bzhugs pa'i gtso 'khor dang / /klu yi rgyal po brgyad dang bshan pa bzhi/ /blon po bzhi dang klu sman rgyal mor bcas/ /lcags ri'i nang gnas brag dmar thog rje btsan/ /'phrang pa'i brag btsan skyes bu klu btsan che/ /rang rang so so'i gnas dang yul phyogs dang / /sa gzhi ri klungs gang bzhugs tsho gos rnams la ྾/ /sngon tshe gsang bdag dregs pa kun 'dul dang / /rta mchog rgyal po —421—
