rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)pad+mā ka ra yi/ /dong sprug la sogs zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor la/ /brten nas dbang bskur dam la ma btags sam/ /tshangs pa lha yi me tog la sogs pa/ /rje 'bangs nyer lnga sa zur myang chos dbang / /bka' gter brgyud pa'i rigs 'dzin grangs med kyis/ /dam la btags pa'i klu rgyal 'khor bcasarnams/ /spur rgyal bod kyi rgyal khams 'di nyid du/ /char chu dus 'bab lo tog rtsi shing dang / /nags tshal rtodang lu ma chu mig 'phel/ /lo tog 'bras bu dus su smin par mdzod/ /lha sabs ma yasamatha' 'dul yang 'dul sogs/ /phan bde'i rtsa lag gtsug lag chos 'khor dang / /mdo sngagasamachod gnas sdoganyis thos bsam sgom/ /bya ba las kyi 'khor los dar bar mdzod/ /sa dbang rgyal po'i lugs gnyis bka' khrims btsan/ /'bangs rnams sgo gsum bde ba'i tshor ba myang / /mtha' dmag nad rims bkres phong sdug bsngal zhi/ /phyogs bzhi'i longs spyod tham sa cad 'du bar mdzod/ /khyad par sngags 'chang bdag cag mi phyugs dang / /grong dang grong khyer dgon gnas sde rnams kyi/ /dkar dmar thab gzhob sa gnyan brkos shing dras/ khrung gnyan bcad na khas rdo gnyan tshal bar gzhags/ /mtsho la rdzasang na gtad sel dme mnol mdze/ /yugs sa ro sogs mi gtsang rdzas kyisa'abags/ /sku gsung thugs la phog kun bzod (228ba bzhes nas/ /'khon bzung bsam ngan sbyor rtsub zhi bar mdzod/ /ban bon sngags pas skam gsher gtang pa la/ /brten nas zos pa ( bsdams pa glod/ /bcings pa khrol la nus pa rul zhig gi sa ba bsos la gnod pa med par mdzod/ /mdor na bcol ba'i 'phrin las ma lus pa/ /thog pa med par lhun gyis grub pa dang / /phyogs dusaganas skabs mtha' dag bde legs pa'i/ /bkra shis dpal gyi dus kun khyab par mdzod/ /phur mo klu bdud kyi gsol mchod rgyas pa zhig dgos zhes smyos btsun chos rje dbang rgyal lhun grub kyis bskul ba ltar yig rnying zhig 'dug par gzhi byas za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon cog go /dbang ོ rta mchog waṃ yig bde wo thabs/ /phag mo e dbyings stong wo shes rab mar/ /—422

dam can chos srung ma' rtogs skrun las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)mkha' la mkha' yi sbyor bas bskrun pa'i rigs//mkha' ri lcam mo rigs sngags 'dzin mar bstod/ /thun mong snang ngor sha ba pho mo zung / /'dus las ma sangs sku lamakha' ri dang / /gos po khu ringasaganyis kyi lcam sring mo/ /ba po shis bsam bzang skyid 'tshor grags la bstod/ /phyi ru shel dkar gangasari mkha' la bsnyeg /nang du rin cen sna bdun gzhal yas khang / /yid 'phrog ba gam dbus na rtsal gsum kun/ /rdzogs pa'i seng chen steng na 'gying la bstod/ /rdul bral ston gyi zla ba skyengs byed bzhin/ /smin ma 'bri shing byu ru'i mchu sgros 'dzum/ khu tig tshems dkar gnag snum dbu skra'i rtser/ /bkra shis g.yas 'khyil dung gis mtshan la bstod/ khyu 'bur mngon mtho'i chu 'dzin rab tu rgyas/ /rked skabs phra ldem spyan gyi zur mig mdas/ /dgra bcom bsam gtan las slong mdzes sdug gis/ /srid zhi'i brtan pa 'phrog byed ma la bstod/ /reg na 'jam mnyen lha yi du kū la/ /pañtsa li ga'i tse ber sum brtsegs kyi/ /'jol ber lhab lhub g.yo ba'i nang ma la/ /(229na tsā na cen ska ragasabacings pas mdzes la bstod/ /yid bzhin nor bu dbang sngon be+eḍūr+ya/ /pad rā ga margad byu ru mu tig pug /gser dngul la sogs lha klu gnod sbyin gyi/ /rin cen sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras la bstod/ /u du ra pad+ma ba kū la/ /ku mu da sogs me tog sna tsho gos pa/ /ma rnyings gsar pa spel legs chun po yi/ /'jam mnyen 'phreng bas brgyan pa khyod la bstod/ /rin cen sna lnga srad bur dra mig gi /tshul du 'phreng bar brgyus par 'dzam bu'i gser/ khren tu sbyangs pa'i 'od 'phros stod g.yogs pa/ /steng gyon tshul du brjid chags mnabs par bstod/ /rdo rje mda' dar dang bcas phyag g.yas kyis/ /bla tshe srog gsum yar ba thams cad 'gugs/ /g.yon pa rin cen gter gyi bum pa yis/ /srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ma lus stsole la bstod/ /phyi ltar mkha' ri lha lcam sman mo'i rigs/ /nang du bde chen ster ba'i ḍā gi ma/ /gsang ba gsang sngags 'dzin pa rgyal ba'i yum/ /slu med srung ma'i dbang mo khyod la bstod/ /sngon rgyu khol mo rdo rje tshe ldan ma/ /za 'og gos bzang rin cen rgyan gyis spras/ /rkyang bu kha dkar nor bu'i sga srab can/ /zhen nas gtso mo'i 'phrin las bsgrub la bstod/ /slad kyi rjes 'brang —423—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)rin cen dpal 'bar ma/kha ba'i mdangs can yid 'phrog gos bzang steng //nor bu'i rgyan sprasarin cen sga srab can/sha ba la zhen bka' bzhin bsgrub la bstod//gtso 'khor gsum gyi phyogasamatshams mtha' skor du//gos bzang lhab lhub rin cen rgyan 'phreng dang //sna tsho gos phyag mas bzhen ba la bcibs pa//lha sman 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho'i tshogs la bstod//nges pa'i don du sa bcu'i dbang phyug kyang //gdul bya'i snang ngor 'jig rten tshul bzung ba//dge bsnyen sku la mkha' ri'i lcam sring ma//ba po shis bsam bzang skyid 'tsho 'khor bcams//sangs rgyas gnyis pa pad+ma sam+bha wa/229ba'ajig rten mig gcig gan jag thang ta dang //mnga' bdag gsung sprul chos kyi dbang phyug zhabs//rtsa brgyud bla mas dam la ma btags sam/khyad par be+e ro'i rnam sprul rdo rje gling /srus brgyud slob mar bcas pa'i tsho gos rnams kyis//dam tshig bskyar zhing nyin mtshan dus drug tu//rten mchod thugs dam dus su bskang ba dang //'brom ston rdo rje dbang grags rgya mtsho la//bod 'bangs bde skyid thabs tshul lung bstan ba//ji bzhin bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu'i re ba kun//skong ba'i dus babs lha sman mthu rtsal can//thub bstan spyi dang khyad par bka' gter gyi//ring lugs bye brag rdo rje gling pa yi//zab gtor dbang khrid lung dang man ngag rgyun//ru bzhi'i rgyal khams khyone la dar bar mdzod//mgon de'i lung bzhin sprul dzugater bdag gling //dbang grags rgya mtsho dus 'dzom rten 'brel mthus//'byom gyi rigs dang chos kyi rgyun bzang po//gas klung wo 'bab ltar go med mdzod//dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i pho brang gi/chos srid gnyis skyong rdo rje thogs med rtsal//srog gi ka ba g.yung drung ltar brtan zhing //rnam par dkar ba'i 'phrin las 'phel bar mdzod//lha sras yang srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho yi/ /sku tshe nyi zla dang mnyam khrims gnyis kyis//'gro rnams bder 'khod bsod nams rtsibs stong gi /'khor lo 'dzam gling mkha' la 'phags par mdzod/kha ba'i sman ljongs nad rims 'thab rtsod dang //dbul phongs mtha' dmag dus kyi chad pa zhi//bde skyid lha yi dpal la 'gran bzod pa'i//bsams don lhun gyis grub 4pa/ tshon las mdzod//ces sras nor bu 'dzin

dam༅ chos srung mdzo rtog skrun la rnam sto lhun grub/ 9)pa'i rnam 'phrul mkha' ri dge bsnyen she'u dkar po tog gi zhing khams su mtshan 'od mdzes bya bar 'tshang rgya ba'i lung bstan pa ltar deng sang rigs 'dzin :gral du bzhugs shing gcung bu rengs bkra shis 'bar mkha' ri'i gangs skyong ba dang lhan cig par sras mo rig sngags 'dzin ma'i sprul pa lcam mo 230na bkra shis bsam bzang skyid 'tsho'i bstod ba zhig gsar du rtsoms zhes rgyal sras rdo rje gling ba'i bstan pa'i srog shing 'brom gyi sngags 'amang chos rje rdo rje dbang grags rgya mtshos bskul ma mdzad pa ltar za hor gyi sngags smyon gang shar rang grol gyis sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni brda dag yig rtsis la blo gros kyi snang ba dkar ba mthar rgyas pa blo bzang dbang po'o//'dir dur khrod bdag mo'am/'dre mo ngan zhe mar gsol mchod 'bul ba ni/rgyud le'u bcu pa las/gtor ma zlum gtor mar thud brgyan tha ma'i bgos bdun mtheb skyu la rta bong phag lug g.yag shas brgyan da la mo yi sku yang gzug ces byung ba ltar sku rten tsa gli 'dzugs sam yang na bris thang lta bus kyang go chod/sman rag phyi nang gi nyer spyod sogs mchode pa rnams bkod pas mdzes par bsham/mar gtor rnams bla med spyi 'gro ltar byin gyis bsas/bh+yo a dun gyi dur khrod gzhal yas su//ma tri bh+yo las dkor bdag mo//dur khrod lha mo sku mdog dmar//dkar dmar dar gyi na bza' gsol//g.yas pa lcags kyu g.yon me long //rin cen rgyan ldan lha mo'i gzugs//sprul pa yang sprul 'khor bcas rnams//gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol//thogs pa med par byon nas kyang //dgyes pa'i gdan la brtan par bzhugs//oṃ ma ma ra li bram ya ka li ye dza dzaḥsam ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/mar zan dkar gsum dngar gsum dang /sha khrag rus pa la sogs pa//sna tshogs mchode pa'i gtor ma rnams//bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor byin brlabs nas//dur khrod bdag mo 'khor bcas la//'bul gyis bzhes la dgyes par rol//gong gi sngags gsham du ma hā ba lin+ta kha hi/ba ling ga re na/di bi lo pa ho/ba ti yul gyi gzugs bzang mo gtor ma khyer la dngos grub stsol zhig/ces pa lan gsum gyis phul/230bsngaXs gsham du ma hā pañtsa dang ma hā btags la dbul/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64) bh+yoḥ mdzes sdug gzugs kyi zlos gar bsgyur/ /snyan brjid rol mo'i sgra dbyangs 'khrol/ /dri bzang ngad ldan chab kyi byug /ro brgya'i zas sbyar lha bsgos dbul/ /'jam mnyen reg bya'i gos zungs rnams//lha mo 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang / /thang skyes chu las skyes pa dang / /dbang po lnga yi me tog bkra /sman sna stong las sbyar ba'i spos/ kha tshil gsur gyi dud sprin 'khrigs/ /nyi zla nor bu'i snang 'od dang / /zhun chen las sbar mar me gsal/ /ga pur gur kum khrag zhag dang / /mkhris pa'i dwangs ma thugs kar byug /lha mi'i bza' bca'i ro mchog dang / sha chen zas mchoge ri ltar spungs/ /nyer spyod mchod pa'i tsho gos rnams kyis/ /lha mo 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang / /rta g.yag ba lang ra lug khyi/ /gnam la phur dgu sa gzhi la/ /'dzul dgu ri dwags 'phyo dgu sogs/ /ji snyed srog ldan tshogasarnams dang / /go mtshon 'phan gdugs lda ldi bres/ /lha mi'i dpal 'byor ji snyed dang / / phyi nang gsang ba'i thun rdzas rnams/ /sa gzhi bar snang khyen gang bar/ /dngos bshams yid kyis sprul pa yis/ /lha mo 'khor bcas rki/ /kye khyod kyi yab kyi mtshon gsol pa/ /yab ni 'od de 'od pa che/ /yum ni 'od bzang mthu mo che/ /gangs dkar stongs na srid pa'i sras/ /mched ni rnam pa bzhi ru srid//che ba lha mo ga spro ma/ /de 'og gnod sbyin ga ba ma/ /chung shos 'dre mo ga zhe khyod/ /'dzam gling brag dkar ldam pa'i sa/ /mtsho 'gram mtsho mi nang shed na/ /sku la dar dkar gos su gyon/ /phyag g.yas 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu dang / /g.yon pa dngul dkar me long bsnams/ /nor sna gcig gi rjes gcod ma/ /rto chag gang gi shas bsnyeg ma/ /nor la dga' zhing nor la dungs/ /dkor bdag can la phyag 'tshar lo/ /bh+yoḥ phyi ltar ma mo 'od kyi bu ga can/ /nang ltar ma mo gser gyi spu gri ma/ /(231na gsang ba dur khrod bdag mo ga ne ma/ /gnas dang dkor /srung ma mthu mo che/ /slob dpon r+sā po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / /gter chen mnga' bdag myang ral la sogs pa/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i spyan sngar khasablangs pa'i/ /g.yar dam gnyen po dus las ma yel bar/ /rnal 'byor dpon slob dgon gnas bcas pa yi/ /'jigs brgyad zhi zhing 'byor drug spel ba dang / /mos bzhi dbang sdud dgra bgegs —426

dam can chos srung mngon rtogs 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub/ 9)sgrol ba sogs/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /kun mkhyen gnyis pa blo bzang grags pa yi/ /bstan pa rin cen srid mthar rgyas pa dang / /dga' ldan phyogs las rnam rgyal pho brang che'i/ /mi nor chab srid mnga' thang 'phel bar mdzod/ khyad par dga' ldan ring lugs nyer bzung nas/ /chos min chos su brdzub bdud kyi sde/ /'dul ba'i khrims ldan dge 'dun gling chen po/ /yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /bh+yoḥ dur khrod lha mo chen mo khyod/ /sku ni mi rdzu dgu ru brdzu/ /chibs su dred mo kham nag bcibs/ /mdog nag zhal gdangs spyan bgrad ma/ /ral pa gsigs pasas gzhi khebs/ /phyag g.yas zhing chen rgyal mtshan 'phyar/ /g.yon na nal bu'i don snying za/ /gnad nas drag tu bskul ba'i tshe/ /gcan gzan bzhi po pho nyar 'gyed/ /mar srang gang gi rjes gtsod ma/ /(phad gang gi phyir 'brang ma/ /nor la ngan zhing dkor la dad/ /las la myur ba'i ma mo khyod/ /dur khrod rgyu ba mi bsrun gzugs/ /srid pa'i ma mo cho 'phrul can/ /gling bzhi bskor cing mi lpags gyon/ /dam nyams dgra yi srog gcod ma/ /dkor nor khab dang skud pa tsam/ /ma bzhag drag pos yud kyisalong / /rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ /gar bzhugs gnas dang dgon pa'i rigs/ /bcol lo gtad do khyod kyis srungs/ /snga dgra byas pa'i rtsa ba chod/ /phyi dgra sems pa drungs nasaphyungs/ /da lta'i dgra bo (231bsil du rlog /rdo rje mas yi gzhags nag de/ /bstan pa bshig pa'i ske la thob/ /dgra byed pha bu yin kyang sgrol/ /dam nyams slob ma yin kyang sod/ /dur khrod zhing skyong ḍā gi'i gtso/ /snang srid dbang du sdus mdzod la/ /bdag cag chos mdzad sgrub pa po'i/ /chos kyi mthun rkyen rtag tu spyor/ /mi mthun bdud kyi zang thing rnams/ /skad cig ma btang thugs rje can/ /dkor bdag chen po khyod nyid kyis/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub pa'i dus/ /dgra bo'i yul dang sgo drung du/ /kun gyis thos pa'i 'o dod bos/ /ltas ga zad mi shes pa ston/ /dgra bo'i yul khamasastongs su chug /rgyal ba'i bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir/ /rnal 'byor che ba thon par mdzod/ /ces drag por bskul tshe 'di nyid kyang bya'o/ /mjug chog spyi dang mthun par bya/ /dur khrod kyi bdag mo ga ne ma'i —427

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho rigasung 'bum/ (4)gsol mchod 'di lho brag mkhar chur dga' ldan bdud 'dul gling du btsugs pa'i tshe gter kha gong ma las nye bar btus te za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rig byed pa blo bzang dbang po'o//mchod gtor spyi ltar byin gyis brlabs//myur mdzad ye shes mgon po thugs rje'i gter//las kyi gshin rje 'chi bdag ma he'i zhal//gnod sbyin rdo rje bdud 'dul mas bo che//srid gsum dbang sgyur dpal ldan re ma tī//btsan rgod chen po rgyal chen bse khrab pa//sprul pa'i chos rgyal rdo rje grags ldan rnams//bka' sdod 'khor tsho gos dam can rgya mtshor bcas//thogs med 'dir spyon dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs//dri ngad ldan pa a rgyu'i mchod yon dang //rnyog med chu klung zhabasabasil tshul du sbreng //sna tshogs me tog 4 po thod du 'ching //dri zhim bdug spos lang long bar snang kheng //gsal byed mar me'i 'phreng ba tshar du dngar//sku la byug pa'i dri chab mtsho ltar bskyil/sha rus ro brgya'i zas mchoge ri bo bzhin//snyan brjid rol mo'i tsho gos rnams gus pas 'bul ma sarba sto rak+ṣi ta sa pa ri wā ra a nas sha rdi'i bar gyis232nasgo cho de/'bru sna khrag chang sha mar las grub pa'i//dam rdzas rgyan ldan bdud rtsir byin brlabs pa//chos skyong srung ma'i tsho gos la 'bul byed na//dgyes pa chen po'i sgo nas bzhes su gsol//rgyas par spron chos skyong so so'i sngagasakyis 'bul zhing /bsdun/oṃ badz+ra dharma pā li ka sa pa ri wā ra i rda bha ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/lan gsum mam bdun dang a kā ro mu sogs kyis bsngo/chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang nang mchod kyang 'bul//thub pa'i spyan sngar bstan pa bsrung ba sa/zhal bzhes mthu stobs rdo 'phrul dpag dka' ba'i//chos skyong srung ma dam can rgya mtsho la//sgo gsum gus pa'i sgo nas bdag bstod do//zhwa ser 'chang ba'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas//de 'dzin dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs pad brtan//sa dbang rgyal po'i sku tshe mnga' thang 'phel//'bangs rnams bde skyid phun sum tsho gos par mdzod//bdag gi chosadang mas pa'i don kun sgrubs//rang gis sgo gsum spyod pas ma nyes na//ko long ga pas ya ga thag ma sa/sgrog par byed la dkar nag bden ba// phye//mdor na 'phrin las rnam bzhi ma lus pa//

dam ༅ chos srung mag rtogs mun las rnam sto lhun grub/ 9) 'bad med sgrub pa'i bstan pa skyong mdzad pas//yid bzhin nor dang yongs 'du'i ljon pa ltar//'dod pa'i re ba mtha' dag skong bar shog khres spyan g.yas mkhan po bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho sogatore 'bul bsdus pa 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes gsung gis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 44sa dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon /ga 9go/sarba maṅga lo////

ra༅༅//gtor ma brgya rtsa bklags pas don 'grub ces bya ba bzhugs//na ma lhar su〉t+na bh+yo/rang bzhi yongs dag kun gsal mdzes ma'i 'dren byed dkyus//dbang gzhu ltar 'byug ma 'dres 'byog po'i mtshar sdug gis//sna tsho gis blo yi 'dod ldan dga' ba'i dpal ster can//zas gtsang sras kyi srid 'di'i duḥkha'i tsha gdung bcil//ting 'dzin lcags kyu'i rdzas kyis lag ldan snar//btab pas rang dgar 'phyan min sbyin pa'i khur//rlabs chen theg pa'i bsod nams gom stabs kyis//byang grol myur du bgrod pa'i byed po mchog/sngon rabs dam pa'i lam srol skyed tshal nas//rgyas bsdus skabs kyis phye ba'i phra ldem can//klags pas don kun 'grub pa'i ut+pal gyi//me tog phon po rna ba'i rgyan du dngar//dbus 'gyur 2na sko tshogs rta can gyi//grong khyer ka pi la wartu'i//phug can ngos na gcung dga' bo//myang 'das tshul la yid phyogs tshe//sngo bsangasadus su 'i 'jungs pa gos//nyer grub zhig gis dga' bo khyod//zhag bdun tso du nyi bu yi//mche ba'i phrag 'gro bdag cag gi/ngang tshul bskal pa brgyad khrir myong //zhes pa'i mtshon cha thos 'dzin du//bsnun pas yid la rma byung ba'i//zug rngu 'khrun sgras sman pa mchog/nyi ma'i gnyen drung gsol ba'i mthus//sngags dang dmigs pa nyal 'gro zan//ro nus stobs la tshegs sa dus//don bzang 'grub pa stsal ba gang //lag tu bstar bas nyam nga ba'i//tshul las bzlog pa'i bde ba thob//rim bzhin brgyud de swa la'i ljongs//lha gcig di paṃ ka ra sogs//rda pa du ma'i rje gzha ༅sa pa/phyag srol rgyun//mchog dman 'ga' yis nyams blangs pas//tshe nor mngon mtho nges legs rnams//thob ces sngon rabs sgros su snang //de yang 'a/ ba/ snod ༅ chos ma skyas 4 4 shin tu sa 4e lcags phor

gtor ma brgya rtsa bkrag pas don 'grub/ 9)ba sdod/ bzhi po/ phyir dor mthun pa'i bhaṇ+ḍa brgyad/ zhe sar/dngul/ zangs gar ga kha bar dug shing rdza rnams kyi snod gang (2ba 〉 sdus nang du log pa'i rdzas/ drug gi grangs spangs cig shos rnams/ /'byor pa'i 'khos dang bstun pa'i tshad/ /bkod pas khyad par 'phags bshams te/ /mchod gnas kun la legs byas kyi//grangs med dngos po bskrun sha 4 /la khug dug gi me tog ༅ mthob rnams/ dkar gsum mngar gsum rigs/zan/me tog nu gtsang / slad du/ 'bul zhing sbyin pa'i yul rnams la/ /longs su spyod cing mi zad pa'i/ /gter du 'gyur zhing gnod pa yis/ /'phrog tu med pa'i dpal ster ba'i/ yā ka thub rigs gsum mgon po bzhi'i/ /mtshan gyi dbyangs snyan sgrog pa sogs/ /tshig don ma 'dres ji bzhin du/ /gtor ma skul bskyod dang bral ba/ /mthob par 'byung po kun log 'gro bas sdig pa che/ /mi khyi'i mang sar yi dgas rnams ga /dben zhing gtsang sar nges 'phongs pa la sa ni byin kyang dga' bltar/ /med dus/ /so sor thar pa'i sdom drang thong rnamasagayo med pa'i sa mir/ldan rab/ /min yang ro dang sha 4 sgog myong sogs dri ga pa mtha' dag dri nga ba'i//zas spangs skyabs phyogs bas dus gsum gyi de zhugashegs pa sogs dang / sangs rgyas chos tshonas ma/ 'gro sems bskyed rnams/ spyi ltar byas te dkyus la 'jug su bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma'i 'dab ma dkar 'jam mnyen lhag rgyas pa'i lte bar/ a las bcu drug cha shas yongs su rdzogs pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rang gi sems (3na snyad gangs ri'i dum bu chad pa lta bu'i khyuḥdakar po las dpag tu med pa'i 'od zer 'phros pas/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba rnams kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin gyis mnyes par byas/ /gzhal du med pa'i sems can gyi don rlabs po ches 'gro ba kun 'phags pa mchog gi go 'phang la bkod/ /don gnyis lhun gyis grub par gyur pa las/bdag nyid thugs rje chen po 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs shel dkar gyi lhun po nyin byed 'bum gyis 'byud pa lta bu'i sku mdog rab dkar mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / dpe byad brgyad cu gsal rdzogs kyis brgyan pa'i rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis kun+da'i phon po 'gro la rjes chags kyis thugs gar 'dzin pa'i nyams kyis sbyar zhing / lhag ma g.yas man shel gyi 'phreng ba brgya rtsas lus can mtha' —431—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)dag thar pa'i khang bzang du 'dren pa'i brda dang / g.yon 'og mas pad+ma dkar po'i sdong po yal 'dab rgyas pa'i grib bsil gyis sdug bsngal gsum 7tsha gdung sel ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin pa/ lha rdzas dar gyi na bza'i stod g.yogs dang sham thabs mdzes par klubs shing / rin po che'i dbu rgyan snyan rgyan mgul rgyan phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub sogs kyis sbud pa'i spyi bor chadakar bo/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūṃ sngon pos mtshan pa las/ lcags kyu (3bskyo bu'i 'od zer grangs med pa 'phros pas/ lho phyogs gru 'dzin ri bo'i spo nas/ rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' 'phrin las kyi 'jug ba dus las mi g.yel bas skar mda' 'phangs pa bzhin du spyan drangs/ grangs med rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse'i 'od dkar can/ /gangs ldan 'gro blo'i chu mtshor shar ba'i gzugs/ /phan bde'i ga bur gsar pa'i thigs pa gang / /stsol phyir 'dir gshegs phyag na pad+ma kye/ /oṃ ā rlu a wa lo ki te sa pa ri wā ra e khya dzaḥlha baṃ sngo dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ /slar yang 'od zer los pas/ /dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ khyed rnams kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhesagasol ba btab pas/ bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi dzi gta sam ya shrī āḥlha/ zhes spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ lus gang / dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ mchod gtor a khra ta bsang / su bhā was sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las: las rin po che'i snod du/ oṃ las mchode gtor rnams 'dod yon lngas khyad par du byas pa'i mchod pa'i sprin zad mi shes par gyur/ oṃ āḥ// dngos bshams yid sprul phul byung mchod pa'i tshogs/ /ngo mtshar spyan dang ro mchog ljags kyi yul/ /zag med bde ba'i klong du dgyes(4na)pa'i ched/ /'jig rten dbang phyug 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /oṃ ar+ya lo ke te sa pa ri wā ra a nas/ sha lta'i bar brjod/ mi zad snyigs ma lnga bdo na kra'i grong / /legs lam nor bu len la dka' ba'i 'phrang / /thugs rje'i rdzings kyis sgrol ba'i 'phags mchogo lha/ /'jig rten dbang phyug gang der phyag 'tshal lo/ /yig drug long gas bkra pa rje smon las bya/ /mgron spyan 'dren pa ni/ dpag yas—432

ga kho ma brgya rtsa bklag pa don 'grub/ 9)rgyal ba'i gsang ba gsum gyi dngos//mi 'gyur bde r+sā tswa du rtag 'tshel yang //dngos grub 'byung gnas byed por ston pa'i phyir//mchog gsum dam pa'i tsho gis rnams gshegs su gsol//gang de'i sku gsung thugs kyi rnam rol las//bgrang yas zla snang chu mtshor shar ba bzhin//khros pa'i gar mdzad mgon chen sdebazhi sogs//chos skyong srung ma'i tsho gis rnams gshegs su gsol//mngon shesardzu 'phrul ldan pa'i bsil sbyin dang //snag tsha yang dag shes dang mdun du bdar//gya gyu khyung ming a 'gur g.yog 'dor sogs//drang srong bram ze'i lis rnams mo//'dod yon nor dang don kun sgrub mdzad pa'i//rmugs 'dzin nor rgyun ma dang tsho gos kyi bdag/gnod sbyin a pa rtsa ta la sogasapa'i/nor bdag lhan cig skyes lha ྾//chos 'khor gtsug lag ba ge grong khyer dang //ri dang nagasatshal la sogs nor 'dzin kun/4bsrung zhing skyong ba sa yi lha mo sogs//yul lha gzhi bdag tshogasarnams mo//sngon tshe snang byed yul gyi dga' ston du/stobs bas mnga' ba gyur cing sgos dbyangasakyis/dbugs dbyung mas dang ldan pa'i mi ma yin/sde dpon rta bdag 'phro ma ྾//ring bo ṣ+ka nasabasags pa'i nag po'i 'bras/mngon par bdo ba'i mi bsrun bsam sbyor gyis//lus can rnams la 'tshe ba'i mi mthun phyogs//bgegs tshogis 'byung po ma lus 'dir sa shig kun gsal lusaphra'i tshad kyi zhags pas kyang //pha mtha' 'ching bar nus pa'i go skabs las//mi 'gyur brtse bas bskyangs pa'i ji snyed ma//rigs drug skye dgu'i tsho gis rnams dze//mi mnyam 'du ba 'khrugs dang glo bur du//dug mtshon lcebs sogs rkyen gyis 'di snang lus//bor zhing phyi ma ma thob 'khyams pa yi//bar dor gnas pa'i 'gro rnams ra//ser sna la sogs las ga rlung shugs kyis//bkres skom sdug bsngal rgya mtshor lhung ba yi/phyi nang sgrib can byings gnas kha 'thor sogs//yi dwags rgyal mo la sogs ྾//sngon nas bcad gtubs 'phrog 'joms la so gos pas//bu lon chags pa'i mi dang mi ma yin//mdor na rigs drug gang du gnas gyur pa'i//lan chags sha 'khon gnyer rnams 'dir 'dus shig/mdor na bde legs zhing du spyan draXs shing //'dod don bsgrub pa'i phyir du bkug pa

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)dang //snying rje'i dbang gis bos pa'i mgron la sogs//mtha' dag rang ldanang nga gdan la brtan par bzhugs//badz+ra sa mā dzaḥpad+ma ka ma la ye sa/pha mtha' yongs bral ye shes chu gter las//dngos grub rnam mang yid bzhin nor bu'i gter//ris med kun la snyil ba'i mdzad pa po//mchog gsum bla ma yid ma la phyag 'tshal//rnam 'dren bstod pa'i rta ljang dkyil 'khor can//phan bde'i 'od sgrib dgra bgegs nam mkha'i gos//mthu stobs nus pa'i rlung gis gtore mdzad pa'i//chos skyong bsrung ma'i tsho gis la phyag 'tshal lo//mdor na dad pa'i yid kyis snyim pa zung //snying khar zums te 'dud pa'i yul gyur pa//dge legs dpal gyi sgo 'phar 'byed mkhas pa//kun la gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo//rnyog bral dwangs pa'i chu klung 'khyil ba'i mtshor/khyun chad med 'bab pa ku snyems pa 'phrog/rnam bkra'i phang phung g.yo ba'i chu skyes kyis//dus kun dbyar du bsgyur ba'i ngal ba bsten//ma la ya yi tshal las 'ongs min pa'i//rmad byung dri bsung nam mkha'i glang por 'gran//mun pa'i go skabs 'phrog pa'i mar me'i 'phreng //bcu gnyis bdag po pham snyam 'gog med rgyu//sna tshogs sman gyis sbags pa'i chal chil dri//rba rlabs srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar du 'khrug/chog mi shesapa'i phun tsho gis bgos bzang ro//legs bris bdud rtsi ji bzhin bla na med//dbyar skyes rnga gsang sgra la rgyud mang glu//snyan brjid rnam mang gdangs kyi rol mo sogs//dngos bshams yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa 5ba'i bul//thugs rjes brtser dgongs bzhes la dngos grub stsol//oṃ spru la skru la su go ri ka sto bu d+dha bo dhi sa te saḥs pa ri wā ra a nas sha lta'i bar brjod/nyon mongs bag chagasadabang gi sa bon gyis//lusang ga yid gsum sgo nas rab bsags pa'i//so thar byang sems sngagasakyi lhung ba sogs//ji snyed sdig pa'i tshogs rnams snying nas bshags//rgyal bas 'gro kun myang 'das sar 'god cing //sras bcas rnams kyis rlabs chen spyod pa spyad//thos sgrog zhi bde gnyer sogs mchog dman gyi//grangs med dge ba'i tsho gos la rjes yi rang //mdzad med zo chun khyud mo'i 'khor lo nga//ma rig dra bas lam byed 'a// ba 'di//stongs min de srid bar du mtha' klas

gtor mo brgya rtsa bklags pa don 'grub/ 9)pa'i/ /'gro ba'i mgon dang skyabs su brtan par bzhugs/ /ji snyed khams dang bsam pa'i bye brag gis/ khyu gos mtho dman theg par mos pa'i blo/ /ma 'dres 'tsham par ston pa'i gsung rab mchog /dam chos chad pa med par bstan du gsol/ /chu shel kha ba'i rdul brtsegs ri bong can/ /sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan rtsa bas bskrun min pa'i/ /rang g.yin rnams kyis ma lus bsags pa yi/ /rnam dkar dge tsho gis kun mkhyen thob phyir bsngo/ /rab stims rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams la/ /rab tu dri bzang bstar ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /rab mdzes snod du bskrun te khrus gsol bas/ /rab rmongs(7na)'gro ba'i sgrib pa byang gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta tha ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sam ya shri ā ཿlha/ 'jig rten dbang phyug phyag sor las babs pa'i/ /mu tig 'phreng ltar 'ongs pa'i 'o ma'i rgyun/ /babs pas yi dwags kun tshim sdug bsngal gyis/ /nad ltar mnar ba'i tsho gos kun zhi gyur cig /byuḥgyi// oṃm ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ oṃ dzā la ma te sa khyu bre te ༷ ཿswā hā/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang phyag mthil du/ /rab dmar ye shes skar mda' ni/ /phyogs gnyis mnyam gzhag mchod sbyin las/ /bab pa'i bdud rtsis 'gro tshim shog /oṃ dz+nyā na a wa lo zhi te sa man+ta su ra ṇa sa smi bha wa sam ya ma hā ma ṇi du ru du ru hri da ya dzā la ni swā hā/ /slar yang de nyid gnas gyur te/ /bcom ldan rdo rje mi zhabrug pa/ /phyag sor las babasachu rgyun gyis/ /nyam chung 'gro rnams dbugs na shog /na mo rat+na tra stu ya/ /oṃ kai ka na kai ka ni/ro tsa ni ro tsa ni/ hro gni to gni/ bhā sa ni tra sa ni/ bra ti ha na bra ti ha na/ sab ga me pa ri pa ra ṇi me sa sa tā nā ñtsa swā hā/ pad zla'i gdan steng dza yig las/ dzam ser pi dza pu ra g.yas/ g.yon pa ne'u le 'dzin pa yi/ /sku la mi 'khrug gnas gyur ba'i/ /spyan ras gzigs gyi phyag sor las/ /byung ba'i mi zad nyal 'gro'i rgyun/ /sbyin bas me sogs zug rngu kun/ /sos nas bde bas tshim gyur cig /oṃ dzam bha la dza len+d+ra ye swā hā/ /gong gi chu sbyin gsum po 'di'i skabs chu sbyong ba sogs 9ba phyag len ltar bya/ /mdor na rnyog bral rab bsil ba/ /reg pas klu sogs 'gro kun rgyud/ /sbyin pa sems kyi rgyan gyur cing / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob gyur cig /de nas gtor ma byin rlabs gong ltar byas—433

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)la/ mgron rnams rang rang gi mos pa dang mthun pa'i 'dod yon gyis tshim par bsams la/ na maḥs spru ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūṃ/ lan gsum me bdun nyer gcig skabs dang sbyar la/ lta gu ru ta thā ga ta de wi ka ma tra la tri rat+na sa pa ri wā ra bye/ sogs kyis mchode/ mgron chen po ni/ phul du byung ba'i 'dod pa'i yon to rnams kyis spras pa'i bdud rtsi'i ro mchog brgya dang ldan pa'i gtor ma 'di nyid/ 'di yan mgron tshan 'og ma gsum la 'gre /dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgo nas phan bde rab stims kun gyi sgo 'phar 'byed pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang / bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod rdo rje/ /dpal ldan rgyu skar gyi dkyil 'khor bde dgyes/ /dmar nag 'jigasagasum gyis mtsho ni pa'i rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ dusagasum gyi stobs bcu mnga' ba sogs mchog gsum dam pa'i ngo bor bzhugs pa sras dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul gyis/ mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi thogs pa med pa'i mthus phan bde'i rtsa lag rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che yar ldan du 'gyur ba dang / lus can kun la (7na gnas skabs su tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor longs spyod sogs rgyas shing / /mthar thug gi don kha sbyor bdun ldan rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ 'di nas gzung ste mgron tshan 'og ma kun la smon lam tshigs bcad skabs rta me kyis phye ste 'don/ mgron tshan gnyis pa ni/ /bha wa'i mjug tu/ oṃ sa spru badz+ra dharmā pā li ka a lha sogs kyis mchode/ myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa/ phyag bzhi pa/ gur gyi mgon po rnam thos sras/ stobs 'phrog zhal bzhi pa/ dam can chos kyi rgyal bo/ /lha mo re ma ti sogs lung dang rtogs pa'i bstan pa srung bar byed pa'i chos skyong srung ma'i tsho gos la 'bul gyis/ 'phrin las rnam bzhi thogs pa med pa'i rdzu phrul gyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che skyong ba dang / bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi mi mthun pa'i phyogs mtha' dag zhi zhing /bsam pa'i don rnams yid bzhin du grub par mdzad du gsol/ /mgron tshan gsum pa ni/ saṃ bha ra'i mjug tu/ oṃ ma hā wa mchi rnyi bru h+ma ṇa sa pa ri wā ra/ sogs brjod/ drang srong chen po mes byin/ snag 436

gtor ma brgya rtsa bklags pas don 'grub/ 9)tsha yang dag shes/ mdun du bar ra/ gya gyur khyur ming / a 'gur g.yog 'dor te drang srong chen po mchog brgyad/ gzhan yang sman gyi drang srong bco lnga rig pa'i gnas bco brgyad la mkhas pa'i drang srong / bram ze gzhon nu sprin rin po che (7ba'i gi'u ha la gzhen nu mchog sred 'gro skyabs rtsibs kyi mu khyud la sogs pa mdor na drang srong dang bram ze bden tshig grub cing dmod ba dang smon lam gyi mthu la dbang ba rnams la 'bul gyis/ /thogs pa med pa'i rdzu phrul gyis/ bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i bde skyid 'phel zhing / /bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi nad gdon rkyen dang bar chad thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ /mgron tshan bzhi pa ni/ /bha ra'i mjug tu/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa dha na de waḥs pa ri wā ra sogs brjod/ nor gyi dbang phyug dzam bha la yab yum/ lha chen tsho gos kyi bdag po/ gnod sbyin a pa ra tsi ta/ chu bdag wa ru ṇa/ rma lha ya be/ ri'i lha rab tu mnan pa'i blo gros/ nags tshal gyi lha mo rma bya'i mdongs can/ shing gi lha kun nas 'od zer/ rtsi thog gi lha mo grub pa'i blo gros sogs gnod sbyin lha'i tshogs dang / 'tsho ba'i lha srung ba'i lha skyob pa'i lha/ 'grogs pa'i lha/ 'go ba'i lha ste/ lhan cig skyes pa'i lha sogs phan grogs srung skyob byed pa rnams la 'bul gyis/ bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la kha na ma tho bas dben pa'i zas gos rta glang po/ bang mdzod sogs 'byor pa kun 'bad rtsol med par 'byung bar mdzad du gsol/ /mgron tshan lnga pa ni/ 6bha ra'i mjug tu/ rang gi mdun du chu skyes 'dab bzhi'i dbus/ rgyal ba shāka thub gtor ma'i rdzas rnams(8na na/ mang por spel phyir de bzhin gshegs pa mchog /rin chen mang la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /mdun ngos phyag na pad+ma mi sdug pa'i/ /ga pa'i gzugs 'chang mtha' dag yid 'ong bar/ /mag par grub mdzad de bzhin gshegs pa mchog /gzugs mdzes dam pa de la phyag 'tshal/ /g.yas su zur phud lnga pa bza' btung la/ /brten pa'i 'tshe ba zhi zhing bzang po'i ro/ /rab tu myong mdzad de bzhin gshegs pa sku/ /'jam klas gang la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /g.yon du lag na rdo rje phan tshun kun/ /'thab rtsod 'phrog brdung 'jigs pa las skyob pa'i/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs pa thams cad dang / /—437

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)yongs su bral ba gang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di rnams mgron tshan 'og ma kun la sbyor/ /mgron rnams so so'i yid dang mthun pa'i kha dog dri ro med du byung ba'i gtor ma 'di nyid/ 'og ma kun la rigasa'agre /sa'i lha mo bstan ma/ gzhan yang yul phyogs dang sa phyogs dgon gnas srung zhing skyong ba'i yul lha gzhi bdag rnams la dbul gyis/ bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams 'gro ba'i tshe na ma bgol/ 'dug na ma gtong / 'tsho ba sbyor/ bya ba dang spyod pa nyes pa la ko long ru nga phrag dog ma byed par 'dod pa'i don kun yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ mgron tshan drug pa ni ྾/(8ba)gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po rta bdag brgyad dang / 'phrog ma ma bu lnga brgya/ rmu bdud btsan rgyal bo ma srin klu gnod sbyin te sdebargyad mthu bo che sogs/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhal mthong zhing / gsung gi bdud rtsis dbugs dbyung ba'i mi ma yin mthu bo che rnams la 'bul gyis/grangs med pa'i sems can rnams la byams pa'i sems dang ldan zhing / bdag cag 'khor dang bcasapa rnams kyi bsam don chos bzhin 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ mgron tshan bdun pa ni ྾/ /bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu/ gdon rigs sum brgya drug cu/ byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga sogs/ tshe la brku ba/ srog la 'jab pa/ mi 'dod pa ster ba sogs gnod byed gdon bgegasa'abyung po rnams la byin no/ /yul phyogs dang sa phyogs rnams su 'thab rtsod 'khrug long nad yams mu ge sad ser than pa mi nad phyugs nad sogs ma gtong bar/ phan pa'i sems dang ldan par byos shig /mgron tshan brgyad pa ni ྾/ 'gro ba rigs drug la rgyud lnga skye gnas bzhis bsdus pa'i mar gyur sems can thams cad la byin no/ /tsha grang bkres skom/ glen lkugs/ skye rga na 'chi 'thab rtsod 'chi 'pho lhung byed sogs mdor na sdug bsngal gsum las grol te/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug rdzogs nas myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya bar gyur cig /mgron tshan dgu pa ni ྾/ /mdang da nang shi ba bsad pa (9na 〉 rtse bas pa sogs 'jig rten 'di snang gi snang ba thams cad 'gags shing / phyi ma'i lus ma rnyed par shing bal rlung gis bskyod pa bzhin du las kyis rang dbang med par 'phyan pa'i bar —438

gtor ma brgya rtsa bklag pa don 'grub/ 9)do'i sems can rnams la byin no/ /mi sdug pa'i gzugs dang sgra 'od sogs 'jigs shing skrag pa'i sdug bsngal mtha' dag ma 'khrul bar rang ngo shes te myur du mtho ris kyi srid ba 'grub par gyur cig /mgron tshan bcu pa ni ྾/ /yi dwags kyi rgyal mo kha la me 'bar mas gtso byas/ yi dwags phyi'i sgrib pa can/ nang gi sgrib pa can/ zas sgom gyi sgrib pa can/ byings na gnas pa dang / kha 'thor ba sogasabakres sgom dbul 'phongs kyis gdung ba rnams la sbyin no/ /zas skom mi rnyed pa dang / rnyed kyang gzhan gyis bsrungs te spyod du med pa dang / phun sum tsho gos pa'i zas kyang mi gtsang bar mthong ba sogs sngon bsags kyi las stug po las byung ba'i bkren pa'i sdug bsngal mtha' dag byang nas zasaskom 'dod dgu'i gter la longs spyod par gyur cig /mgron tshan bcu gcig pa ni ྾/ /sngon nasad lta'i bar du srog bcad pa/ nor rdzas rku 'phrog brdeg bcom sogs gnod pa byas pa la brten nasalan chags pa rnams la byin no/ /lan chags byang bu lon 'khor sha 'khon zhi ste/ (9ba ra du rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob par gyur cig /mgron tshan bcu gnyis pa ni ྾/ /slo bur du lhags shing skal ba chad pa/ kha zhan zhing dbang chung ba/ lhag la re ba'i mgron rnams la byin no/ /zas skom bdud rtsi'i char chen pos tshim nas chags sdang 'tshe ba'i bsam pa thams cad spangs te/ myur du stobs bcu mnga' ba'i go 'phang thob par gyur cig /de ltar dngos gzhi'i rim pa rnams/ legs par grub nas mjug gi rim/ /bden bdag gi bsam pa'i stob dang ni/ zhes sogs dang chos rnams tham cad rgyu las thong zhes sogs/stobasabarjod sogs spyi 'gro ltar/ byas rjes gshegs gsol dge ba bsngo/ /phun tshogs dga' ston la rol ba'i/ /tshe tog 'thor zhing shis brjod rnams/ /go rims bzhin du 'di ltar brjod/ /bde gshegs rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas/ /spyan drangs ye shes sems dpa' bdag la thim/ /'jig rten mgron rnams zang zing chos sbyin gyis/ /smin grol gyur nas rang rang gnas su gshegs/ /rab dkar lhag bsam gser mngal thod yangs las/ /mchod sbyin yan lag brgyad ldan drangs pa'i mthus/ /'gro 'di'i khyab 'jug rkang pa'i duḥ kha'i dri/ /sbyangs te phan bde'i dpal la spyod gyur cig /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i —439

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)thugs rje'i gru char gyis/ /rigs drug nyam nga'i sdug bsngal me 'obs che/ /lhag mar bcom pa'i bde legs pad dkar (10na〉la/ /lus can rkang drug dpal du rgyas gyur cig /gtan pa med par 'bul dang sbyin sogs kyi/ /dge tshogs shugs drag rta ljang gis drangs pa'i/ /rnam 'dren go 'phang nam mkha'i nor bu yis/ /gtan bde'i 'od stong srid 'dir rgyas gyur cig /dbyangs snyan 'chi med rgyud mang las drangs pa'i/ /rgyal ba sras bcas chos srung lha tsho gos kyi/ /mgrin pa'i lam las 'ongasapa'i shis brjod sgra/ /srid 'dir rnam par 'bar ba'i bkra shis shog /smras pa/ sngon byon dam pa'i phyag srol ma nyams ljon shing las/ /ma 'dres tshig gi lhug phran gzhen nu'i dbyang thag rtser/ /don bzang lo ma'i phang phung 'khrigs pa'i mgo lcog ldem/ /blo gros 'dab ldan khu byug yong na tshul 'disamadzes/ /sbyor dngos rjes tshang chog sgrigs gcig pu las/ /rgyas bsdus 'byed dang bstun na gnyisa'agyur ba'i/ /ngo mtshar sgyu ma'i snang bas ston mkhas pa/ /byed po 'di 'dra tshangs pas sprul lam ci/ /lhag bsam dkar po'i rnga yab kyis/ /bskul ba'i dge tsho gos dri bzhen des/ /mtha' med mar gyur gnyis 'thung la/ /reg pa'i dga' bde 'phel gyur cig /gtor ma brgya rtsa rgyas bsdus gnyis ka yod pa zhig dgos zhes/ /se chen dbon pos bskul ba la brten nas/ spros par 'dod na dkyus dang bstun/ rgya chos (10ba)kyis phye ba rnams kyis mdor bsdus su 'gyur zhing / rgyas bsdus gnyis ka'i 'don cha min pa rnams ser gyis phye ste/ tshig sbyor rnams go sla bar byas pa'i klags pas don 'grub ces pa 'di yang / tshangs sras ba 'ad pa'i rdo rjes dbus 'gyur sman ljongs sa'i lte ba'i shar phyogs 'dzin ma'i spo las mngon par 'phags shing / laṅka'i grong khyer sa la 'phos pa'i pho brang 'ol kha stag rtser sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni ngag dbang dge legs so/ /—440

gtor ma brgya rtsa 'khyer bde kun phan/ 9)༄7/ /gtor ma brgya rtsa 'byer bde kun phan bkunas theg/ /dus gsum rgyal kun kun gyi brtse ba rnams/ gcig bsdus lha mchog mchog dman 'gro ba'i gnyen/ /phyag na pad dkar dkar 'jam 'dzin mkhas pa/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang dbang phyug dam par 'dud/ /dkar gsum sman gyis spras pa'i ril bu chu/ /ting shag snod sogs nyer mkho legasapar bshams/ /dri nga'i zas dang rdzas kun nyer spangs nas/ /bde ba'i stan la 'dug ste 'di skad do/ /bla ma sangs rgyas cho me dang dge 'dun la/ /bdag sogs sems can ma lus skyabs su mchi/ /'gro ba'i don du rdzogs byang thob pa'i ched/ /bla med byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do/ /swā bhā wa yi sngagasakyis legs sbyangs nas/ /brtan g.yo'i chos kun stong pa'i ngang nyid las/ /paṃ las pad+ma a las zla ba'i steng / /rang sems gyi yig yongs gyur bdag (2na(da ni/ /'jig rten dbang phyug zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ /rtsa phyag thal sbyar lhag mas shel phreng dang / /pad dkar 'dzin cing zhabs gnyis skyil dkrung bzhugs/ /rin chen rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' gsol/ /gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyisamatshan pa yis/ /thugs ka'i hūṃ sngon dag las 'od 'phros pas/ /ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangasaganyis med gyur/ /dbang lha spyan drangs bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis/ /dbang bskur 'od dpag med kyisadabu brgyan gyur/ /oṃ gra tas bsang su bhā wa yis sbyangs/ /stong pa'i ngang las rgyu las rin chen snod/ /oṃ las mchod gtor 'dod yon rnam pa lngas/ /khyad par byas pa'i kun tu bzang po yi/ /mchod pa'i sprin gyis gang zhing 'phel bar gyur/ /oṃ āḥlha/ med du byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin tsho gis rnams/ /blo yis blangs te gus pas rab tu 'bul/ /sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan ma lus par/ /mi phyed dang pa'i —441—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbas blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)yid kyis phyag tshal bstod//thugs ka'i sa bon dag las 'od 'phros pas//mchod pa'i lha tsho gis ma lus spyan 'dren gshegs//sbyin par bya ba'i bza/yul gyi mchog dman kun//thogs pa med par gnas 'dir rab 'dus shing //badz+ra sa ma dzaḥpad+ma ka ma la ye ri//skyabs yul rnams phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul//sdog lhung kun bshags dge la rjes yi rang //skyabs su brtan bzhugs chos 'khor bskor du gsol//dge ba ma lus byang chub chen por bsngo//spyan ras gzigs dbang phyag sor lasabyung ba'i//bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis yi dwags tshim gyur cig/oṃ āḥhrī hūṃ ཿcham ṇi pad+me hūṃ/( la mi ti sarba bre ta 6 ཿswā hā//bsil ldan chu yis reg pas 'gro ba kun//myur du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob gyur cig/gtor ma gong ltar byin brlabs ma lus mgron//tshim par bsam la sngags 'di gsum mam bdun//nyer gcig skabs sbyar brjod pa mgron tshan ni//bgraganyis kun la sbyor ba gnad du che//na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo gi te oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūṃ/rma mthar a mchod pa'i dkyusaltar du//sbyor ba mgron wo bzhi yi bar du'o//bdud rtsi'i ngo bor gyur pa'i mar gtor 'di//rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lhar 'bul gyi//bstan 'gro'i phan bde bla ma'i sku tshe spel//bdag sogs myur du sangs rgyas thob par mdzod//'dod yon lnga dang ldan pa'i mar gtor 'di//'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das bsrung mar 'bul//bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyong zhing bdag cag gi/'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub par 3nasgo dzod//gtsang zhing yid du 'ong ba'i mchod gtor 'di//drang srong bram ze bden tshig grub la 'bul//lusacan kun bde bdag gi nad gdon rnams//zhi zhing mas rkyen ma lus bsgrub par mdzod//rang rang dgyes ba bskyed pa'i mchod gtor 'di//nor dang grogs 'go lhan cig skyes lhar 'bul//mar gyur 'gro dang khyad par bdag sogs la//zas nor longs spyod dngos grub stsal du gsol///bha ra yi sngags mjug phyag 'tshal 'di//mgron tshan 'byung 'gyur kun la sbyor ba yin//bde gshegs rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo//bde gshegs gzugaX mdzes dam par ྾//bde gshegs 'byams klas

ga 'a ma brgya rtsa 'khyer bde tso phan/ (dpesku la ྾//bde gshegs 'jigs kun bral la ྾//kha dog dri ro phun tsho gos gtore ma 'di//yul lha gzhi bdag sa yi lha mor 'bul//bdag sogs gzhi lam gang 'dug mthun rkyen sbyor//nyes par phrag dog ma byed bsam don bsgrubs//yid 'ong mthun rdzas dam pa'i mchod pa 'di//rta bdag 'phrog ma sde brgyad rnams la 'bul//kun la brtse zhing lhag par bdag sogs kyi//cho ge ldan mthun rkyen mtha' dag bsgrub par mdzod//rang gi smon pa'i bza' btung longs spyod 'di//gdon bgegs 'byung po bar chad byed la ster//yul phyogs kun tu 'thab brtsod nad rigs dag/ma gtong byams pa'i sems(3bdang ldan bar bgyis//rigs drug so sor phan pa'i bza' btung 'di//mar gyur sems can rnams la brtse bas ster//ma lus sdug bsngal gsum las rab grol te//bla med rdzogasapa'i byang chub thob gyur cig/tsha grang bkres skom sel ba'i bza' btung 'di//bar dor ā+o mas pa'i sems can kun la ster//'jigs skrag sdug bsngal sems kyi 'khrul ngo sa shes te lha mi'i srid pa 'grub gyur cig/mthong na mi mthun med ba'i sbyin pa 'di//las ngan gyis mnar yi dwags tshogs la ster//bkres skom spyod du med pa'i sdug bsngal las//thar nas longs spyod tsho gos kyis tshim gyur cig/sna tsho gos dngos por sprul pa'i nyer spyad 'di//gnod lan chags pa'i 'gro ba rnams la ster//lan chags byang zhing bu lon ma lus 'khor/ga 'khon zhi ste me shes mchog thob shog/zad med mkho dgu'i 'byor pa spungs pa 'di/ /lhag 'dod dbang chung glo bur lhags la ster/ /'phongs pa'i sdug bsngal zhi nas ma rga mtho dang //nges legs go 'phang myur du thob gyur cig/bslu med rgyal ba'i bka' dang bdag cag gi/bden pa'i tshig gis deng 'dir 'phral yun du//dge tsho gis rgya mtsho 'byung ba'i smon gnas kun//thogs pa med par lhun gyis grub par shog/ye shes sems dpa' bdag thim 'jig rten pa//dga' bas tshim nas rang rang gnas su gshegs/ /de ltar (4na rdzogabs ma dag pas legasabaskrun pa'i//dge 'dis 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi bar shog/mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma lusapa//'bad pa med par lhun gyis grub par shog /༷༷sa skabs kun tu phun tsho gis bde legs kyis//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)sa steng khyab pa'i bkra shis 'phel bar shog /de ltar gtor ma brgya rtsa'i rim pa'i tshul/ /tshul bzhin ngag 'don khrigs chags tshigs su bcad/ /bcad lhug sna tsho gos spel ba min pa'i tshig /tshig nyung don gsal rgyun du 'byer bde gang / /gang yang mchog dman 'gro ba mtha' dag la/ /la lar ma yin kun la phan sems mchog /mchog tu rab dkar chos lung nor 'dzin sa/ /sa gzhi'i lo thog 'joms nus mi mthun phyogs/ /phyogs kyi pha mthar skrod pa'i sngags rigs rgyud/ khyud ldan rgya gar bod kyi yi ge'i rigs/ /rigs mang sor mo'i 'phrul ༷ byed mkhan/ /mkhan po thon mi'i gtsug lag smra ba'i ngag /ngag dbang dge legs gang des shugs 'byung du/ /du mar spel ba'i 'bol rtsom nyamasa'agyur yang / /yang dag cad na snyan tshig rjes 'gro dang / /dang po'i mgon po gang gi man ngag zung / /zung ldan bcas te bskul tshe ngag gi don/ /don gnyis grub pa'i dbang phyug blo gros gter/ /gter mdzod skal bzang la 'gyed rgya mtsho'i dpal/ /dpal ldan 'bras spungs cho me sder bkod pa dge /—444

gzhi gsum choga'i cha rkyen gtor ma cha bzhi sogs/ (di)ra༅༅//gzhi gsum cho ga'i cha rkyen gtor ma cha bzhi dang gzhi bdag gtor bsngo bzhugs//su sti bra dza bh+ya 'a snyigs lnga bdo'i smag rum stug po mā/mkhyen brtse nus pa'i mthu dpung nyin byed dbang //'char nub dang bral snang bkrag 'od po che//don kun grub pa'i thugs bskyed bser bus g.yos//de'ang gzhi gsum gyi cho ga'i gtor ma cha bzhi gtong tshul la mkhas rlom 'gasarang gi snang bar gang dran gyi sngags lugs bzhin rang lhar bskyed cing gtor ma brlab bsngos mtshon pa sbyar ba mdo lugs la mi 'thad par ma zad dbang rjes gnang thob pa'i sngon la ming yang ma thos par byed pa rnam smin mi bzad pa myong dgos pa gzhung mang por 'byung bas skabs su gang bab lag tu bstar na nyen chung la khe che bas re zhig 'di ltar/dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang sangs rgyasadang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs dang tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs kyis cha bzhi'i gtor ma rnams lha mi'i yo byad dam pa zhal zas phul du phyin pa sna tshogs kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin rgya mtsho thams cad kyis rgyas par gang zhing rgyan klubs pa dang ldan par gyur cig/mchod sbyin gyi yul du gyur pa'i mgron rnams kyang gshegs shing gdan 'dzom nas de bzhin du bzhes te longs spyod par ci gnang /gtor ma dang po/'dod yon lnga ldan zas mchog dam pa 'di//dkon mchog gsum dngos rtsa brgyud bla ma dang /yi dam rgyal ba sras2nang sa thams cad la//dbul lo mchog thun dngos grub stsal du gsol//gnyis pa/'dod yon lnga ldan zas mchogo dam pa 'di//bstan 'gro'i phan bde bla nas blar spel ba'i//༷nga ma dam can rgya mtsho'i tsho gos rnams la//'bul

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)lo 'phrin las mtha' dag sgrub par mdzod/ /gsum pa/ 'dod yon lnga ldan zas mchog dam pa 'di/ /gdon bgegs nga po lan chags rgyud lnga'i 'gro/ /snying rje'i yul du gyur pa ma lus par/ /bsngosatshim sgrib byang sangs rgyas myur thob shog /bzhi pa/ 'dod yon lnga ldan zas mchog dam pa 'di/ /yul gzhis gnas mal 'tsho ba nyer sbyor ba'i/ /bstan ma bcu gnyis lha klu la sogs par/ /'bul lo chos ldan 'phrin las thogs med sgrubs/ bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni/ /de bzhin gshegasapa'i sbyin stobs dang / /chos kyi dbyings kyi sto bos rnams kyis/ /'phags pa rnams la mchode pa dang / /sems can rnams la byin pa yis/ /don rnams gang dag bsams pa kun/ /de dag thams cad ci rigs pa/ /'jig rten khams 'dir ma lus par/ /thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig /chos 'khor rgyal du thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i phyag bzhes la so thar byang sems gsang sngags kyi phyir bcos mdzad pa de gsum thob pa'i gang zag gi phun sum tsho gos pa'i blang byar dgongs nasagasungs na'ang ma thob pa rnams kyi spang byar bshad bas gang thob kyi phyir bcos legs ba bzhin du cha bzhi'i gtor ma 'bul tshul yang so thar gyi skabs mdo dang 'brel ba legs par mthong (2bzhang tshig sna thung bar phal cher dga' ba ltar bkod/ gzhi bdag gtor ma cung zad rgyas pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyisabarlabs dang tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mtha' thang chen po dang chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs kyis gtor ma lha mi'i yo byad dam pa zhal zas phul du phyin pa sna tshogs kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin rgya mtsho thams cad kyis rgyas par gang zhing rgyan klubs pa dang ldan par gyur cig /bstan skyong yul lha gzhi bdag gi tsho gis dang bcas pa thams cad gshegasashing gdan 'dzom nas de bzhin du bzhes te longs spyod par ci gnang / mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di nyid sa'i lha mo bstan mas gtso byas sa gzhi kun la dbang ba'i gnyug mar gnas pa rnams dang khyad par bod kha ba can gyi rgyal khams bsrung zhing skyong ba'i srung —446

gzhi gsum choga'i cha rkyen gtor ma cha bzhi sogs/ (dpem bstan ma bcu gnyis/ lha klu sogs mi ma yin mthu bo che spyi dang bye brag yul phyogs sa phyogs 'di dag gi dgon grong gnas mal bsrung ba'i bstan skyong rdo rje drag mo rgyal/ pe har dgra lha chen po gnas chung chos kyi rgyal po sogs dkar phyogs la mngon par dga' ba ma ltar byams shing sring ltar dungs pa mgon skyabs dpung gnyen mdzad pa'i tsho gis rnams la 'bul lo/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa dang / bstan pa'i rtsa lag dam pa rnams zhabs pad brtan (3na tha dang 'jig rten khams su mi 'dod pa'i nyer 'tshe zhi zhing dge legs rgya chen po 'byung ba dang / bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa'i gzhis lam byes gsum thams cad mthun rkyen mtha' dag sbyor/ chos ldan gyi 'phrin las thams cad sgrubs/ sngon gyi las dang 'phral gyi rkyen las gyur pa'i bya spyod ga par ru nga phrag dog ma mdzad par phyi nang gi nad gdon bar gcod mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni/ zhesasogs brjod/ deng dus khyad 'phags sgoms gdungs smig rgyu'i chus/ /sel 'dod snyan grags rjes bsnyeg ring spongs la/ /thub gsung ji bzhin bstar nas rang gzhan kun//rnam mkhyen go 'phang sgrubs shig shes ldan tshogs/ /zhes chos sde chen po dpal ldan sa spungs kyi dge skos rgan pa gsung rab smra ba rab stims pa thogs med dpal bzang gis kha btags nyin bde ma/ dngul gyi srang ga brgya phrag gos yug dang bcas cha bzhi dang gzhi bdag gtor ma gnyis sngar yod ring thung zhugs nas 'don mi bde bar cha thams cad kyis mthun par gsungs chog pa zhig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /—447

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)༄༄/ /klu gtor bdud rtsi'i 'o ma'i chu rgyun bzhu lta kas theg/ /na maḥlā 'o pad+ma shu'i ya/ rgyal kun thugs rje'i rang gzugs 'jig rten dbang / /dran pas srid zhi'i gdung sel la btud nas/ /gdengs can tsho gos kun dga' byed gtor ma yi/ /las rim bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun spel bar bya/ /de yang klu gtor gyi rim pa 'di la lo rgyus dang / gdams pa dngosaganyis las/ dang po ni/ sngon dpal rga los dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal du dug shing la sku rgyab brten nas thugs dam mdzad pas/ dug sprul gyis bsdams te snyun nad drag pos thebs pa na/ dkon cog la skyabs 'gro mdzad pas jo bo kha sar pā ṇi zhal gzigs nas gdams pa 'di gnang ba thugs nyams su bstar bas de ma thag tu sku khams bde bar gyur/ bla ma bod du 'byon par mas pas klu rnams kyis/ khyed kyi gtor mas nged tsho'i lus snad pa rnams gsos shing phan pa rgya chen po byung bsabazhugs par gsol ba btab/ de la brten slar bod du phebs skabs kyang gtor ma 'di dar bar mdzad pas char chu dus su 'bab pa sogs bkra shis dge mtshan grangs med pa (2na nga / /des zhad mtshal pa la gnang zhing / /rtsa ba'i bla ma bar du dar rgyas su bzhugs pa'o/ /gnyis pa lag dmas pa dngos la btsas bshams pa dang / bsngo ba gnyis las dang po ni/ dkar gsum dang mngar gsum zan dang sbyar ba la klu sman g.yin rnams kyang bsres pa'i ril bu'am chang bu gang rung / chu gtsang dang 'o ma bsres pa la klu sman btab pa/ rgyas par spro na mdun du pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i steng du klu gzugs bkod/ gtor snod so sor klu sman rnams ma 'dres par spyan gzigs kyi tshul du bshams/rang nyid khrus dang gtsang sbra dang ldan pas sha chang sgog btsong sogs spangs te/ kha byang shar la blta 448

klu ga kho bod rtsi'i 'o ma'i chu sa/ 9)bas stan bde ba la 'dug ste nyams su blang bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni skyabs 'gro semasabaskyed tshad med bzhi bsgom/ /su bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i brag gser gyi bya skyibs kha byang shar du lta ba'i nang du/ /paṃ las pad+ma a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/rang sems yi ge myi dkar po las 'od 'phros/(2bton gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid jo bo kha sar pā ṇi sku mdog dkar bo zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ cho rtag yas mag sbyin dang g.yon pad+ma'i rtsa ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs gyisaspras pa/ snang ba mtha' yas kyi dbu rgyan can/ zhabs gnyis sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugasapa'i dpral bar oṃ/ /mgrin par tsa sna thugs dar hūṃ/ de gsum ga hrīḥ dkar dmar mthing khas so sor bskor ba/ /thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer sa pas rang 'dra'i ye shes pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥsaspyan drangs/ dzaḥ/ baṃ ho sa bstim/ klu mchod byin gyis brlab pa ni/ hwa bhā was sbyangs/ gtor ma chab sman rnams stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las: las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/bcud rnams bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po klu rnams tshim zhing nad kun gso ba'i bde ba skyed par byed las dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ sa/ dang nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ rang gi mdun du rin po che'i brag gser gyi bya skyibs can gyi 'og tu/ mtsho/ rdzing lteng ka /chu mig /khron pa/ 'bab chu/ ne'u gsing / spang ljongs/ skyed tshal khang bzang sogs nyams dga' ba'i nang du klu rgyal wa ru ṇa sa gtso byas/ klu chen brgyad stod mi la smad sprul mjug can/ /rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ klu rigs grangs med pa'i 'khor gyi bskor (3na thar bsam/ lcags kyu'i phyag rgya dang bcas thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas klu rgyal wa ru ṇa la klu chen brgyad / gzhan yang 'jig rten khams kyi klu dang sa bdag thams cad zla ba'i gdan la rlung gis bskyod de 'ur sgra dang bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥdzaḥ/ baṃ ho me ya stim/ phyag na rdo rje'i mthu stobs dang /rta mgrin dbang gi byin rlabs kyis/ /gtso bo klu chen brgyad po dang / /rgyal rigs rje rigs dmangs—44mi

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)riṭa dang /bram ze gdol pa la sogs pa/ /ri rab rtse dang rgya mtsho'i gting / /steng 'og phyogs mtshams gang gnas klu/ /gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ nā ga rā dza sa pā ri wa ra sam ya hūṃ dzaḥ dzaḥ dzaḥ& baṃ horang rang dgyes pa skyed 'i nus pa/ /yid kyis sprul pa'i gnas mchog 'dir/ /pad+ma'i gdan la rab bzhugs nas/ /mchod pa'i tshogs rnams bzhes su gsol/ na maḥs spru ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūṃ/ lan bdun dang de bzhi gshegs pa bzhi'i mas brjod/ rang nyid thugs rje chen por gsal ba yi/ /phyag sor rtse las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa/ /mchod pa'i tsho gos dang lhan cig 'dres pa de/ /klu dang sa bdag rnams kyis longs spyod gyur/ zhes brjod cing don bsam nas/oṃ bā su ke me swāhā brgya rtsa dang / na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe saḥsarba ta lha ca te sngar ṇa i me ga ga na kho swāhā zhes pa dang / nā (3bka rā dza sa pā ri wā ra a mṛ ta da ka pā dza te āḥ/ zhes pa lan grangs mang por brjod cing bsngos pas/ klu rnams tshim pas dngos grub ster zhing dga' bas rang la 'dud cing bskor bar bsam la tshigs bcad kyis bsngo zhing smon lam gdab pa ni/ wa ru ṇa sogasaklu chen brgyad po dang / sa bdag klu yi rigs su gyur pa la/ /ga bur dza tis dbugs nyams sosagyur cig /gur kum tsan dan dri ngad bzang gyur cig /dbang po lag pas yan lag sos gyur cig /chu srin sder mos sen mo sos gyur cig /dkar dmar mtshal gyis khrag nyams sos gyur cig /dung gis rus pa nyams pa sos gyur cig /gzi yis mig 'bras nyams pa sos gyur cig /rgya dar dmar pos lce nyams sos gyur cig /zi hun ras skud rtsa nyams sos gyur cig /snying gi zho shas don snying sos gyur cig /sla gong zho shas sha nyams sos gyur cig /mkhal ma zho shas mkhal nyams sos gyur cig /pu shel rtse sa rtsa nyams sos gyur cig /rma bya'i mdongs kyis mdog nyams sos gyur cig /sgrul gyi shun pas pags nyams sos gyur cig /thang lo smyug los skra tsho gos sos gyur cig /rdo rgyus dag gis rgyus 'khums sos gyur cig /gu gul dkar pos tshil nyams sos gyur cig /bu ram ka rasaro mchog myong gyur cig /me tog shing tog lus kun mdzes gyur cig /rin po che yis tshe dpal rgyas—450

klu ga kho bod rtsi'i 'o ma'i chu rgyun/ (gegyur cig/rgya mtsho lha bas rkang mar sos gyur cig/nā ga pad+mas rna dbang sos gyur cig/4 na ngos yang sle tes li shi sug smrel dang //zi ra dkar na ga āt+pal sngon po dang //a ru ra dang spang spos til dkar nag/thal ka rdo rje so ma ra dza dang //rgyan 'brum shing mngar sbrang rtsi dar zab tshogs//dkar gsum gyis mdzes mchode sbyin gtor ma dang //mngar gsum gyis bran 'o ma'i rgya mtsho sogs//klu rnams dga' ba'i mthun pa'i rdzas rnams kyis//so so'i re ba yongs su skong gyur cig/nang gi don snod phyi yi sha lngags rus/skra sen bkrag mdangs rtsa rgyus nyams pa dang /gzhe gos bskams zha 'on lkugs sogs sdug bsngal gyi//'jigs pa kun las klu rnams thar gyur cig/bye tshan mkha' lding me dang thog la sogs//gnod pa kun bral sprul mgo'i gdengs ka ldan//rin cen brag skyibs mtsho rdzing chu mig dang /zhe'u gseng skyed tshal rnams dang ldan gyur cig/mdor na lus dang sems la bdo ba dang //dga' skyid ma lus tshogos kun 'byung gyur cig/de ltar klu rnams sman gyis legs gsosashing /bzang po'i smon lam btab pa 'di yi mthus//bdag sogs 'gro ba sems can ma lus pa/mthong reg bsam dang kha rlangs sbyor ba yi//sa bdag klu yi dug kun zhi bar mdzod//'phags mchoge spyan ras gzigs kyi bkas gnang ba'i//'dod yon lnga ldan gtor ma 'di bzhes la//lan chagasa'akhor zhing sha 'khon ma lus byang //'jig rten khams su char chu dus 'bab cing /lo phyugs sman dang nags tshal rab tu rgyas//'gro rnams nad med bde 4ba jid phun tsho gos pa'i//legs pa'i yon tan ma lusahrūb par mdzod/chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste//zhes sa dang /chos rnamasathams cad rgyu las byung /zhes sogs brjod rang gi lus la dpe longs la/gzhan la gnod pa ma byed cig/phan pa'i 'bras bu bde ba 'byung //gnod pa'i 'bras bu sdug bsngal 'byung //sa bon tsha ba rnam pa bzhis//'bras bu tsha ba skyed par 'gyur//sa bon mngar ba btab pa las//'bras bu mang rab skye bar 'gyur//dpe dang bcas pa'i chos bshad pa//khyed rnams kyis ni shes par gyis//zhes brjod//klu'i sdig pa bshags pa ni//na mo rat+na tra yā ya/lta /ni kai ka ni/ro tsa ni ro tsa ni/khro ṭa ni to ṭa 4

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)ni/ tra sa ni tru sa ni/ bra ti ha na bra ti ha na/ sarba lamaḥpa raṃ pā ra ṇi me sarba swā tā nā dro swāhā/ zhesabadun brjod nas smon lam gdab pa ni/ 'di ltar bgyis pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /klu gnyan sa bdag ma lus pa'i/ /nad gdon 'jigs skrag kun zhi nas/ /bde ba chen por longs spyod shog /phyi ma lha mi'i lus thob cing / dam pa'i chos dang mjal ba yis/ /sangs rgyas go 'phangs ma gyur nas/ /rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub par shog /gzhan yang med byung sras bcas ma sogs smon lam gyi tshig ci rigs par brjod/ 'di ltar bdag gis mchode gtor klu sman bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po dngos su bshams shing / yid kyis sprul te phul ba la brten nas/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis ma rig pa'i dbang gis khyed rnams kyi lusang ga yid gsum la phog (ldan)thug nongs pa bgyis pa mtha' dag bzod par mdzod la/ klu dang sa bdag las byung ba'i gnod pa thams cad zhi ba dang yul phyogs 'di dag tu lo tog la phan pa'i char chen po 'bebs par mdzad du gsol/ bya khyung gi phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ chan ga ra dza sa pā ri wa ra sarba la zhes mgron rnams rang gnas su gshegs par bsam/ bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dag dang / zhes sogs dang bkra shis pa'i tshigasabacad ci rigs pa brjod par bya'o/ /de ltar gdengs can tsho gis rnams mnyes byas nas/ /'gro ba'i nad zhi char gyi rgyun bzang pos/ /rtsi shing lo tog rgyas par byed pa'i thabs/ /bdud rtsi'i 'o ma'i chu rgyun 'di ko mtshar/ rnam dkar dge ba'i rlung gis legs drangs pas/ /phan bde'i ma la ya yi dri bsrung gis/ /srid zhi'i gdung ba ma lus drungs phyung te/ /'gro rnams kun mkhyen ye shes thob par shog /ces klu gtor bdud rtsi 'o ma'i chu rgyun 'di ni don gnyer can du mas bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar/—432

klu ka' sa khyer/ 9)ra༅༅/ /klu gtor rgyun khyer bzhugs so/ /gdengs can tsho gis rnams dga' ba bskyed pa la/ /brten nas 'gro la phan bde'i dpal ster ba/ /tshegs chud tsam gyis sgrub nus ngo mtshar gtam/ /zhakhrul med dam pa'i gsung rgyun 'di na spel/ /de yang gtor ma phyag len ltar bshams/ rdo rje gnod sbyin gyis phyag rgyas/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūṃ/ zhes pasam dag pa bsangs/ rdo rje me'i phyag rgyas/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bha sdu ra ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pas gzi byin bskyed/ rdo rje bsdam pa'i phyag rgya/ oṃ a kha ro mu khaṃ sarba dha rmā 'o ār+ya nu dzin tā ta oṃ sa/ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pas rin po che'i snod du bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'dod pa'i yo byad kyis gang bar bsam/ 'dod rgyal gyi phyag rgyas rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer los pas klu'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa dang / bye brag tu bdag cag la gnod pa'i klu'i rigs thams cad badz+ra sam dzaḥs spyan drangs lta/ klu rgyal mtha' yas nor rgyas bu/ /'jog po dang ni stobs kyi rgyu/ /pad+ma pad+ma r+pā po dang / /dung skyong dang ni rig ldan no/ /lha (2na glo lha mo chen po dang / zla ba'i spyi gtsug spyi gtsug che/ /dbyug 'dzin dgrag 'dzin chen po dang / /sog ma med dang hu lun+ta/ /dga' bo dang ni nyer dag 'bo/ /rgya mtsho rgya mtsho chen po dang / /tsha ba tsha ba chen po dang / dpal gyi 'od dang 'od po che/ /rin cen 'od dang gzugs mdzes dang / gzugs mdzes chen po sbrul bzang dang / /sto 'phye chen po tsi li dang / tsi li chen po rnam dag ni/ /mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ ā ci ā ca ma hā nā ga adhi pa ta le sarba bhu wa phyi phu swāhā/ zhes pas mdun du byon par bsam la/ pad+ma ka ma la ye ri gyisagadan phul/ mahā nā ga a dhi pa ta ye gro sna rda a swāhā/ sgyu t+pa swāhā/ di paṃ swāhā/ ga swāhā/ zhes pasamachod la/ klu dga' bar byed pa'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ hi li hi li mahā hi li / bu swāhā/ zhes lan gsum —433

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)pa/ lta bhak+ṣa ya bha k+ṣa ya sam ya tiṣ+ṭha / phu hūṃ swāhā/ zhes lan gsum la sogs pas phul nas/ ye dha rmā he tu bra bha wā he tu te khri n+ta thā ga to spo wad ta/ te sa ñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā di (2bsgo hā shra ma ṇa: sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste/ /dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /zhes cho me kyi sbyin pa byin la/ klu'i rgyal po brgyad kyis gtso byas pa'i klu'i rigs su gyur ba thams cad dang / bye brag tu bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la/ gnod cing lan chags pa'i klu dang sa bdag thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim zhing mnyes par gyur cig /gnod pa dang gdug pa'i bsam pa zhi zhing phan pa dang zhi bas byang chub kyi sems ldan par gyur cig ces dang / oṃ nā ga a dhi pa ta ye ga : zhes pas gshegs su gsol/ bya khyung gi phyag rgyas/ chag ru ḍa he tsa le tsa le swāhā/ zhes pas nag po'i klu rnams bskrad par bsam/ bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang / chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis/ /don rnamasagang dag bsam pa kun/ /de dag thams cad ci rigs par/ /thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig zhesabaden stobs brjod/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ /thob nas nyes pa'i dgra rnams pham byas te/ /skye rga na 'chi'i rba slong 'khrugs pa yi/ khrid pa'i mtsho las 'gro ba sgrol bar shog /ces sogs bsngo smon bya'o/ /spyir klu gtor ni thebs yod med la ltos na dpal ldan sa skya ba'i phyag len gyi dkar cha bzhi pa'i nang gi klu gtor 'di rgyun du mdzad cing phan yon che bas/ 'phags ba rin po che dang rgyal sras thogs(3na thad bzang po dpal sogs gong ma rnams kyis yig cha nas/ rje shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan gyis gsal bar mdzad pa'i yi ge las phyung ste rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i rgyun khyer du za hor gyi brnyes bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni gnas ban 'jam dbyangs so/ /—454

sa༅༅//bsur chog gi rim pa yid bzhin 'dod 'jo bzhugs//tshegs chud dge ba bsgrub blo'i shel gyi ngos//rang bzo 'bod sgrog gzugs brnyan stong 'char yang //dngos dang 'dra min ma 'dres sud pa'i gtam//gsong por smra la dpyod ldan rna ba ltogs/de'ang bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' dri ma med par yi dwags la zan spos/'bru sna tsho gos dang bcasapas bstan nas rang nyid bza' gas gang yang ma spyad pa'i sngon rol chu sbyin byed pa rgya bod kyi mkhas grub kun la yongs su grags shing rje btsun gong ma rnams kyis dkar cha bzhi'i khrod kyi phyag len du mdzad pas grags che/rgyal ba'i sras po thogs med bzang po dpal sogs tshad ldan mang pos yig char bkod na'ang 'di nyid bza' btung gi snga rol sogs dus la brton dka' gnas su gyur pasaphan yon la ma bsams par byed mkhan nyung /dus nam byung la ban nam kham gyi skar ma ltar byas pa rgyu mtshan du byas te mchog dman mtha' dag la dar bas yig cha yang sna tsho gos pa shig snang zhing /tsha gsur chu gsur zhes ngag sgros yi ger bkod pa mang na'ang chu sbyin gyi sngags kyi thog mar su rū pa zhes byung ba rū pa ni gzugs kyi skad dod yin la/de'i sngon du nyer bsgyur nyi shu'i nang ge su bzhag pas nang zang ba mdzes pa legs pa sogs mang po la 'jug rung /'dir de bzhin gshegs ba gzugs mdzes kyi mtshan du bsgyur zhing sngags la brten nas su rū pa zhes btags pa ma gtogs tsha gsur gyi rang snyom de 'dra ni nam yang ma yin te/chu la bsur mi yong ba glang rdzi rgan po zhig gisakyang shes so/me la rdzas btab pa'i gsur 'di bstan pa phyi dar gyi mdo rgyud man ngag tu gsal ba yod med rang gi brtags shing mang du thos pa'i /gas du mar dris kyang khungs rnyed pa med pa 'dra/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)gsang sngags rnying ma'i phyogs la yod do zhes thams cad mgrin pa bteg nas smra na'ang / rnying ma rgyud 'bum du ngo sprod pa ma byung / bla ma dgongs 'dus su yod zer yang glegs bam dang thob yig bsdur nas btsal kyang ma rnyed gter kha gong 'og gi yin zer ba'i dpe 'khyar 'dra mthong yang gter gzhung tshad ma yid ches kyi yi ger mi 'dug cing kho bos gter kha de gnyis gtso bo gyur pa'i gter ston brgyad cur nye ba'i chos kha nos rung de khrod du ye ma byung bas sngags rnying ma'i lugs la yod ces mgrin pa bteg nas smra bar ma nus mod/ 'on kyang 'di la phan yon cung zad 'byung ste/ mchod yul gong ma rnams la nyer spyod kyi nang gi bdug spos phul ba dang phyogs(2ba75'is/ yul lha gzhisabadag sogs lha 'dre'i rigs lha bsangs btang ba dang dbyibs 'dra/ dri za'i sems can la zasagos byin pa'i phan yon yong bar snang / bar de'i sems can la ster ba deng sang gtor ma mkhan po mang pos kyang bar do'i mgron tshan logs su mdzad pa byung zhing / gshin bo rjes 'dzin gyi cho ga gsar rnying phal cher la zas gtad mdzad bas de dag gis dgongs pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas kho bos mu thi la'i 'khri shing du bar do'i mgron tshan la phan yon yong na'ang brgya rtsa'i rang tshig dang 'gal zhesasmras pa yin la dbyad bzod pa rang zhig byed na rgyal ba la gdams pa'i mdor/ bar do ba la zasaskom ci bsngos kyang mi thob par gsungs shing khungs de la brten nas snyigs dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin bo che mi bzhed cing don la'ang gnas par sems/ gter ma yin zer ba zhig na oṃ su ra phug zer ba'i sngags dang slob dpon klu sgrub la kha g.yar zhag tu a sa bra ti su ra phug pa zer ba 'dug pa'ang mi shes pa zhig gis bzos pa'i rdzus ma 'dra la/ dri spos kyi mchod pa phul rjes mchoge mthun gyi dngos grub rtsol zhes gsol ba btab pa la ni skyon ci yod/ ye shes me'i dkyil 'khor dang 'phrin las bzhi'i sngags brjod pa sogs kyang sbyin sreg la gzhe gos drud bus chas pa 'dra/ phyis kyi yig cha la lar garnye'i sngags sbyar ba'ang sngags des thugs dar dri 'bul ba yin gyi shangs la bdug spos 'bul ba ni ma yin no/ /yang oṃ sa/ kho nas sngags bcad pa'ang mthong bas yid brtan du rung —456

bsur mā gi rim pa yid bsto 'dod la ro/ 9)ba'i yi ge lag tu ma son mod/ 'on kyang don gnyer can rnams kyi ngor re zhig bla chen spyi'i mdzad pa ltar khyi chu brgal gyi tshod du bkod pa'o/ /dkar gsum mngar gsum phye dang bsres pa la dkon mchog la dbul du mi rung ba dang lha 'dre la 'phog thug yong ba ma yin pa'i sman53na me shing sna sogs gang rnyed bsres pa'i rdzas dang me snod bcas mngone par 'du byas/ sangs rgyas chos tshogos ma lta bu'i skyabs sems sngon du btang rang nyid skad cig gis pad zla'i gdan la thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs kyi skur bsam/ mdun gyi rdzas rnams la dmigs te su bhā was rin po che'i snod sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang mu rin po che'i yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gsur rdzas rnams dkon cog gsum mnyes par byed pa'i bdug spos/ yul lha gzhis bdag sde brgyad rnams kyi ma dag pa sel ba'i bsangs rdzas/ dri zas su za ba'i mgron rnams kyi dbang po rnams tshim par byed 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan par gyur cig /lta lha zhes byin gyis brlabs/ rang thugasarje chen por gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer los mchod yul dang sbyin yul thams cad oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs pad+ma ka ma la ye ra gyis gdan dbul/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang semasadang / rang rgyal nyan thos chos skyong srung ma la/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i bdug spos mchode par 'bul/bzhes nas mchogo mthun dngos grub rtsal du gsol/ oṃ gu ru bu bo dhi satwa shri wa ka dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra sgyu pa gu dza me gha sa mu dra sba ra ṇa sam ya shri ye hūṃ/ snang srid lha srin sdo brgyad tsho gos rnamasadang / khyad par gzhi bdag yul lhar bcas rnams la/ /bsangs mchode 'bul gyi nyes tshogos kun byang zhing / /'phrin las thams cad lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ mu myu ta bi shurnya hūṃ/ dri za'i tshogs la 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga/ /'bul gyis dbang po thams cad rab tshims te/ /bkres skom sdug bsngal kun las rnam grol nas/ /myur du bla med byang chub thob par shog /de bzhin gshegs ba (3ba bzhi'i mtshan brjod rjes/ na ma smab ta thā ga ta a wa lo kyi te/ thor ra sam+bha ra hūṃ/ rgya chen gyi sngags kyisabasngo//chos kyi sbyin pa'ang bya/badz+ra muḥs mgron rnams rang gnas su gzhags par bsam/'jam dpal —457

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)dpa' bos ji ltar mkhyen pa sogs/ smon lam ci rigs pa bya'o/ /mkhas rnams dga' ba'i bshad khungs mi ldan yang / /dza gcog gzhan gyis 'phya ba'i gnas min tsam/ /bkod 'dis 'gro rnamasadabul phongs las thar nas/ /'di dang gtan gyi bde la longs spyod shog /sngar gong du 'gro skabasabasam dar nas kyis rnying lugs yin zer ba'i dpe zhig gtad byung bar de don bzhin zin bris byas kyang rjes su rnying ma bka' gter gyi gzhung rnams la dpyad tshe yid brtan du ma gyur pas btang snyomasasu bzhag pa las gsur bsngo zhig dgos tshul dbu mdzad blo bzang yon tan dang / brag sna chos rje blo bzang ngag dbang dang / ri khrod pa blo bzang chos 'phel gsum gyis bskul ba la brten rtsom 'dun yod pa'i thog dpal 'khor bde ba chen po'i zhi gnas slob dpon brag phyi sku skyes bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phrong rgyas lkog pa phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /su sti/ dri zhim bdug spos sprin tsho gis ltar spros nas/ /yar gnas mchode cing ma dag nyes kun bsangs/ khri za dga' bar byed pa'i mchod sbyin gyi/ /lag len ngag 'don nyung pu'i tshul du spel/ /de'ang de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs mdzes kyi mtshan sngags la gras nas ming der btags pa'i zasasna tsho gos dang chu la brten pa'i chu sbyin mdo'i khungs dang 'brel bar rje btsun de ba'i phyag bzhesadakar cha bzhi'i nang du yod la/ me la nas btab pa'i gsur sngags gsar rnying dang mdo phyogs gang nas(4na7nga bshad pa ma mthong bar ma zad/ bar do la bsngo ba don la mi gnas par thams cad mkhyen pa bu sogs bzhed cing dkon cog mchod pa 'dre bsang ba dri za la sbyin pa'i phan yon 'byung ba'i phyir lag len du bkod par dkon cog la dbul du mi rung ba dang lha 'drer 'phog thug mi yong ba'i rdzas dkar gsum mngar gsum phye dang shing sna sman spos sogs tshogis tshad dang bsres pa me snod bcas pa 'du bgyis/ sangs rgyas chos tshogos sa ma skyabs sems bya/ rang nyid gtor ma brgya rtsa'i skabs kyi thugs rje chen po lhar bskyed/ su bha was rdzas rnams mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du bsam/stong pa'i 4 las ma las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i —458

bsur ོ gi rim g.yid 4 6 'dod 'jo/ (dpegasur rdzas rnams dkon cog gsum mnyes par byed pa'i bdug spos/ yul lha gzhi bdag sde brgyad tshogs kyi ma dag pa sel ba'i bsangs/ dri zas su za ba'i mgron rnams kyi dbang po tshim par byed pa'i 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan par bsam/ oṃ 〉〉 lan gsum gyis brlab/ thugs ka nasa'od zer 'phros/ mchod yul dang sbyin yul thams cad phyag rgya dang bcas ma badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ pad+ma ka ma la ye ri gyis gdan dbul/ bla ma rgyal sras nyan rang dang / /yi dam mkha' 'gro chos srung la/ khri zhim bdug spos mcho ne pa 'bul/ /bzhes nas mchogo a dngos grub rtsol/ chabadz+rasgru paṃ pā dza me gha sa mu dra khya ra ṇa sam ya shrī hūṃ/ lha srin sde brgyad 'go ba'i lha/ /yul lha gzhi bdag ma lus pa/ /nyes tshogos dri zhim bdug pas bsangs/ /'phrin las thams cad sgrub par mdzod/ /oṃ shā rgya tā bi shudhe hūṃ/ dngar ba'i ngad ldang gsur gyi dri/ /'dod yon lnga dang ldan pa 'dis/ /dri za ma lus tshim (4bgyur nas/ /longs spyod phun sum tsho gos par shog /de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod/ rgya chen sngags ci rigs pas bsngo/ ye dha ma sogs chos kyi sbyin pa bya/ oṃ badz+ra muḥs mgron rnams rang gnas su gshegs par bsam/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ /sogs bsngo smon ci rigs pa bya'o/ zhes pa 'di'ang ldeb blo bzang mthu stobs kyi nyams len du za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /sarba man lo// //—459

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo r+sāng rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)༄༅༅//lha lnga'i gsol mchod bsod nams dpal bskyed bsdos/sa theg//dran pas srid zhi'i gdung ba kun sel zhing //mchog sa dngos grub stsol ba'i yid bzhin dbang //pad+ma snar brgyud par bcas pa la//gas nas lha lnga'i mchod wen gsal bar dgod//de'ang rang la 'go ba'i lha lnga mchod par byed pa'i mchod gtor sbyan gzigs rnams gter gzhung ltar 'du bgyis/rang nyid che mchog/phur ba rta mgrin/phyag rdor sogs yi dam gang yin gyi 'phrin lasargyas pa'am/bsdun mdzo rtogs mdor bsdus kyis gsal ba nas bzlas pa ca zad bya/ma rdzo rdzas rnams bsangs gzhud sogs kyi skabs su gyer ba'i stong gsum kun tu dri mchog 'byung gyur ba'i/zhes sogs sngags drug phyag rgya drug gam bsdun nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyisabarlab/byin rlabs phyi ma 'di byed na gtor ma brlab ba legs pas/a mi tas bsangs/swā bha wasasbyangs/stong pa'i tswa las las rin po tsho snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du ga sto mkha dog dri ro reg bya phun sum tsho gis pa'i steng du cha snyi gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/'khor 'das kyi bcud thams2na lod bsdus nas yi ge gsum la thim/de yang 'od du zhu ste 'dres pas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho zad mi shes pa'i rang bzhin du bsam/( //lan gsum brjod/lha bskyed pa ni/bsangs sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang nas rang gi mdun du paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor lnga sbrengasakyi dang po'i gdan la dz+nyā las mo lha bud med dar ma mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas mda' dar dang g.yon me long 'dzin pa/dar sngon po'i ber gsol zhing si po tsho shod sla'i dang a sna 4 6 0 pa/sha ba yu mo la bachis te sprul pa ma dang sru

lha lnga'i gsol mchode bsod nams dpal bskyed/ 9)mo'i rnam par ston pa/ gzhan yang zhang lha skyes dar ma'i cha byad can/ sprul pa bya go bo dang zhang blon mang po ston cing / ma lha sman btsun mdzes ma'i tsho gos dang bcas te sprul ba na chung mang po dang sha bar ston pa/ gnyis pa'i gdan la na las srog lha dkar bo skyes dar ma'i rnam pa can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa khrab rmog gyon cing g.yas mdung dar dang g.yon zhags pa 'dzin pa/ stag ral gzig shubasarked la bcings shing / sag (2bsnyom gsol nas rta nag sga srab gong rmed can la bcibs te/ sprul pa mi rta dkar po mang por ston pa/ gzhan yang lhan cig skyes lha dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogasakyis spras shing / sprul pa mi dkar po'i rnam par ston pa/ gsum pa'i gdan la ā las pho lha dkar po lang tsho dar la bab ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas nor bu dang g.yon rin po ches gang ba'i gzheng pa bsnams pa/ ral ba'i thor cog dar gyis bcings pa/ tse ber sngon po gsol zhing rin po che dang sag lham gyis sbud nas srab gong rmed can gyi rta mchog ngang dkar la bcibs te/ sprul pa pha skrun mang po dang khor gsum btags pa'i skyes pa'i cha byad can du ston pa/ gzhan yang pha mes kyi lha dang dbang thang gi lha sum cu rnams dang gos dang rin po che'i rgyan phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa/bzhi pa'i gdan la yu las yul lha dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ khrab rmog gyon cing stag ral gzig shubs rked pa la dkris shing sag lham gyon nas rta dkar sga srab gong rmed can la bcibs te sprul pa mched grogs dang yul gyi gtso rdzi/ lug khyu dang g.yag dkar du ma'i rnam par ston ba/ gzhan yang mkhar gyi rtse lha sogs khang pa la gnas pa'i srung ma rgyan gos sna tshogasadang ldan cing sprul pa bya chen po'i rnam par ston pa/ lnga pa'i gdan ril sha las dgra lha skyes dar ma'i cha lugs can dkar po zhi zhing 'dzum pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas dar mdung dang g.yon zhagasapa 'dzin pa/ dar dkar po'i rtse ber gsol cing dar gyi (3na jo da bcings can/ stag ral dang gzigs shubs rked la dkris shing rin po che'i rgyan sna tsho gis kyis spras ba/ zhabs la sag lham gyon nas rta dkar rlung shugs sga srab gong rmed can la bcibs te/ sprul pa dge bshes dang mi dkar zhu ba —461

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)can/ khra spyang g.yag rgod mang por ston pa/ gzhan yang steng 'og phyogs mtshams kun tu rigs 'dzin rnams kyi lha srung chos skyong gi tsho gis rnams sprul pa slob dpon sngags par ston pa/ dbang lha/ ban skyong dang bon skyong gi sprul pa bon po pha wang du ston pa/ thams cad rang gi rgyan cha lugs dang ldan pas bskor ba rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par sa dmar po/ thugs kar hūṃ sngon po dang bdag nyid yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyis gnas nas mo lha shad lha ma lha srog lha skyes lha pho lha pha mes kyi lha dbang thang gi lha yul lha rtse lha dgra lha rigs 'dzin gyi lha srung chos skyong dbang lha ban skyong bon skyong sogs 'go ba'i lha lnga sprul pa yang sprul bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ spyan 'dren ni gter kha 'og ma las/ kye dgra lha gnyan bo spyan 'dren no/ /phrag gong g.yas nas gshegs su gsol/ /sprul ni dge bshes mang por sprul/ mchod ni bsgos bu gtsang mas mchode/ /de ring bdag gi grogs la spyon/ /dam gdapung bkye la dgra dpung thul//zhang lha pha wang spyan 'dren no/ /mchan khung g.yon nas gshegs su gsol/ /sprul ni zhang blon mang por sprul/ /mchod ni (3ba gsad lug gtsang mas mchode/ /de ring bdag gi grogs la spyon/ /'gal rkyen spongs la mthun rkyen bsgrub tu gsol/ /srog lha 'dzin po spyan 'dren no/ /snying ga'i gnas nas gshegs su gso me/ /sprul ni mi dkar mang por sprul/ /mchod ni ra skyes kham pas 'di yis mchode/ /de ring bdag gi grogs la spyon/ /srog gi bar chad du srung du gsol/ /mo lha 'byung mo spyan 'dren no/ /mchan khung g.yas nas gshegs su gsol/ /sprul ni ma sru mang por sprul/ mchod ni 'brang rgyas ldem pas mchod/de ring bdag gi grogs la spyon/ /zas nor char pa dbab tu gsol/ /yul lha mgon bu spyan 'dren no/ /spyi bo'i gtsug nas gshegs su gsol/ /sprul ni grogs po mang por sprul/ /lha g.yag dkar po 'di yis mchode/ /de ring bdag gi grogs la spyon/ /yid la bsam pa thams cad bsgrub tu gsol/ /pad+ma ka ma lwa ya ri gyis gdan phul/ gsol mchod ni/ gsar spu gis/ 'go ba'i lha lnga 'khor bcas la/ /gtsang ma'i chab kyi sku khrus gsol/ /mi gtsang dri ma dag gyur cig /sna tshogs—462

lha lnga'i gsol mchod bsod nams dpal bskyed/ 9)shing sna'i dud pa yis//nyams grib ma lus bsangs gyur cig/g.ya' chu gangs chu gtsang ma'i chu//sman chab dang ldan skyems su 'bul//sna tsho gis me tog chun po'i thod//sku la mdzes pa'i rgyan du 'bul/dkar gsum mngar gsum shing rtag 'bru//bza' bca' zhim mngar bsgos bu 'bul/nyi zla nor bu 'bru mar gyi//mar me gsal byed sgron me spar/kha dog sna tsho gis za 'og gos//rin chen du ma'i do shal dang //4na cug zhu snyan cha g.yu byur bkra/go mardzo dar thod mdzes brjid mas//stag ral gzig shubs mda' mdung gri/rin chen gzheng pa nor bu sogs//phyag mtshan rlung gi shugs ldan te/sga srab mdzes pa'i chas kyis brgyan/sha ba la sogs bgrod byed bcibs//gnam la 'phur dgu sa gzhi la//'dzul dgu ri dwags 'chong dgu sogs//sna tshogs srog chags bgrang las 'das//rgyal srid bdun dang 'dod yon lnga//bkra shis rtags brgyad la sogs pa'i//lha mi'i dpal 'byor nam mkha' bkang //dngos bshams yid sprul mchod tshogs kyis//lha lnga 'khor bcasagasol zhing mchod//gtor ma rgyal mtshan bsgos bu dang //ja chang gser skyems bas pa ba'i tshogs//ljags kyi dbang po tshig byed pa'i//zhal zas skyems kyis gsol zhing mchod//mo lha shad lha ma lha la/sman gyi 'brang rgyas gsad lug 'bul//zhang po'i mda' yi mde'u dang //ma gru'i 'phang rnams rten du 'dzugs/srog lha skyes lha'i tsho gos bcas la//ra skyes kham pa'i mchod pa 'bul//'phan dar phyug po pha spun
