mda'//dar gyi ru mtshon rten du 'dzugs//pho lha pha mas dbang thang lhar//gsad lug gtsang ma'i mchod pa 'bul//dar mdung nas dkar rten du 'dzugs/yul khang mkhar gyi rtse lha la//lha g.yag dkar po'i mchod pa 'bul//phyug btsan dar kha rten du 'dzugs//dgra lha rigs 'dzin dbang lha dang //ban bon chos srung tsho gos rnams4bsgo//bsgos bu gtsang ma'i mchod pa 'bul//dpa' g.yu phyug mdel rten du 'dzugs//dar mar sna lnga dkar dmar dar//g.yu chung mig med gser dngul zangs//lcags dang byu ru man shel tshogs//pha shing ma shing bu shing gsum//byang bu mig dgu changs bu dang //nas dkar rten gyis lha zheX skongs//bdag sogs mi nor rigs brgyud la//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)mi tso la rtag tu bsrung skyob mdzod/khul lhas spyi bo'i gtsug nas srungs/dgra lhas phrag pa g.yasanas srungs//pho lhas mchan khung g.yas nas srungs//mo lhas mchan khung g.yon nas srungs/khrog lhas snying gi dkyil nas srungs//rigs 'dzin ban bon chos skyong gis//steng 'og phyogs mtshamasakun nas srungs//tshe dpal bsod nams mnga' thang bskyed/swo swo lha rgyal lo//grwa pa mngon shes kyi gter ma'i las bcol ni//kyai/lha dang mi ru ma 'bral cig/bdud char ltar babs na/lhas sbra ltar skyobs shig/gnod dgra ltar gnod na/lhas bran ltar skyobs shig/'dres rkun ltar 'jabs na/lhas khyi ltar zug cig/lha 'og nas mi ma yar zhig/dgra 'og nasagong ma gtong zhig/bsrung 'og tu gdon ma ldang zhig/gnyen 'og tu smas ma ldang zhig/khyi 'og tu rkun ma 'jam cig/gnod pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad srung ba 'di las ma 'da' zhig/bkra shisagazhung legs pa'i rtas srungs shig/lo brgya thub la ston brgya za ba'i rtas srungs shig/bkra shisand med bsam pa 'grub pa ldan bong //nad gdon 'byung po ma lus zhi ba dang //tshe dang bsod nams dbang thang rgyas pa dang /bdag gi lusang ga yid la mi mthun nad gdon srung zhing zhi bar mdzod cig swāhā/yig brgya dang /ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang //zhes sogs kyis bzod par gsol/rten med na/oṃ khyed kyis sems don kun mdzad/zhes sogs dang /yod na/'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu/zhes sogs kyi mthar/oṃ su pra ti sgo badz+re ye swāhā/zhes me tog 'thor zhing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/shis brjod ni/bltas pa tsam gyis srid gsum zil gyis gnon//bsdigs pa tsam gyis sde brgyad bran du 'khol//btsos pa tsam gyis dngos grub char ltar 'bebs//skyon brgyud par bcas pa bkra shis shog/lus dang grib ma bzhin du nyin ma' kun//'bral med bsrung ba 'go ba'i lha lnga sogs//rigs 'dzin ban bon chos skyong tsho gos rnams kyis//bde skyid dpal la sbyor ba'i ba po shis shog/bsod nams dar rgyas ri rgyal lhun po bzhin//sogs brjod do//zhes lha lnga'i mchod 'phrin bsod nams dpal /rdod 'di ni chos dbang rin po che'i gter byon la

lha lnga'i gsol 4 bsod nam dgas bud/ 9)gzhi byas/dge bshes gra pa mngon shes dbang phyug 'bar gyi gter byon nas kyang kha bkang /lha lnga ngos 'dzin lugs mthun mi mthun sna tshogs snang ba tshe bdag lcags sdig dang lcags 'dra/yang bzlog me'i sbu gri/man ngag srid pa'i gter khyim sogs5bar sa kyang zhib mor dpyad de grong smad pa sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i lha gsol gyi ngag 'don du za hor sngags spyon gyis sa rta hor zla brgyad pa'i yar tshes la sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o//sarba ma sgo lo////46

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4) ༄༅༅//lha rnams mnyes par byed pa'i bsangs mchod bkra shis 'khyil ba bzhugs the rgo//phun tshogs dri ldan bsangs mchode pad+ma'i rgyun//mi gtsang nyes tsho gos stid pa'i cho ga mkhan/khungs ldan mes po'i khong las 'dren byed pa'i//sngon med skal ldan shing rta 'di sus bskrun//rgyal kun ngo bo mtsho skyes gsang ba'i gsung //rdo rje'i tshig gi bdud rtsi phra mos kyang //rgud pa'i 'chi bdag 'joms nus de bor nas//yig rnal ngan skyugs 'thung las blun pa su//'on kyang kha ba'i ljongasa'adir rang snang ngor//cher rlom mas rgyu'i gnyis skyes mang po yis//rang bzo'i skad ga bsgragasal tshangs dbyangs zhes//'jug rnams smig rgyur stog pa'i ri dwags bzhin//de phyir bdag 'dra'i blo gros ba tsha'i mtshor/shes rab dman pa'i skyogs kyis bcus pa'i chu//don gnyis mngar ba'i 'bras bur re ba dag/nam mkha'i pa smor lag pas rig min nam//de lta na'ang don gnyer can 'ga' yi//nan tan tshig gi dbyug gus rab bskul bas//phun tshogs snyan gyur tshangs pa'i rnga bo che//rnam dpyod mgrin pa'i lam du dar dir sgrog/lha rnams mnyes byed bsang mchod kyi//bcas kyi rim pa nyams2na tha star par//sna tsho gos ljon shing sman sna dang //dkar gsum mngar gsum phye mar spos//rin chen 'bru sna sha mar chang //mthun pa'i rdzas kun legs bshams nas//rang nyid bde ba'i stan 'dug ste//ma yengasang nga nas gyer bar bya/skyabs 'gro ni/lhaḥbyin rlabs dngos grub char 'bebs bar chad sel//dpal ldan rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tsho gos la//bdag sogs 'gro ba ma lus dus 'di nas//byang chub snying po'i bar du skyabs su mchis//sems bskyed pa ni//hūṃ pha mtha' yongs bral 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho cher//ma rig 'khrul pa'i /༷ 6 lkoms pa'i 'gro/rig pa'i ngo bor rin chen

lha rnams mnyes par byed pa'i bsangs mchode ba po shis 'khyil ba/ 8)gling mchog tu/ /bgrod phyir byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do/ /tshogs zhing ni/ /hūṃ dag pa'i mkha' dbyings 'ja' zer 'brug pa'i klong / /yid bzhin 'o mtshor 'khyil dbus pad sdong rtser/ /nyi zla'i gdan steng dus gsum rgyal ba'i gtso/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas khro chags zhi ba'i nyams/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga thugs kar 'dzin/ /g.yon pa bdud rtsis gang ba'i ka pā la/ /kha / rtsegasum sku yi g.yon phyogs brten/ /gnyen zhu rgod sgro me long dar snas(2bsgodzes/ /za ber bzang gos mthing kha snam sbyar brtsegs/ /zhabs gnyis mi phyed rdo rje skyil mo krung / /thabs shes zung 'jug bde stong phyag rgya'i gzugs/ /yid 'dzin mtsho rgyal gzungs ma'i tshul gyis sgeg /skyabs gnas kun gyi thugs rje'i ro lagar las/ /bzhin lag rnam par shar ba mtshan dpe'i gzugs/ /thogs med gshegs pa rig 'dzin slob dpon che'i/ /steng 'og phyogs mtshams kun tu bzhugs su gsol/ /mi phyed dad pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dzad med kun tu bzang bo mchod sprin stob/ /sdig lhung nyes pa'i tshogasakun so sor bshags/ /dus gsum dge ba kun la rjes yi rang / /zab cing rgya che'i chos 'khor bskor bar bskul/ /gzugs sku bskal brgyar mi g.yo gsol ba 'debs/ /dus gsum rnam par dkar ba'i dge ba'i las/ /kun bzang gdod ma'i go 'phang thob phyir bsngo/ /bsangs rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ /snro rang nyid rdor sems spyi bor rigs kyi bdag /bla ma kun bzang mtshan dpe'i gar mkhan can/ /skyong spel bsgyur thob tshim zhing dbang byed lha'i/ /thugs ka'i sa bon 'od zer 'phro 'du las/ /mi mthun nyes pa'i skyon tsho gos rab sbyangs te/ /'dod pa'i re ba ma lus skong gyur cig /cha shudhe shu khye shodha na ye swāhā/ chabadz+ra sa twa hūṃ/ oṃ su bhā wa shudha sarba dharmā swa bhā wa bi shuṇ+ḍa3lha/ chan ma sarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe ju sarba ta tsā5tha te lpa ra ṇa i me ga ga na khaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra a khri ta kuṇ+ḍali ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa na maḥsarba ta tha ga (3na)ta a wa lo ki te/ oṃ sam+bha sam+bha ra hūṃ/ oṃ dz+nyā na a wa lo zhi te na ma su man+ta lpa ra ṇa ra smi bha wa ma hā ma ṇi du ru du dra lha dwa ya dza la ni swāhā/ /na ma suman+ta buṅgā nai gra he shwa ri pra bha ྅ na ma hā sa ma ya hūṃ phaṭaḥ ces brjod cing phyag rgya rnams bya'o/ /gzhung dngos la 'jug ba'i bdag —467—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)bskyed ni/hūṃ pad sdong nyi zla brtsegs steng bdag wo ni/khrad gsum zil gnon pad+ma thod phreng rtsal//dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i 'khor gyis bskor ba'i dbus//'jigs med lhun chags brjid pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs//mgon thugs rje chen po'i 'od zer gyi//zhing dag pa rab 'byams pad+ma 'od//gnas zangs mdog dpal ri'i pho brang na//rje rgyal ba kun 'dus pad+ma 'byung //sku mtshan dpe'i 'dzum 'od me re re//gsung tshangs pa'i dbyangs snyan di re re//thugs gsal stong 'dzin med jigs se lhag/lha zhi khro'i 'gying bag shigs se shig/yab dpa' bo'i gar stabs khrab se khrab//ma dpa' mo'i glu len sha ra ra//gying pho nya'i bro brdungs chem se chem//mdangs 'ja' tshon 'od lnga khyug se khyug/khyed thugs rje r+ṣa po'i byin rlabs kyis//gnas 'di ru byin wo char ltar phob//rdzas bsangs mchode kun la nus pa skyed//bdag 'dir tsho gos rnams la dngos grub rtsol//oṃ sa/ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sirnyi hūṃ/mgron spyan 'dren pa ni//hūṃ thugs rjes byin sa sa rtsa brgyud bla ma dang //dngos grub rtsab yi dam dkyil 'khor lha//'phrin las kun sgrub dam can chos skyong 3ba ) tshogs/mthun rkyen spel mdzad rigs brgyud 'go ba'i lha//srid gsum gnas pa'i sdebargyad gzhi bdag sogs//ma lus spyan 'dren thogs med 'dir gshegs la//rang rang dgyes pa'i stan la brtan par bzhugs//phyi nang mchod tsho gos bsangs kyis mnyes gyur cig/ba yos gyer ba ni/3 4 ra med mkha' khyab chosasku spros bral la//gsang gsum mi zad rnam rol longs spyod rdzogs//thugs rjes 'gro la ci snang sprul ba'i sku//'gro ba'i dbang por 'tsham pa'i sgyu dra'i gar//gzhom zhig bral ba 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku//'gag pa med pa'i sgra dbyangs nā da'i gsung /shes bya kun mkhyen rang rtsal rigs pa'i thugs//gdod nas rnam dag lhun grub kun tu bzang //ma rig 'byul ngor 'khor ba'i chu nang du//phan gnod byed por btags pa'i 'jig rten lha//zla ba gcig las shar ba'i 'bum phrag gzugs//ji bzhin rang gi sems kyi rol ba'i rtsal//dag dang dag bya dag byed yul bral yang //sgyu ma'i skyes bu'i 'khrul 'khor ji bzhin du//mi gtsang nyes pa/ /gas kun sel ba dang //dngos grub rtsol phyir

lha rnams mnyes par byed pa'i bsangs mchod bkra shis 'khyil ba/ (da)bsangs kyi mchod pa 'bul/ /kyai/ kun dga'i dpal ster dpyid kyi pho nya yis/ /legs drangs chu 'dzin gsar ba'i lang long can/ /lha lam 'gram pa'i ngos su 'khrigs pa dang / /lhan cig dbyar gyi rnga gsang stong ldir zhing / khun sel dmar 'od glog gi zhags pa 'khyug /nam yang 'dzad pa med pa'i char rgyun gyis/ /gser ldan dga' ma'i bzhin ras yongs bkrus tshe/ /rtsi shing sman mchog sgra yi lan bu g.yo/ khri (4na tha zang ngad ldan rkang las yal 'dab dang / /'bru mar rin chen rtsibargyud bsregasapa yi/ /dud pa'i sprin tsho gis lha yi nu bo ltar/ /mi mthun nyes kun sel ba'i cho ga mkhan/ /de phyir rgyal dbang pad+ma sam+bha was/ /gangs can bstan pa'i sgron me spar ba'i tshe/ /bsangs mchode 'phrin lasagrangs med rgyas btab ste/ /'jigs med sgrom bur gsang ba'i gter du sbas/ /mgon der mos ldan rdo rje'i mched lcam rnams/ /sngon rabs dam pa'i rjes su 'jug pa'i blos/ /kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin la 'gran nus pa'i/ /gus pa'i lha bsangs mchode pas sri zhun bgyi/ kyai/ gser gyi mdangs la 'bu ba'i lo 'dab tshogs/ /g.yur du zla ba'i ljon shing stag pas bsangs/ /g.yu yi mdog can gnam sngon bzhun ma dag /'khyil 'dra'i 'dab ma rab rgyas shug pas bsangs/ /rab dkar dung gi mdangs la 'gran bzod pa'i/ /phang phung 'dab ma ba 'ad pa'i mkhan pas bsangs/ /mchong gi mdog ltar rab dmar lo 'dab kyi/ /phang phung mdzes par rgod pa'i ba lus bsangs/ /bzang drug sman dang sposadakar ma nu dang / /tsan dan dkar dmar a /ru yis bsangs/ /bdud rtsi can gyi ljon pa'i shing gi tshogs/ /phye mar zas phud 'bru sna'i rigs kyis bsangs/ /dar dang za 'og rin chen rnam pa lnga/ /dkar gsum mngar gsum la sogs mthun pa'i rdzas/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabasanas/ /rang rang 'dod pa'i dngos por gyur bas bsangs/ /kyai/ tshe gcig sangs rgyas sgrub pa zab mo'i theg /smin (4ba)byed dbang dang grol bar byed pa'i 'khrid/ /rgyab rten lung dang rgyud bshad man ngag dang / /bka' gtad gdams pa rtsol ba'i byed pa po/ khyab bdag thog ma'i mgon po nas bzung ste/ khrin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar byon pa'i/ /rgya bod mkhas dang grub pa'i rig 'dzen tshogs/ /dngos—469

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)brgyud rdo rje slob dpon thams cad bsangs//sde snod gsum dang sgra tshad bzo gso sogs//grangasamed rig pa'i gnas rnams ston mkhas pa'i//'phags yul kha ba'i ljongs 'dir sngon byung dang //da ltar byon pa'i mkhas grub thams cad bsangs//khyad par chos kyi rgyal po mes dbon tshogs//dusagasum sangs rgyas ngo bo pad+ma 'byung //bstan pa'i rtsa lag mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho//bka' drin mtshungasapa med pa rnam gsum bsangs//lnga brgya'i gtsug rgyan jo bo yab sras dang //bstan pa'i mnga' bdag brtse chen snying po'i zhabs/khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po myong kha pa//phan dang bde ba'i 'byung gnas rnam gsum bsangs//kyi/lhun grub dbang gzhu ltar bkra mtshan dpe'i gar//bde bar gshegs pa rigs lnga la sogs pa'i//bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis lha yi 'khor lo mchog/bcom ldan zhi ba'i lha tsho gos thams cad bsangs//in+d+ra ni la'i lhun po dus mtha'i mes//mngon par rab klubs bdud gzhi las rgyal ba//lnga bas rtsa brgyad 'jigs rung he ru ka/khrag 'thung khro bo'i lha yi tsho gis kun bsangs/sku gsung thugs dang yon to 'phrin las can//rbod gtong rig 'dzin mchod bstod drag sngags lha//bde gshegs rgyal ldan tha ma lus rab 'dus pa'i//grangs med dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho lha tsho gos bsangs//'jam rdor mi bskyod dgra gdong 'jigs gsum dang //bde dgyes dus 'khor la sogs rgyud sdebazhi'i//mtha' yas brjod par dka' ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi//'khor lo'i bdag nyid lha yi tsho gos kun bsangs//dur khrod brgyad dang nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i yul//sum cu rtsa bdun gnasadang mkha' spyod sogs//bgrang yas ngo mtshar zhing na legs bzhugs pa'i //dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i lha tsho gos thams cad bsangs//kye/rgyal ba kun yum rdo rje dbyings phyug ma//gdul bya'i don du dbyangs can ngag gi lha//gdug pa 'dul phyir 'dod khams dbang phyug ma//bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams bsangs//dpal ldan ma hā kā la phyag bzhi drug/rnam mang thos sras las kyi gshin rje gshed//dur khrod bdag po legs ldan mgo gsum dang /tsod zhang blon rdo rje bdud 'dul bsangs//bstan bsrung rgya mtsho'i snod// / rje gur//gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo

lha rnams mnyes par byed pa'i bsangs mchod bkra shis 'khyil ba/ 9)dud sol ma/ /stobs log dbang po lha chen gdong bzhi pa/ /pu tra ming sring beg gdong lcam dral bsangs/ /ma ning a ka dza ti dpal lha mo/ /thang lha stag nyon gza' bdud bdud mgon dang / sprul pa'i chos rgyal btsan rgod rdo rje legs/ /bstan ma bcu gnyis tshe ring mched lnga bsangs/ /ra sa'aphrul snang dpal gyi bsam yas dang / /mtha' 'dul yang 'dul ru gnon gtsug lag khang / /dben gnas chos 'khor ma lus skyong ba dang / /chos dang gter (5bcu bsrung ma ma lus bsangs/ /rje yi mgur lha 'bangs kyi srog lha dang / /srid pa chags pa'i lha chen dgu la sogs/ /spur rgyal bod kyi rgyal khams skyong byed pa'i/ /gzhi bdag bsrung ma mthu chen ma lus bsangs/ /rgya gar li bal rgya nag hor gyi yul/ /mnga' ris bskor gsum dbus gtsang ru bzhi dang / /mdo stod mdo smad la sogasa'adzam gling gi /yul gru kun gyi gzhi bdag bsrung ma bsangs/ lha klu gnod sbyin ma bdud dmu btsan dang / /rgyal po gshin rje gza' dang rgyu skar sogs/ /mdor na snang zhing srid pa'i lha ma yin/ /sdebargyad bran g.yog 'khor dang bcas pa bsangs/ /kye/ khyad par bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa yi /bsam pa'i don sgrub rigs dang brgyud rnams spel/ /mi 'dzad nor ster rgyab rten mgon skyabasamadzad/ /dpa' rtsal mthu stobs skyed pa'i lha rnams bsangs/ /dbang po lnga yis so so'i byed lasakyis/ /las rnams thogs med sgrub la dbang ba'i lha/ /mgyogs pa'i rta dang sra ba'i go cha'i tshogs/ /rnon po'i mtshon char gnas pa'i dgra lha bsangs/ /mtho la zhu 'bul dma' la bka' bsgo zhing / /mnyam por gshags 'gyed phyogs su don gnyer dang / /tshong dang khe phogs dmag jag 'grul bzhud sogs/ /bya ba kun la dbang ba'i lha rnams bsangs/ /'go ba'i lha lnga mi thub dgra lha gsum/ khang khyim thab kha mkhar gyi rtse lha dang / /zhing dang phyugs lhas spo dang lam gyi lha/ /pha mes mi rabs brgyud kyi dgra lha bsangs/ /rmugs rabs brgyud dang rmugs rabs4na tha rgyud kyi lha/ /slob dbon brgyud la'ago ba'i lta rnams dang / /'gro ba'i lam dang gzhis kyi srung ma'i tshogs/ /rgyan gos longs spyod grogs la gnas pa bsang / /yar lha sham po gung rgyal spom ra dang / /brgya byin dkar nag khra gsum wer ma'i —471—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)tshogs/ /ser bya'i lha lung rno mthong ston pa'i lha/ /bdud lha sum brgya drug cu la sogs bsangs/ /yab lha dral drug mo btsun rgyal mo mthing / /'dod rigs sman pa bco brgyad ma tshogs stong / /stong dang 'byung ba chags pa'i dgra lha dang / /a gar dkar gyi srung ma ma lus bsangs/ /smu lha gyer 'jom lha bu g.yang dkar dang / /bod kyi mi'u gdung drug zo dor lha/ /thugs gar sum brgya drug cu la sogasapa'i/ /mdog nag g.yung drung bon gyi lha rnams bsangs/ /lo 'khor bcu gnyis spar kha rnam pa brgyad/ /sme ba dgu dang sa bdag rgyal blon 'bangs/ /spor thang brgyad cu spor gyi gtsug lag lha/ /gab rtse dgu la gnas pa'i lha rnams bsangs/ /nyin srib ri dang nags tshal lteng ka dang / /lam chen bzhi mdo chu klung ljon pa'i shing / /rang byung bcos ma'i me dang lung sa sogs/ /so soganas pa'i phyogs 'di'i gzhi bdag bsangs/ /nyams grib bshags pa ni/ /de ltar rtsa gsum cho me srung sdo brgyad dang / /yul lha gzhi bdag dgra lha la sogs par/ /gtsang zhing gya nom mang por spel ba yi/ /dag byed bsangasakyi mchod pa 'di phul bas/ /gdod nas rnam dag gsal stong rig pa'i gshis/ /ma rig 'khrul 4ba)pas bslad pa'i nad gdon bgegs/ /thag khrar sprul du mthong ba'i dngangs skrag bzhin/ /med kyang ma wa zhe sum snang ba'i skyon tsho gos rnams/ /mkha' khyab do dam chos sku bde ba cher/ /chu la chu bzhag lta bur ro gcig kyang / /kun rdzob zhakhrul ngor grub pa'i nyes pa kun/ /dag byed chu yis dri ma zhabrud ltar bshags/ /khyad par bdag cag rgyu sbyor sbyin bdag rnams/ /sgo thar byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa dang / /rigs 'dzin sngags kyi dam tshig nyams pa'i grib/ /gdol dang dme yug ya bshan mdze grib dang / /lha dang mi la 'khon dang rtsod pa'i grib/ /dkar dmar thab gzhed bya spyod mi mkhas pa'i/ /mi gtsang rigs rnams lag tu bstar zhing bcangs/ /zas su zos shing gos su gyon pa dang / /gnasamal 'khor nor longs spyod bstan pa sogs/ /ljon shing mthun rdzas bsregs pa'i dud sprin 'dis/ /ma lus byang zhing rnam par dag gyur nas/ /gangs kyi ri bo lta bur gsal gyur cig /phun tsho gis bkrashis dus bzang yar gyi ngor/ /gza' skar dus sbyor legs pa 'phrod kyi dge /mthun pa'i rkyen kun —472

lha rnams mnyes par byed pa'i bsangs mchode ba po shis 'khyil ba/ 9)tshang ba'i gnas mchoge 'dir/ /bsangs kyis mchod pa'i 'bras bu lhun grub shog /'phrin lasabacol ba ni/ yiḥ bsangs mchode mthun pa'i dam rdzas rgya chen po/ /dngos bshams yid kyi sprul te phul ba'i mthus/ /skyabs mchog ngo bo rtsa gsum lha tshogs kyis/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub char ltar phob/ /bsrung ma dam can sde brgyad tshogs rnams kyis/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las ma lus thogs (7na)med sgrubs/ /yul lha gzhi bdag 'go ba'i lha rnams kyis/ /bar chad sel zhing bsam pa'i re ba skongs/ /mdor na mchod yul dam pa khyed rnams kyis/ /bdag cag mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa la /seng ge glang chen smyon pa me sbrul dang / /lcags sgrog sha za rgya mtsho chen po ste/ /'jigs chen brgyad dang gdon bgegs nad rims dgra/ /dus min 'chi bdag gshin rje'i zhags ba dag /kha smra mi kha gleng gzhi 'thab rtsod sogs/ /bar chad mi mthun g.yul las rgyal bar mdzod/ khrid pa'i mun sdug rdzogs pa'i thun gsum mthar/ shar ba'i legs byas skya rengs kyis drangs pa'i/ /phan bde'i nyin mor byed pa'i 'od zer gyis/ /zhi ba'i 'phrin las snang ba 'bar bar mdzod/ /bsod nams dus las yol med rlabs phreng can/ /tshe dpal 'byor ba mi zad chu bo'i gter/ /bsam pa'i re ba skong ba'i yid bzhin nor/ /rgyas pa'i 'phrin las rgyal mtshan rtser 'god mdzod/ /reg pas gdung sel yid dga'i mdza' na mo/ /'gug byed lho phyogs rlung gi reg bya can/ /mthong na mi mthun med pa'i tsan dan shing / /dbang gi 'phrin las dri bsung 'thul bar mdzod/ /'khu ba'i sems ldan lha min dga' ma'i mngal/ /drag spyor rdo rje'i rtse brgya gdengs tsam gyis/ /bsod nams dpung dang lhan cig lhung byed pa'i/ /drag po'i 'phrin las legs bris stobs ldan mdzod/ /sgrib gnyis sgo nga'i sbubs las rnam grol ba'i/ /tsho gis gnyis 'dab ldan ka la (7ba tsā sko'i bya/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i mkha' dbyings su/ /'phur nas chos kyi dbyangs snyan sgrog par mdzod/ /phan dang bde ba'i 'byung gnas thub pa'i bstan/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bu 'gro ba'i bde skyid kun/ /kun nas 'phel zhing rgyas pa dbyar gyi chu/ /chu gter chen po'i dpal la 'gran par mdzod/ /blo gros mchog mnga' skal bzang 'gro ba'i —473

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)mgon//mgon po 'jam dbyangs dngos gyur grags pa'i dpal//dpal ldan rgyal ba gnyis pa'i ring lugs gang /gang zhig srid mtha'i bar du rgyas par mdzod//bde skyid kun tshang kun nas dga' ba'i dpyid//gangs can yul gru yul gyi snying po cher//phan bde ma lus ma smad 'byung ba dang //dga' skyid dbyangs snyan dbyangs su len par mdzod//dga' ba'i dpal ldan phun tshogs sde bzhi'i dngos//dngos por lhun grub gru won pho brang ma rdzo/mchog tu rab brtan mnga' thang dzo srid dag/dag byed ga sgo'i rgyun la 'gran par mdzod//yangs pa'i tsho wo po'i mdun san//chos bzhin skyong mdzad mdzad bzang dpa' rtul can//sa spyod mi dbang dbang phyug brgyad mnga' ba'i//sku tshe chab srid srid mthar rgyas par mdzod//dung dung snying nas mi phyed gsol 'debs shing //yang yang mar cing bstod na bdag sogs kun//'jigs 'jigs bar chad dgra las rnam rgyal zhing //'dzum 'dzum dgyes pa'i sgo nas dngos grub stsol//phywa g.yang 'gug pa ni/kye/phun tsho gis ba po shis 'khyilaba'i gnas mchog 'dir//'dod pa'i mchog ster phywa dang g.yang gi shasta shas/khab len rdo dang lcags kyi snang tshul bzhin//dga' ba'i gar dang bcas ste thogs med khug/gser mngal mgrin sngon 'khor lo'i lag pa can//grags pa'i mu khyud 'khor rte ba sogs/khrid 'dir mag par mtho ba'i tsho gos rnams kyi//phywa g.yang dpal 'byor snyan grags ma lus la//legs bris tshogis kyi 'chi med btung ba dang //klu dbang gtsug gi yid bzhin nor bu mchog/mi dbang sngon 'gro'i rgyal srid sna bdun gyi//phywa g.yang dpal 'byor snyan grags ma lus stsole//rin chen gdugs dkar gser nya bum pa bzang //pad+ma dung dkar g.yas su la dpal bes/rgyal mtshan 'khor lo bkra shis rtagasabargyad kyi//phywa g.yang dpal 'byor snyan grags ma lus stsol//rnam 'dren zas gtsang sras pos bkra shes pa'i //dngos por byin rlabs dge legs 'byung ba'i sgo//rten 'brel lhun gyis grub pa'i rdzasabargyad kyi//phywa g.yang dpal 'byor snyan grags ma lus stsol//tshe ring nad med 'dod pa'i don kun grub//stobs dang mnga' thang 'byor pa phun sum 4//sa//bde zhing skyid pa'i dga' ston thams cad

lha rnams mnyes par byed pa'i bsangs mchode bkra shis 'khyil ba/ 9)kyi/ /phywa g.yang dpal 'byor snyan grags ma lus stsol/ /nongs pa bzod par gsol ba ni/ lha rmongs pa'i dbang gis tshon las 'khrul par byed/ /mchod pa'i dam rdzas ma tshang 'bags pa sogs/ /nyes pa'i tshogs kun snying nas bshags byed na/ /bzod par bzhes shig thugs rje che ldan rnams/ /gshegs su gsol ba ni/ lhaḥ chu las chu bur rdol ba (8ba ji bzhin du/ /rig pa'i rtsal gyis mgron du bsus pa rnams/ /ngo bo gdod nas skye ba med pa'i klong / /rnam pa rang rang so so'i gnas su gshegs/ /badz+ra mu rgas pa brjod pa ni/ lhaḥ yid bzhin nor dang bum bzang 'dod 'do'i ba/ /dpag bsam shing ltar 'dod pa'i re ba kun/ /'bad med stsol mdzad bla ma yi dam dang / /mkha' 'gro chos skyong bsrung ma'i bkra shis shog /gzhan yang shis brjod ci rigs pa bya'o/ /smras pa/ khungs ldan bsangs gzhung zla ba'i ma ma las/ blo gros a mra'i tshi gus blang ba'i chu/ rnam g.yeng skom tshad kyisagadungs 'ga' zhig la/ /phan snyam snyim par thog nas gar byed do/ /'ga' zhig tshig gi sbyor ba rab mkhas kyang / /bsangs rgyar brgyags rngan dbye ba ma phyed cing / /mjug tu bsgral ba'i mchod pa sbyar ba sogs/ /zhabrul bar byed pa'i ring lugs kho nar nges/ /la la phyogs 'di'i brda la ma byang bar/ /rang bzor byas pa'i tshig gi phreng ba dag /rmo mes pa'i go sar mdzes kyang tshul 'di nyid/ shes pasamathong tshe khrel ba'i gad mo bro/ kha cig grong pa'i gson dge'i gral rim ltar/ /par bkab ti thug khrigs kyi yi ge dag /sos kyi nye ring 'bul ba'i g.yar khral las/ /yang dag don gyis stong pa'i brag ca bzhin/ /spangs rtogs yon tan pha mtha' gzhal dka' bas/ /ye shes lha yi tshad bzung ga la nus/ /gya gyu'i sems kyi rol pa mtha' klas pas/ /'jig rten lha 'dre'i grang kyang gzhal nus su/ /de phyir ma tshang zlos dang 'gal ba sogs/ /skyon bral bdag blos sgrun par mi nus kyang / /mkhasagrub dam pa'i phyag bzhes mthong brgyud las/ /(9na gzhan gyi 'dod pa ji bzhin nyung ngur byas/ /de skad 'gro ba kun gyi gnyen gcig pu/ /'khon ston chos rje'i zhabs zung man+da ra/ /mi phyed dad pa'i thod du legs 'ching ba'i/ /za hor rigs kyis bhu su ku des sbyar/ /med byung rnam par dag pa'i dge —475

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)tsho gos chus/ /'gro kun dug gsum dri ma kun bkrus te/ /tsho gis gnyis lang tsho dar ba'i mdzes sdug lus/ /kun mkhyen ye shes gos kyis klubs par shog /rgyal ba kun dngos pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyi gsung las byung ba'i bsangs yig rdo rje'i tshig rnams byin rlabs kyi tshan kha che bzhin du/ /bdag dang bdag 'dras g.yar khral du bgyis pa'i rigs 'di 'dra la dgos pa mi 'dug na'ang / /bod sog gi skad gnyis smra zhing mang du thos pa la dga' ba'i dpyod ldan/ me rgan dka' bcu shes rab rgya mtsho dang //che chen dbon po blo bzang chos 'phel gnyis kyis nan du bskul ba la brten/ /bsangs kyi yi ge bkra shis sul ba zhes bya ba 'di ni/ /slob dpon chen pos mdzad pa'i bsangs gzhud lho byang gi gter kha du ma las byung ba la gzhi byas/ 'byer bde ba'i phyir du bdag chen rin po che rgya gar shesarab rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i yig cha dang 'ga' zhig cha mthun par byas te/ /za hor gyi rigasalas a wa sgru ti pa'i btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos chu 'go bkra shis 'khyil ba dang zung du 'brel ba'i lha rtse gzhung du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni smon 'gro paṇa chen no/ khubha ma sarba dza ga te// //—476

rgya hor gyi yul du nye bar phan pa'i bsangs kyi mi ge dngos grub char 'bebs/ 8)ra༅༅//rgya hor gyi yul du nye bar phan pa'i bsangs kyi yi ge dngos grub char 'bebs bzhus/sa tre(//mchog gsum zhabs pad zla tshes gang //dad pa'i bde 'byung ral pa'i rtser//bkod nasayul dus gnas skabs dang //bstun pa'i bsangs mchode bri bar bya//bsangs bya ba'i rim pa la bsangs rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/oṃ sarba bid pā ra pā ra/su ra su ra a wa rta ya ho badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa — /zhes pa'i sngags lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/mgron spyan drang ba ni/bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos srung dang //yul dang gzhi bdag 'go ba'i lha lnga sogs//bsangs kyi mchod pa'i mgron du 'os pa kun//thogs med 'dir gshegs dgyes pa'i stan la bzhugs//pad+ma ka ma la ye ri/mchod pa 'bul ba ni/'dod pa'i yon to lnga dang rab ldan pa'i//rang rang dgyes pa skyed pa'i mchod pa'i sprin/sa dang bar snang ma lus yongs bkang ste//gus pas 'bul lo dgyes bzhin bzhes su gsol//bsangs mchode dngos ni/sna tshogs ljon shing phyi mar 'bru sna sogs//bsregs pa'i dud sprin nam mkha'i khyon gang bas//dkon mchog gsum dang 'jig rten srung ma rnams//bsangs so nyes pa'i tsho gos kun byang gyur cig/dus gsum sangs rgyas de sras byang sems2nas gis//nyan thos rang rgyal drang srong grub pa sogs//spangs dang rtogs pa'i yon tan rab ldan pa'i//skyabs mgon thugasarje'i bdag nyid ma lus bsangs//rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa dang //yi dam dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i bdag nyid can//dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can srung ma dang //snang srid sdebargyad dregs pa'i tsho gis kun bsangs//rgya nag pho brang pe cing zhing gi char//ri mtsho bzhi mdo ljon shing mkhar dang brag/4

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)khyad par khreng pan yo la gnas pa yi/ /lha klu lha min 'byung po ma lus bsangs/ /lho phyogs pho brang nan cing zhing gi char/ /ri mtsho ljon shing lteng ka nags tshal dang / /lam srang bzhi mdo grong mkhar la gnas pa'i/ /lha klu lha min 'byung po ma lus bsangs/ /lho nub bu cing shan shi'i zhing gi char/ /ri mtsho bzhi mdo ljon shing mkhar dang brag khyad par byu pan yo dang hu'ang du'i/ /lha klu lha min 'byung po ma lus bsangs/ shar smad bu cing ñtsā cang zhig gi char/ /ri mtsho ljon shing lteng ka nags tshal dang / /lam srang bzhi mdo grong mkhar la gnas pa'i/ /lha klu lha min 'byung po ma lus bsangs/ /lho phyogasabu cing kyang shi'i zhing gi char/ /ri mtsho ljon shing steng ka nags tshal dang / /lam srang bzhi mdo grong mkhar la gnas pa'i/ /lha klu lha min 'byung po ma lus bsangs/ /lho smad bu cing hū ku'ang zhing gi char/ /ri mtsho bzhi mdo ljon shing mkhar dang brag khyad par khri'ang phan yo la gnas pa'i/ /lha klu lha min 'byung po ma lus bsangs/ /lho nub bu cing ze chu 'an zhing gi char/ /ri mtsho bzhi mdo ljon shing mkhar dang brag /khyad par chu bo king du (2bto5 gnas pa'i/ /lha klu lha min 'byung po ma lus bsangs/ /shar lho bu cing phu rten zhing gi char/ /ri mtsho ljon shing lteng ka nags tshal dang / /lam srang bzhi mdo grong mkhar la gnas pa'i/ /lha klu lha min 'byung po ma lus bsangs/ /lho phyogs bu cing ku'ang dung zhing gi char/ /ri mtsho ljon shing lteng ka nags tshal dang / lam srang bzhi mdo grong mkhar la gnasapa'i/ /lha klu lha min 'byung po ma lus bsangs/ /lho stod bu cing ku'ang shi zhing gi char/ /ri mtsho ljon shing lteng ka nags tshal dang / /lam srang bzhi mdo grong mkhar la gnas pa'i/ /lha klu lha min 'byung po ma lus bsangs/ zhub byang pho brang pan shi'i zhing gi char/ /ri mtsho bzhi mdo ljon shing mkhar dang brag /khyad par ri bo rtse lngar gnas pa yi/ /lha klu lha min 'byung po ma lus bsangs/ shar smad bu cing pan dung zhing gi char/ /ri mtsho bzhi mdo ljon shing mkhar dang brag /khyad par tha'i pan yo la gnas pa yi/ /lha klu lha min 'byung po ma lus bsangs/ /lho smad bu cing ha'o nan zhing gi char/ /ri mtsho bzhi mdo ljon shing mkhar dang brag /khyad par zung pan yo dang ci'i du dang / /hā'i du'i lha klu —478

rgya hor gyi yul du nye bar phan pa'i bsangs kyi yi ge dngos grub char 'bebs/ (ge'abyung po ma lus bsangs/ /lho nub bu cing yu' nan zhing gi char/ /ri mtsho ljon shing lteng ka nagasatshal dang / /lam srang bzhi mdo grong mkhar la gnas pa'i/ /lha klu lha min 'byung po ma lus bsangs/ /lho nub bu cing ku'i ci 'o'i zhing gi char/ /ri mtsho ljon shing lte ka nags tshal dang / /lam srang bzhi mdo grong mkhar la gnas pa'i/ lha klu lha min 'byung po ma lus bsangs/ /(3na than den swo dung mug den yul gyi char/ /ri mtsho ljon shing lteng ka nags tshal dang / /lam srang bzhi mdo grong mkhar la gnas pa'i/ /lha klu lha min 'byung po ma lus bsangs/ /ri bo dkar por grags pa la sogs pa'i/ /ri mtsho ljon shing lteng ka nags tshal dang / /lam srang bzhi mdo grong mkhar la gnas pa'i/ /lha klu lha min 'byung po ma lus bsangs/ /lo ha shi ra mu ren u ba shen/ /mu rin la sogs chu bo chen po la/ /gnas shing rgyu ba'i lha dang 'byung po'i tshogs/ /chu bdag klu yi dbang por bcas pa bsangs/ /a la sha dang ar bus kha ro khan/ shang du kha'i bu la sogs rgya hor dang / sog po'i yul gyi mkhar dang ri brag mtshor/ /gnas pa'i gzhi bdag 'byung po ma lus bsangs/ /mdor na bdag sogs 'bor dang bcas rnams dang / /lus dang grib ma bzhin du rab 'grogs nas/ /stongs grogs dpung gnyen byed pa'i lha tshogs rnams/ /bsangs kyi mchod pas mnyes shing tshim gyur cig /dngos grub zhu ba ni/ de ring gnam la bkra shis gza' skar bzang / /sal khri gdugs nyi ma'i 'od kyang dro/ /bar du mi nor khang zhing longs spyod 'dzom/ /phun tshogs bkra shis dag pa'i chom gnas ma ga 'dir/ /tshangs pa brgya byin klu dbang gnod sbyin dang / /'khor los sgyur sogs srid 'dir mngon mtho ba'i/ /tshe dpal bsod nams 'dod dgu longs spyod sogs/ /snyan grags dpal 'byor phywa dang g.yang du stsol/ /mchod pa'i yul du bos pa'i mgron rnams kun/ /dga' zhing tshim (3bzhis rang rang gnas su gshegs/ /slar yang dus su byon nas bdag sogs kyi/ mgon skyabs dpung gnyen dam pa mdzad du gsol/ /bslu ba med pa'i skyabs gnas dkon mchog dang / /mthu ldan srung ma yul lha gzhi bdag gis/ /phun tshogs rnam par dkar ba'i bkra shis kyis/ /phyogs dus kun tu khyab pa'i dge legs stsol/ /ces rgya 479

hor gyi yul du nye bar phan pa'i bsangs mchode dngos grub char 'bebs zhes pa 'di ni//dkon mchog gsum la nges shes kyi dang ba'i blo ldan khi shig ching dbang gis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar////

bsangs yig mi god mar sprin sgo wod/ 9)༄༅༅//mi mthun nyes kun sel zhing legs tshogs ci 'dod 'grub pa'i bsangs yig gi rim pa mi 'dzad mchod sprin sgo 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs tre(//dri bzang po'i shing sna dang phye mar sogs bsangs rdzas gang 'dzom bsags la//oṃ sarba bid gu ra pā ra gu ra gu ra a warta ya a warta ho mi dz+ra lpa ra ṇa byu//zhes lan gsum byin gyis brlabs la 'di skad do//snros phyogs 'di na gnas pa yi//lha klu gnod sbyin bdud btsan sogs/khul lha gzhi bdag ma lus pa//bsangs mchode 'bul gyis 'dir gshegs bzhugs//mchod yon me tog bdug spos dang //mar me dri dzo bza' dang bca'//glu gar rol mo 'dod yon lnga'i//mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes su gsol//khyad par tsan+dan dkar dmar dang /shug pa mkhan pa a ka sa/stag pa ba lu la sogs pa//dri zhim bsangs kyi mchod pa 'bul//sman spos sna tsho gos rab bsregs pa'i//dri zhim bsangs kyi dud pa yis//mi gtsang 'bags bcog thab shor sogs//sku gsung thugs la phog pa bsangs//e nyi sgang dkar ri bo sogs//mthon po bcu gsum la gnas pa'i//lha klu gnyan po mtha' dag gi/sku gsung thugs la phog pa bsangs//mtsho mang la bdun la ser dang //gser gog go ra spar rdo yi//yul lha gzhi bdag ma lus pa//bsangs kyi mchod pas mnyes gyur cig/de ltar bsangs mchod 'di phul bas//bdag sogs rje 'bangs mi nor la//gnod pa'i nad gdon bar gcod bgegs//mi mthun phyogs kun zhi bar mdzod//bskal par gnas pa'i rin po'i che/rnam thos sras mtshungs longs spyod dang //'aXr los sgyur rgyal ji bzhin 1bcu//bsam don

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /mdor na bdag sogs gzhis gnas dang / /g.yul zhugs tsho me dang dge sgrub sogs/ /gzhis lam byes gsum thams cad du/ /mgon skyabs dpung gnyen rgyab rten mdzod/ /ces bsangs mchod nye bar mkho zhing mdor bsdus pa zhig dgos zhes mer gan hong tha'i jis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dpal lo/ /su bhā was bsang rdzas rnams stong par sbyangs/ /stong pa'i ngang las bsang rdzas rnams yul lha gzhi bdag rnams kyi nyams grib sel zhing dgyes pa skyed pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ yo lha / / lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ /dri zhim yid 'ong sna tshogs 'dus pa yi/ /ljon shing sman spos bsregs pa'i dud sprin 'dis/ /rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma ma lus bsangs/ /yi dam dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i lha tsho gis bsangs/ /dam can chos skyong srung ma'i tsho gos rnams bsangs/ /rgya hor bod kyi yul lha gzhi bdag bsangs/ khyad par rma chen sbom ra 'khor bcas bsangs/ khri shog rgyal mor gnas pa'i mtsho sman bsangs/ /mtsho mgo slo ba ri yi gzhi bdag bsangs/ /mtsho mjug mcher pa ri yi gzhi bdag bsangs/ /mtsho snying mahā de wa'i gzhi bdag bsangs/ /gnyan chen zor ba btsan gdong dmar lha bsangs/ /klu yi chu khol wa chu'i gzhi bdag bsangs/ /ring ma chen mo bcu gsum gzhi bdag bsangs/ /tshwa mtsho dkar mo'i gzhi bdag ma lus bsangs/ /mthon po bcu gsum gnas pa'i gzhi bdag bsangs/ /mgon po gdong sna 'ju lag gzhi bdag bsangs/ /mdung rtse che chung be'i rug thang lha bsangs/ /yen ri tsi dang la btsas dkar lha bsangs/ /zho sha la bo che (12na 'a gzhi bdag bsangs/ /klu chen ga rti ka 'khor bcas pa bsangs/ /rdo yi nyi zla seng khog gzhi bdag bsangs/ /dkar thang mar khu'i mtsho mo'i yul lha bsangs/ /ne'u gsing thang la gnas pa'i gzhi bdag bsangs/ /the 'dzin brag dkar gnas pa'i gzhi bdag bsangs/ /'om lung gdong dmar che chung gzhi bdag bsangs/ /btsong kha'i mtsho sngon mtsho sman thams cad bsangs/ /lha ri de'u yag gis gzhi bdag bsangs/ khyad par u la su thal gzhi bdag bsangs/ /cha gan er khir gnas pa'i gzhi bdag bsangs/ ston shi kha thor gnas pa'i gzhi —482

bas yig mi yod mgo sprin sgo khed/ 9)bdag bsangs//na ma ga la gnas pa'i gzhi bdag bsangs//mdor na gar gnas gar 'gro'i gzhi bdag sogs//mgon skyabs dpung gnyen mdzad pa mtha' dag bsangs//bsangs kyis nyamasagrib ma lus byang gyur nas//phyogs 'di'i mi nor phyugs dang bcas pa la//ba po shis bde legasaphun tsho gos g.yang khug la//dus kun phan bde'i dpal la sbyor du gsol//bsangs mchode bsdusapa 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes yer ti ni dwa las lha me tha'i jis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bsdos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs dpal bzang ngo //bsangs rdzas rnams sngags drug phyag rgya drug gisabyin gyis rlab//gangs dkar spun gsum zhes grags pa'i//sa phyogs la gnas lha dang klu//gnod sbyin dri za 'byung po rnams//bsangs kyi mchod pas mnyes gyur cig/mchod pa'i dud sprin tha sprasapas//gzi yi gangs dkar lha rnams bsangs//phud pa gangs dkar lha rnams bsangs//ga ru gangs dkar lha rnams bsangs//spam chen brag dkar lha rnams bsangs//lcags rdzas sngon po'i lha rnams bsangs//lcang rgan 'ob 12bsnyeng lha rnams bsangs//ljang nag sbun gsum lha rnams bsangs//'o mtsho mu tig ril sil mtsho//gangs dkar 'khor gyi mtsho sman bsangs//spa yo lasogs gzhi bdag bsangs//gnas rten brag dgon hor phug dang //snyag gshed g.yu brag mtha' mog sogs//phug chen rnams la gnas pa bsangs//gangs dkar bu chung la so gos ba//lha klu gnyan gsum bu rnams bsangs//gser sgron g.yu sgron la sogs pa//gangs dkar bu mo sman btsun bsangs//bsangs pas nyams chags kun zhi zhing //mthun rkyen dngos grub rtsal du gsol//zhesagangs dkar spun gsum gyi bsangs mchod bsdus pa 'di ni dbon mkha' 'gros tho chung bskur 'dug pa ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni tre bo rig byed pa ngag dbang nam mkha'o//ngo mtshar rdzas sna sbyar spos 'a dan dri//gyer gzhung ma la ya rlung gis drangs dang //nyes brgya tsha sel tshor ba bde ba'i ro/myong 'dod dpyod ldan yongs kyi dga' ba bskyed//de yang bsangs ma rgyun khyer mdor bsdus bya ba la/gla rtsi/dug rigs/shing kun so gos dri mi zhin pa'i rigs spangs pa'i 48

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)sman sna/stag pa/shug pa/mkhan pa/ba lu rnams kyis btsos pa'i dri ldan gyi shing sna tshogs/phye mar/'bru sna/dkar gsum/mngar gsum/zas sna/rin po che/dar zab sogs ci 'byor ba so so'i pa/gzhis byes kun tu 'jug bder 'dod na thams cad lhan cig tu bsres te phye mar byas pa bshams/skyabs sems ni//rtsa ba gsum gyi dkyil 'khor lha tsho gos la/deng nas byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi//gnas skabs bdag g.yin bar chad zhi ba dang //mthar thug byang chub thob phyir sems bskyed do//bsangs rdzas byin brlab ni//pad zla'i 13na yid na la rang nyid skad cig gis//rdo rje semasadapar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas//'od 'phros rdzas kyi nyes skyon kun sbyangs te//'dod yon lnga ldan bdud rtsi'i ngo bor gyur//thal mo khong stong lis yog pa snying gar yos pa stol ba'i thad du g.yas su lan gsum bskor ba dang bcas/byu bid pā ra pā ra su ra gu ra ā ba rta ya lho badz+ra sngar ṇa khaṃ swāhā/nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags phyag rgya dang bcas te byin gyis brlab/mgron spyan 'dren pa ni/hūṃ/mgon po yon to mgron du gyur to cog/sdebargyad spyi dang khyad par gangs ljongs kyi/khul lha gzhis bdag 'go ba'i lha tsho gis rnams//thogs med 'dir spyon dgyes pa'i stan la bzhugs//bsangs gyer ba ni/kyai/sman spos sna tsho gis ljon shing bza' bca' dang //dar zab rin r+sā la sogasams rdzas kyis//rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang /dam can chos skyong srung ma'i tsho gis kun bsangs/khyad par bstan srung yongs kyi sde dpon ched//gur mgon lcam dral gdong bzhi yab yum dang //pu tra ming sring dkar bdud phur srung sogs//rigs dang brgyud la brten pa'i lha rnams bsangs//phyag drug phyag bzhi gur mgon rnam thos sras//re ma ti dang sto bos 'phrog gdong bzhi pa//mi'u thung gsod byed stag zhen beng drag sogs//bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho'i snyi khya༅ byed na blo ka gong ma'i tshang la 'di bzhin bsgyur/tsho gos rnams bsangs//lha sabs ma yas kyis gtsos gtsug lag khang //'dusasdodaben gnas rdzong gzhis grong khyer dang //ri klungs lam gong bzhi mdo me chu shing //so sor dbang zhing las byed mtha' dag bsangs/te dwo ཿ༷nga lha rma chen 13ba ma ras mtshon//srid pa

bsangs yig mi 'dzad mchod sprin sgo 'byed/ 9)chags pa'i lha chen lha sras rje'i/ /mgur lha mnga' 'bangs srung ba'i srog gi lha/ /gangs can bod yul skyong ngo cog rnams bsangs/ /brgya byin dkar nag khra gsum wer ma'i tshogs/ /mdud lha thugs dkar sum brgya drug cu dang / mi'u gdung drug za dar la sogs pa/ /g.yung drung bon gyi lha rnams ma lus bsangs/ /lo zla tshes dang sbar sme sa bdag rigs/ /spor thang lha dang pha mes mi rabs brgyud/ /dmu rabs gtsug rabs brgyud kyi srung skyob mgon/ /mdor na nyes sems phan pa sgrub kun bsangs/bshags pa ni/ ma dag dri ma ga thud pa'i bsangs mchode mthus/ /dam tshig sdom nyams 'khon dang dme yugs mnol/ /mdze bshan bag grib dkar dmar thab gshob btang / /mi gtsang gis 'bags bya spyod nyes pa kun/ /gdod nas rnam dag sems kyi mkha' dbyings su/ /kun rdzob 'khrul ba'i char sprin ji bzhin du/ /gnas lugs rang ngo 'phrod nas mchode yul dang / /mchod bya mchod byed bral ba'i ngang du bshags/ /'phrin 'chol ni/ de ltar mchod pa'i yul gyur khyed rnams kyis/ /nad rims dbul phongs dus min 'chi ba dang / kha smras mi kha 'thab rtsod dug mtshon g.yul/ /mi mthun 'jigs pa kun las bsrung du gsol/ /rdzogs ldan skye dgu'i che dang rnam thos nor/ /brgya byin bde skyid gtsug na zla ba'i mthu/ khyab 'jug 'phrul dang tshangs pa'i dbang thang sogs/ /mnyam por longs su spyod nusa'aphrin las mdzod/ /legs ldan rigs kyi thig le ag glen zhes/ /bod yul chol ga gsum la dbang sgyur ba'i/ khyud las yar 'brog khri skor skyong ba'i rje'i/ bsod nams dbyar gyi mtsho ltar 'phel bar mdzad/ /thub bstan (14na 'dzin dang spel ba'i dge 'dun sde/ /sa chen skyong ba'i rgyal po 'bangasa'akhor bcas/ /bdag sogs mi nor chos srid dkar cha'i zla/ /ji bzhin 'phel ba'i bsod namasadar spyi khyab la blo ka gong 'a tsha༅ 'di chag drag mdzod/ /lha g.yang 'gugs pa ni/ lha klu gnod sbyin dri za grul bum dang / /gling bzhir dbang mdzad 'khor 'e rgyal sogs/ /'jig rten gsum gyisayon tan ma lus pa/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i phywa dang g.yang khug cig /bzod gsol dang gshegs pa ni/ mchod rdzas nyams dang ting 'dzin mi gsal sogs/ /nongs pa mtha' dag mgron rnams spyan snga —485

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)sa bshags pas tshangs pa'i dngos grub legs rtsol zhing //rang rang gnas su gshegs shig badz+ra muḥbakra shis ni/rtag tu thugs rjes bskul ba'i skya rengs kyis//mi shes mun pa'i mal nas nyer bslang ste//phun tsho gos nyi ma'i 'od kyis srid pa gsum//snang ba'i dga' ston chen pos khyab par shog/gzhan yang bkra shis pa'i tshigs bcad ci rigs pa bya'o//gangs ri dpal ldan swā la'i ljongs chen po'i//lha klu gzhi bdag dga' bar byed pa'i bsangs//zhad zhung gshen rabs mi bo'i rjes gongasapa'i//g.yung drung bon gyi srol btod thog mar dar//zan g.yang chos 'khor bzhed pa'i sngon 'gro'i sgor//sangs rgyas kun bos pad+ma thod phreng gis//lha srin sdo brgyad dam chom btags bsangs ma da dang //rang rang dga' bskyed mthun pa'i rdzas kyis brngan//deng dus lha klu zhar byung tsam byas nas//bla ma yi dam gtsor bton bsangs yig rnams//dgos don ma rtogs gya tshom smra ba'i tshig/mchod rten nag 'jam brag la dkar rtsi bzhin/ma dag dri ma zhakhru da thabs lho byang gi/zab mo'i gter kha 14bsgos byung bor nas deng //bdag dang bdag 'dra'i rmongs pas bkod rnams la//brten pa chu la smig rgyur 'khrul dang mtshungs//'on te mkhyen spyod 'jam da byangs gzhone nu la//'gran bzod sa dbang lugs zung rnam g.yeng gis//tshig nyung don tshang gyis zhes bskul ba'i bka'//ma ldog byis blos dpogs nus tsam zhig bkod//snyan snyan dbyangs can zhal lung nas drangs na//gsal gsal yangs pa'i blo can tshogs dgyes mod//mang mang blun po'i lag tu 'khyar ba'i tshe//dam dam tshig don mi khrol nongs pasang la//ag glen rigs kyi thig le spyan gyi zur//zur tsam 'bab ched bkod pa'i dge ba'i tshogs//tsho gis gnyis rgya mtshor mkha' mnyam 'gro ba kun//kun nas rtse dga'i zlos gar bsgyur bar shog/ces bsangs kyi mchod pa lha lam kun khyab ces pa 'di ni chol kha gsum gyi kha lo bsgyur ba dpon chen ag glen rigs kyi thig le sa skyong zhang po kun dga' tshe brtan stobs rgyas kyi rgyun 'byer thugs dam du nyung ngu 'di lta bu zhig gyis zhes gsung gis bskul ba dang du blangs te za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni la 4 8 ༷ rgyas lkog pa phun tshogs dbang po'o//

bsang yig mi 'dzad mchod sprin sgo 'byed/ 9)na mo badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba ma lus pa/ /'dzin mdzod lag na rdo rje stobasapo che/ khyod zhabs pad+ma ra btud nas bsangs mchode dang / /'brel ba'i cho ga'i rim pa cung zad spel/de la 'dir cog tse lta bu stegs kyi bar rten khebs sogs gdan gtsang ma ji ltar rigs pa bkab pa'i steng du bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong spyi'i gtor ma dbus su zlum po dkar po che ba zhig la/de'i mthar bsgos zlum brgyad mtheb skyus skor ba/ de'i g.yas su snod gcig tu gtsang ris la dga' (15na tha'i lha klu gzhi bdag rnams kyi gtor ma dkar po zlum po che ba zhig la mtha' skor du skyu gu brgyad/ ril bu brgyad/ chang bu brgyad kyis bskor bar dkar gsum dngar gsum gyis sbran pa/g.yon phyogs kyi stod cig tu sha khrag la dga' ba'i sdo brgyad/ gzhi bdag rnams kyi gtor ma dbusasu bsgos bu gru gsum che ba zhig la/ gru gsum chung ba brgyad mtheb skyu dang bcas khrag gis byugasashing sha dmar gyis brgyan pa/ gtor ma gsum la dkar rgyan gyis spras pa/ phye mar chang phud/ mtha' skor du ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa/ mda' dar/ bsangs shing sogs yo byad thams cad sta gon legasapar bya/ cho ga dngos la/ skyabs sems ni rgyas pa'am bsdun sangs rgyas chos tshogos ma tshar gsum gyis rgyud dag par byas/ bdag bskyed ni/ rang skad cig gis pad zla'i gdan la dpal phyag na rdo rje sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhal gdangs shing ljags 'dril ba mche ba gtsigs pa/spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa glog ltar 'byug pa/ sma ra dang smin ma dang / dbu skra kham ser gyen du brjes pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'phyar zhing g.yon thugs kar sdig mdzub mdzad pa/ dar sngon po'i stod g.yogs dang stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs gsol pa/ rtse phran sogs rin po che'i rgyan dang sbrul gyis spras ba/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang pa'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan par gyur/ oṃ ni lam wa ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi ra dz+nyā pa ya ti swāhā/ zhes ci rigs bzla/ de nas mchod gtor rnams byin gyis brlab pa ni/ badz+ra a khra tas/ bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ma las rin po che/ a las thod pa'i snod —487—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las byung (15bsgo'i bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong sdo brgyad/ yul lha gzhi bdag rnams dbang po sgo lnga tshim par byed ba'i mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ oṃ sarba bid/ pā ra pā ra/ gu ra gyu ra/ā warta ya/ ā warta ya sngo/ badz+ra spa ra ṇa 'a/ zhes dpral bar nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya sngags dang bcas pa lan gsum dang / oṃ su bhā wa bi shudhe dharmāḥte badz+ra sirnyi hūṃ/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga to bh+yo bi shwa mu khe saḥ sarba thā kho u tho te ྅ ra ṇa i paṃ ga ga na 'a swāhā/ oṃ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇi/ ar+ya nut+pa sno tad/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūṃ/ oṃ ru ru spu ru dz+wa la ti sgo sirnya lo tsā ni sarba sna swā dha ni swāhā/ bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni/ /de bzhin gshegasapa'i sbyin stobs dang / /chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis/ /don rnams gang dag bsam pa kun/ /de dag thams cad ci rigs par/ /thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig khres sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis byin gyis brlabs/ /de nas mgron spyan drang ba ni/ snro chos sku bde chen klong nas 'og min du/ /nges pa lnga ldan gzugs sku mi g.yo bar/ /sprul pas don mdzad shākya seng ge sogs/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas ma lus gnas 'dir gshegs/ /thub pa'i rgyal tshab byams mgon 'jim pa'i dbyangs/ /shing rta ches mtsho ni mkhas pa paṇ+ḍita/ /mda' bsnun zhabs dang dpal ldan chos skyong sogs/ /brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i grub thob gnas 'dir gshegs/ /gangs can ljongs dang rgya hor yul khams su/ /rnam gsum 'khor lo'i nyin byed snang ba yis/ /bgrang yas bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel mdzad pa/ /rtsab brgyud pa'i bla ma gnas 'dir gshegs/ khyud sde bzhi yi dkyil 'khor lha'i (16na〉khor lo/ /dpal mgon lcam dral dam can chos skyong tshogs/ /bdun cu rtsa lnga phyi yi mgon po sogs/ /dkar phyogs skyong ba gnas 'dir ma lus gshegs/ /sngon gyi las dang smon lam mthu rtsal can/ /sna tshogasaphan gnod byed pa lha ma srin/ /dkar nag 'dres mar spyod pa ldebargyad du/ /gtogs pa'i 'byung po ma lus gnas 'dir gshegs/ /chen po hor gyi yul grur gtogs sgo cog /spyi dang khyad par phyogs—488

bsangs yig mi 'dzad mchod zhin sgo 'byed/ (ge'adi'i ri klungs mtshor/ /gnas shing rgyu ba'i stobs ldan mi ma yin/ /lha klu gnod sbyin 'byung bo gnas 'dir gshegs/ /yang sgos bdag dang pha mes rigs brgyud la/ /'go ba'i pho lha shad lha dgra lha dang / /skyes lha yul lha la sogs nyin mtshan kun/ /bsrung skyob byed pa thams cad gnas 'dir gshegs/ bzhugs gsol ni/ nyi zla pad+ma dar zab rin cen khri/ /rang rang dgyes pa'i gdan la legasabazhugs nas/ /'dod yon mchod sprin la rol sta gon du/ /'gying bag rol ba'i tshul gyis tiṣ+ṭha rtsa/ /'dir mchod pa ni/ /mchod cing bsngo ba'i yul du gyur rnams la/ /ja chang 'o dar skyems bzang mchod yon dang / /pad+ma ut+pal sna tsho gis me tog gi /'phreng ba spel legs chun po thod du 'chings/ shar phyogs sa 'dzin yangs shing ngos 'jam par/ /stag ba sdong po yal 'dab gser mdog can/ /lho phyogs sa 'dzin yangs shing ngos 'jam par/ khug pa sdong po yal 'dab g.yu mdog can/ zhub phyogs sa 'dzin yangs shing ngos 'jam par/ /sba smyug sdong po yal 'dab zangs mdog can/ /byang phyogs sa 'dzin yangs shing ngos 'jam par/ /mkhan dkar sdong po yal 'dab (16bcung mdog can/ /tsan dan dkar dmar skya pe ga sa /dri bsung ngad ldang bdud rtsi can gyi shing / /dzāti li shi susmel/kol/ /gur kum stogang ga pur spos dkar dang / /gil chu srin sder mo du ru ka /thang dang chu las skyes pa'i sman sna stong / /gar spos la sogs dri zhim rdzas kyi rigs/ /bsangs dud sprin phung shangs kyi yul du 'bu' / /rtsi bcud 'bru mar snang gsal mun pa sel/ /sman gyi ngad ldan dri yi byug pa dang / /lha mi'i bza' bca' ro brgya ldan pa'i bgos/ /sna tshogs sgra snyan rol mo'i mchod pa dbul/ /phun tsho gos 'dod pa'i yon to lnga ldan zhing / /rnam par dkar dmar ba lo rgyan ldan pa/ /ngo bo bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho'i pā dza 'dis/ /mchod pa'i yul rnams thugs dam skongs gyur cig /bye brag bsangs kyi mchod pa ni/ khyad par dri zhim ngad 'thul bsangs mchode kyi/ /dud pa'i sprin phung sa gzhi bar snang kun/ khyab pa'i nyes tshogos dri ma mtha' yas pa/ /ting 'dzin sngags brgya rdzas kyis byang gyur cig /chos kyi dbyings las kha sbyor bdun ldan skur/ /bzhedas pa'i ma 'gags—489

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya 4tshogasung lkom/ (4)rang gdangs rigs gsum dang //rigs lnga rigs brgya bcom ldan shāka thub sogs//dus gsum bde bar gshegs ba ma lus bsangs//byang sems rang rgyal skye 'phags dge 'dun spyi//gnasabs grub thob brgyad cu rgyan drug mchog/skyon sham bha la dang 'phags bal bod//rgya hor byon pa'i mkhas grub thams cad bsangs//dngos su chos kyi bka' drin stsal ba dang //brgyud nas thugs rje 'jug pa rtsa brgyud kyi//dpal ldan bla ma spyi dang khyad par du//rje btsun blo bzang grags pa yab srasabasangs//'dus pa dmar nag gshed skor bde dgyes dang //dus 'khor la sogs pha ma 17naganyis med rgyud//yo ga bya spyod la 'dus rgyud sdebazhi'i//bgrang yas dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thamasato ba4sa//gnas dang nye gnas sto dang nye ba'i ṣ+ka //dzas tshes dang nye ba'i 'du//dur khrod nye dang 'thung spyod nye 'thung sogs//gnas gsum bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsangs//myur mdzad mgon po lcam dral gnod sbyin bzhi//las gshin phyi nang gsang ba re ma twe//zhal bzhi rnam mang thos sras beg tse sogs//nang gi chos skyong ma mgon 'khor bcas bas//phyogs skyong bcu dang lha klu gza' chen brgyad/khyu skar nyer brgyad sdod pon chen bo dgu/rgyal wo bzhi ste gtsang risabadun cu lnga'i//dkar phyogs skyong ba phyi yi mgon po bsangs//lha dang gshin rje bdud gza' rgyal po btsan//gnod sbyin klu srin sa bdag la sogs pa//'dzam gling yul gru kun na gnas pa yi//snang srid lha srin sdebargyad ma lus bsangs//byang phyogs sog po'i rgyal khams mtha' dag dang //khyad par bdag sogs gnas yul ri klungs mtsho//brag spang shing la gnas shing rgyu ba yi//'jig rten 'byung po'i rigs gyur mtha' dag bsangs//khyad par o rod phyogs gyi yul gru'i cha//al tha'i swā ri thar ba ga tha'i dang /jal man bog do a lag yo la dang //kho gor kho pogs pa yan du re khen//smyor ge tshor dang khu khe gu ya dang //bu la na'i dang chog lhum la dang //kha su lug dang ba yan a la dang /khug cu bu dang sha ra bel sogs la//rtsi shing nags tshal me tog spang ljongs dang //lcags zangs zha nye la sogs rin po che//sna tshogs kyis gtams 'byor ba'i sgo phye zhing //ring ba'i ri 490

bsangs yig mi la dzad mchod sgrin sgo 'byed/ 9)brgyud ser nag rgyan(17bslebs pa/ /ri bo kun la gnas pa'i lha rnams bsangs/ /kho bog khrer gsum ji rags lang thu khum/ /ji ra ga lang thu thal ye sud dang / /e shin nu ra chag na nu ra dang / /bo ro tha la ol jos mu sbom dang / /jul thu su dang ge gen thel me dang / /thub jir ga lang 'bru sna me tog dang / shing tog nags tshal 'dod yon sna tsho gis pas/ /rgyan gyur yul dang yul ljongs mtha' klas par/ /gnas shing bdag gir 'dzin pa'i rdzu phrul can/ /gnas gzhi yul gyi bdag po thamasacad bsangs/ /er chos skya nag khe ran khe mu cheg /kha pa bur chi khur chin kha la 'than/ /na rin spos rol a na'i tsha ras lam/ khem tshig mtsho mang sol bi bu la gan/ /u rung gu dang khi sal pa sha dang / /us khol e mil khu 'ur ge kheng gir/ /sud khol ba tsha'i gin ji lig leb zha/ /kha ra thal dang khu khe u su dang / /theng gis kha sha khong gis i li dang / khyad par bla mtsho chen po bar kha dang / /mtsho dang klung chen klung phran khron pa rdzing / /nyal 'gro kun la gnas pa'i lha klu dang / mtsho sman sa srin gnyan dang sa bdag bsangs/ /gzhan yang sa chu me rlung 'byung ba'i lha/ /pho lha zhad lha srog lha yul lha dang / /dgra lha skyes lha 'go ba'i lha rnams dang / khrid pa'i lha dang smon pa 'grub pa'i lha/ /sku gsung thugs dang gling bzhi dar ba'i lha/ /dpa' rtsal myur mgyogs dmu rabs gtsug rabs dang / /rang la yod dang grogs la 'go ba'i lha/ /dgra las thob dang bzang kha byed lha bsangs/ /gzhan yang byes su bgrod pa'i lha gnyan dang / /mgron gyi mgron g.yag bcu gsum lam srung dang / /rdzong gi rdzong btsan dkar po brag ri yi/ /btsan dmar mtsho yi mtsho sman phyug mo dang / /khang pa sa zhing thab kha (18nangasakyi lha/ /sbra gur 'bru sna rnga mo rta drel phyugs/ /rin chen sna tsho gis gos dar ja ras bags/ /phyi nang nor rdzas skyong ba'i lha rnams bsangs/ /tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor rigs brgyud dang / /mtha' thang spel zhing don rnams sgrub pa'i lha/ /gzhis su rang gzhan bde ba mdzangs ma'i las/ /sgrub la mthun rkyen byed pa'i lha rnams bsangs/ /dpa' brtul chen pos pha rol 'joms pa'i g.yul/ /bgom pa'i btsan po'i go dang rnon po'i mtshon/ /mtho dma' bar du bya 'os zhi drag gi /las rnams—491—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)kun la dbang pa'i lha rnams bsangs/ /spar kha sme ba lo skor bcu gnyis dang / /sa bdag rgyal blon mo dang rtsis kyi lha/ /gzhis sdod lam 'jug byes bgrod las kun la/so sor phan pa'i srung ma thams cad bsangs/ /mdor na rgya gar shar nub lho byang dang / /bal li rgya nag pā cing bcu gsum sa/ /bod dang bod chen glo mon sham+bha la/ /'dzam gling yongs kyi gzhi bdag thams cad bsangs/ /de nas dgra lha dbang bstod bya ba ni/ ru dar la dgra lha sku mdog dkar po dbu la lcags rmog rgyal mtshan dar lcog sogs kyis spras pa/ sku la brtse khrab ser po/ 'khas la sag lham ga sgob/ rked par stag ral gzig shubs bcings pa/ phyag g.yas sba lcags dang g.yon srab mda' 'dzin pa/ lcags kyi bya khra klad la lding pa/ phrag gong g.yas la seng chen dang g.yon la stag chen 'gying ba/ khyi nag dom dred rjes su khrid pa/ mdun du sdebargyad dang sprul pa'i 'khor sna tsho gis bris pa zhig btsugs pa'i mdun du/mchod pa dang / khrab/ rmog /ral gri /mdung / mda' gzhu/ mda' dang / /spyan gzigs rnams ci 'byor ba thog ma nas bshams pas byin rlabs zhar la 'grub/ /de nas 'di skad do/ /kye/ semasacan spyi mthun las kyis yongs grub pa/ /nam mkha' stong pa'i dbyings sung ba bzhi'i (18ba)dkyil 'khor rim chags steng du gling bzhi dang / /gling phran lcags ris yongs su bskor ba'i dbus//rin cen sna bzhi las grub ri rab rtser/ /phun tsho gis lha yi pho brang grong khyer dang / /rtsa bar thagasabazang ris sogs lha min gnas/ /dpag bsam yongs 'du'i ljon pa'i gos bu la/ /lha dang lha min phan tshun rtsod pa'i mthus/ /legs bris gnas su sra ba'i go cha dang / /sbyin skyes yul du rno ba'i mtshon cha brdungs/ /dpung tsho gis yan lag rnam bzhi'i g.yul bshams pa'i/ /dang por lha yi dmag dpung pham pa'i tshe/ /mig stong can gyis gsang ba'i bdag po la/ /gsol ba btab par lung bstan ji bzhin du/ /g.yin gyis ma bcos rang byung go mtshon dang / /rten 'brel shugs kyis lha rgod thog 'bebs dang / /klu mo dung skyong gnyis po bgos pa'i sras/ /dgra lha wo po mgo dgu dngos su byon/ /lha yi dbang por khyed rnams rgyal 'dod na/ /nged la rten chags phyag dang mchod bstod rnams/ /gyis—492

bsang yig mi yod ma rdzo sprin sgo tshod/ 9)zhes bskul ltar mthun pa'i rten rdzas btsugs / /ri rab rtse mor dgra lha spyan drangs nas/ mthun rdzas kyis mchode brda yis bskul ba na/ /hūṃ hūṃ lan gsum brjod bas lha dmag rnams/ /gzi brjid phun sum tsho gos pa'i bkrag mdangs byung / /kye kye lan gsum brjod pas sra ba'i go /rnon po'i mtshon cha rnams la 'od zer 'bar/ /su su lan gsum brjod pas dpung gi tshogs/ zhus pa med pa dpa' bo'i ngar dang ldan/ /brda' brda' lan gsum brjod nas g.yul bshams pas/ /lha min mgo lag bregasashing go cha ral/ /ru dar rol mo chag cing pham byas nas/ /lha rnams rnam par rgyal ba'i ru mtshon bslang / /sngon byung de bzhin deng dus(19na thad ga cag gis/ /lha khyod spyan 'dren mchod bstod bskul byed na/ /thogs pa med par gnas 'dir gshegs nas kyang / /sku gzugs 'di la g.yo med brtan par bzhugs/ /lha yi dbang pos sri zhu mdzad pa ltar/ /yon gyi bdag po'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /brtsigs pa'i mkhar khyim phub pa'i gur dang sbra/ /smos shing btab pa'i sa zhing lo rtag dang / /bsags pa'i gser g.yu mu tig dngul zangs sogs/ /rin chen sna tsho gos bzang gos dar ras ja/ /pags rigs sna tsho gos las grub zhwa gos lham/ /rta drel rnga mo gnag phyugs ra lug bya/ jo bo thun dang ub chi kha rab chi/ /o mo rub chi sob chi su thab chi dang / /dbus ga chi a la khral or sbog go /tho bi lcags 'bag rmog chen phru yis mdzes/ rno ngar ral gri mdung ring 'phang mdung dang / /es nge chi khrin su khar pā gur/ /jo bo go de li dang khes su mos/ /gang ba'i stag gdong rin cen pha gu can/ /mchog dkar gzhu mo gzig shun shubs ldan can/ /me yi mda' sgrogs dgra sta sta re sogs/ /sna tsho gos mtsho ni cha'i khyad par ji snyed pa/ /rdzu phrul rlung gi shugs ldan rta mchog la/ sga srab gong rmed mdzes pa'i mas kyis spras/ /'phan gdugs rgyal mtshan dar bkra'i lda ldi g.yo/ /ru tshon dar lce lhab lhub nam mkha' 'geng / gtor ma lha mi'i bza' bca' ro brgyar ldan/ ja chang zho dar gas ba mtsho ru bskyil/ /me tog sna tshogs snang gsal sgron me sbar/ /dzornga zom rnga rnga zlum dung chen dang / /sbug sil bi waṃ rol mo gnam sa ldir/ /dgra lha chen po dgyes pa'i rten du 'bul/ /rten —493

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo yong rgya mtsho ri gsung 'bum/ 64)lam ma g.yo stong grogs dpung gnyen mdzod/ /kyi/ mkha' lab khu 'brug 'brug la (19bcu ba rgyas/ /gangs la seng ge seng chen ral pa gsig /spang la sha ba rwa bcu phyogs su rgyas/ /chu la nya mo nya mo gser mig 'khyil/ /mtsho la ngang pa ma tshes be'u mtsho/ /pha mas bu tsha la ni byams pa ltar/ /dgra lha chen po mi dang ma 'bral bar/ /nyin mtshan dus drug g.yel med mel tshe mdzod/ /sra ba'i go cha dbu rmog gangs ri'i mdog /rno ba'i mtshon cha rnams la dgra lha bzhugs/ /dpa' rtsal ldan pa'i mi pho bzhen pa'i rta/ /las byed zhub can dmag gi dpung tsho gos la/ /dgra lha lus dang grib ma ltar 'grogs shig /gung sngon mthon po sa gzhi dro po la/ /dgra lha chen po 'bral ba med bzhugs nas/ /pha rol g.yul las rnam par rgyal bar mdzod/ /g.yang 'gugs ni/ /kyai/ nam mkha'i dbyings nasa'abrug skad snyan po'i g.yang / /nags ma'i khrod nas rgya stag rtsal gyi g.yang / /nor 'dzin steng nasamago nag mi yi g.yang / /spang ljongs ngos nas sha rkyang 'phel ba'i g.yang / khugs ldan rta yi gsar 'gros bang gi g.yang / /khyung dkar mdzo dang 'dod 'jo ba yi g.yang / /g.yang dkar lug dang tshe tshe ra yi g.yang / /stobs chen rnga mo khal chen theg pa'i g.yang / /rin cen dar zab ja 'bras 'bru yi g.yang / /stag gzig rgyal po'i mi zad mdzod kyi g.yang / /ge sar rgyal po'i dpa' rtsal dmag gi g.yang / /mtshon gyis mi phigs go cha btsan pa'i g.yang / /dgra dpung byer 'thag mtshon cha rno ba'i g.yang / /'jam mnyen rig na bde ba gos kyi g.yang / /lce la ro brgya bda' ba zas kyi g.yang / /tshe ring bde zhing skyid pa lha yi g.yang / /dpal 'byor bsod nams dar ba gnod sbyin g.yang / /mi brgyud chu las ring ba bu tsha'i g.yang / /chab srid dbu rmog bas pa dpon gyi g.yang / /mnga' (20na'i bangs phyogs bcur rgyas pa 'khor gyi g.yang / /'dod gzugs lha dang bcud bral gnod sbyin dang / /dri za grul bum sto 'phye mi'am ci/ /'khor rte rgyal btsun mo mdun na 'don//rin chen glang po rta mchog dmag dpon sogs/ /mdor na srid zhi'i phywa g.yang kun khug la/ /phywa g.yang gnyen po gnas 'dir 'khyil li li/ /dgra lha 'khor dang bcas pa'i dbu 'phang bstod/ /—494

bsang yig mi 'dzad ma rdzo zhin sgo khed/ 9)bdag sogs gzhi lam byes gsum gang du yang //rgyab kyi brten sa mdun gyi 'khar ba dang //skyelabasu sgrol 'don mgon skyabs dpung gnyen mdzod//nad rims gdon bgegs dus min 'chi ba dang //dbul phongs mi kha gleng brjod la sogs pa//nyes tshogos kun gzhil sdang ba'i dgra bo 'thul//tshe dpal bsod na mas legs tshogis rgyas par mdzod//su su lha rgyal lo/sang mus lasadagra lhar dpangs bstod mi byed na bsangs la grung rje dang /byed na gnyis/rdzogs4mos 'dir wen las 'chos ba ni//de ltar bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang //chos skyong srung ma yul lha gzhi bdag sogs//mchod pa'i yul du gyur ro cog rnams la//lha bsangs dud sprin mchod pa phul ba'i mthus//bdag sogasarnams kyis 'khor ba thog med nas//bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes lhung dri ma dang //lha 'khon mi dang mi 'khon lha la 'phog/dme grib yugs grib dam grib bcog grib dang /ro grib bag grib bshan grib mdze grib sogs//mi gtsang nyes pa'i tsho gos kun dag gyur cig/bdag sogs mi nor 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis//bsam pa'i don rnams lhun gyis grub par mdzod//yi ge brgya pas chad lhag bkang /ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang //zhes sogs kyis bzod par gsol/khyod kyis 20ba thams can don kun mdzad//sogs kyis mgron rnams rang gnas su gshegs/mas brjod ni//dngos grub kun stsol rtsa brgyud bla ma dang /byin rlabs ga kho mdzod yi dam dkyil 'khor lha//'phrin las sgrub mdzad chos skyong dam can gyis//bkra shis dge mas char ོ deng 'dir phob//gtsang ris dpal mgon bdun cu'i tsho gos rnams dang //snang zhing srid pa'i lha srin dregs pa'i tshogs//'go ba'i lha dang yul lha gzhi bdag gi/bkra shis dge mtshan char chen deng 'dir phob//gnam la nyi zla gza' skar 'od bkrag gsal//sal srid zhi'i dge mtshan g.yang du chags//lha rnams dbu 'phang 'thon por bstod pa yis//bkra shis dge mtshan char chen deng 'dir phob/ces byang phyogasachen po hor gyi yul du nye bar mkho ba'i bsangs mchod dgra lha dpang bstod dang bcas pa lha rgyal snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs 'di ni rgyal ba gnyis pa ba/༷ kha pa chen po'i bstan pa bla nas blar 'degs pa'i

sri zhur brtson pa sa'i tshangs pa dad stobs kyi dbang phyug dad ldan bstan 'dzin sbo shog thu rgyal pos 'bad pa chen pos bskul ma mdzad pa ltar za hor gyi brnyes drag po zhes pa lcags sbrel hor zla bdun pa'i yar tshes la rang byung 'phags pa'i gzhal yas khang pho brang dmar po rir sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni mthar rgyas pa blo bzang dbang pos bgyis pa'o/ /sarba maṅga lo// //

klu gtor gdeng ༅ dga' bskyed/ 9)༄༅༅/ /klu gtor gdengs can dga' bskyed bzhugs/ /gdengs can tshogs rnams dga' ba bskyed pa la/ /brten nas 'gro la phan bde'i dpal ster ba/ /tshegs chung tsam gyis sgrub nus ngo mtshar gtam/ /zhabrul med dam pa'i gsung rgyun 'di na spel/ /de yang gtor ma phyag len ltar bshams/ rdo rje gnod sbyin gyis phyag rgyas/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūṃ/ zhes pas ma dag pa bsangs/ rdo rje me'i phyag rgyas/ oṃ badz+ra tha la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bha sdu ra ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pas gzi byin bskyed/ rdo rje bsdam pa'i phyag rgya/ oṃ a kā ro mu zhe sarba dha rmā ṭ+wāṃ ār+ya nu t+pa na tā ta oṃ sa/ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pas rin po tsho snod du bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'dod pa'i yo byad kyis gang bar bsam/ 'dod rgyal gyi phyag rgyas rang gi snying ga las 'od zer 'phros pas klu'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa dang / bye brag tu bdag la gnod pa'i klu'i rigs thams cad badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ sa spyan drangs/ oṃ/ klu rgyal mtha' yas nor rgyas bu/ /'jog po dang ni stobs kyi rgyu/ pad+ma pad+ma chen po dang / /dung skyong dang ni rig (2na dzin no/ /lha mo lha mo chen po dang / zla ba'i spyi gtsug spyi gtsug che/ /ltag 'dzin ltag 'dzin wo po dang / /sog ma med dang hu lun+ta/ /dga' bo dang ni nyer dga' bo/ /rgya mtsho rgya mtsho chen po dang / /tsha ba tsha ba chen po dang / dpal gyi 'od dang 'od po che/ /rin cen 'od dang gzugs mdzes dang / gzugs mdzes chen po sprul bzang dang / /lto 'phye chen po tshi li dang / tshi li chen po rnam dag ni/ /mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ ā gtsā ā la mahā nā ga adhi pa ta le sarba bhu rtu wa / phu swāhā/ zhes pas mdun du byon par bsam la/ pad+ma ka ma la ye sto gyis gdan phul/ mahā nā ga a dhi pa ta ye gro ste rda a swāhā/ pu / swāhā/ lha t+pa swāhā/ di paṃ swāhā/ byu swāhā/zhes pas mchode la/ klu dga' bar byed pa'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ hi li hi li mahā hi li sbyo phu swāhā/ zhes—497

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo4)lan gsum dang / yo bhak+ṣa ya bhak+ṣa ya sam ya tiṣ+ṭha / phu hūṃ swāhā/ zhes lan gsum la sogs pas phul nas/ ye wo he tu bra bha wā he tu te a thā ga to sgo wad ta/ te dzin yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī mahā shra ma ṇaḥsdig pa ci yang mi bya ste/ /dge ba phun sum tsho gos par spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /zhes chos kyi sbyin pa byin la/ klu'i rgyal po brgyad kyis gtso byas pa'i klu dang sa bdag gi rigs su gyur pa thams cad dang / bye brag tu bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la/ gnod cing lan chags pa'i klu dang sa bdag thams cad gtor ma (2ba'i dis tshim zhing mnyes par gyur cig /gnod pa dang gdug pa'i bsam pa zhi zhing phan pa zhi bas byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par gyur cig ces dang / oṃ nā ga a dhi pa ta ye byu zhes pas gshegs su gsol/bya khyung gi phyag rgyas/ chag ru ḍa he tsa le tsa le swāhā/ zhes pas nag po'i klu rnams bskrad par bsam/bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni/ /zhes sogs bden stobs brjod bsod nams 'di yis thamasacad gzigs pa nyid/ khes bsngo smon bya'o/ /spyir klu gtor ni thebs yod med la ltos na'ang dpal ldan sa skya pa'i phyag len gyi dkar cha bzhi pa'i nang gi klu gtor rgyun du mdzad cing phan yon che bas/'phags pa rin po che dang rgyal sras thogs med bzang po dpal sogs gong ma rnams kyis yig cha nas/ rje shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan gyis gsal bar mdzad pa'i yi ge las byung ste rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i rgyun khyer du za hor gyi brjes bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni gnasabartan 'jam dbyangs so/ /—498

༄༅༅//dkar cha bzhi'i dga' ston phan bde'i 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs so//mi mthun bdud bzhi 'jiṭa brgyad bcu drug kun/ /zhi mdzad mi g.yo mgon dang 'phags ma'i zhabs//bslu med gtan gyi skyabs mchoge lhag pa'i lha//byang chub bar du snying gi ze'u 'byur bzhugs//mgon zung mchod dang gdengs can dga' ba bskyed//'jur gegs bkres skom lasasgrol mchod sbyin gyi//sgo 'phar brgya phrag 'byed pa dkar cha bzhi//bya sla tshegs chung 'di phyi'i don chen 'grub//de'i tshul 2na7khon rigs ma dros klung chen las//'jam mgon mkhyen pa'i mtho ris chu bo'i rgyun//thub bstan rgya mtsho'i srog tu rtag 'bab pa//sa skya'i rje btsun phyag bzhes 'khrul med 'bri//de la 'dir sa skya'i rje btsun rnams kyi thugs dam du mdzad pa'i dkar gtor cha bzhir grags ba ni/lhag pa'i lha bcom ldan mi g.yo mgon po/rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma gnyis/sa skya'i gtsug lag khang klu gtsug na rin chen gyi pho brang gi steng na yod pas gtso bor gyur ba'i klu/yi dwags rnams la dbul ba ste/gtor ma sdod shoms na so so dang de min gtor skrungs byas kyang rung /yi dwags kyi gtor ma ni dkar gtor dang ril bu la nges pa med kyang chu sbreng ba dang bcas phyi ma 'jug pa bde ba mthong brgyud kyi phyag len ltar bsham/gtor ma gong ma gsum po'i dus la nges pa med cing su ྅ pa ni nges par bza' btsong gang yang ma byas pa'i sngon du gtor dgos la/dengs sang phyag len lhan cig tu mdzad pa'i dbang gis tho rangs kyi cha'am 'phyi yang zas skom la longs ma spyad pa'i gong du sangs rgyas chos tshogos ma lan gsum gyis skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa sngon du btang /dang po rje btsun mi g.yo ba la 'bul ༷ ṭ+wāṃ/oṃ a gra ta ji phaṭa gyis bsangs/( bhā wa

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)shurnya sarba dharmāḥsu bhā wa shu rdzo3lha/ stong pa'i ngang las yo las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por mos/ oṃ skya//(2bsgon gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas rje btsun mi g.yo ba sku mdog sngon po ral gri dang zhags pa 'dzin pa rin po che dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ dar gyi stod g.yogs dang stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can pad nyi'i gdan la g.yas bskums g.yon brkyangs kyis bzhugs pa'i rnam pa can rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas ma badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ ces lan gsum mam bdun gyis gtore ma phul/ /ā+oṃ wa ra a tsa la a nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ kye kye mtha' gnyis rnam par ma g.yos kyang / /mtha' bral bde chen khro bo rgyal po'i sku/ /sprul pa'i gzugs kyis 'gro don dpag med mdzad/ /'jigs byed chen pos 'gro ba kun sgrol zhing / srid pa gsum na dgyes pa'i gar mdzad pa/ khrid pa'i chu bo skems shing mi mthun bdud rnams 'joms/ khrid pa'i rlung gis ma g.yos thugs rje'i mgon/ /rab brjid mi g.yo mgon la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod la thal mo snying khar sbyar te/ mi g.yo mgon pos bdag dang sems can kun/ /bar gcod bdud bzhi'i dgra las rnam rgyal zhing / /'jig rten 'jig rten 'dasapa'i dngos grub rnams/ thogs pa med par myur du stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab bo/ /gnyis pa rje btsun ma la 'bul pa ni/ gtor ma gong ltar gyis brlabs/ lho phyogs ri bo po ta la na rje btsun sgrol ma 'khor bcas mngon sum du bzhugs (3na sgos bdag la thugs rjes dgongs nas gtor ma bzhes par mos pas cho ga la spyan 'dren pa sogs bya mi dgos so/ /nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang bcas/ na ma'i: burnya bo dhi sa tā — / a pra ti ha ta shā sa nā — / he he bha ga wa te/ mahā satwa sa spru burnya a wa lo gi te/ mā bi la spa/ mā bi la spa/ i 4 li gri rmā pa ya kṛ hā pa ya hūṃ hūṃ/ sarba bi sa twa ra swāhā/ zhes pa lan gsum mam lan bdun gyis phul/ oṃ ār+ya tā re bye nas shasta'i bar gyis —500

dkar cha bzhi'i dga' ston phan bde'i 'dod 'jo/ 9)mchod/ lha dang lha min cod pan gyis/ /zhabs gnyis pa blo la btud de/ /phongs pa kun las sgrol mdzad ma/ /sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bstod/ 'phags ma sgrol mas bdag dang 'gro ba kun/ /'jigs chen brgyad dang bcu drug las skyob cing / /'khor ba ngan song sdug bsngal che las sgrol/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i dngos grub stsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ gsum pa klu rnams la dbul ba ni/rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūṃ gis gtor ma'i bgegs bsangs/rdo rje me'i phyag rgya dang oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañtsa ra ṇa hūṃ phaṭa kyis rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du klu rnams dga' bar byed pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mchos gang bar bsam rdo rje bsdam pa'i phyag rgya 'debs pa'i tshul dang / oṃ a ka ro mu byu sarba dharmā 'o ā bya nut+pa ma twata/ oṃ sa/ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis gtor ma las klu rnams ji ltar 'dod pa'i yo byad thams cad thogasapa med par byung bar bsams la/ 'dod rgyal gyi phyag rgya bcas rang gi snying ga nas 'od (3ba thar 'phros bas klu'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad dang bye brag tu bdag sogs la gnod par byed pa'i klu rigs thams cad badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs par mos la/ oṃ ba ta li ba ta li mahā ba ta li hūṃ hūṃ dzaḥdzaḥ swāhā/ lan gsum dang / cha klu rgyal mtha' yas nor rgyas bu/ /'jog po dang ni stobasakyi rgyu/ /pad+ma pad+ma chen po dang / /dung skyong dang ni rigs ldan no/ /lha mo lha mo chen po dang / /zla ba'i spyi gtsug spyi gtsug che/ /dbyug 'dzin dbyug 'dzin chen po dang / /sog ma med dang hu lus/ /dga' po dang ni nyer dga' bo/ /rgya mtsho rgya mtsho chen po dang / tsha ba tsha ba chen po dang / /dpal gyi 'od dang 'od po che/ /rin cen 'od dang gzugs mdzes dang / /gzugs mdzes 0 po sprul bzang dang / /sto 'phye chen po tshi li dang / /tshi li chen po rnam dag ni/ /mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /byur la ā la mahā nā ga a dhi pa ta ye sa spru snu rdzu waḥ/ / swāhā/ zhes pas mdun du byon par bsam pad+ma ka ma la ye skye gyis gdan phul/ oṃ mahā nā ga a dhi pa ta le kṛ ste rda a swāhā/ de bzhin du arnya gyi gnas su pu sge dhu pe/ di paṃ/ ga rnye bcug pas mchod/ klu dga' bar byed pa'i phyag rgya dang / ma lha li —50/ —

rgyas dang lnga pa ngag dbang blo 44 rgya ge'i gsung la ya/ (4)hi li mahā hi li / phu swāhā/zhes pa rtse gol brdab pa dang bcas ga gsum dang /oṃ bhak+ṣa ya bha k+ṣa ya sam ya tiṣ+ṭha — / hūṃ swāhā/zhes pa lan gsum gyis gtor ma bsngo/ye dharmā dang /sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste/dgeb yi sum tsho gis par spyang/ /rang gi sgos ni yongs su 'dul/'di ni sangs rgyas ba 4napa yin//zhes chos kyi sbyin pa byin//klu chen brgyad so gos klu rigs thams cad dang /bye brag bdag cag rnams la gnod byed kun//gtor ma 'dis tshim dgyes shing gdug sems zhi/phan pa byang chub sems dang ldan gyur cig zhes smon lam gdab/oṃ nā ga a dhi pa ti sa pā ri wā ra ga smo zhes pasadakar phyogs kyi klu rigs rnams rang gnas su gshegs/bya khyung gi phyag rgya dang /oṃ gwa ru ḍa nya sa he tsa le tsa le swāhā/zhes nag po'i klu rig rnams bskrad par mos so/sa skyar klu gtsug na rin chen la gtso bor dmigs nas mdzad pa yin pa yul gzhan du byas par dgos pa med dam snyam na/klu gtsug na rin byu med pa'i yul rnams su'ang klu re nges par 'ong bas phan yon che'o//bzhi pa su rū ba'i sngag kyis yi dwags rnams la sbyin pa ni/rang nyid skad cig gis de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs mdzes su bsgom/oṃ ba/ lan gsum gyis yi dwags rnams tshim par nus pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho wo por gyur par bsams la/mar sbyin gyi phyag rgya sa te/sangs rgyas rin 'a gzugs mdzes rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/na mas rū pā ya ta thā ga tā ya a rta te sa myaklas ya/tar+ya thā/oṃ su ru su ru spru su ru khra su sa ta ra ta ra/bha ra bha ra/sam+bha ra sam+bha ra /sma ra sma ra/sh+ka rā ya san+ta rā ya/wā pre tā māṃ swāhā zhes lan gsum mam bdun brjod pas yi dwags rnams la zad mi shes pa'i bdud rtsi dang 'dod yon lnga byung bar bsam/a pa sa ra/ a wa grub chu ra bre khyi kho da dwa mya ti sa spru lo ka dhā tu bha gi /bre tu na mahā raṃ/zhes pa lan cig bod skad du byed na/'ag rten gyi khams thams cad na gnas pa'i yi dwags rnams la bdag gis bza' ba 'di ster gyi/glags lta ba rnams phyir de pas shig/ces brjod cing sngags i las bod skad ma brjod kyang nyes pa med/yeya sogs chos kyi sbyin pa gong bzhi bya/phan tso phyir dang yib rtsod meX 2pa sa/bde bar zas thob longs spyod dbang po

dkar cha bsto dga' ston 3 ne'i 'dod wo/ 9)tshim/ /bkres skom phongs pa'i sdug bsngal las grol nas/ /mtho ri thar pa'i bde ba thob par shog /ces smon lam gdab/ deng sang me bsur chu bcur zhes mchogo dman kun la grags shing yi ge mang por yang phyogs mthun du bkod par snang mod/ me bsur la mdo sogs kyi brin so med cing / gsang sngags gsar ma'i phyogs su ma grags pas sngon rabs khungs btsun gyis yi ger yang ma 'khod/ de'i khungs ni gsang sngags rnying ma phyogs la brten dgos shing sdos me la btab pas bsur ming dang don mthun pa yin/ 'di la chu bsur zhes pa'i ming nam yang mi thob/ sngags la brten nas su ྅ ba zhesabatags pa/ su ni nyer bsgyur nyi shu'i nang gi legs pa mdzes pa bzang ba sogs la 'jug pa'i su dang ྅ pa ni gzugs yin pas de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs mdzes kyi mtshan las btags la/ chusabasur mi yong ba gnag rdzi rgan pos kyang shes pa de'o/ /phan yon ni dbul por mi 'gyur/ skye ba kun tu sto bos tsheb/ gzugs bzang zhing mthong na dga' ba/ longs spyod che ba/ tshe ring nad med (5na tha/myur du sangs rgyas thob pa/ de ma thob pa'i skye bar yang bde ba can du skye ba sogs kyi phan yon mdo las gsungs so/ /chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa yan chad la gtor ma cha bzhi po 'di las mi mdzad na'ang bla ma phyi ma rnams kyis gzhi bdag dang chu sbyin gyi rigs mdzad pa spro na so so'i yi ge dang /'phags pa'i rgyun gtor dang / rje shar khang pa'i dkar cha bzhi'i yi ge sogs las shes par bya'o/ /de nas bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni/ /zhes sogs kyis bden pa brjod/ gtor mgron rnamasami dmigs par bzhag pas khyab pa/ blo dman dag gshegs su gsol ba 'dod na/ mtheb srin gyisase gol dang badz+ra mu tshog pas mi g.yo ba rang bzhin gyi gnas dang / chu sbyin ched du lhags pa yi/ /'byung po thams cad rang gnas dengs/ /sarba bhū ta gas zhes brjod pas rang gnas su song bar bsam mo/ /bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ zhes sogs bsngo ba smon lam ci rigs pas mtshams sbyar/ gtor ma rnams gtsang sar dor bar bya'o/ /de ltar tshegs chung bya sla 'bad pa'i don/ /'di dang gto gyi skye ba'i zhing sal/ /'dzad med phan bde'i myu gu rab bskrun pa'i//—503—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)byed po mtha' dag bzang po'i skal ba can//de phyir rang gzhan mang por phan don du//rdul bral ston gyi zla ltar ches dkar ba'i//rnam dag bsam ba mchog gis kun blangs te/yi ge bkod pa yang dag don dang ldan//dge ba'i chu thigs byang chub rgya mtsho cher/dbyer med 'dres pa'i pha mtha' rtogasadaka' ba//5ba7kha' mnyam 'gro kun rnam pa thams cad mkhyen//ring por mi thogs rnyed pa'i rgyur 'gyur shog/ces sa skya'i 'jam mgon rim byon gyi phyag len 'byul ba'i dri ma med pa dkar cha bzhi'i ngag 'don phan bde'i 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba 'di ni g.yo ru grwa dge ba'i 'byung gnas kyi yul gru'i char byung ba'i sdum po pa nor bu dar rgyas kyis don gnyer chen pos bskul ba la brten nas/rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha ba sogs yongs 'dzin dam pa chos bzhi na du spyod pa du ma'i bka' drin gyis 'tsho ba za hor gyi brnyes chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa/sems dpa' chen po thogs med bzang po dpal/e waṃ shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa sogs khungs btsun gyi yi ge la brten nas rang bzos ma bslad par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas 5 a 'jam dbyangs so//

da༅༅//gtor ma brgya rtsa'i rim pa mu thi la'i 'khri shing bzhus/sa thes//na maḥpā 'o pad+ma shu'i ya/phyag na pad+mas rjes bzung zla rgyal rje/rdor 'dzin bye ba'i gtsug rgyan grags pa'i mtshan//dngos brgyud bla ma'i zhabs sen dbang gi rgyal//byang chub bar du gtsug tor rtse mor mdzes//gto pa med pa'i mchod sbyin gru rdzings la//brten nas bsod nams chu gter cher bgrod de//nges legs rin cen phung po skal bzang rnams/dga' spro'i yid kyis gzengs bstod ci dgar longs/de yang thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs kyis rjes su bzung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' zla ba rgyal mtshan gyi bzhed srol rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i gtor ma brgya rtsa'i phyag bzhes kyi rjes su 2na mo lbangs te gas sdebs su bkod pa la/gzan sum tshan gsum dang nyis 'a snyag tu bar pa'i dang po bcu la ril bu re dang phyi ma la brgyad byas pa/'byor na bzang sman sna tsho gos dang dkar gsum dngar gsum rin po che bsre/ting shags/chu bum sogs mngon par 'du bgyis/gnas dben par khrus dang gtsang sbra sngon du 'gro bas/gtor stegs la gtor cha bkram pa chus bkang 'grub na zhal zas shig kyang gams/bde ba'i stan la 'khod nas skyabs 'gro bzhi skor spyi ltar byed/bdag gis sems can thams cad gyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/de'i ched du mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya r+pā po 'di phul bas 'phags pa'i tshogs mnyes shing rigs drug rnams chos dang zang zing gis tshim par bya'o//zhes lan gsum brjod nas sems bskyed 3 med bzhi bsgom/thor thun dang snga thun lta bu rdzogs pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor la gnas na des khyab cing min na 'og nas yang ba'i spyan ras gzigs kyi bdag bskyed len/phyag rgya dang bcas/oṃ badz+ra0

ga 'a ma brgya rtsa'i rim ga ku thi la'i mu shing / 9)dzā la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañtsa ra ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/su bhā was sbyangs/stong pa nyid du gyur/stong pa'i ngang las ma las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ dpag tu med pa zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/zhabs bsil/me rtag/bdug spos/mar me/dri chab/zhal zas/rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med ba zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can bskyed 2ba thar gyur par bsam la/— sa//oṃ pā thu sa//chabadz+ra pu zhe skya/ nas/chabadz+ra sha rtotsohūṃ/chabadz+ra dharmā ra ṇi sogs kyis mchode pa byin gyis brlabs/rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas mchod pa dang sbyin pa'i yul du gyur pa thams cad badz+ra sa mā dzāḥs phyag rgya dang bcas spyan drangs/ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing /sogs sgro ka gcig dang /bcom ldan thugs rjes byon pa legs nas/'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol gyi bar sh+lau sna gnyis kyi mthar/ltasarba ta thā ga ta ga ga na sam ye hūṃ/ji ltar bltams pa nas/sam ya shri ye hūṃ gi bar brjod/bdag dang 'gro la thugasabartse'i phyir sogs kyi mjug tu oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pad+ma ka ma la ye ra gyis gdan phul/rab 'byams rgya mtsho dbag med na//mchod yon zhabs bsil
