me rtag dang //bdug spro tha/snang gsal dri chab dang //zhal zas sil snyan la sogs pa//mchod rdzas ji snyed mchis pa kun//bdag gi gus pas bshamasab 'di//ji snyed rgyal ba sras dang bcas//de snyed rnams la bdag 'bul na//thugs rje mnga' ba khyed rnams kyis//ci bde bar ni bzhes nas kyang //sems can don kun mdzod du gsol/oṃ ā nasasha dzi'i bar gyis mchode/sangs rgyas gtso la phyag 'tshal lo sogs blo ka gcig dang /bstod par 'osapa thams cad la//zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi//lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu //mchog tu dad pas bstod bar bgyi//zhes bstod phyag bya/ldan sgo gron wo dang po ni/de nas gtor cha lnga'i chu rnams bshams nas gzan gnyis gnyis blug par chab sbran pa ni 'og ma bcu la 'gre/a khra ltasabasangs/su bhā was sbyangs/stong ba'i tswa las las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du gton ma 'dod pa'i yon to lnga dang ldan 0༷'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho wo por 'gyur/oṃ ba//

rgyal dbang lnga pa pag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)zhes byin gyis brlab/ bsdu na oṃ 〉྅ lan gsum brjod pas kyang rung / na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo gi te sogs rgya chen gyi sngags gsum bdun nyer gcig gang 'os brjod pa dang gong gi gtor ma brlab pa 'og ma kun la 'gre /chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga rol mo'i bar gyis mchode pa mgron tshan drug pa yan 'dra zhing 'jug pa bde bar 'dod na ma byas kyang rung / rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams dang yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo/ /bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod rgyu sbyor bas gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ mgron tshan gnyis ba ni/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro /rdo rje mkha' 'gro /rin chen mkha' 'gro /pad+ma mkha' 'gro /sna tsho gos mkha' 'gro la sogs pa rnams dang gzhan yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung ba'i nang gi dpal mgon po lha mor bcas pa/ phyogs stong bcu rgyal po chen po sdebazhi/ lha chen po brgyad/ klu chen po brgyad/ gza' chen po (3ba brgyad/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ 'jigs byed chen po dgu sogs gtsang ris kyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga 'khor dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang bla ma dam pa rnams kyis bka' dang dam la btags shing sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung zhing rdo rje gdan gyis gtso byas rgya gar shar nub/ bod yul gyi gtsug lag khang dang gdan sa khyad par can skyong zhing bstan pa la mngon par dga' ba lha klu 'byung po'i tsho gos thams cad la 'bul lo/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas pa dang bstan pa'i rtsa lag dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams dang rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi sngon gyi las dang 'phral gyi rkyen las gyur pa mi dang mi yin pa'i gnod pa rkyen phyi nang gi bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ mgron tshan gsum pa ni/ rig 'dzin gyi sal gnas pa dge sbyong dang bram ze lha'i drang srong mngon par shes pa lnga dang ldan pa/ tshig tsam gyis phan 'dogs nus pa/ smon lam la dbang ba/ dmod pa 'dor bar nus pa rnams la 'bul lo/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang sems can thams cad bde zhing skyid pa bdag cag rgyu sbyor ba 'khor dang —507

gtor ma brgya rtsa'i rim pa mu thi la'i stse shing / 9)bcas pa chos bsgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba dang mthun rkyen thams cad chos bzhin du 'grub pa'i smon lam bzang po gdab tu gsol/mgron tshan bzhi pa ni/lhan cig skyesapa'i lha dang rnam thos sras/dzam bha la/nor rgyun ma/tshogs kyi bdag po la sogs te nor lha rnams dang bdag cag 'khor dang bcas 4na tha la bsrung skyob mdzad pa rnams la 'bul lo//nad dang dbul phongs kyi 'jigs pa med pa dang tshe dang dpal 'byor rgyas par mdzad du gsol/mgron tshan lnga pa ni/'dzam bu gling gi gzhi'i bdag po rnams dang khyad par bod khams skyong ba'i bstan ma bcu gnyis/sgos dbus gtsang ru bzhi/bye brag tu yul phyogs sa cha 'di nyid du gzhug mar gnas pa'i lha/klu bdud/ba 'a/gshin rje/ma mo/gza'/rgyal po/ma mo/the'u rang /sa bdag/g.yi mo thu bo che rnams la 'bul lo//'jig rten gyi khams su char chu dus su du 'bebs lo phyugs rtag tu legs pa/mi nad dang phyugs nad zhi ba/mu ge dang 'khrugs pa mi 'byung ba'i 'phrin las mdzod cig/mgron tshan drug pa ni/gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon wo po gang ba bzang po/nor bu bzang po/yang dag shes/rgyal ba khyu mchog/'brog gnas mched lnga la sogs te 'brog gnas kyi tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnamasal 'bul lo//sems can gyi srog dang gzi mdangs 'phrog pa sogs gnod 'tshe'i bsam pa thamasacad zhi zhing khyad par du bdag cag gi mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi nas chos dang mthun pa'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa mdzad du gsol/mgron tshan bdun pa ni/gong gi byin khas kyis bdud rtsir bsgyur bar ma zad gang la gang 'dod kyi 'bor ba'i yo byad du mos nas/rgya chen gyi sngags kyis kyang 'khor dgu'i longs 4brgyud phun sum tshogs par bsam la/de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs mdzes dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin gshegs pa sku 'byams klas la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigasapa thams cad dang bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo//zhes brjod pa 'di man la 'gre/bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu/gdon rigs sum brgya drug cu/༷sa pa'i gdon ོ bco lnga/nad bdag/rims

rgyal dbang lnga pa ga dang blo r+sāng rgya 4'gasung 'bum/ 64)bdag /yams kyi bdag mo/ gdug pa can gnod byed kyi tshogs dang bar snang la gnas pa 'dod pa'i gegs byed cing mi 'dod ba'i rkyen byed pa rnams la sbyin no/ /de ring phyin chad nas semasacan thams cad la bsam ga dang sbyor rtsub dang gnod cing 'tshe ba ma byed par gzhan phan byang chub kyi sems rgyud la skyes te brtse ba'i sems dang ldan par gyur cig /mgron tshan brgyad pa ni/ 'gro ba rigs drug /lam rgyud lnga/ skye gnas bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad la sbyin no/ /des tshim nas rigs drug so so'i bu lon lan chags 'khor bas sdug bsngal mtha' dag dang bral te pha rol tu phyin pa drug rim gyis rdzogs nas bla na med pa'i byang chub rin po che myur du thob par gyur cig /mgron tshan dgu pa ni/ yi dwags kyi gtso bor kha la me 'bar ba la sogs te phyi'i sgrib pa can/ nang gi sgrib pa can/ me lce'i sgrib pa can/ zas skom gyi sgrib pa can/ byings na gnas pa/ kha 'thor ba'i tshogs/bkres skom dbul phongs kyis(ldan gdungs pa rnams la sbyin no/ /mdun du zas skom bdud rtsi'i char chen po babs pas lus sems la phan pa dang bde bas longs spyad cing dga' bas tshim nas ser sna'i sdig sgrib byang zhing sdug bsngal mtha' dag dang bral te sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa rim gyis rdzogasanas gos bu sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i skal pa dang ldan par gyur cig /mgron tshan bas pa ni/bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas ba la/ tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas lan chags pa'i mgron bu lon ma 'khor ba/ tshe 'dir yang phog thug can dang zur la phog pa gnod par byed cing bag la nyal gyi gdon ngos la ma zin pa rnams la sbyin no/ gtor ma 'dis tshim nas lan chags dang sha 'khon thamasacad byang / bu lon thams cad khyer te gdug rtsub dang gnod 'tshe zhi nas re ba stong bar gyur cig /mgron tshan bcu gcig pa ni/ ril bu brgyad bshams la/ gtor ma re zhing skal pa chad pa/ kha zhan pa dbang chung ba/ 'byung po glo bur du lhags ba/ lhag ma dang shal chu la dbang ba rnams sbyin no/ so so'i mdun du zad mi shes pa'i zas skom gyis tshim par gyur cig /mjug tu kha zas mi thob pa'i yi dwags rnams la chu spyin pa ni/ gong gi gtor cha gcig phyis te gzan gyi dri tsam la yang med par byas/ rang —3tso

gtor ma brgya rtsa'i rim ga ku thi la'i 'khri shing / 9)skad cig gis 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon pad+ma dkar po 'dzin pa/ dar sna tshogs (4ba)kyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tsho gos kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs par bsam/ oṃ sa/ gis chu byin gyis brlab/ phyag g.yas pa'i steng gi bum pa bdud rtsis yongs su gang ba nas chu'i rgyun mi chad par byin bas kha 'bar ma dang 'jur gegs la sogs pa'i yi dwags kyi tshogs thams cad tshim par bsam zhing / cham ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ zhes mang du brjod/ mthar mas / / gis kha la me 'bar ma sogs la chu sbyin/ yang chu thigs re phyir 'bo zhing se gol gags te/ oṃ dzā la mi rda sarba bre te saḥ swāhās 'jur gegs la byin nas/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang gi /phyag nas 'bab pa'i 'o rgyun gyis/ yi dwagasarnams ni tshim byas nas/ /khrus byas rtag tu bsil bar shog /chu'i sbyin pa 'di la brten nas kha 'bar ma dang 'jur gegs la sogs te yi dwags kyi tshogs thams cad kyi mdun du zas skom longs spyod kyi tshogs chen pos tshim nas sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa myur du rdzogs par gyur cig zhes brjod/ 'jig rten pa'i mgron rnams la rten 'brel snying po dang sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing sogs kyis chos sbyin pa bya/rgyan gyis brgyan par byas kyang nas gnod pa ma byed cig gi bar gtong / yig brgya brjod/ ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ badz+ra mu chis me shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ sarba lo ka bhū ta la 'jig rten pa rnams rang gnas su gshegs 4na)par bsams/ bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang / /chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis/ /'phags pa rnams la mchod pa dang / /sems can rnams la byin pa yis/ /don rnams gang dag bsams pa kun/ /de dag thams cad ci rigs pa/ /thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig /gzhan yang smon lam shis brjod ci rigs bya'o/ /de yang mkhas rlome 'dra'i ngag bgros su mnyam med jo bo chen po lugs kyi brgya rtsa yod par grags kyang / jo bo'i gsung ngo ma mi snang zhing / dge ba'i bshes gnyen po to ba nas brgyud pa'i kha 'bar ma'i lugs la mgron rnams phyogs —310

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64)tsam 'dra na'ang brgya rtsa'i gsal kha med/ /spyan snga ba lugs kyi brgya rtsa ni yul yi dwags 'ba' zhig la bya bar gsungs pas de dag gi khungs mchod pas rna thos 'dra zhing thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po ches chos spyod rnam mkhyen du bgrod pa'i bde lam du/ gtor ma brgya rtsa gtong thabs ni spyir kha 'bar ma'i gzungs rnam pa gnyis la brten nas mdzad cing gzungs ni/ dkon cog gsum la lha bsgos 'bulab la gzungs nyi shu rtsa gcig /drang srong la gtor ma 'bul ba dang yi dwags la gzungs bdun dang de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod de gtor ma sbyin par gsungs pa ma gtogos pa/ brgya rtsa stong rtsa'i grangs nges dang mgron gyi rim pa'i gsal kha gsungs pa med cing bod 4bsgoms kyis grangs nges dang mgron gyi rim pa'i rnam gzhag mi 'dra ba mang du mdzad na'ang zhes pa'i tshig la dbagasan yang jo bo chen po rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍita yin pas don gyis khegs par snang mod/ rgya gar du srol ji ltar yang byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan thugs rje chen pos dngos su rjes su bzung bas 'phags ba'i gsung bzhin bla ma byang chub sems dpa'i rjes su 'brangs te rje btsun chen pos mdzad pas som nyi'i yul min no/ /brgya rtsa'i 'gor dzam bha la dbang bar do sogs kyi chu sbyin sbyar ba 'gal ba med kyang med du mi rung ba'i yan lag min pas zor yangs pa'i ched du ma bkod cing rang gzhan gyi bla ma mang po'i yig char mgron tshan la bar do bsnan pa'i bcu gnyis su mdzad pa phan yon las 'gal ba cher mi snang mod/ 'on kyang rje btsun chen pos mdzad pa'i yig cha la brgya rtsa brgyad du gsungs pa dang rang tshig dngos su 'gal bas ha cang gu yangs dang 'thol du 'gro bar sems so/ /de ltar bya sla don che 'di dang phyi'i/ /ma smad bde skyid 'byung ba'i sgo gcig pu/ /ris med kun la mchod sbyin mu thi la'i/ /'khri shing 'dzad pa med pa nam mkha' mdzod/ /tshul 'di 'chi med 'od gsal 'khon gyi rigs/ /'jam mgon gos dkar zol gyis rdo rje 'dzin/ /rje btsun chen po gsung rab pi wang rgyud/ /'byul med sor rtses bskul ba'i sgra dbyangs snyan/ /mtha' yas bsod nams phung por brtsegs pa'i rdul/ /bye ba phrag brgya'i grangs kyis gzhal min pa/ /yid can ma lus thar pa'i (7na)them skas la/ khrid nas rnam —511

gtor ma brgya rtsa'i rim pa rtsa thi la'i 'khri shing / 9)mkhyen thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /de yang sngon chad brgya rtsa'i chog sgrigs bkod pa le tshan gzhan ngo ma bzlog par dpe hrul dang ngag rgyun 'dra la yid brtan du bzung ba mun pa'i mda' 'phen du mthong nas blo kha ma khengs par yongs 'dzin dam pa chos bzhin du spyod pa du ma'i gsung gi bdud rtsi myangs pas rigs mi 'dra ba'i phyi gtor gyi rnam gzhag mang po khong du chud par byas te 'bri 'dun rim gyis lus pa/ nye char gtor ma brgya rtsa'i rim ba mu thi li'i 'khri shing zhes pa 'di ni don gnyer can mang pos yang bskul zhing / khyad par dbu mdzad blo bzang yon to gyis don gnyer r+sā pos nan gyis bskul ba la brten nas za hor gyi sa lcags phag hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i dmar cha'i bzang po gsum par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sdom brtson rig pa 'dzin pa 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /—312

ga 'a ma brgya rtsa phan bde'i sgo khed/ 9)ra༅gyi//gtor ma brgya rtsa phan bde'i sgo 'byed/phyag na pad+mas rjes bzung zla rgyal gyi//zhal lung 'jam mgon grags pa rgyal mtshan zhabs/gsung bcud snying po 'byer bder rab dril nas//brgya rtsa'i lag len nyung ngu rnam gsal 'bri//de la 'dir rje btsun rin po che'i gsung rab las byung ba ltar zan sum mtshan gsum dang nyis tshan gcig tu bcad pa'i dang po bcu la ril bu ban re dang phyi ma la brgyad byas pa/'byor na dkar gsum mngar gsum bzang sman sna tsho gos rin po che bsre/chu bum ting shags gyis mtshone pa 'du bgyis/khrus dang gtsang sbra sngon du 'gro bas/gtor cha bkram pa chus 'geng zhing grub na zhal zas shig bsham/stan bde bar 'khod nas skyabs sems ni sangs rgyas na༄6cu tshogos ma lan gsum brjod/tshad med bzhi bsgom/rang skad cig gis 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas mag sbyin dang g.yon pad+ma dkar po 'dzin pa/dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tsho gos kyis brgyan pa/zhabs mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs par bsam/mchod pa ni/phyag rgya dang bcas/oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūṃ/oṃ badz+radzā la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañdza ra ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/sa was sbyangs/stong pa ṣ+ka du gyur/stong pa'i 4 las yo las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ dpag tu med pa zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon//zhabs bsil/me tog/bdug spos/mar me/dri chab/zhal zas/rol mo rnams dngas shing thogs pa med pa zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can bskyed par bsam/oṃ a: sa:/oṃ brgyasa3/oṃ badz+ra paPROB sa/ nas/oṃ badz+ra sha lta sa3 gi bar dang /oṃ badz+ra dharmā pa ṇi ta sogs brjod/rang gi thugs ka nasa'od zer 'phros/mchod pa dang sbyin pa'i yul du gyur pa thams cad badz+ra sam dzaḥs phyag rgya dang

rgyal dbang lnga pang ga dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (4)bcas spyan drangs / pad+ma ka ma la ye sto gyis gdan dbul/ a lha nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchode/ bstod par 'os pa thams cad la/ /zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi/ /lus ba khud pa yis rnam kun tu/ /mchog tu dad pas bstod par bgyi/ phyag bya/ mgron tshan dang po ni/ gtor cha lnga'i chu rnams bshams nas/ zan gnyis gnyis blug par chab sbran pa 'og ma bcu la 'gre/ (2ba yi rta me ma brlab pa ni oṃ sa// lan gsum gyis 'dod yon lnga ldan gyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por bsam/ na maḥ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba a ba lo gi te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūṃ/ rgya chen sngags 'di gsum bdun nyer gcig gang rung dang gtor brlab 'og ma rnams la sbyar zhing chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mos mchod pa mgron rigs drug la 'gre/ 'jug pa bde bar 'dod na ma byas kyang chog /bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems slob mar bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo/ /bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog thun gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /gnyis pa ni/ mkha' 'gro sde lnga/ nang gi dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma/phyi'i mgon po gtsang ris kyi dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga/ gtsug lag khang dang dgon gnas skyong bar byed pa'i lha klu 'byung po'i tsho gos la 'bul lo/ /bstan 'gro'i phan bde dang bdag sogs 'khor bcas la rkyen phyi nang gi bar chad thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ gsum pa ni/ lhan cig skyesapa'i lha dang nor lha sogs bdag cag 'khor bcas srung skyob mdzad pa rnams la 'bul lo/ nad dang dbul phongs kyi 'jigs pa med pa dang tshe dpal rgyas pa mdzad du gsol/ bzhi pa ni/ lhan cig skyesapa'i lha dang gnod sbyin nor lha sogs srung skyob mdzad pa po rnams la 'bul lo/ /nad gdon dbul phongs zhi ba dang tshe dpal 'byor ba rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig /lnga pa ni/ 'dzam bu gling gzhi'i bdag po rnams dang khyad par bod khams skyong ba'i bstan ma bcu gnyis/ sgos dbus gtsang ru bzhi/bye brag (3na yul phyogs 'di nyid du gnyug mar gnas pa'i sdebargyad mas bo che rnams la 'bul lo/ /'jig rten gyi khams su char chu dus su 'bab cing lo phyugs rtag tu legs pa nad rims dbul phongs4ba rtsod zhi ba'i wen las mdzod cig khrug pa ni/ gnod sbyin gyi sdod pon 'khor dang bcas—514

gtor ma brgya rtsa phan bde'i sgo tshod/ 9)pa rnams la 'bul lo/ /sems can gyi srog dang gzi mdangs ga pa sogs gnod 'tshe'i bsam pa zhi zhing khyad par bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi 'gal rkyen zhi ba dang mthun rkyen bsam don sgrub par mdzad du gsol/ bdun pa ni/ gong gi byin rlakhas kyis bdud rtsir bsgyur ba ma zad mkho dgu'i yo byad du mos nas rgya chen gyi sngags kyis kyang gang 'dod kyi longs spyod thob par bsam zhing / de bzhin gshegs pa rin cen mang la phyag 'tshal lo/ sku 'jam klas la ྾/ gzugs mdzes dam pa la ྾/'jigs pa thams cad dang bral ba la ྾/ zhes pa 'di man la sbyor/ bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu/ gdon rigs sum brgya drug cu/ byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga/ nad rims kyi bdag mo sogasaganod byed gdon bgegs kyi tshogs la sbyin no/ /bdag sogs sems can thams cad la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i bsam pa spongs la byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par gyur cig /brgyad pa ni/ rigs drug gi sems can rnams la sbyin no/ /des tshim ste rigs drug so so'i bu lon lan chags 'khor nas myur du ma' par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig /dgu pa ni/ yi dwags kyi rgyal mo kha la me 'bar masagatso byas phyi nang zas skom me lce'i sgrib pa can sogs(2ba tsā dwags thams cad la sbyin no/ /zasaskom bdud rtsi'i char chen po babs pas tshim nas ser sna'i sgrib pa dang bral te myur du sangs rgyasathob par gyur cig /bcu pa ni/ bdag cag 'khor bcas la tshe thog ma med pa nas da lta'i bar du mgron lan chags bu lon ma 'khor ba/ tshe 'dir yang phog thug byung ba sogs gdon ngos ma zin pa rnams la sbyin no/ /gtor ma 'dis ro chags sha 'khon byang / gdug rtsub zhi nas re ba skong bar gyur cig /bshal chus btang ba snod cig tu dral lhag ma bzhin ril bu brgyad bshams la/ gtor mar re ba gzhan dbang chung skal ba chad pa/ glo bur lhags pa/ lhag ma dang bshal chur dbang ba rnams la sbyin no/ /so so'i mdun du zad mi shes pa'i zas skom gyis tshim par gyur cig /'dir kha zas mi thob pa'i yi dwags rnams la chu sbyin pa ni/ /gtor cha gcig phyis te/ zan gyi dri tsam yang med par byas/ chu oṃ ā& gis byin gyis brlab/ spyan ras gzigs kyi phyag g.yas kyi bum pa bdud rtsis —515

rgyal dbang lnga gang ga dbang blo sang rgya 4 tsā gsung tsom/ (4)yongs su gang ba nas chu'i rgyun ma chad par byin pas kha 'bar ma la sogs pa'i yi dwags kyi tshogs thams cad tshim par bsam la/oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/mang du brjod/cha gyi/ gis kha la me 'bar ma so gos la chu sbyin/chu thigs shig phyir 'bo zhing se gol gtagos te/cha dzā la mi rda sarba bre te ༷ ཿswāhāsa'ajur gegs la byin nas/'phags pa spyan ras gziṭa dbang gi phyag nas thub pa'i 'o rgyun gyis//yi dwags rnams ni tshim byas nas/khrus byas rtag tu bsil bar shog/chu'i sbyin pa 'di la 4nabarten nas kha 'bar ma dang 'jur gegs la sogs te
